a-nimisa, mfn. \sa. a-nimiṣa], not winking
(said of the eyes); Ja V 34,13 (yakkhānaṁ akkhīni
rattāni honti ~āni); Ud-a 52,9 (Bodhi-rukkhaṁ ~ehi
akkhīhi olokayamāno sattâhaṁ vītināmesi, taṁ
ṭhānaṁ Animisa-cetiyaṁ nāma jātaṁ) — Ps II
184,11 ≠ Ja I 77,30 ≠ As 12,37 ≠ Mhbv 36,1; acc.
n. pl. ~e, Dāṭh V 26 (nayane) — m., a god, a fish,
Abh 12 (pl ~ā); 1044 (~o).

Animisa-cetiya, n. Npr. of a sacred place near
the Bodhi-rukkha (cf. a-nimisa); Ud-a 52,10; Ps II
184,13; Ja I 77,3]..

a-nimisatā, f. abstr. of a-nimisa; instr. ~āya
(akkhīnaṁ), Ja VI 336,39'; 337,10'; 338,32'.

a-nimisa-netta, mfn., with unwinking eyes (as
a god or demon); Ja VI 339,3' (abhīto ~o eso Sakko).

a-niyata, mfn. [ts.], undetermined, uncertain,
doubtful; irregular, casual; dve ~ā dhammā, the two
rules (Vin III 188,17-25**, and 191,27—192,2**) re-
garding undetermined matters (i. e. matters involving
penance only according to circumstances), Vin III
187,1—194,9; I 112,18 (dve ~e uddisitvā); V 8,15 (dve
a-niyatapadaṁ); ~o rāsi, DN III 217,2 (undetermined, i. e. not
coming within the items mentioned; = avasesānaṁ
dhammānaṁ etaṁ nāmaṁ, Sv) = Nett 96,26 ≠ Pp
13,21 (avasesā puggalā ~ā) ≠ Nett 49,20; Tikap
335,15 (micchatta-niyata, sammattaniyata +); 354,25
(~aṁ cittaṁ); ~ā dhammā, Dhs (p. 7,1; As 50,25);
1030; 1414 = 1595; Dhs 584 (~aṁ aniyyānikaṁ);
Ja V 452,17* (uddhatā ~ā asaññatā, scil. pamadă;
= aniyata-cittā, CI, i. e. capricious, changeable);
V 453,25* (gacchatī ~o gaḷāgalaṁ, tumbling, tossing
about); Dhp-a I 431,10 (parihīnajjhānassa . . . ~ā
gati); Ps III 322,4 (senāsanaṁ pan'ettha ~aṁ);
Nett 99,6 (purā veneyyattaṁ [v. r. aniyataṁ, Nett-a
quoted p. XXXVIII n. 27] samatikkamati). —
Aniyata, n. (pl), title of Vin III 187—194 (cf.
°-dvaya, n., Sp (Sṝ) II 445,21); ct. thereon Sp (III)
631—635 (°-(khaṇḍa-) vaṇṇanā); — °kathā, f., title
of Vin-vn 542—50. — °-kālika, mfn., indefinite as to
time; Sadd 56,18. — °-gatika, mfn., whose path
(through the various existences) is uncertain, Dhp-a
III 173,3 (cf. (opp.) niyato sambodhi-parāyano). —
°-citta, mfn., capricious; f. pl. ~ā, Ja V 454,22' (=
'aniyatā'). — °-tta, n. abstr., As 50,25 (~ā aniyatā).
— °-yevāpanaka, m. pl, a class of yevāpanakas
(q. v.) comprising karuṇā, muditā, etc., Nāmar-s
10,8-9. — °-liṅga, mfn., of undetermined gender;
Sadd 78,23. — °-vacana, n., an indefinite (or relative)
pronoun; Pj I 228,12 (yā ti ~aṁ); see aniyamattha
below. — °-saṁkhā, f., an indefinite number; Sadd
18,18. — Aniyat'-uddesa, m., title of Vin III 187—
194 (see Aniyata above).

a-niyama (or a-niyāma, q. v.), m. [ts.], absence
of rule or fixed order, uncertainty; Abh 949; °-vasena,
adv., without rule or order, indiscriminately, in general
(without summoning any certain persons, Tr.), Ja III
532,5 (~ bhikhusaṁgham sannipătetvā). — °-[a]ttha,
mfn., with indefinite sense (ind the sense of the rel.
pron., see aniyāmita); Pay fol. khai 3—4 (said of
aññatara, aññatama; do. ya-saddo); Sadd 266,28;
Ud-a 321,1 (vā-saddo). — °-niddesa, m., (expression
by means of) an indef, or rel. pron, (see aniyāmita);
Ud-a 278,13 (fye keci'); Pj I 134,16 ('yā').

a-niyyātit'-attabhāva, mfn. (cf. niyyāteti), who
has not entrusted pr resigned oneself, Vism 115,29.

a-niyyāna, n., not marching out; DN I 9,31 (=
puna āgamanaṁ(l), Sv). — °-dīpaka, mfn., not
throwing light upon the emancipation, Dhp-a II 209,2
(~ehi padehi). — °-magga, m., a path which does
not lead out (to emancipation; see next); Ps I 237,24
a-niyyāna

a-niyyānika (as to the spelling (a)nīyānika see
Sadd 804,16-24), mfn., 'not leading out' (or to the goal),
not conducive to salvation; dhammo dvākkhāto hoti
duppavedito ~o, SN V 379,29 (spelt anīyāniko); durak-
khàte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite ~e an-upasama-
saṁvattanike (loc. abs.), DN III 118,3 = MN II 244 7
(cf. MN I 67,1 = DN III 119,1); Dhs 584 (aniyataṁ
~aṁ); ~ā dhamma, Dhs p. 6,35 (As 50,23); 1593 (cf.
a-niyyānikadhammesu); Ja VI 287,16' (saggamaggānaṁ adāya-
kaṁ ~aṁ); Ps I 188,21 (ayathāva +;; III 253,4 ad
MN II 33,19 (= 'appāṭihīrakata'); 254,9 (amhākaṁ
katha ~ā); 446,1 (mama laddhi ~ā); 579,16 (~aṁ
sāsanaṁ hoti; cf. III 14,3: ~e pi sāsane); Sp.(HI)
604,15 (uddhammaṁ ubbinayaṁ vilomaṁ ~aṁ satthu
sāsanaṁ bhaveyya). — °-kāraṇa, n., unconclusive
reasoning; Ja I 105,6'-ll'. — °-tta, n. abstr., Sv I
89,16 (abl. ~ā) = Ps III 209,15. — °-bhāva, m.
abstr., Ps II 234,16 (°-kathana, n.).

a-niyāma, m., = aniyama; only instr. ~ena
(adv.), indiscriminately, at random; Ja V 337,26
(nesādo tattha ~ pāse oḍḍeti).

a-niyama (or a-niyāma, q. v.), m. [ts.], absence
of rule or fixed order, uncertainty; Abh 949; °-vasena,
adv., without rule or order, indiscriminately, in general
(without summoning any certain persons, Tr.), Ja III
532,5 (~ bhikhusaṁgham sannipătetvā). — °-[a]ttha,
mfn., with indefinite sense (ind the sense of the rel.
pron., see aniyāmita); Pay fol. khai 3—4 (said of
aññatara, aññatama; do. ya-saddo); Sadd 266,28;
Ud-a 321,1 (vā-saddo). — °-niddesa, m., (expression
by means of) an indef, or rel. pron, (see aniyāmita);
Ud-a 278,13 (fye keci'); Pj I 134,16 ('yā').

a-niyāmita, mfn. (or a-niyamita; cf. niyameti
& niyameti), indefinite, mostly = the sense of the
rel. pron, (which is niyămita by a foll demonstr.);
°-vasena (adv.), Pj I 169,20 ('yaṁ kinci'ti ~ anava-
sesaṁ pariyādiyati). — °-niddesa, m. = a-niyama-
a-niyāmitamfn., nominative of the rel pron., Pj I 236,9 ('yan'ti
~aṁ, opp. niyāmita-upayoga, í. e. acc. of demonstr.
pron. ('taṁ')). — °-pariccheda, m., a term of
indef.-rel quantity, Ja IV 173,26' ('yāvā' ti ~o). —
°-paridīpana, n., expression for 'indefinite', Pj I
104,17 ('ekaṁ samayan' ti ~aṁ); Ud-a 18,30 (do.).
— °-vacana, n., an (indefinite or) relative pronoun,
Pj I 167,4 ('yānîdha bhūtāni samāgatānī' ti ~ena
bhūtāni pariggahetvā); Vv-a 231,8 (aniyămita°); —
°-samkhā-niddesa, m., expression for an indefinite
number, Pj I 123 7 ('balm'). — °âlapana, n. addres-
sing no certain person, Ja III 177,18' ('passā' ti ~aṁ).
— [aniyāmif]-uddesa-vacana, n., = aniyāmita-
vacana, Pj I 184,13 ('ye').

a-nirassāda, mfn., not dissatisfied; Vism 135,16
(~aṁ . . . cittaṁ, alīnaṁ anuddhataṁ +).

a-nirākata-jjhāna, mfn., one who is not inter-
rupted or disturbed in his religious meditation; It 39,11
(ajjhattaṁ cetosamatham anuyuttā ~ā, etc.; = bahi
anīhata-jjhānā avināsita-jjhānā vā, It-a) ≠ MN I
33,10 ≠ 216,31 ≠ AN V 131,14 ≠ Nidd I 375,5
a-nirākata-jjhāna

a-niruddha, mfn. [ts.], unobstructed, not checked,
not ceased; MN I 455,1 (upekhāsukhaṁ ~aṁ hoti). —
°-patha, m. [ts.], the sky, MTD.

anila, m. [ts.], air or wind; Abh 37; Ja II 219,21*
(giri-m-eva ~ena duppasaho); V 418,3**= 422,13** (~o
viya yena-kămaṁ-gamāyo). — Ifc. v. lokadhammâ°,
hadayâ°. — — °-jaIa-vega-sañchādita, mfn.,
anila116,12 (gaganaṁ ~aṁ; Hīnaṭ renders vega by pra-
vega; read bala-vega- for jala-v°?) — °-java, mfn.,
(running) with the speed of the wind, Mil 141,16
(assâjāniyo . . . sīghagati ~o). — °-ñjasa, m(77).
(anila + 2añjasa), 'the wind's path', the air, space;
Bv I 31 (ambare ~e); Ap 253,24 (do.); āgacchi ~ā
[instr, as from *anilañjas-, cf. añjasā, ind.], Ap 381,1;
loc. ~e (gacchantaṁ), Ap 409,14. — °-ñjasâsaṁ-
khubbha, mfn. (id. + a-saṁkhubbha), imperturbable
as the space; Ap 113,26 (~o yathi ākāso asaṁ-
khiyo; scan anilañjasa-asaṁkh°) = Th-a (Ce) 494,17*
(anilañjaso va sambuddho!). — °-pacupita, mfn.
[sa. pracupita; cf. copeti], see anila-pamuccita below.
— °-patha, m., = anilañjasa; Abh 46; Ja III
377,22 (~ena ... agamāsi) ≠ IV 119,4; III 382,20'
(hatthato muttā sakuṇī ~aṁ laṁghayitvā). —
°-pamuccita, mfn. and °pamuñcita, etc., unmelrical
readings at Vv 622 (~ā (metr. °pamucitā) pavāyanti
(melr. pavanti) surabhiṁ; Vv-a: anilapavūsitā [v. l.
°padhūpitā ɔ: °pacupitā, q. v. = set in gentle move-
ment by the wind] ti pi paṭhanti, vātena mandaṁ
(so Ce) ādhūyamāna-hemamaya-pupphā ti attho);
— -pariyāya, m. [sa. °-paryăya], swelling of the
eyelids, MTD. — °-bala, n., the power of the wind;
Mil 161,14 (°-vegâbhihata, mfn., struck by the violence
of a°, scil. rukkho); 181,6 (°-samāhata, mfn., struck
or carried away by a°, scil. rajo); 254,18 (do., scil.
mahatimahārukkhe). — °-sakha, m. [ts.], 'friend
of wind', fire, MTD. — °-âmaya, m. [ts.], distending
of the stomach, MTD. Cf. āmaya. — °-âyana, n.
[ts.], = anilañjasa, Ap 157,1 (ambare ~e). Cf. ayana.
— °-âsayana, n., the sky (misreading of prer.1),
MTD. Cf. āsaya.

anilêrita, mfn.. (anila + īrita or erita), moved
by the wind, Ja V 404,1* (~ā lohitapattamālinī).

a-nilīna-manasa, mfn., not niggardly (Tr.), Ja
VI 569,32 (so Cks; Ee, Se & Bd anolīna-mānasa).

anilûpama-samuppāta, mfn. (anila + upama
+ s°), swift like the wind, Ja VI 223,15* (pl. ~ā, scil.
sindḥavā hayā; = vātasadisavegā, Ct.; Ee °-samup-
padā; Se anīluppa-°).

a-nivattana, n. (cf. sa. a-nivartana, mfn.), the
not turning back (esp. to the worldly life); abl. gatassa
~ato, Th-a (Ce) 464,25 ad Th 451; °atthaṁ, for the
sake of ~, Pj II 114,26. — °-tā, f. abstr., see Tr.
a-nivattanaback, not fleeing, Ja I 263,13. — °-bhāva, m. abstr.,
Ja I 470.29'. — °-sabhāva, mfn., having the nature
of ~, ib. 32'. — °-saraṇa, n., the refuge for ever,
Mp III 344,13. — °-sīla, n., a steadfast moral con-
duct, ib. 16.

a-nivattanīya-gamana, n., going away for ever;
Dhp-a I 63,9.

Anivatta-Brahmadatta, 77?. Npr. of a king in
Benares, Pj II 114,16.

a-nivattam, ind. (cf. nivatta), incessantly, Mhv
(see Index to Cūlavaṁsa p. 636, without reference).

a-nivatti(n), mfn. [sa. anivartin], (a) not turning
a-nivattinmacariya-parāyano; Mp) — III 75,14* (Mp); pl. ~ino
hutvā yujjhatha, Ja III 5,23; — an-avatti(n), Ja
VI 573,2* (Lk; E? anibbattī, q. v.). — (b) incorrigible;
Ps III 115,21 (atekiccha +) = III 545,2.

a-nivattika, mfn., = 'anivatti(n)', Mp II 243,4
Se a-nivattaka, Ee anibbattaka, cf. Ja VI 573,2*);
III 36,21 ad AN III 75,14*; yāva lokappavatti, tāva
~ā dhammā, Pj I 153,10 (= 'loka-dhammā').

a-nivattita-ggahaṇa, mfn., with a firm grasp,
grasping per sever ingly, Sv (III) 919,23 ad DN III
145,24 (= 'avatthita-samādāna').

a-nivatti-dhamma, mfn., = anivattana-dham-
ma, trustworthy, true to one's word, Ps III 517,11
(tesaṁ cittaṁ upatthambhetvā ~e katvā) = Sp
ad Vin V 201,12-13.

a-nivatti(n), mfn. [sa. anivartin], (a) not turning
a-nivattinmacariya-parāyano; Mp) — III 75,14* (Mp); pl. ~ino
hutvā yujjhatha, Ja III 5,23; — an-avatti(n), Ja
VI 573,2* (Lk; E? anibbattī, q. v.). — (b) incorrigible;
Ps III 115,21 (atekiccha +) = III 545,2.

a-nivatti-mānasa, mfn., of resolute mind, Bv
XXII 15 (Ee anivatta-m°; = an-osakkiyamāna-
mānasa, Bv-a).

a-nivattiya, mfn., (a) neg. grd. from nivatteti;
(b) = a-nivattika; in Saddh 13 (pāpikaṁ diṭṭhiṁ
sabbathā ~iyaṁ). — °-yodha, m., a soldier who does
not turn back, Mp III 226,15 ad AN IV 107,14 (=
'mahānāgā') = Sv I 157,1 (Ee anivattita-°).

Anivalakki, m. Npr. of a place in Southern India,
Mhv LXXVI 235 (koṭṭaṁ ~iṁ), 276, 293—4, 303.

a-niviṭṭha, mfn., 'not placed', f. unmarried; Mp
III 188,2 (pl. ~ā, explaining kula-kumāriyo, AN IV
16,25). Cf. a-nibbiṭṭha.

a-nivuṭṭha, mfn., not having dwelt in; n. abstr.
°tta, Sadd 95,17 (ācariya-kule; cf. Ja I 436,19*).

a-nivesana, mfn. [sa. a-niveçana], homeless, not
attached to worldly things; Dhp 40 (= anālaya, Dhp-a).

a-nisamma, neg. abs. (from ni + √çam, see nisā-
meti), not hearing (considering or minding), Abh 738;
Ja III 106,1* (= a-nisāmetvā, Ct.); ~ kataṁ kam-
maṁ, a thoughtless act, Ja IV 451,1*. — °-kāri(n), mfn.,
acting inconsiderately, reckless; m. ~ī, Abh 729 (=
a-nisamma441,26* (khattiyāse).

a-nissaggiya, mfn., not (necessarily) to be aban-
doned; instr, (adv.) ~ena, Vin I 255,12 (atthataṁ hoti
kaṭhinaṁ, cf. Trsl. II 156,11).

a-nissaṭa, mfn. (cf. sa. nih-sṛta), not gone out;
Ud 33,9 (ete ~ā bhavasmā; Ud-a), cf. Mvu II 418,8-9;

a-nissaṭṭha, mfn., not given up, not abandoned
or handed over; a-dinnaṁ +, Vin III 46,32' (= attano
hatthato vā yathā-ṭhita-ṭṭhānato vā na nissaṭ-
ṭhaṁ, Sp).

a-nissaya, mfn., without supplies or habitations,
barren, desolate; Abh 886 (°-mahī-bhāga, = 'īriṇa').

an-issara, mfn. [sa. an-īçvara], (a) not owner
or master, powerless; m. ~o, Mil 253,4 (+ assāmī
avasavattī); Ja V 18,21' (= 'anesamāno'); VI 106,11'
(ahaṁ attano ~o hutvā); VI 516,29' (rājâpi ~o);
Mp III 54,3 ad AN III 136,14 (~o va samāno);
an-issaraasmiṁ] sarīre ~ā), Ja III 57,20*. — (b), without a
lord or master, ownerless; Dhp-a III 407,8 (suññā
assāmikā ~ā, scil. sabbe dhammā); Sp (III) 561,18

Th 713 (sabbaṁ ~aṁ etaṁ, iti vuttaṁ mahesinā,

a-nissaraṇa, n., in the foll. comp.s: °-das-
sāvi(n), mfn., seeing no escape; m. ~ī, Th 732
(cf. anādīnava-dassāvi(n) and anissaraṇapañña); —
°-dassi(n), mfn., id.; gen. ~ino, SN IV 205,21*-23*;
— °-pañña, mfn., not knowing how to escape;
gathita +, DN I 245,25 (Sv) = MN I 173,28 (Ps) ≠
DN III 43,29 (Sv) = AN I 274,21 (Mp) ≠ SN IV
332,29.

an-issara-tā, f. abstr. [sa. an-īçvaratā], the not
being one's own master; Mil 180,30 (vacana-karo ~āya,
scil. apacitim na karoti).

an-issara-vikappi(n), mfn., one who makes
arrangements though not himself being the master;
asanthava-vissāsī + ~ī, AN III 136,14 foll. (Mp).an-issara-vikappin

an-issara-vikappi(n), mfn., one who makes
arrangements though not himself being the master;
asanthava-vissāsī + ~ī, AN III 136,14 foll. (Mp).an-issara-vikappin

an-issariya, mfn., not to be controlled(1); abl.
~ato, Nidd II 279,31 (= attano issariye avasavatta-

an-issā, f., freedom from envy; MN I 44,20;
45,30; AN I 95,23 foll. (~ā ca a-macchariyañ ca). —

21,27.an-issāyana

811; ñatvā dhammaṁ ~o, ib. 856 = 947; pubbam

anu-kampana, n. [ts.], compassion; Abh 1193
('handa' hāse ~e); abl. [~ā, Pv-a 88,6; prob. w. r. for
anukampamānā, Ce]; ~ato (pacchimaṁ janataṁ ~),
Ps II 236,2. — °-sīla, mfn., compassionate, Pv-a 16,2
(= 'anukampaka').

anu-kampā, f. [ts.], compassion, pity; kindness;
Abh 160; with gen. or loc. pers., Vin III 42,15 (pāṇesu
anuddayā ~ā; = paradukkhena citta-kampanā, Sp);
Sv (II) 456,31 (ad DN II 28,33,= mettāya pubba-
bhāgo); anukampana-vasena ~ā, Nidd-a II 190,6 (ad
Nidd I 488,11) = As 362,10 (ad Dhs 1056); atthi me
tumhesu ~ā, MN I 12,16; atthi me kumāre ~ā,
MN I 395,1 (cf. 2 3); ~ā no katā . . . tayā, Mhv I
anu-kampā~ā, AN I 92,29; acc. ~aṁ (anuddayam, anurak-
khaṁ+), SN IV 323,22 foll.; frequently in the
phrase ~aṁ upādāya, out of pity or kindness, Ud 25,21
(atthakāma +); AN III 37,19; IV 265,10; MN II
238.22 (dhammaṁ deseti) ≠ III 117,21 = 221,6;
MN II 265,36 (yaṁ Satthārā karanīyaṁ sāvakānaṁ
~) = III 302,7 = SN IV 359,19 (Spk) = V 157,24
= AN IV 139,24; with imper. = 'please', 'kindly'
. . . : upasaṁkamatu ~, DN I 204,16 (quoted Ud-a 7,1)
≠ MN I 161,15 ≠ II 192,10 ≠ III 153,6 ≠ AN
I 64,28 ≠ II 145,7; paṭigaṇhātu ~, DN II 133,13
(= mayi ~aṁ paticca, Sv) ≠ MN II 116,32 ≠
AN III 49,17; MN'il 113,9; SN II 199,25 (kāruñ-
ñaṁ . . . anudayam paṭicca +; = muducittataṁ,
Spk); abl. (or dat.) ~āya, Th 492 (pāṇinaṁ) =
1258; 560 (me); 1223 (nibbāpanaṁ brūhi ~); Thī 136
(so me dhammaṁ adesesi ~) ≠ 148 ≠ 155; AN I
98.20 (gihīnaṁ, dat., cf. ib. 22); AN I 125,8 (aññatra
anuddayā ~ā(ya), quoted Dhp-a II 24,6) — Pp 35,20;
AN II 176,33 (dat. pāṇānaṁ anuddayāya ~āya paṭi-
panno); Ja III 280,18 (tava); IV 471,16* (tass' eva);
Cp I 9,38 (~āya dārake; sg. for pl. dārakesu, or
anukampāya governing the acc. ɔ: anukampitvā?;
quoted Ja VI 514,8*); Ud-a 196,32 (sattesu); Dhp-a
I 166,11. (taṁ ... ~āya paṭijaggi); Pv-a 47,13
(tassā); 147,20 (do.); Mil 129,18 (tassa kulassa);
224,16 (janakāyassa). — Ifc. v. āmisâ°, dhammâ°,
bhūtâ°, mittâ°, lokâ°, sâ°. — — °-jātika, mfn.,
merciful; MN II 205,5 foll. (~aṁ dānam).

anu-kampi(n), mfn. [ts.], sympathizing with
(acc), compassionate; m. ~ī, Th 334 (if not aor. 3 sg.);
It 21,10* (with acc. sabbe va pane manasâ°, v. l. anu-
kampaṁ) = AN IV 151,3* (v. l. do., quoted Pj I
168,18*); [Ap 35,13 (~ī and aṁ, w. rr. for anukampa)].
— Ifc. v. ahitâ°, sabbabhūtâ°, sabbalokâ°, hitâ°.

anu-kampita, mfn. (pp. of anu-kampati) [ts.],
favoured, pitied, compassionated; Ap 507,24 (sumit-
tenâ° ~o); 538,20 (sugatenâ° ~ā); 538,29 (~itā
amha[ṁ], Ce anukampikā) = Thī-a 152,23* (CeEe);
Pv 429 (anukampif amha). — Ifc. v. therâ°,
devatâ°, navâ°, majjhimâ°, satthâ°; — — °-rūpa,
mfn., id.; MN I 23,37 (°âyaṁ bhotā Gotamena
pacchimā janatā; = °-jātika, °-sabhāva, Ps I
129,14-15).

anu-kampi(n), mfn. [ts.], sympathizing with
(acc), compassionate; m. ~ī, Th 334 (if not aor. 3 sg.);
It 21,10* (with acc. sabbe va pane manasâ°, v. l. anu-
kampaṁ) = AN IV 151,3* (v. l. do., quoted Pj I
168,18*); [Ap 35,13 (~ī and aṁ, w. rr. for anukampa)].
— Ifc. v. ahitâ°, sabbabhūtâ°, sabbalokâ°, hitâ°.

anu-karaṇa, n. [ts.], imitation; = √anuvidhā,
Sadd 484,20 (= anukiriyā, ib.); Ud-a 29,20 (°-va-
sena); Sadd 262,11 (°-mattaṁ etaṁ, cf. next); —
°-sadda, m., an onomalopoetic word; Ud-a 66,23;
67.21 ('akkula-pakkula', Ee anu-kār°!); Sadd 642,15.anu-karaṇa

anu-karoti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu + √kṛḷ; 3 pl.
anu-kubbanti « kurvanti), hence a possible 3 sg.
anu-kubbati (not in our texts), cf. part, anu-
kubbaṁ; (a) to do after or in return; (b) to imitate;
(c) to equal, to emulate (with gen. pers.); Sn 221
(gihī nânukaroti bhikkhuno, c); Ja V 434,2** (ka-
taṁ anu-karoti, b; Ct. ib. 436,29') quoted Dhp-a
anu-karoti211.23 foll. (Mp) ≠ IV 249,7 foll. = 388,19 foll.;
pr. 3 pl. anukubbanti (duddadaṁ dadamānānaṁ . . .
asanto nâ°, c), SN I 19,4* = Ja IV 65,8* (Ct. tesam
gatamaggaṁ nânugacchanti) = VI 571,16*; passa-
mānâ°, (b), AN I 153,1* = III 44,23*; — part. m.
anukubbaṁ (mamâ°, c), Vin II 201,24,27* (cf. anu-
kubba, mfn. below) ≠ Ja I 491,15 (mama anukaronto)
≠ II 162,15 (mayhaṁ anukaronto) ≠ III 112,20
(tumhākaṁ anukaronto); tassânukaraṁ, (c), Ja II
150,14* (= tassa anukaronto, Ct.) quoted Dhp-a I
144,11*; gen. m. °-kubbantassa, (a), Ja II 205,19' (=
'anukubbassa'); III 108,26' (do.).

(anu-kasati), pr. 3 sg. [anu + √kṛṣ], to adduce,
recite, quote; fut. 1 sg. anukassāmi, DN II 255,23*
(silokaṁ ~; = akkhara-pada-niyamitaṁ vacana-
saṁghāṭaṁ pavattayissāmi, Sv);

an-ukkaṭṭha-cīvara, n., not a (mendicants)
robe stricto sensu; Vism 64,2 (cf. ukkaṭṭha, paṁ-
sukūlika).

an-ukka[ṭ]ṭhita, mfn. (an + pp. of ut + √kvath)
not boiling, not come to a boil; AN III 234,15 (uda-
patto agginā a-santatto ~o an-ussadaka-jāto).

an-ukkaṇṭhanā, f. (cf. ukkaṇṭhati & next),
contentment, patience; Ja VI 4,26 (°-atthāya); Mp III
120,19 (~ā appaṭisaṁ(g)haraṇā = 'appaṭivānī').

an-ukkaṇṭhita, mfn., not coveting, not longing,
content, pleased; ramanti abhiramanti ~ā hutvā niva-
santi, Pj I 112,5 = Ps I 60,19; abhiramamānā va ~ā
va, Ja III 58,5; ~ā vasatha, Pv-a 13,29. — an-
ukkaṇṭhitā, f. abstr., Nidd II 235,24 (°âdhivacanaṁ,
scil. 'rati'). Cf. ukkaṇṭhitā, f.an-ukkaṇṭhita

anu-kkama, m. [sa. anukrama], (a) succession,
order; instr, iminā ~ena, Pj I 88,30; 201,13; 216,18;
frequently ~ena, adv., in due course, gradually, by
and by, Ja I 157,3; 255,22; 262,20; 290,3; VI 275,6;
Dhp-a I 84,19; III 20,3; Ud-a 240,17; 408,10; Th-a ad
Th 727 (= 'anupubbaṁ'); Ps I 249,11; Pv-a 5,30;
Mhv XIV 38 (v. l.), etc. etc. — (b) a certain element
in the training of war-horses; loc. ~e MN I 446,17
anu-kkamaca nikkhipane ca, etc.). — Ifc. v. anusayâ°, jeṭṭhâ°,
desanâ°, bhavâ°, bhāvanâ°, vuttâ°, sah'-°. —
°-âgata, mfn., handed down in this order; Ps II
199,27 (~aṁ . . . pāḷipadaṁ; Ee anukkamagatam).

anu-kkamati, pr. 3 sg. [anu + √kram], to go
after, to step along, to follow; metaph, to conceive,
understand; 3 pl. ~anti, (sudesitaṁ maggaṁ), It
80,8* (= anugacchanti, paṭipajjanti, It-a); part. m.
~aṁ, AN III 41,8* (= anukkamanto, Mp); Vv 742
(= gacchanto, Vv-a); part. med. ~amāno, AN V 195,2
(anupariyāyapathaṁ); pot. 3 sg. ~e (hatthikkhan-
dhâvapatitaṁ, I. e. walk over, trample upon), Th 194;
inf. ~itave, SN I 24,8* (na-y-idaṁ bhāsita-mattena
. . . ~ (Ee anukkamituṁ ve) sakkā; = okkamituṁ,
paṭipajjituṁ, Spk); abs. ~itvā, Ps II 336,13 (ito vā
etto vā); intens. anucaṅkamati, q. v.

an-ukkhitta, mfn. (an + pp. of ukkhipati), not
suspended, not excluded or expelled; Sp (Se II 409,1)
ad Vin IV 82,30'; Vin-vn 505.

anu-kkhipati, pr. 3 sg. [anu + √kṣip], to throw
along, to trundle; part. m. vaṭṭaṁ ~aṁ, Cp III 11,6
( = bheṇḍuka-kīḷaṁ kīḷanto ti attho, Cp-a; cf. Ja
IV 30,27); grd. ~itabba, see next.

anu-kkhepa, m., compensation (Utt. throwing
back, delivering in return, cf. anu-kkhipati); Vin I
285,30 (~e dinne; anukkhepo nāma yaṁ kiñci anu-
kkhipítabbaṁ anu-ppadātabbaṁ kappiya-bhandaṁ,

anu-kāma, mfn. [sa. ts. with different sense],
loving in return, enamoured; instr, f. & m. anukā-
māyânukāmena . . . saha, Ja II 157,22* (Ee anukā-
măyâ°, Se anukāmayakāmena; cf. ib. n. 20 and Ct.).

anu-kāra, m. [ts.], imitation, resemblance; Dīp
V 39 (tesañ ca ~ena; quoted Kv-a 4,3* and Sp-t ad

anu-kāraṇa, n., a secondary tenet; Sv (II) 349,18

kathenti); [also w. r. for anu-karaṇa, q. v.]

anu-kiṇṇa, mfn. (pp. of next; sa. anu-kīrṇa),

gaṇâ°, rajâ°.

[anu-kirati], pr. 3 sg. [anu + √kṛ], (a) to scatter

tîti [read: anvākiri, saṁyojayîti] attho, Ct.; Se

anu-kiriyā, f. [sa. anu-kriyā], imitation, mimi-

anu-kubba, mfn. (from the present stem in

kūla°, Sv I 302,29 reads anukula°); AN II 43,28
(niccadānaṁ ~aṁ; anukūla° Ed.). Cf. prec.

anu-kūla, mfn. [ts.], sometimes wrongly spelt

(jātassarassânukūlā ketakā, but v. l. anukulaṁ ɔ: °kū-
lam); 368,25 (~ ā ketakā, v. l. anukūle). — (2) (a)

ṇaḍḍho ~o); Mhv X 1,5 (duve dhītā ca anukūlā (so

anu-kūlaṁ

anu-kūlaṁ, ind., along the beach; Ap 347,1

anu-kūla-kiriya, mfn., = anukula-vatti(n),

anu-kūla-bhāva, m., compliance, deference;
Dhp-a III 162,21 ; Vv-a 71,18 (sāmikassa ~ena vat-
tanasīlā).

anu-kūla-mitta, m., an agreeable or faithful

anu-kūla-vatti(n), mfn., compliant, being at

anu-kūla-vatti(n), mfn., compliant, being at
anu-kūla-vattinwith Tr. & Se for °-vattanī, Ee; — 'kāmakaro');
Pj II 28,21 (samānena ~inā parijanena saddhiṁ vāso
yassa, so 'samānavāso').

Anukevaṭta, m. Npr. of a brāhmaṇa (cf. Ke-
vaṭṭa); Ja VI 406,8; 407,29 foll.

anu-khaṇati, pr. 3 sg. [anu + √khan], to dig
after (or deeper); pot. 3 sg. ~ṇe, Ja V 233,13* (= anu-
khaṇeyya, Ct.).

anu-khuddaka, mfn. (abstracted from khuddâ-
nukhuddaka), minor, less important; ~āni sikkhā-

ib. 5 (quoted Sv (II) 592,26). — Ifc. v. khuddâ°.

anu-ga, mfn. [ts.], going after, following, with

dheyyasarâ°, vasâ° (atthacintā-°, chanda-°, bad-

anu-gacchati, pr. 3 sg. [anu + √gam & √gā],

anu-gati, f. [ts.], going after, following; ifc. v.

an-upanahinSN II 207,12; AN V 124,16; 125,20; Ja IV 463,20*
(anūpanāhī, metr.); — SN IV 244,7 (saddho, hirimā,
ottāpī +); also title of the sutta, ib.

an-upanahi(n) (once in verse an-ūpa°), mfn.
(from prec), not rancorous; akkodhano + ~ī: Th 502
an-upanahinSN II 207,12; AN V 124,16; 125,20; Ja IV 463,20*
(anūpanāhī, metr.); — SN IV 244,7 (saddho, hirimā,
ottāpī +); also title of the sutta, ib.

anu-panthe, ind., along the road, on the side
of the road; Ja V 302,24*; 303,17' (so Cks and Se;
Ee (B) against metre anu-pathe, cf. Mvu III 20,8*).

anu-panna, mfn. (pp. of anu-pajjati), entered,
appeared, following; Ja VI 216,24' (°brāhmaṇānaṁ
vacana-pathaṁ ~ā, Mss. anuppannā, or perhaps for
anu-ppattā, cf. Ja VI 417,3'). — Ifc. v. kavyapathâ°,
panthâ°, māradheyyâ°.

an-upanāmita, mfn., not delivered; Sp (Se) II
409,1 ad Vin IV 82,30'.

an-upanisa, mfn. (a) (cf. upanisā in the sense
of upanissaya, i. e. paccaya), unconditioned; SN II
30,2 foll. (opp. sa-upanisa, see Spk II 53,19); —
(b) (cf. çraddhayā upaniṣadā, Chāndogya-up. I 1,jo),
not attentive (to a guru); AN I 198,26-27 (an-ohita-
soto . . . ~o hoti); cf. Sn 322 & AN IV 391,13.

an-upanissaya, mfn., unqualified (for Arhat-
ship); Ps II 105,4 (opp. sa-upanissaya).

an-upanissaya-sampanna, mfn., not endowed
with qualifications (for Arhatship); Pj I 175,7.

an-upanīta (once in verse an-ūpa°), mfn. (neg.
pp. of upa + √nī), (a) not led near or into, not ad-
duced, not propounded; Sn 846 (anūpanīto so nivesa-
nesu; Pj, cf. AN III 359,28*); Vin I 185,10 = AN III
359,25 (attho ca vutto, attā ca ~o, see attūpanāyika);
an-upanīta'adantaṁ'). — (b) not initiated, not having received
brahmanical education; MN II 154,5 (an-ajjhāyako
+ ~o).

an-upaneyya, neg. abs. of upa + √nī (or neg.
pot. 3 sg.?), not having presented, Sn 799 (samo ti
attānaṁ ~; = sadiso 'ham asmī ti attānaṁ na upa-
neyya, Nidd, see an-upanīta (a)).

an-upapatti, f., not entering into a new existence;
Paṭis 111,5 foll.

an-upapattika, mfn., not leading to re-birth;
+ a-ppaṭisandhika, Spk II 371,24 ad SN IV 57,26 =
Ps III 725,15 ad MN III 264,26 (= 'anupavajja', q. v.;
w. rr. anuppattika, apapavattika, anupavattika).

an-upapada, m., not a first member of a com-
pound; Kacc-v 392; Sadd 491,30.

an-upapanna, mfn. [ts.], (a) who has not entered
upon or into, not reborn in (acc); SN IV 400,2 (añña-
taraṁ kāyaṁ ~o; Ee anuppanno; Spk); AN V 270,23
(taṁ ṭhānaṁ ~o; v. l. anuppanno); — (b) not
accomplished (in, instr.); AN II 6,25 (sutena~o; Ee
an-upapannahence: without competence, etc.: DN I 97,22 (mātito
. . . ~o, not of pure descent on the mother's side; Ee
anuppanno; — khattiyavaṁsaṁ appatto apari-
suddho, Sv); — (c) in gramm. = not to be formed
accord, to the given rules (said of words given as
nipāta), Kacc 393; (quoted Sadd 800,17). — Cf. an-
uppanna.

anu-pabbajati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu + pra +
√vraj], to adopt a homeless life after or in imitation of
another; 3 pl. ~anti (Bhagavantaṁ pabbajitaṁ), Vin
II 180,6; part. m. pl. ~antā (Bhagavantaṁ ~ nikkha-
miṁsu), Mil 108,2; aor. 1 sg. ~iṁ (ahaṁ taṁ), Ap
anu-pabbajatiagārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajitaṁ ~), DN II 30,11;
cf. Kacc-v 301; fut. 1 sg. ~issāmi (taṁ purisaṁ ~),
Ja I 56,32; 1 pl. ~issāma, DN II 244,9* (v. l.); pp.
anu-pabbajita, q. v.

anu-pabbajjā, f. (from prec), adopting a homeless
life after another; It 107,11 (~aṁ pâhaṁ . . . tesaṁ
bhikkhūnaṁ bahukāraṁ vadāmi; It-a) = SN V 67,21
(Spk), quoted Ps I 160,6; Ap 49,23 (nikkhantenânu-
pabbajjaṁ ... mayā) = Th-a (Ce) II 3,13*; Dhp-a
I 105,17 (~aṁ pabbajitvā, paron.); Anāg 65 (Met-
teyyassânupabbajjaṁ pabbajissanti, paron.).

anu-pabbajita, mfn. (pp. of anu-pabbajati),
who has adopted a homeless life after another; n. pl.
~āni (°sahassāni), Sv (II) 457,22 (Ee anupabbajjitā
ti); gen. pl. ~ānaṁ (gaṇanā na vijjati), Mhv V 168.

an-upama (or with rhythmical lengthening an-
ūpama & an-opama, q. v.), mfn. [ts.], incomparable,
peerless; excellent, highest; Mil 156,15 (asama -√);
246,13 (sāra, vara, etc. +); 278,18 (Buddho ati-agga-
an-upama(~ena Buddha-vesena).

(anu-pamodati), pr. 3 sg., to rejoice together
with; part med. ~amāno, Pj II 378,22 (= 'anu-
modamāno', ɔ: anupadam modamāno?).

an-uparama, m., not stopping, non cessation; abl.
~ā, Mil 44,26.

anu-parigacchati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu + pari +

(acc); part. f. sg. ~antī, Dhp-a I 416,14 (pāsādaṁ;

sg. ~eyya, Spk III 181,7 (= 'anuparisakkeyya', SN
anu-parigacchati(= parito parito agamāsi, Pj) = SN I 124,5*; do. 3 pl.
for °~guṁ, It 21,13* (rājîsayo yajamānâ°) = AN IV
151,6* (Ee anupariyayā, v. l. anucariyagā; = vica-

tuṁ, Vin III 151,21'; abs. (a ) ~gamma (sabbā disā),
Ud 47,21* (Ud-a) = SN I 75,25*; (b) ~gantvā, Vin
III 119,28 (gabbhaṁ); Ja IV 267,26 (gumbaṁ); Ps
III 390,9 (mahantaṁ gacchaṁ).

anu-paridhāvati, pr. 3 sg. [aṇu + pari +
√dhāv], to run round and round (acc); MN II 233,1
(sā gaddūla-baddho . . . khīlaṁ vā thambhaṁ vā ~
+ anuparivattati) ≠ SN III 150,9 foll.; 3 pl. ~anti
(+ anuparivattanti), MN II 232,24; 233,3; III 72,27
foll; part. m. ~aṁ, SN III 150,18.

anu-paridhāvana, n. nomen actionis of prec;
Ps III 435,15 (ad MN II 232,24 foll).

anu-paripphuṭa, mfn. [anu + pari + sa. sphuṭa,
pp. of √sphar], pervaded throughout; As 117,3 (sakala-
sarīraṁ . . . ~aṁ hoti) = Vism 144,25.

anu-pariyante, ind. (anu + pariyanta, loc), all
round the boundaries (of.,ifc. devalokâ°, Ap 307,12).

anu-pariyāti (or anu-pariyāyati, q. v.), pr. 3 sg.
[sa. anu + pari + √yā], to go round about; Ja V
anu-pariyātiJa VI 121,6* = 122,2* (najjo ca ~; cf. ib. 121,22'
and Sadd 739,14); Dhp-a I 417,10 (pāsādaṁ ~; v. l.

Mhv XVII 40 (~ taṁ thānaṁ); 3 pl. ~anti, AN IV
254,26*; Ja V 322,17* (samantā); Pv 434 (udakas-
miṁ ~ (metre faulty); — anuvicaranti, Pv-a); —

~). — Cf. anu-pariyeti.

anu-pariyāya, m. (from prec.), walking round;
Dhp-a I 416,14 (~aṁ gacchanti, v. l. for anuparigac-
chanti, q.v.); — °-patha, m., a path leading round
(within the parapet of a fortress); AN IV 107,2 =
109,26 (~o hoti ucco c'eva vitthato ca; = anto-
pākārena saddhiṁ gato mahāpatho, yattha ṭhitā
bahi-pākāre ṭhitehi saddhiṁ yujjhanti, Mp); acc.
~aṁ (samantā ~ anukkamamāno), DN II 83,12 =
III 101,4 (= anupariyāya-nāmakaṁ pākāra-maggaṁ,

anu-pariyāyati, pr. 3 sg. = anu-pariyāti (q. v.);
Spk I 175,29; part. acc. m. pl. ~ante, Ja VI 279,5'
(= 'anupariyante'); pot. 3 pl. ~eyyuṁ, Mil 38,30
(taṁ yeva ~); aor. 3 sg. ~āyi (sattakkhattuṁ),
Dhp-a III 202,17; abs. ~āyitvā (āḷāhanaṁ), Pv-a
92,25.

anu-pariyāti (or anu-pariyāyati, q. v.), pr. 3 sg.
[sa. anu + pari + √yā], to go round about; Ja V
anu-pariyātiJa VI 121,6* = 122,2* (najjo ca ~; cf. ib. 121,22'

aor. 3 sg. ~āsi, Vin II 111,19 (tikkhattuṁ Rājagahaṁ
~). — Cf. anu-pariyeti.

anu-pariyeti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu + pari + √i;
cf. anu-pariyāti, which may be scanned ˇ ˇ - - ˇ
except perhaps at AN IV 254,26* and (the corrupt)

(samantā ~ sāgarantaṁ mahiṁ imaṁ); Th 1250 =

anu-parivatta, m. (anu + sa. parivarta),
turning after (in conformity with); only °-ja, mfn.,

(aṭṭha lokadhammā lokaṁ ~) = IV 157,3; Sp I
anu-parivattatica Bodhisatto ca ekato ~anti); part. m. ~aṁ, SN
III 150,18.

anu-parivattana, n. (anu + sa. parivartana)
— anu-parivatta above; Ps III 669,18 ad MN III
227,32. — Ifc. v. ādiccâ° (Mp II 32,13).

anu-parivatti(n), mfn. (anu + sa. parivartin),
following in moving, conforming to; only in comp.
rūpa-vipariṇāmâ°, etc. MN III 227,32 (°ânuparivatti
anu-parivattin

anu-parivattin

anu-parivattiyati, 3 sg. pass, of anu-parivattati

anu-parivatteti, pr. 3 sg. (anu + parivatteti

anu-parivāreti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of anu + pari
+ √vṛ), (a) to surround, enclose, shut up; (b) to em-
brace, follow, side with; imper. 2 pl. ~etha (b), Vin I
338,8 (mā . . . anuvattittha +); pot. 1 pl. ~eyyāma
(a), MN I 153,19; aor. 3 pl. ~esuṁ (a), ib. 153,23
(Ps); abs. ~etvā (b), Ja III 487,6 = Dhp-a I 55,3.

anu-pariveṇaṁ, ind. (anu + pariveṇa), about

round in every cell; Vin I 80,1 (~ bhikkhūnaṁ āro-
cehi); 106,36 (~ pātimokkhaṁ uddisanti).

round about, to escort; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, SN IV 312,18

anu-parisakkana, n., nomen actionis of prec;
SN IV 312,22 foll. (°-ḥetu).

anu-pariharati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *anu + pari +
√hṛ], to surround, cover, embrace; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya

an-uparodha, m., 'not disagreement', conformity

(tad-), Kacc 56; Kacc-v 405 (jinavacanâ°; cf. Sadd
809,1); 644 (yathânuparodhena Buddhasāsane[na]).

an-upalakkhaṇa, n., not discriminating; abl.
~ā, SN III 261,21 (aññāṇā ... asallakkhaṇā +);
also title of the sutta ib.

an-upalabbhana, n. (cf. pass, upalabbhati),
non-existence; Ud-a 275,19 (kassaci attanā piyatarassa

an-upalabbhamāna, mfn. [an + part. pass, of

an-upavajja, mfn. (an + grd. of upavadati; cf.

mutto, Mp); IV 82,16 foll. (tīhi [scil. nimittehi] ~o
an-upavajja97,34 (adaṇḍâraho ~o); Pj II 523,1 (kena dosena . . .

anu-pavattaka (or anu-ppavattaka), mfn., one

to roll onwards, to proceed or advance (continually);

anu-pavattana, n., nomen actionis of prec, Ud-a

anu-pavattita, mfn. (pp. of next), kept advancing;

polemic disposition); Sv (III) 895,12 (niddosā ~ā, —
'anāsavā anupadhikā'(!) DN III 112,10). — °-citta,
mfn., not disposed to polemics; AN IV 26,12*; V 149,6.

anu-pālaka, m(fn)., (from anu-pāleti), guarding,
preserving; Ps I 210,19 (kammajānaṁ ~o hutvā pac-
cayo hoti, scil. āhāro, opp. janako as in the foll.);
Abhidh-av 116,15* (janako hetu akkhāto, paccayo
~o); pl. ~ā, Mp II 122,5 (vaḍḍhakā + ; = 'āpādakā').
— Ifc. v. ariyavaṁsâ°.

anu-pālana, n. (nomen actionis of anu-pāleti),
continual keeping, preserving, maintenance; Ps II
350,14 (usmāya ~aṁ); As 310,30—311,5 (upakāra,
upatthambhana + , cf. ib. 310,24-25) ≠ Vism 446,11-15;
447,24; Dīp III 2 (āyuñ-ca-anupālanaṁ ɔ: āyu-anu-
pālanaṁ ca?). — °-lakkhaṇa, mfn., characterized
by ~, As 123,29 foll.; Abhidh-av 19,8 (~aṁ, scil.
jīvitaṁ). — °-samattha, mfn., capable to preserve;
anu-pālana— °-samatthatā, f. abstr., abl. ~āya, Ud-a 15,27 ≠
Ps 16,6.

anu-pālita, mfn. (pp. of next), guarded, main-
tained; Mp II 122,6 (puttā hi mātāpitūhi vaḍḍhitā
c'eva ~ā ca).

anu-pāleti, pr. 3 sg. [anu + √pāl], to keep up,
preserve, maintain; Ja II 432,14* (yāva so ~eti; =
rakkhati, Ct.); III 19,25* (yo dhammaṁ ~eti; =
pāleti rakkhati, Ct.); Abhidh-av 19,12 (te dhamme
~eti); Ps 1268,5 (āpodhātu sineheti ca allattaṁ ca
anu-pāletiVism 447,18; imper. 2 sg. ~aya, Ja VI 317,25* ( ˇ ˇ
- ˇ - , Ee spells anupālayā; scil. asampadosaṁ; =
anurakkha, Ct.) = 321,14*; aor. 1 sg. ~esiṁ, Ap 218,13
(bhājanaṁ); ~ayiṁ, ib. 14 (do.); 243,10 (sīlaṁ); —
pass. part. ~iyamāna, mfn., As 310,25 ≠ Vism 447,32;
— pp. anu-pālita (q. v.).

an-upāhana, mfn., without shoes; ~o, Vin I
187,7 foll.; Th 946; f. ~ā, Ja VI 586,3* (pattiyā+);
pl. ~ā, Ja VI 552,1* (pattikā +); gen. pl. ~ānaṁ,
Nidd I 228,20 (= upāhana-virahitānaṁ, Nidd-a).

[anu-pithīyati, pass. 3 sg. (*anu+ (a)pi+ √dhā),
to be shut in (or up); 3 pl. (med.) ~are, Ap 152,20
= Th-a C 151,36* (v. l. in Th-a for anusuyyare or
anusūyare) for anuvidhīyare, and this substituted for
anuvijjhare?].[anu-pithīyati

Anupiya, n. or Anupiyā, f. [prob. Anūpiya in
spite of Ms. tradition; cf. anūpa], Npr. of a town
(fn.) and a mango-grove (n.) in the Malla country,
where Gotama spent the first week after his renunciation
before he went to Rājagaha; (a) n., Vin II 180,4 =
DN III 1,4 (~aṁ nāma Mallānaṁ nigamo; Sv (in
Se spelling Anuppiya) reports a v. r. Anopiya, cf.
AnupiyaII. ib.

anu-pīḷita, mfn. [pp. of anu + √pīd], strongly
pressed; Dhp-a I 201,6* (padaṁ . . . duṭṭhassa hoti
sahasânupīḷitaṁ) = Mp I 436,18* = Pj II 544,3* (584,1)
= Vism 105,5* (— aggapādena paṇhiyā ca sahasā
anu-pīḷitacf. ib. 9*).

anu-pucchati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu + √prach], to
question, to inquire for; sg. ~asi, Sn 432 (evaṁ maṁ
pahitattam pi kiṁ jīvaṁ ~); I sg. ~āmi, Sn 1113
('n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato ñāṇaṁ ~); part. med. m.
~amāno, Sn 841 (diṭṭhiñ ca nissāya ~); pot. 1 sg.
~eyyaṁ, Ja IV 249,24* (read kim evâhaṁ Tuṇḍilam
ānupucche[yyaṁ] kaṇeyya(ṁ)saṁ (so Ck) bhātaraṁ
Kālikāya), for pot. 1 sg. ~e (with ahaṁ) cf. MSL 1927
anu-pucchati227,30* (only Ck, meaning ānupucchi or *anv-apucchi
[cf. ānucāri s. v. anucarati]; = anu-pucchi, ib. 221,24');
— pp. anu-puṭṭha, mfn., asked; ifc. v. an-ānu-
puṭṭha.

Anupubba-(setthiputta), m. Npr., surname of a
young merchant; Dhp-a I 298,11 (so evam anupubbena
puññakammassa katattā ~o nāma jāto).

anu-pubba, mfn. [sa. anupūrva], following in
successive order, regular, gradual (increasing or de-
creasing); pl. ~ā ūrū, Ja V 155,22* (regularly formed).
— n. ~aṁ, regular (systematic) order, As 135,13;
Th-a (Ce II 19,9) ad Th 727 (+ anukkamo = 'ānu-
pubbaṁ'); — do. ind. & instr. ~ena (adv.), abl. ~ato
(adv.), see below, and cf. anupubbaso, ănupubbī f.,
and ānu-pubba, n.

anu-pubbaṁ, ind. [sa. anupūrvam], in regular
order, in turn, by and by; Sn 510—11 (= pañha-
paṭipāṭiyā, Pj); 600 (~aṁ yathātathaṁ); MN I
338,12* (do.); Th 548 (~ paricitā yathā Buddhena
desitā) quoted Paṭis I 172,5* (see ib. 173,17-28); Th
647 (~ paricitaṁ); SN I 3,5* (vayoguṇā ~aṁ jahanti;
Spk) = 62,33* = 63,1* = Ja IV 487,19* foll; SN
IV 217,4-18; 220,13-19 (see v. l.); ~aṁ suvaṭṭitaṁ,
Ja III 282,22* (said of a needle; 'tapering', Tr.); ~aṁ
kathaṁ datvā, Ja VI 469,24* (= in what order).

anu-pubba-kathā, f. = anu-pubbi-kathā or
ānu-pubbi-kathā (q. v.); Ja I 50,3; Mhv XXII 1.

anu-pubba-kāraṇa, n. (or more prob. f. ~ā),
gradual training; abl. ~ā, MN I 446,8 (abhiṇha-
kāraṇā +).

anu-pubba-kiriyā, f., gradual or regular work-
ing; anupubba-sikkhā +, MN III 1,10; Ud 54,30
(Ud-a) = Vin II 238,29 = AN IV 201,2 = 207,19,
quoted Kv 219,21; instr, abl. ~ā, MN I 479,36 (Ps:
karaṇatthe paccattavacanaṁ).

anu-pubba-gattatā, f., the 21st anuvyañjana
of the Buddha; Dharmapr 13,15 (ad Mhbv 1,1*); Vyu
18,20 (anupūrvagātra)

anu-pubb'-aṅgulitā, f., the second anuvyañ-
jana of the Buddha; Dharmapr 13,9 (ad Mhbv 1,1*);
Vyu 18,6. Cf. Sv (II) 446,14-15.

anu-pubba-tanuka, mfn., gradually narrowing
(upwards); Sp ad Vin I 91,13 (uddhaṁ ~ena sīsena
samannāgato = 'sikhara-sīsa'; Vmv: ~ena sīsenā
ti cetiyathūpikā viya kamena kisena sīsena).

anu-pubbatā, f., [(a) 'acting in turn', compliance;
~ā (instr. ?) tā tava mānase rata, Vv 755—56—57
(= anukūla-kiriyā, Vv-a 280,22), Ce (better ) anu-
bbatā]. — (b) succession, series; ifc. v. gaṇanâ°,
padâ°.

anu-pubbato, ind. = anupubbaṁ; Vibh-a
226,22, 26-33 = Vism 243,30, 34—244,1 ≠ Pj I (41,5)
70,19-27 (= anupaṭipāṭiyā); Abhidh-av 106,10.

anu-pubba-ninna, mfn., gradually deepening;
~o + anupubba-pono, °-pabbhāro (scil. mahāsa-
muddo), Ud 53,9 foll. (Ud-a) = Vin II 237,19 foll.
= AN IV 198,1 foll. quoted Kv 219,19.

anu-pubba-nirodha, m., successive cessation (of
consciousness) (in jhāna, q. v., cf. anupubba-vihāra);
nava ~ā, DN III 266,6 (= anupaṭipāṭiyā nirodhā,
Sv) = 290,6 ≠ AN IV 409,1 (= anupaṭipāṭi-nirodhā,
Mp) ≠ 456,6; Paṭis I 35,3.

anu-pubba-paṭipadā, f., gradual progress; anu-
pubba-sikkhā anupubba-kiriyā +, MN III 1,10; Ud
54,30 (Ud-a) = Vin II 238,30 - AN IV 201,2 =
207,19, quoted Kv 219,22; instr. abl ~ā, MN I 479,36.

anu-pubba-pada-vaṇṇanā, f., successive ex-
planation of words; Ps I 54,7 (so Ck & Se; Ee
a-pubba-°).

anu-pubba-pabbhāra, mfn., with precipice
succeeding precipice; Ud 53,9 (anupubba-ninno +,
scil. mahāsamuddo) = Vin II 237,19 — AN IV 198,8
quoted Kv 219,19.

anu-pubba-poṇa, mfn., with slope following on
slope; Ud 53,9 (anupubba-ninno+, scil. mahāsa-
muddo) = Vin II 237,19 = AN IV 198,9, quoted Kv
219,19.

anu-pubba-muñcana, n., gradual release; abl.
~ato, Vibli-a 226,24; 227.33—229,19 = Vism 243,31;
245,1—246,25 ≠ Pj I (41,7) 72,28—73,26.

anu-pubba-rucira-gattatā, f., the 26th anu-
vyañjana of the Buddha; Dharmapr 13,17 (ad Mhbv
1,1*); cf. Vyu 18,20-21 (anupūrva-gātra, çuci-gātra).

anu-pubba-vavatthāna, n., the having been
put in due order; Pj I 13,29*; 20,21-30.

anu-pubba-vipassanā, f., discerning knowledge
in due order; ifc. (mfn.) pavattâ°, Ud-a 35,1 =
Vism 700,22 (tassa (evaṁ) ~assa).

anu-pubba-vihari(n), mfn., gradually passing
through the (nine) stages (in meditation); m. ~ī tattha
so kalen'eva tare visattikaṁ, Ud 78,3* (Ud-a).

anu-pubba-vihari(n), mfn., gradually passing
through the (nine) stages (in meditation); m. ~ī tattha
so kalen'eva tare visattikaṁ, Ud 78,3* (Ud-a).

stages (in meditation); nava ~ā, DN III 265,19 (=

(Paṭis-a); gen. sg. ~assa vasībhūto, Ap 30,1 =

(Nidd-a); Ud-a 135,30 (°-ñāṇāni); 269,2 (°-yogaṁ).

anu-pubba-sikkhā, f., gradual (systematic) train-
ing; + anupubba-kiriyā, °-patipadā, MN III 1,10;
Ud 54,29 (Ud-a) = Vin II 238,29 - AN IV 201,2 =
= 207,18, quoted Kv 219,21; instr, abl. ~ā, MN I
479,36.

anu-pubbaso, ind. [sa. anu-pūrvaçaḥ], success-
ively, in regular order (— anupubbaṁ, anupubbena);
Sn 1000; Ap 541,22 = Thī-a 155,14*; Vin I 99,2*;
DN II 256,12* (= anupaṭipāṭiyā, Sv); Abhidh-av
58,16*.

anu-pubbâdhigata, mfn. (anu-pubba + adhi-
gata), gradually acquired or attained; ~ena arahatta-
maggena avijjaṇḍakosaṁ padāletvā, Mp III 233,14.

anu-pubbâbhisaññā-nirodha, m. (cf. abhi-
saññā-nirodha), gradual cessation of conscious ideas;

Sv (reckoning abhi for "upasagga-mattaṁ" and in-
verting the order of samp° and nirodha)).anu-pubbâbhisaññā-nirodha

anu-pubbâbhisamaya, m. (anupubba + abhi-
samaya), gradual apprehension or penetration; Kv
212,32; 219,16. — °-kathā, f., title of Kv II 9 (p.212—
220).

kathaṁ, Sv 277,25; 471,33; cf. Sadd 260,4); 148,6; II
41,10 (= anupatipātiyākathaṁ, Sv); 43,5—44,18; M
I 379,33; II 145,4 (Ps III 89,21 = Sv); A IV 186,12;
209,25; 213,17 (Mp IV 99,14 = Sv); Ud 49,5 (Ud-a
281,15 = Sv); Dhp-a I 6,8; II 121,12; III 27,9; 375,1;
Bv-a 125, 36; Vv-a 66,15; Paṭis-a 33,6 (Ee °pubbī°);
~aṁ kathessāmi, A III 184,17 (Mp III 293,13); ~aṁ
kathetvā, Vv-a 197,27; Dhp-a I 140,11; 207,21; ~aṁ
kathento, Dhp-a I 67,10; kathento ~aṁ, Mil 228,7;
— tatrâyam ~ā, Sp (I) 45,9; 63,19; (II) 417,25; Ps V
33,23 (Ee ănupubbakathā both times); Ud-a 77,20; Cp-a
21,7; 29,4; 35,28; 40,14; 75,2; 134,2; 187,8 (v. l. ănu°);
216,11; 242,13; 258,7; 264,24; Ja II 300,9; V 48,27;
412,15; Dhp-a I 83,9; IV 120,4; 199,13; Saddhamma-s
37,2; tatrâyaṁ saṁkhepato ~ā, Ja IV 263,10; ettha
ayaṁ ~ā, Spk I 317,2; Mp IV 180,16; etthâyaṁ ~ā,
Ja I 8,8; Cp-a 268,4; tathâyaṁ ~ā, Thūp 38,5; vag-
gulīnaṁ vatthumhi ayam ~ā, Saddhamma-s 81,4;
cf. 82,30; 84,28; 86,11; 88,25; migaḷuddakassa + ayam

Mp I 136,2; 163,9; tass' āvibhāvatthaṁ ayam ~ā, Pj

tha-dīpanatthaṁ ayam ~ā, Saddhamma-s 23,14; dho-
vanaphalakaṁ viya ~ā, Ud-a 284,5; — — °ânupub-
baka, mfn., immediately following that; Vv-a 208,6

kathā. See also Geiger, Pāli Dhamma, p. 44, and
Lūders, Kl. T. II, p. 85—86.ānupubbi-kathā

anu-pubbûpasanta, mfn. (anu-pubbaṁ + upa-
santa), gradually expired or died away; ~assa yathā
na ñāyati gati (scil. jātavedaso), Ud 93,24* (Ud-a)
= Ap 543,16 = Thī-a 157,2*.

anu-pubbena, ind. (see anupubbaṁ), gradually,
successively, regularly, by and by, in course of time
(later); Vin I 83,16 (~ cārikaṁ caramāno ... tad
avasari); MN II 49,12 (do.); Mil 22,1; Dhp 239 (~ . . .
thokathokaṁ khaṇe khaṇe; = anupaṭipāṭiyā, Dhp-a;
quoted¥Lv 108,32*; 219,29*); It 10,20* ≠ Ja II 22,26*;
anu-pubbena= III 214,19* (Mp); Ja III 57,18*; Ja II 2,5; 105,17
(~ vaḍḍhiṁsu); III 127,1 (~ vaḍḍhetvā); Ud-a 180,8;
Ja IV 470,26*; Pp 41,32; 64,34; Dhp-a I 4,1; 14,10;
298,10; Pv-a 19,26; Ps II 219,27 (~ upanessati; opp.
ekappahārena); III 229,19; Abhidh-av 51,20*; 93,30*
(~ . . . vikkhambhanti); Mhv V 73; XV 55; XXX 2;
Mil 74,21; 276,3. — prp. (with acc.) along; Ap 422,1.
— °-vaddhana, mfn., successively increasing; Sp
I 95,5 (avasesā navuti ~ā, scil. mahāmūlā; v. l.

anu-purohita, m., an under-purohita (ɔ: the
purohita of a sub-king), Sv (II) 663,1; pt ad Ja IV
304,19 (= 'upapurohita').

anu-pekkhaṇatā (or °pekkhanatā), f. (from
anu-pekkhati), sustained consideration; cittassa anu-
sandhanatā + (cāro, vicāro, etc. +), Dhs 8 — 85 =
284 = 372; As 143,12 (Se: ārammaṇaṁ anu-
pekkhamāno (!) viya tiṭṭhatī ti "anu-pekkhaṇatā

anu-pekkhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu-pra + √īkṣ], to
look or consider carefully; cetasā anuvitakketi anu-
vicāreti manasânupekkhati, DN III 242,8; AN III
23,3 = 87,13 = 361,23= 382,5; pāpakena manasâ°,
anu-pekkhati303,16; Nidd II 87,23 (= 'anukampamāna'); As
143,10; pp. anu-pekkhita (q. v.); caus, anu-pekkheti
(q. v.).

an-upe(k)khā, f. (cf. upe(k)khā), the being

(scil. pahānaṁ), Pj II 9,8 = Ud-a 32,18 = Ps I 23,19.

anu-pekkhita(r), m., nomen agentis of anu-
pekkhati ; nom. attānaṁ ~ā, one who controls himself,
Mp III 53,9 (= 'attânupekkhī', AN III 133,20).

anu-pekkhita, mfn. (pp. of anu-pekkhati), care-
fully considered or dwelt on; m. pl. ~ā, Vin II 95,36
(dhammā (sutā) dhatā vacasā paricitā manasâ °~ā
ditthiyā suppaṭividdhā) = MN I 213,5 (= cittena

tena ~ā, Mp) ≠ MN III 115,20 ≠ AN II 185,(e)-io
≠ Sv I 30,28 ≠ Ud-a 17,19; 31,18; 293,8.

anu-pekkhita(r), m., nomen agentis of anu-
pekkhati ; nom. attānaṁ ~ā, one who controls himself,
Mp III 53,9 (= 'attânupekkhī', AN III 133,20).

anu-pekkheti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of anu-pekkhati),
to cause one to consider; Vin II 73,27 (pekkheti + ;
Sp: yathā so (Ce: yathā-yogaṁ) atthaṁ pekkhati
c'eva punappunañ ca pekkhati, evaṁ karoti).

an-upe(k)khā, f. (cf. upe(k)khā), the being
interested, interestedness; gen. upe(k)khā-ñāṇena ~āya
(scil. pahānaṁ), Pj II 9,8 = Ud-a 32,18 = Ps I 23,19.

anu-peti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu-pra + √i, or *anu-

pagacchati, DN I 55,22 (= anuyāti, Sv) = MN I
515,11 (do. Ps), etc., see passages quoted under anu-
pagacchati.

anu-peseti, pr. 3 sg. caus. [sa. anu-pra + √iṣ],
to send forth after; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya (anusāreyya +),
Mil 36,28.

°anu-poṅkha, only in the iterative comp. poṅkhâ°,

an-uposatha, m., not a fast-day; Vin I 136,7
(na . . . ~e uposatho kātabbo; Sp).

an-uposathika, mfn., not keeping fast-day; Ps
III 290,6 foll. (opp. uposathika).

anu-posathikam, ind. (from anu + posatha =
uposatha), every fast-day; Vin IV 145,2' = 315,27'
(= 'anvaddhamāsaṁ').

anu-posiya, mfn. (grd. of anu + poseti, caus.
of √puṣ), to be nourished (afterwards); nânuposiyaṁ
(sabbasampatti-bījaṁ), Saddh 318.

anu-(p)pharaṇa, n. (nomen actionis of anu-
pharati), flashing through, pervading; Mp III 129,13
ad AN III 332,4 (°aṭṭhena); III 230,19 ad AN IV
120,2 (°ânubhāvo); ifc.mfn. Mil 148,23 (sata-yojanâ°);
cf. hitâ°.

anu-pharati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *anu + √sphar], to
flash through, to pervade; Ps Ee III 381,1 = Sv
(II) 449,30 (sabbaṁ kāyaṁ ~); aor. 3 sg. anu-phari,
Dhp-a I 134,20; inf. ~ituṁ, Mp III 230,12 ad AN IV
118,13; abs. ~itvā, Ja V 272,20'.

anu-phusīyati, 3 sg. pass, of anu + √phus [sa.

anu-baddha, mfn. (ts., pp. of anu + √bandh;
very often written anu-bandha, q. v.), Utt. 'bound up

Thī 493 (~e jarāmaraṇe) ; Ap 308,25 (devaloke manusse
[for brachylogy see under anaggi] vā ~ā ime guṇā);
anu-baddhaIII 278,5 (devatāsahassāni ... ~āni); frequently in
the phrase piṭṭhito piṭṭhito ~ (see anubandhati with

89,29; It 91,1-15* (= anugato, It-a); DN I l,i& foll.;
226,ai; Vin II 111,36; SN IV 173,11-18; II 227,19
(atthi me idaṁ suttakaṁ . . . ~aṁ, see anubandhana,
mfn.); — (b) followed or pursued (by, instr, or ifc),
[SN IV 188,9 v. l. for anu-buddha q. v.]; Ud-a 179,20
(janapada-manussehi ~ā); Sp (II) 455,19 (corehi ~o);

anu-vyañjan'-assāda-gadhita, mfn., 'bound by
the satisfaction of the details' (of the objects); SN
IV 168,18 (nimitt'-assada-gadhitam viññāṇaṁ . . .
~aṁ vā).

anuvyañjanaso, ind. (a) (≠ abl. of anu-vyañ-
jana (a)), as to details or particulars; SN IV 168,16
(~ nimitta-ggāho, quoted Ps I 75,17; Spk); Nidd II
272,11; MN III 126,17 (mātugāmassa ~ nimittaṁ
gahetā); — (b) as to the 'vyañjana' (the linguistic
form); suttato+, Vin I 65,9 = 68,24 ≠ IV 51,30
(suttaso + ; = akkhara-pada-pāripūriyā, Sp) = AN
IV 140,25 (Mp) = 279,28 ≠ V 73,11; 81,2.

anu-vāka, m., designation of a subdivision of
vedic texts; Mogg-v IV 16 (Devadattassa visayo ~o);
Mogg-v II 3 (māsena ~o [a]dhīto) = Pay fol. go 6.

anu-vāceti, pr. 3 sg. (anu + vāceti, caus.), 'to
make recite after', to teach things taught before; 3 pl.
~enti (vācitaṁ), DN I 104,12,24 (= te hi aññesaṁ
vācitaṁ ~enti, Sv) = 238,20 = MN II 169,29 (Ps
= Sv) = 200,5 = AN III 224,1 (= do. Mp) =
229,29 = Vin I 245,20.anu-vāceti

anu-vāta, m., prob, a collar or facing (on a
monk's cowl); + paribhaṇda, Vin I 297,21; II 116,17;
177,8; IV 121,10 (aggaḷa+); Sp ad Vin I 287,22
(explaining 'kusi'); Sp (III) 684,19 (~aṁ viya das-
setvā, ad Vin III 226,10); Th-a Ce II 137,27 ≠ Mp I
168,6 (cīvarakammaṁ karontā ~e appahonte saṁ-
haritvā ṭhapetuṁ āraddhā) = Pv-a 73,16 ≠ Ras I
28,12; ~aṁ āropento cīvaraṁ katvā pārupi, Pv-a
anu-vātanivārana, Ras 141,2 & vātâvaraṇa, ib. 41,17*; Sp
(II) 291,10.

anu-vātaṁ, ind. (cf. anu-vāte), with the wind,
to leeward; AN I 225,28 foll. (opp. paṭivātaṁ); IV
118,12 (~ yojanasataṁ gandho gacchati); Mil 333,11
+ paṭivātaṁ); Vism 182,17. — Ifc. v. paṭivātâ°.

anu-vāta-karaṇa, n., making of or supplying
with an anuvāta; Vin I 254,32 (°-mattena).

anu-vāta-paṭivātaṁ, ind., with the wind and
against the wind; AN I 225,33 foll. — °-paṭivātamhi,
ind. id., Anāg 102.

anu-vāta-magga, m., the way with the wind;
instr. ~ena, Vism 182,17.

anu-vāte, ind. [ts.] on the lee-side; SN I 226,23
(so C, Ee anuvātaṁ; ~ pañjaliko namassamāno
aṭṭhāsi); Ja II 382,28 (~ ṭhatvā); Vism 10,13* (opp.
paṭivāte); 182,29. — Ifc v. nâti-°.

anu-vāda, m. [ts.], (a) censure, blame, admoni-
tion; Abh 120; na ~o paṭṭhapetabbo, Vin II 5,13;
32,9 (Sp: ~o ti vihāre jeṭṭhakaṭṭhānaṁ na kātab-
baṁ, pātimokkhuddesakena vā dhammajjhesakena
vā na bhavitabbaṁ nâpi terasasu sammutisu eka-
sammutivasenâpi issariyakammaṁ kātabbaṁ, thus

+ upavadanā c'eva codanā ca, Ps Se III 454,9; —
(b) approbation, adhesion, joining a party; Vin II
88,33 (~o + anu-vadanā anullapanā, etc, prob,

dantesu upavādo!)) = 91,19; Vin-vn 2762, 2766,
2768. — Ifc v. attâ°, an-°, parâ°, vādâ°, sâ°.— —
°-mūla, n., reason for adhesion; cha ~āni anuvādâ-
dhikaraṇassa m[ū/u]laṁ, Vin II 90,1; V 91,1; 92,24;
134,5. — °-vimutta, mfn., free from blame; Pj II
396,8 (— 'an-anuvajja'). —- °âdhikaraṇa, n., a
question or case of joining one's party; one of the four
adhikaranāni (vivādâ° +), Vin III 164,9 (Sp (III)
595,1); 168,13'; 1188,18 foll; 99,20; V 100,1 (°-pac-
cayā; cf. Utt-vn 287); 101,36 foll; 150,2 foll; Vin-vn
2760; MN II 247,1 (Ps); Sv (III) 1040,30.

(anu-v-āsati), pr. 3 sg. (anu + √ās), to sit down
after (or behind), to attend; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, Ja VI
296,19* (25': anuvāseyyā [Ck anuvaseyyā] ti upo^
sathavāsaṁ vasanto anu-vatteyya, cf. anu-vasati).

anu-vāsana, n. [ts., cf. anu-vāseti], an oily
enema, injection; Mil 353,13 (°vamana-virecanânu-
vāsana-kiriyam anusikkhitvā).

anu-vāsanīya, mfn. (grd. of anu-vāseti),. to be
treated with an enema; ~aṁ anuvāseti, Mil 169,12.

anu-vāsita, mfn. (pp. of anu-vāseti), treated with
an enema; gen. vantassa virittassa ~assa, Mil 214,30.

anu-vāseti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu + √vās], 'to per-
fume', esp. to give an oily enema; anuvāsanīyam ~eti,
Mil 169,12 (vamanīyaṁ vāmeti +).

anu-vikkhitta, mfn. (anu + pp. of vi-√kṣip),
scattered abroad; + anu-visaṭa, SN V 277,27 (pañca
kāmagune ārabbha, explaining vikkhitta; Spk);
279,14; 280,3.

anu-vi-gaṇeti, pr. 3 sg. [anu-vi + √gaṇ], to
reckon over ('to con over', Trsl.); Th 109 (~sāsanaṁ;
cinteti anuyuñjati. . . vitakketi, Ct.).

anu-vi-carati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu-vi + √car],
(a) to walk or pass through, to wander about, to walk
up and down (or along with, acc); — (b) to explore,
to ponder (in the pp. (q. v.) and as v. l. to anuvicā-
reti); anuvitakketi + ~ati (b), MN I 144,5 ≠ AN
III 23,3 ≠ 87,12 (°-cāreti) = 383,5 ; nagaraṁ ~ati (a),
anu-vi-caratiJa II 128,16; Pv-a 189,6 (= 'anupariyanti'); SN III
83,25* (metre demands vicaranti; anu- from Spk);
anucaṅkamanti +, SN IV 117,1; AN I 142,24 (catun-
naṁ mahārājānaṁ amaccā . . . imaṁ lokaṁ ~anti

~antānaṁ (anucaṅkamantānaṁ +), DN I 235,15

~amāno (anucaṅkamamāno +), Sn p. 105,1 (= ito

anu-vi-carāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of prec), to

anu-vi-carita, mfn. (pp. of anu-vi-carati (b));

anu-vi-caritamajjitaṁ, pt; = 'vīmaṁsânucaritaṁ').

anu-vicāra, m., repeatedly pondering or scrutin-

anu-vicinaka, m. (from anu-vi + √ci, for *anu-

anu-vi-cintayati (or °cinteti) pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu-

(dhammaṁ); imper. 2 sg. ~aya (yoniso), SN I 203,15*;

vaṇṇanā, f., title in Sp ad Vin V 160,1-18. See anu-
vijjhati (b, β) below.anu-vijjhaka

Ee andhitva, read āvijjhitvā?]; grd. ~itabba, mfn.,
Vin V 163,21 (b β, Ee -jj-); caus. °-vijjhāpeti (q. v.);
pp. anu-viddha (q. v.). Cf. (an-)anuvejja.

anu-vijj(h)ā, f. nomen actionis of prec; Vin V
162,22 (Ee -jj-; uddāna to Vin V 160—62, cf. anu-
vijjhaka).

(anu-vijjhāpeti), pr. 3 sg., caus. of anu-vijjhati,
to let track or search for; abs. ~etvā, Ja V 162,14 (so
Cks, Ee °-vijjāpetvā, Bds anu-vicārāpetvā; ǣta mǣta
carapuruṣayan yavā parīkṣā karavā, Ja-pot; anu-
yuñjitvā (!) ti pariyesitvā, pt).

[anu-vi-jānāti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. anu-vi + √jñā], to

(v. l. Ck for anu-vijj(h)eyyaṁ)].

anu-vi-takketi, pr. 3 sg. [anu + sa. vi-√tark],
to reflect upon, to ponder; + anu-vicāreti, MN I 116,28;
144,5 (+ anuvicarati ); II 253,19; AN I 264,11; do.
+ manasânupekkhati, DN III 242,8; AN III 23,3;
87,12; 88,22; 361,23; 382,1; 383,5; anu-ssarati +,
SN V 67,28-30; 3 pl. ~enti, AN III 177,24—178,16

~ayato (+ anu-vicārayato), MN I 116,12; AN I
anu-vi-takketi3 sg.

anu-viddha, mfn. [ts.; pp. of anu-√vyadh, cf.
anu-vijjhati], pierced along, adorned or set with (instr.);
Vv-a 277,20 (maṇinā ~aṁ). — Ifc. v. maṇi-maya-
candakâ° (ib. 278,2), mani-maya-mandalâ° (ib.
277,19).

anu-vidita, mfn. [pp. of sa. anu-√vid], who has

528—530 (= anu-buddho, Pj) ≠ Mvu III 397,13*—
398,1*; — anu-viditâkāra, m., Vmv ad Vin I 236,17

anu-vidhāna, n. [ts.], acting conformably to order;
Spk III 141,19 (~aṁ āpajjeyyuṁ = 'anu-vidḥīyey-
yuṁ').

(anu-vidhāyaka), mfn., acting in conformity
with; °-tta, n. abstr., Ps I 14,12 (Satthu-cariyâ°).

Anuvindakā, m. pl. Npr. of a people; Ap 359,1

[anu-vi-bhavati, pr. 3 sg.; abs. ~itvā, Ja V

anu-hīratiI 104,17.

— 5. of the queen of Coranāga, Siva, and Vaṭuka,
etc, etc; Mhv XXXIV 16—29; Dīp XX 26—30!

an-udaka (or an-ūdaka, an-odaka), mfn. [sa.
an-udaka & (in the Rāmāyaṇa) an-ūdaka], without
water, dried up; n. anodakaṁ (sinānaṁ), SN I 38,8*

°-bhūta, mfn., not being water, Ps I 242,17 (an-
udaka-bhūtāya marīciyā).

an-ūna, mfn. [ts.], not lacking, not less, entire,
complete, without deficiency; Sv I 248,9 (~o paripūra-
kārī; = 'anavayo'); Pv-a 285,5 (~āni; = 'paripuṇ-
ṇāni'); Nidd-a II 65,9 (= 'anoma'); 72,5 (do.); alâyi-

an-ūnaka, mfn. [ts.] = prec; Abh 702; Ap
306,25 (~aṁ dānavaraṁ); 457,28 (sampuṇṇaṅgo ~o,

Cp III 6,11 (~aṁ me passitvă; = hatthâdīhi avi-

Anūna-nāma, m., a punning designation for
Puṇṇaka (anūna = (pari)puṇṇa); Ja VI 273,30*
(= no-ūnanāmo, Ct.); 322,26*.

anūna-bhoga, mfn., having full enjoyment; Ap
40,12 (= Th-a Ce 363,22*); 361,16; 458,16. — [°-va(t),

naṅga)√

anūna-sata, n., a full hundred; in comp. = by
hundreds; Mil 226,27 (°-salākâlaṁkataṁ ... seta-

an-ūnâdhikafor 'neither less nor more';

anūpa-khetta

an-ekaṁsa(g)gāha, m. (an + ekaṁsaggāha,

an-ekaṁsa(g)gāha, m. (an + ekaṁsaggāha,
q. v.), irresolution, Dhs 425 (kaṁkhā + ; = vicikicchā;
an-ekaṁsaggāhagāho, As 260,2 = Nidd-a II 153,19); Nidd I 414,23 =
II 75,10-11; — °-paccupaṭṭhāna, mfn., manifested

an-ekaṁsika, mfn. (an + ekaṁsika), uncertain,
undetermined; ~ā, DN I 191,13 foll. (= na ekakoṭṭhāsā,

— °-bhāva, m. abstr., id.; lokasammatānaṁ ka-

an-ekaṁsikata, mfn. [neg. pp. of *ekaṁs[ī/i]-

('aniyato').

aneka-kāraṇa, n.; instr, (adv.) ~ena = 'aneka-

aneka-koṭi-saṁkha, mfn., numbering many

an-ekagga, mfn. [sa. an-ekâgra], not closely

— °-tā, f. abstr., in the cpd. °-tâkāra, m., state

scil. nārisu).

with numerous ornaments or pictures; ~aṁ (scil.
hayavāhanam), Vv 742 (Ee sandanaṁ 'neka-cittaṁ;

aneka-ṭṭhāna, mfn., occurring in many places,

Anekattha, m., title of a glossary, ed. Rangoon
1883 (cf. Franke, Gesch. u. Krit. d. Pāli-Gramm. p. 65

anekattha, (aneka + 2attha), (a) mfn. [sa. ane-

anek'-atthapada-nissita, mfn., making up for

anekadhā, ind. [ts.], variously; Ap 505,5; Vism

Bm according to Tr. nekadā, q. v.; = anekappa-

aneka-pariyāyaMN II 90 7 (do. bhotā Kaccānena ~); II 162,15

makkhikaṁ nimmakkhikaṇḍakaṁ parisuddhaṁ, Sp
I 182,18); DN III 85,17 (-el-, v. l. -eḷ-; = niddosaṁ
makkhikaṇda(ka)-virahitam, Sv (III) 866,9); DN
III 87,6 (khuddaṁ madhuṁ aneḷakaṁ); MN II
5,8 (do. -el-; = niddosaṁ apagata-makkhikaṇḍa-
kaṁ, Ps); AN III 369,9 (do. -īl-, v. l. -eḷ-; = niddo-
saṁ, Mp); — Ap 193,18 (read [cf. Ce] isimuggāni
sannetvā [Se sandh°, v. lI. sand°, sant°; Ce piṁsetvā]
madhu-khudde anīlake); Mp III 84,18 ad AN III
237,14 (khuddaka-madhu anelakaṁ). Cf. khuddā, f.
[sa. kṣudrā] and sa. kṣaudra, n.

a-neḷaka-sappa, m., a kind of venomous snake;
Spk (Se) III 65,8 (maṇi-sappa + ; yassa visaṁ sīghaṁ
abhirūhati na sīghaṁ otarati ~âdīnaṁ visaṁ viya,
ayaṁ āgata-viso ca ghora-viso ca) quoted Ss 173,15
(= mahā-āsīviso, ib. 173,33).

an-ela-mūga (or an-eḷa-mūga), mfn. (cf. sa.
eḍa-mūka and ela, n., elā, f., mūga, mfn.), not fool,
not imbecile (cf. prec); Sn 70 (~o sutavā satīmā;
= a-lālă-mukho, athavā an-eḷo ca a-mūgo ca, paṇdito
vyatto ti vuttaṁ hoti, Pj & Nidd-a); DN III 265,16
(paññavā ajaḷo ~o paṭibalo subhāsita-dubbhāsitānaṁ
atthaṁ aññātuṁ) = AN IV 227,3 ≠ AN I 35,20 (pl.
~ā; Mp: yesaṁ elā mukhato na galati te ~ā nāma);
AN III 137,18 (paññavā hoti ajaḷo ~o) = 262,3 =
437,4; SN V 100,6 (paññavā ~o); MN I 32,23 (paññā-
vanto ~ā) = AN III 199,16. — °-tā, f. ábstr., AN III
441,8; Pj I 34,19.

an-o°, = 1. an-ava°, see anoṇata, etc. (and,
accordingly, for an + apa, see anodissa, anottāpi(n)).
— 2. seemingly for an-u°(an-ū°), see anodaka, anopama,
anopa (?). —3. anu-ava°: anomajjati, (anojagghati).an-o°

an-oka, mfn., 1. 'homeless', free from worldliness
(attachment); ~o, Sn 966 (abhisaṁkhāra-viññāṇâdī-
naṁ anokāsa-bhūto, Pj and Nidd-a); SN I 126,26*;
127,5* (= an-ālayo, Spk), cf. Mvu III 284,9*; 285,8*.
— 2. m. or n., the not home, the houseless (indepen-
dent) state; ~aṁ, Dhp 87 (okā ~aṁ āgamma (cf.
an-oka24,23* (= do. Spk) = AN V 232,28* (= vaṭṭato
vivaṭṭaṁ āgamma, Mp) = 233,20* = 253,6* =
254,6*. — °-sāri(n), mfn., wandering about homeless
(cf. a-niketa-sari(n)); nom. ~ī, SN III 10,7 = Nidd
I 197,19 (= kamma-viññāṇena okaṁ asarantena
[Nidd-a asaranto] ~ī, Spk and Nidd-a); Ud 32,16*
(Ud-a); acc. ~iṁ, Sn 628 (v. l. B. °-cāriṁ; = anālaya-
cāriṁ, Pj) = Dhp 404 (= anālaya-cārinaṁ, Dhp-a)
= MN ch. 98 (Ps Ee III 438,12: okaṁ vuccati pañca-
kāmaguṇâlayo, taṁ an-allīyamānan ti attho), quoted
Mil 386,20*.

an-okkanta, mfn. = an-avakkanta (q. v.); Ps
ad MN III 115,9.

an-okāsā, m. (= an-avakāsa, q. v.), no place or
room, an improper place; [Mogg-v 111,12: ~aṁ kā-
retvā; cf. an-odhiṁ katvā, a-paccakkhaṁ katvā,
and see Ai. Gr. II: 1 § 31 c, and 3a 5 above]; Mil
229,20-25 (~e ṭhito); — mfn. not giving sufficient
room, Dhp-a III 442,4 (dvārāni ~āni ahesum; w. r.
anekasahassāni) = Pj I 164,25; not finding place,
Sp (IV) 944,5 (bhikkhū ~ā). — °-kata, mfn.,
who has not given occasion or leave; ~aṁ bhik-
khum pañhaṁ pucchanti, Vin IV 344,9, 14**, 17'
(= asukasmiṁ nāma ṭhāne pucchāmī ti evaṁ
akata-okāsaṁ, Sp; cf. anokāsaṁ kāretvā above, an-
oghatiṇṇa below); ~aṁ bhikkhuṁ āpattiyā codenti,
Vin I 114,15. — °kata-sikkhāpada, n. title of Vin
IV 344,6-28 (Bhikkhunī-Pāc XCV); ns ad Sadd 708,15.
— °-tta, n. abstr., abl. ~ā, Vism 186,27 (Ee anokā
sattā); Sadd 140,25. — °-bhūta, mfn. = 'an-oka',
q. v.; Pj II 573,1 = Nidd-a II 188,16.

an-oggata, mfn., not having set (as the sun);
~asmiṁ suriyasmiṁ, Th 477 (= suriye anatthaṁ-
gate yeva, Th-a).

an-ogha-tiṇṇa, mfn., not having crossed the
stream; acc. m. pl. ~e, Sn 1081 (= kam'-ogham, etc.
a-tiṇṇe, Nidd; see Ai. Gr. quoted s. v. an-okāsa).

anojakā, m. or f., = prec, pl. ~ā, Vv-a 161,27-28
(v. l. anojā); — ifc. v. yodhika-gaṇdik'-°, Vv 394.

anô-jagghati (or anu-jagghati), pr. 3 sg. (anu +
(ava) + √jaggh [cf. sa. √jakṣ and √g(h)aggh]), to
anô-jagghatiDN I 91,18 (= an[ū/u]hasantā, Sv).

an-ojava(t) or °-ojavanta, mfn., powerless, not
giving strength, without effect; n. ~vantaṁ (asamayena
bhuttaṁ ~ hoti), AN III 260,9 (= akāla-bhuttaṁ
ojaṁ pharituṁ na sakkoti, Mp); f. ~vantī sa kathā,
Nidd I 163,22 (= na ojavatī, teja-virahitā ti attho,
an-ojavatan-ojava

an-ojava(t) or °-ojavanta, mfn., powerless, not
giving strength, without effect; n. ~vantaṁ (asamayena
bhuttaṁ ~ hoti), AN III 260,9 (= akāla-bhuttaṁ
ojaṁ pharituṁ na sakkoti, Mp); f. ~vantī sa kathā,
Nidd I 163,22 (= na ojavatī, teja-virahitā ti attho,
an-ojavatan-ojava

Anojā, f. Npr. of a princess (named after the
flowers of anojă); Dhp-a II 116,13 (Ck Aṇojā); the
queen of Kappina-rājā, ib. 117,1; Mp I 319,5 (°-devī);
Vism 393,11 (do.).

anojā, (m? or f.), name of a tree (the flowers of
which are used for wreaths; cf. sinh, anōdā, 'marsh-
mallow1, or anônā, the custard-apple tree (Anona
squamosa)'}; sometimes spelt aṇoja-); Ap 118,6 (~aṁ
puppham uttamaṁ, split-cpd.); Ja VI 536,34* (koraṇ-
ḍakā~ā) — °-puppha, n., its flower, Dhp-a II 116,11
anojāwith that

an-oññāta (or °-oñāta), mfn., not disregarded
(= an-avaññāta); Vin IV 6,19' foll. (~aṁ anavaññā-
taṁ ahīḷitaṁ aparibhūtaṁ cittikataṁ, scil. nāmaṁ,
etc.); see also *an-uññāta s. v. [an-uyyāta].

an-oṇata (or an-onata), mfn. (an + pp. of oṇa-
mati), not bent down, not humble or dejected; m. ~o,
an-oṇatakosajje na ijjhati, Paṭis II 206,14 (quoted Ud-a 186,1
& Vism 386,12, in both places -n-).

an-oṇamaka, mfn., not bowing; instr. ~ena
pavisituṁ na sakkā, Dhp-a II 136,16 (Ee -n-; v. l.
an-onatena & an-oṇatena).

an-oṇamana, n. (cf. oṇamati), the not bending
down; Ud-a 185,29 (an-onamanâdīhi soḷasahi [ib.
186,1-19] vodāna-dhammehi).

an-oṇami(ta)-daṇda, m., an inflexible stick (so
Tr. Mil p. 427,31 taking oṇami — oṇamiya, grd., un-
warranted like *o-ṇămi(n)); °-jāta, mfn., grown stiff
like that, Mil 238,3, quoted Ps Se III 528,11 = Ss
an-oṇami(ta)-daṇdaoṇami°; Mp-ṭ: anoṇamitad° = yāvadatthaṁ bho-
janena oṇamituṁ asakkuṇeyyatāya anoṇamana-
daṇḍo viya jāto).

Anotatta (& °-daha; rarely Anavatatta; Buddh,
sa. Anavatapta; etym. Pj II 438,9 ≠ Ps Ee III 36,5
= Ud-a 301,3), ni. Npr. of one of the seven large
lakes in Himava(t), Ja IV 497,31' (~âdīni; cf. Ja II
92,26 °-dahâdayo satta-mahāsare + pañca-mahāna-
diyo); enumerated: Abh 679; AN IV 101,13; Ja V
415,25; Sv I 164,4 = Ps E* III 232,1; Pj II 407,22;
Ps Ee III 35,8; Ud-a 300,14; Vism 416,19; — its posi-
tion: Ud-a 300,16-19 = Pj II 437,19-21 (cf. 1166,27)
= Ps Ee III 35,10-12; — those seven lakes (mahāsarā)
AnotattaAN IV 101,13 (abl. ~ā), but cf. Kacc-v 274 (Sadd
702,12): ~amhā mahāsarā pabhavanti; Mil 286,25
(°dahato udakaṁ Gaṅgaṁ nadiṁ pavisati (cf.
Abhidh-k-vy Trsl. III p. 147,15)); — its water is by
devatās brought to Asoka: Dip VI 3 ≠ Sp I 42,3; —
there_bathed Māyā, Ja I 50,14; do. Sirī, Ja III 264,19;
do. Asā, Saddhā, Sirī, Hirī, Ja V 392,22; — its
water used by the Buddha, Ja I 80,15 (As 16,14);
Dhp-a III 222,12; Vism 391,8; — do. by pacceka-
buddhas, arahats, and others: Th 430; Pj II 77,13;
Ja I 232,6; III 379,18; IV 368,14; 379,20; V 321,20'-27;
324,13'; Dhp-a II 211,5; IV 129,21; 130,5; 131,1;
135,14; Pj II 420,22; — Ja IV 213,5; — Nidd II 51,11;
— cf. Ud-a 301,6-8; — Vessavana's yakkhinīs bring
him water from A., Dhp-a I 49,3; there they also
make music, Vv-a 131,29 (°-dahatīre); cf. Vv 301
(Vv-a 134,15); — Buddha there took his meal and
meditated, Dip I 44; Mhv I 18; Vin I 28,1-22 ; —
Buddha went there with 500 bhikkhus and preached
the Kuṇāla-jātaka, Ja V 415,11 foll., agreed the
evidence of Soṇa Koṭivísa, Ap 298,28, and told Ap
299,2—301,16 (Pubbakammapiloti ≠ Avadānakalpa-
latā ch. 50). — °-udaka, n., water from A°; Pj II
420,25; Dhp-a IV 134,5; — °ôdaka, n., Ja V 314,20;
320,10; Dhp-a IV 135,3; Dip XII 3 = XVII 85
(~aṁ kājaṁ, split-cpd.; quoted Sp I 75,19*); Mhv V
24; Mhbv 152,20; Jina-c 281; Sās 123,16; — °-daha,
m., id., Vv-a 134,15; Sās 24,6, etc., see under Ano-
tatta. — °-daha-udaka, n., water from A°, Dhp-a
IV 135,11; — °-daha-piṭṭha, n., the strand of A°;
Dhp-a IV 131,15 (= Anavatatta-vila-kere-dī, Rt);
132.1 (= Anavatatta-vila-piṭa, Rt); — °-pānīya,
n., water from A°; Dhp-a IV 130,5 (°atthāya āgato);
— °-piṭṭhi, f., the strand of A°; Ja III 257,23 (? Ja-
pot: Anotatta-vilaṭa nānṭa giyaha); — °-vāpī, f.,
name of a tank in Ceylon; Mhv LXXIX 49 (cf. Trl.
p. 121 n. 1);— °-sara, m. (or n.), the A° lake; Ap
299.2 (°âsanne . . . silātale [ɔ: Manosilātala]; quoted
Ud-a 263,28*); — °-salila, n., water from A°; Mhbv
101,18; 155,9; — °ôdaka, n., see above; — °ôda-
kāja, m., a load (Utt. a carrying-pole) of water from
A°; Mhv V 84; XI 30 (see Dip XII 3, etc., above).

an-ottappa, n., (an + ottappa, abstr. of (an)ottā-
pi(n), cf. ātappa: ātāpi(n)), want of tact, indiscretion,
disregard, recklessness; nom. ~aṁ, Dhs 365; Pp 20,5 =
Vibh 359,15 = 370,34; As 248,25 (— na ottappaṁ);
takkānaṁ . . . ~aṁ āsayo, Nidd I 501,28 ; ahirīkaṁ +,
DN III 212,12 (Sv) = AN I 83,27; V 146,18 =
an-ottappa~aṁ, It 34,9 = SN V 1,14 (Spk) = AN V 214,11;
assaddhiyaṁ ahirikam ~aṁ, AN III 421,9-15; lobho,
doso, etc. +, Vibh 341,12; Ud-a 335,3; Vism 210,29;
instr. ~ena, Nett 39,30; pl. ~āni, As 389,28 (ahirikâ°,
dvandva). — °-bala, n., the strength of a°; Dhs
365 (As 248,22); Nāmar-s 14,1. — °-mūlaka, mfn.,
founded on an-o°; pl. ~ā tīṇi, title of SN II 163,27—
164,22 (uddāna ib. 166,3*)^ see Spk II 143,2: ~kā
tayo (scil. tikā, ib. 143,8). — °ânupatita, mfn.,
befallen with an-ott°; Kv 413,4.

an-ottāpi(n),mfn. (quasi *an-apatrāpin, verb. adj.
to sa. apatrapate, pāli 1 sg. med. ottape [so C-mss and
metre] SN I 154,33*; the spelling (an)-ottappi(n) from
an-ottāpinan-ottāpiuttāsanato [read uttăs°?] ubbega-lakkhaṇaṁ ottappan
ti~ī); AN V 146,22 (-pp-); As 389,30; ari-ātāpī~ī, SN
II 195,28 (also title of the sutta ib.; Spk: nibbhayo.
kilesuppattito kusalânuppattito ca bhaya-rahito) =
It 27,14 (-pp-; It-a); AN II 13,8 — It 115,16 (-pp-; It-a
do.); asaddho ahiriko +, etc., DN III 252,8 (-pp-) =
282,22 (-pp-) = MN III 21,20 (-pp-) = SN IV 240,28
foll. = AN II 218,6 foll. = III 3,11 (≠ 7,2) = 112,13;
do. + ~ī purisapuggalo ti parihānaṁ etaṁ, SN II
206,21; AN V 123,23 foll; lābhakāmo +, AN IV 1,15
(-pp-); appiya-pasaṁsī +, AN IV 155,25 (-pp-); gen.
~issa purisapuggalassa ottappaṁ hoti parikkama-
nāya, MN I 44,26 = 45,35; pl. ~ī, MN I 43,16 (Ps:
na ottappantī ti ~ī); ~ino ~īhi saddhiṁ, SN II 159,6
foll. (= pāpakiriyāya abhāyamănā, Spk); ~ino, AN V
150,5 (-pp-; Nigaṇṭhā); MN III 21,24 (-pp-; samaṇa-
brāhmaṇā). — °-itā, f. abstr., AN II 218,13.

an-ottāpi(n),mfn. (quasi *an-apatrāpin, verb. adj.
to sa. apatrapate, pāli 1 sg. med. ottape [so C-mss and
metre] SN I 154,33*; the spelling (an)-ottappi(n) from
an-ottāpinan-ottāpiuttāsanato [read uttăs°?] ubbega-lakkhaṇaṁ ottappan
ti~ī); AN V 146,22 (-pp-); As 389,30; ari-ātāpī~ī, SN
II 195,28 (also title of the sutta ib.; Spk: nibbhayo.
kilesuppattito kusalânuppattito ca bhaya-rahito) =
It 27,14 (-pp-; It-a); AN II 13,8 — It 115,16 (-pp-; It-a
do.); asaddho ahiriko +, etc., DN III 252,8 (-pp-) =
282,22 (-pp-) = MN III 21,20 (-pp-) = SN IV 240,28
foll. = AN II 218,6 foll. = III 3,11 (≠ 7,2) = 112,13;
do. + ~ī purisapuggalo ti parihānaṁ etaṁ, SN II
206,21; AN V 123,23 foll; lābhakāmo +, AN IV 1,15
(-pp-); appiya-pasaṁsī +, AN IV 155,25 (-pp-); gen.
~issa purisapuggalassa ottappaṁ hoti parikkama-
nāya, MN I 44,26 = 45,35; pl. ~ī, MN I 43,16 (Ps:
na ottappantī ti ~ī); ~ino ~īhi saddhiṁ, SN II 159,6
foll. (= pāpakiriyāya abhāyamănā, Spk); ~ino, AN V
150,5 (-pp-; Nigaṇṭhā); MN III 21,24 (-pp-; samaṇa-
brāhmaṇā). — °-itā, f. abstr., AN II 218,13.

an-otthata (or °ṭa), mfn. (77sg. pp. of ottharati),
not overflown (or overcome, by (instr.)); m. ~o, Sv (III)
1013,34 (tanhāya ~o apariyonaddho; = 'an-ajjhā-
panno', DN III 224,27).

an-ottharaṇa, mfn., or n., not being overflown;
Sadd 438,5 (udakôghena °-ṭṭhānaṁ thalo ti vuccati).

an-ottharaṇīya, mfn. (neg. grd. of ottharati),
not to be overflown; °-tta, n. abstr., Sadd 438,6.

an-otiṇṇa, mfn., not lying before, not in question;
~e (vatthusmiṁ), Mp I 71,10 = Spk II 250,5 ≠ Sp
ad Vin I 50,29.

an-odarika, mfn. [cf. sa. audarika], not glut-
tonous; Kacc-v 362 (~assa bhāvo an-odarikattaṁ);
Sadd 791,1. — °-tta, n. abstr., freedom from gluttony;
appâhāro hoti ~aṁ anuyutto, AN III 120,12 foll.
an-odarikappatto, Mp).

an-odissa, ind. (an + abs. of avadisati, prob,
for sa. apadiçati; cf. uddissa, sa. uddiçya), without
reference (to a certain person), in general, universally;
Vin III 76,25 (opp. uddissa); Sp (II) 452,17; Vin-vn
1199 (from Vin IV 71,3'); 2021 (from Vin IV 225,14');
Utt-vn 910; Mil 156,19 (cf. upadisitvā [ɔ: apad°?]
uddissa, ib. 22); ~ saddaṁ na karoti, Ps II 242,12
foll.an-odissaside 235

an-odissaka, mfn. (from prec.; cf. an-uddesika),
general, universal; odissaka + , Ps I 283,3 = Sv (III)
779,15; n. ~aṁ (adv.), Vin-vn 284 (opāto khato, cf.
Vin III 76,25); Utt-vn 125 (~aṁ opātaṁ khaṇato);
902 (~aṁ opāte khate); Ja II 146,3' (~aṁ katvā;
Ee odissakaṁ without v. l.); IV 113,26 (pt); °-vasena,
generally, Ja I 81,33; °-nayena (v. l. °-vasena), Vv-a
97,7 (opp. odissakanayena); Ja II 61,9 (odissakâ-
nodissaka-vasena mettā bhāvetabbā); 148,11' (do.);
— °-mettā, f., universal amity (cf. an-odhiso below);
an-odissaka

an-odhi, mfn. [sa. an-avadhi], 'without limits',
not making distinction; Ps I 173,7 (arahattamaggo
kiñci kilesaṁ anavasesetvā pajahati, tasmā ~ī ti
vuccati); — anodhi-katvā (or anodhiṁ katvā [cf.
an-okāsaṁ kāretvā above]), ind., having made no
distinction, indiscriminately; Kv 208,31 (= odhiṁ
mariyādaṁ koṭṭhāsaṁ akaritvā, avisesena sabbe yevā
ti attho, Kv-a); AN III 443,8 (sabbasaṁkhāresu ~iṁ
karitvā; Mp: ettakā va saṁkhārā aniccā na ito pare
ti evaṁ sīmaṁ mariyādaṁ akatvā).

an-odhi-jina, mfn., who has not overcome the
limits (scil. of his lower nature); gen. ~assa, MN III
219,10 (Ps: kilesodhiṁ jinitvā ṭhitattā khīṇâsavo
odhi-jino nāma, tasmā a-khīṇâsavassā ti attho);
As 194,26.

an-odhiso, ind. (from an + odhi), without limit
or distinction, indiscriminately; Paṭis II 130,16-25 (~
pharaṇā mettā; Vism 309,19-26); Ps I 283,5 (odhiso
~ disā-pharanavasena mettaṁ bhāventassa) = Sv
(III) 779,17; Nett 94,15 (hetuso ṭhānaso + ; = odhi-
abhāvato kiñci anavasesetvā ti attho, Nett-a).

an-oṇata (or an-onata), mfn. (an + pp. of oṇa-
mati), not bent down, not humble or dejected; m. ~o,
an-oṇatakosajje na ijjhati, Paṭis II 206,14 (quoted Ud-a 186,1
& Vism 386,12, in both places -n-).

anopa, mfn., = -anūpa; f. pl. imā tā haritâ-
nopā, Ja IV 358,30* (= harita-tiṇa-sañchannā anūpa-
bhūmiyo, Ct.).

anūpa (and (once ) anopa), mfn. [ts.], (near the
water) watery, moist; — m., watery land, lowland;
Abh 187; 814 (cf. Abh-sūci: anugatā āpā atrêti ~o);
loc. ~e, Ja IV 381,12'; pl. f. imā tā haritânopā, Ja
IV 358,30* (scil. bhūmiyo, accord, to Ct.). — Cf.
anopa & Anupiya. — Ifc v. nadī-'nūpa-nisevita
(Ja VI 507,1*),

Anopama, n. Npr. of the capital of king Suppa-
tīta (father of Vessabhū-Buddha), DN II 7,9 (v. l.
Anomaṁ); cf. Bv XXII, 18 (Anomaṁ, metr.); Ja I
42,11 (v. l. Anomaṁ, Se); see 4Anoma.

an-opama, mfn. (prākr. aṇovama, Pischel § 77;
= an-ūpama, the rhythm, lengthening of an-upama,
q.v.); Ap 78,4 (appameyyam ~aṁ); MN I 386,8*
(~assa virajassa Bhagavato); Ja I 89,22 (~āya Bud-
dha-siriyā); III 384,7 (do.); V 131,17 (~āya siriyā);
VI 404,11 (~ena sirivibhavena); Ps II 2,12 (sassirīkaṁ
an-opama237 (sukhaṁ tattha ~aṁ).

Anopamā, f. Npr. of a then (author of Thī
151—56); Thī 152, 153 (Thī-a 138,16 139,33).

an-obhāsanīya, mfn. (neg. grd. of obhāseti),
not (needing) to be elucidated; Ud-a 151,9.

4Anoma, n., = Anopama Bv XXII 18 (Ee;
Bv-a Ce prints Anupamaṁ against metre).

a-pada, mfn. [ts.], (a) footless; m. pl. ~ā (scil.

646,8 (~e padaṁ dassitaṁ, ākāse padaṁ kataṁ); which

Apadāna, n. [sa. Avadāna, cf. prec. 2 d], title of
the 13th division of the Khuddaka-Nikāya, containing
Buddhâpadāna (Buddhâpadāniyo dhammapariyāyo;
p. 1-6), Paccekabuddhâpadāna (p. 7-14, 58 vv., whereof
8-49 = Sn 35-75), Therâpadāna (ṝ. e. Sāriputtâpadāna,
etc., in 547 (or 550) chapters including the Buddha's
Pubbakammapiloti p. 299-301 ≠ Av-klp ch. 50), and
Therī-apadāna (i. e. Sumedhâpadāna, etc., in 40
chapters) tales in verse about the past karma of Bud-
dhist saints (cf. apadāna above); Gv 57,4; Sv I 15,28;
17,12; Sp I 18,14; Pj I 12,9; Mhbv 94,28; a great deal of
these auto-biographies are given in extenso (tena vuttaṁ
~e) in Th-a (see Ap (Ce) p. V-IX), and Thī-a (see E* p.
IX-XI); see also Ud-a 263,27 foll. Ss 134,24 foll. (ta-
trâyaṁ Apadāna-pāḷī); Buddh.-sa. Litt. has transmitted
similar legends in Divyâvadāna, Avadāna-çataka, and
Avadāna-kalpalatā; — Ed.s: (Beí) Bangoon 1917
(together with Bv & Cp); (Be2) ib. 1924 (do.); (Ee) by
Mary E. Lilley, I—(II), 1925—27 (PTS; cf. JBAS
1926 p. 340); (Ce) by A. P. Buddhadatta, Colombo
1930; (Se) in the Siamese Tipiṭaka, voll. 32-33 (with
Bv & Cp), 1927; Commentary see next; — Mss. see
JPTS 1882 p. 33 OB.); p.48(C); p.61(B.); — Litt.
see Geiger Gr. 14 (p. 15).

apadāna, n. [sa. avadāna (Speījer in Av-ç
p.I-IV; Hôb. s. v. ahadana); from apa + √dā3: ava-
khaṇḍane, cf. Sadd 398,4; Abh 943 (khaṇḍane ~aṁ
ca itivutte ca kammani); Sp ad Vin I 321,38 (~aṁ
vuccati paricchedo); [1. cutting off, break, {inter-
apadānamowing, reaping, harvesting > (b) harvest-work, mowed
field 5 > (c) exploit, result, work, (esp. meritorious
act); Ct.s explain by lakkhaṇa, from AN I 102,18,
etc.: bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālâpadānāni bālani-
mittāni; Mp-ṭ ad Mp II 169,5: apadīyanti dosā etena,
rakkhīyanti lūyanti chijjanti vā ti apadānaṁ, sattā-
naṁ sammā micchā vā pavatta-ppayogo; tena so-
bhatī ti apadāna-sobhanī; pt ad Sv (III) 828,19:
te (scil. Sugatā) apadāyanti sodhenti satta-santānaṁ
etehī ti Sugatâpadānāni: tisso sikkhā ...);> (d) a
tale or report of such acts; — [1. saha ~ena, without
interruption, in the analysis of sapadānaṁ (q. v.),
Vism 60,20 (Ee sāpadānaṁ!) cf. sa-Dhātup 26,39];
— [Ud-a 216,14 w. r. ~ena for a-ppadānena]; — 2. (a)
DN III 88,17 (nâpadānaṁ paññāyati; = alāyitaṁ
hutvā anūnam eva paññāyati, Sv) ≠ 91,25; 90,14
(~aṁ paññāyittha; = chinnaṭṭhānam ūnam eva
hutvā paññāyi); (b) Th 47 (tuyhi ~e viharaṁ viha-
rāmi anāsavo; Th-a: tuyhaṁ tava apadāne ovāde
gatamagge paṭipatticariyāya viharaṁ . . .); DN III
24,20 (Sugatâpadānesu jīvamāno, gleaning where the
Buddha has mowed; = SMakkhaṇesu, °tassa sāsana-
sambhūtāsu tīsu sikkhāsu, Sv); — (c) AN I 102,3 (~e
sobhati paññā, so Ee; C-mss and Mp: apadāna-sobhanī
paññā, see apadāna-sobhana below); AN V 337,21
(kacci . . . saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajito
sandissati saddhâpadānesu; — saddhānaṁ puggalā-
naṁ ~esu lakkhaṇesu, cf. Ja VI 292,22'(apākaṭa-guṇo
avidita-kammâpadāno)); MN I 96,6 (~e na sampāyati,
"fails to explain his proceedings" (Trsl.); — attano
cariyāya, Ps); — (d) Ap 241,21-23; 301,24; Sv (II)
480,8-10 (~vasena, see next). — Ifc. v. an-°, kammâ°,
caritâ°, Therâ°, Therī-°, Buddha°, Paccekabud-
dhâ°, paṇditâ°, bālâ°, Mahâ° (-suttanta), saddhâ°,
Sugatâ°; cf. pariyāpadāna.

Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā, f., named Visuddhajana-

apadāniya, mfn., ifc. Buddha°, relative to the

Apadāniya, m. Npr. of a thera; his apadāna,

[apadisaṁ, Dhp-a II 39,20 w. r. for apadesaṁ,
