a-paripakka-ñāṇa, mfn., mentally unripe; —
°-tta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, Ps (Ee) III 280,13.

a-paripakka-vedaniya, mfn., to be suffered for
(even) before full ripening; AN IV 382,22 . . . 383,26
(kammaṁ ~aṁ; diṭṭhadhamma-vedaniya +; —
aladdha-vipāka-vāraṁ, Mp).

a-paripakk'-indriya, mfn., whose faculties are
not yet ripe; Ps II 150,35 (veneyyasattā ~ā honti).

a-paripphandana, mfn. & a-paripphandanta,
neg. part, (from paripphandati), not quivering; Ud-a
320,24; 342,21.

a-paripphuṭa, mfn. (cf. sa. parisphuṭa, = an
intensified sphuṭa), not manifest, not clear. — °âlāpa,
mfn., speaking indistinctly; pt ad Sv (III) 938,29 ( =
'mammana'; conj.; Be apparipphuṭatalāpa).

a-paripucchā, f. (3a + sa. paripṛcchā), the not
asking a question, non-inquiring; AN V 136,11 (a-sus-
sūsā ~ā paññāya paripantho).

a-paripuṇṇa, mfn. (3a + sa. paripūrna), (a) not
full, not globular; Ps (Ee) III 384,19 = Sv (II) 451,16
(aññesaṁ akkhigaṇḍā ~ā honti, hatthi-mūsika-kā-
kâdīnaṁ akkhi-sadisehi .. . akkhīhi samannāgatā
honti); —(b) not plentiful or abundant; DN III 81,6
foll. (paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no ~āya; = antarā
a-paripuṇṇaperfect; m.

a-paripuṇṇiya, n. (neg. abstr. of paripuṇṇa),
the not being sufficiently filled; instr, abl. ~ā, Ja IV
284,13* (nadī ~ā va sussāmi), tf not ~iyā = ~ikā,
f. sg. of *a-paripuṇṇaka.

a-paripūra, mfn. (3a + paripūra, cf. pari-
pūrati; cf. aparipuṇṇa); not complete, imperfect,
defective; m. ~o, Vin V 129,13 (addhānahīno + ; ≠ no
paripuṇṇo, Utt-vn 435); AN IV 314,5 (saddho ...
hoti no ca sīlavā, evaṁ so ten' aṅgena ~o) = 359,20
= V 10,5; It 107,13 foll. (~o sīlakkhandho); acc
~aṁ, Pp 35,36 foll. (sīlakkhandhaṁ); AN II 77,14
a-paripūran. ~aṁ (brahmacariyaṁ), MN I 492,1 foll.; AN I
186,10 foll.; — °-kāri(n), mfn., not completing, not
doing the full; m. ~ī, AN III 215,9 (sīlesu ~ī); SN V
378,6 (sikkhāya ~ī).

a-paribrflhayi, aor. 3 sg. of pari-brūheti, to
encourage (with the augment before the prp.), Ja V
361,16* (object rājānaṁ implied, cf. ib. n*);Tr. pro-
poses to read ati-brūhayi; Ct.: 'mā bhāyī' ti vacanaṁ
bhaṇanto ati-brūhesi, mahāsaddaṁ nicchāresi; see
ati-brūheti above.

a-paribhāsaneyya & a-paribhāsiya, mfn.
(neg. grd. of paribhāsati), not reprehensible, blameless;
~aneyyaṁ puggalaṁ, Pj II 478,27; ~iyā (tathāeatā),
Mil 224,29.a-paribhāsaneyya

a-paribhāsaneyya & a-paribhāsiya, mfn.
(neg. grd. of paribhāsati), not reprehensible, blameless;
~aneyyaṁ puggalaṁ, Pj II 478,27; ~iyā (tathāeatā),
Mil 224,29.a-paribhāsaneyya

a-paribhutta, mfn. (neg. pp. of paribhuñjati),
(a) not enjoyed, not shared; AN I 45,28 (amataṁ tesaṁ
~aṁ, quoted Sadd 725,16); — (b) unused; Ja III
257,17 (anucc(h)iṭṭhaṁ ~aṁ); ib.-is (°-pallaṁkaṁ);
— °-kāma, mfn., who has not enjoyed sensual plea-
sures in full; Spk II 395,1 (= 'anikīḷitāvi(n)').a-paribhutta

a-paribhūta, mfn. (neg. pp. of paribhavati), not
despised or disregarded; Ap 462,4 (vattā ~o ca niddoso
paññavā tathā); — °-tta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, It-a (Se)
326.4 ad It 72,22, (a-hīḷitattā ~ā).

1a-paribhoga, mfn., (a) not to be enjoyed; MN I
369.5 (maṁsaṁ ~aṁ; Ps (Ee) III 47,1-49,13); Pj I
175,9 (supinante pi~o, scil. Tathāgato, see ib. 174,23);
— (b) useless; Vin III 48,18 (bhindati vā chaḍḍeti vā
jhāpeti vā ~aṁ vā karoti; = akhāditabbaṁ vā apā-
tabbaṁ vā karoti, Sp); Ud-a 378,33 (udapānaṁ ~aṁ
karissāma); Ja VI 394,27 (macchamaṁsaṁ ~aṁ kat-
1a-paribhogapariggahīta-pokkharaṇī viya ~aṁ tiṭṭhati).

2a-paribhoga, m., the not making use; As 374,14
(+ dup-paribhoga); —°âraha, mfn., = 1a-paribhoga;
Ja V 234,1'; Ud-a 400,1.

a-parimaṇḍala, mfn., incomplete (in its form);
f. tassa kathā ~ā nāma hoti, Ps II 253,19; — n. (adv.)
~aṁ, not all around; Sp (IV) 889,29 (... virajjhitvā ~
nivāsentassa anāpatti; opp. pari-maṇḍalaṁ, q. v.).

a-parimāṇa, mfn. [ts.], without measure, im-
mense, boundless; numerous, indefinite, infinite (in
space or time); Thī 220 (du[k]khaṁ ~aṁ); Sn 149—50
(mānasaṁ bhāvaye ~aṁ; Pj I 248,25; cf. anodhiso,
aparitta, appamāṇa, appamañña); Ud-a 257,1 (~aṁ
cakkavatti-rajjaṁ); ib. 8 (°-kālasambhūtaṁ); Ja IV
6,15' (~aṁ atimahantaṁ); V 411,27 (~am assa
a-parimāṇaVv-a 114,15 (~a[ṁ]-hita-sukha-nibbattakaṁ [Ce
parimāṇa-rahita-sukh°], = 'aparimitaṁ-sukhâva-
haṁ'); Sv I 284,21 (~o dassanâvakāso, explaining
'akkhuddâvakāso'); Ps II 185,1-8 (~esu cakkavā-
ḷesu ~ā sattā); As 6,36 (anantam ~aṁ); Vin II 62,18
foll. (āpattiyo āpajjati ~ā apaṭicchannāyo); 68,25
(āpattiyo āpajjati parimāṇam pi ~am pi, etc.) =
70,15; SN V 430,10 (~ā vaṇṇā ... vyañjanā ...
saṁkāsanā; = appamāṇā, Spk); AN II 182,8 (~ā
padā . . . vyañjanā . . . Tathāgatassa dhammadesanā;
Mp); Nett 8,29 (~ā padā . . . akkharā . . . vyañjanā,
etc., quoted Sadd 230,8); Pj II 110,23 (evaṁ imehi
ekam ekaṁ atthaṁ niddisantehi ~ā atthā niddiṭṭhā);
Dhp-a III 178,5 (~esu deva-manussesu); 452,12
(°-sīlakkhandha-gopanaṁ); Mil 350,2 (~ā devatāyo);
— °-gaṇana, mfn., of immense number; f. ~ā, Sv
(III) 825,30 (= 'aneka-sahassā'); — °-vaṇṇa, mfn.,
with numberless titles to praise (eulogy); DN I 117,14
(~o hi so bhavaṁ Gotamo; = appameyya-vaṇṇo, Sv)
- 133,25 = MN II 168,5 (Ps = Sv); cf. ananta-vaṇṇa,
and MN I 387,3; — °-sattârammaṇa, mfn., directed
towards innumerable individuals; Pj I 248,16; ib. 25
(°-tā, f. abstr.; v. l. appamāṇa° in both places).

a-parimita, mfn. [ts.], unmeasured, unlimited,
indefinite; Thī 475 (petesu ca nirayesu ca ~ā dīyante
ghātā, or ~o dīyate ghāto (v. l. metr.)); 510 (~aṁ
dukkhaṁ; = aparimāṇaṁ, ettakaṁ ti (so Ce) pari-
cchindituṁ asakkuṇeyyaṁ, Thī-a); Pv 248 (ānubhā-
vaṁ ~aṁ; Pv-a); Vv 213 (~aṁ-sukhâvahaṁ; Vv-a
114,12); Ud-a 256,22 (uḷāraṁ ~aṁ lābha-sakkāraṁ);
284,23 (~aṁ dhanaṁ, see apariyanta); 382,8 (~aṁ
sakalaṁ puññasambhāraṁ); 401,17 (°-kālaṁ); Pv-a
129,14-20 (°-sampadā); Mil 355,12 (+ asaṁkhya, appa-
meyya); — °-jala-dhara, mfn., holding immeasurable
waters, Mil 287,13 (mahāsamuddo ~o); — °-ñāṇa-
vara-dhara, mfn., possessing immeasurable excellent
knowledge; Mil 343,9 (pl. ~ā); — °-dassi(n), mfn.,
with unlimited sight, allseeing; instr., Th 91 (~inā Gota-
mena . . . desito dhammo); — °-pañña, mfn., with
unlimited wisdom; m. ~o, Pj II 409,3 (= 'ananta-
pañño').

a-parimita-pāna-bhojana, mfn., eating and
drinking to excess; m. pl. ~ā, AN II 249,22.

a-parimutta, mfn. (neg. pp. of parimuñcati),
not liberated (from, abl.); SN II 174,27 (~o dukkhas-
mā); V 342,12 foll. (~o nirayā, etc.) quoted Ud-a
108,36 foll.

a-parimeyya, mfn. [sa. a-parimeya], immeasur-
able, innumerable; n. ~aṁ, Ap 42,24 (aparimeyy' upā-
dāya patthemi tava sāsanaṁ ɔ: aparimeyyaṁ kālaṁ
or °yye kappe? cf. ib. 40,23; 45,1) = Th-a (Ce) 365,25*
(aparimeyyaṁ up°); m. ~o, Ap 113,22 (Himavā
vâparimeyyo) = Th-a (Ce) 494,13* (Himavā yathā
~o, metr.); Ud-a 419,19 (vipāko); Mil 331,25 (asamo,
a-parimeyyaappamāṇo ~o); m. pl. ~ā manussā, Pv-a 212,8
(asaṁkheyyā + ); acc. pl. or loc. sg. ~e ito kappe, Bv
III 11; Ap 330,3 = Th-a (Ce) 345,19*.

a-pariyatta, mfn. [sa. a-paryāpta], (a) insuffi-
cient; Ja IV 173,22' (idam pi ettakaṁ vatthuṁ
ekass'eva ~aṁ, Ee apariyantaṁ); Ps Ee) III 172,2 (an-
alaṁ ~aṁ, Ee apariyantaṁ, v. l. pariyattaṁ); — (b)
unsatisfied; Spk I 52,22 (atittā ~ā jātā or better
°-a-jātā, Se apariyantajātā; = 'an-alaṁkatā').

a-pariyatti-kara, mfn., not satisfying (cf. a-
tittikara); Dhp-a I 71,8 (idaṁ sarīraṁ idan'eva
olokentānaṁ ~aṁ hutvā idan'eva khayaṁ pattaṁ).

a-pariyanta, mfn. [sa. a-paryanta; sometimes
misreading for a-pariyatta, q. v.], unbounded, un-
limited; DN I 23,3 (ananto ayaṁ loko ~o); Ud-a
339,33 (~o, = 'na antavā'); Paṭis I 43,5-38 (sīlaṁ
~aṁ, opp. (sa)pariyantaṁ: lābhapariyantaṁ, etc.; cf.
Vism 12,25); Dhp-a II 34,8 (~aṁ dhanaṁ ≠ Ud-a
a-pariyantacha'); V 322,21* (a-kkhobhaṇī ~ā sāgarassêva ūmiyo,
scil. senā); Pv-a 58,26 (~esu uḷāresu bhogesu); — °-tā,
f. abstr.; Pv-a 166,25 (saṁsārassa ~aṁ); Dhp-a I 136,24
(kammantānaṁ ~āya akkhayatāya); -—°-kata,mfn.,
infinite; Mil 108,31 (~aṁ kammaṁ); — °-gocara,
mfn., whose sphere (of perception) is unlimited; Dhp-a
III 197,20 (= 'ananta-gocara'); — °-dhana-dhañña,
mfn., possessed of enormous wealth; Pv-a 97,18 (pl. ~ā,
= 'pahūta-dhana-dhaññāse'); — °-pārisuddhi, f.,
complete morality; Vism 47,2, quoted Ss 45,5 ; — °-pā-
risuddhi-sīla, n., the precept of complete purity;
Paṭis I 42,19 foll., quoted Vism 11,12; 46,12 (Paṭis-a
203,14);— °-va(t), mfn., not duly limited or defined;
acc.f. °-vatiṁ (vācaṁ), MN I 287,4 (= aparicchedaṁ,
Ps) = II 148,15 = AN II 22,22 (= pariyanta-rahiLaṁ,
Mp) = V 265,11 = 283,28; — °-sikkhāpada, mfn.,
for whom the precepts are obligatory without restriction;
gen. pl. ~ānaṁ, Paṭis I 42,26 (Paṭis-a 204,18-32), quoted
Vism 46,13; — °âdīnava, mfn., with innumerable
disadvantages; pl. ~ā, īhī-a 243,33 (+ bahudosā, scil.
kāmā; = 'anantâdīnavā').

a-pariyādāna, n., the not being absorbed or over-
come (cf. next); abl. cetaso ~ā, SN IV 125,17 (opp.
pariyādāna, SN III 16,13 with Spk II 262,20: pariyā-
dāya = pariyādiyitvā; = khepetvā, tassa pavatti-
tuṁ okāsaṁ adatvā, pt).

a-pariyādinna (also written °diṇṇa), mfn. (neg.
pp. of pariyādiyati (pari + ā + √dā)), not used up,
not consumed or finished; MN I 79,18 (yāva kīvañ ca
me sakaṁ muttakarīsaṁ ~aṁhoti; = a-parikkhīṇaṁ,
Ps); 83,7 foll. (~ā yev' assa Tathāgatassa dhamma-
desanā, etc.; = a-parikkhīṇā, Ps); SN II 178,15 (~ā
. . . tassa purisassa mātu mātaro assu); Ps I 215,17
(not included, passed over); — °-citta, mfn., whose
a-pariyādinnaAN I 191,7.

a-pariyāpanna, mfn. (neg. pp. of pariyāpajjati,
pari + ā + √pad), 'unincluded'' (opp. pariyāpanna,
involved in the tebhūmaka-vaṭṭa (≠ saṁsāra), see
Abhidh-k-vy Trsl IV 35,16; ib. II 187 n. 3); Kv 507,2
(diṭṭhigataṁ ~aṁ); Tikap-a 129,14; loc. ~e, Yam I
283,11; pl. ~ā (dhammā), Dhs p. 6,34 (As 50,19-20);
583 = 983 = 1037 ≠ 1124 ≠ 1241 ≠ 1267; 992
(maggā) = 1014 = 1165 = 1220 = 1242 ≠ 1489 =
1539; ~ā dhammā, Paṭis I 101,17 = II 230,8; ~ā
bhūmi, Paṭis I 83,28 (Paṭis-a 297,3-4); 84,13-15; Vism
88,29 (apariyāpanno samādhi; opp. kāmâvacaro rū-
pâv° arūpâv°); — °-kathā, f., title of Kv XIV 9 (p.
a-pariyāpannakāmâvacara-hetu, etc.); 1066.

a-pariyāpuṭa, mfn., not studied, not learned (by
heart), not mastered; Vin IV 143,28 (~aṁ idaṁ varaṁ),
— prob, for a-pariyāputa (neg. pp. of pariyāpuṇāti),
cf. Sv I 21,6-25 and Ps II 108,5 (against the B-tra-
dition of Nidd I 234,16 and Vin).

a-pariyiṭṭha, mfn. (neg. pp. of pariyesati), not
sought for; MN III 269,12 (taṁ me idaṁ ~aṁ yeva
sattha-hārakaṁ laddhaṁ) = SN IV 62,26.

a-pariyogāhanā, f. (neg. nomen actionis of
pariyogāhati), want of research (or inquiry, penetration);
Pp 21,20 (aññāṇaṁ +) — Dhs 390 = 1061 = 1162;
Nidd I 413,24 (Ee a-pariyogāhatā; adassanaṁ + ;
Nidd-a: tam eva dhammaṁ na pariyogāhati); kaṁ-
a-pariyogāhanāatthatāya ~ā) = Dhs 425 (As 260,4 = Nidd-a) =
1004 = 1118 = 1235(quoted Sadd 330,7); —a-pariyo-
gāhetvā, neg. abs. of pariyogāhati, Pp 48,30 foll. ( =
paññāya guṇe an-ogāhetvā, Pp-a).

a-pariyodāta, mfn. (neg. pp. of pariyodāyati;
sa. pari + ava + √dai), not (entirely) purified; AN III
213.8 (~assa cittassa pariyodapanāya).
a-pariyonaddha, mfn. (neg. pp. of pariyonan-
dhati; cf. sa. pary-ava-naddha), not insnared, un-
hampered; DN III 223,7 (vivaṭena cetasā ~ena; =
samantato a-naddhena, Sv) = SN V 263,26 ≠
278,28-32; Sv (III) 1013,34 (taṇhāya an-otthaṭo ~o;
= 'an-ajjhāpanno').

a-pariyosita, mfn. (neg. pp. of pariyosiyati; cf.
sa. pary-ava-sita), unfinished, unfulfilled; °-saṁ-
kappa, mfn., whose aspirations are unsatisfied; DN II
287,7* (~o vicikicchī kathaṁkathī vicari(ṁ) dīgham
addhānaṁ; = a-niṭṭhita-manoratho, Sv); Ap 26,1 (~o
kutitthe sañcariṁ ahaṁ) = Th-a (Ce) II 104,31*; —
°-sikkha, mfn., whose training is unfulfilled, hence
°-sikkhatta, n. abstr., Ud-a 363,5.

a-parivajjana, n. (neg. nomen actionis of pari-
vajjeti; cf. sa. parivarjana), not shunning, not avoiding;
loc. ~e (pāpānaṁ), Ud-a 293,31.

a-parivyatta, mfn. (3a + sa. parivyakta), not
distinct; As 174,8 (~aṁ hi tassā tattha kiccaṁ);
°-kicca, mfn., whose function is not distinct, As
174,7 (abl. [abstr.] ~ato).

a-parivāra, mfn. (cf. appa-parivāra), without
followers; Ud-a 324,5 (~ena ekaken'eva [Ee etaken'
eva, cf. Sv (II) 555,7] ṭhātabbaṁ hoti).

[a-parivāsika, mfn., Ja II 435,22', w. r. for
a-pārivāsika, q. v.]

a-parivesana, n. (3a + sa. pariveṣaṇa); Sadd
557,26 (loc. ~e, giving the sense of √yam, but orig,
meaning "except in the sense of parivesana", see Kṣī-
rataraṅginī I 871; X 82).

a-parisaṁkita, mfn. (neg. pp. of parisaṁkati,
pari + √çaṁk), not suspected; Vin III 172,5 (tikoṭi-
parisuddhaṁ macchamaṁsaṁ adiṭṭhaṁ asutaṁ
~aṁ; Sp (III) 604,28: ~aṁ pana diṭṭha-parisaṁkitaṁ
suta-parisaṁkitaṁ tad-ubhaya-vimutta-parisaṁki-
taṁ ca ñatvā tabbipakkhato ñātabbaṁ) ≠ Vin I
238.9 ≠ MN I 369,9 (= diṭṭha-parisaṁkitâdivasena
a-parisaṁkitaṭhaṁ asutaṁ ~aṁ; = cittena ~aṁ, Sp).

a-parisamatta, mfn. (3a + sa. parisamāpta),
not (completely) finished; ifc. v. āraddhâ°, Mogg-v
VI 1 (begun but not ~; = 'vattamāna').

a-parissavanaka, mfn. (3a + parissavanaka from
pari + √sru, cf. sa. parisrava), not overflowing; Ja
I 400,6' (anavasiñcanakaṁ ~aṁ; = 'anavasekaṁ').

a-parissāvanaka, mfn. (from 3a + parissāvana
[sa. parisrāvaṇa], cf. parissāveti (caus. of pari + √sru)),
not provided with a strainer or filter; Vin II 119,5 (na
~ena addhānamaggo paṭipajjitabbo); m.~o, Ja I 198,22
(cf. ib. io: a-parissāvetvā pānīyaṁ pītaṁ bhikkhuṁ).

a-parisâvacara, mfn. (3a + parisâvacara), not
living or associating with an assembly, shunning publi-
city; ~o samaṇo Gotamo, DN III 38,12 (— a-visāra-
dattā parisaṁ otarituṁ na sakkoti, Sv) = 53,9.

a-parisiñcanaka, mfn. (cf. sa. pariṣecaka from
pari + √sic), not pouring over; Nidd-a ad Nidd I 471,18
(synon, an-avasiñcanaka; = 'an-avaseka', q. v.).

a-parisuddha, mfn. (neg. pp. of pari-sujjhati,
from pari + √çudh), not pure, not purified; Vin II
236,19 foll. (~ā parisā, i. e. disqualified); Ja IV 54,9'
(asundaraṁ ~aṁ; = 'anariyaṁ'); Nidd-a ad Nidd
I 448,9 (abbhantare rāgâdīhi ~ā; = 'anto asuddhā');
— °-kāya-kammanta, mfn., 'without purity of
a-parisuddhado. of (bodily) behaviour; AN II 200,17; III 186,18
foll.; — °-ñāṇa-dassana, mfn., do. of knowledge and
insight; AN III 125,26; — °-dhamma-desana, mfn.,
do. of preaching; AN III 124,27; — °-mano-kam-
manta, mfn., do. of mental act; MN I 17,23; — °-ma-
no-samācāra, mfn., do. of mental behaviour; AN II
200,18 foll.; — °-vacī-kammanta, mfn., do. of verbal
act; MN I 17,23; — °-vacī-samācāra, mfn., do. of
verbal behaviour; AN II 200,17; III 186,31 foll.; —
°-veyyākaraṇa, mfn., do. of (detailed) information;
AN III 125,11; — °-vohāra, mfn., do. of social beha-
viour; AN II 188,14; — °-sīla, mfn., do. of morals;
AN III 124,1; — °âjīva, mfn., of impure livelihood;
MN I 17,24 (Ps); AN II 200,18; III 124,14.

a-parisesa, mfn, [sa. a-pariçeṣa], without re-
mainder, all-enclosing; n. ~aṁ nirujjhati, SN V 213,22
foll; As 176,16; pl. ~ā nirujjhanti, DN I 215,24; MN
I 110,11; 267,4; II 25,23 foll.; AN III 165,27 foll.;
Pp 64,5 foll.; ~aṁ ñānadassanaṁ paṭijānāti, MN I
92,36; 482,5; 519,14; 1131,8 foll.; AN I 220,30; IV
428,22 foll. (here Ee °-ñāṇadassanaṁ).

a-parihari(n), mfn. (opp. parihāri(n) from pari
+ √hṛ), accord, to Ct. = not absorbing; SN IV 316,1
foll. (a-chiddo a-hārī ~ī, scil. udaka-maṇiko; Spk:
'ahārī aparihārī' ti udakaṁ na harati na pariharat√
na pariyādiyatī ti attho).

a-parihari(n), mfn. (opp. parihāri(n) from pari
+ √hṛ), accord, to Ct. = not absorbing; SN IV 316,1

hoti) - AN II 183,30 = Dhp-a II 90,20; SN I 108,14

Ja IV 65,21* (appasm' eke pavecchanti; Ct.) — SN
I 18,27* (= ~ pātheyye saṁvibhāgaṁ katvā pavec-

Ud-a 197,2; — f. ~ikā, Ja III 409,8* (dakkhiṇā; quoted
I 228,12*); III 408,18* (pāricariyā; = mandā, parittā,
Ct., quoted 1228,15*); — n. ~aṁ (jīvitaṁ) Thī 95
(= parittaṁ, lahukaṁ, Thī-a); Nidd I 42,10 (do.;
= mandaṁ, lāmakaṁ, Nidd-a); ~aṁ hoti vetabbaṁ,
Ja VI 26,18*; ~aṁ āyupamāṇaṁ parittaṁ lahusaṁ,
DN II 4,3; ~aṁ etaṁ, omakaṁ, thokaṁ, lāmakaṁ,
jatukkaṁ, parittakaṁ, Nidd I 306,22 (— 'appaṁ hi
etam'); appamhā ~aṁ dajjā, Ja V 387,19*; bahuṁ
passatu ~aṁ vā, Sn 909; ~aṁ (puññaṁ), Pv 58;
~aṁ sutaṁ hoti suttaṁ, etc., Pp 62,33; ~am pi

III 10,9 (= domanassa-saṁkhātaṁ ~aṁ pākaṭaṁ

250,29 = 251,2 = 1131,12 ≠ Ja II 277,10; do. +

a-ppaccayā, ind. (3a + paccayā, abl.); from no

pakṣa), non-opposition, non-antithesis; abl. ~to, Ud-a
76,27 (nahānassa pāpahetūnaṁ ~).

a-ppaṭipannaka, mfn. [3a + sa. pratipannaka],
who has not entered upon the path (ariyamagga); Ps (Se)
III 671,1 (~o anārādhako, opp. sīlavā guṇavā, etc).

a-(p)paṭipaharaṇa, n. [cf. sa. pratiprahāra.
m.], the not returning a blow (to, acc); Dhp-a IV 148,8.

a-ppaṭipuggala, m(fn). [apratipudgala, Vyu
1,42; cf. sa. pratipuruṣa], incomparable, matchless;
Thī 185 (Sakyakule jāto buddho ~o); DN II 157,1*
(satthā loke ~o; = patibhāga-puggala-virahito, Sv)
= SN I 158,27* (Spk = Sv) ≠ Av-ç II 199,1*; SN III
86,2* (sa-devakassa lokassa satthā ~o; = sadisa-
puggala-rahito, Spk) = AN II 34,2*; AN I 22,24
Bv XVIII 1 (asamo ~o) quoted Ja I 40,27*; Dhp-a
III 114,1 (Bhagavā sīlâdīhi guṇehi asamo ~o); Vism
207,16 (asamo+) = Sp I 120,10; Mil 239,12 (aggo,
etc, ~o Buddho); acc ~am (jinaṁ +), Ap 156,1;
Nidd II 51,6 (= paṭipuggalavirahitaṁ, Nidd-a); gen.
~assa, Bv I 2; — °-tta, n. abstr., Mp I 116,15 (abl.~ā).

a-ppaṭipucchā, ind. (neg. of paṭipucchā, instr.,
cf. 2ajjhā & anāpucchā above, appaṭisaṁkhā(ya)
below), "without calling upon for an answer", without
inquiry; Vin I 325,33 (paṭipucchā-karaṇīyaṁ kam-
maṁ ~ karoti; formula: asammukhā . . . ~ . . . appa-
ṭiññāya); 113,3 (~ kataṁ hoti).

a-ppaṭibaddha, mfn. (neg. pp. of paṭibandhati
[sa. prati + √bandh]), untied, independent; Nidd II
188,13 (anissito ~o vippamutto; = mānena na
baddho vibaddho, Nidd-a); MN III 25,23 foll. (an-
upāyo anapāyo anissito ~o, etc); n. ~aṁ (cittaṁ),
Paṭis II 206,19 (quoted Ud-a 186,6; Vism 386,16); —
-citta, mfn., whose mind is not fettered (to, loc), Sn
65 - Ap 11,29 (kule kule ~o; Pj II 118,20; = kula-
palibodhena ~o, Nidd II 90,5); f. kāmesu ~ā, Thī
a-ppaṭibaddha

a-ppaṭibala, mfn. [cf. sa. a-pratibala], unable,
incapable; — °-pañña, mfn., whose intelligence is
not capable (of, inf.); acc. f. ~aṁ, Ja IV 35,7' (ku-
ṭumbaṁ vicāretuṁ ~aṁ; = 'asamataṁ').

a-ppaṭi-bāhanīya, mfn. (neg. grd. of paṭibāhaṭi
or ~eti), not to be warded off or evaded; n. ~aṁ, Pv-a
286,11; — °-bāhita, mfn. (neg. pp. do.), not con-
tradicted; m. pl. ~ā(= 'appaṭikkuṭṭhā'), Spk II 279,13
≠ Mp II 277,24 (m. ~o); — °-bāhitvā, neg. abs. of
do., nhaving disapproved; Sv I 160,19 (= 'appaṭi-
kkositvā'); — °-bāhiya, mfn. (neg. grd. of do.), —
a-ppaṭi-bāhanīya(°pāpakammassa ~aṁ ñatvā).

a-ppaṭibhaya, mfn. [3a + sa. pratibhaya; opp.
sappaṭibhaya], from which one does not entertain fear;
m. ~o paṇḍito, MN III 61,21 ≠ AN I 101,18 (quoted
Pj I 127,14; Sadd 317,24); acc. m. gāmantaṁ anupā-
puṇeyya khemaṁ ~aṁ, DN I 73,1; f. disā paṭi-
cchannā hoti khemā ~ā, DN III 189,17 foll.; n.
tīraṁ khemaṁ ~aṁ, MN I 134,36; fearless, pl. khe-
mino ~ā, Pj I 155,9.

a-ppaṭibhāga, mfn. [cf. sa. pratibhāga], 'without
analoggy unequalled, incomparable; m. ~o, Dhp-a I
423,1 (asadiso + ; = 'anuttaro'); Mil 239,11 (aggo, etc,
~o Buddho); Vism 207,16 (asamo +) = Sp I 120,9;
acc m. ~aṁ, Nidd II 51,6 (asamaṁ + ; = attano
paṭibimba-virahitaṁ, Nidd-a); n. ~aṁ . . . nibbā-
naṁ, Mil 316,1; 357,5 (atuliyaṁ+); asadisaṁ ~aṁ
(synon, appatirūpaṁ), Sp I 219,31.

a-ppaṭibhāna, (B-mss often °bhāṇa) mfn. [3a +
sa. pratibhāna from prati + √bhā], who has lost Ms
presence of mind, bewildered, at a loss for an answer;
m. ~o nisīdi (tuṇhībhūto +), DN III 53,22 = MN I
132,30 (= kiñci paṭibhānaṁ apassanto chinna-paṭi-
bhāno, Ps) = 234,2 (= uttaraṁ apassanto, Ps) =
II 154,25 = III 298,23 = AN I 186,29 = 187,18 =
SN I 124,12; ~o maṁkubhūto pajjhāyanto nisīdi, Ja
VI 362,30; Ja IV 121,25 (rājā ~o ahosi) ≠ VI 246,15
(niggayhamāno ~o ahosi); IV 304,16 (paccāharituṁ
na sakkonto ~o nisīdi); acc. m. ~aṁ (tunhībhūtaṁ +),
a-ppaṭibhānaJa V 238,5 (taṁ niggaṇhitvā ~aṁ akāsi); 369,2].
(~aṁ katvā); VI 36,11 (naṁ ~aṁ karonto) ≠ 55,20;
m. pl. ~ā (nisīdiṁsu tunhībhūtā + ), Vin III 162,4 =
II 78,24 ≠ DN III 57,13 = AN V 188,18; Sadd 96,13
(niruttarā +); ~ā ahesuṁ, Bu-upp 39,32 (here spelt
apaṭibhāṇā). — °-tā, f. abstr., Ja IV 12,27' (instr.
~āya).

a-ppaṭima, mfn. sa. a-pratima], incomparable,
matchless; m. ~o (Tathāgato), Ud 84,16* ( = appaṭi-
samo, Ud-a) — DN II 135,6*; AN I 22,24 (adutiyo + ;
scil. Tathāgato); Pj II 583,1 (= 'vidhuro'); Vism
207,15 (asamo + ); Mil 239,11 (aggo+); gen. ~assa
tādino, Th 536 ≠ Mvu III 109,20*; n. ~aṁ, Th 614
(sīlaṁ balaṁ ~aṁ); acc. m. pl. vaggū subhe ~e, Ja
V 54,21* (between dantāni, 20* and dante, ib. 24*).

a-ppaṭimaṁsa, mfn. [cf. sa. pratimarça, m.,
from prati + √mṛç], Utt. 'not to be fingerea", faultless
(said of (bodily) conduct); Vin II 248,22 foll. (Sp) =
AN V 79,16 foll. (parisuddhen' amhi kāya-samā-
cārena (vācī-s°) samannāgato acchiddena ~ena; Mp
(Se) III 393,5 ≠ Sp; opp. sappaṭimaṁsa).

a-ppaṭirūpa (or appatirūpa), mfn. [sa. a-prati-
rūpa], improper, unsuitable, imfit; m. ~o (ayutto +),
Mil 357,10-27; acc. f. ~aṁ (anesanaṁ), DN III 224,25
( = ayuttaṁ, Sv) = SN II 194,6 = AN II 27,22 =
Nidd I 496,32; n. ~aṁ (an-anucchaviyaṁ an-anulomi-
kaṁ+), Vin III 20,19 (Sp: ananulomikattā ~aṁ)
a-ppaṭirūpaattano); Dhp-a III 5,22 (~aṁ oḷārikaṁ); Pj I 242,12
(kāyena~°-karaṇaṁ); Ud-a 16,23(°-dese); Pj I 242,27
(°-vācā-nicchāranaṁ); — °-tta, n. abstr., Sp I 219,31
(abl. ~ā).

a-ppaṭiladdha, mfn. [sa. a-pratilabdha, neg.
pp. of prati + √labh], not (yet) obtained (or learnt);
gen. f. paññāya ~āya paṭilābhāya DN III 284,20 =
AN IV 151,16 foll.; gen. n. ~assa paṭilābhāya, Nidd I
34,11 (= appattassa, Nidd-a); — °-labhitvā, neg.
abs. of do., Nidd II 88,33 (+ aphassayitvā asacchi-
katvā).

a-ppaṭiloma-vatti(n), mfn. [sa. a-pratiloma
+ vartin], not contrary, compliant; m. ~ī, Ja VI
298,1' (= 'a-saṁkusaka-vattī').

a-ppaṭiloma-vatti(n), mfn. [sa. a-pratiloma
+ vartin], not contrary, compliant; m. ~ī, Ja VI
298,1' (= 'a-saṁkusaka-vattī').

a-ppaṭivattiya, mfn. [neg. grd. of sa. prati +
√vṛt], not to be turned backwards (as a rollinq wheel),
or stopped; n. cakkaṁ ~aṁ, Sn 554 = MN ch. 92
(quoted Mil 183,14*) ≠ AN III 148,1 = MN III 248,8
(dhammacakkam pavattitaṁ ~aṁ samaṇena vā
brāhmaṇena vā ...); Ps I 46,28 (°-varadhammacakka-
pavattana, n.); m. ~o (dhammapariyāyo pavattito),
MN III 77,25; acc. ~aṁ sīhanādaṁ nadi, Ja II 245,5
a-ppaṭivattiya

a-ppaṭivāna, mfn. (also spelt °-vāṇa; neg. of
paṭivāna (q. v.), prob. (Tr) from sa. prati + √vā2 (or
*vā: √vam like *dhā: √dham (niddhāpeti), *klā;
√klam (a-kilāsu), see AiGr I § 13), cf. paṭivāpeti, As
407,32 [— nivatteti, mṭ]), incapable of being dis-
gusted, insatiable, indefatigable; m. atitto ~o kāla-
kato, AN I 279,18 foll. (= anivatto anukkaṇṭhito,
Mp); dvinnaṁ dhammānaṁ [scil. methunadhamma-
samāpattiyā ca vijāyanassa ca] atitto ~o mātugāmo
kālaṁ karoti, AN I 78,1-5 (= anukkaṇṭhito a(p)pacc-
osakkito, Mp) ≠ quoted Ja II 326,24' (tiṇṇaṁ dham-
a-ppaṭivānarassa ca); n. ~aṁ (adv.), AN I 50,9-24 (padahāmi;
Mp reads appaṭivānī, see appaṭivāni below); — °-citta,
mfn. id.; AN III 41,24* (= anukkaṇṭhitacitta, Mp).

a-ppaṭivān[ī/i], f. = appaṭivānitā [Buddh-sa. apra-
tivāṇih, Divy 654,27 = 655,2; Vyu 245,1241];
adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhi ca
~nī ca, AN II 93,16 (= anivattanā, Mp; 'appaṭivānitā'
ti vattabbe ~ī ti vuttaṁ, Mp-ṭ); 195,14; III 307,11
(=ukkanthanā appatisaṁgharanā, Mp [cf. Ps III
146,16]); 308,8; IV 320,26; V 93,24; 95,19; 98,2;
a-ppaṭivānīSpk); V 440,9-13; Nidd I 59,22 (Nidd-a = Spk);
376,21 (= anivatti, Nidd-a); Nidd II 144,11 (spelt a-
ppaṭivāṇi).

a-ppaṭivāni, mfn. = prec. (3a + *paṭivānī, see
a-ppaṭivānīya); so AN I 50,9 accord. to Mp II 94,11
(m. ~ī . . . padahāmi; = anosakkanāya ṭhito, Mp);
pl. ~ī, ib. 15-2 4 (padaheyyātha, padahissāma).

a-ppaṭivānitā, f. abstr. from prec; ~ padhāna-
smiṁ, DN III 214,6 (= anivattanatā, Sv) = AN I 50,8
(= appatikkamanā anosakkanā, Mp) = 95,6 = Dhs
(p. 8,10) 1367 (As 54,24; 407,30).

a-ppaṭivāniya, mfn. [Buddh-sa. a-prativāṇīya,
Mvu III 343,1], not loathful, not causing tedium; n.
tañ ca ~aṁ [ - ˇ ˇ - - - ] asecanakam ojavaṁ
(scil. buddhasāsanaṁ), Thī 55 (= anivattita-[fetter
Ce: anivattanīya-]bhāvâvahaṁ niyyānikaṁ, Thī-a)
= SN I 212,30* (Ee with metre °ānīyaṁ; cf. Spk I
316,8: imaṁ hi dhammaṁ paṇḍitā vassasatam pi
a-ppaṭivāniya

a-ppaṭivān[ī/i], f. = appaṭivānitā [Buddh-sa. apra-
tivāṇih, Divy 654,27 = 655,2; Vyu 245,1241];
adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhi ca
~nī ca, AN II 93,16 (= anivattanā, Mp; 'appaṭivānitā'
ti vattabbe ~ī ti vuttaṁ, Mp-ṭ); 195,14; III 307,11
(=ukkanthanā appatisaṁgharanā, Mp [cf. Ps III
146,16]); 308,8; IV 320,26; V 93,24; 95,19; 98,2;
a-ppaṭivānīSpk); V 440,9-13; Nidd I 59,22 (Nidd-a = Spk);
376,21 (= anivatti, Nidd-a); Nidd II 144,11 (spelt a-
ppaṭivāṇi).

a-ppaṭivijjha(t), mfn. (neg. part. of paṭivij-
jhati), not penetrating (to, acc), not acquiring; m.
~anto (uttariṁ), AN V 342,10 (quoted Paṭis II 130,12
a-ppaṭivijjhatvimuttiṁ), SN V 119,19 foll. — °-vijjhiya, neg.
abs., Ja IV 165,24* (atthaṁ; = appaṭivijjhitvā, Ct.).

a-ppaṭivijjha(t), mfn. (neg. part. of paṭivij-
jhati), not penetrating (to, acc), not acquiring; m.
~anto (uttariṁ), AN V 342,10 (quoted Paṭis II 130,12
a-ppaṭivijjhatvimuttiṁ), SN V 119,19 foll. — °-vijjhiya, neg.
abs., Ja IV 165,24* (atthaṁ; = appaṭivijjhitvā, Ct.).

a-ppaṭivijjhana, n. (neg. verb. noun from paṭi-
vijjhati, sa. prati + √vyadh), the not penetrating, not
attaining or acquiring; instr. ~ena, Sv (II) 542,35
(= 'appaṭivedhā') = Spk ad SN V 431,19; abl. ~ā,
Spk II 96,6 (= 'appaṭivedhā').

a-ppaṭivijjhanaka, mfn. (cf. prec), not pene-
trating; Dhp-a IV 194,8 (catunnaṁ saccānam °-mohañ
ca atīto) = Pj II 469,18.

a-ppaṭivijānanta, mfn. [neg. part. of sa. prati
+ vi + √jñā], unsusceptible (of sukha-dukkha), Mil
299,17.

a-ppaṭividdha, mfn. (neg. pp. of paṭivijjhati)
(a) not pierced, unhurt; acc. f. tava senaṁ . . . ~aṁ
ānessāmi, Ja VI 446,26; — (b) not penetrated, not
understood; m. ~o, MN I 438,32 (samayo pi kho te
Bhaddāli ~o ahosi; = kāraṇaṁ ... na paṭividdhaṁ,
na sallakkhitaṁ, Ps); — °-catusacca, mfn., who has
not realized the four truths; gen. ~assa, Ps I 113,17
a-ppaṭividdha

a-ppaṭividita, mfn. (neg. pp. of sa. prati +
√vid1, cf. paṭivedeti), not comprehended, not under-
stood; pl. yesaṁ dhammā ~ā, SN I 4,4*-6* (metre?; =
ñāṇena appaṭividdhā, Spk); also title of the Sutta ib.

a-ppaṭivibhatta, mfn. (neg. pp. of paṭivibhajati,
sa. prati + vi + √bhaj), not divided in fixed portions
(said of food or gifts to the fraternity), to be enjoyed in
common ( = sādhāraṇa); n. ~aṁ, SN IV 304,15 (yaṁ
kiñci kule deyyadhammam sabban taṁ ~aṁ bhavis-
sati; Spk) — V 352,6 = 397,11; — °-bhoga, or
°-bhogi(n), mfn., enjoying in common; m. ~ī, MN
I 322,18 (tathārūpehi lābhehi ~ī hoti sīlavantehi sa-
brahmacārīhi sādhāraṇa-bhogī; Ps: appaṭivibhattaṁ
bhuñjati, ayaṁ ~ī nāma) — II 251,1 = AN III
a-ppaṭivibhatta~ī, DN II 80,20 (Sv = Ps); m. pl. ~ā, Ja IV 390,1
(aññamaññaṁ ~ā paramavissāsikā ahesuṁ).

a-ppaṭivirata, mfn. (neg. pp. of sa. prati + vi +
√ram), not abstaining (from, abl.); pl. ~ā (pāṇâtipātā,
etc), It 63,5 foll. ( = samādāna-viratiyā sampatta-
viratiyā ca abhāvena na pativiratā, It-a (Se) 306,1)
≠ DN III 195,11 foll. ≠ SN V 468,21 foll.; Vin II
295,35 foll. (surāmerayapānā, etc).

a-ppaṭiviruddha, mfn. [3a + sa. prativiruddha],
without combative disposition; gen. ~assa (an-ănu-
ruddha-°), MN I 65,8 (cf. aviruddha, SN IV 71,16*).

a-ppaṭivekkhitvā & °vekkhiya (neg. abs. of
paṭivekkhati, blend of sa. prati + vi + √īks & praty
+ ava + √īks), without having examined or enquired;
a-ppaṭivekkhitvājitabbaṁ); Ja IV 192,8* (~ daṇḍaṁ kubbati; Ct.);
— (b) ~iya, Ja IV 4,27* (maggaṁ; = apaccavekkhitvā,
Ct.); IV 192,1* (sāmaṁ ~; Ct.), quoted Dhp-a III
181,17*.

a-ppaṭivekkhitvā & °vekkhiya (neg. abs. of
paṭivekkhati, blend of sa. prati + vi + √īks & praty
+ ava + √īks), without having examined or enquired;
a-ppaṭivekkhitvājitabbaṁ); Ja IV 192,8* (~ daṇḍaṁ kubbati; Ct.);
— (b) ~iya, Ja IV 4,27* (maggaṁ; = apaccavekkhitvā,
Ct.); IV 192,1* (sāmaṁ ~; Ct.), quoted Dhp-a III
181,17*.

a-ppaṭivedita, mfn. (neg. of sa. prativedita,
pp. caus, prati + √vid1), unannounced; Ja VI 475,20*
(anāmantā pavisati pubbe ~o; Ct.); cf. appaṭisaṁ-
vidita.

a-ppaṭivedha, m. (cf. Buddh-sa. prativedha
from prati + √vyadh), non-penetration, non-intel-
ligence, ignorance; nom. ~o (aññānaṁ+), Pp 21,20
≠ Nidd I 413,24 (Nidd-a) ≠ Dhs 39Ô (As 254,9); 1061;
1162; abl. ~ā (ariya-saccānaṁ an-anubodhā +), DN
II 90,9 (= appativijjhanena, Sv) = Vin I 230,28 =
SN V 431,19 (Spk = Sv) = AN II 1,9 (quoted Kacc-v
a-ppaṭivedha(= tīrana-pahāna-pariññāvasenaappativijjhanā, Spk)
≠ DN II 55,15 (Sv = Spk); rūpe ~, SN III 261,15;
title of the Sutta ib. 261,12-16.

a-ppaṭisaṁkhā, f. [sa. a-pratisaṁkhyā; secon-
dary noun abstracted from appaṭisaṁkhā(ya) below],
not taking into account, non-deliberation; ~ bhojane,
Dhs 1346; Mp I 85,32 (rāgâdīnaṁ avinayo asaṁvaro
appahānaṁ ~ā); acc ~am, Paṭis I 33,15 (= anupāya-
gahaṇaṁ, Ct.); 45,38.

a-ppaṭisaṁkhā(ya), ind. (adv., orig. neg. abs.
of prati + sam + √khyā; cf. appaṭipucchā), without
reflecting, undeliberately: sahasā ~ piveyya, SN II
110,10 (= apaccavekkhitvā, Spk) ≠ MN I 316,3 foll.
(~āya pipeyya; Ps — Spk); SN II 219,19 (sahasā
~ā vācā bhāsitā; = do. Spk) ≠ MN I 94,1 foll.; uda-
karahadaṁ sahasā ~āya pakkhandeyya, AN V 203,1;
sahasā ~āya pamādaṁ āgamma, Ud-a 235,28; ~ā
ayoniso āhāraṁ āhāreti, Pp 21,1 = Dhs 1346 ( =
patisaṁkhāna-paññāya ajānitvā anupadhāretvā, As
401,23).

a-ppaṭisaṁkhā(ya), ind. (adv., orig. neg. abs.
of prati + sam + √khyā; cf. appaṭipucchā), without
reflecting, undeliberately: sahasā ~ piveyya, SN II
110,10 (= apaccavekkhitvā, Spk) ≠ MN I 316,3 foll.
(~āya pipeyya; Ps — Spk); SN II 219,19 (sahasā
~ā vācā bhāsitā; = do. Spk) ≠ MN I 94,1 foll.; uda-
karahadaṁ sahasā ~āya pakkhandeyya, AN V 203,1;
sahasā ~āya pamādaṁ āgamma, Ud-a 235,28; ~ā
ayoniso āhāraṁ āhāreti, Pp 21,1 = Dhs 1346 ( =
patisaṁkhāna-paññāya ajānitvā anupadhāretvā, As
401,23).

a-ppaṭisaṁvidita, mfn. (neg. pp. of sa. prati +
saṁ + √vid1, [in this sense caus.! cf. cudita to codeti,
rusita to roseti], see also a-ppaṭividita above), (a)
not known, (b) unannounced; m. pubbe ~o, Vin IV
160,15** (b; loc. ~e, ib. 32'; wanting JAs 1914 p.
522,1-16); yo 'haṁ pubbe ~o, MN II 141,20 (b =
aviññāta-āgamano, Ps); ... pubbe ~o, AN III 59,3
(b; v. l. ~aṁ); acc pubbe ~aṁ mam . . . pañhaṁ
apucchi, SN II 54,13 (a or b; = pubbe mayā avidi-
taṁ aññātaṁ, Spk); — °-viditvā, abs., (cf. paṭisaṁ-
vediyati); AN V 292,3-6 = 294,27-30 (v. l. °-veditvā).

a-ppaṭisaṁvedana, mfn. (cf. prec), not feeling,
void of sensation; m. ~o me attā, DN II 66,8 foll.
(misprinted °-vedino, Sv (II) 505,33).

a-ppaṭisaṁharaṇā (or °samgharaṇā), f. (neg.
verb. noun of paṭisaṁharati, sa. prati + saṁ + √hṛ),
not drawing back, not abandoning; Mp ad AN III 307,11
a-ppaṭisaṁharaṇāṭisaṁsaraṇā; Ce appaṭisaṁgharaṇā; cf. Ps III 146,16).

a-ppaṭisandhi, f. (3a + sa. pratisandhi), free-
dom from rebirth; ~i abhiññeyyā, Paṭis I 11,1 foll.;
gen. ~iyā, Nidd I 438,29* (nâññaṁ patthayate kiñci
aññatra ~iyā; Nidd-a).

a-ppaṭisandhiya (or °ika, mfn. (á) (properly ~iya,
neg. grd. of sa. prati + sam + √dhā), what cannot be put
together again, irreparable; udakumbho bhinno ~iyo,
Pv 92 (= puna pākatiko na hoti, Pv-a) = Ja III

appāyana, n., nomen actionis from prec. [sa.
āpyāyana], Sadd 559,8 (sense of √pūr).

appâyuka, mfn. [cf. sa. alpâyuṣ], short-lived;
f. ~ā (Bhagavato mātā), Ud 48,5 (= parittâyukā
ati-ittara-jīvitā, Ud-a; cf. DN II 14,3); ~ī, Vv 453
(= ~ā, Vv-a 183,29); m. pl. ~ā, DN I 19,1 foll.
(aniccā addhuvā+) — III 131,26; MN III 202,21
appâyuka65,12 (aññe ~ā, aññe dīghâyukā); Dhp-a I 140,1
(pubbe . . . manussā dīghâyukā, etarahi ~ā); Pv-a
103,27 (°âdi-vasena); — °-tara, mfn. (compar.); pl.
~ā, DN I 18,22; — °-tta, n. abstr., MN III 206,1;
— °-dīghâyuka-bhāva, m.abstr.; Vism 422,16; —
°-buddha, m., a short-lived Buddha (i. e. a Buddha
belonging to an epoch, in which the human life is
short; opp. dīghâyuka-buddha); pl. ~ā, Pj II 194,9;
— °-saṁvattanika, mfn., conducive to a short life-
time; m. ~o, AN IV 247,11 (scil. pāṇâtipātassa
vipāko); Ps III 67,1 (scil. pāṇâtipāto); f. ~ā (paṭi-
padā), MN III 203,23; 206,6; n. ~am, Ja I 275,5
(scil. pāṇâtipāta-kammaṁ).

appâyutta, n. abstr. (from appa + āyu), — ap-
pâyukatta; Mhv LXXIII 145 (~aṁ ca sattānaṁ
. . . jānantī).

appâvasesa, mfn. [sa. alpa + avaçeṣa], with
only little left; n. parittakaṁ ~aṁ, Pv-a 52,6.

appâsi(n), mfn. [from sa. alpa + √aç1], ealing
little, abstinent; m. ~ī nipako sūro, Ja VI 295,12*
appâsin

appâsi(n), mfn. [from sa. alpa + √aç1], ealing
little, abstinent; m. ~ī nipako sūro, Ja VI 295,12*
appâsin

2appâhāra, mfn. [sa. alpâhāra], taking little
food, moderate, abstinent; m. ~o samaṇo Gotamo,
MN II 6,81; 7,2, quoted Pj II 207,24; Bhagavā hi
~o, MN II 5,32; ~o (scil. Bhagavā), Ps III 238,14;
bhikkhu appaṭṭho hoti, appakicco . . . ~o hoti ano-
darikattaṁ anuyutto, AN III 120,12 = 121,13; acc.
2appâhāra(scil. muniṁ . . . Gotamaṁ), Sn 165 = SN I 16,* ( =
bhojane mattaññutāya mitâhāraṁ . . . parittâhāraṁ,
Spk); pl. ~ā, Ap 18,3 (appicchā nipakâ ete ~ā alo-
lupā) = Th-a Ce II 97,17*; Ap 363,18 (~ā ca te sabbe
sobhenti mama assamaṁ); — °-tā, f. absir., Mil
181,27 (khanti ~ rati-vippahānaṁ ākiñcaññaṁ); Ja
VI 260,24' (appâhāratā-saṁkhātaṁ āhārahetu pā-
passa akaraṇaṁ = 1appâhāra); instr, tāy' ev' ~āya,
MN I 80,13 foll; 245,28 foll.; ~āya vaṇnavādī, MN
II 5,32 = 6,31; 7,3, quoted Pj II 207,25; SN II 202,20;
208,29; Ja IV 50,11 (Siddhatthakumāro ~āya mato);
Dhp-a III 79,18 (sattâhaṁ ~āya); °-dhammena, Ps
III 238,13.

1appâhāra, m. [sa. alpa + āhāra] = appâhāratā,
(f. abstr.): Ja VI 260,20* (~aṁ Garuḷo, scil. bhāsati
[ɔ: vaṇṇeti]).

appiccha, mfn. [appa + icchā, sa. alpôccha],
having few or moderate wishes; Sn 628 (anokasāriṁ
~aṁ; = anicchaṁ, Ps III 438,14) = Dhp 404 (quoted
Mil 386,20*); Sn 707 (ūnûdaro mitâhāro appicch' assa
appicchaappâhārā (see above) alolupā); 30,24 (~ā hotha san-
tuṭṭhā, etc.) = Th-a Ce II 109,6*; ~o + santuṭṭho
pavivitto, Th 581 = 857; Nidd I 225,11 {quoted Vism
25,3); SN I 63,27; II 202,20; 208,29; 209,1; AN IV
233,1; Mil 358,13; Ps III 20,25; ~assa santuṭṭhassa
ayaṁ dhammo, DN III 287,17; AN IV 228,20;
229,18; 232,25; ~assa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa ...
vaṇṇaṁ bhāsitvā, Vin III 21,12 = 145,22 ≠ 305,17
= II 196,37; ~ā santuṭṭhā lajjino, etc, Vin I 44,24;
~o santuṭṭho āraddhaviriyo, Vism 19,13; ~o sorato
danto, SN I 65,21*-2 5*; ~aṁ hirisampannaṁ, Pv
747; MN I 214,6 (attanā ca ~o appicchatāya ca
vaṇṇavādī) = 217,26; AN V 167,19 (~o icchāvinayassa
vaṇṇavādī); MN I 145,20 (attanā ca ~o °-kathañ ca
bhīkkhūnaṁ kattā) = AN V 130,1 ≠ Ud-a 233,28;
MN I 19,26 (~o 'ham asmi, ye hi vo ariyā ~ā . . .
paṭisevanti tesam ahaṁ aññatamo); AN III 432,18
(musāvādā paṭivirato ~o ca sammādiṭṭhi ca); IV 2,3
(hirimā ca ottappī ca ~o ca sammāditthi ca; cf.
ib. V 154,1); IV 218,10 (~o so . . . kulaputto); 220,11.
(saddho, etc. + ~o) ≠ V 124,16 = 125,10; Ja III
313,13* (~assa hi posassa appacintisukhassa ca);
342,13 (~o dhuta-guṇena (Se dhutaṅgag°) na tappati);
Mil 343,10 (dhutaṅgam anugatā ~ā santuṭṭhā); AN
I 12,19 (~assa . . . kusalā dhammā uppajjanti: =
anicchassa, Mp); Dhp-a III 72,16 (evaṁ ~assa Bud-
dhassa sāsane pabbajitvā); Ud-a 79,12 (aho ~o
vatâyaṁ ayyo); 227,14 (~o ti, na(-)iccho; so Ee Ce Se);
Pj II 500,11 (tīsu ṭhānesu ~o ahosi); — ifc. v. adhi-
gama-°, dhutaṅga-°, paccaya-°, parama-°, pari-
yatti-° (Ps II 140,1-141,1 ≠ Ud-a 228,14-29), and
adhigamappicchatā (f. abstr.), etc. (Pj II 494,22-31).

appiccha-kathā, f., instruction about appichā;
~ā + santuṭṭhi-kathā, etc., Ud 36,14 (Ud-a); AN IV
352,1; MN I 145,10 = AN V 130,1; Nidd I 220,18
(Nidd-a).

appicchatā, f. (abstr. from appiccha), modera-
tion of desires (one of Ihe 5 dhuta-dhammā: Mp I
162,17 foll.); nom. ~ā, AN I 12,18 foll. ( = alobho,
Mp); 38,16; Th 1124 (sappurisehi vaṇṇitā); + san-
tuṭṭhitā sallekhatā, DN III 115,12 (= nittaṇhată,
Sv); Vism 53,10 = 81,10 ≠ 59,1; + santuṭṭhitā,
Vibh-a 88,14; Vism 569,16 (~ā-santuṭṭhitā-paṭipak-
appicchatātappa-~âdi); Ud-a 228,10 (etesaṁ appicchānaṁ yā
~ā); Pj II 501,1 foll. (dassane . . . savane . . . puc-
chāya ~ā); acc. ~aṁ attani sampassamāno, MN I
19,18; ~aṁ ... santuṭṭhiṁ, etc, nissāya, AN III 219,1
foll.; dat. ~āya, Vin I 305,10 (naggiyaṁ . . . ~āya, etc,
saṁvattati); MN I 13,10 (taṁ . .. ~ ... saṁvattissati);
gen. ~āya, etc, vaṇṇavādī, MN I 214,1 = 217,16 = SN
II 202,10 ≠ 208,19 'foll.; Ja I 127,1 (do. vaṇṇaṁ bhā-
sāmi); + nittaṇhatāya, Ja III 313,16,1 mahicchatāya
pahānāya ~ā bhāvetabbā, AN III 448,10; mahic-
chatāya saṁvattanti no ~āya, AN IV 280,11 = Vin
II 258,14; iminā aṭṭhamena . . . dhammena . . . yad
idaṁ ~āya, AN IV 218,14; catubbidhāya ~āya, Pj II
494,10 (cf. Ud-a 228,15); tena ~āya kiñci avutto
(so Ce), Pv-a 73,18; Ud-a 62,15 (paramappicchatā-
dassanamukhena); — ifc. see appiccha, ifc

appiccha-paṭipatti, f., practice of contentment
(appicchā); Mil 242,1 (Bhagavatā . . . ~iṁ pakittaya-
mānena; quoting MN I 13,17).

appiccha-bhāva, m. (abstr. from appiccha),
= appichatā; °-paṭisaṁyuttā kathā = appiccha-
kathā, Ud-a 227,15; Dhp-a I 285,1 (parama°).

appiccha-santuṭṭha, mfn., with few wishes and
contented (dvandva of two synonyms); Ja III 491,1
(parama-°) = Dhp-a I 284,16; — °-bhāva, m. abstr.;
Ja III 491,1 (°-guṇena); Dhp-a I 284,17 (do.).

appicchā, f. [sa. alpa + icchā], contentment;
~añ ñeva nissāya, Nidd I 238,10 (+ santuṭṭhiṁ) ≠
Pp 70,1; instr. ~ā appacintāya avidūragamanena
ca, Ja III 313,11* (= āhāre appicchatāya nittaṇha-
tāya, Ct.; -ā: -āya see appaṭipucchā, etc).

appita, mfn. (pp. of 1appeti; sa. arpita, √ṛ (caus.))
1. fixed into or on; directed towards; fastened; Ja VI
78,11' (maraṇamukhe ~o; Se reads sampatto paviṭṭho
ti attho); Ud-a 333,10 (suṭṭhu ~ā+ allīnā; = 'samap-
pitā'); Mp I 445,11 (attano ~aṁ kaṇḍaṁ ... paṭibāhi);
— (saidof a textile product: firm, solid), Vin III 257,12
foll. (āyatañ ca karohi vitthatañ ca ~añ ca suvītañ
ca) = 259,1** (= ghanaṁ, Sp); — 2. do. of the citta:
appitaviya acalaṁ tiṭṭhati, scil. cittam); Mil 415,1 (māna-
saṁ yoniso manasikāre ~aṁ vahati; [Ud-a 417,11
(ekacco pana dussīlo pi samāno adussīlo appito (v. l.
dappito) viya carati, Se susīlo, omitting appito) ≠
Sv(II) 539,16 (ekacco dussīlo pi dappito viya vicara-
ti)]; °-appitakkhaṇe, Ps II 232,1; —3. ended, ousted,
destroyed; m.pl. ~ā, Vibh 195,11 (santā ... atthaṁgatā
... ~ā vyappitā; = vināsitā, Vibh-a 263,1), quoted
As 170,17 = Ps I 245,10; — °-citta, n., a concen-
trated mind; Saddh 233 (maggaṁ ~añ ca).

appitthika, mfn. (from appa + itthi), with few
women; n. pl. kulāni ~āni bahu-purisāni, SN II
264,7 (C-mss. appatthikāni; opp. bahutthikāni appa-
purisāni, ib. 1, cf. Vin II 256,17 = AN IV 278,24).

1appiya, mfn. [sa. a-priya], (a) disagreeable,
unpleasant, not dear; Sn 363 (hitvāna piyañ ca ~añ
ca); p. 78,13 (piyañ ñeva bhāsati no ~aṁ); 450
(piyaṁ bhaṇe nâppiyaṁ); 811 (na piyaṁ kubbati no
pi ~aṁ; Nidd I 134,13 foll); 968 (atha-ppiyaṁ vā
pana ~aṁ vā ... abhisambhaveyya); Dhp 210
(mā piyehi samāgañchi ~ehi kudācanaṁ, piyān'
1appiya246 (sace te dukkham ~aṁ, mā kāsi . . .) ≠ 248 =
288; Vin I 10,28 = SN V 421,22 (~ehi sampayogo
dukkho; opp. piyehi vippayogo); Vibh 99,8, etc.
(quoted Vism 498,13); MN I 97,20 (ayam me pug-
galo ~o amanāpo); 395,9 (sa ca [scil. vācā] pare-
sam ~ā amanāpā); AN III 136,12 (kulūpako bhikkhu
kulesu ~o ca hoti amanāpo ca, etc.) ≠ IV 155,21;
Khp VIII 5 (~ā vā pi dāyādā); Ja III 302,8* (dāyādā
yeva [ɔ: ye ca?] ~ā); 353,6* (yācako ~o hoti, yācaṁ
adadam ~o) = Vin III 148,32*; Ja IV 217,18* (atici-
raṁ-nivāsena piyo bhavati ~o) = V 233,24*; V 29,11*
(na câpi me manasā ~o si); 308,18* (na câpi ~aṁ
tuyhaṁ kareyyāmi) = 309,2*; Mil 74,10 (~o pabbaji-
tānaṁ kāyo); — (b) m. subst. = an enemy; Dhp 77
(asataṁ hoti ~o) — Th 994; — ifc. v. an-°, piyâp-
piya (Dhp 211; DN II 277,7 foll.), piyâppiyena,
ind. (Ja IV 102,13*); — — °-akaraṇa, n., not
doing harm; Ja V 309,7' (vikuddha-bhāva+); —
°-amanāpa-sadda, m., a disagreeable and unplea-
sant sound; Sv (III) 828,15 (= 'bheraṇḍakaṁ'; pt);
— °-tā, f. abstr., disinclination, non-affection; loc.
~āya, Ja IV 32,22*; acc. ~aṁ, ib. 35,3*; — °-pa-
samsi(n), mfn., extolling unpleasant persons; m., ~ī
ca hoti piyagarahī, etc, AN IV 155,23 (Mp) = 156,1;
— °-puggala, m., a person whom one does not hold
dear; Vism 296,1 (~e, etc, scil. ayaṁ mettā . . . na
bhāvetabbā, cf. ib. 314,16); — °-bhāva, m. abstr.
= appiyatā; Ja IV 33,1'; 35,11'; — °-rūpa, mfn.,
of unpleasant shape; loc. ~e rūpe na vyāpajjati,
MN I 270,10 ≠ SN IV 184,27, quoted Nidd II 85,11
(= aniṭṭha-sabhāve rūpârammaṇe, Nidd-a); —
°-vacana, n., unkind words; Mil 161,20 (~ena . . .
parisā bhinnā ti na sutapubbaṁ); — °-vādi(n), mfn.,
speaking abusively. Abh 735 (= 'mukhara'); —
°-sampayoga, m., association with unpleasant persons
or things; Ja II 205,4 (lokasmiṁ hi ~o va dukkho);
+ piyavippayoga, Ja I 168,10' (cf. Vibh (99,8)
100,29-35); Vism 504,26 (~o nāma amanāpehi satta-
saṁkhārehi samodhānaṁ); — °-sīla, mfn., of an un-
pleasant disposition; pl. ~ā (puggalā), Ja IV 382,6'
etym, of a-pesala).

2appiya, mfn. [sa. arpya, grd. of arpayati; cf.
prākr. appi(y)a from sa. arpita (see appita above and
appeti, a, 2), grd. appetabba below], to be set up as
the main thing (i. e. the principal expression or the
leading word; cf. sa. abhidheya); Kv 26,20 (kāyo ti
vā sarīran ti vā, sarīran ti vā kāyo ti vā kāyaṁ
~aṁ karitvā, ese se ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte;
— kāyaṁ appetabbaṁ alliyāpetabbaṁ . . . avibhaji-
tabbaṁ katvā, Kv-a) ≠ 119,36 (cf. Kv Trsl. p. 24 n. 3).

Appiyā, m. pl. Npr. of a legendary people; SN
II 192,5 (C-mss.; Ee & Se Suppiyā; quoted Ss 180,32
(Ce Appiyā); 193,11* (do.).

a-ppiyāyanta, mfn. (neg. part. of piyāyati [sa.
priyāyate]), unkindly disposed; Ja V 114,26'(kalyāṇa-
kammaṁ dussento (or °anto) ~o aṭṭiyanto).

appī-kriyā, f. [from sa. alpī + √kṛ], the making
small; loc. ~āya, Dhātum 575 (sense of √thus, prob,
only in order to explain thusa [sa. tuṣa; cf. tūsta)].

a-ppīta, n. = appīti, f. (q. v.); loc. ~e, sense
of γāus, Dhātum 439.

a-ppīti, f. [sa. a-prīti], dislike, aversion, enmity;
(a) loc. ~iyaṁ, Dhātup 451 (sense of √dis3 [sa. √dvis])
= Sadd 452,6; ~imhi, Dhātum 690 (do.); — (b) loc.
~iyaṁ, Dhātup 452 (sense of √dus) = Sadd 489,28;
~imhi, Rūp 529 — Dhātum 691 (do.) ≠ 439 (appīte,
a-ppīti

appī-bhāva, m. abstr. [from sa. alpī + √bhū],
the being small; loc ~e, (a) Sadd 335,13 (sense of
√kuñc); (b) Sadd 353,9 (sense of √cuṭ); (c) Sadd 489,23
(sense of √mas5); (d) Sadd 489,24 (sense of √lis).

appīyati, pr. 3 sg. (pass, of 1appeti [sa. arpyate]),
to be adapted or fastened (in, loc); Vibh-a 9,13 (tādisam
hi ārammaṇaṁ manasmiṁ na ~ati, explaining a-
manāpa).

appuyya, abs. of √āp, v. l. for pappuyya, Vin II
156,28* = AN I 138,6* (Ee pappuyya; v. l. appuyya;
cf. Geiger § 212).

app-eka, m(fn.) pl. (api + eka; properly two
words like next), some; nom. m. pl. ~e satam addak-
khuṁ . . . sataṁ eke . . . ~ 'nantam addakkhuṁ, DN
II 256,6* foll. (= ekacce, Sv) ≠ Kl Turf IV 165,3-7*.

app-ekacca, mfn. mostly pl. (api + ekacca, pro-
perly two words, cf. Amg app egaiya; see Sadd 285,18-
286,1), (and again) some, several; m. sg., MN II 264,24
(app' [Ee ap'] etth' ekacco); acc m. pl. ~e paraloka-
vajja-bhaya-dassāvino, DN II 38,24 — SN I 138,18
= MN I 169,10 ≠. Paṭis I 121,5-6; 1133,11-12; f.
pl. ~ā sakiṁ vijātāyo, Thī 216; n. pl. ~āni uppalāni,
app-ekacca= AN III 26,19; ~āni seda-phusitāni, MN I 233,33;
— often repeated — some . . . some (others ) [Mvu I
23,9-11]; m. pl. ~e, Sn p. 104,22 foll; DN II 89,14
foll. = Ud 90,3 foll.; Ud-a 360,17 foll.; do. Vin I
36,1 = DN I 118,27 = MN I 290,30 = 401,13 = AN I
180,32 = 188,23 ≠ Ud-a 380,16 ≠ Vv-a 208,27; ~e
. . . nibbānaṁ ārādhenti, ekacce nârādhenti, MN III
4,26; n. pl. ~āni uppalāni, DN II 38,27 — MN I
169,14 = SN I 138,13 ≠ Mvu III 318,7 (anyāni . . .
anyāni).

app-ekadā, ind. (api + ekadā), sometimes, now
and then; Vin IV 178,29-32; SN I 162,6-10; IV
111,1-28; MN I 238,30; 117,1 (. . . 16 . . . 33, etc),
quoted Mil 213,8 foll.; Ja I 67,14 (cf. atho pi ekadā, Ja
V 401,6*); — repeated = now ... now, Dhp-a III 303,22-
304,1; Mil 273,18; repeated with negation, ~ Tathā-
gataṁ dhammadesanā patibhāti, ~ na p°, AN IV
337,13 = V 154,17; AN V 83,18 foll.; 86,9-10.

2appeti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. apy-eti, api + √i], to pour
or flow into; SN II 184,4 (yato câyaṁ Gaṅgā nadī
pahoti yattha ca mahāsamuddam ~eti) ≠ Dhp-a IV
130,15*; Abhidh-av 132,33* (tīraṁ ~eti pārimaṁ,
arrive to); [pt ad Spk I 78,24: na ~etī ti na u[p[peti,
see 1appeti]; 3 pl. ~enti (savantiyo mahāsamuddaṁ),
AN IV 199,8-11 (= allīyanti osaranti, Mp) = 202,23
— Ud 53,33 (Ud-a = Mp) = Vin II 238,2 ≠ Mil 70,23.

1appeti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. arpayati, caus. of √ṛ], to
connect, to adapt or fit, thus: (a) 1. to place or fix in
or upon (loc, see appita 1); 2. to exhibit, display
something (acc) as the main point; 3. to direct towards
(see appita 1); (b) 1. to put into, to insert (in, loc.); 2. to
apply to (esp. cittaṁ ārammaṇe; cf. appanā); 3. to bring
into the state of appanā (with obj. jhānam, samāpattiṁ);
4. to realize the appanā (without obj.); — (c) to deliver,
to give (in return), hand over (to, dat.); — 3 sg. ~eti
(Jina-vacanaṁ), Sv I 31,7 (a, 2; = nidasseti, pt) =
Ps I 7,16 = Spk I 9,9 = Pj I 104,2 - Ud-a 18,1;
1appetimano ~eti, Spk I 78,24 (b,2; explaining 'amanāpā';
but pt: na appetī ti na u[p[peti, as from 2appeti);
magga-cittaṁ ~eti, Ud-a 33,31 (b, 3); nirodhe cittam
~eti, Ud-a 35,6 (b, 2); so hi ekaggo hutvā ~eti, As
115,13 (b, 4); Abhidh-av 95,24*-28*; 101,1* (b, 3);
102,12* (b, 4?); āneti deti ~eti, Pj II 231,2 (= 'āva-
hati', (c)); handa naṁ gaṇhathā ti ~eti viya, Ps II 18,10
(c) ≠ Sv (II) 498,13 (epexegesis to nideti; = niyyāteti,
pt); — 3 pl. ~enti (nimbasūlasmiṁ), Ja III 34,26* (a,
1; = āvuṇanti, Ct.; Ce accenti; Ck abbenti, cf. Tr.
Notes p. 64 n. 4;) Vin II 136,37 (gaṇṭhikaṁ . . . cīvare
~enti; cf. 137,1 (b, 1)); As 142,36 (cittam ārammaṇe
~e[n]tī ti 'appanā', (b, 2)); Ap 3,6 (abhiññā, b, 3); —
part. f. ~entī (nāmamuddikaṁ saññāṇañ ca), Vv-a
110,11 (a, 1); — imper. 2 pl. ~etha (sūlasmiṁ), Ja VI
17,5* (a, 1; Ee accetha; Ck abbaccetha, which Tr. in-
terprets as abbetha; = āvuṇetha, Ct.); — pot. 1 sg.
~eyyaṁ (veraṁ), Vin I 347,4 (see foll.); — aor. 3 sg.
~esi, Ja IV 210,17-23* (veraṁ; = pā koṭa giyēya, Ja-
pota, i. e. retaliated); Mhv XXX 33 (~esi balatthaṁ
tassa; c) ≠ Thūp 78,1 (ṭhapesi); — inf. ~etuṁ, Vin II
137,3-4 (b, 1); Abhidh-av 95,32* (b, 4); Ps 1131,15 (taṁ
hi jhānaṁ hutvā ~etuṁ na sakkoti; cf. ib. 362,4-2 5 ; b,
4); — abs. ~etvā, Ps I 103,21 (b, 3; phalasamāpattiṁ);
II 116,18 (do.); 152,32 (samāpattiṁ); III (Se) 571,20
(samāpattiyo; ad MN III 115,9); Mp (S'') III 234,3 ad
AN IV 126,32 (nibbānârammaṇaṁ samāpattim); 362,8
ad AN V 8,1 (santaṁ santan ti ~etvā nisinnassa;

apâpāsi, aor. 3 sg. of apa + pā, to drink from
(acc); Ja II 126,7* (taṁ [scil. pokkharaṇiṁ] sigālo ~;
= apāsi, Ct.).

a-pāpuṇitvā, neg.abs.of pāpuṇāti (cf. a-(p)patva);
na taṁ ~ viriyassa santhanaṁ (spelt santhānaṁ or
saṇṭhānaṁ) bhavissati, MN I 481,4 — SN II 28,27
= 276,15 = AN I 50,12 = IV 190,11).

apâpuraṇa, n. (from apâpurati, q. v.), also
written avâpuraṇa; a key; x\bh 222 (kuñcikā tāḷo
avāpuraṇaṁ); Sadd 430,11 (avâpuraṇan ti avāpuranti
vivaranti dvāraṁ etenā ti avāpuraṇaṁ, yaṁ kuñcikā
ti pi tālo ti pi vuccati); apâpuraṇaṁ ādāya: Vin I
apâpuraṇaavâpuraṇaṁ ādāya: SN III 132,17; AN IV 374,12 (v. l.
apâ°); Ja I 501,25; Mp I 196,21. (misprint avāpūra-
ṇaṁ); 198,18 (misprint avapūraṇaṁ).

apâpurati, pr. 3 sg., sometimes written avâ-
purati [from *apāvurati, sa. apa + ā + √vṛ; p-p
for p-v as in palāpa, opilāpeti (Tr. Notes 63); *vurati,
sixth present class, Whitney § 756; for vowel degree
see Ai Gr I § 21, (a)-b; Sadd 430,5-13 books it under
√pur], to open (a door); 3 pl. ~anti amatassa
dvāraṁ, It 80,5* (so Mss. Se Se for apāvuṇanti Ee,
which was conjectured (cf. āvuṇati) for B apāmu-
ṇanti, cf. apāpuṇitvāna above; = ugghāṭenti ama-
tassa nibbānassa dvāraṁ ariyamaggaṁ, It-a); part,
m. avāpuranto (atthassa dvārāni), Ja VI 373,14* (no
apâpurati(= ariyamaggaṁ vivarantaṁ, Vv-a 284,11-13, v. l.
avāp°); imper. 2 sg. ~a, Vin I 5,31* (apâpur' etaṁ
amatassa dvāraṁ) = MN I 168,27* (= vivara, Ps;
≠ MN II 93(20*)) = SN I 137,23* (Ee avâpur', but
see v. l.; = vivara, Spk; quoted Sadd 430,6) ≠ Mvu
III 317,17* (Tuneld, Recherches p. 161; codd. +apa-
vṛtamam°) ≠ (retouched) Lal 398,17*; inf. ~ituṁ,
Vin II 148,19 (na sakkonti kavāṭaṁ ~); abs. (a ) ~itvā,
MN I 30,30 (= vivaritvā, Ps); (b) ~itvāna, Thī 494
(Ee w. r. apâpuṇitvāna); pp. apāruta, caus, apâpu-
rāpeti, pass, apâpurīyati (q. v.).

(apâpurāpeti or avâpurāpeti) pr. 3 sg. caus. of
prec, to have to be opened; abs. avâpurāpetvā (nagara-
dvārāni), Ja I 263,30.

apâpurīyati or avâpurīyati, pr. 3 sg. pass, of
apâpurati, to be opened; MN III 184,20-21 (mahāni-
rayassa pacchima-° . . . uttara-° . . . dakkhiṇa-dvāraṁ
apâpurīyati); Ja I 63,6 (sace dvāraṁ na avâpuriyati);
aor. 3 sg. avâpurīyittha (dvāraṁ), Ja I 63,15.apâpurīyatiavâpurīyati

a-pāpetabba, neg. grd. of pāpeti [sa. pra + √āp,
caus.], not to be brought to; Ja VI 36,8'.

a-pāpessaṁ, cond. 1 sg. of pāpeti, Ja II 11,18
(jīvitakkhayaṁ).

apâbhata, mfn. [pp. of apa + ā + √bhṛ?ḷ, taken
away, stolen(1); Ja III 54,1* (khettapālassa ratti-
bhattaṁ ~aṁ; Tr. conjectures upābhataṁ; Ct. =
ābhataṁ, ānītaṁ, but Cp-a ad Cp I 10,9: apâbhatan
ti rattibhojanato apanītaṁ), cf. kenâpi saṁtyaktam
apâbhata

apāmagga, m. [sa. apāmārga], name of a plant,
Achyranthes Aspera; Abh 583 (~o sekhariko; cf. Am-k
II 4,88).

apâya, m. [ts.] (from apa + √i; a different ety-
mology is given by Sadd 403,9: n'atthi pāyo vuddhi
etthā ti a-pāyo, cf. ib. 421,16), "going away (or down)",
departure, outlet (in apāya-mukha, °-sampanna), falling
off, decline, regress, abatement; hence generally (1) loss
(of property or moral values; opp. āya, cf. apāya-
apâyasugati), (3) and thus almost = "hell" (opp. sagga); —
(1) ~o, Sv (III) 1005,6 (= avaḍḍhi, opp. āyo); Vism
440,5 (= avuddhi); pl. ~ā, Sv (II) 544,20 (nirayâdayo
vaḍḍhi-saṁkhātato ayato apetattā ~ā); loc pl. ~esu
ca'yo sakhā, DN III 186,29* (quoted Ja II 390,19*;
a bad companion; cf. ib. 185,22: apāya-sahāyo amitto
mitta-paṭirūpako); — (2) in the phrase ~aṁ duggatiṁ
vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati (upapannā): Vin III
5,7 (Sp; Vism 427,10, mht); Nidd I 356,2 (Nidd-a);
II 125,1; Ud 87,5 (Ud-a); It 12,22 (It-a); 73,13 foll.;
Pp 51,32; DN I 82,32; 1185,30; III 111,26; MN I
22,36; 73,22; 308,17; II 21,16; 86,10; 149,20; III
165,14; SN II 232,10; IV 240,3; 313,13; 342,7; AN
I 55,27; do. ~aṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ saṁsāraṁ
nâtivattati, DN II 55,16 (Sv); SN II 92,16; IV 158,8;
— cattāro ~ā, the four bad states (in the saṁsāra)
= niraya-tiracchāna-pettivisaya-asurakāyā, Pj I
189,12 = Sv (II) 496,11 (ad DN II 55,27) = Spk II
97,5 (ad SN II 92,16); cattāro ~ā sayanighara-sadisā
(pamattassa), Dhp-a I 260,18; Sv (II) 539,20; acc pl.
cattāro ~e pūrenti (scil. mata-matā), Ja II 143,4;
instr, pl. catūhi ~ehi vippamutto, Sn 231 = Khp VI
10 (Pj); catūhi ~ehi muttā, Ja IV 300,5' (= 'pari-
muttā ~ā'); loc pl. ~esu, Saddh 75; catūsu ~esu,
Abhidh-av 53,4*; Ud-a 287,20; Dhp-a I 24,2; Ja I
168,18'; nirayâdisu catūsu ~esu, Pv-a 103,27; —
tayo ~ā, Saddh 5; — (3) esp. = niraya (hell), opp.
sagga; thus frequently in Ct.s = niraya-vevacanaṁ,
e.g. Sp I 166,32; Ud-a 418,1; Nidd-a II 89,19, etc.; ~o
(dussaho . . . atidukkho), Saddh 95; acc. ~aṁ (paripū-
rentesu sattesu), Pj I 170,14; cf. apāya-bhūmi below;
saggâpāyaṁ ca passati, Sn 647 = Dhp 423 (dvandva)
≠Thī 63; abl. ~ā mutti me kuto, Mhv LXXII 306;
Yam I 226,4 (asaññasattā); loc. ~e (asaññasatte),
ib. 179,1; ~e nibbattiṁsu (scil. mata-matā), Ja III
304,12; itthī khīṇâyukā ahosi ~e uppajjanârahā,
Vv-a 118,12; loc. pl. mata-matā ~esu (!) pūriṁsu, Ja
IV 181,16; manussānaṁ ~esu nibbattim ñatvā, ib. 17;
— ifc. v. atthâ°, an-°, āyâ°, piyâ°, pihltâ°, saggâ°,
sukhumâ°.

apâya-kusala, mfn., endowed with apâya-ko-
salla, q. v.; attha-kusalo +, Nett 20,19.

apâya-kosalla, n., 'skill in loss' (scil. of akusalā
dhammā); āya-kosallaṁ, ~aṁ, upāya-kosallaṁ, DN
III 220,3 (Sv (III) 1005,15 foll.); Vibh 326,3 (Vibh-a
414,32-415,1), quoted Vism 440,1.

apâya-gata, mfn., being in apâya; Kacc-v 329
(apâyaṁ gato ~o); Kacc-v 573.

apāya-gamanīya, mfn., leading to perdition; ~o
kāmâsavo, Paṭis I 94,22; Pj II 113,23 (lobho nam'esa
~o dhammo); acc. ~aṁ rāgaṁ . . . dosaṁ . . . mohaṁ,
AN III 438,5 foll.; f. ~ā (avijjā), Ud-a 47,23 (so Se;
Ee w. r. °gāminiyā); n. ~aṁ, Mil 99,8 (titthiyānaṁ
apāya-gamanīyam[ū/u]pādānaṁ ~aṁ, Ud-a 214,1; apāyaṁ gametī ti
~aṁ, Sadd 462,17 (untraced quotation; cf. Paṭis-a
(Ee) I 310,29); pl. ~ā (kāmarāga-paṭighā), Abhidh-av
130,21; acc. pl.* ~e kāme samucchedato parivajjeti,
Nidd I 7,20 (Nidd-a); — °-tā, f. abstr., Ja IV 499,20.

apâya-gāmi(n), mfn., liable to perdition; m. ~ī,
Mil 278,30 (majjadānaṁ . . . adānasammataṁ, yo
taṁ dānaṁ deti so ~ī hoti); pl. ~ino, ib. 273,1 (a-
saddahantā te manussā ~ino bhavissanti); Dhp-a III
175,11' (Mārajālena otthaṭesu sattesu bahū ~ino
honti).

apâya-gāmi(n), mfn., liable to perdition; m. ~ī,
Mil 278,30 (majjadānaṁ . . . adānasammataṁ, yo
taṁ dānaṁ deti so ~ī hoti); pl. ~ino, ib. 273,1 (a-
saddahantā te manussā ~ino bhavissanti); Dhp-a III
175,11' (Mārajālena otthaṭesu sattesu bahū ~ino
honti).

apâya-dvāra, n., the door of "hell" ; amhākaṁ ca
~āni vivaṭāni, Dhp-a II 243,20; ~āni pi pidheti (scil.
ayaṁ maggo), Abhidh-av 126,8*.

apâya-dukkha, n., "misery of the states of woe"';
~aṁ pañcamaṁ (scil. among the 8 saṁvegavatthūni),
Vism 135,8; ~aṁ anubhonto, Dhp-a III 14,14; pl.
idhaloke ~āni anubhonto, Ja V 118,30'; cf. Sās 113,22
(iminā puññakammena sabbehi apāyâdi-dukkhehi
moceyyāmi).

apâya-duggati-vinipāta, m. (dvandva of three
synonyms, see apâya); abl. ~ā (aparimutto), SN V
342,14 = AN IV 378,22; cf. apâya (2); — ifc. v.
khīṇâ°.

apâya-paṭisandhi, m., rebirth in a state of misery
(cf. apây[ū/u]papatti); ~i kāmasugati-paṭisandhi rūpâ-
vacara-p° arūpâvacara-p° cêti catubbidhā paṭisandhi
nāma, Abhidh-s 22,1.

apâya-parāyaṇa, mfn., destined to hell; Dhp-a
III 138,20 (~am eva naṁ karoti).

apâya-paripūraka, mfn., one who joins in filling
hell, ending in hell; Pj II 115,27 (~o bhavissāmi); —
°-tta, n. abstr., Ps I 91,21.

apâya-parimutti, f., release from hell; acc. ~iṁ
sabbaguṇa-sampattiñ ca icchanto, Ps I 91,24.

apâya-pūraka, mfn., = apâya-paripūraka; Ps
II 419,1 (opp. saggapatha-pūraka); (Se) III 446,2
(avasesa-jano mā ~o ahosi); Mp I 180,14 (amhesu
paduṭṭhacitto mahājano ~o bhaveyya).

apâya-bhaya, n., fear of hell; Vibh-a 279,1
(~aṁ paccavekkhantassa pi viriya-sambojjhaṅgo
uppajjati); As 126,27 (bhayan ti ~aṁ); Ja IV 299,22
(~ehi muttā); — °-paccavekkhanatā, f., reflection
on a°, Vibh-a 278,21 (cf. Vism 132,17: apâyabhayâdi-
p°); — °-vinimmuttatā, f., the being released from
apâya-bhaya

apâya-bhūmi, f., the plane of apāya (hell); ~i,
kāma-sugati-bhūmi + . . . catasso bhūmiyo nāma,
Abhidh-s 21,6; ~iyo (tisso), Abhidh-av 36,5*; acc.
~iṁ, SN I 27,9* (na te gamissanti ~iṁ, C-mss, better,
apâyaṁ) — DN II 255.4* ( ˇ - ˇ - | - ˇ ˇ | - - ; quoted
Pj I 17,22*; Ja I 97,2*); ~iṁ anokkamitvā, Ja VI
571,30'; loc. ~iyaṁ, Saddh 43.

apâya-magga, m., the wrong way, the way of
hell; maggakusalo puriso . . . ~aṁ dassento, Ps II
169,30; supihita-saggadvāro ~aṁ samārūlho, Vism
57,21*.

apâya-mukha, n., outlet (for water), way of
abatement; āya-mukhāni (scil. of a pool) pidaheyya
. . . ~āni vivareyya, AN II 166,16 (= apāya-vāha-
naka-cchiddāni. Mp; opp. āya-mukha, cf. DN I
74,21); anuttarāya vijjā-caraṇa-sampadāya cattāri
~āni bhavanti, DN I 101,1 foll. (= vināsa-mukhāni,
Sv); bhogānaṁ cattāri ~āni, AN IV 283,14 ( =
apâya-mukha~āni, ib. 283,17 = 287,23; cha bhogānaṁ ~āni, DN
III 181,20; 182,21 foll. ≠ Nidd I 267,3 (= bhogānaṁ
vināsa-dvārāni, Nidd-a).

apâya-loka, m., ɔ: the four apâyas; Nidd I 9,22
(~e manussa-loke, deva-loke, etc.) = 29,1; Dhp-a I
334,8 (catubbidhaṁ ~aṁ, = 'Yama-lokaṁ').

apâya-sampanna, mfn., provided with outlet
(for the water); AN IV 237,10 (na āya-sampannaṁ
hoti, na ~aṁ hoti, scil. khettaṁ; = pacchābhāge
udaka-niggamana-magga-sampannaṁ hoti, Mp);238,1
(āya-sampannaṁ hoti, ~aṁ hoti, do.).

apâya-sampāpaka, mfn., leading to (or resulting
in) hell, etc.; n. pl. ~āni pane' orambhāgiya-saṁyoja-
nāni, Dhp-a IV 109,1 (opp. devaloka-sampāpakāni).

apâya-samudda, m., the ocean of distress;
Dhp-a III 432,14 (maccurājā sabbasatte . . . mahogho
viya parikaḍḍhamāno yeva ~e pakkhipati).

apâya-sahāya, m., a spendthrift (sumptuous)
companion; ~o amitto mitta-paṭirūpako, DN III
185,22; 186,17 (= bhogānaṁ apāyesu sahāyo hoti,
Sv) ≠ ib. 186,29*, quoted Ja II 390,19*.

[apâyi, aor. 3 sg. of apeti, q. v. (DN III 88,1-9,
v. l.)}.

apâyûpapatti, f. (apâya + upapatti), rebirth
in one of the 'bad states' (cf. apâya-paṭisandhi); Dhp-a
I 281,5 (read °tti or °ttī (pl.); Ee w. r. apâyuppattiṁ,
Be °upapattiṁ, acc. for nom.).apâyûpapatti

a-pāyesi, aor. 3 sg. of pāyeti (caus. of pivati),
q. v.

1a-pāra, n. [ts., orig, abstr. from para-(a)pāraṁ?],
(a) the near bank (of a river; opp. pāra), (b) metaph. =
the world here; Abh 665 (a, synon, oraṁ); Dhp 385 (5);
acc. ehi pārâpāraṁ, DN I 244,17 (a; = ehi pāra!
apāraṁ, Sv); abl. gacche pāraṁ ~ato, ~ā pāraṁ
1a-pārakhandhā ca abhisaṁkhārā ca, Nidd II 89,18); me
bhaya-jātassa ~ā pāram esato, Th 763 (b); ~ā pāraṁ
garnanāya(a), MN I 134,37 ; SN IV 174,8; V 24,11 (b) =
180,15; AN V 4,2; ~ā pāraṁ gantu-kāmā, Ud 90,5 (a)
= DN II 89,16 (Ee w. r. aparâparaṁ); — ifc. v. pārâ°
(b; Dhp 385).

2a-pāra, mfn. [ts.], (a) shoreless, endless; mahā-
samuddaṁ gambhīraṁ vitthataṁ agādham ~aṁ
disvā, Mil 105,11; ~am atighoraṁ (scil. anamatagga-
. . . °mahodadhiṁ), Abhidh-av 126,10*; Dhātum v. l
(nirutti-nikarâ°-); — (b) who has not crossed (the river);
a-tiṇṇaṁ yeva yācassu ~aṁ tāta nāvika, Ja III
230,20* (= orima-tīre ṭhitaṁ, Ct.).

a-pāra-ṇeyya, mfn. (3a+pāra-neyya, or from pā-
reti), that which cannot be carried to (the further shore
o:) the goal; n. ~aṁ (kammaṁ aphalaṁ), Ja VI 36,6*
foll. (= vāyāmena matthakaṁ apāpetabbaṁ; Ct.).

a-pāra-pāragu, mfn., who has reached the limit
of the endless (saṁsāra), epithet of the Buddha; Bv-a
introd. v. 2.

a-pārivāsika, mfn. (cf. pari-vāsa & pari-vasati),
'not left to stay overnight' (of food), fresh, not vapid,
that has preserved its aroma; n. abbhuṇhaṁ ~aṁ (so
read with Tr. δc Se for a-parivāsikaṁ, E€ Se Ck; =
'paccagghaṁ' [scil. rāja-bhojanaṁ]), Ja II 435,22' (cf.
Pj II 35,23).a-pārivāsika

apâruta, mfn. [pp. of apâpurati, sa. apâvṛta, cf.
AiGr I § 184], open, laid open; pl. ~ā tesaṁ amatassa
dvārā, DN II 39,21* (= vivaṭā, Sv; pt: apârutaṁ
tesaṁ amatassa dvāran (cf. Mvu below) ti keci pa-
thanti), = MN I 169,24 (v. l. B: apārutāse tesaṁ; Ps
— Sv) = MN II 93,(26) = SN I 138,22* (Spk = Sv) =
Vin I 7,4* (cf. Mvu III 319,3*); DN II 217,15 (~ā
amatassa dvārā; = vivaṭā, Sv). — °-ghara, mfn.,
apârutacorānaṁ abhāvena dvārāni asaṁvaritvā vivaṭadvārā)
≠ Mp ad AN IV 151,7* ; — °-dvāra, mfn., with open
door; loc. ~e nivesane, Ja I 264,4.

apâlamba, m. [ts., from apa + ā + √lamb],
SN I 33,11* (hirī tassa [scil. rathassa] ~o, by Ct. ex-
plained as a leaning board on a carriage = rathe
ṭhitānaṁ yodhānaṁ apatanatthāya dārumayaṁ ālam-
apâlambabahussutabhāva-mayena ~ena samannāgato = 'bā-
husacca-m-apâlamba', mfn., having scriptural lear-
ning for its hold or support, Ja VI 252,26*).

[apâvuṇanti, pr. 3 sg., by conjecture for apâ-
puranti, It 80,5*, see apâpurati].

a-pāsāṇasakkharilla, mfn., (cf. pāsāṇa-sak-
khara + suff. -ilia), free from stones and gravel; n.
~aṁ (khettaṁ), AN IV 237,28 (see ib. 237,8; Mp).

a-pāsādika, mfn. (cf. sa. prāsādika), not satis-
fying, not possessed of charm (to create pasāda); loc.
~e, AN III 255,15-21-30-256,1 (opp. pāsādika, 255,22
foll.; = ~ehi kāyakammâdīhi samannāgate, Mp).

apâhata, mfn. (pp. of apa + ā + √han); inter-
changeable with apa-hata, q. v.), repulsed, refuted; (a)
n., an offence, SN I 24,26* (so C-mss. for unmetr. apa-
gataṁ [from 24* ib.]; ɔ: aparādho, Spk I 66,17, cf.
apâhatataṁ]); — (b) mfn., rejected (on account of logical faults):
yam assa vādaṁ parihīnam āhu ~aṁ pañhavīmaṁ-
sakāse, Sn 827 (Nidd I 165,1: 'atthâpagataṁ bhaṇitan'
ti atthato apaharanti, 'vyañjanâpagataṁ bhaṇitan'
ti ... etc.; Nidd-a; Pj); loc. abs. ~asmiṁ, Sn 826 (Pj:
'atthâpagatan te bhaṇitan' ti. . . ādinā nayena apa-
sādite (v. l. apahărite) vāde).

apāhāya, ind. [ts., abs. of apa + √hā = apa-
hāya, at the end of an uneven çloka-pāda, as Mhbh
I 4946, III 2963, etc.], leaving, quitting, Ja VI 234,35*
(ujumaggaṁ; so Cks; Ee & Se avahāya).

2api or pi, prefix to verbs and their derivates,
expressive of placing on or over ('covering' = saṁ-
varaṇa, Abh 1183): (a)+√i, see 2appeti; — (b) +
√dhā, see api-dahati (apidheti), api-dhāna, api-hita;
pi-dahati, pi-dahita, (a)pidahana pi-dhāna, (a)pi-
thīyati; — (c) + √nah, see api-ḷayhati, pi-landha, pi-
landhati, pi-ḷayhati, (a)pi-landhana; — (d) + √lap,
see api-lāpeti, api-lapana(ta), pi-lapati; [at Ja VI
246 2 6*: kākolasaṁghehi pi kaḍḍhamānaṁ, Tr.
suggests *pi-kaḍḍh°; vi-kaḍḍh° would fit the meaning];
— cf. api-ratte below.

1api, ind. [ts.], before vowels ap', or apy > app',
see app'eva below; enclitically mostly pi (or with elision
p'); emphatic particle, according to Grr. (Rūp C 87,11-15
[cf. Pāṇ I 4,96 and Am-k III 3,248] ≠ Sadd 884,13-20
≠ Pay fol. gr v. 1 foll.; Abh 1183) used to express:
(I) sambhāvanā: 'api dibbesu kāmesu ratiṁ so
nâdhigacchati', Dhp 187; 'Meruñ ca pi vinivijjhitvā
1api— (II) apekkhā: 'ayam pi dhammo aniyato', Vin III
192,2**; — (III) samuccaya: 'iti pi arahaṁ'. Vism
198,8; 'antam pi antaguṇam pi ādāya', MN III 186,7;
cf. Ud-a 278,15 (api-saddo sampiṇdanattho); Ps I
250,16 (upari-atthaṁ upādāya sampiṇḍanatthe pi-
kāro); —(IV) garahā: 'api 'mhākaṁ panditaka', cf.
DN I 107,18 (Sadd-ns); — (V) pañha: 'api bhante
bhikkhaṁ labhittha', cf. Sp I 37,16 (api kiñci labhit-
tha) = Mil 9,3 and Vin II 11,8; — to this Abh adds
(VI) saṁvaraṇa (see 2api): 'api-dhānaṁ', Abh-sūci;

a-piṇḍa-pātika, mfn. [3a + sa. piṇḍa-pātika],
not belonging to the piṇḍa-pātika-class of monks; gen.
pl. ~ānaṁ, Ud-a 203,26.

a-piṇdita, mfn. (neg. pp. of piṇḍeti), not balled
together, not lumpy; n. ~aṁ (an-uttaṇḍulaṁ a-kilin-
naṁ+, scil. odanaṁ), Sp (III) 703,5.

a-pittaka, mfn. (3a + pitta), not bilious, with-
out gall; n. a-cittaṁ ~aṁ (so read with Cks) kaliṅgara-
kaṇḍaṁ, Ja III 273,19 ('echo-formation', meaning'de-
void of intelligence', cf. a-citta).

a-pitika, mfn. [sa. a-pitṛka], fatherless; m. ~o
(a-mātiko + [ ˇ ˇ ˇ - ]) Ja V 251,29* (= nim-mātā-pi-

api-thīyati, pr. 3 sg. (pass. of. api + √dhā, cf.
pi-thīyati, pi-dahati), to be covered or obscured; navena
sukha-dukkhena porāṇaṁ ~ati, Ja II 157,23* (v. l. Bl
api-dhiyati; = pithīyati paṭicchādiyati, Ct.); pp.
1api-hita (q. v.).

a-pidahana, n. (neg. verbal noun of pi-dahati,
q. v.), non-closing; As 401,20 (a-thakanaṁ ~aṁ; =

api-dhāna, n. [ts., cf. pi-dhāna], cover, lid;
Vin I 203,30 (quoted Sadd 625,23); 204,29; II 122,23;

(api-dheti), pr. 3 sg. (= pidheti, pidahati, q. v.),
to close or stop; only inf. ~etuṁ (mahāsindhuṁ),
Ja V 60,6*-lo' (quoted Sadd 393,1). Cf. api-thīyati.

api-ratte, loc. (ind.), [sa. *api-rātre, cf. api-
çarvare, see Ai Gr II 1 § 37 c], early in the morning;
Ja VI 560,30* — 32* (= (api) balava-paccūse, Ct.).

a-piladdha-pubba, mfn., with which one has

pilandhitvā; Ck apiladdhana-p°, Se apilandha-p°).

a-pilāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (3a + pilāpeti, caus. of

a-piva(t), mfn. (neg. part, of pivati), not drinking;
