apekkha or apekha (this mostly C-reading), mfn.,
looking for, desiring, keeping in view, referring to,
only ifc from apekkhā (apekhā), q. v. (see, however,
apekkha

ape(k)khate, pr. 3 sg. med. [sa. apa + √īkṣ, cf.
avekkhati], to look for, to long for, to expect (with
apekkhatenâpekhate, Bai apekkh°; Pj: yathā . . . pipāsāya
phuṭṭhānaṁ udakam apekkhate cittaṁ, evaṁ pañ-
casu kāmaguṇesu kāmam pi nâpekkhate cittaṁ);
3 sg. act. ~ati, As 365,3 (ālayakaraṇa-vasena ~; =
'apekkhā'); part. med. (a ) ~āna, m. ~o, Ja V 340,1*
(Ck ave°; dhammaṁ ~; = apekkhanto, Ct.); (β)
~amāna, m. ~o, Ja IV 226,14* (saccaṁ hirottap-
paṁ); Spk I 185,10 (vivaraṁ); ~o pabbajjaṁ, Mhv
XIV 28 (cf. pabbajjâpekkha, mfn.); f. ~ā, Sp (IV)
901,3 (= 'patimānentī'); m. pl. ~ā, Sn 773 (pacchā
pure vā pi ~ā); — do. neg. an-°, mfn., Sn 59 (khiḍḍaṁ
... ~o; Pj; Nidd); pl. ~ā gacchanti, Ja IV 424,19*
(= mayi an-apekkhā va gacchanti, Ct.) = V 359,27*
(cf. 339,6*); ~ā vakkaṅgā, Ja IV 426,9*; — part,
act. m. ~anto, Ja V 341,28' (= 'apekkhāno'); f. ~antī,
Thī 96 (Thī-a Ce avekkh°); — aor. 1 sg. apekkhi
'haṁ(?), Thī 222 (v. lI. avekkh°; Thī-a: avekkhitaṁ
= 'apekkhi 'haṁ' ti dhammamayaṁ ādāsaṁ ad-
dakkhiṁ apassiṁ ahaṁ); — abs. («) apekkhiya
(sukhadukkhaṁ manujesu ~), Ja III 57,21* (Bl ave°;
perhaps originally (with metre): manujesu pekkhiya);
(β) ~itvā = with reference to, with regard to (acc ),
Sv I 33,20* = Pj I 106,25* ≠ Sp I 108,13* (apekkhiya);
Ud-a 201,29; Vv-a 13,2-9; — pp. apekkhita, q.v.

ape(k)khava(t), mfn. (from ape(k)khā), full of
longing or desire; m. ~vā, Th 228 foll. (with loc); 558
= Ap 58,31 (Th-aC* 516,31*); Ap 250,3; SN III 16,13
foll. (uttāsavā . . . vighātavā + ; = sâlayo, Spk) =
MN III 228,20 (Ee upekh° = sâlayo sapiho, Ps); Ja
V 453,10* (nārinaṁ vasagato ~vā; = sataṇho, Ct.);
Pj II 76,10 (tāya apekhāya ~vā); Vin IV 214,15'
(sāratto ~vā paṭibaddhacitto; = 'avassuto'); f. ~vā,
ib. 14' (= apekkhāya samannāgatā, Sp (IV) 901,8 (E
apekkhavā ti, Se apekkhavat[ī/i]ti)); m. pl. ~vanto, MN
I 32,20 (with loc sāmaññe; opp. an-°) = 1116,22 =
= AN III 199,12-30. — Ifc v. an-°.

ape(k)khava(t), mfn. (from ape(k)khā), full of
longing or desire; m. ~vā, Th 228 foll. (with loc); 558
= Ap 58,31 (Th-aC* 516,31*); Ap 250,3; SN III 16,13
foll. (uttāsavā . . . vighātavā + ; = sâlayo, Spk) =
MN III 228,20 (Ee upekh° = sâlayo sapiho, Ps); Ja
V 453,10* (nārinaṁ vasagato ~vā; = sataṇho, Ct.);
Pj II 76,10 (tāya apekhāya ~vā); Vin IV 214,15'
(sāratto ~vā paṭibaddhacitto; = 'avassuto'); f. ~vā,
ib. 14' (= apekkhāya samannāgatā, Sp (IV) 901,8 (E
apekkhavā ti, Se apekkhavat[ī/i]ti)); m. pl. ~vanto, MN
I 32,20 (with loc sāmaññe; opp. an-°) = 1116,22 =
= AN III 199,12-30. — Ifc v. an-°.

ape(k)khā, f. [sa. apekṣā], regard, care, affection,
desire, longing for (loc); Abh 1183 (a sense of prp.
api) ≠ Pay fol. gr v. l ≠ Sadd 884,13; puttesu dā-
resu ca yā ~ā, Sn 38 (Nidd-a: ~ā vuccati taṇhā)
= Ap 8,22 ≠ Dhp 345 (= taṇhā, Dhp-a) = SN
I 77,15* (= ālayo, nikanti, Spk) = Ja II 140,18*;
— the same formula modified: puttesu dāresu ca te
~ā, Th 187 (= adhigata-[o: avigata-?]-sinehā, Th-a;
thus an adj.l); mātāpitusu ~ā, SN V 409,4*; rāgo
. . . sineho ~ā, etc, Dhs 1059 = 1136 = Nidd I
8,18 (Nidd-a: ālayakaraṇavasena apekkhatī ti ~ā,
= As 365,3-4); 'mayhi etV ti ~ā hoti, Mil 160,1 foll.;
acc vihari [w ^ —] ~aṁ, Th 10; ('vihari' = visesato
hari, apahari, apanesi, Th-a); kāye~aṁ jaha, Th 1113;
~aṁ karohi (jīvite), DN II 190,29 foll. ( = sâpekkhaṁ
ālayaṁ taṇhaṁ karohi, Sv); taṁ ~aṁ maggañāṇena
chindanto, Pj II 76,11; abl. ~āya, Ud-a 17,15 (vakkha-
mānâ°); — ifc v. tibbâ° (MN I 324,28); — do. in adj.-
cpd.s. °ape(k)kha (see above): v. aññâ°, an-°, anu-
ṭālanagahaṇâ° (Ja II 280,1'; cf. anuṭāleti), a-raho-
'pekkha, ārādhâ°, āsādanâ°, uttaragāthâ°, upa-
assād'-°, vigatâ°, visibbanâ° (= visīvanâ°), vi-
suddhâ°, vihesâ°, vīmamsâ°, sâ°, hāsâ°.

apeta, mfn. [ts., pp. of apeti, apa + √i], gone
away, rid of, deprived of ([instr., or] abl., or cpd.); Pay
fol. gū 6 (ex. of the sense 'apagata' of prp. apa); ~o
dama-saccena, Ja II 198,9* (= indriya-dama-saṁkhā-
tena damena nibbāna-sarhkhātena ca paramattha-
apetavacanaṁ: etasmā dama-saccā ~o ti attho, Ct.; thus
the use of instr, prob, due to the foll. upeto dama-
saccena, cf. saccena danto damasā upeto, Sn 463;
sa. apeta-dama-sauratya[h], Turfan Rec of Dhp in
Sitzungsber. d. Preuss. Akad. d. Wiss. 1908 p. 977)
= Dhp 9 (= viyutto, pariccatto, Dhp-a) = Th 969
= Ja V 50,27*; — f. dukkhato ~ā, Pv-a 35,24; m.
pl. ~ā te brāhmaññā, Ja IV 362,1*—365,8* (≠
apagatā, Vin III 44,25); ~ā paribbhaṭṭhā, Ud-a
260,21 (= (sāmaññā) 'apagatā'). — Ifc v. an-°,
methunâ°.

apeta-kaddama, mfn., without mud; rahado
va ~o, Dhp 95 (= apagata-kaddamo, Dhp-a).

apeta-kammâvaraṇa, mfn., one who has got rid
of the obstructions caused by his karma; gen. ~assa,
Mil 151,16. Cf. apetâvaraṇa below.

apeta-citta, mfn., without love or affection;
Ja II 205,14* (~ena na sambhajeyya; = vigata-
cittena vipallattha-cittena, Ct.) = III 108,21* (= vi-
gata-cittena, Ct.) ≠ Mvu II 67,5* (apetabhāvena na
saṁvaseyā).

apeta-jātarūpa-rajata, mfn., who has not (or
has done with) gold and silver (nikkhitta-maṇi-suvaṇṇa
+); m. ~o, MN II 51,23 (cf. Mvu I 326,18); m. pl.
~ā (samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā), SN IV 325,29.

apetatta, n. abstr., absence of (abl.); puñña-
samkhātā ayā ~ā, Vism 427,11 = Ud-a 418,6 (ex-
plaining apāya = niraya); manussattabhāvato ~ā,
Pv-a 92,28 (etymology of peta); Th-a ad Th 5 (see
apeta-bherava below).

apeta-daratha, mfn., free from distress; m. ~o,
Ja V 4,8* (Ct).

apeta-pāpaka, mfn., free from sin or mischief;
acc m. ~aṁ, (asāhasaṁ+), Ja III 320,21* (= apa-
gata-pāpakammaṁ, Ct.).

apeta-bhaya-santāsa, mfn., free from danger and
fear; m. ~o bhave'haṁ [so Ce; Ee bhavesaṁ] sabbato
bhave, Ap 458,26 [Se reads avero gatasantāso . . .
sabbadā bhave].

apeta-bherava, mfn., free from fear; m. vijitāvi
~o, Th 5 ( = pañcavīsatiyā bhayānaṁ sabbaso ape-
tattā apagata-bheravo abhayūparato, Th-a) ≠ Th 7.

apeta-mana-pāpaka, m(f. ~ikā)n., without men-
tal defects Ci); f. ~ikā, Ap 522,1 (so Se; Ee apetā
manapāpikā, Ce apeta-mala-pāpikā) = 529,11 (Ce
Ee Se here °-manapāpikā) = Thī-a 52,11* (C Ee do.).

apeta-lomahamsa, mfn. (a) free from shud-
dering; vijitāvi ~o, Th 6; 8; — (b) without bashfulness,
unscrupulous; gen. ~assa rañño kāmânusārino sabbe
bhogā vinassanti, Ja V 117,9* (— attânuvādâdi-
bhayehi nibbhayassa, Ct.).

apeta-viññāṇa, mfn., without understanding,
senseless; m. ~o (kayo), Dhp 41; Thī 468 (do. ; = apa-
gata-viññāṇo, Thī-a); — °-tta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā,
Pv-a 63,15 (cf. Ja Y 100,26': appatta-v°, prob. w. r.
for apeta-v°, or apagata-v°; Bds aparagata-v°, Se
apeta-viññāṇa

apeta-soka, mfn., released from grief; DN II
39,14* = Vin I 6,1* = It 33,6*; SN I 110,27*; Vv
410 (Vv-a).

a-petteyya, mfn. (neg. of 1petteyya, Mogg IV 40,
cf. sa. paitṛka from pitṛ; as to 2petteyya see Mogg-v IV
37 (Pay)), not loving or not doing reverence to one's
father; m. ~o, AN I 138,15 (a-matteyyo + ; Mp); pl.
m. ~ā, DN III 72,1 (Ee misprint appetteyyā); SN V
467,19; — °-tā, f. abstr., a-matteyyatā +, DN III
70,25 (Sv); 71,8.

apetâvaraṇa, mfn. (apeta + āvaraṇa), 'free
from hindrances', unbound; f. ~ā, i. e. not married,
Ja V 214,1' (so Se = 'avāvaṭā'; Ee w.r. apetâbha-
raṇā).

apeti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. apa + √i], to go or flee away,
to depart, vanish, disappear; Sadd 315,20; 319,9-10;
to go away from (abl.), Kacc 273 (from Kātantra II
4,8); Sadd 60,19*; 701,16; upeti pi ~eti pi (scil.
saññă), DN I 180,8; sa tena aṭṭiyamānā ~eti, Ja I
292,12; Ja IV 217,27' (= 'vivasate', to be afar from,
abl.); 3 pl. nâpenti (Gotama-sāsanamhā), Sn 1143
apetihonti); 1 pl. ~ema (nibbijjâpema Gotamā, or Gota-
maṁ [governed by nibbijja?]), Sn 448 = SN I 124,8*;
imper. 2 sg. ~ehi, Vin IV 175,16 (~eh'ayye; = apagac-
cha, Sp); ~ehi bhikkhu, DN II 138,27 (= do., Sv; cf.
apasādeti); ~ehi, Spk I 185,27 (unmetr.) in the pratīka
for 'pehi', SN I 123,15* (= apayāhi); ~ehi tvaṁ . . .
vinassa, AN II 182,28 (cf. nāseti, s. v. apasādeti); ~ehi
etto, Ja III 261,2* ( = apagaccha, Ct.); Ja IV 380,26*
(do. [Ee misprint ettho] — do; quoted Ps III 79,16*);
~ehi ~ehī ti accharaṁ pahari, Ja VI 542,7; ~ehi . . .
mā vārayi, Dhp-a I 61,3 = IV 27,10; ~ehi amma,
Dhp-a I 307,17; ~ehi devadhīte, Dhp-a III 8,12-15
(see ib. 14: mā maṁ nāsetha); ~ehi . . . ti paṇāmesi,
Dhp-a IV 118,15; ~ehi samma, Ps III 281,9 ; — 1 sg.
apāyāmi [sa. apa-ayāni; cf. pāli ayāma, v. r. DN II
81,14], Ja VI 183,16* (handa dāni~; = apagacchāmi,
palāyāmi, Ct.); — 2 pl. ~etha, SN I 127,17* (nibbijjâ-
petha Gotamā or (C-mss) Gotamaṁ; = apagaccha-
tha, Spk); — [aor. 3 sg. apāyi, v. l. for ahāyi, DN
III 88,1-9 (≠ Mvu I 342,1); = antarahitā, Sv]; —
abs. apecca, Sadd 315,26; — pp. apeta (q. v.).

a-peyya, mfn. [neg. grd. of pivati, sa. a-peya],
(a) undrinkable; n. ~aṁ (udakaṁ), AN I 250,4-8; III
188,14; f. ~ā (Gaṅgā), AN I 250,11; m. ~o (udakakkhan-
dho), ib. 15; Ja VI 205,2* (scil. sāgaro; Ct.) = 213,6*;
ib. io* (samuddo; Ct.); ib. 14* (āpo); — (b) not to be
drunk off or emptied; ~o kira sāgaro, Ja II 442,16*
(= ria sakkā kenaci udakaṁ khepetvā pātuṁ, Ct.).

a-pesala, mfn. [sa. a-peçala], unkind, not genial;
n. pl. ~āni (khettāni, metaph, not fertile), Ja IV 381,28*
(cf. Ct.: appiyasīla, na mahapphala).

a-pesita, mfn. (neg. pp. of peseti), not urged or
impelled (or set at work); Vin II 177,23 (pesitâpesitaṁ
ca jāneyya). Cf. apesiyamāna.

a-pesiyamāna, mfn. (neg. part. pass, of peseti),
not being sent forth (to work); pl. ~ā (ārāmikā), Vin II
177,19; cf. ārāmika-pesaka.

a-pesuñña, n. [3a + pesuñña, sa. paiçunya],
freedom from backbiting or calumny; Ja VI 252,21*
(°-susaññato; = ~ena suṭṭhu-saññato suphassito, Ct.).

a-pesuṇa, mfn. (3a + pesuṇa, see prec), not
backbiting, not slanderous; m. ~o, Ja VI 295,22*
(akkodhano . . . +; as to paiçun(y)a, see sa. kau-
çal(y)a, pāli alolu(p)pa, appossu(k)ka, vesa(m)ma
[Nidd I 42,23* v.I.; Sadd 791,12], yobbana: yobbañña).

a-porisa, mfn. [sa. a-pauruṣa], not made by
human (hands); °-tā, f. abstr., Vv-a 275,29 (instr.
~āya).

a-posana, n. [neg. of sa. poṣaṇa], non-supporting;
instr. ~ena an-aññaposī, Pj II 118,17; — °-tā,
f. abstr., (from *a-posana, mfn.), id., Spk I 207,14
(~āya anaññaposī).

apoha, m. (from next), pushing away, denying;
Sadd 458,17; 459,5.

apohati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. apohate from apa + √ūh],
to throw away, to leave, to reject; sabbaṁ anattham
~ati, Sadd 459,5 (from Sāratthadīpanī, ns).

a-phandana, mfn. [sa. a-spandana], not qui-
vering, not moving; f. ~ā, Ja V 425,5* (mahī yathā ...
sabbāsahā [ɔ: sabbaṁsahā[ ~ā (unmetrical) akuppā,
tathi itthiyo; cf. Ct. ib. 431,3'-6').

a-pharusa, mfn. [sa. a-paruṣa], not rough; not
harsh, smooth, mild; akakkasaṁ ~aṁ (scil. sūciṁ),
Ja III 282,13* (Ct.: vaṭṭatāya ~aṁ); bhāsitaṁ
~aṁ, Ja V 206,22' ( ='akakkasaṁ'); kāya-vacī-cittehi
a-pharusa— °-vācatā, f., smooth or gentle speech; Dhs 1343
(saṇhavācatā sakhilavācatā + ; = akakkhaḷa-vācatā,
As 397,18); do. + metta-vācakatā (or °vācatā) ~ā,
Nidd I 388,6 (= madhura-vācatā, Nidd-a).

a-phala, mfn. [ts.] (a) fruitless, barren; un-
profitable; Dhp 51 = Th 323 (subhāsitā vācā ~ā hoti
akubbato); MN II 155,28 (~aṁ brahmacariyaṁ);
AN I 225,1! (do.); MN II 221,34-222,1 (~o upakkamo,
~aṁ padhānaṁ); SN IV 169,29 (~aṁ jīvitānaṁ,
scil. suttaṁ (sleep); vañjhaṁ +); Ja III 253,13*
(~aṁ madhuram vācaṁ); 339,24* (~aṁ giram udīri-
taṁ); 495,10*-n* (~aṁ dumaṁ); 13* (~o, scil. dumo);
VI 61,5* (phalī ambo ~o ca; see Sadd 794,3); 557,4
(~ā rukkhā); 557,8* (~ā va [so Lk] phalino rukkhā));
Mil 95,13 = 96,18 (adhikāro vañjho bhavati ~o);
a-phala(b) n. subst.; no fruit, perhaps in phalâphala (q. v.).

a-phassaka, mfn. [cf. sa. a-sparça], not having
the faculty of touch; Vibh 419,29 (Asaññasattā devā
ahetukā anāhārā ~ā, etc; quoted Pj I 77,16; Mp
ad AN V 50,28).

a-phassayi, aor. of phasseti (see next); Th 1172
(Ee w. r. a-passayi; scil. aṭṭha vimokkhāni); 1202
(Mahāneruno kūṭaṁ vimokkhena ~); Thī 322 (tisso
vijjā); 323; 324; ~iṁ, ib. 433; — a-phassayitvā,
neg. abs. of do., Nidd II 88,34.

a-phassita, mfn. (neg. pp. of phasseti [sa. spar-
çayati, caus. of √spṛç or (b) denom, of sparça]), (a) not
caused to touch, not closed; Pālim ch. 1, prob. =
Sp I 281,20 ([ī/i]sakaṁ ~e, i. e. ajar, v. l. a-phusite [cf.
phusitaggaḷa]); — (b) not perceived, unattained; Paṭis
I 134,5 (~o paññāya dukkhaṭṭho n'atthi) ≠ II 32,17;
MN I 475,29 (a-ññātaṁ + asacchikataṁ ~aṁ pañ-
ñāya) = SN V 221,5 (Ee aphusitaṁ, v. l. apassitam
a-phassitataṁ) = Nidd I 178,12 (Ee aphusitaṁ; = asammoha-
paññāya phuṭṭhattā paññāya aphusitaṁ nāma
n'atthi, Nidd-a); AN II 244,17 (iti ~aṁ vā dham-
maṁ vimuttiyā phassissāmi; v. l. aphusitaṁ); Th
945 (~aṁ; Ee aphusitaṁ (unmetr.) vā phusituṁ, phu-
sitaṁ vânurakkhituṁ); = aphuṭṭhaṁ, Th-a).

a-phāsu, mfn. (3a + phāsu, [from. *sphāsu
(√sphāy, to thrive), for which we might expect sa.
*sphāsnu, cf.pāli kilāsu (√klam; Buddh-sa. a-kilāsin)
with sa. glāsnu (√glai)]; cf. sa. sphīta, sphāti & pāli
phīta, phāti-, (cf. Sadd 421,12); differently Tr. Noles
p. 81 — sa. prāçu; cf. Pischel below s. v. a-phāsuka;
Mvu (III 48,12, etc.) writes phāsu (-vihāra), but Vyu
255,3, etc. sparça-v°), uncomfortable, annoying, incom-
moding, only n. ~u or ~uṁ with hoti or karoti (gen.
pers.); Vin I 192,3 (aññatarassa bhikkhuno yānugghā-
tena bāḷhataraṁ ~u ahosi); Vin IV 290,29' (imissā ~u
bhavissati); Vin IV 290,23** (yā pana bhikkhunī
bhikkhuniyā sañcicca ~uṁ kareyya, pācittiyaṁ); ib.
17 (~uṁ karissati); ib. 19 (~uṁ karoti); MN I 205,24
(mā tesaṁ ~uṁ akāsi) = III 155,19 = Vin I 350,35;
Ud-a 113,17 (viheṭhenti vividhehi ākārehi ~uṁ ka-
ronti; = 'vihesenti'). Cf. next.a-phāsu

a-phāsuka, mfn. (3a + phāsuka, see prec.; prākr.
aphāsuya (by Pischel § 208 (following Hoernle)
explained as a + *sparçuka (√spṛç)), unpleasant,
not wholesome; mostly used as subst, n. ~aṁ, in-
disposition, illness; Ja I 291,27 (puttassa te ~aṁ
jātaṁ); ib. 28 (kin te tāta ~aṁ); ib. 292,1 (mayhaṁ
aññaṁ ~aṁ n'atthi); II 275,14 (kenaci ~ena bhavi-
tabbaṁ); 395,23 (añño ~o nāma n'atthi, dohaḷo
pana me uppanno; Bid aññaṁ ~aṁ; m. ~o like
dohaḷo and rogo); III 392,14 (kiṁ amma ~aṁ); IV
52,14 (ekena ~ena jīvitakkhayaṁ patto); Dhp-a I
13,24 (mayhaṁ ~aṁ bhavissati); Nidd-a ad Nidd
I 473,15; — °-bhikkhu, m., a monk with some
illness (cf. paṇḍurogatāpasa), As 80,30 (~ūnaṁ bhe-
sajjaṁ deti).

a-phāsu-kāma, mfn., not wishing what is
pleasant (to, gen.); n. pl. ~āni (scil. kulāni asad-
dhāni+), Nidd I 473,15 (= phāsukaṁ na icchanti,
aphasukam eva icchanti, Nidd-a).

a-phāsu-vihāra, m., discomfort; dat. ~āya
(ahitāya dukkhāya +), SN I 70,21 foll. = 98,5 foll.,
quoted Nidd I 16,8 foll. (= na sukhavihārāya, Nidd-a).

a-phuṭṭha, mfn. (neg. pp. of phusati = sa.
spṛçati (√spṛç)), untouched; m. ~o, Ps III 308,6; n.
~aṁ phusitabbaṁ, Ps III 211,12; Th-a ad Th 945
(= 'aphusitaṁ' or 'aphassitarh' q. v.).

a-phussa, mfn. (neg. grd. = sa. a-spṛçya), not
to be touched; n. pl. ~āni, only in a corrupt passage in
Mil (Ee) 157,19-2 0: sabbe ... guṇā ekarasā arogā
akuppā aparûpakkamā, ~āni kiriyāni (retouched in
a-phussakriyāvō, Hīnaṭ).

a-phusiṁ, aor. 1 sg. of phusati, Thī 212; Nidd
I 185,17 (so Nidd-a (Se) for passiṁ, Ee).

a-phegguka, mfn. (cf. pheggu, sa. phalgu),
without weak wood; Ja III 318,3* (sasiṁsapā sāra-
mayā ~ā; Se sa sīsapā, Bdf yā sisapā); cf. apagata-
phegguka.

Apheggu-sāra, m. or n., title of a work, composed
by a thera in Haṁsāvatī; Sas 48,12.

Apheggu-sāra-dīpanī, f., title of an anuṭīkā to
Abhidhammattha-vibhāvanī by Mahāsuvannadīpa
(Tipiṭakadhara); see JPTS 1910-12 p. 126 and
MBode, Pāli Litt. of Burma p. 36, n. 2; Piṭ-sm 837;
Ms. in India Office Library, see JPTS 1896 p. 39.Apheggu-sāra-dīpanī

a-bajjhanta, mfn. (neg. part. of bajjhati, pass,
of √bandh), not being bound; m. ~o (arajjanto asaj-
janto +), Dhp-a IV 100,11 (v. l. asocanto).

a-baddha, mfn. [ts., neg. pp. of √bandh], un-
bound, not fettered (by, gen. or instr.); m. ~o, Sn 39
= Ap 8,25 (migo araññamhi ~o; Bai abandho; do.
Ap & Nidd II 91,23 (Nidd-a — Pj II 83,4)); ~o Mā-
rassa, It 56,20 (Ee abandho, v. l. abaddho; opp.
a-baddhamārena baddho, It-a (Se bandho)); Ja V 372,18*
(pakkhī ~o); gen. ~assa, Ps III 98,17 (= 'asitassa');
— Abh 126 ( = samudāyattha-rahita, i. e. incoherent
(of speech)).

[a-baddhaka, Ap 95,23 Ee prints satthukañ ca
'baddhakañ ca, unwarranted, v. l. padakañ ca, Se pa-
văkañ ca; see C and Th-a (Ce) 475,1*: vatthaṁ
senāsanañ c'eva āmisaṁ].

a-baddha-pitta, n., 'the unbound bile'; Pj I
60,30 (opp. baddhapittaṁ pittakosake thitaṁ);
Vibh-a 65,2 = Vism 359,18; Vibli-a 243,26 = Vism
260,20 = Ss 205,35.

a-baddha-mālā, f., unbound flower-ornament;
Sv I 88,25 (mālā ti baddha-mālā vā ~ā vā; pt:
mālā-saddo sāsane pupphesu pi nirūḷho [cf. sgh.
mal] ti āha: baddhamālā vā).

a-baddha-sandhi, mfn., with loose joints,
rickety; Ja VI 549,23' ('vikato' [or vikaṭo] ti vikata-
pādo, ~ī ti pi vuttaṁ).

a-baddha-sīma, mfn., whose limits are not
staked out (by the saṁgha); pl. ~ā vihārā, Sp (Ce
204,27) ad Vin I 106,5.

a-baddha-sīmā, f., an uposatha-limit not
indicated by special marks (see Abhidh-k-vy Trsl.
IV 212,10); Kkh Ce (4,28), 7,5-8,21 (viz. gāma-sīmā,
sattabbhantara-s°, udakukkhepa-s°) ≠ Vin-vn 2551;
2553-60; Ps III 241,8 ('saṁghamajjhe osarantī' ti
~āya kathitaṁ, baddha-sīmāyaṁ pana vasantā at-
a-baddha-sīmā

a-badhira, mfn., not deaf; m. ~o, Ja VI 4,15
(~o badhiro viya hohi); Sp (III) 635.4-7 ≠ Vin-vn
549—50.

a-bandhana, mfn. [ts.], (a) 'without bands',
esp. not riveted (said of alms-bowls); Vin III 246,17'
(patto ~o vā ekabandhano vā, etc); — (b) free from
the fetters of existence, untrammeled; Sn 948 (chinna-
soto ~o; Nidd I 433,15-24); Th 282 (pl. chinnasuttā
a-bandhanasotaṁ ~aṁ; Ud-a: n'atthi etassa bandhanan ti
~o); [Ap 323,22 (~aṁ, w. r. for a-bandhunaṁ)].

a-bandhanôkāsa, mfn. (a + bandhana + okāsa
[sa. avakāça]), with no room for bands; Vin III
246,19' (~o nāma patto yassa dvaṅgulā rāji na hoti).

a-bandhitabba-yuttaka, mfn. (neg. grd. of
bandhati + yuttaka), not meriting to be imprisoned;
Ja I 440,9-11.

a-bandhu, mfn. [ts.], friendless; m. ~u aparā-
yano, Ja III 468,1* ( = asaraṇo nippatittho, Ct.);
Ja IV 303,6' (akhetto ~u [so 'ck & Se, Ee ~ū] =
'akhettabandhu'); f. ~u aparāyinī, Ja III 386,12*;
Ap 323,22 (tvaṁ hi nātho ~unaṁ, gen. pl., so read
with Ce and Th-a for abandhanaṁ, Ee) — Th-a C
a-bandhu

ababa, n., name of a certain high numeral, viz. a
koṭi11 = 1011 millions = 1077; Abh 475 ≠ Kacc-v 397
(Sadd 801,27 foll.) - Pay fol. gu v. 3.

Ababa, m., Npr. of a hell (cf. prec, and see
^bbuda); Sn p. 126,15 (eko ~o nirayo . . . vīsati
~ā) = SN I 152,8 = AN V 173,12.

2a-bala, mfn. [ts.], not strong, weak, feeble; m.
~o, Sn 1120 (jiṇṇo 'ham asmi ~; Pj; = dubbalo appa-
balo appathāmo, Nidd; = balarahito, Nidd-a) ≠ Ja
VI 523,27*; acc. ~aṁ taṁ balaṁ āhu, yassa bālaba-
laṁ balaṁ, SN I 222,5* = 223,30*; ~aṁ puggalaṁ
2a-balabandhanam (+ dubbalaṁ, pūtikaṁ, asārakaṁ), MN
I 449,21; rūpaṁ . . . ~aṁ virāg(uṇ)aṁ anassāsikaṁ,
MN III 30,31; sabalaṁ ~aṁ pi ca, scil. cittaṁ,
Abhidh-av 31,20*; pl. ~ā, DN I 53,32 (avasā + ; Sv)
= MN I 517,2 (cf. Ja VI 225,26*); Mil 253,27 (°-dub-
bala-parittaka-tiṇesu); Dhp-a I 316,19' (°-dubbalaṭ-
ṭhena) ≠ 336,23'; — f. (subst.) ~ā, see below; — n.,
soḷas' evâbalāni, Abhidh-av 31,19*; — — °-ka, mfn.
id.; ifc v. kisâbalaka (MN I 225,32, v. l. for kisa-
balaka, cf. Ps II 267,1, pt); — °-tta, n. abstr.; Pj II
513,16 (abl. ~ā).

1abala, m., according to Sp (III) 622,17 (ad Vin
III 181,6) = bonda, see abalabala.

abalabala, mfn. (accord. to Ct. abala + abala,
āmreḍita-cpd.), foolish, silly; Vin III 181,6 (kv-āyaṁ
~o viya mandamando viya, etc, quoted Sadd 40,31
(atisayatthe āmeṇḍitaṁ), while Sp reads abalabala
and explains: abaḷo kira bondo vuccati, atisayatthe ca
idaṁ āmeṇḍitaṁ, tasmā atibondo viyā ti vuttaṁ
hoti; Sp-ṭ (Vmv): bondo ti ṇaṭo (loḷo ɔ: jaḷo) muddha-
(manda-)dhātuko); Ja II 234,11' (~o viya hutvā kiñci
ajānanto viya; = 'mandamando va jhāyati').

abalassa, m. (i. e. abala + assa [sa. açva]), a
weak horse; Dhp 29 (~aṁ va sīghasso hitvā; =
dubbalassaṁ, Dhp-a).

a-balā, f. [ts.], awoman; Abh 230 ≠ Sadd 363,29;
pl. ~ā va naṁ balīyanti, Sn 770 ( = kilesā, Pj, Nidd;
Nidd-a: n'atthi etesaṁ balan ti abalā balavirahitā).

a-bahi, ind. [sa. a-bahih], not outside, in the
interior, in one's heart; olokayate te abahi, v. r.
in Nett 4,23* (= abbhantaraṁ, Nett-a); — °-gata,
mfn., ~ena mānasena, with the mind not directed
towards things around, AN IV 87,3 (antogatehi in-
driyehi +) ≠ a-bahig-gata-mānasa, mfn., Vv 571
a-bahi

a-bahu-aggha, mfn. = appaggha (q. v.), Pp-a(ad
Pp 33,6), only in Se 88,5 for atibahuṁ (an)-agghanto,
Ee216,1.

a-bahukata, mfn., not much concerned (about,
instr.); m. ~o, SN V 89,17 (= akata-bahumāno, Spk;
cf. Vin I 247,17).

a-bahumata or °-māna, mfn., disregarded;
Mp I 328,8 (putta-dārena °-māno; so also Ce & Se,
but Ce & Se v. l. °-mato) ≠ Th-a Ce 253,34 (putta-
dārehi apasādito); — °māna-kata, mfn. — prec,
Ja IV 244,19 (tehi ~o, v. l. Bd ni(k)kaḍḍhito).

a-bahulī-kata, mfn. (neg. pp. of bahulī + √kṛ),
not made much of, not practised or developed; m.
~o, AN IV 439,30 (kāmesu ādīnavo . . . ~o); f. ~ā,
MN III 95,2 (abhāvitā ~ā, scil. kāyagatā sati); AN I
46,16 (kāyagatā sati); SN II 264,5 (do., scil. mettā
cetovimutti); n. ~aṁ, AN I 6,5 (abhāvitaṁ ~aṁ
... cittaṁ); 46,15 (amataṁ tesaṁ ... ~aṁ); —
a-bahulī-katavanā ~aṁ, etc, scil. kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ).

abbajati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. āvrajati, ā + √vraj],
to go to, come to; pot. 1 sg. ~e, AN II 39,5* (Se w. r.
abbhaje; v. l. aṇḍaje), quoted Ps I 61,31* (v. l. do.),
Ud-a 176,16* (v. l.do.), Sadd 344,27.abbajati

a-bbata, mfn. [sa. a-vrata], not keeping (his)
vows; m. ~o, Dhp 264 (Ck abbuto; = sīlavatena ca
dhutavatena ca virahito, Dhp-a; cf. Udāna-v XI 13
(reading avṛtas for avratas)); — n. (subst.), keeping
aloof from vows; abl. ~ā (asīlatā +), Sn 839 (= dhu-
taṅgavataṁ vinā, Pj = Nidd-a).a-bbata

abbahati (or abb[ū/u]hati) pr. 3 sg. [sa. ā-bṛhati,
ā + √bṛh (vṛh), (liable to be confounded with √vah),
abbahatiimper. 2 sg.

abbāhana, n., nomen actionis from next [cf. sa.
ābarhaṇa], or abbūhana, abbahana do. from prec;
Dhp-a III 404,4 (rāgasallâdīnaṁ santhanaṁ nimma-
thanaṁ ~; v. l. abbūhanaṁ &nibbāpanaṁ; = upu-
ranu, gp); mahato taṇhā-sallassa abbūhanaṁ, Nidd I
343,14 = Nidd II 225,21 (Ee abbuḷhanaṁ, v. l. abba-
hanaṁ, abbuhanaṁ; exp la in ing mahesi); — °-hetu,
ind., on account of that, MN II 216,14 (Ee abbya-
hana-°).

abbāheti, (or ~ayati), caus. of abbahati [cf. sa.
ābarhita]; to drag out; to pull up; 3 pl. satthaṁ
~ayanti, Ja IV 364,13* (Ce abbhā°, Sel ambāhayanti
but Set abbāhayanti; Ct.: satthe cora-aṭaviṁ atibā-
henti (Se: satthaṁ corā aṭaviṁ atibāhenti), thus
taking sattha = sa. sārtha (caravan), and not =
sa. çastra (weapon), see 2atibāheti = ativāheti);
— aor. 3 sg. ~esi, Ja II 319,23 (asigāho asiṁ ~; Bid
aggahesi; = abbhahi [o: abbahi]; pt); — abs. ~etvā
(asiṁ), Ja II 330,3; Dhp-a II 249,1 (v. l. aggahetvā);
sonḍāya bhisañ ca muḷāliñ ca (bhisa-muḷālaṁ) ~etvā
(or 'abbahitvā?), Vinl 214,37 (Ee abbāhitvā (v. I.
abbāhetihitvā & aggahetvā) — SN II 269,10-17 (Ee abbhugga-
hetvā, B abbuhetvā, C-mss. adhohetvā; Spk (Ee):
abbāhitvā ti uddharitvā).

abbu, n (?), believed to be identical with abbhu,
ɔ: avaḍḍhi or vināsa; pt ad Spk I 100,23 (abbuṁ
vuccati abbhu[daṁ], taṁ detī ti abbu-daṁ; see
abbuda, 2).

[2Abbuda, m. Npr. of a prince; Ap 263,24
(Ee Ce: °-Nirabbudāni aṭṭh'-aṭṭhâsiṁsu khattiyā, i. e.
eight named Abbuda and eight named Nirabbuda;
metrical v. l. Abbhā Nirabbhā †Nigatamhā ɔ: Niha-
tabbhā?)].

abbuda, n. [sa. arbuda], excrescence, tumor, 1.
esp. said of the embryo in the second week after con-
ception; [Hôb s. v. abudon]; SN I 206,11.* (paṭha-
maṁ kalalaṁ hoti, kalalā hoti ~aṁ ḷḷ ~ā jāyate pesī
abbuda40,28 & Ja IV 496,25*; gen. ~assa, Mil 40,11 (aññā
kalalassa . . . ~assa . . . pesiyā . . . ghanassa . . .
khuddakassa . . . mahantassa mātā); °-kāle pi cavati
marati, etc, Nidd I 120,3 ad Sn 804 (kalala-kāle + ;
Nidd-a ≠ Spk I 301,1-13*) ≠ Vism 236,19; — 2.
metaph. — stain, scandal (cf. Abhidh-k-vy Trsl. IV
211-12); Vin III 18,35 (Sudinnena . . . ~aṁ uppādi-
taṁ, ādīnavo uppādito) = 19,3; Sp I 35,9 (uppajjis-
sati . . . sāsanassa evarūpaṁ ~aṁ; = upaddavaṁ,
corakammaṁ . . . (and from a gp) gaṇdaṁ, Sp-ṭ); ib.
53,16 (anekarūpaṁ sāsanassa ~añ ca malañ ca kaṇ-
ṭakañ ca samuṭṭhāpesuṁ, cf. Mhv V 231); SN I 43,23*
(kiṁ su lokasmiṁ ~aṁ); ib. 2 8* (m. pl. by attraction:
corā lokasmiṁ ~ā; Spk I 100,23 : '~an' ti vināsakāra-
ṇaṁ, corā lokasmiṁ vināsakā ti attho; pt, see abbu);
Ps II 87,30 (citte uppannaṁ ~aṁ nīharitabbaṁ); —
ifc. v. nir-°, sāsana°; — 3. a certain high numeral
= a koti8 = 108 millions = 1056 (see Burnouf,
Lotus (1925) p. 852-59); Abh 475; Kacc-v 397 = Pay
fol. gu v. 3; Sadd 801,26; Pj II 477,5 (sataṁ satasa-
hassa-ninnahutāni ekaṁ ~aṁ) ≠ Ja III 360,12'; pl.
chattiṁsati pañca ca ~āni, Sn 660 = SN I 149,29*
(Spk) = AN II 3,33* (Mp) = V 171,24*; — ifc. v.
nir-°.

1Abbuda, m., name of a certain hell, or a plare
(in Avīci) where the supplice dures an abbuda of
years, cf. abbuda, 3; Sn p. 126,12 foll. = SN I 152,6
foll. - AN V 173,9 foll. (Pj II 476,27: ~o nāma koci
paccekanirayo n'atthi, Avīcimhi yeva abbuda-gaṇa-
nāya paccanôkāso pana ~o nirayo ti vutto ≠ Spk I
218,30); Ud-a 140,9 (°âdi-sītanarakā); Hôb s. v. a-
buda; — ifc. v. Nir-°.

abbuda-gaṇanā, f., counting by abbudas (see
abbuda, 3); instr'. ~āya, Pj II 476,29 = Spk I 218,32.

abbuda-jāta, mfn., defiled; Ud-a 298,14 (idāni
bhikkhu-saṁgho ~o, aparisuddhā puggalā uposa-
thaṁ āgacchanti); cf. abbuda, 2.

abbusita, mfn., v. l. for a-vusita (q. v. MN I
515,23 foll.).

abbahati (or abb[ū/u]hati) pr. 3 sg. [sa. ā-bṛhati,
ā + √bṛh (vṛh), (liable to be confounded with √vah),
abbahatiimper. 2 sg.

abbahati (or abb[ū/u]hati) pr. 3 sg. [sa. ā-bṛhati,
ā + √bṛh (vṛh), (liable to be confounded with √vah),
abbahatiimper. 2 sg.

abbūhita, mfn., prob, removed, swept away
(see abbūḷhita); Ja III 541,24* (~aṁ pupphakaṁ
aḍḍharattaṁ; Ct. (v. l. Cks abyūhita) = ṭhapitaṁ
a-ppaghara[ṇa]kaṁ katam, taking pupphakaṁ =
abbūhitaexecutioner stanching blood after maiming; Tr. sug-
gests it to be the charge of a dustman

abbūḷha, mfn. (pp. of abbahati, abbuhati; sa.
ā-bṛḍha, with ṛ = f, AiGr I § 28), drawn out, re-
moved; n. ~aṁ (vicikicchākathaṁkathā-sallaṁ), DN
II 283,27; ~am agha[ga]taṁ vijitaṁ (Se: aghata-
abbūḷhaw. r. for abbuhi, see abbahati]; loc. ~e (scil. salle),
Pj II 461,25; — °-tta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, Pj II 518,6;
Nidd-a (Ee) 185,30.

[abbūḷhana, n., w. r. prob, for abbūhana = abbā-
hana, q. v.].

abbūḷha-salla, mfn. (abbūḷha + sa. çalya),
having the sting (scil. of taṇhā) pulled out; Sn 593
(~o asito satiṁ pappuyya cetaso; Pj); 779 (~o caraṁ
appamatto; Pj; = abbūḷhita(!)sallo pahata-sallo, etc,
Nidd); Ja III 157,11* (so 'haṁ ~o 'smi vītasoko
abbūḷha-salla(sv-āhaṁ ~o 'smi sītibhūto 'smi nibbuto) = Vv 942
= Dhp-a I 30,21*; Thī 53 (sâjja ~âhaṁ nicchātā pari-
nibbutā; = uddhaṭa-taṇhāsallā, Thī-a) — 132.

abbūḷha-sokasalla, mfn. (cf. prec), having the
sting of grief pulled out; n. ~aṁ (scil. cittaṁ), Pj I
153,13 (nissokaṁ ~aṁ = 'asokaṁ', Khp V 11 =
Sn 268).

abbūḷhita, mfn. a clerical blending of abbūḷha
and abb[ū/u]hita; pulled out, removed; °-salla, mfn. =
abbūḷha-salla; Nidd I 59,10 (+ pahata-salla, etc; —
nīhaṭa-salla, Nidd-a; see v. l. in Nidd and Nidd-a).

abbūḷhesika, mfn., whose pillar (of desire) is
pulled out (i. e. abbūḷha + esikā [not in sa.] = a
pillar or door-post, metaph. = taṇhā, cf. abbūḷha-
salla above; Michelson Z D M G LIX p. 126 refers to
sa. iṣīkā, reed, arrow, cf. Ps III 228,21); MN I 139,17
(ukkhitta-paligho, saṁkiṇṇaparikho, ~o, niraggaḷo,
etc, see ib. 27-30; Ps II 116,1: 'taṇhā'ti vaṭṭamūlikā
abbūḷhesikaten'esa tassā abbūḷhattā luñcitvā chaḍḍitattă (so v. l.
and Nidd-a Ee I 85,31) ~o ti vutto) ≠ AN III 85,26
(Mp (Se) III 39,12: ~o ti taṇhā-saṁkhātaṁ esikā-
tthambhaṁ abbuyha luñcitvā thito) ≠ Nidd I 21,6
(Nidd-a = Ps).

2abbeti, pr. 3 sg., to enjoy, to feed upon (acc),
as synon, with paribhuñjati giving an etymology of
gandhabba; pt ad Sv (II) 498,3 (gandham ~enti
paribhuñjantī ti gandhabba ≠ pt ad Spk II 350,18).2abbeti

abbokāra, m. (3a + vokāra [from sa. vy-ava +
√kṛ]), non-commixtion, distinction; abl. ajjhattika-
bāhirānaṁ ~ato sabhāva-dassanatthaṁ√Vibh-a 51,15.

paripuṇṇaṁ ~aṁ; = nirantaraṁ, Ps); Pj II 146,28

abbokiṇṇaMp I 277,12); Vibh (307,22) 320,20 (na ~ā uppajjantī
ti na paṭipāṭiyā uppajjanti); Sp (II) 404,1 ('aseca-
nako' = anāsittako ~o pāṭekko āveṇiko, scil. vihă-
ro; ad Vin III 70,20) = Vism 268,4; — n. ~aṁ, ind.,
constantly, in unbroken succession; satataṁ samitaṁ
~aṁ, AN IV 13,16 foll. (= nirantaraṁ, Mp) = 145,21

'niccaṁ'); Nidd I 18,26 (so v. l., Ee abbocchiṇṇaṁ;
= 'sadā'; = aññena asammissaṁ, Nidd-a); ~aṁ
pañcasataṁ pabbajiṁ isipabbajjaṁ [ ˇ ˇ - ˇ - , see

Ps II 140,17* (susāne saṭṭhi vassāni ~aṁ vasām'
ahaṁ) = Mp I 77,3*; Ps II 165,8 (pañcavīsati vas-
sāni ~aṁ). Cf. next & avyākiṇṇaṁ.

abbocchinna, (sometimes misspelt abbh°), mfn.
[sa. a-vyavachinna, neg. pp. of vi + ava + √chid],
unbroken, uninterrupted; DN III 105,16 (viññāṇa-
sotaṁ pajānāti ubhayato ~aṁ; — dvīhi pi bhāgehi
a-cchinnaṁ, Sv); Ps III 130,5 (gamanaṁ ~aṁ katvā,
= 'piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi'); ~o pubbâcariya-
nicchayo, Pj I 11,13* [ ˇ - - - ]; instr, f. ~āya san-
tatiyā, Mil 72,30 (quoted Ss 110,34); — n. ~aṁ, ind.,
uninterruptedly, Ap 89,20 (aṭṭha kappāni devesu ~aṁ
vasiṁ ahaṁ; Ee abbh°, opp. vokiṇṇaṁ); Pj II 426,27*
(khandhānaṁ paṭipāṭi dhātu-āyatanāna[ṁ] ca | ~aṁ
vattamānaṁ [Ee °mānānaṁ, Ba °mānā] saṁsāro ti
pavuccati) = Ud-a 270,11* (Ee abbh°) = Mp ad AN II
212,1 (Ce Se vattamānaṁ) — Vism 544,11* (do.)) ≠ As

— °-nirantara- viriya, n., unbroken continuous energij;

— °-viriya, n., unbroken energy; Ja I 280,9' (~aṁ,
= 'dhiti'); VI 287,10' (~ena 'dhitimā'); 373,6' (~aṁ,
= 'dhiti').

abbohāra, mfn. (3a + vohāra [sa. vyavahāra]),
not to be taken into consideration, negligible, of no
consequence (cf. next); ~o va so (scil. sevālo pānīya-
ghaṭâdīnaṁ anto), Vin-vn 1019 (cf. Sp (IV) 765,7);
do. m., a matter of no consequence, Vin-vn 1521 (cf.
Sp (IV) 854,2); — °-naya, mfn. = abbohārika-naya,
Vin-vn 1452 (Sp (IV) 847,28)

abbohārika (or ~iya), mfn. [sa. avyavahārya],
negligible, ineffective; Vin III 91,16 (etaṁ ~aṁ;
= ... vohāraṁ na gacchati, āpattiyā aṅgaṁ na
hoti, Sp (II) 488,1); Sp (IV) 847,29 'foll.; Vin III
112,15 (atth' esā cetanā, sa ca kho ~ā; Sp: esā
assāda-cetanā atthi, sa ca kho avisaye uppan-
nattā ~ā; āpattivā aṅgaṁ na hoti) quoted Kv-a
195,5 (Trsl. 361 n. 4); Sp (III) 521,30 (. . . ~ā va
supinanta-cetanā, = Ss 63,28); Ja V 286,6 (Pabhā-
vatiyā sarīra-ppabhā ~ā ahosi [scil. rattiṁ]); As 90,28,
abbohārikapakkhikā vā bhavanti ~ā vā; cf. ib. 94,19); Mp II
193,6 (sa [scil. upekhāvedanā] °-ṭṭhāne ṭhitā); Ja V
271,20' (~āni, scil. madhu-bindūni); ib. 21' (~ā
honti); Ps II 366,23-30 (assāsa-passāsā ~ā honti);
with karoti — to disregard: Ja III 309,17' (idāni
kasmā evarūpaṁ dosaṁ ~aṁ karosi); Ps III 169,22
(acc. m. pl. ~e katvā); Ps III 338,23 (taṁ jātiṁ ~aṁ
katvā); — °tthāna, n., the state of a°, Mp II 193,6;
— °-tā, f. abstr., Vin-vn 1021 (see Sp (IV) 765,13);
— °-tta, n. abstr., Sp (IV) 853,8; — °-naya, m., the
inference(?) about a°, Sp (IV) 847,28 (cf. abbohāra-
naya); — °-pakkha, m., the category of a°; Sp (IV)
853,12 (raso na paññāyati ~aṁ bhajati, does not
count); — °-bhāva, m. abstr., Sp (III) 518,26.

abbha, m. (f. & n.), [sa. abhra, m. (or n.)],
1. firmament, sky; n., Abh 45 (+ gagana); Sadd
442,11* (ākāso+); acc. ~aṁ rajo a[c]chādesi, Ja VI
581,21*; — 2. a cloud (thunder-cloud); m. f. or n.,
abbhaJa IV 494,2* (abbh' uṭṭhito; = valāhaka-saṁkhāto
~o uṭṭhito nibbatto, Ct.), quoted Ps II 310,11*, Th-a
ad Th 451 & Sadd 407,18; pl. ~ā subahalā honti,
Mil 274,8; — (b) f. ~ā mahikā dhūmo rajo, Dhs 617
(= valāhako, As 317,32); ~ā mahikā dhūmo rajo (for
dhūma-rajo see below) Rāhu, Sv I 141,6 (see Vin II
295,24 below; quoted Sadd 407,19) = Ps II 250,28 (Ee
abbhaṁ) cf. ~a-mahikâdi-upakkilesa°, Ud-a 354,5;
413,12; Vv-a 134,24 (so Ce; Ee abbhā-m°); — (c) 77.
~aṁ candima-suriyānaṁ upakkileso, Vin II 295,23 (+
mahikā . . . dhūmarajo . . . Rāhu) = AN II 53,5;
~aṁ suriyassa rogo, Mil 273,21 (+ mahikā . . .
megho ... Rāhu); SN III 256,22 (also title of the
sutta ib.; = abbha-maṇḍapo (q. v.), Spk); Ja VI
231,35* (sateratā ~am iva Candakaṁ pāvisī Rujā);
abl. ~ā, MN II 104,22* (lokaṁ pabhāseti ~ā mutto
va candimā; Ps: abbha-mahiyā-dhūmaraja-Rāhū ti
imehi pana upakkilesehi mutto candimā, so CkCe) =
Th 871; 872; 873 = Dhp 382; Dhp 172-3; Th 548
quoted Paṭis I 172,6* (Ct. ib. 172,8-14), and Ps III
137,3*; pl. ~āni, Th 598 (yathā ~āni verambo vāto
nudati pāvuse); Sadd 407,20 ('abbhāni candamaṇḍa-
laṁ chādenti', untracedquotation). Cf. abbhâdi-° below;
— ifc. v. ati-° (Spk II 351,18).

abbhaka, n. [sa. abhraka], talc or mica; Abh 492
≠ Am-k II 9,100.

abbhakkhāti (= abbhācikkhati, q. v.), pr. 3 sg.
[sa. abhi + ā + √khyā], to accuse (falsely), to slander
(acc); Ja VI 377,27* (~āti abhūtena alikena-m-
abhisāraye; cf. abbhācikkhanti (aññamaññaṁ abhū-
tena), ib. 378,2); aor. 3 sg. ~āsi, Ap 299,20 (v. l. abbhā-
cikkhi), quoted Ud-a 264,12* (abbhācikkhi); inf.
~ātuṁ, m the cpd. an-abbhakkhātu-kāma, mfn.,
not wishing to bring false accusation (against, acc);
pl. ~ă hi mayaṁ Bhagavantaṁ (bhavantaṁ Gota-
maṁ), Vin I 234,20 = DN I 161,17 (= na abhūtena
abbhakkhātiIV 182,7.

abbhakkhāna, n. [sa. abhyākhyāna], false
accusation, calumny; Abh 116; Dhp 139(rājato vāupas-
saggaṁ ~aṁ va dāruṇaṁ; Dhp-a); Ap 299,14 foll.
(~aṁ . . . laddhaṁ, a periphrastic passive; quoted
Ud-a 264,6* foll.); na hi sādhu Bhagavato ~aṁ, DN
III 248,5 foll. — MN I 130,22 = III 207,17 = SN III
110,8 = AN III 290,27; Sp (Ce) ad Vin I 237,34 ('na
... jhīranti (so Sp Ce) ... abbhācikkhantā' = ~assa
antaṁ na gacchanti); Sp-ṭ ad Sp I 26,4 (amhākaṁ
~aṁ karoti; = 'abbhācikkhati'); — ifc. v. abhūta°.

abbha-kūṭa, m. or n. [sa. abhra + kūṭa], the
summit of the clouds; Vv 1 (obhāsasi vijjur iv' ~aṁ;
= valāhaka-sikhara, Vv-a, assuming "acc. for loc.",
or caus. meaning in obhāsasi); pl. ~ā, Ja VI 528,27*
= 533,32* (uggatā ~ā va nīlā añjana-pabbatā); —
abbha-kūṭais almost equal to that;

abbha-ghana, m. (cf. sa. abhra-ghana, mfn.),
a thick cloud; Sn 348 (vāto yathā ~aṁ vihane; —
~aṁ vihanti, Pj); It 64,14* (cando ~ā mutto; =
abbha-saṁkhātā ghanā ghana-megha-paṭalā vā vi-
mutto cando viya, It-a); Ap 332,18 (cando v'~ā
mutto vicarāmi ahaṁ tadā) — Th-a Ce411,2*(abbha-
gatā!); Ap 20,11 (vijjuṁ~e yathā) = Th-a Ce II 99,17*
(vijjutaṁ gagane yathā); Ap 83,15 (suriyo ~e yathā);
Ja VI 269,29* (vijjut' ~ā va nissaṭā; = ~ato ghana-
valāhakantarato nissaṭā vijjullatā viya, Ct.); Ja VI
124,7* (vijju v' ~ntare; Ct.) = 449,15* ≠ Ap 68,23
= Th-a Ce 21,23* (vijju va gaganantare); Pj II 349,1
(~e(na) nivuto loko).abbha-ghana

abbhaṅga, m. [sa. abhyaṅga], unction; Vibh-a
485,21 (veḷupesikā viya ~aṁ parassa guṇaṁ nippeseti
nipuñchati) = Vism 29,24 (= abbhañjanaṁ, mhṭ).

abbha-chādita, mfn. [sa. abhra + chādita],
covered with clouds; Th 1068 (ummā-pupphena sa-
mānā gaganā v' ~ā, n. pl.; Th-a).

abbhañjati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √añj], to
smear, oil, lubricate, anoint; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya (akkhaṁ),
SN IV 177,2; aor. 3 sg. ~i, Dhp-a III 311,9 = Vv-a
68,17 (satapăka-telena); 3 pl. ~iṁsu, Vin III 83,15
(telena); abs. ~itvā, MN I 343,32 (sappi-telena kā-
yaṁ ~) ≠ Pp 56,14; DN II 324,19 (telena); pp.
abbhañjati

abbhañjana, n. [sa. abhy-añjana], smearing,
oiling, inunction; grease, unguent; Ap 236,5; 456,7
= Th-a Ce 100,37*; Vin I 205,13; III 79,5* (~ena, title
of 83,14-16); akkhass' ~aṁ, (simile), Ja II 294,6* =
Mil 367,8* = Vism 45,13*; pāda{s)s' ~aṁ telam,
Dīp VI 83 (Ee pādasambhañjanaṁ); mhṭ ad Vism
29,24 (= 'abbhaṅga'); — °-kicca, n., ihe work of
lubricating, Vism 264,22; 362,25 — ifc. v. akkha°,
gatta°, pāda°, sarīra°.abbhañjana

Abbhañjana-dāyaka, m., designation of two
theras; 1. Ms apadāna, Ap 236,2-10; — 2. otherwise
Kumāputta: his apadāna, Ap 456,2-12 = Th-a Ce
100,33*-101,3* (ad Th 36).

abbhañjāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abbhañjati), to
cause to be anointed; abs. ~etvā (sarīraṁ sahassapāka-
telena), Ja III 372,25.

abbhañjita, mfn. (pp. of abbhañjati or abbhañ-
jeti), smeared, oiled; — ifc. v. tela° (Vism 362,26).

abbhañjeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus.) = abbhañjati;
aor. 3 pl. ~ayiṁsu (satapāka-telena), Ja V 376,32;
abs. ~etvā (telena gattāni ~, sense of a sa. caus. med.),
Ja I 438,20.

abbhatta, mfn. [pp. of abbhañjati; sa. abhyakta],
greased; Ja VI 253,12' (kucchi-saññama-saṁkhā-
tena mitabhojana-mayena telena ~o, Ee abbhanto;
= 'kucchi-saññaman'-abbhatto' [Ee -abbhanto],
252,20*, in the simile kāya = ratha).

abbhatthaṁ, ind. [sa. abhy-astam, cf. 3attha],
'towards home', only with gacchati = to disappear,
subside, become extinct; ~aṁ gacchati (kāma-vitakko),
MN I 115,6 ( = khayam natthibhāvaṁ gacchati, udaka-
bubbuḷako viya nirujjhati, Ps); pahīyanti + ~aṁ
~anti (scil. akusalā vitakkā), MN I 119,12 foll., cf.
akusalā pi dhammā eka-lakkhaṇattā pahānaṁ ~aṁ
~anti, Nett 31,26; viditā ~aṁ ~anti (dhammā),
abbhatthaṁdo. (vedanā, etc), ib. 124,12-13 = AN IV 32,25 =
33,17 = 168,13; °-upāyāsā ~aṁ ~anti, AN III
238,10; sabbaṁ taṁ kulaṁ ~aṁ agamāsi, Ja I
478,10; sabbo surā-mado ~aṁ agamāsi, Mp I 396,6;
mahatā vātena ~aṁ gaccheyya (°-valāhako), Mil
305,4; — pp. °-gata (or °~aṅ-gata), see next; caus.
°~aṅ gameti, Kv 576,5 ≠ Paṭis II 217,25 (quoted Ps
III 252,21, Vism 686,10).
abbhattha-gata, mfn., v. l. for next; As 170,17.

abbhatthaṅ-gata, mfn., disappeared, m. santo
+ , Sadd 178,8; n. ~aṁ abbhatthaṅ gameti, Kv 576,5
(see above); pl. dhammā atītā+ , Dhs 1038 (As 361,12);
vinītā honti+, Vibh 195,21 quoted Ps I 245,20.abbhatthaṅ-gata

abbhatthatā, f. (abstr. of abbhatthaṁ), dis-
appearance, death; ~am gatā, Ja V 469,22* (= sabbe
maraṇaṁ eva pattā, Ct.).

abbhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhrati, √abhr], to go, to
move; Sadd 407,14 (cf. √abbh & abbha, m.).

abbhatika, mfn. [sa. abhi + *ati-ka, this formed
like adhi-ka, cf. abhyadhika], superior, of higher
rank, more appreciated (by, gen.); Ja VI 291,15* (ko
n'īdha rañño ~o manusso; Ct.: idha rājakule tum-
hehi añño ko nu rañño ~o manusso ti attano āsane
abbhatikatarika (q. v.), which does not fit in with metre; Se reads
abbhutiko).

abbhatikkanta, mfn. [pp. of sa. abhi + ati +
√kram], deceased, departed (cf. next); pl. m. ~ā sam-
pattā kālapariyăyaṁ, Ja V 376,1* (= imaṁ manussa-
lokaṁ atikkantā, Ct.); cf. abbhatītā kālagatā (below).

abbhatîta, mfn. [sa. abhy-atîta], (a) (passive)
transgressed; m. saṁyamo ~o, Ja III 541,23* (= jīvi-
kavuttiṁ nissāya pabbajanten' eva sīlasaṁyamo
atikkanto, Ct.); — (b) (do.) n., adiṭṭhaṁ ~aṁ ba-
hukehi kappanahutehi (= what has been passed),
Ap 25,13 = Vin I 40,34* (Ee abbhatitaṁ) = 42,4*
(do.); — (c) (intr.), elapsed; pl. kappā ~ā atikkantā, SN
abbhatîta242; DN II 201,9; 218,3; ~ā ca ye Buddha (opp.
vattamānā Tathāgatā, or, with Ce, anāgatā), Ap
261,6; ye c' abbhatītā sambuddhā ye ca Buddha
anāgatā, AN II 21,19* = SN I 140,11.* (C-mss; Ee ye
ca atītā sambuddhā); acc. pl. sāvake ~e kālagate,
MN I 464,35; 465,6 ≠ DN II 200,5 (paricārake);
acc. sg. sāvakaṁ ~aṁkāla[ṁ]kataṁ, SN IV 398,13-16 ;
— °-sahāya, mfn., whose comrade has passed away;
gen. ~assa atītagata-satthuno, Th 1035; — °-hara,
mfn., bringing the past back; Ja III 169,10* (nâbbha-
tīta-haro soko + nânāgatasukhâvaho; = na abbha-
tītâhāro [read with metre °âharo], ayam eva vā pāṭho,
soko nāma abbhatītaṁ atikkantaṁ niruddhaṁ at-
thaṁ puna nâharati, Ct.).

1abbhantara, n., 1. [= sa. abhy-antaraḷ, (a)
an intermediate space, interval, interior; Abh 771
(~aṁ = antaraṁ); ~aṁ pavisanto, Sadd 399,27;
some case-forms are used as adv. (also ifc), see ~aṁ, ~e,
1abbhantarahanaṁ, bāhiraṁ parimajjasi; Dhp-a) — Ja III 85,14*
(Ct.); Thī 471 (~am assa bāhiraṁ kayirā); [instr.
imassa ten' ~ena [read ~e] bhavitabbaṁ, Ja I 506,5];
loc ~e pīti uppajji, Ja VI 11,5; — ifc. v. upa-
hatâ°; — 2. a certain measure of length = 28 hatthas;
Abh 197; Vin III 201,21 (~aṁ na vijahitabbaṁ); pl.
satt' ~ā, ib. 20 (Sp (III) 654,16: ekaṁ ~aṁ aṭṭha-
vīsati-hatthaṁ hoti); Vin I 111,2 (Sp as before ≠ Kkh
Ce 7,11 ≠ Vin-vn 2557); — ifc. v. satt'-abbhantara-
sīmā; — (3) designation of a particular (mythical)
mango-tree, see abbhantaramba below.

2abbhantara, mfn. [sa. abhy-antara and ābhy-
antara], (a) being within, interior (opp. bāhira); DN
II 75,(2),6 (~āni c'eva bāhirāni [scil. cetiyāni]; = anto-
nagare ṭhitāni, Sv) = AN IV 16,28; DN III 146,28
(~ehi vā bāhirakehi vā paccatthikehi [scil. avi-
kkhambhiyo hoti]; = anto uṭṭhitehi rāgâdīhi, Sv);
AN IV 108,5 foll. (~ānaṁ ratiyā . . . bāhirānaṁ pa-
ṭighātāya; = anto-nagara-vāsīnaṁ, Mp); Ja III
210,20' (~assa vā bāhirassa vā parissayassa); Ps I
177,10 (~ena kilesavuṭṭhāna-sinānena; = 'antarena
sinānena'); ~aṁ katvā, including (or, making it the
main thing, cf. c): Cp I 9,6 (mamaṁ ~aṁ katvā
Phusatī dasa vare vari; Cp-a); Sv (III) 933,18-19
(dosaṁ, atthaṁ); — (b) one belonging to one's house,
private, personal; yo so bhattu ~o antojano, AN III
37,32 ≠ IV 270,3; bhattu ~ā kammantā, AN III
37,27 = IV 265,24 = 268,16; rañño antepure ~ā
guyhamantā, Vin IV 159,26 = AN V 82,9; — (c) do.
2abbhantaraone more prominent among (gen. or loc); Ja III 372,12
(tesaṁ ~o hoti); V 456,24 (asīti-mahātherānaṁ ~o
ahosi); VI 553,2' (ahaṁ tesaṁ ~o); Ps I 181,7 (Bha-
gavato sāvakānaṁ arahantānaṁ ~o ahosi; = 'añña-
taro'); Pj II 158,28 (mahā-sāvakānaṁ ~o; = 'añña-
taro'); Sv (III) 833,2 (~o eko sāvako); Dhp-a I 91,10
(Pañcavaggiyānaṁ ~o, v. l. abbhantare), cf. Mp I
157,29 (Pañcavaggiyabbhantaro); Dhp-a II 74,7 (Pañ-
ca-vaggiyānaṁ ~aṁ Mahānāma-theraṁ . . . disvā);
Ud-a 267,2 (mahā-sāvakesu ~o); — (d) intimate,
familiar with (gen.); Ja V 167,8*(~o pāṇadado
sahāyo; = hadayamaṁsa-sadiso, Ct.); sāsanassa
ñātako ~o homi, Sp-ṭ ad Sp I 50,20 (= 'sāsanassa
dāyādo'); — ifc v. amata°, nibbāna°, bāhira°.

3abbhantara, n. [sa. abhra + antara]. interval
between clouds; loc. ~e, Sās 117,9.

abbhantaraṁ, ind. [sa. abhyantaraṁ], inter-
nally, inside (with loc); Sv I 300,7 (= 'antaraṁ');
Ja V 233,10* (~aṁ pure āsi, tato majjhe, tato bahi);
Mil 303,7 (~aṁ paridayhanto); Nett-a ad Nett 4,23*
(~aṁ citte; = 'a-bahi'); Ja V 351,14'(selâyabbhan-
abbhantaraṁ~aṁ).

abbhantara-gata, mfn., gone or being within;
m. ~o, Kv 64,27 (scil. puggalo avekkhati = anto gato,
ito vā etto vā anikkhamitvā, Kv-a); Sp (II) 445,13,
quoted Ss 117,29; Ud-a 245,1 (dve Sakkā viya eka-
vimān'-~ā); — ifc. v. kottha° (Mil 68,1), sāgara°
abbhantara-gata

abbhantara-cara, mfn., dwelling within (in
intimacy); m. ~o vadhako, Spk (Se) III 68,21 ( =
'antara-caro', SN IV 173,18).

Abbhantara-jātaka, n., title of Ja (281) II
392-400; referred to Ja II 433,5.

abbhantara-dhātu-saṁkopa, m., disturbance
of the humours within (the body); Nidd I 486,28-30
(°-vasena vā sītaṁ [resp. uṇhaṁ] hoti, bahiddhā utu-
vasena vā; = sarīrabbhantare āpo-dhātu-kkhobha
vasena vā aññatara-dhātu-kkhobha-vasena vā, Nidd-a
abbhantara-dhātu-saṁkopa

abbhantara-bhūta, mfn., occurring within; loc.
hemantassa utuno ~e [scil. hima-pāta-samaye],
Ud-a 74,17.

abbhantara-maṇḍala, n., 'the inner circle';
= antima-maṇḍala (q. v.), Vjb ad Sp I 196,35; pt ad
Ja IV 180,28 ('tīsu maṇḍalesū' ti mahāmaṇḍalaṁ
majjhimamaṇḍalaṁ ~am iti), cf. anto-maṇḍala above.

Abbhantaramba, m. [sa. abhyantara + āmra],
name of a mythical amba-tree, belonging to the gods
and kept in the interior of Himavat (at Ja II 395,1*
it is simply named abbhantara, n. (~aṁ nāma dumo;
Ct.) or do. used as adj. to phalaṁ, ib. 395,12'; cf. ~aṁ
ambapakkaṁ, ib. 394,21); ~o, Ja II 396,15 (deva-
tānaṁ paribhogo, Himavati Kañcanaguhāya anto);
Abbhantaramba395,25-26; gen. ~assa, ib. 396,14; 397,27; — °-pakka,
n., its fruit; ib. 399,17; — °-phala, n., id., ib. 395,24;
398,9.

abbhantara-mātikā, f., a detailed list of con-
tents; Dhātuk-a 114,10 (naya-mātikā+); ib. 19
(pañcavīsâdhikena pada-satena nikkhittā ~ā, ɔ:
Dhātuk 1,12-17).

abbhantara-vāta, m., the internal air; Sadd
399,26 (gabbhaseyyakānaṁ mātn-kucchito nikkha-
manakāle paṭhamaṁ ~o nikkhamati, pacchā bāhira-
vāto . . . nibbāyati).abbhantara-vāta

abbhantara-sīmā, f., the 9th among the 15
sīmās, Sp ad Vin I 309,26; cf. sattabbhantarasīmā
{see 1abbhantara, 2); Vin-vn 2558 (imā dve sīmāyo
. . . abbhantarûdakukkhepā ṭhitôkāsā paraṁ siyuṁ).

abbhantarâpassaya, mfn., lying inside; n. ~aṁ,
Th 757 (dele superfīuous sallaṁ and reqd abbhantara-
apassayaṁ; Th-a C: sallaṁ abbhantarăpassayaṁ).

abbhantarika, mfn. [sa. ābhyantarika, cf. sa.
abhyantaraka], intimate, trusted, confidential; m. ~o,
Ja I 86,14 (rañño sabbatthasādhako ~o ativissāsiko
. . . sahāyo); loc. ~e vissāsika-ṭṭhāne, Vin I 346,20;
m. pl. ~ā, Ja I 337,34 Çthose who are concerned', opp.
bāhirakā); VI 390,23 (upaṭṭhahantā tesaṁ ~ā ahesuṁ).abbhantarika

abbhantarita, mfn. (pp. of abhi + antar + √i),
being separated by a distance of (ifc); Mp I 138,22
(cakkavāḷa-sahass'- ~am pi).

abbhantarima, mfn. (cf. majjhima, pacchima,
2antima); (a) interior; ~ena mānena (by inner mea-
sure), Vin III 149,30', Sp (III) 567,30 ( = 'antarā');
pl. ~imā, Ja V 82,11' (na ~ bahi nikkhamanti ɔ:
anto-valañjanakā?); — (b) intimate; Ps II 407,34 (vis-
sāsikaṁ ~aṁ karissāmi (cf. abbhantarika); — °anta,
abbhantarima— °-passa, n. [sa. °-pārçva], id., Ja V 38,12 (tassa
~aṁ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṁ); — ifc. v. sabba-° (DN II
164,14).

abbhantare, ind. (loc. of iabbhantara), (α) adv.,
inside; in one's heart; Mil 30,28 (~e vāyo jīvo); 54,28
(~e jīvo); Ps I 262,2 (~e attā); II 282,32 (~e yeva
khantiṁ dhārento); Dhp-a IV 114,19 (~e rāgâdīnaṁ
upasantatāya); Pv-a 48,6 (~e tiṭṭhantī; = 'anto');
Mil 262,2 (~e nimuggā); Dhp-a II 59,7 (~e yeva taṁ
[ɔ: the requisites of a pabbajita[ gahetvā carāmi, v. l.
for Ee ~en' eva gahetvā); — (b) prp. with gen., with,
within, among; Dhp-a I 91,10 (v. l. for abbhantaro, =
within a narrow ring, opp. antare = among a greater
number(1 ); cf. Mp I 157,29: Pañcavaggiyabbhantaro);
Dhp-a II 64,1 (jaṭila-sahassassa ~e, v. l. antare); Ja
abbhantaresiko, cf. abbhantarika, °ima); 280,2 (sabbe pi tuyhaṁ
~e atthi); 506,5 (so read for ~ena?); II 395,0' (asu-
kassa ~e); ib. il' (devisahassānaṁ ~e); III 250,23
(phalassa ~e); Dhātuk-a 114,23 (Dhātukathāya ~e);
— with loc. (cf. anto, 2 c), Mil 376,22* (~e suññāgāre
[ - - ˇ - , - ˇ - - ] dhammato abhivaḍḍhayiṁ); —
(c) do. ifc. v. aḍḍhayojana° (Sp (IV) 792,30), um-
māra° (Mp I 169,9), viṭapa° (Dhp-a I 165,3), vīsa-
tivassa° (Ps I 258,6), sattadivasa° (Ja V 53,7),
sattavassa° (Dhp-a II 92,13), sarīra° (Nidd-a ad
Nidd I 486,29), sīlasaṁvara-pariccheda° (Nidd-a
ad Nidd I 483,16).

abbhanujānāti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + anu +
√jñā], to acknowledge, to concede, to be in accord (or to
agree) with (gen. pers.), about (acc. rei); DN III 114,16
(ekaccaṁ ~āti, ekaccaṁ nâ°); MN II 178,16 (sabbo
loko brāhmaṇānaṁ etad ~āti) ≠ AN III 384,9 (kiṁ
pana . . . Pūraṇassa Kassapassa sabbo loko etad ~āti)abbhanujānāti

abbhanumodati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + anu +
√mud], to accept with pleasure and thanks, to assent to,
to approve of (by saying 'sādhu', 'suṭṭhu'), to praise
(with gen. pers. & acc. rei); DN I 143,11 (kasmā
pana bhavaṁ . . . Gotamassa subhāsitaṁ subhāsitato
nâ°) ≠ AN I 221,34 (kiṁ pana tvaṁ . . . Ānandassa
snbhāsitaṁ . . . nâbbhanumodasi); MN I 146,11 (tañ
ca satthā ~ati; Ps); part. m. ~anto, Dhp-a IV 102,2
abbhanumodatisādhukāraṁ adāsi); ptirt. med. m. ~amāno, Pj II
155,6 (Bhagavato dhammadesanaṁ); pot. 3 sg. ~eyya,
DN I 143,14 (muddhā pi tassa vipateyya yo . . .
°assa subhāsitaṁ subhāsitato nâ°) ≠ AN I 222,2 ≠
DN I 190,13; aor. 3 sg. ~modi, Vin I 196,37 (Soṇassa
sarabhañña-pariyosāne ~i, see Dhp-a IV 102,2 above);
MN I 397,34 (nâ°, with gen. pers.) = SN IV 224,26;
Mil 29,28 (suṭṭhū ti thero ~i); 87,19 (suṭṭhu bhante
ti rājā ~i); 210,1]. (tesañ ca Tathāgato pasanno sādhū
ti ~i); fut. 1 sg. ~issāmi, AN I 222,1; abs. ~itvā,
Ps I 113,9 (taṁ vacanaṁ sampaṭicchitvā ~itvā ca);
sādhū ti ~itvā, Mil 211,1; — pp. ~ita, q. v.

abbhanumodana, n. (verb. noun of prec; once f.
~ā, Saddh 218), rejoicing, satisfaction, thanksgiving;
As 157,21; 158,30 (sādhu suṭṭhū ti anumodana-
vasena ~aṁ veditabbaṁ); Sp-ṭ ad Sp I 29,2 (°-vasa-
ppavattaṁ pīti-somanassaṁ, = 'tuṭṭhiṁ'); giving
the sense of 'abhikkanta' (q. v.), e. g. Pj II 155,8 foll.;
Vv-a 52,27 (here spelt abbhānumodane).

abbhanumodita, mfn. (pp. of abbhanumodati),
assented to, approved; pl. ~ā appaṭikkositā (pubbâ-
cariyehi), Sadd 57,10.

abbha-paṭala, n. [sa. abhra + paṭala], a thin
cover of clouds; ~aṁ viya macchikā-pattaṁ viya
ca tanukā honti (scil. sakadāgāmino rāgâdayo),
Mp II 349,12; mandamandā uppajjanti tanukâkārā
hutvā ~am iva makkhikā-pattam iva ca (scil. sakad-
ăgāmissa kilesā), Ps I 163,13 = As 239,2; Ps II
38,32 (~aṁ viya tanupaṇṇo, = 'tanupattapalāso');
— °-sañcaraṇa, n., the motions of a°, pt ad Sv (II)
690,17, see abbha-valāhaka below.

abbha-maṇḍapa, m. [sa. abhra + maṇḍapa],
a pavilion (or dome) of clouds; Spk II 351,16 (so Se;
Ee °-maṇḍalo; pt: maṇḍapo ti maṇḍapa-sadisa-
abbhapaṭala-vitānam āha); ~aṁ katvā devo ekam-
ekaṁ phusāyatu, Spk ad SN IV 289,32 (Ce Se ab-
bhāmaṇḍalaṁ; but pt: abbhamaṇḍapakaṁ katvā ti
samantato chādanavasena maṇḍapaṁ viya megha-
paṭalaṁ uppādetvā).

abbha-mutta, mfn. [sa. abhra + mukta], free
from clouds; Sn 687 (suriyan tapantaṁ sarada-r-iv'
~aṁ); cf. abbhā mutto, MN II 104,22*, etc., see
abbha.

Abbhavalāhaka, m. pl. ~ā devā, a class of gods
of the atmosphere; SN III 254,8 (Sītavalāhakā devā,
Uṇhavalāhakā devā, ~ā devā, Vātavalāhakā devā,
Vassavalāhakā devā; cf. Valāha(ka)-kāyika); 256 23;
gen.pl. ~ānaṁ devatānaṁ, ib. 255,21; -ă, Sv (II)
690,17 (= kevalaṁ abbhapaṭala-sañcaraṇa-hetavo,
scil. devatā, pt); Mp II 128,16."Abbhavalāhaka

[Abbhasa, Th-a (Ce) 182,2, w. r. for Ambaraṁ-
sa, [q. v.], Ap 166,15].

abbha-sama, mfn. [sa. *abhra-sama], high as
the sky; n. ~aṁ (mahantaṁ pabbataṁ), SN I 101,4
(= ākāsa-samaṁ, Spk, scil. puthula-bhāvena).

abbha-sampilāpa, m. [sa. abhra + *samplāva
for samplava; as to p-v: p-p see apilapati], heaping
together of clouds; SN IV 289,27-30 (Ee °-saṁvilāpo;
cf. Chānd Up II 4,1: megho yat samplavate, & ib.
II 15,1: abhrāṇi samplavante; see abbha-maṇḍapa).

Abbha-hatthi-pabbata, n. Npr. of a mountain;
Spk II 376,4 (~aṁ nāma patvā vāṇija-gāmaṁ
piṇḍāya pāvisi).

a-bbhākuṭika (or a-bhākuṭika), mfn. (neg. of
bhākuṭika from bhakuṭi, sa. bhrŏkuṭi), not frowning,
genial; m. ~o, DN I 116,10 (Gotamo ehisâgatavādī
a-bbhākuṭikaSv: yathā ekacce parisaṁ patvā (Ee katvā) thaddha-
mukhā saṁkucitamukhā honti, na ediso) ≠ Dhp-a
IV 8,13 (Ee abbhokuṭiko); n. pl. ~ā, Vin III 181,9
(sanhā + . . . ehisvāgatavādino ~ā, etc, v. l. abh°;
do.'Sp (III) 623,4) = Vin II 11,4.

abbhāgata, mfn. (pp. of abhi + ā + √gam),
having arrived (as a guest); m. pl. ~ā, Mil 157,3
(bhojanaṁ na labhiṁsu); acc. pl. ~e āsanôdakena
paṭipūjissāma (i. e. if guests or strangers may arrivè),
AN III 37,25 (= attano santikaṁ āgate, Mp) ≠
AN IV 268,15; gen. pl. °-ān' āsanakaṁ adāsiṁ, Vv 5
(= sampatta-āgantukānaṁ, Vv-a); ~ānaṁ āsanaṁ
datvā, Mp ad AN III 37,25.

abbhāgamana, n. [sa. abhy-ā-gamana], (α)
arrival, visit; Ja III 528,18* (cirassaṁ ~aṁ hi vo
idha; Ct.); AN IV 64,26 (bhikkhusaṁghassa); —
(b) approach (for sexual intercourse); Vin IV 221,1**
(purisassa vā ~aṁ sādiyeyya); ib. 25'.

abbhāghāta, n. [sa. abhyāghāta, but in the
sense of āghāta], a slaughtering-place; °-nissita, mfn.,
situated near that; Vin III 151,13 (pubbaṇṇa-nissitaṁ,
aparaṇṇa-n°, ~aṁ, āghāta-n°, etc.; Sp: abbhāghātan
ti kāraṇāgharaṁ verigharaṁ corānaṁ māraṇatthāya
katan ti Kurundiādisu vuttaṁ).

abbhācikkhati, pr. 3 sg. (abhi + *ācikkhati
(q. v.), sa. abhi + ā + √khyā), to accuse or impute
(falsely), to calumniate; misrepresent (acc); MN I
133,3 foll. (attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva ~ati,
attānañ ca khaṇati bahuñ ca apuññaṁ pasavati)
quoted Sp I 26,4 (= amhākañ ca abbhakkhānaṁ
karoti, Sp-ṭ); 2 sg. ~asi (do.), MN I 132,22; 1 sg. na
ca Bhagavantaṁ abhūtena ~āmi, MN III 139,31.;
3 pl. ~anti, DN I 161,15 (na ca bhavantaṁ Gotamaṁ
abbhācikkhatidhammaṁ vyākaronti) = MN I 368,29 = 482,] 2 =
II 127,4 = SN IV 340,26 = AN I 161,9 = IV 182,5 -
Vin I 234,18; DN III 34,12 (evaṁ-vādiṁ kho maṁ . . .
eke samaṇa-brāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena
~anti; = abhi-ācikkhanti, Sv) = MN I 140,8 (cf. 12)
- AN V 64,25; DN III 82,4 (te Brahmānañ c'eva
~anti musā ca bhāsanti bahuñ ca apuññaṁ pa-
savanti); AN I 59,23 foll. (dve 'me . . . Tathā-
gataṁ ~anti; = abhibhavitvā ācikkhanti, Mp); —
part. m. ~anto, Dhp-a III 477,9 (musāvādaṁ katvā
tucchena paraṁ ~o; = 'abhūtavādī'); m. pl. ~antā
(Bhagavantaṁ ... abhūtena), Vin I 237,35; loc.pl.
~antesu (pharusāhi vācāhi), Ud-a 261,13; — pot. 2 pl.
~eyyātha (Bhagavantaṁ abhūtena ~), SN III 6,22 ;
1 pl. ~eyyāma (do.), MN I 482,2].; — aor. 3 sg. ~i,
Ud-a 264,12* (Ciñcamāṇavikā mama(ṁ) ḷ ~i abhūtena
[of. Ja IV 189,13]), and Dhp-a III 512,21* from Ap
299,20 (abbhakkhāsi); 2 sg. mā Bhagavantaṁ ~i,
DN III 248,4; 249,32; MN I 130,21; 131,20; 256,30;
257,26; III 207,16; SN III 110,8; AN III 290,26 foll.;
1 sg. ~iṁ, Ap 299,10 (Surabhiṁ ~iṁ adūsakaṁ,
quoted Ud-a 264,2* and Dhp-a III 512,16*); — pp.
~ito (abhūtena), Dhp-a III 120,9.

abbhācikkhana, n. (nomen actionis from prec),
calumniation; Sadd 95,29 (Buddhâdīnaṁ garūnaṁ
~aṁ); instr, abhūtena ~ena, Ud-a 434,11. Cf. abbhak-
khāna.

abbhâdi-upakkilesa-rahita, mfn. (Pj II 487,5:
= 'visuddhaṁ'); and abbhâdi-mala-rahita, mfn.
(Ja V 63,28': = 'vimalo'), see abbha.

abbhāna, n. [sa. āhvāna, see abbheti], the act of
re-admission or re-habilitation of a monk who has
been expelled; Vin I 319,28 (ṭhapetvā tīṇi kammāni:
upasampadaṁ pavāraṇaṁ ~aṁ); cf. ib. 31-34; AN
I 99,12 (pātimokkhaṁ . . . etc. + ~aṁ paññattaṁ;
= ciṇṇamānattassa ~aṁ, Mp); Vin II 39,33 foll.
abbhāna(JRAS 1892 p. 64,26); Vin-vn 2602-03 (3010); Vin
V 161,24* (~aṁ kissa kāraṇā); ib. 28* (visuddhatthāya
~aṁ); gen. mānattadānassa ~assa, Vin V 142,7; ~ +
vuṭṭhāna, mānatta, parivāsa, As 399,14; — °-kam-
ma, n., id.; JRAS 1892 p. 66,24; °vasena osāre-
tabbo, Sp (III) 630,2 (= 'abbhetabbo'); ifc. akata°,
mfn.; m.~o, ib. 630,4 (= 'an-abbhito'); — °-kamma-
vācā, f., title of one of the Kammavācās; JRAS
1892 p. 64-66; — °-saññita, mfn., named a°; Vin-vn
3010 (kammaṁ~aṁ); — °âraha, mfn., who is worthy
of or standing for a°; m. ~o, Vin I 49,26; 53,1; 143,26;
II 162,28; 226,26; 230,11; V 205,36; acc ~aṁ upa-
sampādeti, Vin I 326,6; 327,14; V 220,21; instr.
~ena, Vin II 33,26; 35,5; pl. ~ā bhikkhū, Vin II
36,29; °-catuttha, mfn., such a person making a
fourth; m. ~o, Vin I 321,4.

abbhā-matta, n. (or mfn.) [abbhā (abbha 2 b)
+ matta, sa. °mātra], (of) the size of a cloud (so Ctt.
& Tr.; metre does not require abbhā°; Kern p. 54:
ontzaglijk groot = sa. *abhva-mātra!); SN I 205,4*
abbhā-mattahaka-kūṭa-mattaṁ, Spk) = Ja III 309,11* (Ct:
mahāmegha-pamānaṁ hutvā upatthāti) = Th 652
= 1001.

abbhāsa, m. [sa. abhy-āsa], (a) repetition; Sadd
397,20 (sense of √man2, sa. √mnā); — (b) in gram-
mar — reduplication or the syllable of reduplication,
Kacc 461 (= Sadd 826,1), see the rules Kacc 460-477 &
Sadd 826,3-827,25; — -sañña, mfn., called a°; dve-
bhūtassa dhātussa yo pubbo so ~o hoti: dadhāti,
dadāti, babhūva, Kacc-v 461 = Sadd 826,1 = Rūp 447.

abbhāhata, mfn. [sa. abhyāhata, pp. of abhi
+ ā+ √han], struck, overpowered, afflicted, impeded;
Sn 581 (evaṁ ~o loko maccunā ca jarāya ca) ≠
Ja VI 26,11* foll. (+ parivārito) ≠ Th 448 (do.)
= SN I 40,6* ≠ Th 449 (+ parikkhitto); SN I
40,4* (kena ssu 'bbhāhato loko, kena ssu parivārito);
Paṭis I 129,2, quoted Ud-a 143,15 (~o lokasannivāso);
Vism 232,15 (jarāya anusaṭo . . . maraṇena ~o, scil.
sabbo lokasannivāso); n. ~aṁ, Ps (5**) III 696,20
ad MN III 244,19 (jarāya anusaṭaṁ, maraṇena ~aṁ,
abbhāhataṭhavidho lokadhammo, iminā pana ~ā santo na
kampanti na vedhanti); — ifc. v. an-°, ūmivega°
(Ja VI 440,20'), jarā-vātavega° (Dhp-a IV 25,11);
cf. sam-abbhāhata.

abbhita, mfn. (pp. of abbheti (q. v.), on the model
dassita: dasseti, (ud)ita: (ud)eti), called back, re-
admitted, rehabilitated; Vin-vn 538 (bhikkhu pakatatto
pan' ~o, cf. Sp (III) 630,1); — ifc. v. an-°.

a-bbhida, mfn. (cf. next), not to be split or
pierced; Th 614 (sīlaṁ kavacam ~aṁ, v. r. for abbhu-
taṁ; = abhejjaṁ, Th-a).

a-bbhidā, aor. 3 sg. of bhindati, q. v., (Ja I
247,29*; II 163,25* quoted Dhp-a I 144,17*); with
bbh on the pattern of a-cchidă (q. v.), Tr., cf. Franke,
Pāli u. Sanskrit p. 153,25 (suggesting a remnant of
the vedic augment ā(!)).

[abbhibhāsi, v. l. for abbhihāsi, aor. 3 sg. of
abhiharati [for *abbhahāsi, sa. abhy-a-hārsīt], Ja V
169,23*, cf. Tr.Notes p. 79 n. 3].

abbhīrita, mfn. [pp. of abhi+ √īr], pronounced;
(ex. of bbh < bhy) Kacc-v 46 = Sadd 619,11.

abbhu(ṁ), ind. (by emphasis [cf. Sadd 889, n. 8]
with °bbh°) - abhu(ṁ) [by Ctt. taken from a-bhū
abbhuṁp. 201: *ā -f bhuk], interj, expressive of 'aversion' or
'terror'; Vin II 115,6 (abbhuṁ me, pisāco vata maṁ,
'o horror, woe is me, an ogre is after me'; Sp: utrāsa-
vacanam etaṁ) = MN I 448,35 (Ps III 165,3: bhū ti
vaḍḍhi, abhū ti avaḍḍhi, vināso mayhan ti attho);
Ja V 178,11* (abbhuṁ [~—, thus *abhu] me, kathan
nu bhaṇasi, Ee abhumme; = avaḍḍhiṁ, Ct.) ≠ Ja
VI 495,23* (a(b)bhum me, kathan nu bhaṇasi, so Cks,
Bd (with metre) abhu me, Ee abhumme; = abhūtaṁ
[Se abhūtapubbaṁ] vata me katheyyāsi tvaṁ [Ce Lk
gaccheyyāsi, before which Tr. inserts yaṁ], Ct.; quoted
Sadd 84,21 [n. 7] & 207,2); Mp I 442,19 (abbhuṁ me,
anto sappo; Ee abbhumme); — at Ja V 295,14* [re-
touched in Mvu II 481,11* = III 16,19*] abbhu and
its opp. bho are used as subst, n. (~u hi tassa bho
hoti [Ck omits bho], yo anicchantaṁ [Ce ~iṁ] icchati;
Ct.: abbhū ti abhūti, avaḍḍnī ti attho).

abbhu(ṁ), ind. (by emphasis [cf. Sadd 889, n. 8]
with °bbh°) - abhu(ṁ) [by Ctt. taken from a-bhū
abbhuṁp. 201: *ā -f bhuk], interj, expressive of 'aversion' or
'terror'; Vin II 115,6 (abbhuṁ me, pisāco vata maṁ,
'o horror, woe is me, an ogre is after me'; Sp: utrāsa-
vacanam etaṁ) = MN I 448,35 (Ps III 165,3: bhū ti
vaḍḍhi, abhū ti avaḍḍhi, vināso mayhan ti attho);
Ja V 178,11* (abbhuṁ [~—, thus *abhu] me, kathan
nu bhaṇasi, Ee abhumme; = avaḍḍhiṁ, Ct.) ≠ Ja
VI 495,23* (a(b)bhum me, kathan nu bhaṇasi, so Cks,
Bd (with metre) abhu me, Ee abhumme; = abhūtaṁ
[Se abhūtapubbaṁ] vata me katheyyāsi tvaṁ [Ce Lk
gaccheyyāsi, before which Tr. inserts yaṁ], Ct.; quoted
Sadd 84,21 [n. 7] & 207,2); Mp I 442,19 (abbhuṁ me,
anto sappo; Ee abbhumme); — at Ja V 295,14* [re-
touched in Mvu II 481,11* = III 16,19*] abbhu and
its opp. bho are used as subst, n. (~u hi tassa bho
hoti [Ck omits bho], yo anicchantaṁ [Ce ~iṁ] icchati;
Ct.: abbhū ti abhūti, avaḍḍnī ti attho).

abbhukkiraṇa, n. [verbal noun from next; cf.
abbhok(k)iraṇa], sprinkling (with water, also as an act
of consecration); sense of √saj, Sadd 348,18 (vi(s)sagga-
parissaj[j]ana- ~esu); — ifc. v. daṇḍasattha-° (Nidd
I 216,12).

abbhukkirati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *abhy-ut-kirati(√kṙ),
cf. abbhokkirati], to sprinkle, besprinkle; MN III
172,26 (vāmena hatthena bhiṅkāraώ gahetvā dak-
khiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṁ ~ati); Ja VI 205,5'
(udakaṁ gahetvā attano upari sajati ~ati); part.
m. ~anto (pattena udakam ādāya sabbanagaraṁ ~o
anuvicari), Pj I 164,22; aor. 3 sg. ~kkiri (cakkarata-
naṁ), DN II 172,22; hatthena udakaṁ ādāya purat-
abbhukkirati75,7-9 = Mp I 172,19-22; abs. ~itvā (udakena), Ja
II 311,24; Sv (II) 620,23; Ja V 390,1 (pāyāsaṁ).

abbhuggacchati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhy-ud + √gam;
cf. Tr. Notes p. 72-73], (a) to go forth or out, to be
spread abroad (about: acc. pers, or gen.); to rise; dussl-
lassa . . . pāpako kittisaddo ~ati, Vin I 227,26 = DN
II 85,19; AN III 252,17; (with acc. naṁ) Pp 36,15-19;
Sv (II) 521,12 (atha nesaṁ avaṇṇo ~ati); sīlavato . . .
kalyāṇo kittisaddo ~ati, Vin I 228,5 = DN II 86,7;
yāva Brahmalokā saddo ~ati, AN IV 120,2; SN V
284,3 (appakasirena paṭhaviyā vehāsaṁ ~ati, scil.
tūlapicu); — pot. 3 sg. kassa . . . kalyāṇo kittisaddo
~eyya, AN IV 80,24-29; — aor. (a) 3 sg. ~ggañchi
(yāva Brahmalokā saddo), Vin III 19,5 (= abbhut-
ṭhāsi, Sp) = Vin I 12,13 (Ee ~ggacchi) = SN V 424,4
abbhuggacchatikittisaddo); MN I 126,11 (pāpako kittisaddo); Ja I
60,10; Mp (Ee) III 368,24 (Se ~ggacchi, scil. pācīna-
lokadhātuto cando); 3 pl. ~ggañchuṁ (devatāyo
. . . ujjhāyantiyo vehāsaṁ), SN I 24,20; ~ggañchiṁ-
su, Ja I 60,12 (Ee ~ggacchiṁsu); — (β) 3 sg. ~ggam[ī/i]
(nabhaṁ), Ap 380,14 — 517,10 = Thī-a 40,8*; —
fut. 3 sg. (a ) ~ggañchiti (kalyāno kittisaddo), MN I
392,17 = SN IV 323,13 (Ee ~ggacchissati) ≠ AN
IV 80,27 (Ee do.); — (β) ~ggañchati (for °ggañchiti),
DN III 258,15 (Ck; Ee ~ggacchati) = AN IV 236,7
(Ee do.); — abs. ~ggantvā (Bhagavā vehāsaṁ), Vin
I 32,19; DN III 27,13 (do.); As 13,4 (do.); Ja I 88,19
(ākāsaṁ); Dhp-a IV 198,18 (vehāsaṁ); Ud 30,8 (Sakko
. . . vehāsaṁ ~; — abhiuggantvā, Ud-a); — (b) with
acc. = to go to meet (cf. abbhuyyāti); Ja I 93,6; 202,22
(samuddapiṭṭhe yeva ~); — opp. ~ggata (q. v.).

abbhuggata, mfn. (pp. from prec, sa. abhy-ud-
gata); gone forth (out), risen; m. taṁ (about him)
. . . evaṁ kalyāṇo kittisaddo ~o, Vin III 1,13 (Sp I

(abbhokirati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. *abhi + ava +

a-brahma, mfn. [sa. *a-brāhma], not holy,

carantī ti 'abrahmacārī', Ps I 188,2.

a-brahmacariya, n. [3a + sa. brahmacarya],
unchastity, non-celibate; acc. ~aṁ parivajjayeyya, Sn
396; ~aṁ pahāya, DN I 4,9 (= asetthacariyaṁ, Sv);

a-brahmacariya(Pj I 26,11); Pj I 34,3; ~ā paṭivirato, MN II 181,30;

IV 254,19*; — °-va(t), mfn., unchaste; acc. ~van-

gious) life, opp. brahmacariyavāsa; cattāro ~ā, MN
I 514,30-518,36; paṭhamo ~o, ib. 515,35; dutiyo ~o,
ib. 516,28; tatiyo ~o, ib. 517,14; catuttho ~o, ib.
518,32.

a-brahmacāri(n), mfn. (3a + brahmacāri(n)),
not leading a life of chastity; m. ~ī brahmacāri-paṭiñ-
ño, Nidd I 231,20 (= setthacariya-virahito, Nidd-a);
It 42,12; Pp 27,9; 36,11 ';' SN IV 181,1; AN I 108,22;
126,16; II 239,31; IV 201,28; do. gen. ~issa brah-
macāri-paṭiññassa, AN IV 128,25; ~ī (opp. brah-

vacārī +, AN III 145,6; m. pl. ~ī, MN I 42,8 ( =

~ī, Ps).

a-brahmacāri(n), mfn. (3a + brahmacāri(n)),
not leading a life of chastity; m. ~ī brahmacāri-paṭiñ-
ño, Nidd I 231,20 (= setthacariya-virahito, Nidd-a);
It 42,12; Pp 27,9; 36,11 ';' SN IV 181,1; AN I 108,22;
126,16; II 239,31; IV 201,28; do. gen. ~issa brah-
macāri-paṭiññassa, AN IV 128,25; ~ī (opp. brah-
macārī), AN III 347,26 foll. = V 138,2 foll; asappā-
vacārī +, AN III 145,6; m. pl. ~ī, MN I 42,8 ( =
abrahmaṁ hīnaṁ lāmakaṁ dhammaṁ carantī ti
~ī, Ps).

a-brahmañña, mfn. [sa. a-brāhmaṇya], having
no respect for brāhmaṇas; m. ~o (amatteyyo +), AN

(do.); — °-tā, f. abstr., DN III 70,26; 71,8 (amat-
teyyatā +).

a-brāhmaṇa, m. (& f. ~ī) [ts.], α person who is
not a brāhmaṇa; ~o (= na brāhmaṇo), Kacc-v 328;
335; Sn 650 (na jaccā hoti ~o); acc ~aṁ, Sn 457;
pl. ~ā, DN III 81,13 (brāhmaṇā va sujjhanti, no
~ā) = MN II 84,12 = 156,13; acc.pl. ~e kariṁsu,
Ja IV 388,5; — f. ~ī, acc ~iṁ, MN II 156,24-27;
AN III 221,15-16; — — °-karaṇa, mfn., constituting
the state of not being a brāhmana; m. pl. dhammā ~ā,
DN I 246,1.

a-bādha, mfn. [ts.], unobstructed; Abh 717
(= niraggala); [a-bādhatā, misreading in Se for
avāvaṭā, Spk I 52,25 (Ee Ce; = 'anussukā')].

a-bāla-jātika (or °jātiya), mfn. (3a + bāla-
jātika [sa. bāla-jātīya]), not childish (or foolish); pl.
~ā (C-mss. °-jātiyā), SN V 148,19 (+ alolajātikā,
scil. makkaṭā).

a-bāhira, mfn. (3a + bāhira, cf. sa. a-bāhya,

SN V 153,17 (see above an-antara (3)).

a-bāḷha, mfn. (3a [or 2a?] + bāḷha [sa. bādha,

DN III 174,8* (~aṁ [unmetr.] giraṁ so na bhaṇī
pharusaṁ [ madhuraṁ bhaṇī susa[ṁ]hitaṁ sakhilaṁ;
Sv: ettha a-kāro parato bhaṇi-saddena yojetabbo,
bāḷhaṁ balavatiṁ atipharusaṁ giraṁ so na abhaṇī
ti ayaṁ ettha attho; pt: 'a-bāḷhan' ti vā ettha
a-bāḷharusaṁ giran' ti evaṁ attho veditabbo, 'na bhaṇī'

bhaṇī pharusaṁ [ - - | ˇ - ˇ | ˇ ˇ - | ˇ ˇ - || ≠
Pramitākṣarā].

a-bīja, mfn. [ts.], seedless, without germinating
power, or n. no seed; Vin I 215,24 (anujānāmi . . .
~aṁ nibbatta-bījaṁ akatakappaṁ phalaṁ pari-
bhuñjituṁ; Sp: 'abījan' ti taruṇaṁ, yassa bījaṁ na

IV 35,17-19 (bīje ~ī . . . abīje ~ī).

[a-bujjhaka, mfn. (from bujjhati, √budh), im-

jecture by E. Hardy [PED s. v. bujjhaka] for na-
bujjhakā, Dīp IX 17 (luddāni kammāni kurumānā
~ā; Morris (not at the point) JPTS 1893 p. 69 =
a-yujjhakā)].

a-bujjhana, n. (neg. nomen actionis from buj-
jhati), ignorance; instr. ~ena ajānanena, Sv (II)
542,34 (= 'an-anubodhā').

a-bujjhi, aor. 3 sg. of bujjhati; AN IV 449,10*
(v. l. abuddha, bu(d)dhā; = anubujjhi, Mp) = SN

metre in both places abudhā = sa. a-budhat; cf.

a-buddha-vacana, n., not a word of Buddha;
Ps II 286,4 (~aṁ nāma etaṁ padaṁ); Spk II 202,1;
n. pl. ~āni, Sp (IV) 742,31.

a-buddhika, mfn. (3a + buddhi + ka), without
intellect; Mil 76,5 (kim pana Brahmā sa-buddhiko ~o).

a-bodha, mfn. [ts.], ignorant, stupid; acc. m.
~aṁ, Ja V 77,12* (= nippaññaṁ, Ct.).

a-bhakkha, m(fn). (neg. grd. of √bhakkh; sa.
a-bhakṣya), forbidden as food; Ja VI 63,26* (na câpi
me . . . so ~o; = so piṇḍapāto mama ~o nāma
na hoti, Ct.); -— °-sammata, mfn., considered as
a°; °-bhāva, m. abstr., Ja VI 77,9 (attano sarīramaṁ-

a-bhacca, m(fn.) [3a + sa. bhṛtya], not being
servant; m. pl. ~ā (anna-bhaccā +), Ja II 370,13*
(tathā (ɔ: annena) abharitabbattā ~ā, Ct.).

a-bhajanta, mfn. (neg. part. of bhajati), dis-
inclined; ~aṁ na bhājaye, Ja V 233,16* ( = paccat-
thikaṁ, Ct).

a-bhajanā, f. (neg. nomen actionis from √bhaj),
non-association, no intercourse; Pj I 124,23 (= 'a-se-
vanā').

a-bhaṇḍana, n.(3a+bhaṇḍana, √bhaṇḍ), no strife
concord; SN I 224,11 (~aṁ + a-viggaho, a-kalaho).

a-bhaddaka, mfn. [cf. sa. a-bhadra], inauspi-
cious, unlucky; Ap 101,13 (vācaṁ bhāsiṁ ~aṁ);
n. subst., ~aṁ anatthaṁ, Pv-a 116,2 (= 'pāpaṁ');
pāpena ~ena aniṭṭhena [v. l. anatthakena] bādhati,
Pv-a 116,19 (= 'pāpena hiṁsati').a-bhaddaka

a-bhanta, mfn. [sa. a-bhrānta, √bhram], un-

Nidd I 353,12 (an-erito +).

a-bhabba, mfn. [sa. a-bhavya in differeni mean-
ing], (a), unable, incapable (of, inf. or dat.); Sn 231
= Khp VI 10 (cha câbhiṭhānāni ~o kātuṁ); Sn 232
= Khp VI 11 (~o so tassa paṭicchādāya [Fsb. with
metre °cchadāya]); Sn 725 (~ā te antakiriyāya) —
It 106,9*; Dhp 32 (~o parihānāya); Vin III 47,20'
(~o haritattāya, scil. paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pa-
a-bhabba(quoted Ud-a 46,5, Sadd 343,23); Vin I 96,27 (~o tena

3111 (ekādasâbhabbā asamvāsā; cf. 319); Utt-vn 665

abhabba-ṭṭhāna, n. (a) the state of being un-
qualified; Sp (II) 515,16 (aṭṭha [scil. abhabba-pug-
galā] attano kiriyāya vipannattā ~aṁ pattā ti

MN I 523,1-3 s; AN IV 370,2-7; Sn 231 (abhiṭhānāni)[;

abhabba-puggala, m., a person who is un-

abhabbâgamana, mfn. (abhabba + āgamana),
incapable of progress; katamo ca puggalo ~o, Pp 13,7

abhabbâpattika, mfn. (from abhabba + āpatti),
incapable of being guilty of an offence; Utt-vn 433

abhabbâbhāsa, mfn. (abhabba (c) + ābhāsa),
apparently inoperative, or hopeless; MN III 215,15-18

abhabbuppattika, mfn. (from abhabba (α) +

abhabbuppattika

XVII 75; — (4) = Dutthagāmani-Abhaya; Dip
XVIII 18; 23; 32; XIX 23; Mhv XV 172; XXVI 6;
LXXXII 22: Mhbv 132,28; 133,10; As 80,1; Pj II
71,18; — (5) the father of Deva (or Khañjadeva),
Mhv XXIII 78; — (6) = Goṭhâbhaya, Mhv XXII
Abhayakanna, Dīp XVIII 37; XXI 1 (cf. Bhātikâbhaya,

20; — (9) — Amaṇḍagāmaṇī, Dīp XXI 34; Mhv

Vibh-a 275,24; — (3) do. of a Vinaya-teacher, Mahā-

48; 56; — (5) = Cūlâbhaya or Tipitika-Cūlâbhaya,

maṅgala, abhi-rāja(n), abhi-vinaya (in nat. exeg.)
and (with a nuance of sympathy or esthetical appre-
ciation): abhi-nava, °-nalāṭa, °-nīla, °-yobbana, °-rat-
