1 sg., nâ° . . . atimaññittho (sic! Cks; Ee ~ittha), Ja
IV 319,27* (Ct).

abhi-jāyati, pr. 3 sg. [ts., pass, of abhi + √jan],
to be born (or reborn) to (acc), to be fit to be or become
(cf. abhijāti (a), paccājāyati); Sn 214 (yo ogahane
thambho-r-ivâbhijāyati; = thambho-r-iva bhavati.
Pj); DN III 251,1 foll. (kaṇhaṁ (sukkaṁ) dhammaṁ
~; = pasavati, karoti, Sv!) = AN III 384,24 foll.
(= kaṇhasabhāvo hutvā jāyati nibbattati, kaṇ-
hâbhijātiyaṁ vā jāyati, Mp); abs. ~itvā, Sv (III)
1038,4 (so taṁ ~ niraye nibbattati); caus, abhi-janeti
(q. v.); pp. abhi-jāta (q. v.).

abhi-jigiṁsati, pr. 3 sg. (B-reading °jigīs°; desi-
derative of abhijeti, √ji, sa. abhijigīṣati). to wish to
overcome; Ja VI 193,19* (nāgena mamaṁ ~ati; =
yuddhe jinituṁ icchati, Ct.); Th 743 (uccâvaceh'
upāyehi pare yam ~ati; Ee paresam abhijigīsāti; cod.
A (in Tr.s transscript) pare yam ābhijigīsati; Th-a:
paresaṁ abhijigīsatī ti paresaṁ santakaṁ āharituṁ
abhi-jigiṁsati

abhi-jīvati, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + √jīv], to live upon,
subsist by; 3 pl. ~anti, Sp ad Vin I 187,21 (see next).

abhi-jīvanika, mfn. (from abhi + jīvana),
procuring one his livelihood; gen. ~assa sippassa,
Vin I 187,21 (= yena sippena abhijīvanti, jīvitaṁ
kappenti, Sp).

abhi-jīhanā, f. (nomen actionis from abhi +
sa. √jeh prayatne), striving after, exertion, strong
effort; Ja VI 373,16* (kālañ ca ñatvā ~āya; = viriya-
karaṇassa, Ct.).

abhi-jeti, (with rhythm, length, ābhi-jeti; cf. abhi-
vi-jeti), pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √ji], to win, acquire,
conquer; Ja VI 273,3* (ko n'īdha raññaṁ [Cks raññā]
varam abhijeti; = ahaṁ jinām[ī/i]ti vattuṁ ussahati,
Ct.); pot. 1 pl. kam ābhijeyyāma varaṁ-dhanena, ib.
4* (kaṁ vā mayaṁ jineyyāma, Ct.); — desiderative
abhi-jigiṁsati (q. v.).abhi-jeti

abhi-jotayati, pr. 3 sg. [caus. of sa. *abhi +-
dyotayati, √dyut], to cause to shine (or to be seen);
pot. 3 & 2 sg. ~aye, Ja V 339,25* (sañcajaṁ pāṇaṁ
kam atthaṁ ~; = pāṇaṁ sañcajanto kaṁ atthaṁ
joteyyāsi, Ct.) ≠ Jāt-m 134,9*.

abhiñña, mfn. [sa. abhi-jña], knowing, possessed
of higher knowledge (abhiññā, q. v.); Abh 720; —
in adj.-cpds., see abhiññā ifc. [cf. Abhidh-av 34,26:
~āni sabbāni, prob, to be read with v. l. viññāṇāni].

abhiññaṭṭha, m. (abhiññā + 1aṭṭha), the sense of
abhiññā; Paṭis I 173,31 (~o yathattho); II 156,27-28
(abhiññāya . . . paññāya ~o).

abhiññatara, mfn. (compar. of abhiñña), wiser,
more intelligent; DN II 82,5 (bhiyyo 'bhiññataro)
= III 99,10 (Sv (III) 878,19: bhiyyataro abhiññāto,
bhiyyatarâbhiñño [so Se, Ee bhiyyataro 'bhiñño] vā,
uttaritara-ñāṇo ti attho) = SN V 159,9 (Spk = Sv).abhiññatara

abhiññatṭha, mfn. (abhiññā + 2attha), useful
(or indispensable) for abhiññā; f. ~ā, MN I 293,37
(paññā ~ā + pariññatthā pahānatthā); acc. n. ~aṁ
(adv.: 'for the sake of ~), It 29,11-14* (+ pariññat-
thaṁ, scil. brahmacariyaṁ vussati (adesayi); It-a).

abhiñña-ppatta, mfn. [sa. abhijñā + prāpta],
that has attained to abhiññā; instr. ~āya ekāya
rūpâvacara-kiriyāya, As 323,32.

abhiññā, f. [sa. abhi-jñā, verbal noun of abhijā-
nāti (1)], 1. 'higher or supernatural knowledge'', intui-
tion; (cf. S. Lindquist, Siddhi und abhiññā, Uppsala
1935 & Vism 373-435; Abhidh-av 104-111; Abhidh-s-
abhiññātāva pavattā paññā ~ā ti vuccati, As 182,34 (cf.
183,3) = Vism 86,34 (cf. 87,1); ~ā + pariññā, pahā-
nam, bhāvanā, sacchikiriyā, Nett 19,34-20,3; acc.
~aṁ uppādentassa, Vibh 324,26; dat. ~āya, frequent
in the phrase: (ekanta-)nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya
upasamāya ~āya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṁvattati
(or saṁvattanti), sometimes preceded by the same
phrase in neg. form, DN I 189,(i)-14; II 285,18; III
131,17; 137,1; MN I 431,34; 1182,29; III 113,27;
SN II 223,21; V 179,17-25; 255,19; 361,23; 438,17;
AN I 30,6; V 217,26; 238,20; Ud 36,13; do. na
nibbidāya, etc, samvattati, AN III 325,29 foll.;
do. in the phrase upasamāya ~āya sambodhāya
nibbānāya saṁvattati, Vin I 10,16; MN III 230,14;
SN IV 331,9; V 80,1; 81,13 (quoted Ud-a 61,1); 421,9
(Spk); do. ~āya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṁvattati,
Vibh 228,4 foll.; — rāgassa, etc. . . . ~āya pariññāya
parikkhayāya, etc. . . . dve dhammā bhāvetabbā
(scil. samatho ca vipassanā ca), AN I 100,1 ≠
SN V 241,1 (imesaṁ [pañcannaṁ uddhambhāgiyā-
naṁ saṁvojanānaṁ] . . . ~āya, scil. pañc' indriyāni
bhāvetabbāni) ≠ 247,23; 251,1; 292,15; SN V 247,1
(imāsaṁ . . . esanānaṁ ~āya, etc); °atthāya, Saddh
470; gen. ~āya, Paṭis II 156,27-30; loc. uppannāya
~āya, Vibh 324,28; pl. ~āyo, Vism 371,28; instr.pl.
~āhi, Dhp-a II 49,6; gen.pl. ~ānaṁ, Abhidh-av
91,29*; — the five supernatural faculties (pañcâbhiññā)
viz. iddhi-vidhā (or °vidhaṁ), dibba-sotaṁ, para-
citta-vijānanā, pubbenivāsânussati, dibba-cakkhu
[this last in Vibh 334,13 given as sattānaṁ cutû-
papāte ñāṇaṁ], see Abhidh-s 43,23-25* (cf. Paṭis I
111—115);' SN II 216,32-222,5 (pañcannam ~ānam
evaṁ peyyālo); Mil 221,15 (pañcâbhiññāyo nibbat-
tetvā brahmalokûpago ahosi); cf. DN Trsl. I p. 59; —
the six abhiññās (cha ~ā) are = pañcâbhiññā with
addition of āsavānaṁ khaye ñānaṁ, see Vibh 334,11
foll. (cf. SN II 121,14 foll. ≠. 126,10 foll.; SN Trsl, by
Geiger II p. 165—66); cha me ~ā sacchikatā, Thī 71
= 228 = 233 ≠ 516; DN III 281,13; SN II 217,19
= 222,10; Dhp-a IV 30,14; Sās 73,13; Vism 5,13
(~ pāpuṇāti); Paṭis I 35,1; cha ~āyo vitthăre-
tabbā [sicl], SN V 282,10; acc. pl. aññe ~ā appenti,
Ap 3,6; instr, chahi ~āhi samannāgato puggalo chaḷ-
abhiñño, Pp 14,10; chahi ~āhi saddhim arahattaṁ
pāpuṇi, Sās 54,1; gen. channaṁ ~ānaṁ, Nidd I 143,17
(= iddhividhâdīnaṁ, Nidd-a); loc. chasu ~āsu va-
sībhāvaṁ pāpuṇāti, Mil 214,18; 264,1; — sattâ-
bhiññā, pl. = cha abhiññā + anāgataṁsa-ñāṇa:
Abhidh-av 108,4*; gen. sattannaṁ ~ānaṁ, ib. 5*;
111,29* (cf. Vism 429,26: satta abhiññā-ñāṇāni) —
ifc v. āsavakkhayâ° (Ps I 164,14), kriyâ° (Abhidh-av
45,28*), chal-° (Mil 359,1; 369,18), jhānâ° (Ja III
396,31; 450,18), pañcâ° (see above), magga-phala-
vijjâ° (Pj II 110,30), maggâ° (Abhidh-s 19,26*),
muṇḍâ°-kathā (Ps I 164,17), rūpârūpabhavâ°
(Saddh 228), lokikâ° (Dhp-a I 292,7; Vism 373,7-23),
lokiya-pañcâ° (Ps I 164,15); sabbâbhiññā-bala-
ppatta (mfn. Ap 322,10); do. in adj. cpd.s, v. adhi-
gatâ°, khippâ°, (AN II 149,10; Nett 7,17), chal-° (Vin
III 88,1), dandhâ° (AN II 149,9; Nett 7,16), pañcâ°
(Pj II 421,3), bhiyyatarâ° (Sv (III) 878,19), mahâ°
(SN II 139,18), sâ° (Mhv LII 38; Abhidh-av 104,9*).
— 2. common apprehension or opinion; only ifc. v.
yathâbhiññaṁ (ind. Ja V 365,10* = yathāruciṁ,
Ct., cf. sa. yathâbhijñāyaṁ), —3. mark, name, ap-
pellation (cf. abhiññāṇa); only ifc. v. kimabhiñña,
mfn. (Ja VI 126,3*).

abhiññā-kathā, f., discourse on abhiññā (iddhi-
vidhā, etc); acc. ~aṁ (ārabhissāma), Vism 373,13
(cf. Ps I 164,17).

abhiññā-kusala, n., "the moral consciousness
belonging to super-intellection"; Abhidh-s 14,13 (pañ-
cama-jhāna-saṁkhātaṁ ~aṁ).

abhiññā-cakkhu, n. = dibba-cakkhu (q. v.),
the fiṭth of the five abhiññā (see above); Ud-a 73,14
ad Ud 6,5 (Ee abhiñña-cakkhuṁ).

abhiññā-citta, n., the mind intent on abhiññā;
~aṁ ca puññato, Abhidh-av 45,29; instr. ~ena, As
323,30; Ps II 411,1; — °-ja, mfn., produced by that;
f. ~ā paññā dibba-cakkhū ti vuccati, Abhidh-av
65,19*; cf. abhiññā-mānasa, °-hadaya.

abhiññā-javana, n., alertness or full perception
by abhiññā; pl. mahaggata-javanāni ~āni ca sabbadā
pi ekavāram eva javanti, Abhidh-s 19,16 (Trsl. 133,2).

abhiññā-ñāṇa, n. [sa. abhijñā + jñāna],
knowledge by abhiññā; instr, [pañcâbhiññā-ñāṇena,
Nidd I 328,10; loc. do. ~e, Nidd I 108,5]; gen.pl.
channaṁ ~ānaṁ, Paṭis II 189,33; satta ~āni, Vism
429,26 ≠ Abhidh-av 108,4-5*.

abhiññāṇa, n. [sa. abhijñāna], mark, sign;
means of identifying or recognizing; Abh 55; Ja VI
339,33' (~ena); ib. 39' (~ehi); ~ena passitabbaṁ
passāmi, It-a (Ee) I 76,24; ~āṇaṁ katvā . . . tena
~ena, etc, As 110,24 (cf. paccabhiññāṇa); — ifc. v.
kathâ° (Mil 78,17; 79,21).

abhiññāta, mfn. (pp. of abhi-jānāti), 1. known,
understood; n. abhiññeyyaṁ ~aṁ, Sn 558 = Th 828
= MN II 143,29* (quoted Ud-a 84,29*; Vism 201,32*);
do. Nidd I 21,3 (= adhikena ñāṇena ñātaṁ, Nidd-a);
— 2. celebrated, famous, notable, distinguished; Abh
724; m. ayaṁ kumāro ~o ñātamanusso, Vin II 159,12;
~o abhilakkhito, Ps II 380,15; evaṁ ~o, Ud-a
307,8; gen. ~assa brāhmaṇassa, DN I 89,25 (= rūpa-
abhiññātakatā+), Ud-a 260,2; f. pl. rattiyo ~ā abhilakkhitā,
MN I 20,28 (Ps), quoted As 20,4 = Sv I 18,15 ≠ Pj
I 114,1 (reading abhikkantā for abhiññātā); — the
pl. repeated in distrib. sense (mostly preceded by sam-
bahulā): DN I 235,9 (= tattha tattha kula-cārittâdi-
sampattiyā paññātā, Sv); Vin I 43,7; MN I 462,29;
II 1,4; AN II 29,24 — 176,9; instr. ~ehi ~ehi, MN
I 212,3; gen. ~ānaṁ ~ānaṁ, Vin I 73,26; — °-ko-
lañña, mfn. [kolañña, sa. kaulīnya; see Sadd 791 n
d, etc), of distinguished family; m. ~o, DN I 89,25
(= pākaṭakula-ja, Sv).

abhiññā-dvaya, n., the twofold abhiññā (q. v.
1—2); Abhidh-av 44,33*; — °-citta, n., ib. 47,5*.

Abhiññā-niddesa, m., title of Abhidh-av
104—107 (exposition of the five supernatural facul-
ties); do. of Vism 407—435.

abhiññânisamsa, mfn. (from abhiññā +
ānisaṁsa), 'bringing higher knowledge as reward';
f. ~ā (scil. samādhibhāvanā), Vism 371,30; 373,8.

Abhiññânuyoga, m. (abhiññā + anuyoga),
question about abhiññā; title of Kv 55,27—56,23 (Trsl,
p. 50—51).

abhiññā-paññatti, f. [cf. sa. prajñapti], Nett
61,2 (~i sabbadhammānaṁ, an expression for (Ms)
intuitive knowledge of all dharmas; + nikkhepa-pañ-
ñatti dhamma-paṭisambhidāya).

abhiññā-paññā, f., intuitive knowledge; + pa-
riññā-paññā, etc., Paṭis I 87,16 (kathaṁ ~ ñātaṭṭhe
ñāṇaṁ).

abhiññā-paṭipāṭi, f. [cf. sa. pari-pāṭi], the re-
lative order or succession of the abhiññās; Mp (Se)
III 351,7 ad AN IV 421,11 (khīṇâsavassa ~iṁ dassento
'yassa yassa cā' ti ādim āha).

abhiññā-padaṭṭhāna, n., 'the proximate cause
of higher knowledge'; °-tta, n. abstr., Vism 371,29
(abl. ~ā).

abhiññā-pariññeyya, mfn., (or two words: a-
bhiññā. instr, or abs. + pariññeya), to be comprehended
by higher knowledge; n. ~aṁ (sabbaṁ), SN IV 29,10
(also title of the sutta ib.).

abhiññā-pādaka, (mf)n. (abhiññā + pādaka),
(serving as) a basis of the abhiññās; ~aṁ jhānaṁ samā-
pajjitvā (ɔ: in preparing for performance of a miracle),
Ps II 411,1-27; III 76,12; Dhp-a III 202,14; Vism
371,26; Ja I 88,18 (°-jjhānaṁ); ~aṁ catuttha-
jjhānaṁ samāpajjitvā, Sp I 59,7 (= abhiññāya
patiṭṭhā-bhūtaṁ, Sp-ṭ); Mp II 303,30; Vv-a 4,7;
abhiññā-pādakakaṁ, nirodha-pādakaṁ na hoti); °-jjhānaṁ,
Abhidh-av 104,21* foll.; loc. ~e jhāne, Ps I 161,32;
n. pl. °-jjhānāni, ib. 34; °-pañcama-jjhānā vuṭṭha-
hitvā, Abhidh-s 43,21.

abhiññā-pāragū, mfn. [cf. sa. pāraga], who has
attained perfection through the abhiññās; m. ~ū, Nidd
I 20,17 foll. (= adhigatena ñāṇena ñātapariññāya
nibbāna-pāraṁ gantukāmo, gacchati, gato ti pāragū,
Nidd-a); Dhp-a IV 140,12 (°-pāragâdivasena ayaṁ
khīṇâsavo pāragū hoti).

abhiññā-pāramī, f. [cf. Buddh.sa. pāramī],
perfection in the abhiññās; acc ~iṁ gantvā brahma-
lokaṁ agacchiahaṁ, Ap 23,30 = Th-a (O) II 103,1*;
— °[ī/i]-(p)patta, mfn. perfect in abhiññās; m. ~o, Th
1262 (channam pi abhiññānaṁ pāramiṁ ukkaṁsaṁ
adhigato, Th-a); pl. ~ā, Ap 18,1 (= Th-a (ɔ» II
97,21*) ≠ 369,1*.

abhiññā-pāripūrī, f. [cf. Buddh.sa. pāripūrī],
= prec; acc ~iṁ, Ps 1164,18; 113,5.

abhiññā-bala, n., the power of the abhiññās;
Bv II 30 (quoted Ja I 6,27*); — °-(p)patta, mfn.,
possessed of that; Bv VIII 11 (gen. pl. ~ānaṁ ˇ - - ˇ
ˇ - - - ; Bv-a); °-pāraga, mfn., perfect inthat; Mhv
XIX 20 (Saṁghamittā mahātherī ~ā; Mhv-ṭ).abhiññā-bala

abhiññā-mānasa, n., the mind intent on abhiñ-
ñā (cf. abhiññācitta); Abhidh-av 32,22*; pl. ~ā dve,
ib. 45,9* (cf. ib. 33,8*: °-dvayaṁ).

abhiññā-lābhi(n), mfn., possessed of the super-
natural faculties; m. ~ī, Sās 51,24; 86,14; in cpd. ~i-
abhiññā-lābhin— ifc. v. lokiya-jjhānâ° (Sās 47,30).

abhiññā-lābhi(n), mfn., possessed of the super-
natural faculties; m. ~ī, Sās 51,24; 86,14; in cpd. ~i-
abhiññā-lābhin— ifc. v. lokiya-jjhānâ° (Sās 47,30).

abhiññā-vasi-bhāvita, mfn. (cf. vasī + bhā-
vita), who has developed (full) mastery of the abhiñ-
ñās; pl. ~ā, Ap 3,6 (aññe abhiññā appenti ~ā).

abhiññā-vosāna-pārami-ppatta, mfn. (cf. vo-
sāna, n. [from sa. vi-ava + √so] + pāramī, f.),
who has reached full accomplishment (emancipa-
tion) through a°; m. ~o, AN III 9,14 (= abhijānitvā
vosāna-pāramiṁ . . . katakiccabhāva-pāraṁ patto,
abhiññā-vosāna-pārami-ppatta= abhiññā-vosāna-saṁkhātañ c'eva abhiññā-pāramī-
saṁkhātañ ca arahattaṁ pattā, Ps); — ifc. v.
diṭṭha-dhammâ°, mfn., who has attained that in
this life; m. ~o, MN II 211,3 (— imasmiñ ñeva
attabhāve abhijānitvā vosita-vosānā hutvā pārami-
saṁkhāta-sabbadhammānaṁ pāra[mī]-bhūtaṁ nibbā-
naṁ pattā, Ps).

abhiññā-vosita, mfn. (or in two words: abhiññā
(abs., see next) + vosita (q. v., pp. of sa. vi + ava
+ √so)), perfect (emancipated) through a°; jātikkhayaṁ
patto ~o muni, MN II 144,19* (Ps: arahattaṁ abhi-
jānitvā vosito vosāna-ppatto) = SN I 167,2* (= jā-
nitvā vosita-vosāno, Spk) — 175,24* (Spk) = AN I
165,30* (= jānitvā kicca-vosānena vosito, Mp) =
Dhp 423 (Dhp-a) = Thī 64 (Thī-a) = It 100,24* =
Ap 584,1 = Thī-a 73,25*; ~o santo sa ve yogâtigo
muni, It 47,19* (It-a) = 61,15* = 81,10*.

abhiññā-sacchikaraṇīya, mfn. (also printed
as two words, cf. abhiññā-pariññeyya above), realizable
bij higher knowledge; gen. in the phrase: yassa yassa
~assa dhammassa cittaṁ abhininn[ā/a]meti abhiññā-
sacchikiriyāya, etc, MN III 96,17 (Ps: 'abhiññāya
sacchikaraṇīyassa' = abhiññāya sacchikātabbassa)
= AN I 254,32 = 258,13 = III 17,2 = 28,10,22 =
IV 421,11 (quoted Vism 371,31); gen. pl. ~ānaṁ dham-
mānaṁ, Vism 378,1; loc.pl. ~esu dhammesu, SN III
232,12 foll. ( = paccavekkhaṇa-ñāṇena abhijānitvā
sacchikātabbesu chaḷabhiññā-dhammesu, Spk).

abhiññā-samāpatti-lābhi(n), mfn., possessed
of the abhiññās and of the samāpattis; m. pl. ~ino
abhiññā-samāpatti-lābhin

abhiññā-samāpatti-lābhi(n), mfn., possessed
of the abhiññās and of the samāpattis; m. pl. ~ino
abhiññā-samāpatti-lābhin

abhiññeyya, mfn. (grd.of abhijānāti), to be known
or understood; m. ~o, DN III 273,11-1.2 (eko dhammo;
= ñāta-pariññāya abhijānitabbo, Sv) ≠ Paṭis I
5,5 foll.; acc ~aṁ dhammaṁ abhijānitvā, Dhp-a
IV 233,16; n. ~aṁ (sabbaṁ), SN IV 29,2 (also title
abhiññeyyataṁ, Sn 558 (Pj) = Th 828 = MN II 143,29* (quoted
Ud-a 84,29*; Vism 201,32*); Nidd I 21,3 (Nidd-a);
m. pl., katame cha dhammā ~ā, DN III 281,9-12;
[kathaṁ . . . Gotamassa dhammā ~ā, SN IV 399,15
(C-mss. better dhammo aññeyyo)]; acc pl. ~e dhamme
abhijānati, Mil 69,19; — °-niddesa, m., according to
Vism 608,32 title of Paṭis I 5,14 foll. (cf. SN IV 29,1).

abhi-ṭhāna, n. (from abhi + √sthā), trans-
gression, misdeed, crime, esp. one of the six deadly
sins (cf. pañcânantariya-kammāni), viz. mātu-ghāta,
pitu-ghāta, arahanta-ghāta, lohituppāda, saṁgha-
abhi-ṭhānaAN I 27,13-37); Sn 231 = Khp VI 10 (cha câbhiṭhā-
nāni abhabbo kātuṁ, quoted Kv 109,9*; Pj: abhiṭhā-
nānī ti oḷārikaṭṭhānāni, tāni esa cha(!) abhabbo kātuṁ).

abhi-nata or abhi-ṇata, mfn. (pp. of abhi +
√nam; sa. abhi-nata), bent towards (with sympathy); n.
~aṁ, SN I 28,31. (samādhi(ṁ) subhāvitaṁ cittaṁ ca

āha ~assa, attham assa na so 'dhigā, Mhv XXXVII
221; loc. ~e suppaṭipanno (duppaṭipanno), As 24,7
(26); Suttante vā ~e vā, Mil 12,17; piṭake ~asmiṁ,
Abhidh-av 15,5* (split cpd.); piṭake '~e, ib. 78,29*;
~e ca kasmā appamaññā ti vuttā (scil. catasso
brahma-vihārā), Vism 320,29 (see Vibh 272—276);
— A° quoted, loc. ~e: Ud-a 21,30 (from Dhs 1 (p. 9,2;
As 57,5)); Ud-a 92,28 (alluding to Kv 361,6—366,25);
176,28 (fromDhs 1448; As 427,1 e-19)≠Sv(III)989,10;
Sv (II) 642,10 (~e Uttara-cūlika-vāro nāma āgato, ɔ:
Vibh 223,18 foll. ? cf. Vibh-a 308,7); Sv (III) 978,14
(ɔ: Dhs 1013; As 392,30); 981,2 (from Dhs 1339;
As 395,26); 988,14 (ɔ: Vibh 365,13 foll.); ~e nippa-
riyāyena . . . vuttaṁ, Ps I 112,16 (ɔ: Vibh 251,17, cf.
Vibh-a 366,29-30); Ps II 28,31 (from Vibh 335,35);
29,18 (from Vibh 339,8); ~e patisedhitaṁ, Ps ad MN
III 179,12 (alluding to Kv ch. XX 3); Vism 441,11-2 8
(from Vibh 293,10 foll.); 472,17-25 (from Vibh 1,9
foll.); 658,21-24 (from Dhs 510).

Abhidhamma-atthasālinī-atthayojanā, f.,
title of a work on Abhidhamma (no doubt = Attha-
sālinī-atthayojanā); edited by K. Paññasekhara; Ka-
ṭaluwa 1890 (see JPTS 1910—12 p. 135,31).

Abhidhamma-anuṭīkā, f., a sub-commentary
on the mūlaṭīkā on Abhidhamma, written by Dham-
mapāla, with the title Līnatthavaṇṇanā; Gv 60,16;
Sās 33,26; Piṭ-sm §247; cf. M. Bode, Pāli Litera-
ture of Burma, p. 102,17.

abhidhamma-kathā, f., (a) discourse on dham-
mas, or (b) [later] on Abhidhamma; acc. ~aṁ kathenti
(paron.), MN I 214,24; 218,12, quoted As 29,1; ~aṁ
vedalla-kathaṁ kathentā, AN III 107,4 (= (sīlâdi-)
uttama-dhamma-kathaṁ, Mp); ~aṁkathentānaṁ, AN
III 392,30 (= abhidhamma-missakaṁ kathaṁ, Mp);
(b) ~aṁ kathesi, Dhp-a I 299,15; III 326,12 (do. +
~ā nāma atisaṇhā; cf. ib. 29); instr. ~āya (gambhī-
abhidhamma-kathāka-mūle . . . devānaṁ ~aṁ kathesi, Ja IV 265,19 ≠
As 31,15 = 35,35 ≠ Vism 391,5 (~aṁ ārabhi); As
2,11* = 36,1*; — °-magga, m., id., As 1,12* (mṭ adloc.
quoted Sadd 525,11). — Cf. abhidhamma-saṁyutta.

Abhidhamma-gaṇṭhi, m. (also written °-gaṇ-
dhi; cf. sa. granthi), name of a ganthi-pada on A°;
Gv 62,32; 72,17.

Abhidhamma-gata, mfn., occurring in or
belonging to A°; m. pl. ~ā (atthā), Abhidh-av 35,11*.

Abhidhamma-gantha, m., pl. the (7) books of
A°; Gv 59,25; 60,13.

Abhidhamma-gūḷhatthadīpanī, (or only Gūḷhat-
thadīpanī), f., title of a work on A°; Ms. in the
Mandalay Collection, see JPTS 1896 p. 35 No. 119.

Abhidhammaṭṭhakathā, f. (abhidhamma +
aṭṭhakathā), the Ct. on A° (Bu's Atthasālinī, or olderl);
gen. ~āya, Gv 60,15; loc. ~āyaṁ, Vism 547,11.

Abhidhamma-ṭīkā, f., a sub-commentary on A°
by Ānanda-thera, generally styled mūla-tīkā; Pit-sm
§246; Sās 33,16-17; loc. ~āyaṁ, Sadd 525,9; Sās 48,8
mentions a sub-ṭīkā Madhura-sāratthadīpanī by Ananda
of Haṁsavatī.

Abhidhamma-tanti, f. (cf. sa. tantrī), the cano-
nical textof A°; ~i(ṁ; paccavekkhantānam, As 11,34.

Abhidhammatthagaṇṭhipada, n., title of a
treatise by Mahākassapa about "difficult terms in the
Abhidhamma"; see JPTS 1910—12 p. 122,24 &
Geiger p. 32,23.

[Abhidhammatthadīpanī, f., said to be a com-
mentary on Itivuttaka; see Childers s. v. aṭṭhakathā;
edition projected JPTS 1920—23 p. 34,1; the correci
title is Paramattha-dīpanī; see It-a (Ee) I note p. IV].

Abhidhammatthavikāsinī, (or Abhidhamma-
vikāsinī), f., title of a commentary (ṭīkā) by Sumaṅgala
on Abhidh-av; Gv 62,19; Ms. in the Colombo Museum
(see JPTS 1882 p. 50,1; cf. ib. 1910—12 p. 124,21).Abhidhammatthavikāsinī

Abhidhammatthavibhāvanī, (or ~inī), or Abhi-
dhammavibhāvanī (or ~inī), f., title of a commentary
(tīkā) by Sumaṅgala on Abhidh-s (Abhidh-s-ṭ); Gv
62,20; Pit-sm § 306; Sās 96,20; 97,3 (its Ct. the Maṇi-
sāramañjūsā); Sandes 28,28; see Abhidh-s Trsl. p. IX
(Tīkā kyo2); cf. the Pagan inscription mentioned by
M. Bode, Pāli Literature of Burma p. 102 No. 37;
Edd.: Colombo 1898; Bangkok 1922 (together with
Abhidhammatthavibhāvanīib.

Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha (or Abhidhamma-
saṅgaha, q. v.), m., title of a work on Abhidhamma by
Anuruddha (4); Gv 61,25 (°-pakaraṇa); 71,1; Piṭ-sm
§280; Sandes 28,27; Buddhadatta's Introd. to Nā-
mar-p 3,11-14; Sās 34,1; 77,20 (°-pakaraṇa); 111,25;
121,21 (°-pakaraṇa; a gaṇṭhipada thereon by Nāṇa-
vara); — Edd.: Abhidh-s ed. by T. W. Rhys Davids,
JPTS 1884 p. 1—48; by H. Devamitta, Colombo
1888 (2. ed. ib. 1909); (°-pakaraṇa) ed. by Paññā-
nanda, ib. 1898 (also printed in Burma, see Nā-
AbhidhammatthasaṅgahaBangoon 1922; Trsl, by Shwe Zan Aung, revised and
ed. by C. Rhys Davids, London 1910 ('Comp,
of Phii:; PTS's Trsl. Series vol. 2); — Mss.: in the
Mandalay Collection of the India Office (see JPTS
1896 p. 46,16); three Burmese Mss. in the India Office
Library (see JPTS 1882 p. 83, Nos. 50—51—52); in
the Cambridge University Library (Burmese; see
JPTS 1883 p. 145,15); in the British Museum seven
Burmese Mss. (see ib. 141,16 foll.; in the Colombo
Museum (Sinhalese; see JPTS 1882 p. 50,2); —
nava-ṭīkā thereon Saṁkhepa-vaṇṇanā by Saddhamma-
jotipāla (Chapaṭa), Gv 64,2]. (cf. ib. 74,14); other
ṭīkās see below and JPTS 1910—12 p. 124,26—126,6
(the five ṭīkās);— — °-aṭṭhakathā, f. commentary on
Abhidh-s; in the Pagan inscription (see M. Bode,
Pāli Lit. in Burma_ p. 102 No. 35); — °-gantha, m.,
the text of A°; gen ~assa atthayojanaṁ, Sās 126,31;
pl. ~ā, ancillary works to Abhidh-s, Dhammārāma's
Introd. to Nāmar-s 2,5; — °-gandhi (?), see Abhidh-s
Trsl. p. X; — °-ṭīkā, f. (1) porāṇa-ṭīkă by Na-
vavimala, Piṭ-sm § 305; — (2) = Abhidhammat-
thavibhāvinī (q. v.); Ms. in the Mandalay Coll. (see
JPTS 1896 p. 38,19); do. with Burmese interpretation
in the British Museum (see JPTS 1883 p. 142,1);
(3) ~āya anuṭīkā (= Paramatthamañjūsā by Ve-
pullabuddhi or Vimalabuddhi), Gv 64,29 (cf. JPTS
1908 p. 95,3); (4) ~āya navânuṭīkā (= Maṇisāra-
mañjūsā by Ariyavaṁsa), Gv 65,1 (cf. 75,5); — °-ṭīkā-
vivaraṇa n., Gv 65,25; 75,21; — °-dīpanī, f.,
Piṭ-sm § 308; Ms. in the Mandalay Coll. India Office
(see JPTS 1896 p. 38,15). see °-sarūpa-dīpanī below;
— °-pakaraṇa, n. = Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha
(above); — °-paritta, n., a modern work on A° by
Maung Tun Aung (1897), see M. Bode, Pāli Lit. in
Burma p. 95,30; — °-madhu (n.), see Abhidh-s Trsl.
p. X; — °-vaṇṇanā, f., by Saddhammajotipāla; Gv
74,10 (cf. JPTS 1883 p. 145 note 1); — °-vivaraṇa,
n., Gv 65,22; 75,19; — °-samkhepa-vaṇṇanā, f.,
by Saddhammajotipāla (cf. °-vaṇṇanā above); Ed.
Colombo 1889; Ms. in the Mandalay Coll. India
Office (see JPTS 1896 p. 39,6), and in India Office
Library (see JPTS 1882 p. 85 No. 54; cf. Gv 74,14);
— °-sarūpa-dīpanī, f., and °-sarūpa-dīpaka, m.,
Burmese works on Abhidh-s, see Trsl. p. X.

abhidhamma-desanā, f., the preaching of A°;
Dhp-a III 219,4 (°atthāya Paṇḍukambalasilāyaṁ
vassaṁ upagataṁ); Mil 350,3 (Paṇdukambalasilāyaṁ
~āya); cf. abhidhamma-kathā (b) above; — °-pa-
riyosāna, n., the end of that, As 17,10.

abhidhamma-naya, m., the method of A°;
instr. ~ena cattāro āsavā veditabbā, Ud-a 177,4;
loc. ~e durāsade, Abhidh-av 28,9*; — °-ññū, mfn.,
conversant with that; m. ~ū 'haṁ kathāvatthuvi-
suddhiyā, Ap 37,1 (so Ce, Ee ~o) = Th-a (Ce) 38,14*;
f. ~ū, Ap 550,22 = Thī-a 135,12*; — °-samudda,
m., the ocean of A°; As 35,2 (~aṁ adhigañchi).

Abhidhamma-niddesa, m. [cf. sa. nirdeça],
detailed exposition from the A°; Vibh-a 7,18-26-35
~ato, opp. Suttanta-pariyāyato).

Abhidhamma-paṇṇarasaṭṭhāna, n., title of
a work by Nava(or Culla)-vimalabuddhi, explaining
some passages of the A°; Gv 64,25.

Abhidhamma-pada, n., a word or passage from
A°; pl. ~āni, Mil 17,18-21.

Abhidhamma-paramattha-vibhāga, m., title
of the f[ī/i]rst section of Nāmar-p (p. 1—55 = ch. I—VII,
vv. 1—878).

abhidhamma-paricaya, m., reflecting on (synon.
sammasana), going through the A°; Ud-a 51,1 (Rata-
nagharasattâhe [cf.As 13,11-15; Ja I 78,3-6; Ud-a
52,14] . . . °vasen'eva vihāsi).

abhidhamma-pariyāya, m., the form of expo-
sition peculiar to A° (opp. Suttanta-pariyāya; cf. A°-
niddesa); m. ~o, Sv (III) 991,22-25; ib. 883,33 (~aṁ
patvā, opp. Jātaka-p°, Suttanta-p°); instr. ~ena ani-
mitta-maggo nāma n'atthi, As 224,22 (cf. Vism 669,6);
Vibh-a 138,31 (~ena pubbante aññāṇan ti [Dhs 1061]
pi catūsu ṭhānesu aññāṇaṁ gahitaṁ; cf. ib. 139,18 ≠
abhidhamma-pariyāyasetuṁ) ≠ Vism 72,13.

Abhidhamma-ppakaraṇa, n., one of the books
of the A°; Tikap-a 366,8* (sattamaṁ ~aṁ; = Paṭ-
ṭhāna); [Dīp V 37, read with Kv-a 3,26*: Abhidham-
maṁ cha-ppakaraṇaṁ].

Abhidhamma-pāḷī, f., the text of A°; Ps I
222,13 (~iyam eva vuttaṁ [Ee Abhidhamme pāliyaṁ],
scit. Dhs 597—600).

Abhidhamma-piṭaka, n., (see abhidhamma (b))
the third of the three main divisions of the Buddhist
canonical books, containing seven works on the dham-
mas, viz. (in the canonical order) Dhammasaṅgaṇi,
(or Dhammasaṅgaha), Vibhaṅga, Dhātukathā (-paka-
raṇa), Puggala-paññatti, Kathāvatthu, Yamaka, Paṭ-
Abhidhamma-piṭakaSp I 18,17-18 (in different order [metri causal], Sv I
15,15*, quoted Mhbv 94,20*); Ud-a 4,11 (Vinaya-pita-
kaṁ +); As 18,18 & 27,21 (do.); Vibh-a 431,9 (do.);
— Gv 5.5,28; Sv I 15,18; 17,16; — Sp I 21,24 (para-
mattha-desanā ti vuccati) — Sv I 20,3; loc. ~e
adhipaññă-sikkhā, Sv I 19,37; ~e anusaya-ppahānaṁ
anusaya-paṭipakkhattā paññāya, Sv I 19,37 = Sp I
22,19 — As 22,3; As 409,27 (sakale ~e nayamag-
gaṁ . . . aṭṭhakathā-kaṇḍato yeva samānetuṁ vaṭ-
tati); further see Sv I 23,24; 25,6; 101,15; (11)645,1;
(III) 898,1; Ud-a 52,15 ≠ Ja I 78,1; Mil 13,1; Mhv LH
50; Mhbv 94,24; Sās 27,30; 118,9; 150,10; piṭake
(A)bhidhamme (split-cpd.), Abhidh-av 78,29*; — ac-
cording to Buddhist theory A° was gone through during
the 4th week after the bodhi, see As 13,11-15 (s. v.
Abhidhamma-paricaya), and expounded to Mahāmāyā
in Tāvatiṁsabhavana: Dhp-a III 216,16; 218,14;
222,8-9; Mp I 126,8; As 1,1*-12*; Kv-a 1,14-2,3; in
the future A° shall disappear as the first part of the
holy tradition (cf. pariyatti-antaradhāna): Mp I 88,14-18
(pathamaṁ ~aṁ parihāyati; cf. JPTS 1886 p. 35,16)
= Vibh-a 432,13; — Edited in PTS's series (1883
foll.) and in the Bangkok editions of Tipiṭaka; Ms.
(K) in extract in Bibl. Nat. Paris (see JPTS 1882 p.
34,19); aṭṭhakathā thereon = Paramatthakathā (=
As, Vibh-a + Pañcapakaraṇaṭṭhakathā), Gv 59,25;
68,24 (by Buddhaghosa); ṭīkā (o: mṭ), by Ānanda,
Gv 60,3; 69,19; anuṭīkā = Līnatthavaṇṇanā by
Dhammapāla, Gv 60,15; 69,31; —.ifc. v. Vinayâ°
(Pj I 12,10).

abhidhamma-bhājanīya, n., a subdivision of
the chapters in Vibhaṅga (:Suttantabhājanīya and
Pañhāpucchaka); Vibh 61,26, 73,1, 90,12 etc. passim
(Vibh-a 36,2, 43,3, 54,13, 82,6 etc.).

Abhidhamma-mahaṇṇava-pāra, n., the further
shore of the great sea of A°; Abhidh-av 48,3*; 107,32*.

Abhidhamma-mahāpura, n., the great city of
A°; Abhidh-av 1,13*.

Abhidhamma-mahôdadhi, m., the sea of A°;
Abhidh-av 1,14* (acc. ~iṁ); 15,7* (do.).

Abhidhamma-mātikā, f., register of the sub-
jects of A° in Dhammasaṅgaṇi; Dhs p. 1—8 (As 36,5—
54,31); Tikap-a 241,29 = 242,33 (°padehi saṅgahi-
tānaṁ dhammānaṁ).

abhidhamma-missaka, mfn. [cf. sa. miçraka],
containing A°-elements; Mp (Ee) III 401,6 (~aṁ ka-
thaṁ = 'abhidhamma-kathaṁ').

Abhidhamma-mūlaṭīkā, f., sub-commentary
written by Ānanda (see Abhidhamma-ṭīkā) on the
aṭṭhakathā on Abhidhammapiṭaka (q. v.); C-ms. in
the Colombo Museum {see JPTS 1882 p. 50,5).

Abhidhammatthavikāsinī, (or Abhidhamma-
vikāsinī), f., title of a commentary (ṭīkā) by Sumaṅgala
on Abhidh-av; Gv 62,19; Ms. in the Colombo Museum
(see JPTS 1882 p. 50,1; cf. ib. 1910—12 p. 124,21).Abhidhammatthavikāsinī

Abhidhamma-Vinayôgāḷha, mfn. [cf. ogāḷha,
sa. avagāḍha (pp. of ava + √gāh)], immersed into ɔ:
being in harmony with A° Se Vinaya; f. ~ā, Mil 1,1*
(scil. Nāgasena-kathā).

abhidhamma-virodha, m., contradiction with
A°; kiñ c'ettha yadi tāva sutto passati, ~o āpaj-
jati, Sp (III) 521,1 (ad Vin III 112,17**) = Mp (Ee)
III 317,9 (ad AN III 240,18) = Vibh-a 408,1 (quoted
Ss 63,10).abhidhamma-virodha

Abhidhamma-saṁyutta, mfn., connected with
A°; instr, f. ~āya kathāya, Mil 56,25.

Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha (or Abhidhamma-
saṅgaha, q. v.), m., title of a work on Abhidhamma by
Anuruddha (4); Gv 61,25 (°-pakaraṇa); 71,1; Piṭ-sm
§280; Sandes 28,27; Buddhadatta's Introd. to Nā-
mar-p 3,11-14; Sās 34,1; 77,20 (°-pakaraṇa); 111,25;
121,21 (°-pakaraṇa; a gaṇṭhipada thereon by Nāṇa-
vara); — Edd.: Abhidh-s ed. by T. W. Rhys Davids,
JPTS 1884 p. 1—48; by H. Devamitta, Colombo
1888 (2. ed. ib. 1909); (°-pakaraṇa) ed. by Paññā-
nanda, ib. 1898 (also printed in Burma, see Nā-
AbhidhammatthasaṅgahaBangoon 1922; Trsl, by Shwe Zan Aung, revised and
ed. by C. Rhys Davids, London 1910 ('Comp,
of Phii:; PTS's Trsl. Series vol. 2); — Mss.: in the
Mandalay Collection of the India Office (see JPTS
1896 p. 46,16); three Burmese Mss. in the India Office
Library (see JPTS 1882 p. 83, Nos. 50—51—52); in
the Cambridge University Library (Burmese; see
JPTS 1883 p. 145,15); in the British Museum seven
Burmese Mss. (see ib. 141,16 foll.; in the Colombo
Museum (Sinhalese; see JPTS 1882 p. 50,2); —
nava-ṭīkā thereon Saṁkhepa-vaṇṇanā by Saddhamma-
jotipāla (Chapaṭa), Gv 64,2]. (cf. ib. 74,14); other
ṭīkās see below and JPTS 1910—12 p. 124,26—126,6
(the five ṭīkās);— — °-aṭṭhakathā, f. commentary on
Abhidh-s; in the Pagan inscription (see M. Bode,
Pāli Lit. in Burma_ p. 102 No. 35); — °-gantha, m.,
the text of A°; gen ~assa atthayojanaṁ, Sās 126,31;
pl. ~ā, ancillary works to Abhidh-s, Dhammārāma's
Introd. to Nāmar-s 2,5; — °-gandhi (?), see Abhidh-s
Trsl. p. X; — °-ṭīkā, f. (1) porāṇa-ṭīkă by Na-
vavimala, Piṭ-sm § 305; — (2) = Abhidhammat-
thavibhāvinī (q. v.); Ms. in the Mandalay Coll. (see
JPTS 1896 p. 38,19); do. with Burmese interpretation
in the British Museum (see JPTS 1883 p. 142,1);
(3) ~āya anuṭīkā (= Paramatthamañjūsā by Ve-
pullabuddhi or Vimalabuddhi), Gv 64,29 (cf. JPTS
1908 p. 95,3); (4) ~āya navânuṭīkā (= Maṇisāra-
mañjūsā by Ariyavaṁsa), Gv 65,1 (cf. 75,5); — °-ṭīkā-
vivaraṇa n., Gv 65,25; 75,21; — °-dīpanī, f.,
Piṭ-sm § 308; Ms. in the Mandalay Coll. India Office
(see JPTS 1896 p. 38,15). see °-sarūpa-dīpanī below;
— °-pakaraṇa, n. = Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha
(above); — °-paritta, n., a modern work on A° by
Maung Tun Aung (1897), see M. Bode, Pāli Lit. in
Burma p. 95,30; — °-madhu (n.), see Abhidh-s Trsl.
p. X; — °-vaṇṇanā, f., by Saddhammajotipāla; Gv
74,10 (cf. JPTS 1883 p. 145 note 1); — °-vivaraṇa,
n., Gv 65,22; 75,19; — °-samkhepa-vaṇṇanā, f.,
by Saddhammajotipāla (cf. °-vaṇṇanā above); Ed.
Colombo 1889; Ms. in the Mandalay Coll. India
Office (see JPTS 1896 p. 39,6), and in India Office
Library (see JPTS 1882 p. 85 No. 54; cf. Gv 74,14);
— °-sarūpa-dīpanī, f., and °-sarūpa-dīpaka, m.,
Burmese works on Abhidh-s, see Trsl. p. X.

Abhidhamma-saṅgaha, m. = Abhidhamm-
attha-s° (q. v.); two K-mss (in extract) in Bibl. Nat.
Paris (see JPTS 1882, p. 34,30-31); — °-gantha,
m. = Rūpârūpa-vibhāga; Rūpārūp, p. 147,2.

[Abhidhamma]-Sammohavinodanī-atthayo-
janā, f., tztte of a work on A° (Ct. on Vibh-a); edited
by Paññāsekhara, Galle 1892.

Abhidhamma-siṅghāṭaka, mfn., having A° for
crossways [sa. çṛṅgāṭaka]; n. ~am (scil. Bhagavato . . .
dhamma-nagaraṁ), Mil 332,8.

Abhidhammâvatāra, m. (or n.) (Abhidhamma
+ avatāra), title of an A°-compendium by Buddha-
datta; Piṭ-sm §283; Gv 59,32; 69,ṇ; instr. ~ena,
Abhidh-av 15,1*; ib. 27,2, quoted in Pay fol. khlṛs;
°-Sumatâvatārâdi viya, Vism-mhṭ (Se) 3,1 (= Bel
2,16); — edited by A. P. Buddhadatīa in Buddha-
AbhidhammâvatāraMuseum (see JPTS 1882 p. 50,6), and in the Mandalay
Coll. of the India Office (see JPTS 1896 p. 35 No.
120); — °-tīkā, f., CI) porāṇa-ṭīkā by Vācissara-

na; ~aṁ, DN II 51,15 (Vipassissa); ~aṁ nāma anac-
chariyaṁ, Ja VI 1,1; ~aṁ nikkhanto, paron, (scil.
Sutasomarājā), Ja V 190,30; the a° of Sāriputta anà
other theras referred to Ps II 246,13-25-34—247,8-19-32 ;
°-kālo, Ja VI 144,11; abl. ~ato paṭṭhāya, Dhp-a
I 230,15; III 195,10; Ps II 293,3; — ifc. katâ°,
mfn., Ps II 257,14 (Bhagavā); — gabbhâ°, n., going
outfromthe womb; Pj II 264,3; —mahâ°, n., the Great
Renunciation, Ja I 61,31 (ajj'eva mayā ~aṁ nikkha-
mituṁ vaṭṭati, paron.); mahāsattānaṁ ~aṁ, Ss 16,24;
abhi-nikkhamanaabhinikkhamitvā, Ja I 56,25; ~aṁ nikkhanto, Ja I
139,24; Mil 285,17; Ps II 187,18; III(Se) 679,2; Bhaga-
vato ~assa vaṇṇaṁ kathayiṁsu, Ja VI 1,5. (cf. ib. 1,3).

abhi-nikkhipati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *abhi + ni +
√kṣip], to throw down (into, acc); aor. 3 pl. ~iṁsu,
Dāṭh III 12 (tāya [ɔ: aṅgārakāsuyā] . . . titthiyā te
taṁ dantadhātuṁ ~).

abhi-nikūjati, pr. 3 sg. (cf. next); aor. 1 sg.
mañjunâbhinikūj' ahaṁ, Ap 489,25 (v. l.) = Th-a
(Ce) 471,10*; see abhi-kūjati.

abhi-nikūjita, mfn. [pp. of sa. *abhi + nikū-
jati, √kūj], resounded by noise (of animals or birds); n.
~aṁ (sonena), Ja V 232,20* (= sunakhena evaṁ
mahā-viravena viravitaṁ, Ct.); loc. ~e, Ja V 304,24*
(kokilâ°; Ee °nikuñjite; = kokilāhi abhinikūjite, Ct).

abhi-niggaṇhanā, f. (verbal noun from next),
taking hold of; āmasanā +, Vin III 121,15-21' (~ā
nāma aṅgaṁ gahetvā niggaṇhanā; cf. Sp (III) 535,26:
~āya hatthe vā bāhāya vā daḷhaṁ gahetvā).

abhi-niggaṇhāti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *abhi + ni +
√grah], [often [with 'reciprocal cpd.s' as kāyena(-)
kāyaṁ, etc.]; (a) to take hold of, to hold fast; Vin III
121,29 foll. (itthiyā kāyena kāyaṁ āmasati . . . ~āti
abhinippīḷeti); — (b) to keep down, restrain; AN V 230,13
foll. (adhammikena vādena adhammikaṁ vādaṁ ~āti
abhinippīḷeti); 1 sg ~āmi (cetasā cittaṁ), MN I
abhi-niggaṇhāti93,24 Se 212,6); part. m. gen. ~gaṇhato (cetasā eit-
taṁ), MN I 121,2-14 = 242,29-35; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya
(a; dubbalataraṁ purisaṁ sīse vā gahetvā khandhe
vā gahetvā), MN I 121,1 = 242,32; 1 sg. ~eyyaṁ
(cetasā cittaṁ), MN I 242,25 (= niggaṇheyyaṁ,
Ps; cf. Sn 716); grd. ~itabba, n. ~aṁ (cetasā cit-
taṁ), MN I 120,37.

abhi-nighāta, m. [sa. *abhi + nighāta, ni +
√han], suppression; °-paññatti, f., an expression for
a°, Nett 59,27 (pāpakānaṁ akusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ;
'= tesaṁ āsāṭikānam ~ samugghātapaññatti, Nett-a).

abhi-niddisatl, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + nir + √diç],
to point out, indicate; 3 pl. ~anti, DN III 168,21*.

abhi-ninnāmeti, pr. 3 sg. [Buddh, sa. abhi-nir-
ṇāmayati, caus. of abhi + nir + √nam], to bend or
stretch out (acc), to direct (towards, dat. gen.); DN I
76,15-32 (ñāṇadassanāya cittaṁ abhinīharati ~eti);
abhi-ninnāmeti≠ Paṭis 1112,28; DN I 79,28 (do. ceto-pariya-ñāṇāya,
etc.) = 80,22 ≠ Paṭis 1113,15; DN I 77,9-24 (do. mano-
mayaṁ kāyaṁ abhinimm[in]āya, etc); 78,24 (do.
iddhi-vidhāya, etc) ≠ Paṭis I 111,22; DN I 81,12 (do.
pubbenivāsânussati-ñāṇāya, etc.) = 82,5 = MN I
182,2]. = 278,8 = 347,26 = 412,33 = 441,33 =

348,29 = 413,9 — 444,12 - 522,23 = II 38,34 ≠ Pp
60,36 (Pp-a); AN I 254,33 (yassa yassa (ca) abhiññā-

~eyya (aḷaṁ, scil. kakkaṭako), SN I 123,25 = MN I
234,13; aor. 3 sg. ~esi (aṅgaṁ, scil. kacchapo), SN
IV 178,11; 1 sg. ~esiṁ (pubbenivāsânussati-ñāṇāya
cittaṁ ~), Vin III 4,20 (= abhinīhariṁ, Sp) — MN
I 22,11 (Ps = Sp) = 248,1; Vin III 4,38 (sattānaṁ
cutûpapāta-ñāṇāya cittaṁ ~; = parikammacittaṁ
nīhariṁ, Sp) = MN I 22,29 = 248,21 (cf. Vism 423,11
foll.); Vin III 5,22 (āsavānaṁ khaya-ñàṇāya cittaṁ
~; = vipassanācittaṁ abhinīhariṁ, Sp) = MN I 23,13
(Ps = Sp) = 249,6 = AN III 93,1; fut. 3 sg. ~essati
(aṅgaṁ, scil. kacchapo), SN IV 178,1.

abhi-nipajjati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + nipadyate,
ni + √pad], to lie down (upon, acc or loc. loci), to lie
down up to (with acc loci); Vin IV 273,6 (āsane abhi-
nisīdati pi ~ pi); bhikkhuṁ (near to) . . . mātugāmo
abhinisīdati ~ati ajjhottharati, AN III 92,2 = Pp
67,26; 68,2; 3 pl. ~anti (āsane n'eva abhinisīdanti
na ~), Vin IV 273,1; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya (āsane abhini-
sīdeyya vā ~ vā), Vin IV 273,20**-'; fut. 3 sg.
~issati (āsane), Vin IV 273,10; inf. ~ituṁ, AN IV
188,23 (jegucchī hoti uccāraṁ vā passāvaṁ vā abhi-
nisīdituṁ vā ~vā, scil. assâjāniyo); — pass. part. m.
abhi-nipajjiyamāno, AN III 92,3-19 (so mātugāmena
abhinisīdiyamāno +) = Pp 67,27; 68,1; — caus.
(abhi-nipajjāpeti); to cause to lie down (upon, acc);
pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, AN IV 133,2 (tattaṁ ayomañcaṁ
. . . abhinisīdāpeyya vā ~eyya vā).

abhi-nipatati, pr. 3 sg. [cf. sa. abhi-ni-pātayati,
caus. of abhi + ni + √pat], to fall into, to set about;
+ pakkhandati paṭipajjati, Ja II 8,3'; Ps I 211,12
(paṭisandhi-viññāṇaṁ . . . yasmiṁ ṭhāne ~ati).abhi-nipatati

abhi-nippatati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + niṣ +
√pat], to fly out against (in one's way), to become the
result; part. m. nom. ~aṁ, Ja VI 36,1* (maccu yassâ-
bhinippataṁ; = yassa . . . maraṇam eva nipphatti,
abhi-nippatatiought to read

abhi-nipphanna (or abhi-nippanna), mfn. (pp.
of abhinipphajjati), produced, accomplished, ripened,
ready; m. ~o, DN II 223,24-2 5 (Bhagavato lābho
. . . siloko) = 229,18-19 (Ee -pp-, Se -pph-); MN II
abhi-nipphanna(so me attho ~o); n. ~aṁ (agga-sassaṁ), Mil 8,23.

abhi-nippīḷanā, f. (verbal noun from next),
pressing or squeezing (mutually); āmasanā +, Vin III
121,15'-22' (~ā nāma kenaci saha nippīḷanā); instr.
~āya, Sp (III) 536,2.abhi-nippīḷanā

abhi-nippīḷeti, pr. 3 sg. [from abhi-ni + √pīḍ (with
-pp- from the opp. uppīḷ°, like -kk- in a-ppaṭikkūla,
q. v.), hardly from abhi + niṣ + √pīḍ], as to construc-
tion cf. abhi-niggaṇhāti: (a) to press or squeeze (mutual-
ly); āmasati . . . abhiniggaṇhāti ~eti (itthiyā kāyena
kāyaṁ), Vin III 121,29'; — (b) to coerce; to obviate,
abhi-nippīḷeti~eti, AN V 230,13; 1 sg. ~emi, MN I 242,27 (cetasā
cittaṁ abhiniggaṇhāmi ~emi, santāpemi); in similar
phrases: part. gen. ~ayato, MN I 121,14 = 242,30;
pot. 3 sg. ~eyya(α; dubbalataraṁ purisaṁ), MN I 121,1
= 242,32; pot. 1 sg. ~eyyaṁ (cetasā cittaṁ), MN I
242,25 (= nippīḷeyyaṁ, Ps); grd. n. ~etabbaṁ (ce-
tasā cittaṁ), MN I 121,12; — (c) to annoy or trouble;
pr. 2 sg. ~esi, DN II 115,16 (atha kiñ carahi tvam . . .
Tathāgataṁ ~).

abhi-nipphajjati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-niṣpadyate,
abhi + niṣ + √pad], to arise, appear, be produced;
3 pl. ~anti, MN I 86,2 (bhogā nâ°; = na nipphajjanti,
Ps) = (92,22,) quoted Nidd II 121,25 (spelt nâbhi-
nippajjanti); MN I 86,3 (bhogā) = (92,22); —pp. abhi-
nipphanna, q. v.; — caus, abhinipphādeti (q. v.).

[abhi-nipphatti, f. [sa. abhi-niṣpatti], production,
appearance; instr. ~iyā, DN II 283,22 (tassa tass' eva
bhavassa ~iyā; v. l. Se better abhinibbattiyā, cf. Sv
(III) 738,16); cf. nipphatti, Ja VI 36,9].

abhi-nipphanna (or abhi-nippanna), mfn. (pp.
of abhinipphajjati), produced, accomplished, ripened,
ready; m. ~o, DN II 223,24-2 5 (Bhagavato lābho
. . . siloko) = 229,18-19 (Ee -pp-, Se -pph-); MN II
abhi-nipphanna(so me attho ~o); n. ~aṁ (agga-sassaṁ), Mil 8,23.

abhi-nipphādaka, (mf)n. (verb. adj. from abhi-
nipphādeti), producing, effecting; Abhidh-av 7,1 (suga-
tiyam pi dukkha-visesassa ~aṁ).

abhi-nipphādita, mfn., pp. of next; Vin III
223,11'.

abhi-nipphādeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi-nip-
phajjati), to bring about, produce, realize; (as a caus.
med.) obtain, acquire; Vin III 222,33' foll.; Abhidh-av
4,23 (bhava-bhoga-sampattiṁ); 5,35 (cattāro ariya-
puggale); 3 pl. ~enti. Mil 39,23 (nānā santā ekaṁ at-
abhi-nipphādetiattaṁ iddhiṁ); pot. 3 sg. taṁ (scil. bhājana-vika-
tiṁ) . . . kareyya ~eyya, DN I 78,14-17; Vin III
221,35** foll. (codiyamāno sāriyamāno taṁ cīvaraṁ
~eyya, read with Sp (III) 673,8: codayamāno sāraya-
māno, etc; = "should succeed in obtaining", Chil-
ders s. v. (ɔ: in having it delivered)); aor. 3 sg. ~esi,
Vin II 183,23 (Devadatto pothujjanikaṁ iddhiṁ ~esi);
3 pl. ~esuṁ (iddhipadesaṁ), SN V 255,30; 256,20
(samattaṁ iddhiṁ); fut. 3 pl. ~essanti, SN V 256,2
foll. (do.).

abhi-nipāta, m. [sa. ts.], falling in; touch, hit,.
stroke; nom. ~o, Ps I 210,29 — Spk II 27,8 (viññāṇe
~o yeva bhayaṁ); Ps I 211,15 = Spk II 27,32 (vin-
ñāṇâhāre ~o yeva bhayaṁ); As 114,34 (cetaso paṭha-
mâbhinipāto vitakko) = Vism 142,10; loc ~e, Ps I
276,5 (ārammaṇe citta-cetasikānaṁ paṭhamâbhini-
abhi-nipāta2matta and mattā), Vibh C 307,27) 321,10 (= āpātha-
mattā; cf. Vibh-a 405,13); — n. abstr. °-tta (paṭha-
mâ°), Abhidh-av 17,17* (abl. ~ā); — ifc v. daṇḍa-sat-
thâ° (Ps II 132,16; cf. çastrâbhinipāta, Divy 125,11).

abhi-nipātana, n. or mfn. (from sa. abhini-
pātayati, caus.), only ifc daṇḍa-satthâ°, mfn., striking
with stick or sword; Nidd I 216,14 (m. ~o, scil. kodho).

abhi-nipāti(n), mfn. (from abhi-nipāta), falling
or rushing into; acc m. (ifc ) turitâbhinipātinaṁ, Ja
II 7,26* (Ct.: yo puggalo . . . turito hutvā vegen' eva
abhi-nipātin

abhi-nipāti(n), mfn. (from abhi-nipāta), falling
or rushing into; acc m. (ifc ) turitâbhinipātinaṁ, Ja
II 7,26* (Ct.: yo puggalo . . . turito hutvā vegen' eva
abhi-nipātin

abhi-nipuṇa, mfn. [sa. abhi + nipuṇa], very
acute or clever; pl. ~ā, DN III 163,20* (manujā;
= ati-nipuṇā sukhuma-paññā lakkhaṇa-pāṭhakā
manussā, Sv).

abhi-nibbajjeti, pr. 3 sg. [from sa. abhi + nir
+ √vṛj], (prob.) imper. 2 pl. abhinibbajjayātha, Sn
281 = AN IV 172,6*, see abhi-nibbijja (b); v.l. for
abhi-nivajjeti (q. v.).

abhi-nibbatta, mfn. [pp. from next; sa. abhi-
nirvṛtta], come forth, produced, reborn; aggi ~o, MN
II 152,12; loc. ~e, Nidd II 147,8 (sañjāte nibbatte
~e pātubhūte = 'jāte'); m. pl. ~ā, Dhs 1035 (nibbattā
+ ; Ee w. r. (abhi)nippattā; cf. A 359,s); tadanan-
taraṁ ~a-kkhandha-gahaṇā (abl.), Ud-a 293,14 (here
°-i-kkh°) = 418,2; — ifc. v. an-° (q. v.), kammâ°
abhi-nibbattakammâ

abhi-nibbattati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + nirvar-
tate, abhi + nir + √vṛt], to come forth, arise, to be
produced; to come to birth, to be reborn; SN IV 215,23
(usmă jāyati, tejo ~) = V 212,22; Pp 51,14 (ājīvo);
cond. 3 sg. med. ~issatha (nāmarūpaṁ), DN II 63,8;
pp. abhi-nibbatta (q. v.); caus, abhi-nibbatteti (or
~ayati), q. v.

abhi-nibbattana, n. (verbal noun of prec), the
being reborn; Sv (III) 738,16 (ejā . . . purisaṁ tattha
tattha °atthāya kaḍḍhati); 797,32 (nibbatti-saṁ-
khātena °aṭṭhena abhinibbatti, cf. Vibh-a 95,17).

abhi-nibbatti, f. [sa. abhi-nirvṛtti], coming forth,
becoming, birth, rebirlh; jāti sañjāti okkanti ~i, etc,
DN II 305,1 = MN III 249,16 - SN II 3,1 = Vibh 99,14;
DN III 94,28 (iti ... etassa brāhmaṇa-maṇḍalassa
abhi-nibbatti(khattiya-kule [etc] ca attabhāvassa ~i hoti); uppādo
ṭhiti ~i pātubhāvo, SN II 175,12-17; IV 14,8 foll.;
~i kho āvuso dukkhā, an-° sukhā, AN V 121,1; As
341,16 (dhammānaṁ ~i); Abhidh-av 85,16-17 (aṁ-
kurâdīnaṁ ~i ... kusalâdīnam dhammānaṁ . . .
~i); dat. ~iyā, DN I 229,1 (dibbānaṁ bhavānaṁ);
II 283,22 (ejā . . . purisam parikaḍḍhati tassa tass'eva
bhavassa ~iyā; v. l. for abhinipphattiyā); AN III
400,3 (taṇhā sibbati tassa tass' eva ~iyā; v. l. abhi-
nippattiyā); loc. ~iyā . . . sati idaṁ dukkhaṁ pāṭi-
kaṁkhaṁ, AN V 121,8-12 ; — °-guṇa, m., Pj II 264,2
(Tusita-bhavane ~aṁ, the merit of being reborn in
the Tusita-ñeayen); — ifc. v. attabhāvâ°, an-°
(& punabbhavân-°), punabbhavâ° (Vin III 3,25;
MN I 294,18; SN II 65,18, 101,15; AN I 223,25).

abhi-nibbattita, mfn. (pp. of abhi-nibbatteti,
q. v.; cf. abhinibbatta); f. ~ā, Abhidh-av 14,12*
(rūpârūpa-samāpatti); °-dhamma-kkhaṇasmiṁ, As
341,23 (mṭ: abhinibbattiyamāna-dhamma-kkhaṇas-
min ti adhippāyo).

abhi-nibbatteti (or ~ayati), pr. 3 sg. (caus. of
abhinibbattati), to cause to come forth, produce,
evoke (with aggiṁ = to make a fire); ~eti, DN II
216,15 (bahiddhā para-kāye ñāṇa-dassanaṁ ~eti;
— attano kāyato parassa kāyâbhimukhaṁ ñânaṁ
abhi-nibbatteti412,26 (attabhāvaṁ); Nidd II 148,3 (janeti [Ee jān°]
+ ; = 'upadhiṁ karoti'); part. m. ~ento, SN III 152,15
foll.; do. neg. an-°, Pj II 547,6 (āyṁ attabhāvaṁ
~ento; = 'apurekkharāno'); neg. part. med. m., an-
abhinibbattayamāno (a-janayamāno + ; — 'a-kubba-
māno'), Nidd I 51,24 (Nidd-a); part. act. gen. ~ayato
(attabhāva-paṭilābhaṁ), MN III 53,8-13; imper. 3 pl.
~entu, MN II 152,1 (aggiṁ); pot. 3 sg. ~eyya (do.),
MN I 240,35; 241,21; II 129,29; III 95,8; 96,3; fut.
1 sg. ~essāmi (do.), MN I 240,32; 241,18; III 95,5-32;
aor. 3 pl. ~esuṁ, AN V 47,4-18 (paṭhavī-kasiṇa [etc.]-
samāpatti-paramā ... eke samaṇa-brāhmanā at-
th(aṁ) ~; Ee atthâbhinibbattesuṁ; — attho ti
gahetvā ~esuṁ, Mp!); pp. abhi-nibbattita, q. v.

abhi-nibbāti, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. nirvāti, nih
+ √vā], 'to be fully cooled', i. e. to be freed from pas-
sions; m. ~o, Saddh 450; cf. abhi-nibbuta.

abhi-nibbijja, abs. of abhi + sa. nir + √vṛj
= (a) to decompose, distinguish (through analyse); (b)
to exclude, reject; (a ) tato sakāya paññāya ~ dakkhi-
saṁ (v. l. dakkhasi), Thī 84 (Thī-a: ghana-vinib-
bhoga-karaṇena, cf. vinibbhujati) ≠ Ap 576,8 (dak-
khasi) — Thī-a 85,26* (Ee w. r. dakkhisaṁ); — (b) in
abhi-nibbijjayātha naṁ, reminding of Sn 448 (nibbijjâpema Go-
tamaṁ); but Pj = vivajjeyyātha, mā bhajeyyātha
points to an imper. 2 pl. abhi-nibbajjayātha (so also
AN Ee); v.ll. °nibbajjeyyātha, °nibbijjayātha, °nib-
bajjiyătha, cf. Geiger § 176 n. 2).

abhi-nibbijjana, n., verbal noun from prec;
Pj II 311,21 (°-mattena).

abhi-nibbijjhati, pr. 3 sg., v. l. for abhi-nibbhij-
jati, q. v.

abhi-nibbuta, mfn. [abhi + sa. nir-vṛta (nih
+ √vṛ) = pāli nibbuta, which also is used as pp. of
nibbāyati (nir + √vā)], perfectly cooled, calmed, serene;
m. pl. ~ā, Sn 1087 (satā diṭṭhadhammâ°; = rāgassa
nibbāpitattā nibbutā, Nidd II 94,1); Saddh 35; —
°-citta, mfn. = next; Ja II 383,17'; Ud-a 195,10;
abhi-nibbutacitto [v. l. nibbuta-citto] a-paridayhamāna-citto, Pj)
= Th 1263; Sn 456 (nivutta-keso + ; = atīva
vūpasanta-pariḷāha-citto gutta-citto vā, Pj); 469
(panuṇṇa-kodho +) = Ud 29,5* (= abhinibbuta-
citto, Ud-a); Sn 783 (santo bhikkhu ~o; Pj: rāgâdi-
kilesa-vūpasamena santo tathā ~o; Nidd I 71,6);
Ja II 383,8* (asaṁkam[ā/a]nā + ; = abhinibbuta-cittā,
Ct.); III 14,22* (= abhinibbuta-sabhāvā, Ct.).

abhi-nibbhijjati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + nirbhi-
dyate, passive (intrans.)of abhi + nir + √bhid: some-
times misspelt abhi-nibbijjati, or v. l. abhinibbijjhati,
as from sa. abhi + nih + √vid or √vyadh], to break

padaletvā sotthinā abhi-nibbijjheyya) = AN IV
176,12 (with the same spelling); pot. 3 pl. ~eyyuṁ,
MN I 104,8 = 357,11 = SN III 153,19 (-bbijj-) = AN
IV 126,3-27 (do.); inf. ~ituṁ, MN I 104,10 = 357,13
= SN III 153,22 = AN IV 126,6-29 (-bbijj-; Mp
(Se) III 232,3 (-bbhijj-)); — trans, only abs. abhi-
nibbhijja, (more properly from *abhi-nibbhindati),
MN I 73,6 foll. (aṇḍakosaṁ (etc.) ~ jāyanti; = bhin-
ditvā nikkhamana-vasena jāyanti, Ps).

abhi-nibbhijjana, n. (verbal noun from prec),
breaking through (metaph.); abl. ~ato, Nett-a ad
Nett 98,32 (kilesâbhisaṁkhārānaṁ; spelt -bbijjh-);
cf. next.

abhi-nibbhidā, f. [from sa. abhi + nih + √bhid;
variously spelt like abhi-nibbhijjati, cf.' Buddh.sa.
abhi-nirbheda, Mvu I 272,19], the successful breaking
through (the egg-shell), also metaph. = (the successive
states of) enlightenment; ayam assa paṭhamā . . .
(dutiyā, etc.) ~ā hoti kukkuṭa-cchâpakassêva andako-
samhā, MN I 357,27-32 (= ñāṇabhedo, Ps) ≠ Vin III
abhi-nibbhidākhanti, Sp); 5,19 (dutiyā); 6,1 (tatiyā; Sp) = AN IV
177,28; 178,23; 179,12 (°nibbidhā throughout; Mp
(Se) III 257,1 (°nibbhidā)); dat. bhabbo ~āya, MN I
104,1-12 (= ñaṇena kilesabhedāya, Ps) = 357,1-21
(= ñāṇa-pabhedāya, Ps); Nett 98,32 (na ca bhabbo
~ā gantuṁ (instr.1); = °-saṁkhātaṁ ariyamag-
gaṁ adhigantuṁ na ca bhabbo, Nett-a, both times
°nibbidhā); — °-kāla, m., the moment of a°, Mp (Se)
III 233,10; — °-paññatti, f., an expression for a°;
Nett 61,8 (cittassa; cf. abhiññā-paññatti).

abhi-nimantana, n. (from next) & °-tā, f.
abstr., invitation, appeal; instr. ~tāya, MN I 331,31
(= nimantana-vacanena, Ps).

abhi-nimanteti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-ni-man-
trayate, √mantr], to invite (one, acc; to, instr.);
pot. 1 pl. ~eyyāma pi naṁ (abhivādeyyāma +), DN
I 61,2 (~ cīvara-piṇḍapāta- . . . parikkhārehi; = abhi-
haritvā pi naṁ nimanteyyāma, Sv) — MN II 89,8-20
(Ps≠Sv) = 101,18.abhi-nimanteti

abhi-nimmadana, n. (or °nā, f.?) [verb. noun of
abhi + *nim-madayat.i, to subdue the pride (of an ele-
phant or a horse)], subduing, correcting, amending;
dat. ~āya, MN III 132,16 foll. (nāgaṁ damayāhi
āraññakānaṁ . . . sīlānaṁ ~); AN IV 189,1 (yāni kho
pan' assa honti sāṭheyyāni . . . etc. . . . tesam assa
sārathi ~āya vāyamati).

abhi-nimmāna, n. (verbal noun of abhi + nir
+ √mā, cf. sa. nirmāṇa), forming, creating (by magic);
dat. manomayaṁ kāyaṁ ~āya cittaṁ abhinīha-
rati abhininnāmeti, DN I 77,8 [= 209,8], so C&
according to Tr.; Ee abhi-nimmināya, Se abhinimmi-
nanāya.

abhi-nimmita, mfn. [pp. of abhi-nimmināti,
sa. abhi-nirmita], created (by magic); pl. m. ~ā
(pañca rathā satā), Vv 137 (Vv-a); f. pl. ~ā, Vv 745
(imā ca nabhyo manasâ°; Vv-a); — ifc. v. puñña-
kammâ° (Ap 280,19 = Th-a (Ce) 97,23*, cf. Anāg 12).

abhi-nimmināti, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. nir +
√mā, cf. Buddh, sa. abhi-nirmimīte & abhi-nirmiṇoti],
to create (mostly by magic), to produce, to shape; DN I
77,10 (so imamhā kāyā aññaṁ kāyaṁ ~āti rūpiṁ ma-
abhi-nimminātiVism 406,25) ≠ Nidd II 209,20; 3 pl. ~anti (do.), MN
II 17,25; 18,5; part. gen. pl. ~antānaṁ (manomayaṁ
kāyaṁ), AN I 24,2, quoted Ud-a 319,32; imper. 2 sg.
~āhi (oḷārikaṁ attabhāvaṁ), AN I 279,2; pot. 3 sg.
~eyya (itthirūpaṁ vā purisarūpaṁ vā, scil. rajako
vā cittakāro vā), SN II 102,2 — III 152,13; pot. 1 sg.
abhi-nimmine (ahaṁ sahassaṁ ~), Ap 29,26 = Th-a
(Ce) II 108,16*; aor. 3 sg. abhinimmini (abhirūpaṁ
itthiṁ ... iddhibalena ~; v. l. °nimmitaṁ; Ee °nimmi),
Dhp-a III 115,14 ≠ Pj II 243,1; abs. (α) °-nimmitvā,
Thī 229 (iddhiyā ~ caturassaṁ rathaṁ); (β) °nim-
minitvā, DN III 27,13 (satta-tālaṁ acciṁ); AN I 279,4
(oḷārikaṁ attabhāvaṁ); SN I 104,6 (hatthi-rāja-vaṇ-
ṇaṁ, quoted Vv-a 16,25); 106,17 (sappa-rāja-vaṇṇaṁ);
112,16 (balivadda-vaṇṇaṁ); 115,5 (kassaka-vaṇṇaṁ);
117,19 (brāhmaṇa-vaṇṇaṁ); 125,2 (kumāri-vaṇṇa-sa-
taṁ); Dhp-a I 139,10 (kumāra-vaṇṇaṁ); Ja IV 21,16*
(nāvaṁ sucittam); Ud-a 68,15 (mahantaṁ bherava-
rūpaṁ); 432,27 (ākāse paṭhaviṁ); — pp. abhi-
nimmita (q. v.); cf. abhinimmāna.

abhi-niropana, n., or~ā, f., verbal noun of abhi-
niropeti (q. v.) [cf. Vyu 245,1050; Abhidh-k-vy Trsl.
I 61,12?]; ~ā, Paṭis I 79,9 foll.; cetaso ~ā, Dhs 7 (As
143,2); 21; 84; 298; 382; MN III 73,15 (Ps); Vibh 87,1;
instr. °a-vasena, Sv I 121,31; °-a + pariggahaṇa (sam-
mā-°), Ud-a 147,7; °aṭṭho or °aṭṭhena, Paṭisl 16,31,
etc, passim; As 114,34; — °-cariyā, f., undertaking
of a°; Nidd II 141,35 (Nidd-a CSe) II 337,3: tassa āram-
maṇe cittassa ~ā); — °-lakkhaṇa, (a) n., the cha-
racteristic of a°, Sv I 63,6; (b) mfn., having a° as
characteristic, As 114,16 — Abhidh-av 18,18; Vism
515,25; Sv I 314,2 (sammā-°).

abhi-niropita, mfn., fixed into (pp. of next); —
°-tta, n. abstr., Paṭis I 79,10 foll. (abl. ~ā; = rū-
pârammaṇaṁ abhirūḷhattā, Paṭis-a).

abhi-niropeti, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. niropayati,
caus. of ni + √ruh], 'to transplant into', esp. to fix
(one's mind, cittaṁ) into (loc.); ārammane cittaṁ ~eti,
patiṭṭhāpeti, As 143,2; Ps (Se) III 541,9; Ud-a 220,1;
ettha sammā-saṁkappo sahajāta-dhamme ~eti, Sv I
314,14; sampayutta-dhamme ... sammā ~eti, Ps I
abhi-niropetidhammassa nāmaṁ) ~eti, Nett 33,4 (— deseti,
Nett-a), to use [an expression] (explaining nirutti); —
pp. ~ita (see prec); verbal noun abhi-niropana, see
above.

abhi-nilīyati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-ni-līyate, √lī],
to lie hid, to conceal oneself; aor. 3 sg., Vessagiri-vane
abhinilīyi so, Mhv XXXIII 48.

abhi-nivajjeti, pr. 3 sg. abhi + sa. *ni-var-
jayati, caus. of ni + √vṛj; sometimes spelt abhi-
nivaṭṭeti or °vatteti = sa. *abhi-ni-vartayati [√vṛt],
to lay aside, avoid (acc); tad ~eti, AN I 265,11 foll.
(Ee °-vaddheti ɔ: vaṭṭ°; = taṁ abhi-nivaṭṭeti, Mp Ee
Ce; Mp-ṭ (Be): taṁ abhinivattetī ti taṁ vipākaṁ
abhi-nivajjeti(abhinlhaneyya abhinīhareyya+), MN I 119,16 ( =
hatthena cāletvā nikkaḍḍneyya, Ps; 2 sg. ~eyyâsi,
DN III 61,19 (yaṁ akusalaṁ taṁ ~; = gūthaṁ
viya . . . suṭṭhu vajjeyyāsi, Sv); abs. ~etvā (oḷāri-
kaṁ iriyāpathaṁ ~, opp. sukhumaṁ iriyāpathaṁ
kappeyya), MN I 120,30; taṁ (upekhaṁ) ~etvā, MN
I 364,25; ime tayo kusale dhamme ~etvā, MN I
402,17; tad ubhayaṁ ~etvā, MN III 221,24; 301,19;
DN III 113,1; SN V 119,14-28; 120,11-32; 295,19; 318,1;
AN III 169,21; It 81,17 (= appaṭipajjitvā akatvā,
It-a); te tayo dhamme ~etvā, AN I 102,14; tad
~etvā, AN I 265,13 foll. (Ee abhi-nivaddhetvā; abhi-
nivaṭṭetvā, Mp Ee Se Ce, which last gives the v. l.
abhi-nibbajjetvā).

abhi-nivaṭṭeti (or °nivatteti), pr. 3 sg. [caus.
of abhi + ni + vṛt], to turn back, to stop, to put to
a stand; perhaps correct reading at MN I 119,16
(120,30), AN I 265,11-13 foll., see abhinivajjeti.

abhi-nivaṭṭeti (or °nivatteti), pr. 3 sg. [caus.
of abhi + ni + vṛt], to turn back, to stop, to put to
a stand; perhaps correct reading at MN I 119,16
(120,30), AN I 265,11-13 foll., see abhinivajjeti.

abhi-nivasati, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. ni-vasati,
√vas], to dwell or sojourn with (acc); [imper. 2 pl.
~atha Cp I 10,3 (see under abhi-nivisati)]; pp. abhi-
nivuttha (q. v.).

abhi-niviṭṭha, mfn. [sa. abhi-niviṣṭa; pp. of
abhi-nivisati (b), q. v.], attached to, clinging to or intent
on; m. ~o, Ja V 61,6 (paradāra-kamme); As 224,33
(aniccato ~o, "convinced as to impermanence"); m. pl.
~ā (taṇhāvasena), Thī-a 284,26 (= 'ajjhositā'); Ps
I 250,24 (ekassa assāsa-passāsa-vasena °-bhikkhuno);
abhi-niviṭṭha( = 'āsīno'); f. ~ā (samattā . . . parāmaṭṭhā ~ā
+ ajjhositā adhimuttā, scil. diṭṭhi), Nidd I 64,16 ( =
visesena laddha-ppatiṭṭhā, Nidd-a); Ps (Se) III 547,20
ad MN III 81,7 (tesaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ °-kammaṭṭhāna-
dassanatthaṁ); — ifc. v. micchâ° (Ud-a 346,1).

abhi-nivisati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-ni-viçate, √viç],
(a) to enter into, settle down; 3 pl. ~anti, MN III
148,12 foll. (yattha yatth' eva tā devatā ~anti,
tattha tatth' eva . . . abhiramanti; = vasanti, Ps
(pt)); (b) to devote oneself to, to be disposed to, or at-
tached to, to adhere to (a certain opinion, acc loc.1));
na upeti . . . na parāmasati na ~ati, Nidd I 308,25;
iminā ākārena ~ati, As 377,6; upādiyanti c'eva ~anti
ca, Spk II 33,15; part. gen. ~antassa, Ud-a 321,21;
m. pl. ~antā (°-dassanaṁ), Ud-a 353,3-6; neg. part.
m. an-°anto (amamāyanto +), Nidd I 51,16; acc
~antaṁ, Nidd I 111,12 (Ee misprint abhinivisantaṁ
for an-°; Nidd-a); do. med. m. an-° ~amāno (an-
upādiyamāno +), Nidd I 108,2; imper. 2 pl. kalyāṇe
abhi-nivisati°nivīsatha quoted Cp-a-ns, Colombo 1904; Ee abhi-
nivassagtha; = abhimukhabhāvena nivissatha (sic),
Cp-a; see abhi-nivasati); pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, Nidd I
309,1 (upeyya+); abs. (ct ) ~nivissa, MN I 130,34
(pāpakaṁ ditthigataṁ . . . parāmassa + ; — adhiṭṭha-
hitvā, Ps) ='257,5 ≠ 498,34 ≠ III 210,28 ≠ 235,1;
kim upādāya kim ~ 'etam mama' . . . ti sam-
anupassati, SN III 181,30; — (β) ~nivisitvā, As
224,31 (yattha katthaci); Ps II 264,3 (locl); Ud-a
343,1; Spk II 335,1 (= 'abhi-nivissa'); Vism 661,21;
— pp. °-niviṭṭha (q. v.); cf. abhinivesa, m. (& -niveseti).

abhi-nivuttha, mfn. (pp. of abhi-nivasati, q. v.),
who has lived or dwelt in (loc); DN III 111,10 (yas-
miṁ yasmiṁ attabhāve °-pubbaṁ hoti (v. l. °-pubbo)
"with whatever individuality they previously existed").

abhi-nivesa, m. [sa. abhi-niveça, cf. abhi-nivisa-
ti], (á) lit. 'entirely entering into', or 'extending over', (b)
metaph. = tendency, inclination, adherence; confidence,
"conviction", (Vism 661,20 opp. vuṭṭhāna), also =
false opinion (superstition); (a) nom. ~o, AN III 369,1
(nigrodha-rājassa dvādasa yojanāni ~o ahosi, t. e.
abhi-nivesa— (

abhinivesa-karaṇa-paccupaṭṭhāna, mfn., As
110,35 = Abhidh-av 18,10 (f. ~ā, scil. saññā, see
As-Trsl. (I) 147,8); — °-paññatti, f., an expression
for a°, Nett 61,21; — °-parāmāsa, m., the being af-
fected by a°, Paṭis 1135,6 . . . 157,8; — °-bhūta, mfn.,
consisting of a°, Spk II 259,15 (adhiṭṭhāna-bhūta +);
— °-vuṭṭhāna, n., dvandva ("conviction and emer-
gence"); Vism 661,20 (gen. pl ~ānaṁ); — °-lakkha-
ṇa, mfn., characterized by a°; Nett 28,2 (sabbadham-
mānaṁ ~ā anatta-saññā); — °âkāra, m., mode of
a°; gen. pl. ~ānaṁ nissayā, Ud-a 339,11; — °ânu-
saya, m., (dvandva); cetaso adhiṭṭhānam ~aṁ na
upeti, SN II 17,16 (= nivesa-bhūtañ ca anusaya-
bhūtañ ca, Spk) ≠ III 135,7; pl. ~ā, Nidd II 115,33.

(abhi-niveseti?), pr. 3 sg. (denom, of prec), to
aspire to, apply oneself to (acc); to affect; pot. 3 sg.
~eyya, MN III 234,30—235,16 (janapada-niruttiṁ
nâ°, samaññaṁ nâtidhāveyya; — na adhiṭṭhahitvā
ādāya vohareyya, Ps); 1 sg. ~eyyaṁ, Thī-a 284,2 (so
Ce Ee = 'abhisaṁviseyyaṁ').

abhi-nissaṭa, mfn. [abhi + sa. niḥ-sṛta, √sṛ],
entirely gone out or detached from; — ifc. v. tibhavâ°
(from the three planes of existence, Th 1089; = bha-
va-ttayato vinissaṭo, Th-a).

abhi-nisinna, mfn. (pp. of next), (a) in active
sense = sitting upon (acc); m. pl. ~ā (Paṇḍukambala-
silaṁ ~ā dve Sakkā), Ps II 155,18; — (b) passive;
acc m. rājakumārena ~aṁ rukkha-kkhandhaṁ, Ja I
323,30 ('the tree-trunk to which the prince was clinging').

abhi-nisīdati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-niṣīdati, √sad],
to sit (sink) down by or on (acc or loc); tasmiṁ ~ati,
Vin IV 46,24'; anāpucchă āsane ~ati pi abhinipajjati
pi, Vin IV 273,5; cattāro pāde ~ati (scil. assa-khaḷuṅ-
ko), AN IV 192,12 = 195,8; bhikkhuṁ . . . mātugāmo
. . . ~ati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati, AN III 92,1 ( =
abhibhavitvā santike vā ekâsane vā nisīdati, Mp) =
Pp 67,26; 2 sg. ~asi, Vin IV 46,11; 3 pl. ~anti, Vin IV
abhi-nisīdativā abhinipajjeyya vā, Vin IV 46,17** (acc; ≠ JAs
1914; 506,6: mañce . . . niṣīdet . . .); anāpucchā āsane
~ vā abhinipajjeyya vā, Vin IV 273,20**; aor. 3 sg.
~i, Vin IV 46,3 (āhaccapādakaṁ mañcaṁ sahas[ā/a] ~;
Sp (IV) 782,17 comments on abhinisīdati); fut. 3 sg.
~issati, Vin IV 46,10; 273,10; 2 sg. ~issasi, ib. 46,13;
inf. ~ituṁ, Vin I 194,4 (acc); AN IV 188,23 (cattāro
pāde); abs. ~itvā (aṅgajāte), Vin III 37,37; pass,
part. m. ~iyamāno, AN III 92,3 = Pp 67,27; pp.
abhi-nisinna (g. v.); caus, abhi-nisīdāpeti & abhi-
nisīdeti (q. v.).

abhi-nisīdana, n. (verbal noun of prec), sitting
on; As 347,29 (divasa-santatto ayoguḷo makkhikānaṁ
~assa paccayo na hoti).

abhi-nisīdāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhinisīdati),
to force to sit on; pot. 3 g. ~eyya (sīse . . . gahetvā
tattam ayomañcaṁ . . . ~eyya vā abhinipajjāpeyya
vā), AN IV 133,2.

abhi-nisīdeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi-nisīdati,
cf. Sadd 384,16-18), to cause to sit on; 3 pl. ~enti,
Vin III 30,8 (manussitthiṁ bhikkhussa santike ānetvā
vaccamaggena aṅgajātaṁ ~; = sampayojenti, Sp I
262,4).

abhi-nihata, mfn. (pp. of sa. abhi + ni +
√han], struck, hit; m. cakkâbhinihato, Ja IV 4,11*
(= cakkena abhinihato, Ct.).

abhi-nīta, mfn. [ts., pp. of abhi-neti, q. v.], lit.
'brought near', metaph. = (a) finished, excellent (? see
°-vāsa below); — (b) summoned, cited (as before a
court); ~o sakkhi-puṭṭho, MN I 286,27 (= puc-
abhi-nīta= Pp 29,20 (Pp-a = Ps) = MN III 48,23 = AN I
128,15 (= pucchanatthāyânīto, Mp; cf. pañhâbhi-
nīta) = V 283,14 = 284,28; — (c) hence (ifc) 'ob-
noxius'n a precarious state (owing to fear for kings,
gangsters, etc, or to sickness); — ifc v. corâ° (MN I
463,23; SN III 93,7; Mil 32,3), rājâ° (ibid.), pañhâ°
(AN II 77,8), vātarogâ° (Th 350 (= vātâbādhena
aseribhāvaṁ upanīto, vāta-vyādhinā abhibhūto,
Th-a) = 435);— — °-vāsa, mfn., 'excellent in con-
duct'(1); m. ~o, Mil 362,2 (akuppadhammo ~o ana-
vajjabhogī; = 'having the ten ariya-vāsas', Hīnaṭ; =
'armoedig' Kern p. 57; cf. abhi-nīta (c)).

abhi-nīla, mfn. [ts.], of a (beautiful) dark colour;
— °-netta, mfn., (said of a Buddha); m. ~o, DN II
18,27 (Sv (II) 451,4-11) ≠ III 144,23 ≠ MN II 137,6
(Ps — Sv); — °-netta-nayana, mfn. (tautol, cpd.);
m. ~o, DN III 168,17*; — °-m-āyata, mfn., beau-
tifully dark and long; m. pl. nettâhesuṁ [ - ˇ - ˇ ]
~ā, Thī 257 (= abhinīlā hutvā āyatā ca, Thī-a).

abhi-nīhaṭa, mfn. (pp. of abhi-nīharati (e), sa.
abhi -f- nirhṛta), prepared, kept in readiness; n. ~aṁ
(dhamma-cakkaṁ), Mp I 121,5 foll.

abhi-nīhanati (or °nīhanti), pr. 3 sg., [sa.
abhi + nirhanti, √han], to expel, remove, knock out;
part. m. abhi-nthananto phalakato nīhareyya, Ps II
abhi-nīhanatiMN I 119,16 (= muggarena ākoṭento haneyya, Ps).

abhi-nīhanati (or °nīhanti), pr. 3 sg., [sa.
abhi + nirhanti, √han], to expel, remove, knock out;
part. m. abhi-nthananto phalakato nīhareyya, Ps II
abhi-nīhanatiMN I 119,16 (= muggarena ākoṭento haneyya, Ps).

abhi-nīharaṇa, n. (verbal noun of next); gama-
navasena kāyassâbhinīharaṇaṁ 'gamanâbhinīhāro',
pt ad Ps II 168,5.

abhi-nīharati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + nir-harati,
√hṛ], (a) to pull out (āṇiṁ); (b) to stretch out or forth
(pādaṁ, uraṁ); (c) to set out for (gamanaṁ); (d) to
direct, apply (cittaṁ); (e) to prepare, keep in readiness
(kammaṁ, dhamma-cakkaṁ); DN I 76,15 (ñāṇadas-
sanāya cittaṁ ~ati abhininnāmeti (d); = tan-nin-
abhi-nīharatiDN I 100,13 - 173,24 ≠ I 83,35 (Sv. do.); Abhidh-av
104,20* (iddhividhāya ca ~ati ce cittaṁ); Mp I 121,4
foll. (dhamma-cakkaṁ ~ati . . . uppādeti . . . pavat-
teti); pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, MN I 119,16 (āṇiṁ abhinīha-
neyya + ; = abhihananto phalakato nīhareyya, Ps);
aor. 3 sg. ~i, Ap 587,11. (yaṁ dhammaṁ ~ī); gama-
naṁ ~i, As 388,24-27; Mp I 266,10; pādaṁ ~i,
Mp I 287,23; Mhv XXXIV 88 (attānaṁ câvasese ca
samghato ~i, redeemed from the saṁgha); 1 sg. ~iṁ
(yaṁ kammaṁ ~), Ap 53,27 = Th-a (Ce) II 126,17*;
Sp I 158,27 (so v. l. — 'abhininnāmesiṁ'); 168,1 (vi-
passanā-cittaṁ; = 'cittaṁ abhininnāmesiṁ'); abs.
~itvā (uraṁ), Mp (Se) III 396,4 ad AN V 88,1; Ps III
262,8-11 (vipassanā-ñāṇaṁ); pp. abhi-nīhaṭa (q. v.).

abhi-nīhāra, m. (from prec), (a) bringing into
motion; Ps I 251,13 √Vāyodhātu-vipphārena sakala-
°kāyassa purato ~o gamanan ti vuccati) = Sv (III)
767,1; (b) initiative (intent); ummaggo ... ~o . . .
pañhasamudācāro, AN II 189,12 (= pañhâbhisaṁ-
kharaṇa-vasena cittassa ~o, Mp, cf. ummaggo . . .
paṭibhānaṁ . . . paripucchā, AN II 177,29); — (c)
generally in the sense of an earnest wish, aspiration,
resolve, determination (to become a Buddha, a pacce-
kabuddha, etc.), synon, paṇidhāna, patthanā; ~o,
Bv I 75 (kīdiso te . . . ~o; = buddhabhāvatthaṁ
mānasaṁ bandhitvā 'buddha-vyākaraṇaṁ aladdhā
na vutṭhahissāmī' ti nipajjanaṁ, Bv-a, see Bv II

163; — ifc. v. phātikaranâ° (Ud-a 350,31), vimuttâ°
(Ud-a 356,3), sañjātâ° ' (Pv-a 154,25; Ps (Se) III
621,21).

abhi-lāsi(n), mfn. [sa. abhi-lāṣin], wishing,
desiring; — only ifc. v. sakakammâ° (Ap 348,19,
so Ce; Ee °âbhilābhi(n); 427,7 = Th-a (Ce) 281,21).abhi-lāsin

abhi-lāsi(n), mfn. [sa. abhi-lāṣin], wishing,
desiring; — only ifc. v. sakakammâ° (Ap 348,19,
so Ce; Ee °âbhilābhi(n); 427,7 = Th-a (Ce) 281,21).abhi-lāsin

abhi-limpati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √lip], to
lime, to catch (as with birdlime); sa [scil. jappā] kathaṁ
~ati, Nett 12,4; pp. abhi-litta (q. v.); cf. abhi-lepeti.

abhi-lekheti, pr. 3 sg. [caus. of sa. abhi +
√likh], to cause to be inscribed; aor. 3 sg. ~ayi (cāritta-
lekhaṁ, paron.), Dāṭh V 67.

abhi-lepana, n. (verbal noun from abhi-limpati),
lime (for catching monkeys, etc); ki 'ssâbhilepanaṁ
brūsi, Sn 1032 (quoted Nett 10,28*; = kiṁ assa lo-
kassa ~aṁ vadesi, Pj; = lagganaṁ bandhanaṁ
upakkileso, Nidd); jappâbhilepanaṁ brūmi, Sn 1033
(quoted Nett 11,10*; Pj: jappâbhilepanan ti taṇhā
abhi-lepanamakkaṭassa abhilepanaṁ), cf. Nett 12,2-3 (Nett-a).

abhi-lepeti, pr. 3 sg. (denom, from abhi-lepa(na),
to daub, plaster, smear with (instr.); aor. 1 sg. ~ayiṁ
(cetiyaṁ ~), Ap 84,10.

abhi-vagga, m., prob, a sort of portcullis; instr.
~ena pi omaddanti, MN I 87,2 (v. l. ahi-v°; = sata-
dantena, Ps II 58,8; pt), quoted Nidd II 122,34
(Nidd-a II 378,11 = Ps).

abhi-vajjita, mfn. [abhi + sa. varjita, √vrj],
free from (abl.), cf. vivajjita; m. ~o, Mhv-ṭ (I) 47,8
(tehi tīhi dosehi ~, scil. ativitthāra, atisaṁkhepa,
punarutta).

abhi-vañcana, n. [verbal noun of abhi + √vañc],
deceit, fraud; Dāṭh III 64.

abhi-vaṭṭa, mfn. [pp. of abhi-vassati; sa. abhi-
vṛṣṭa, √vṛṣ], (a) pass. = rained upon; n. ~aṁ va
bīraṇaṁ, Dhp 335 (misreading °vaḍḍṅaṁ; — punap-
puna vassantena devena ~aṁ bīranaṁ, Dhp-a; cf.
Udāna-v (I) p.39) = Th 400 (°vaḍḍhaṁ); m. pl. ~ā
abhi-vaṭṭa= rained down (v.ll. °vuṭṭha, °vaṭṭha); n. ~aṁ (uda-
kaṁ), Mil 197,17; 349,3; — (c) act., having rained;
loc. ~e (mahāmeghe), Mil 176,1; 286,11.

abhi-vaḍḍhaka, mfn. (from caus. of abhi +
√vṛdh), causing increase; pl. ~ā (tanhā-avijjānaṁ),
Ud-a 351,30.

abhi-vaḍḍhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √vṛdhḷ,
(a) intr, to grow or increase more and more, (b) trans, to
grow up aboul, to outgrow (acc.); ~ati, Dhp 24 (appamat-
tassa yaso); Saddh 288; 523; Ud-a 356,24 foll.; Pv-a
8,23 (dātā . . . puñña-phalena); 3 pl. ~anti (opp. pari-
hāyanti), MN I 309,31; II 114,27 foll.; 225,6; III 46,17
abhi-vaḍḍhati— aññaṁ vanaspatiṁ atikkamma vadḍhanti, Ct.); V
100,14* (b; susaṁvihita-kammantaṁ . . . sabbe bhogā
~anti; = abhimukhaṁ gacchantā vaḍḍhanti, Ct.);
part. med. ~amāna, mfn., Pv-a 133,6 (°-dānajjhāsayo);
pot. 3 pl. ~eyyuṁ, MN I 309,28; aor. 3 sg. ~i (rogo
bhiyyo ~), Mil 175,26; aor. 1 sg. caus.(\) Mil 376,22*
(e[va]m evâhaṁ . . . dhammato ~ayiṁ; for *abhi-
vaḍḍñisaṁ?); fut. 3 sg. ~issati (samaṇassa Gotamassa
yaso), DN I 113,20; 129,33; 3 pl. ~issanti, DN I 195,33
(vodāniyā dhammā) = III 57,9; inf. ~ituṁ (arahatte
°-u-kāmena manasā), Mil 374,14; grd. ~itabba, mfn.,
Mil 374,16 (arahatte ~aṁ); pp. v. abhi-vaḍḍhita, abhi-
vuḍḍna, abhivuddha; caus. ~eti (q. v.).

abhi-vaḍḍhana, mf(~ī)n., verbal adj. of abhi-
vaḍḍheti, increasing, augmenting, only ifc. v. raṭṭhâ°
(Ja V 6,9*, here spelt °âbhi-vaddhana; Ja VI 193,21*,
Cks raṭṭhā-vivaddhana), rāgadosâ° (Saddh 68, f. ~ī).

abhi-vaḍḍhi, f. [sa. abhi-vṛddhi], growth, in-
crease (opp. parihāni); acc. ~iṁ icchasi, Mil 95,6;
dat. ~iyā vāyamati, Mil 94,31. Cf. abhi-vuddhi.

abhi-vaḍḍhita, mfn. (pp. of abhi-vaḍḍhati), very
well-grown (of high stature); m. ~o āroha-sampanno,
Ps III 127,17 (= 'ubbūḷhavā' (urūḷhavā), MN I
414,30). Cf. abhi-vuddha.

abhi-vaḍḍheti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi-vaḍḍhati),
to cause to increase; pr. 3 pl. ~enti (upādāna-kkhan-
dhe), Ud-a 352,12; [aor. 1 sg. ~ayiṁ, see above under
abhi-vaḍḍhati]; cf. abhivaḍḍhana, mfn.

abhi-vaṇṇita, mfn. (pp. of next), praised, (highly )
estimated; acc. m. bahunâbhivannitaṁ (scil. vaṁsaṁ),
Dip I 4.

abhi-vaṇṇeti, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. varṇayati],
to praise, extol; aor. 3 sg. ~ayi (visesena), Saddh 588.

abhi-vadati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √vad], 1. to
address, to salute (respectfully), in this sense more
frequently caus. (sa. caus. med,) abhi-vādeti; DN II
269,19 (evaṁ . . . Tathāgatā evarūpe mahesakkhe
~anti; Sv); pot. (cf. imper, vadehi) 2 pl. mañjunâbhi-
abhi-vadatity-ābhiī, Ja VI 325,26* (= yaṁ tvaṁ māṇavo ti
abhivadasi, Ct.); — 2. to speak of, to aim at; to lay
stress upon, maintain, assert; to propose, profess, admit;
~ati, MN II 237,16 (nibbānaṁ sappāyam eva paṭipa-
daṁ; = abhimānena upavadati, Ps); 3 pl. ~anti
(rūpĕ, etc. . . . yaññā), Vin I 36,18* (accord. to Sp-ṭ
yaññā is abl. = yāga-hetu) quoted Ja I 83,16* and VI
220,14*); Sn 891 (aññaṁ ito yâbhivadanti dhammaṁ;
Pj); DN I 13,1 (anekavihitāni adhivutti-padāni (q. v.)
~anti) = MN II 228,15 = 233,9; parisuddhaṁ brahma-
cariyaṁ ~anti, MN I 213,4 = 356,13 = AN IV
152,26; āsattiṁ yeva ~anti, MN II 232,16; dhammañ
c' imā ~anti gāthā, Ja V 489,5*; 'sassato attā ...
mogham aññan' ti icc eke ~anti, Ud-a 18,24; 1 sg.,
paṭhaviṁ . . . sabbaṁ nâbhivadiṁ, MN I 329,15-2 6;
bhavaṁ nâbhivadiṁ, ib. 330,14* (= na gahesiṁ,
Ps); — 3. often following abhi-nandati (q. v.),: to ap-
prove of, assent to; to show favour, to welcome; 3 sg. ~ati,
MN I 266,29, etc, ≠ SN III 14,7 (Spk); MN III
267,15 = SN IV 36,5; 3 pl. ~anti, Mil 69,2; part.
gen. ~ato, MN I 266,30; imper. 3 sg. ~atu, MN I
458,8 foll.; inf. nâlaṁ ~ituṁ, MN II 263,8; grd. n:
~itabbaṁ, MN I 109,36, quoted As 5,4; — caus. v.
abhi-vādāpeti & abhi-vādeti.

[abhi-vana, mfn. [as from sa. abhi + √van], very
desiring; pl. ~ā, v. l. forabhi-bhavanā, SN II 210,18; =
adhimatta-patthanā, Spk; Spk (Se) reads abhi-vānā].
abhi-vandana, n. [ts.], saluting respectfully, wor-
ship; Abh 426; ~aṁ katvā 'abhivādiya', Payfot. jhī 3
(cf. abhi-vādeti).

abhi-vandati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √vand], to
salute respectfully, to honour (acc); pitu pād' abhi-
vandati, Ja VI 548,19* (Ce pādâbhivandati, Lk °pā-
dāni vandati, see below); pr. 1 sg. med. abhi-vande,
abhi-vandati3 pl.

abhi-vandanā, f. = prec; Sadd 381,12.
abhi-vandita, mfn. (pp. of abhi-vandati),
greeted with honour; m. ~o, Th 1168 (dāyādo bud-
dhaseṭṭhassa Brahmunā ~); ~o 'si thuti-vandanāya
(paron.), Vv 971 (= namassito thomito vā asi, Vv-a).
abhi-vassa, m. [ts.], rain; ifc. v. anna-pānâ°
(~o me abhivassati, paron., Ap 372,26).

abhi-vassaka, mfn. (from next), 'raining',
metaph, pouring out, strewing, scattering; ifc. v.
pupphâ° (Vv-a 38,23, °niyāmena).

abhi-vassati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √vṛṣ], to rain
down; to pour, shed, wet; Sadd 883,9 (from Rūp) ≠
Pay fol. gr v. 7 (sense adhika- of prp. abhi); Th 985
(jaṇṇuke (acc.pl.) nâbhivassati), quoted Mil 366,10*;
pajjunno-r-iva bhūtāni bhogehi-m-~ati, Ja VI 298,9*
(Ce abhi-vaḍḍhati); ~ati, Ap 137,19 (pupphavuṭṭhi
abhi-vassatipānâbhivasso, paron.); Mil 304,30 (mahatimahā va-
lāhako); 2 sg. ~asi, Th 1240 (mahāmegho va hutvāna
sāvake ~); 3 pl. ~anti (vicittapupphā gaganā), Bv
II 91, quoted Ja I 18,11* = As (Se) 61,3*; part. m.
~aṁ (megho . . . ~ vasundharaṁ), SN I 100,17* =
AN III 34,24*; DN III 160,2* (mahim iva sūro ~aṁ,
Ee ābhivassaṁ; = abhi-vassanto devo viya, Sv);
~anto (mahatimahā megho), Mil 160,10; 200,2; part.
med. m. ~amāno, Mil 200,4 (do.); imper. 3 sg. ~atu
(Pajjunno), Cp III 10,6; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya (mahā-
megho), Mil 132,16; 296,23; aor. 3 sg. abhi-vassi, Mil
223,17 (Ghaṭikārassa . . . āvesanaṁ sabbaṁ temāsaṁ
ākāsacchadanam aṭṭhāsi, na câbhivassi, "no rain fell
upon it", Tr: it was water-proof) from MN II 54,3
(na câtivassi, but see v. l.); aor. 3 sg. med. ~atha
(Pajjunno), Cp III 10,8; Ap 540,16 (puppha-vuṭṭhi
(paron.) gaganā ~ mediniṁ) = Thī-a 154,10*); pp.
abhi-vaṭṭa (or abhi-vuṭṭha), q. v.; caus. v. abhi-vassā-
peti ác abhi-vasseti.

abhi-vassāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of prec), to cause
to rain; pot. 3 pl. ~eyyuṁ (Buddhaputtă . . . ācāra-
. . . °- meghavassaṁ), Mil 132,25.

abhi-vassi(n), mfn. [sa. abhi-varṣin], raining;
— ifc. v. sabbatthâ° (It 64,20; Ap 229,14, here Npr.
of several cakkavattis), sarâ° (Ja II 217,9*, °~ihi,
abhi-vassin°ahi).

abhi-vassi(n), mfn. [sa. abhi-varṣin], raining;
— ifc. v. sabbatthâ° (It 64,20; Ap 229,14, here Npr.
of several cakkavattis), sarâ° (Ja II 217,9*, °~ihi,
abhi-vassin°ahi).

abhi-vindati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi + √vid2], to
find, get, obtain; pot. 2 sg. °-vinde, Sn 460 (— lacchasi
adhigacchissasi, Pj).

abhi-vyañjaka, mfn. [ts., from abhi + vi +
√añj], manifesting, showing; m. ~o, Ud-a 199,8; —
ifc. v. pahāna-sampadâ° (Ud-a 28,9).

abhi-vyañjeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi-vi +
√añj), to make manifest or distinct; Sadd 333,25 (ati-
sundaratāya).

abhi-vyatta, mfn. [sa. abhi-vyakta, pp. of
abhi-vi + √añj], (more and more) manifest (or evident);
instr, f. ~āya (pakatiyā), Ps I 216,6 = As 328,19 (ad
Dhs 644 = MN I 49,22).

abhi-vyāpana, n. (verbal noun of next); mṭ ad
Vibh-a 8,30 (ettakam evā ti 'tesan tesan' ti (Vibh
2,20) iminā āmeḍitavacanena °atthena vuttam eva).

abhi-vyāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of sa. abhi-vi +
√āp), to pervade, spread, extend (over); ~eti (vidhū-
peti +), Mil 252,21 (scil. lohita-candanaṁ); 3 pl.
~enti (pupphāni . . . gandhena disā-vidisaṁ), Mil
251,24; abs. ~etvā (vyāmamattappadesaṁ), Ud-a
354,12.abhi-vyāpeti

abhi-vyāhata, mfn. [sa. abhi-vyāhrta, pp. of
next], spoken, addressed; Mogg-v V 61 ≠ Pay foi. jau
v. i (m. ~o).

abhi-vyāharīyati, pr. 3 sg. (pass, of sa. abhi-vi-ā
+ √hṛ); to be spoken or addressed; aor. 3 sg. ~īyittha,
Pay fol. jau v. 1 (explaining abhivyāhato).

abhi-vāda, m. [ts.] = abhi-vādana, n. (q. v.);
sense of √vand, Dhātum 193; do. of √vad, Dhātum
822; cf. Sadd II 1501 (544,22); acc. ~aṁ atthato va-
dāpeti, Vv-a 24,25 (O āsi-vādaṁ, i. e. āçīrvāda).

abhi-vādana, n. [ts.], respectful salutation ( =
abhi-vāda, m.); sense of √vand, Dhātup 135; 588;
Sadd II 461 (381,12); do. of √vad, Sadd II 1501
(544,22); DN I 126,2-13 (sirasā me taṁ bhavaṁ Gotamo
abhi-vādana(= 'pāde sirasā vandāhi'); ~aṁ kāresiṁ, Vv-a 24,22
(= 'abhivādayiṁ'); ~aṁ sādiyeyya, AN IV 129,17;
130,3; ~aṁ + paccuṭṭhānam (often written as a dvandva
cpd.), añjalikammaṁ, sāmīcikammaṁ, AN II 180,14;
IV 276,24; Ja I 218,5; 219,11; °-paccuṭṭhānâdīni sab-
bakiccāni akaṁsu, Ja I 82,4; na ~âdīni karissāma,
Dhp-a I 57,14; imassa ~âdīni na karissāma, Ja I
81,29; tassa ~âdīni karissāma, Ja I 218,15; ~âdīni
katvā, Ja V 332,7'; cf. MN II 128,8; III 254,10; AN
I 123,30; Ja III 408,27'(explaining 'pāricariyā'); Ud-a
80,10; Mil 315,8; ~aṁ + paccuṭṭhānaṁ, sakkāraṁ,
upāyanânuppadānaṁ, Mil 171,22; — °- paccuṭṭhāna- °
(see above); — °-sampaṭicchana, n., salutation and
acceptance; instr. ~ena vandita-vacanena vadanti,
Sv (III) 705,3 (= 'abhivadanti', DN II 269,19); —
°-sīla, mfn., of devout character; gen. ~assa niccaṁ
vaddhâpacāyino, Saddh 549 (from Dhp, see nexl); —
°-sīli(n), mfn., = prec; gen. °-sīlissa, Dhp 109 ( =
vandana-sīlissa, Dhp-a).

abhi-vādāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi-vādeti;
cf. abhi-vadati); to cause to salute (or bid welcome);
pot. 3 sg. med. ~ayetha, Ja VI 315,3* (Ct: tena attā-
naṁ ~) = 315,16* = 319,27*, see Sadd 546,19 foll.;
grd. m. ~etabbo, Vin II 208,19.

abhi-vādita, mfn. (pp. of abhi-vādeti), addressed,
saluted; m. ~o DN II 269,20 (= vuḍḍṁ-vacanena
vutto, Sv).

abhi-vādiya, abs. (of abhi-vādeti); having
saluted respectfully; Pay fol. jhī 3 (= abhivandanaṁ
katvā); Abhidh-s 1,5* (sammāsambuddhaṁ; .= vise-
sato vanditvā, Abhidh-s-t); Ap 475,28 (sambuddhaṁ)
= 576,25 = Thī-a 96,13*.

abhi-vādeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. [sa. caus. med.] of
abhi + √vad, cf. abhi-vadati), to salute respectfully
(both at arrival and at departure; with acc and (in
Vin III 212,7, see below) loc); Sadd 883 10 (from Rūp
≠ Pay fol. gṙl (sense vandana of the prp. abhi); pr. 3 sg.
~eti (abhivādetabbaṁ na ~), MN III 205,17; ~eti +
paccuṭṭheti, etc, AN III 223,9 foll. — IV 173,6 foll.;
abhi-vādeti~esi, Ja VI 314,28'; 1 sg. ~emi, Ja V 89,26* (= van-
dāmi, Ct); 3 pl. ~enti, Vin III 212,1 (Ee bhikkhū,
acc pl., but accord. to gramm, to be read bhikkhusu,
see Kacc-v 312 (Sadd 727,21 and Pay fol. ghu i));
pot. 3 sg. ~eyya, Ja VI 315,3*-9'; na vajjho ~eyya vaj-
jhaṁ vā nâbhivādaye, Ja VI 315,2*-15* = 319,26*-30*;
1 sg. ~eyyaṁ, DN I 126,4; 1 pl. ~eyyāma (+ paccuṭ-
ṭheyyāma, etc), DN I 61,1 ≠ MN II 89,7-18; aor.
3 sg., sirasā pāde sasurassâbhivādayi, Ja VI 584,3* ≠
586,6*; 1 sg., abhivādes' ahaṁ, Ap 247,17; na kañci
~esiṁ, Th 425; sirasā ~esiṁ, Th 427; sirasā ~ayiṁ,
Ap 1,10 (v. l. Bv °aye, Sadd °ayaṁ), quoted Sadd
545,27; Vipassiṁ ~ayiṁ, Ap 157,9 = Th-a (O) 159,32*;
1 pl. ~ayimha (paccuṭṭhimha +), AN IV 390,24;
391,26; fut. 1 sg, ~ayissaṁ (nihacca mānaṁ ~), Ja
III 307,4*; inf. ~etuṁ, Ja VI 315,8'; abs. (a ) ~etvā
katvā ca naṁ padakkhiṇaṁ, Sn 1010 (= pañca-
patiṭṭhitena vanditvā, Nidd-a); Bhagavantaṁ ~etvā
padakkhinaṁ katvā pakkāmi, Ud 49,33 (= vandi-
tvā, Ud-a) = DN I 125,13; 225,28 (cf. 189,13);
Bhagavantaṁ ~etvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi, Khp V
(p. 2,31; = vanditvā paṇamitvā namassitvā, Pj) =
SN I 1,11 = 29,24 = DN II 269,21; Bhagavantaṁ
~etvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi, DN I 225,18 = MN I 40,15
(Ps) — 339,6 (Ps) = SN I 70,17 ≠ DN II 84,17 ≠
MN II 48,8; satthāraṁ n'eva ~etvā na paṭisanthā-
raṁ katvā ekamantaṁ ṭhito, Dhp-a I 33,1; (β) ~ayi-
tvā (mātāpitū), Thī 433; (γ) ~iya (q. v.); grd. m.
~etabbo, Vin II 208,19; 210,31; acc ~aṁ, MN III
205,17; — pp. ~ita (q. v.), cf. abhi-vādāpeti, caus.

abhi-vāyati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-vāti, √vā], to
blow through or pervade; Mil 385,8 (vāyu °vanasaṇḍ-
antaram ~ati).

abhi-vāreti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-vārayati, √vṛ1],
to keep off, hold back (acc & abl.); Ja V 325,1* (maṁ
puññâbhivāreti; Bd puñña nivāreti; = tamhā puññā
~eti nivāreti, Ct.).

abhi-vāheti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. abhi-vāhayati, caus.
of abhi + √vah], to remove, put away; aor. 3 sg. ~ayi,
Bv X 5 (sabba-kilesāni; Bv-a).

[abhi-vijjotate, pr. 3 sg. med., [sa. abhi + vi +
√dyut], to shine over (acc), more properly as two words:
rukkham abhi vijjotate vijju (cando), Sadd 883,11-12
(Pay)].

abhi-vi-jināti (or abhi-vi-jeti), pr. 3 sg. [abhi-vi
+ √ji, cf. abhi-jeti], to vanquish, win, conquer, overcome
(acc); intr, to be victorious; 3 pl. ~jinanti, Mil 39,29
abhi-vi-jināticakkaratanaṁ, DN II 172,23 = III 62,7 — MN III
172,27; 2 sg. ~jina mahārāja, MN II 71,32; inf. ~jini-
tuṁ, MN II 71,32; abs. (α) ~jinitvā (pathavim), DN
II 174,6 - III 63,18 ≠ MN III 173,24; (saṁgāmaṁ
~ vijita-saṁgāmo), AN I 106,30 (= jinitvā sattu-
maddanaṁ katvā, Mp); (so taṁ saṁgāmaṁ ~),
MN I 253,5; AN III 90,1; 92,14; 93,22; Pp 66,6; (β)
~jiya (ajjhāvasati), Sn p. 106,18 = MN etc. 92; DN I
89,7; 134,27; 135,1; II 16,22; III 75,29; MN II 72,1;
134,26; Ud-a 274,20.

abhi-vi-jināti (or abhi-vi-jeti), pr. 3 sg. [abhi-vi
+ √ji, cf. abhi-jeti], to vanquish, win, conquer, overcome
(acc); intr, to be victorious; 3 pl. ~jinanti, Mil 39,29
abhi-vi-jināticakkaratanaṁ, DN II 172,23 = III 62,7 — MN III
172,27; 2 sg. ~jina mahārāja, MN II 71,32; inf. ~jini-
tuṁ, MN II 71,32; abs. (α) ~jinitvā (pathavim), DN
II 174,6 - III 63,18 ≠ MN III 173,24; (saṁgāmaṁ
~ vijita-saṁgāmo), AN I 106,30 (= jinitvā sattu-
maddanaṁ katvā, Mp); (so taṁ saṁgāmaṁ ~),
MN I 253,5; AN III 90,1; 92,14; 93,22; Pp 66,6; (β)
~jiya (ajjhāvasati), Sn p. 106,18 = MN etc. 92; DN I
89,7; 134,27; 135,1; II 16,22; III 75,29; MN II 72,1;
134,26; Ud-a 274,20.

abhi-viññāpanā, f., verbal noun of next; Sp I
213,28.

abhi-viññāpeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi + vi +

3 sg. ~esi (purāṇadutiyikāya (loc.) tikkhattuṁ me-

abhi-vi-tarati, pr. 3 sg. [abhi + sa. vi + √tṛ],

(yaṁ jānanto sañjānanto cecca ~itvā vītikkamo);

maddanto nirāsaṁkacittaṁ pesetvā) = 112,19' (ex-
abhi-vi-taratisañjānantī cecca ~itvā vītikkamo, Vin IV 290,27' ( =
'sañcicca'); neg. abs. an-°, Vin I 134,7; II 91,31.

abhi-vidhi, m. [ts.], complete comprehension,

749,3; 880,24,28 (from Rūp), see Kāç IIl,13; —

abhi-vinaya, m., absfracted from abhi-vinaye,

(Tr.); nom. ~o, Vin V 1,17—2,19 (ko tattha vinayo,
ko tattha abhi-vinayo 'ti paññatti vinayo. vibhatti
abhi-vinayo . . .); ~o ti Khandhaka-Parivārā . . ., Sv
(111)1047,24; loc.abhivinaye, ind. as to the Vinaya (+
abhi-dhamme, q. v.).

abhi-vi-rājeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of abhi + virā-
jeti, vi + √rañj), to cause to get completely rid of
desire; abs. cetasā ~etvā, AN I 265,12 (abhi-nivaj-
jetvā (or °vaṭṭetvā) +).

abhi-visate, pr. 3 sg. med. (abhi + √viç), to
penetrate into; Pay fol. gai v. 7 (dhammam ~ dhamme
vā; synon, ni-visate).

abhi-vissattha, mfn. (abhi + pp. of vi + √çvas),
trusting or confident; m. ~o, MN II 52,22 (= ati-
vissattha, Ps) ≠ Mvu I 327,20 (ativiçvasto).

abhi-visiṭṭha, mfn. (abhi + sa. vi-çiṣṭa), most

instr. ~ena ñāṇena, Sv I 99,23; 313,23 (= 'abhiññā');

abhi-vihacca, abs. [abhi + sa. vihatya, vi +
√han], having dispersed, removed, or destroyed; MN I
317,12 (ādicco . . . sabbaṁ ākāsagataṁ tamagataṁ
[or tamaṁ] ~ bhāsati, etc; = abhi-hantvā, Ps) =
SN I 65,14 = III 156,27 = V 44,23 = AN I 242,19
= V 22,16 = It 20,10 (v. l. abhihacca: = abhiha-
abhi-vihaccaNidd-a).

[abhi-vihata, mfn. [abhi + sa. vihata, vi +
√han], befallen, overwhelmed; gen. pl. ~ānaṁ (bhoga-
pārijuññena vā vyādhi-pārijuññena vā), Pj I 141,24
(so Ce; Ee abhihatānaṁ, read with Baabhi-bhūtānaṁ)].

abhi-vuḍḍha, pp. of abhi-vaḍḍhati; grown up;
m. pl. sukhena ~ā, phītā (so Ce), ti attho, Pv-a
150,9 (= 'sukhedhitā', v. r. to 'sukhe ṭhitā').

abhi-vuddhi, f. [sa. abhivṛddhi], growth, in-

(daharassa), As 196,3 (Ee °vuḍḍhi-°).abhi-vuddhi

med. ~ayittha (maggaṁ), Dāṭh V 2.abhi-vedeti

595,7*;^ anodissa adassanena ~aṁ, Mil 156,19 (-t-);
iddhiyā ~aṁ, Dhp-a II 194,18; kataṁ ~aṁ, Ps III
441,8 (= 'pakappitaṁ'); m. ~o (pañho), Ja VI 352,22;
~aṁ pañhaṁ, Ja V 141,5 (-ṭ); Ps III 109,19 (v. l. -t-);
instr, manussā viya ~ena kāyena, Ps II 125,19; acc
pl. ~e cattāro pañhe, Ja V 143,7 (-t-); ~e sukhuma-
pañhe, Ja VI 255,17 (-ṭ-); n. pl. ~ā, Nidd I 186,3
(kappitā ~ā saṇṭhapitā; = 'pakappitāni', Sn 838);
kehici ~āni padāni, Sadd 131,27; — °-asitâpaṅgī,
adj. f., with artificially black eye-corners, Ja III
419_,22' (Ee abhisaṁkhita-°; cf. asitâpaṅgī); °âbhi-

abhi-saṁkharaṇa, n., verbal noun of abhi-
saṁkharoti (q. v.); Abh 832; ~aṁ (bījānaṁ), Abhidh-

— [°-sabhāva, m., Ud-a 364,25; prob. w. r. for abhi-
kaṁkhana-sabhāva (q. v.)].

abhi-saṁkharotibajjhaṁ] kāya-saṁkhāraṁ [etc] ~oti; Ps) = AN I
122,12 foll. (Mp); SN II 40,6 foll. (kāya-saṁkhāraṁ

akusalaṁ, AN I 201,23 (= āyūhati sampiṇdeti rāsi(ṁ)-

dupadam pi tipadam pi catuppadam pi pañhaṁ ka-
ronti, Ps) = II 122,25 ; saṁkhataṁ ~ontī ti . . . tasmā
saṁkhārā ti vuccanti, SN III 87,8 foll., quoted As
51,33; saṁkhāre ~onti, SN V 449,25; puthu-nānâ-
bhisaṁkhăre[hi] ~ontī ti puthujjanā, Nidd I 146,21,
quoted As 349,6; vividhaṁ abhidhānaṁ ~onti, Sadd
75,16; cuṇṇiya-padāni ~onti, Sadd 131,15; — part.
m. pl. ~ontā (corānaṁ paṭibāhanatthāya paccanta-

~onto, MN III 244,21 (+ an-abhisañcetayanto) =
SN II 82,18; do. gen. ~oto, DN I 184,23 (a-cetayato+);
— pot. 1 sg. ~eyyaṁ (ceteyyaṁ +), DN I 184,20-22;
— aor. 3 sg.°-khāsi(iddhâbhisaṁkhāraṁ, paron.), Sn p.
107,23 (B-mss. °-khāresi) = DN I 106,10 — MN II 99,8

171,28; 1 sg. °-khāsiṁ (do.), MN I 330,10; — inf. (a)

366,35 (vācaṁ ~ na sakkonti); — abs. (a ) °-khacca,
SN I 100,18* (~ bhojanaṁ vanibbake tappayati; =
abhisaṁkharitvā samodhānetvā rāsiṁ katvā, Spk);
do. neg. an-° (q. v.); (b ) °-kharitvā, Sn 984 ( =
kuhanaṁ katvā ti vuttaṁ hoti, Pj, i. e. having
made some hocuspocus, Tr); MN I 389,31 foll. (kāya-
saṁkharaṁ [etc.]; — saṁkaḍḍhitvā pindetvā, Ps);
395,25—396,8 (pañhaṁ) = II 252,28; SN V 449,28
(saṁkhāre); Ja II 382,18 (pārāpata-maṁsaṁ); IV
282,7* (annañ ca pānañ c' abhisaṁkharitvā; Ee
°karitvā, no v. l.); Mil 61,22 (visaṁ); 61,31 (sappi
[etc] ekajjhaṁ ~); 228,9 (Bhagavato ... bhāsitaṁ
sutvā deva-manussā ~ dānaṁ denti); Pj II 138,16
