*alaṁ patye], ripe for marriage; f. pl. pañcavassikā
kumārikā ~ā bhavissanti, DN III 71,17 (= patino
dătuṁ yuttā, Sv); pañcavassasatikā kumārikā ~ā
bhavissanti, DN III 75,5 = AN IV 138,13.

[Alampāna, loc. ~e, w. r. in Vism 304,6* for
Ālampāne or Alambāne, from Cp II 2,6].

1a-lamba, mfn., Utt. not hanging down; m., said
of female breasts; acc. m. te nūna tāl[ū/u]panibhe ~e . . .
thanesu [thane su?] me lambahīti [ɔ: lambihiti, Fsb]
sigālo, Ja V 302,13*.

2a-lamba, m. [3a + sa. lamba], non delay; ~aṁ
katvā, accord, to Mp-ṭ, v. r. for alambitaṁ katvā,
Mp III 107,3.

a-lamba-tthana, adj. f. (~ā or ~ī), (1a-lamba
+ thana, sa. stana), with breasts not hanging down
(as a well qualified nurse); ~ā, pt ad Sv (III) 965,23
(quoted Ss 254,23); pl. ~iyo, Ja VI 3,1-9; — °-tā,
f.abstr., Ja VI 483,26'.

a-lambita, mfn. (neg. pp. of √lamb, caus.), not
retarded, without hesitation; ~aṁ katvā, Mp ad AN II
77,8 (= 'a-lambetvā', q. v.).

Alambusa, f. [sa. Alambuṣā], Npr. of an Apsaras;
acc. ~aṁ nāma accharaṁ, Ja V 152,28* foll.; Sv (II)
370,6 (~aṁ nāma devakaññaṁ).

alambusa, m. [sa. alambuṣa], the palm of the
hand; sickness; f. a kind of tree; MTD.

a-lambetvā, neg. abs. of lambeti (caus. of
√lamb), without delay (or hesitation); AN II 77,8: ahā- I
petvā ~ [Ee alampetvā] . . . parassa avaṇṇaṁ bhāsitā
hoti (Mp III 107,3: aparihīnaṁ alambitaṁ [Ee Ce
alampitaṁ] katvā; Mp-ṭ: alambitaṁ katvā ti alam-
baṁ katvā; ayam eva vā pāṭho, vi[pa]lambaṁ akatvā
ti attho [see an-okāsa]).

alam-sākaccha, mfn. (cp. sākacchā, f., with sa.
sāṁkathya, n.), fit to speak in a discussion with (gen.);
m. ~o sabrahmacārīnaṁ, AN III 81,3 (= sākacchāya
yutto, Mp) = 191,1.

a-lavana-bhoji(n), mfn., not eating salted food;
asaddha-bhoji(n) +, Sadd 744,15 ≠ Pay ghau v. 2.a-lavana-bhojin

a-lavana-bhoji(n), mfn., not eating salted food;
asaddha-bhoji(n) +, Sadd 744,15 ≠ Pay ghau v. 2.a-lavana-bhojin

2[alasa, m., a musical instrument; ~o ca tāḷam-
barañ ca alasatāḷambaraṁ, Virita-sanne apud Ppd
114,24 ad Mogg-v III 23, see 2alasatā below].

1alasa, mf(n). [ts.], lazy, idle, negligent; ~o,
Abh 516 (cf. Kacc-v 675: aliso (v. l. alaso) ≠ Sadd
873,12); m. ~o, Sn 96 (Pj II 170,2 foll); Dhp 280
(= mahā-alaso, Dhp-a); SN I 217,5* (alas' assa
an-uṭṭhātā; = alaso assa, Spk); ib. 7* (yatthâlaso
an-uṭṭhātā); Ja III 105,23* (~o gihī kāmabhogī na
sādhu) = 154,23* (≠ quoted Ja IV 30,6); Ja III
247,24* (read yatthâlaso ca dakkho ea, see v. ll.);
V 113,12* (nâlaso vindate sukhaṁ); Mil 92,19 (~o
alasatāya mantitaṁ atthaṁ vyāpādeti); ib. 23* (luddo
tathā 'laso); 187,16 (sayam eva so ~o khalitvā pati-
to); acc. m. kiṁ su ~am an-alasañ ca mātā puttaṁ
va posati, SN I 44,18*-24*; passāmi pdsaṁ ~aṁ ma-
hagghasaṁ, Ja V 399,21*; — °-tthero, Dhp-a I 261,1;
°-bhikkhuṁ, Ja III 139,21; — f. akammakāmā ~ā
mahagghasā, AN IV 92,22*, quoted Ja II 348,4* (Mp:
'alasā' ti nisinna-ṭṭhāne nisinnā va ṭhita-ṭṭhāne ṭhitā
va); — m. pl. akammakāmā ~ā paradattôpajīvino,
Thī 273 (= kusītā, Thī-a); — cf. ālasiya (ālasya,
ālassa); — ifc. v. an-° (q. v. and add MN I 125,8),
jāti-° (Pj II 170,2), mahā-° (Dhp-a III 410,4).

alasaka, m. [ts., cf. sa. a-lasa, m.], name of a
certain disease, tympanitis; instr. ~ena kālaṁ karissati,
DN III 7,16 foll. (= alasaka-vyādhinā, Sv; = ajīra-
ṇena āmarogena, pt).

a-lasa-jātika, mfn. (from 1a-lasa + jāti), of a
lazy disposition; f. ~ā, Dhp-a I 389,6; gen. m. ~assa
(sattassa), DN III 89,16; Vism 419,4 (do.; = alasa-
pakatikassa, mhṭ).

1alasata, f. (abstr. of 1alasa), sloth, lazyness;
instr. ~āya, Pj II 141,18; Mil 92,19; — ifc. v. an-°
(q. v.).

2alasatā, f., name of a musical instrument, ac-
cording to Ppd 114,21-25 ad Mogg-v III 23 (= Pay
ṅī 3) meaningsgh. kāhala [pipe, horn!] in alasatâḷam-
bara; the analysis alasa + tāḷ'-ambara rejected by
Ppd; — alasatâḷambara, n., 'pipes and drums' (Isee
prec), ib. (alaso ca tāḷambaro ca ~aṁ, see 2alasa; w. r.
(or haplol.) for alasa-tālâḷambara [sa. alasa + tāla +
āḍambara] ?).

Alasanda, m. (scil. dīpo), n. (scil. nagaraṁ),
Npr. [Greek Alexandreia, cf. Alikasundara = Alexan-
dres; as for identification see Cambridge Hist, of
India I 550, BEFEO XXIV: 1, 30 n. 1, Memorial
Sylv. l.evi 413 foll.]; perh. we may distinguish be-
tween: (a) a d(v)īpa (river-bound province) and a
Yavana-town, birthplace of Milinda, 200 yojanas
I (Chinese Trsl.: 2000 yoj.) distant from Sāgala ɔ:
Alex, under Caucasus'!, and(b) [in geographical lists, of
Ceylonese proveniences] a distant locality (sea-port)
in the Yavana- world (Yona, Parama-yona+) ɔ: Alex,
in Egypt; nom. ~o nāma dīpo, Mil 82,23-24 (a);
acc. ~aṁ, Mil 359,29 (b); Nidd I 155,5 (b; Yonaṁ
Parama-yonaṁ ~) = 415,11 (E* Alia°); abl. ~ā
(Yona-nagarâ°), Mhv XXIX 39 (a; = ~ā nāma
nagaraparivattato, Mhv-ṭ, cf. Mhv-Trsl. p. 194 n. 3)
≠ Th up 72,38 (— Yon-raṭa Alasanda[tā] nam nu-
varin, Sinh-Thūp); loc. Cīna-Cilāte pi ~e pi, Mil
327,9 (b); pl. ~a-Kasmīra-Gandhārā, people from A°
(a or b), Mil 331,18.

Alasandakā, m. pl., the inhabitants of Alasanda
(b); Ap 359,3.

a-lasa-pakatika, mfn. (*alasa + sa. prakṛti +
ka) = a-lasa-jātika (q. v.), mhṭ. ad Vism 419,4.

a-lasa-bhikkhu, m. (1alasa + sa. bhikṣu), a
slothful monk; Ja III 139,21 (idaṁ Satthā . . . ~uṁ
ārabbha kathesi); ib. 141,18.

a-lasuṇa, n., not garlic [cf. sa. lacuna]; Vin
IV 259,22 (°-saññā, adj.f.); loc. ~e, ib. 23 foll.

alla, mfn. [cf. 2adda; sa. ārdra], wet, moist, not
dry, fresh; Abh 753; m. acc. ~aṁ palāla-puñjaṁ, Spk
II 274,31* = Mp I 38,5* = Ss 54,26*; f. acc. ~aṁ
kusamnṭṭhiṁ, AN V 234,4; 249,13; ~aṁ tintaṁ, Ja
VI 310,3' (= 'addaṁ', scil. pāṇiṁ); n. ~aṁ kaṭṭhaṁ
sasnehaṁ, MN I 240,34 (Ps) = III 96,1 ≠ 142,1; ~aṁ
sukkhaṁ ca bhuñjanto, Th 982 (quoted Ja II 293,26*,
Mil 407,1*); ~aṁ vā sukkhaṁ vā (bhojanaṁ), AN
IV 188,21; ~aṁ (bhattaṁ), Dhp-a II 3,16 (ɔ: half-boil-
ed); instr, m. & f., ~ena cammena, ~āya mattikāya,
DN II 332,26-27; loc. f. ~āya paṭhaviyā, AN I 32,13
foll.; V 212,32 foll.; n. pl. ~āni (cīvarāni), Vin I
109,3; 292,1; ~āni pi tiṇāni sukkhāni〈pi〉, MN III
167,22; ~āni gomayāni, AN V 263,17-18; ~ān' eva
na siyuṁ, Ja VI 209,23'; instr.pl. ~ehi pādehi, Vin
II 174,34; — ifc. v. an-°.

allaka, mfn. [sa. ārdraka] = alia; m. or n.,
Coriandrum sativum (— kotamburu, sn); Bhes 5, 29.

Allakappa, m. or n. Npr. of the country (and
town) of the Bulis; Allakappakā Bulayo ~e Bhagavato
sarīrānaṁ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṁsu, DN II 167,5 ;
cf. ib. 165,9-10; acc. ~aṁ, Sv(II) 613,27; — °ka, mfn.,
inhabiting A°, see prec. — °-tāpaso, m., designation
of an ascetic (formerly king of A°); Dhp-a I 165,16; —
°-raṭṭha, n., the country A°; Dhp-a I 161,9; 169,14
(v. l. for Ajita-°; cf. Addila-raṭṭha above); — °-(ka)-
rāja(n), m., the king of A°; ~ā nāma, Dhp-a I 161,9.

alla-kesa, mfn. [sa. ārdra + keça], with wet
hairs; m. ~o (alla-vattho+), Vin II 126,7; DN III
181,6; Dhp-a IV 220,5 foll.; acc. ~aṁ, DN II 345,1;
f. ~ā, Ud 91,16 foll; Ja III 425,17*; m. pl. ~ā, Ud
14,24 foll.; Ja I 100,6; — ifc. v. an-°.

alla-gatta, mfn. [sa. ārdra + gātra], with wet
limbs; ifc. v. an-°.

alla-gūtha, n. [sa. ārdra + gūtha], fresh ex-
crements; nom. ~aṁ, Ja II 211,7.

alla-gomaya, n. [sa. ārdra + gomaya], fresh
cow-dung; acc. ~aṁ (āmasati), Pj I 119,18 (among lucky
omens); instr, bhūmiṁ ~ena (upa)limpati or opuñjā-
peti[opuñch°]: Ja IV 48,21; VI 413,4; Ps III 18,7;
Dhp-a I 377,24; Ud-a 409,23; Mhv-ṭ 605,29.

alla-camma, n. [sa. ārdra + carman], the wet
skin; instr. ~ena pariyonaddho (scil. ayaṁ attabhāvo),
Ps II 88,21 (cf. Pj I 46,2-4); [Dhp-a IV 132,16 ~aṁ
viya, read with gp alāta-cammaṁ viya (q. v.)]; —
°-paṭicchanna, mfn. [sa. prati-cchanna], covered with
a°; m. ~o, Pj I 46,10* = Mil 74,15* — Vism 196,19*
(= alla-camma-pariyonaddho, mhṭ).

alla-cīvara, mfn. [sa. ārdra + cīvara], with wet
clothes; m. ~o, Ja VI 51,8*.

allatta, n. [sa. ārdratva], freshness, greenness;
āpo-dhātu sineheti ca ~añ ca anupāleti, Ps I 268,5;
~aṁ vā pallavita-haritabhāvo (scil. matassa ruk-
khassa) vā na bhaveyya, Mil 151,20.

alla-tiṇa, n. [sa. ārdra + tṛṇa], fresh grass; pl.
~āni [ā/a]gamma nibbāyati (scil. tejo-dhātu), Ps II 228,10
(ad MN I 188,19).

alla-dāru, n. [sa. ārdra + dāru], green wood;
pl. ~ūni bhañjitvā, Ja I 318,8; — °-rāsi, m., a heap
of a°; acc. ~iṁ, Mp I 37,2 ≠ Spk II 274,4-5.

alla-pāṇi, mfn. [sa. ārdra + pāṇi], with a wet
hand; instr. ~inā, Pv-a 116,20 foll.; — °-hata, mfn.,
ungrateful; Pv 257 (~o poso; query = the miserable
one with the wet hand (that obliterates debts of gratitude);
cf. (a)-makkhi(n)).

alla-piṇḍa-maṁsa, n. [sa. ārdra + piṇḍa +
māṁsa], a fresh lump of flesh; instr. ~ena hadaye
pahaṭā viya, Ja III 283,3.

alla-pimka, n. [sa. ārdra + *piṁka (only here)],
a fresh top-shoot; ~aṁ va chijjito, Ja III 389,17*
(= māluva-latāya(ṁ) agga-pavāḷaṁ, Ct.).

alla-maṁsa-pesi-vaṇṇa, mfn. [sa. ārdra-
māṁsa-peçi + varṇa], having the colour of a fresh
piece of flesh; acc. m. ~aṁ kumārakaṁ, Ja V 21,11.

alla-mattikā, f. [sa. ārdra + mṛttikā], moist
clay; — °-piṇḍa, m., a lump of a°; loc. ~amhi, Ps V
92,9, quoted Ss 32,33; — °-puñja, m., a heap of a°;
loc. ~e, MN III 94,31-33.

alla-madhu, n. [sa. ārdra + madhu], fresh
honey; acc. ~uṁ, Dhp-a II 196,2J. (opp. pakka-
madhu); — °-madhuka, n. id.; dat. °atthāya, ib.
II 197,2.

alla-manussa-camma-pariyonaddha, mfn.
[sa. ārdra + manuṣya-carman + pary-ava-naddha],
covered with fresh (live) human skin; n. ~aṁ (scil. idaṁ
sarīraṁ), Vism 195,5.

alla-mamsa-sarīra, mfn. [sa. ārdra + mārhsa
+ çarīra], having a body made up of flesh and blood;
m. pl. na hi ete kolāparukkhā na ca vammikā, ~ā
eva, Dhp-a II 51,4 = IV 166,14.

alla-marica-vaṭṭikā, f. [sa. ārdra-marica-var-
tikā], a green pepper-pod; — acc. ~aṁ, Mhv-ṭ 492,27
(= 'marica-vaṭṭikaṁ', Mhv XXV 114; cf. Marica-
vaṭṭi-vihāra).

alla-yūsa, m.n. [sa. ārdra-yūṣa(n)], fluid soup;
Ps II 227,21 (°-bhāva-lakkhaṇaṁ, scil. 'āpogataṁ';
= dravabhăva-lakkhaṇaṁ, pt).

alla-rasa, mfn. [sa. ārdra + rasa], of a fresh
taste; acc. n. ~aṁ (muddika-pānaṁ), Ja II 96,19 ( =
drava-rasaṁ, pt; = svarasa-vū, gp); Dhp-a II 155,9
(°-muddika-pānaka°; — ada-rasaætimidiya-panu, gp).

alla-rukkha, m. [sa. ārdra + vṛkṣa], a green
tree; acc. pl. udumbarâdayo ~e, Spk II 274,4 (quoted
Ss 54,4).

alla-rohita-maccha, m. [sa. ārdra + rohita-
matsya], a fresh rohita fish; acc. ~aṁ, Pj I 118,14 (as
a lucky omen); Ja III 333,16 (~aṁ khādituṁ icchāmi).

alla-vaṇa, mfn., with a new (bleeding) wound; m.
~o, Sp (V) 998,30; 999,5.

alla-vattha, mfn. [sa. ārdra + vastra], with wet
clothes; m. ~o alla-keso, Vin II 126,7, etc. see alla-kesa
above; Ja I 100,3 (alla-sïso +); pl. ~ā; ib. 102,21; Ap
46,15 (+ alla-sirā) = Th-a (Ce) 368,22*; — ifc. v. an-°.

[Allasanda, °-saṇḍa, w. r. for Alasanda, Nidd I
155,5; 415,11].

alla-sarīra, n. [sa. ārdra + çarīra], a newly dead
body; loc. abbhuṇhe ~e, Sp (II) 374,30 (= 'abhinne
sarīre'); loc.pl. ~esu, Dhp-a III 112,6.

alla-sasa-maṁsa, m. [sa. ārdra + çaça-
māṁsa], fresh hare flesh; acc. ~aṁ, As 103,8 = Ps I
203,33.

alla-sāṭaka, n. [sa. ārdra + çāṭaka], a piece of
wet cloth; acc. ~aṁ hadaye katvā, Vism 275,1.

alla-siṅgivera, m. [sa. ārdra + çṛṅgavera; cf.
adda-siṅgivera], green ginger; acc. ~aṁ, Ja III 225,23.

alla-sineha, m. [sa. ārdra + sneha], the white of
an egg; ~o, Sp I 137,31 — Spk II 329,4 = Mp ad
AN IV 126,27.

alla-sira, mfn. [sa. ārdra + çiras], with wet head
(hairs); pl. ~ā (alla-vatthā +), Ap 46,15 = Th-a (Ce)
368,22*.

alla-sīsa, mfn. [sa. ārdra + çīrṣan] = prec;
m. ~o, Ja I 100,3; pl. ~ā, ib. 102,21.

alla-sukkha-tiṇa, n. [sa. ārdra-çuṣka-tṛṇa],
grass green and dry; pl. ~āni khādanti, As 331,27
= Ps I 208,17 ≠ Spk II 24,5 (quoted Ss 145,32).

alla-hattha, m. [cf. sa. ārdra-hasta, mfn.], a wet
hand; acc. ~aṁ thapetvāna, Khuddas XXXIV 17
≠ Sp (IV) 758,1; instr. ~ena chupitvā, Sp (IV) 757,8;
gen. ~assa a-jjhāpanaṁ nāma, Ja VI 311,7' (cf. adda,
alla-pāṇi).

allāpa, m. (by-form of ālāpa [ts.], due to the cpd.
a°-sallāpa, cf. allīyati below), speaking to, addressing; (cf.
ālāpe sati vissāso hoti, Sv (II) 583,3, etc.); — °-sallāpa,
m. [sa. saṁlāpa], conversation; nom. n'atthi ~o, Ja VI
522,13*; ~o, Sv (II) 560,15, quoted Ss 12,8 (Sv-pṭ: ādito
... bhāsanaṁ 'ālāpo', kathana-paṭikathanaṁ 'sallāpo',
quoted Ss 12,30); acc. ~aṁ, Ja IV 240,30* (bālen' ~aṁ
na kare na ca rocaye); Ja IV 241,9* (dhīren' ~aṁ taṁ
kare tañ ca rocaye), quoted Pj I 127,24*—129,6*; Ja
VI 365,7 (~aṁ katvā); Dhp-a II 259,5 (~aṁ karoma);
instr, aññamaññaṁ ~vasena, Ud-a 232,11.
allāyate, v. l. for addāyate (q. v.), Ja IV 351,26*.

allâvalepana, mfn. = addâvalepana (q. v.); f.
~ā (kūṭâgāra-sālā), Nidd II 86,14 (= asukkha-matti-
kâdānā, Nidd-a; cf. SN IV 187,1 (Spk)).

alli, f., (a) name of certain tree; Mogg VII 198;
gen. ~iyā, Vin-vn 2744—46 (see alli-patta); — (b) the
dyeing stuff from the leaves of a°; acc. ~iṁ . . . vi-
vajjiya (so sn), Khuddas IV 2 (≠ allipattaṁ ṭhapet-
vā, Sp (V) 1126,14; = sihin-kasā-kola, sn); alli-ādi
rajanavatthuṁ, pt ad Sv (III) 924,6 (= 'rajanaṁ' [Ee
rajata-!]).

alli-patta, n., a leaf of alii (a); acc. ~aṁ, Sp (V)
1126,14.

allīna, mfn. (pp. of allīyati), adhering, attached to,
sticking to (acc, rarely loc); m. ~o (dukkhaṁ; +
upagato ajjhosito), MN I 233,9 (Ps); AN V 187,15;
Ud-a 347,12 (diṭṭhigate ~o); patiṭṭhito ~o (= 'ruciyā
niviṭṭho'), Nidd I 65,7 (Nidd-a); ~o (= 'taṁ nissito'),
Nidd I 75,6 (Nidd-a); loc. ~e, Vism 445,23 (attano
nissayaṁ ~e visaye); f. ~ā (udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇ-
ṭakaṁ), MN I 80,28 (Ps), cf. Saddh 102; n. kāyasmiih
~aṁ (cīvaraṁ), MN II 139,22 (Ps); m. pl. tapo-ji-
gucchaṁ (so BeSe) ~ā, DN III 40,24 — AN II 200,15 ;
~ā, Ud-a 333,30 (= 'samappitā'); 339,10; instr.pl.
~ehi, Ud-a 351,26; gen. pl. ~ānaṁ, Nidd-a (Ee) I
169,28 = Vism 612,14; f. pl. pāvaḷā (or pāvuḷā) su
nāma te pīṭhakasmiṁ ~ā (etc), DN III 19,5; — ifc.
v. an-°; (add As 127,20 ≠ Abhidh-av 19,22); —
°-tta, n. abstr.; abl. cittena ~ā, Ja IV 217,28'.

allīyati, pr. 3 sg. (ā + √lī; -ll- from (paṭi)sal-
līyati? cf. allāpa above), to stick to (acc or loc), to lean
against, to be attached to, to be fond of; Ja I 433,4 (kile-
sesu cittaṁ na ~ati); na ~ati, Ja III 65,22'(= 'na
upalippati') ≠ 367,22'; na ~ati, Nidd-a (Ee) I 172,19
(= 'an-upalitto'); ayaṁ pāpo madhura-kathāya na
~ati, Ja III 481,5; na ~ati, Ps III 437,27 (= 'na
lippati', Sn 625); vanati bhajati ~ati, As 364,20;
nâllīyati, Ja VI 347,15; kavātaṁ vā bhittiṁ vā ~ati,
Ja V 436,24; ~ati, Sp (IV) 756,12; 3 pl. ~anti, SN III
190,12 (Ee ālayanti; + kelāyanti †manāyanti (v.l. vanā-
yantia: dhanāyanti) mamāyanti); Ja IV 5,26'; Ud-a
302,14 (= 'appenti'); nâllīyanti (makkhikā), Saddh
529; ~anti (sajanti+), Pj II 373,31; [ālayanti, v.l.
ālīyanti, Ps II 174,30 ad MN I 167,32]; — part. neg.
an-allīyanto (kilesaratiṁ), Ja III 392,29; instr, kā-
mesu ~ena . . . cittena, Ja VI 45,25; part. neg. med.
an-allīyamānaṁ, Ps III 438,13 (= 'anokasāriṁ'); —
pot. 3 sg. ~etha kelāyetha dhanāyetha mamāyetha,
MN I 260,33; — aor. 3 pl. ~iṁsu (sīsaṁ), Ja I 64,33;
~iṁsu (ekâbaddhā), Ja I 347,32 ; — fut. 3 pl. ~issanti,
Vin I 137,12 (vassâvāsaṁ); — inf. ~ituṁ, Ja I 502,8;
V 154,24'; Nidd-a (Ee) I 169,27 = Vism 612,14; —
abs. ~itvā, Ja IV 376,7; Mil 405,14; neg. abs. an-°-itvā,
Ja IV 485,20; taṇhaṁ ~, Pj II 409,34 (= 'āsaṁ
anissāya', Sn 474).

allīyana, n. (verb, noun of allīyati), (close) contact;
Vism 217,8 (sacchikiriyā-vasena ~aṁ; = phusanaṁ,
mhṭ); Ud-a 72,5(kāmesu); Pay fol. ghī, 3 (paccekasid-
dhānaṁ bhāvānaṁ yattha upasileso ~aṁ atthi, so
opasilesiko [scil. okāso]) ≠ Sadd 710,3 (upagamo for
allīyanaṁ) from Rūp (Ce) 113,8-9.

allīyāpeti, pr. 3 sg. caus. of allīyati, to attach to,
to apply, sew on; abs. ~etvā, Sp (III) 684,20.

allôkāsa, m. (sa. ārdra + avakāça), a wet place;
acc. ~aṁ, Sp I 278,29; loc. ~e, Khuddas I 2 ≠ Vin-vn
6 (cf. Utt-vn 163) ≠ Vin-vn 1967.

Alāta, m. Npr. of one of the ministers of king
Aṁgati; Ja VI 221,3; 221,32* (senāpati rañño) foll.;
255,6* (= Devadatta in a former birth).

a-lāta, n. [ts. & ālāta], a fire-brand; Abh 36
(synon, ummuka); nom. ~aṁ, Mp III 66,17 (v. l. āl°);
acc. ~aṁ, Ja I 485,3; instr. ~ena, Ja I 485,5; nom.pl.
dve ~ā, Ps IV 14,17; acc.pl. ~āni, Ja I 68,26 (v. l.
āl°) = Ps II 182,24 = Mp I 402,23; loc.pl. ~esu,
MN II 225,18-20-22; Ps IV 14,25; — °-saṁkāra-
kūta-°, Dhp-a III 442,2; — ifc. v. uddhanâ° (Ps III
168,25), chavâ° (AN II 95,16 ≠ Ap 67,19), tindukâ°
(Pp 36,31).

alāta-khaṇda, n. (sa. alāta + khaṇḍa), a piece
of fire-brand; ~aṁ vā aṅgāra-piṇḍo vā, etc., Vism
172,1.

alātaggisikhā, f. (alātā + sa. agni-çikhā), the
flame of a fire-brand; Ps III 162,1 (~ā viya).

alāta-cakka, n. (sa. alāta + cakra), a wheel of
fire; Vism 633,4 (māyă-marīci-supinanta- + ~a°;
— maṇḍalâkārena āvijjhiyamānam alātaṁ, mhṭ).

alāta-camma, n. [cf. sa. carman], bellows for a
coal-fire, Dhp-a IV 132,16 (so gp: alăti samak, kum-
buru udunehi baňdu samak; Ee alla-cammaṁ).
alāpu, (m)n., v. l. for alābu (see next & lāpu),

alābu, (m)n. [sa. [ā/a]lāb[ū/u], f.], the bottle-gourd
(Cucurbita lagenaris); a calabash for oil, dadhi, etc.;
Abh 596 (here given as f.); Sadd 218,13 (n. = lābu,
q. v., cf. lāpu); Ja I 312,24 (ālābu-° (Se alābu-) +
kumbhaṇḍī-elāḷukâdīni); n. visapūraṁ viya ~u, Ja
III 85,19'; Bhes 5,121 (= labu-koḷa, sn, its leaves);
m. tittako ~u, Ps II 376,26 (= 'tittakâlābu'); instr.
~unā, Ap 389,11 (alābunôdakaṁ; lābunā, ib, 16); pl.
~ūni, Dhp 149 (alāpūn' eva, with p for b; see Fsb
Dhp (1855) p. 313 & Tr. Notes 62 n. ie); — ifc. v.
tittakâ° (MN I 80,22; 315,34 (Ps); Pv-a 47,2 [Ee tin-
takalābu]).

alābuka, n. — prec; nom. ~aṁ, Pj II 249,18
(dadhi-bharita-°); acc. ~aṁ, Ap 389,12; loc. ~e (tela-
bhājanesu visāne vā nāḷiyaṁ vā ~e vā), Sp (II)
293,13 ≠ Khuddas XXXV 18 (visāṇa-nāḷi-lābâdi-
ppabhede tela-bhājane [ɔ: (a)lābu; = tel-labu, sn],
used as an oil-vessel).

alābu-kaṭāha, n. [sa. alābu + kaṭāha], a bowl
made of a gourd; udake ~aṁ viya, As 405,29; —
°-saṇṭhāna, mfn. [sa. saṁsthāna], formed like that;
n. pl. ~āni (sibbetvā ṭhapita-jajjarâ°), Pj I 51,6.

alābu-lomasa, mfn. [alābu + sa. lomaça], hairy
like a°; pl. n. ~āni, MN II 7,17 (cīvarāni; v. l. alāpu-°;
Ps (do.)).

a-lābha, m. [ts.], no gain, want, lack, deficiency,
loss; nom. ~o (dhammena), Th 666; Vin IV 216,13
(yo etissā ~o, mayh' eso ~o); lābho ~o ayaso yaso
ca, Ja III 98,22* = AN IV 157,(i)-5* - 159,21* ≠

~ā, . . . dulladdhaṁ, Ud 84,29 (Ud-a); ~ā vata me,

223,7; SN I 185,12; 187,15; AN I 237,4 ≠ Vin III
19,13 (Sp) = MN I 186,31; tassa te . . . ~ā, tassa te

505,18), lābhâ° (Ap 47,23; 97,7; 421,27; Pj II 497,16).

a-lābhaka, n. (from prec), the (disappointment
caused by) not getting anything; instr. ~ena sussitvā
marissati, Vin III 77,14 (Sp); ~ena sussati, ib. 15;
~ena pi bhattaṁ na bhuñjati, AN IV 139,17 (v. l. āl°;
among the five bhattantarāyā); ~ena asantasanto, Pj
II 549,11.

a-lāmaka, mfn. (neg. of lāmaka, q. v.), not low,
not bad (sinful); n. ~aṁ, Spk II 314,24 (= 'apāpa-
kaṁ'); Nidd-a (Ee) I 193,34 (= 'anomam'); gen. ~assa,
Ja III 408,25' (= 'anomassa'); instr.pl. ~ehi, Ja VI
316,11'(= 'apāpakehi'); f. rūpena ~ikā, Thī-a 251,22
(= 'apāpikā'); — °-dassana, mfn., not looking un-
handsome; f. ~ā, Vv-a 103,23 (= 'anoma-dassikā').

a-lāyita, mfn. (neg. pp. of lāyati, √lū), not cut,
not reaped; Sv (III) 869,13 (so Se; Ee alāyikaṁ; pt:
alāyitan ti lāyita-ṭṭhānam pi tesaṁ kammappaccayā
~am eva hutvā anūnaṁ paripuṇṇam eva paññāyati;
na kevalaṁ paññāyanam eva, atha kho tathābhūtam
eva hutvā tiṭṭhati); cf. apadāna (DN III 88,17).

a-lālāmukha, mfn. [3a + sa. lālā + mukha],
(not drivelling) not childish, not babbling; m. ~o, Pj
II 124,10 (= 'aneḷa-mūgo'; = Nidd-a (Se) II 396,9,
reading a-lāla-mukho).

ali (or aḷi), m. [ts.], a (large black) bee; Abh 636;
Jināl 70 (ruditâḷi-pāḷi); — ifc. v. ka-moḷi-ali-sevitadevatā
(Sadd 239,10), chappadâ° (Ras 7,7*: °-nisevita).ali

bhaṇanto, Dhp-a); AN V 160,2 (~aṁ maṁ samma
avaca, tucchakaṁ m. s. a.); ib. 4 (do. na . . . avacaṁ);
Ja III 198,27* (~aṁ vata maṁ samma abhūtena
pasaṁsayi); 457,5* (~aṁ bhāsamānassa apakkamanti
[ ˇ - - - ˇ !] devatā; Ct.); IV 204,24* (~aṁ abhāṇīṁ);

1alika, n. [ts.], the forehead; MTD ≠ Am-k II 6,92.

alika-vadi(n), m(fn). [cf. sa. alīka + vādin],

~inaṁ, Dhp 223 (Dhp-a: ~ī saccavacanena jinitabbo)
= Ja II 4,17* (quoted Vv-a 69,26* ≠ Mil 117,13);

alika-vadi(n), m(fn). [cf. sa. alīka + vādin],

~inaṁ, Dhp 223 (Dhp-a: ~ī saccavacanena jinitabbo)

kiriyā-lakkhaṇam ākhyātikam ~aṁ, Sadd 27,30; —

do.); Nidd I 55,24 = 90,21 (~o + asaṁlitto anupa-
litto); acc. m. kalāpaṁ ~am upalimpati, It 68,6* (It-a

alinī, f. [a Sanskrit word], a female bee; Sadd

a-lippamāna, mfn. (part. med. of lippati), not

ṭhaṁ yadā cittaṁ ~aṁ bhavati 'nuddhataṁ, Nidd

245 (= jīvitavuttim anu ~ena, Dhp-a III 354,19);
instr, n. ~ena cittena alīnamanaso naro, Ja I 275,16*.

alīna-gattatā, f. (abstr.) [cf. sa. adīna-gātra],

13,16 ad Mhbv 1,4* (cf. Vyu 18,28).

alīna-citta, mfn., not faint-hearted; m. ~o, Sn
717; AN V 149,10; Ja V 491,25*; ~o akusīta-vutti,
Sn 68 (Nidd II 96,28); ~o (= 'an-olīno'), Cp-a ad

Ja IV 271,8*; gen. ~assa, ib. 4*.

alīnatā, f. abstr. from a-līna, q. v.; dhammânu-

Ct.); acc. ~aṁ, Mhv LXVII 8 (passâlīnatam etassa);

alīna-manasa, mfn. — prec; m. ~o naro, Ja I
275,16* (Ct.), quoted Sadd 123,22.

alīna-mana-samkappa, mfn. (alīna + sa. manas

Bv-a), quoted Ja I 22,19*.

alīna-vutti, mfn. [cf. sa. vṛtti], of spirited be-

[alībaddha, mfn., w. r. for ālibaddha, MN III

alu, [f. ts.], a small water pot; MTD (Am-k II

alutta-vibhattika, mfn. [sa. a-lupta + vibhakti

alutta-samāsa, m. [sa. a-lupta-samāsa], a cpd.

a-luddha, mfn. [sa. a-lubdha], not covetous; m.
