pl. ~ā (Bodhisatta), Vism 116,23 (= alubbhanâkārena
pavatta-ajjhāsayā, mhṭ); — °-maya, mfn., consisting
of a°; instr. ~ena (alaṁkārena), Ja VI 253,18'; —
°-nidāna, mfn., caused by a°; n. ~aṁ, AN I 135,20
= 263,28; pl. ~ā, ib. 203,18; — °-nissandatā, f.,
the being a result of a°, Vv-a 14,15; — °-niddesa,
m., exposition of a° (ɔ: Dhs 32); loc. ~e, As 149,33;
— °-pakata, mfn., performed under the influence of
(determined by) a°; n. ~aṁ, AN I 135,20 = 263,28;
— °-paccaya, mfn., conditioned by a°; m. pl. ~ā,
AN I 203,18-26; — °-samkhāta, mfn., named a°;
n. ~aṁ kusalamūlaṁ, As 150,5; — °-samudaya,
mfn., originating in a°; n. ~aṁ, AN I 135,21 =
263,29; m. pl. ~ā, ib. 203,18; — (alobh-)ussada,
mfn., abounding in a°; m. pl. ~ā, Vism 103,19 (from
the Ussadakittana).

a-loma, mfn. [sa. a-loman], hairless, not hairy; m.
siṅgī migo . . . aṭṭhi-ttaco vāri-sayo ~o (soil, kakka-
ṭako), Ja II 343,4* = III 295,18*; f. nâlomā nâtilo-
masā, Ja VI 457,2*.

a-lomahaṭṭha, mfn. [3a + sa. loman + hṛṣṭa],
with no bristling of the hair, i. e. fearless, (opp.
sa-l°, cf. vigata-lomahaṁsa); m. ~o, Ja VI 98,12*
(= nibbhayo a-haṭṭḥa-lomo, Ct.); acchambhi abhīto
~o, Ja VI 322,11* (= bhayena a-haṭṭha-lomo, Ct.).

Alomā, (v. l. Al°) f. Npr. of a woman; Vv-a 184,10
(ekā ~ā nāma duggatitthī); acc. ~aṁ sukhitaṁ disvā,
Vv 459 (Vv-a).

a-lola, mfn. [ts.], not greedy, not lustful; firm,
steady; m. rasesu gedhaṁ akaraṁ ~o, Sn 65 =
Ap 11,27 (= idam sāyissāmi, idaṁ sāyissāmī ti evaṁ
rasavisesesu anākulo, Pj II 118,9; Nidd-a); sīlavā ca
~o ca anuratto ca rājino, Ja VI 297,29* (= aluddho,
Ct.); ~o (saddho +), Mil 352,15; f. ~ā (gopī mama
assavā ~ā), Sn 22 (Pj).

a-lolakkhi, mfn. (a-lola + akkhi), not looking
(around) unsteadily; ~i(ṁ) mitabhāṇiṁ, Ap 497,20 =
Th-a (Ce) II 195,26* (query (metr.): *alolacakkhuṁ
mitabhāṇim?).

a-lola-jāti-ka (or °-jāti-ya), mfn. not of greedy
(lustful) nature; m. pl. ~ā, SN V 148,19.a-lola-jāti-ka

a-lola-jāti-ka (or °-jāti-ya), mfn. not of greedy
(lustful) nature; m. pl. ~ā, SN V 148,19.a-lola-jāti-ka

a-lolupa, mfn. [ts.], not greedy; m. appicch'
assa ~o, Sn 707 ≠ Ja IV 172,25*; often preceded by
appâhāra: Ap 351,26; acc. m. ~aṁ, Sn 165 = SN I
16,7* (= loluppa-virahitaṁ, Spk); m. pl. ~ā, Ap 18,3
(= Th-a Ce II 97,17*), quoted Mil 342,21*; cf. alo-
luppa.

a-loluppa, mfn. (3a + loluppa, sa. *laulupya),
free from greed; m. pl. ~ā, Ap 420,5 (so Ce), see
appakicca above; — °-cāratā, f., a not greedy way of
feeding; instr. ~āya hiyyo khādita-tthāne . . . otari,
Ja IV 278,27 (cf. Ja V 358,11-14).

a-lohita, mfn. [ts.], (a) not red; (b) bloodless;
f. ~ā, without (regular) menses (a term of abuse), Vin
III 129,24 (animittā + ; = sukkha-soṇitā, Sp).

a-lohitaka, mfn. = prec, (a); n. pl. ~āni (scil.
upadhānāni) pi dve vaṭṭanti yeva, Sv I 88,4.

ava, ind. [ts.; cf. avaṁ, avāka, Avīcī, oma below],
prefix to nouns and verbs, sometimes taking the place
of apa-° (q. v.): avāpurati (see Geiger §28,2: 39,6
[two labialsl] and cf. avattha, avâkaroti, avâgata),
before conss. alternating with o-° (which is more
common in concrete meanings; Kacc 50; Sadd 626,14):
avagaccḥati, ogacchati [the formula oñātaṁ avañā-
taṁ, Mil 191,24, is glossematical, like samatta samā-
dinna, SN I 228,14; in DN II 96,29 read oloketha ...
apaloketha with Vin I 232,13-14], o-° alternating with u-°
in uññāta [if not like ū-han-, ū-had-, ū-has- representing
ud-; otherwise Geiger § 28,1]; with rhythmic lengthening
in an-āvakūla; note besides tiṇ'-avatthāraka (see Sp
ad Vin II 87,12), a-ppati-'vekkhiya, Ja IV 4,27*; —
(a) with nouns: (a): Ava-kaṇṇaka, ava-kūla, ava-
kokila, o-gaṇa, o-patta, o-puppha (= galita-puppha,
pt ad Ja VI 497,28*), ava-maṅgala, o-matta (As
336,4); (β) iterative cpd. chiddâvachidda; — (b) with
verbs (and verbal nouns) in the senses: (a) down (see
o-gāhati, o-gilati (opp. ugg°, MN I 393,7), o-tarati,
o-patati, o-lambati; ukkaṁsâvakaṁsa, unnat'-onata);
(β) off (ava-hāra, o-mukka); (γ) connoting 'under-
standing' (avagacchati), or 'ascertaining' (ava-dhā-
reti), 'to be concerned with' (ava-carati), 'to under-
rate, despise' (ava-maññati); — meanings accord, to
Rūp Ce 85,30: (1) adhobhāva (avakkhitta-cakkhu),
(2) viyoga (omukka-upāhano, avakokilaṁ), (3) pari-
bhava (avajānanaṁ, avamaññati), (4) jānana (ava-
gacchati), (5) suddhi (vodānaṁ), (6) nicchaya (ava-
dhāraṇaṁ), (7) desa (avakāso), (8) theyya (avahāro)
≠ Sadd 882,15-19 ≠ Pay fol. gūv. 6; Ahh 1173 (adding:
īsadattha, vyāpana, hāni, vacokriyā, ñāṇappatti);
— ava is preceded by other prpp.: adhi (see ajjh°),
paṭi (see pace°), pari, vi (see vïvadāta, vodāta), sam.

avaṁ, ind. [sa. avāk], downwards (alternating
with ava in ava(ṁ)-sira(s), q. v.); ~ gacchantī ti ava-
dāniyā, Nidd I (36,29) 37,3-6 (= apāyaṁ, Nidd-a);
avaṁ sari (or avamsari), Sn 685 (= otari, Pj); avaṁ
hari, see avaṁharati; avaṅ hoti (Pay fol. kā 5; JPTS
1908, 135,5) transcribes sa. avāṅ (nom. sg. m.).

a-vaṁka, mfn. (3a + vaṁka; cf. sa. vakra;
Sadd 323,4 foll.), (a) not crooked (twisted); (b) (metaph.)
straightforward, sincere, honest; — m., mutto visallo
amamo ~o, Pv 541 (Pv-a; b); ujū ~o asaṭho amāyo,
Vv 996 (Vv-a; b); ajjava-sampanno ujujātiko ~o
akuṭilo, Mp II 347,2 (b); f. & nom.pl. ~ā adosā
akasāvā, AN I 112,21 (scil. nemī, arā and nābhi; a);
f. uju ~ā akuṭilā ajimhā, Vism 219,1 (scil. sammā-pa-
ṭipadā; mhṭ: gomutta-vaihkâbhāvena [cf. As 151,19];
a—b); gen. ajimhassa ~assa, etc, Mil 105,28 (scil. nā-
rācassa; a); — °-tā, f. abstr., Dhs 50 (As 151,20: can-
dalekhā-vaṁkabhāva-paṭikkhepo); 51; 1339; — °-tta,
n. abstr., AN I 112,22-24.

avaṁ-sira(s), mfn. [sa. avāk-çiras; synon, ava-
sira(s), Sadd 102,30; Mogg I 38], having the head
downwards (see adho-sira(s)); nom. m. patāmi . . .
uddha-pādo ~o, Ja I 233,9*; ~o uddha-pādo, Ja IV
103,7* (cf. ib. 18*) ≠ V 143,28*; ~o olambanto, Dhp-a
IV 153,2; acc. f. ~aṁ, Vv 613; nom.pl. patanti
nirayaṁ ~ā, Sn 248; visame magge papatanti ~ā,
SN I 48,25* (Spk); [interpolated (see Ee) in Ja VI
108,28*,34* ≠ 115,2*,8*,14*]; Pv 554; ~ā olambanti,
Spk II 290,14 = Vibh-a 4,20 (cf. Sv (II) 433,34); Dhp-a
I 436,13; 438,7.avaṁ-siras

avaṁ-sira(s), mfn. [sa. avāk-çiras; synon, ava-
sira(s), Sadd 102,30; Mogg I 38], having the head
downwards (see adho-sira(s)); nom. m. patāmi . . .
uddha-pādo ~o, Ja I 233,9*; ~o uddha-pādo, Ja IV
103,7* (cf. ib. 18*) ≠ V 143,28*; ~o olambanto, Dhp-a
IV 153,2; acc. f. ~aṁ, Vv 613; nom.pl. patanti
nirayaṁ ~ā, Sn 248; visame magge papatanti ~ā,
SN I 48,25* (Spk); [interpolated (see Ee) in Ja VI
108,28*,34* ≠ 115,2*,8*,14*]; Pv 554; ~ā olambanti,
Spk II 290,14 = Vibh-a 4,20 (cf. Sv (II) 433,34); Dhp-a
I 436,13; 438,7.avaṁ-siras

avaṁ-harati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. avāk + harati], to
drag down; aor. 3 sg. mā taṁ kāmarajo ~hari (so
C-mss; Ed. avāhari), SN I 197,18* (= apāyaṁ mā
pātetū ti attho, Spk).

ava-kaṁkhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. avakāṅkṣate, cf.
Sadd 330,4-12], to long for; 2 sg. nâvakaṁkhasi jīvi-
taṁ, Ja IV 371,21* (= attano jīvitaṁ na kaṁkhasi,
ib. 373,2'); 1 sg. nâvakaṁkhāmi (do.), Ja V 340,3* ≠
348,18*-20* (~anti) = 377,26*-28*; do. jīvituṁ, MN
III 264,10 (Ee °taṁ) = SN IV 57,6; 3 pl. nâvakaṁ-
khanti jīvitaṁ, SN I 121,24* (quoted Dhp-a I 432,9*).

ava-kaṁsa, m. (verb, noun of *ava-kaṁsati, cf.
ukkaṁsati and avakaḍḍhati), a low degree, minimum
(opp. ukkaṁsa); abl. ~ato, Vism 563,5* foll. ('at least')
= Vibh-a 174,19* foll. ≠ Abhidh-av 78,9*; gen. ~assa,
Abhidh-av 78,10*; — cf. hetthima-pariccheda; —
ifc. v. ukkaṁsâ° (DN I 54,18 (Sv) = MN I 518,12
(Ps) - SN III 212,10; Vism 563,10).

ava-kaḍḍhati, pr. 3sg. [replacing sa. avakarṣati;
cf. oka(s)sati], (1) trans. = to remove, v. l. for apa-
kaḍḍhati (q. v.) and apa-kassati (q. v.); — (2) intrans.
(pass. ?) to sink, be dragged down; hadayaṁ me ~ati,
Ja IV 415,18*-22*(= galati, sokenaavakaḍḍhīyati; v. l.
avakassati) = 416,13*-17*; — pass, avakaḍḍhīyati,
caus.(?) avakaḍḍheti, q. v.

ava-kaḍḍhana, n. (from prec), reducing, dis-
carding; — ifc. v. chandarāgâ° (instr. ~ena, Spk II
110,9; = chanda-rāgassa pajahanena, pt; see apa-
kaḍḍhana).

(ava-kaḍḍheti, pr. 3 sg., caus.-form, but act.
meaning), to 'bring down', to extract or quote (from a
text); abs. hetum ~ayitvā, Nett 4,13* ( = hetuṁ ākaḍ-
ḍhitvā, Suttato niddhāretvā, Nett-a).

ava-kaṇṇaka, mfn. [ava + sa. karṇa + ka],
earless (with cropped ears), as a slave-name: hīnaṁ
nāmaṁ Avakaṇṇakaṁ (gender attr.) Javakaṇṇakaṁ,
Vin IV 6,14' (~âdi dāsānaṁ nāmaṁ hoti, Sp; ~an ti
chinnakaṇṇaka-nāmaṁ, Vjb); nom. ~o, ib. 8,5; acc.
~aṁ, ib. 8,4; pl. ~ā, ib. 10,1.

2[avakanta, w. r. for aya-kanta, Spk II 376,9-12
= Ps (Ee) V 87,15-18 ad MN III 267,4, see ayakanta-
pāsāṇa].

1ava-kanta, mfn. (pp. of ava-kantati; sa.
avakṛtta), cut off; n. ten' eva tassā galakâvakantaṁ,
Ja IV 251,25* (o: galakaṁ av°).

ava-kantati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-kṛntati, √kṛt; cf.
Sadd 362,23-25], to cut off (piecemeal); 3 pl. ~anti,
Pv-a 213,23 (= 'okantanti'); impers. 2 pl., puthuso
maṁ vi-kantetvā khaṇḍaso ~atha, Ja IV 155,27*
(Ct.); part. m. pl. ~antā, Ja IV 156,7'; pp. avakanta,
avakantita, qq. v.

ava-kappana, n., the being fit or possible (?),
sense of √kap, Sadd II 1535 (p. 553,15) and √bhū, ib.
II 1556 (p. 555,29), w. rr. avakampane [sa. Dhātup:
avakalkane], cf. okappati.

ava-kappanā, f. [verb, noun, cf. sa. avakal-
payati], (a mode of) bridling a horse; instr, assaṁ,
yathā ākaḍḍhito suṭṭhutaraṁ palāyati, evaṁ ~āya
kappetvā (paron.), Ja VI 408,27; ~āya kappita-asso,
ib. 30.

ava-kassati (or °-kasati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-
karṣati, or -kṛṣati; cf. ava-kaḍḍhati], v. l. for apa-kas-
sati (q. v.); abs. ava-kasitvā explaining 'okkassa' (see
ok(k)assati), Sv (II) 520,9 = Mp (Se) III 188,4 ad
AN IV 16,26.ava-kassati

ava-kassati (or °-kasati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-
karṣati, or -kṛṣati; cf. ava-kaḍḍhati], v. l. for apa-kas-
sati (q. v.); abs. ava-kasitvā explaining 'okkassa' (see
ok(k)assati), Sv (II) 520,9 = Mp (Se) III 188,4 ad
AN IV 16,26.ava-kassati

ava-kkanta, mfn. (pp. of ava-kkamati) =
okkanta; — ifc. v. an-°, dukkhâ° (SN II 173,26 ( =
dukkhena okkantā otinnā, Spk) ≠ III 69,15),
sukhâ° (ib.).

ava-kkanti, f. [sa. avakrānti; see ava-kkamati]
= okkanti (cf. avakkama), (a) entering in a way or
course (niyāma), (b) entering in a womb (gabbha), (c)
rebirth, (d) materialization, realization; nom. ariya-
dhammassa ~i, Pp 13,1 (d; — nibbatti pātubhāvo,
Pp-a); nāmarūpassa ~i, SN II 66,12 foll. (c —d); 90,28
—91,31 (do. + viññāṇassa); 101,13 foll. (do. do.;
discussed Kv 142,32—143,29); SN III 46,23 (c—d;
pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ; = nibbatti, Spk); gabbhassa
~i, MN I 266,1 foll. (d; Ps II 310,7-28; quoted Mil
123,9); II 156,29—157,3; Mil 125,11-22; — ifc. v.
gabbhâ° (b; DN III 103,4-19; 231,1-15; Mil (123,9)
127,29—129,25; Ja V 331,18'), niyāmâ° (a; Nidd I
314,4), suññatâ° (d; MN III 105,3—109,1; - suñ-
ñatā-nibbatti, Ps).

ava-kkama, m. = avakkanti (c—d); utu-sinā-
tāya hoti gabbhass' avakkamo, Ja V 330,3* ( =
gabbhâvakka[ma]nti, Ct.).

ava-kkamati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. avakrāmati, √kram]
= okkamati (q. v.), cf. ava-kkanti; aor. 1 sg. (tuyha
naṅguṭṭhaṁ) katham kho 'haṁ ~miṁ, Ja III 480,20*
(to tread on); abs. naṅguṭṭhaṁ me avakkamma, ib.
12* (= mama naṅguṭṭha-maṇḍalaṁ akkamitvā, Ct.).

ava-kkamana, n. = okkamana (q. v.), cf.
okkanti (c—d); gabbhassâvakkamanaṁ Mil 125,14;
— ifc. v. gabbhâ° (Mil 125,25).

(avakk[ā/a]ri, ind., apart; assumed by Vibh-mṭ ad
Vibh-a 515,1: avakkarī (so Be) ti nipāto nānā-bhāve
vattatī ti a-nānā-karaṇam an-avakkari, taṁ katvā;
avakkāriṁ vā akatvā 'anavakkāriṁ katvā' ti evaih
dassento āha: 'avinibbhogaṁ katvā' ti; 'anavakāriṁ
karitvā' ti vā pāṭho, tattha avakiraṇaṁ vikkhe-
panaṁ samūhassa ekadesānaṁ vinibbhujanaṁ 'ava-
kāri', etc.; see an-avakāra).(avakkāri

ava-kkāra, m. [sa. ava-kara and avaskara, √kṙ;
see ukkāra (metr. ukkăra, Vism 196,17*)], leavings
from a meal; — °-pātī, f., a (liddedl) recipient for
that; acc. ~iṁ upaṭṭhāpeti, MN I 207,14 (= atireka-
piṇḍapātaṁ apanetvā ṭhapanatthāya ekaṁ samugga-
pātiṁ dhovitvā ṭhapeti, Ps; pṭ: samuggapātin ti
samugga-puṭa-sadisaṁ pātiṁ); do. paṭisāmeti, ib.
207,19 ≠ III 157,7-11; Vin I 157,14-19 ( = atireka-
piṇḍapāta-ṭṭhapanakaṁ ekaṁ bhājanaṁ, Vmv; Sp-ṭ
= Ps); 352,6-11; ~iṁ dhovitvā upaṭṭhāpetabbaṁ
. . . dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṁ, Vin II 216,21-27; loc.
bhikkhūnaṁ ~iyaṁ (so gp; Ee °pātiye) bhuttâvase-
sakaṁ bhattaṁ hoti, Dhp-a I 305,16 (= vakāra-
pāhi, gp).

(avakk[ā/a]ri, ind., apart; assumed by Vibh-mṭ ad
Vibh-a 515,1: avakkarī (so Be) ti nipāto nānā-bhāve
vattatī ti a-nānā-karaṇam an-avakkari, taṁ katvā;
avakkāriṁ vā akatvā 'anavakkāriṁ katvā' ti evaih
dassento āha: 'avinibbhogaṁ katvā' ti; 'anavakāriṁ
karitvā' ti vā pāṭho, tattha avakiraṇaṁ vikkhe-
panaṁ samūhassa ekadesānaṁ vinibbhujanaṁ 'ava-
kāri', etc.; see an-avakāra).(avakkāri

ava-kkhalita, n. [subst, pp. of ava + sa.
√skhal, cf. Sadd 436,23], mistake, offence; ~am vi-
pphanditaṁ vā, Ud-a 398,7 (= 'calitaṁ'); vālagga-
mattam pi ~aṁ, Sv I 66,23 = Ps I 50,23 = Mp I
110,4 ≠ Spk I 185,11 (rathareṇu-mattaṁ) ≠ Ps III
372,25 (aṇu-mattaṁ).

ava-kkhitta, mfn. [sa. avakṣipta, √kṣip, cf.
Sadd 404,9] i. q. okkhitta, cast downwards, etc.; nom.
m. ayaṁ kayo ujjhito ~o seti, MN I 296,10 (Ps II
351,10: chaḍḍito, quoting apaviddho from SN III
143,5*); in cpd.: ~ -mattikā-piṇdo viya, Sv I 289,11
≠ Pv-a 174,5; — ifc. v. an-°, sedâ° (AN II 67,27
(Mp III 99,4) — III 45,10 ≠ IV 95,13; cf. sveda-
malâvakṣipta, Vyu 245,649).

avakkhitta-cakkhu, mfn. — okkhitta-cakkhu;
Rūp Ce 85,30 = Sadd 882,15 = Pay fol. gū v. 6.

avakkhitta-seda, mfn., whereby sweat has been
shed, won by sweat (exertion); intr. pl. ~ehi, Mp III 99,4
(= 'sedâvakkhittehi', AN II 67,27 foll.; see above).

(ava-kkhipati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √kṣip;
see avekkhipantī, Ja IV 251,24*; vavakkhitvāna, DN
II 262,8*], to cast down, fling away (as for apa-°); aor.
3 sg. ~pi, Sv I 268,14 (mahā-vāte bhusaṁ punanto
viya dūram eva ~ [cf. sa. dūrâpāsta?]); cf. okkhipi,
AN IV 264,3; okkhipiṁ, ib. 265,10; pot. okkhipe, Th
209).

ava-kkhipana, n., verb, noun from prec; instr.
adho ~ena, Ja I 163,24' (opp. uddhaṁ ukkhipanena).

ava-kāra, m. (verb, noun of ava-kirati, q. v.);
— ifc. v. an°, see okāra.

avakārakaṁ, ind. (from ava-kirati (a)), scat-
tering about; — ifc. v. na sitthâvakārakaṁ
bhuñjissāmi, Vin IV 196,31** (— sitthāni avakiritvā
avakiritvā, Sp; cf. sittha-prthak-kārakam, Vyu 263,59)
≠ II 214,23.

ava-kāsa, m. [sa. ava-kāça] = okāsa (q. v.);
Sadd 882,17; — ifc. v. a-kkhuddâ°, an-°, ariyâ°,
katâ° (mfn. DN II 39,25 = MN I 169,28 = Vin I 7,8;
MN II 143,14* ≠ Sn 1030; AN III 40,21* = Vv 212;
Mil 95,8), sarīrâ° (m., Ja VI 357,19*), seyyâ° (m.,
Mil 94,6), hatâ° (mfn., Dhp 97).

ava-kirati, pr. 3 sg. [ts.; √kṛ] = okirati (q. v.),
(a) to scatter about, (b) to bestrew, (c) to discard, (d) to
throw away; ~ati, Kacc-v 79; aor. 2 sg. avâkiri, Vv
283 (d; — chaḍḍesi, Vv-a) = 543; 1 sg. avakiri(m),
Pv-a 86,25 (b; = "samokiriṁ"); — abs. (a ) Vacchaṁ
avakiriya, Ja V 143,19* ([ ˇ ˇ - ˇ ]; b; = avakiritvā
[this from pt], nuṭṭhubhana-dantakaṭṭhapātanena
tassa sarīre kaliṁ pavāhetvā [cf. Ps III 61,15], Ct.)
≠ 267,7* [ ˇ ˇ - ɔ; okiriya]; — (β) avakiritvā, Sp
(IV) 893,27 (a; see avakārakaṁ); cf. an-avakārakaṁ
(c) and see apakirati.

ava-kiriyati, pr. 3 sg. pass, of prec, (d); pahūtaṁ
annapānaṁ hi (or pi) api (s)su ~ati [ ˇ ˇ - ˇ ≃ ], Pv
388 (Ee avakirīyati unmetr.; — avakirīyati chaḍ-
dīyati, Pv-a).

ava-kujja, mfn. [Buddh.sa. avakubja(ka), cf.
ukkujja, ni(k)kujja, Buddh.sa. nikubja; see Sadd
349,23-28 ; cf. further sa. nyubja and kubja), falling or
lying with the face downwards: m. nom. tatth' eva ~o
papatāmi, MN I 80,29 (Ps; cf. Mvu II 130,1) = 81,26
= 246,8 = (II 93,20 = 212,6); ~o nipajj' aham,
Bv II 52 (= adhomukho hutvā, Bv-a), quoted Ja I
13,28*, Sadd 349,25; f. ~ā nipajj' ahaṁ, Ap 514,21
= Thī-a 9,10*; acc. m. imaṁ purisaṁ ~aṁ nipātetha,
DN II 336,13 (opp. uttānaṁ); instr. ~ena [Ee w. r.
~e] phaṇena, Vism 399,20 (= nikujjitena, mhṭ),
quoted Ss 215,15 (Ce āvajjena); pl. ~ā patāmase,
Pv 781 (= kadāci ~ā hutvā patāma, Pv-a); gen. pl.
~ānaṁ sattānaṁ uttānamukha-bhāvassa pubbani-
mittaṁ, Mp III 320,14, quoted Ss 65,18; — — °ka,
mfn., id. — ifc. ukkujja-m-avakujjakam (ind. vicini
saṁkhāre, Bv X 4 (= saṁkhārānaṁ udaya-vyayaṁ
vicini, Bv-a)).

ava-kujjati, pr. 3 sg. denom. — ava-kujjeti;
part. nom. sg. ~anto, Mp II 345,1 (bhatta-pātiṁ ~
viya).

avakujja-nipanna, mfn., lying with the face
downwards; m. ~o, Nidd I 381,17 (scil. supinaṁ pas-
sati; = adhomukho hutvā nipanno, Nidd-a).

avakujja-pañña, mfn. [cf. sa. prajñā], one whose
intellect is stooping (like a stooping pitcher) ɔ: unable
to learn or to remember; m. ~o puggalo, Pp 31,14-26
(opp. ucchaṅga-p°, puthu-p°; Pp-a 213,19—214,17)
≠ AN I 130,(7),9-24 (Mp II 201,12); 131,20*; acc.
~aṁ, Spk I 215,3 (= 'nivutaṁ' or 'nidhutaṁ'?).

ava-kujjeti, pr. 3 sg. denom., to turn over, to
upset; Sadd 349,25; cf. ava-kujjati.

ava-kuṭṭha, mfn. [sa. avakruṣṭa, √kruç], filled
with the sound of (instr.); nom. n. ~aṁ kokilāya (scil.
vanaṁ), Mogg III 15 (= 'ava-kokilaṁ', q. v.; Pay),
from Mahābhāṣya ad Pāṇ II 2,18, vārt. 7.

ava-kūla, mfn., with steep banks; f. na ~ā,
Ja V 169,1' ( = 'an-āvakūlā'); — ifc. v. an-āvakūla.

ava-kokila, mfn. [ts.], accord, to Rūp Ce 85,31
— Sadd 882,16 'abandoned by the koïl', while Mogg
(see under avakuṭṭha) follows Patañjali [Pay, how-
ever: avakuṭṭhaṁ = pariccattam!].

ava-khaṇḍana, n. [ts.; Sadd 533,15], cutting off
(reaping), from sa. Dhātup 26,37 ɔ: the sense of √do
(dyati, dāna); Sadd 480,13 (cf. 367,30; 398,4); accord-
ingly Pali-Ct.s explain sapadānaṁ, ind. (q. v.;
Buddh.-sa. sâvadānam ["as one goes mowing"} as
sa-apa-dānaṁ, 'with absence of interruption', Vism
60,19-24 (mht); Kkh and Sp ad Vin IV 191,28** (Sp-ṭ,
Kkh-ṭ); Spk I 205,27; Pj II 118,18; — °-virahita,
mfn., without interruption, Vism 60,21 (= 'apa-dāna',
mfn.).

ava-gacchati, pr. 3 sg. [ts.; cf. ogacchati], to under-
stand; ~atï ti jānāti, Sadd 462,23; Sadd 882,19 —
Payfol. gūf. 7 (from Rūp Ce 85,32); 2 sg. vilomato
mam tvaṁ ~asi, Pv-a 87,24 (= 'vāmato . . . pac-
cesi', you have a wrong (unfavorable) opinion of me);
[aor. 3 sg. ~añchi, Dhp-a II 1,15, w. r. in Ck for apa-
gañchi]; grd. ava-gantabba, Sadd 48,33*; pp. ava-
gata; pass, ava-gamyate (q. v.).

ava-gaṇḍa-kārakaṁ, ind., so as to fill the
cheeks (with food); na ~ bhuñjissāmi, Vin IV 196,11**
(= makkaṭo viya gaṇḍe katvā katvā, Sp, Kkh;
cf. Vyu 263,(60)61) ≠ II 214,22; ~ bhuñjanto viya
kapol'-antare ṭhapeti, Spk I 109,8.

ava-gata, mfn., pp. of ava-gacchati; (a) under-
stood; Abh 757; m. ~o, Pv-a 222,14 (v. l. adhigato as
good; = 'aññāto', cf. Pj II 490,30: viditam); — (b) in
an active sense: having understood, in Ct.s (referring
to non-Pāli idiom: yathā loke avagantā ~o ti vuccati,
Pj I 15,11); Sv I 67,26-27 = Ps I 51,27-29 = Mp I
111,18-20 ≠ Ud-a 132,15; — ifc. v. dasanâ° (Jināl
109).

ava-ganta(r), m. (nomen agentis of ava-gacchati),
one who understands; nom. ~ā, Pj I 15,10 (= 'ava-
gato', q. v.).ava-gantar

ava-ganta(r), m. (nomen agentis of ava-gacchati),
one who understands; nom. ~ā, Pj I 15,10 (= 'ava-
gato', q. v.).ava-gantar

ava-gama, m. [ts.], understanding; m. ~o, Sadd
465,1; — ifc. v. an-°, paccaya-khayâ° (Ud-a 50,16).

ava-gamana, n. [ts.] = prec; sense of √budh,
Dhātup 414; Dhātum 652; Sadd 481,25; — avagama-
naṭṭhena, Ps I 101,26.

a-vagga-vāsa, mfn. [sa. a + vyagra-vāsa],
living without discord; m. pl. ~ā, Ja IV 77,24' (so Cks;
= 'samaggā').

ava-ggaha, m. [sa. avagraha, see Pāṇ III 3,51],
drought; ~o, Sv I 95,17 (+ vassa-vibandho; = 'dub-
buṭṭhikā').

ava-gāhati, pr. 3 sg., in canonical texts and Ct.s
always o-gāhati (q. v.) [sa. ava + √g[ā/a]h, gāhate], to
dive into, penetrate; ~ati, Saddh 383; 3 pl. nâvagā-
hanti, Saddh 370; inf. ~ituṁ, Saddh 37; 327.

ava-gāhana, n-. (from prec), sense of √pīḷ, Sadd
569,11 (see note ib.); — ifc v. sukhâ° (suttassa,
Spk II 3,13). — See also o-g[ā/a]hana (Sn 214; Pj II
434,25) and Nett-a ad Nett 15,18; 28,13 ɔ*. v.
a-pilāpana).

2avaca, mfn. (abstracted from uccâvaca), low,
inferior; f. sg. ~ā, Pj II 497,28-30 (scil. paṭipadā) ≠
Kv-a 38,17-22; f. pl. khaṇe khaṇe uppajjamānā cetanā
uccā pi ~ā pi uppajjanti, Ja VI 304,30'; n., paṇītaṁ
uccaṁ vuccati, hīnaṁ ~aṁ, Spk I 125,6; — °-kam-
ma, n., a minor duty; ~aṁ, Ps II 402,26-29 (ucca-
kammaṁ +; = 'uccâvacāni kiṁkaranīyāni') ≠ Sv
(III)1047,12 = Mp ad AN V 24,11.

1a-vacana, n. (neg. verb, noun of √vac), non-
saying; tathā ~aṁ, Ja I 410,15 (not to say so); ~aṁ
yeva yuttataraṁ, Sadd 161,9; evaṁ ~ena, ib. 592,8
(because it has not been said so); ~e kāraṇaṁ atthi,
Sadd 135,18; 150,10; 290,15; — in cpd. avacana-
kāraṇaṁ, Ja III 309,6 (why she did not speak to him).

2a-vacana, mfn., speechless, dumb; loc. ~e, Sadd
405,23 (scil. pabbata-kūṭe).

a-vacana-kara, mfn. (3a + vacana(ṁ)kara), not
obedient; pl. ~ā, Nidd I 37,22 (an-assavā + ; Nidd-a:
suṇamānā pi vacanaṁ na karonti) = II 195,10.

a-vacanīya, mfn. (neg. grd. of √vac), (a) inex-
pressible, see abstr.; (b) inaccessible to admonitions;
acc. attānaṁ ~aṁ karissati, Vin III 177,29-34;
178,27'—179,11'; Ja III 483,17; — °-tta, n. abstr.,
Sadd 126,9 (ākhyātena ~ttā, because it can not be
expressed by a verb form).

ava-cara, m. [ts.; from ava + √car; cf. gocara],
sphere of action or movement, department, resort; —
ifc.; in bahuvrihi-cpd.s: moving in, active within the
sphere of, concerned with, conversant with [for tradi-
tional exegesis [as an upapada-cpd.] see ava-carati]:
ifc. v. atakkâ°, adaṇḍâ°, antepurâ°, ambarâ°,
a-parisâ°, arūpâ°, asatthâ° (SN I 224,11), icchâ°
([prob. m.\ MN I 27,9; 30,16; Pj II 478,10), etthâ°
(Dhs 1280; As 387,23), kāmâ° (m. Ja VI 99,7;
mfn. Dhsl (As 61,33 foll. ≠ Abhidh-av 3,7* foll);
Vism 452,30—453,22; °-aka, m. Ja VI 99,14'; °-ika,
mfn., Anāgll 2; Saddh 254; °-javana, n., Vibh-a
154,20; °-deva(loka), Vibh-a 167,2; °-dhamma, Vibh-a
154,22; °-vipāka, ib. 179,4), tāḷâ° (m(fn.) Ja I 60,17;
n. DN II 159,16), parisâ° (AN IV 314,17), yena-
kāmâ° (Ja V 425,17** cf. Ct. 432,13'; sic Cks: better
Ee; yena-kāmaṁ-carā), yogâ° (Mil 33,7; Vism 245,30;
Vibh-a 115,22; pubba-°, Pj II 47,9-10), rūpâ° &
rūpârūpâ° (see arūpâvacara), samgāṁâ° (Ja II
95,3*), sadaṇḍâ° (SN I 224,8), santikâ° (DN I 206,2),
(sa)satthâ° (SN I 224,8; As 62,10 ≠ Abhidh-av
3,8*), sāsanâ° (Sadd 74,27*; 131,5; cf. sāsanâvaca-
rika, Spk II 310,8).

ava-caraka or o-caraka, m(fn)., [see avaca-
rati, and cf. sa. avacārayati, anv-ava-har°, ny-ava-
car° abhyavacara], being active (within a country,
etc.) in an obtrusive or secret way, viz. as a robber
(a; cora+) or as a spy (b; ɔ: cara-purisa]; m. ~o,
Vin III 47,32—52,36' (b; bhaṇḍaṁ ocaritvā ācikkha-
ti, itthannāmaṁ bhaṇdaṁ avaharā ti; Sp(II) 365,14);
m. pl. corā ocarakā, MN I 129,15 = 186,12 (a; Ps II
102,5: avacarakā heṭṭhā-carakā, nīcakamma-kārakā ti
attho); do. Ud 66,5 (= heṭṭhā-carakā . . . nihīna-
kammattā [for kammantattā? cf. ib. 20-21], athavā
'ocarakā' ti cara-purisā, Ud-a 333,21 foll.) — SN I
79,8 (v. l. carā ocarakā; Spk I 150,17: heṭṭhā-carakā,
corā hi pabbatamatthakena carantā pi heṭṭhā-carakā
va honti); — ava-caraka-manussa, m., id.( b); acc.
pl. ~e, Th-a in Th Trsl. 189 n.8 - Th-a (C) 403,19
(ocarake manusse).ava-caraka

ava-caraṇa, n. (verb, noun of next); abl. saṅgāme
~ato 'saṅgāmâvacaro', As 62,18.

ava-carati or o-carati, pr. 3 sg. [ava + √car;
Sadd 423,13], (a) [cf. Ct.s on avacara, q. v.] to be found
or to be active within a definite sphere, to be conversant
with; MN I 502,23 (evaṁ hi no sutte ocarati; = āgac-
chati, Ps); As 62,5-18 ≠ Abhidh-av 3,4*,7*,n*; 3 pl.
~anti, As 62,9 (cf. Nidd-a I 17,1-2; 168,27); part. n.
~antaṁ, As 62,23; loc. pl. ~antesu, As 62,10; grd.
~itabba, mfn., Sv I 99,19 (explaining 'atakkâvacara');
(II)464,10; Ps II 174,27 (= ogāhitabba); Ja IV 360,6'
(explaining 'adaṇḍâvacara'); — (b) the same, said
of a secret or unavowable activity: to transgress; aor.
3 sg. avācari. Ja V 444,5* = 27* (Ct.: anācāraṁ cari;
Se accācarī, Tr. apācarī); — (c) to be active as an
ocaraka (b) s. v. avacaraka) to investigate; abs. ocarit-
vā, SN I 79,9 (= avacaritvā vīmaṁsitvā, Spk); Ud
66,6 (= do. Ud-a).ava-carati

ava-cchādana, n. (verb, noun of ava + chādeti;
Sadd 542,14), covering, making disappear; Ps I 106,27
(tad- [ɔ: paraguṇa-] avacchādana-paccupaṭṭhāno, scil.
'makkho').

ava-cchita, mfn. [ts.; pp. of √cho] = ava-cchāta,
cut off; Sadd 479,1.

ava-cchidda, mfn. [ava + sa. chidra], torn
asunder; only in the iterative cpd. chiddâvacchidda,
mfn., Dhp-a I 122,11 (gp: 'chidda' nam maha-sid,
'avacchidda' nam kudu-sid); 319,11; Ja III 491,12 ≠
Dhp-a I 284,20; Spk III 44,3; Sadd 537,9.

ava-cchindati or o-cchindati, pr. 3 sg. [sa.
avacchinatti, √chid; Sadd 472,13], (a) to cut off (to
intercept or bar), (b) to divide in morsels (small portions),
(c) to do something abruptly; Ja II 388,16 (maggaṁ
0°; a); part. med. f. ~amānā (0°, ib. 15, do.); abs.
(a). ~itvā, Ja II 389,14 (maggaṁ o°; a); 404,14 (do.);
Ps III 7,25-28 (khandhagataṁ pātetukāmassa sato,
scil. hatthi-dammassa (c), i. e. with a sudden move-
ment); ~itvā ~itvā (kabaḷaṁ), Sp (IV) 893,24 (b);
(β) avacchijja padentassa, Vin-vn 1536 (scil. yaṁ
kiñci āmisaṁ; b), cf. Sp (IV) 855,6 (vicchinditvā
vicchinditvā deti, scil. yāguṁ).ava-cchindati

ava-cchedakaṁ, ind. (cf. abs. of prec.); — ifc. v.
kabalâ°, dividing the 'mouthfuls' (in small parts), na
~ bhuñjissāmi, Vin IV 196,1** (Sp (IV) 893,24) ≠
II 214,21; cf. kavaḍa-cchedakaṁ, JAs 1914, 532,10.

ava-cchedika, mfn. (avacchedi(n) + ka, but see
below); — ifc. v. āsâ° (mf. ~iko kaṭhinuddhāro, Vin
I 259,25; ~ikā (mātikā kaṭhinassa ubbhārāya), Vin I
255,22 (Sp (V) 1113,15,31); perhaps better taken as a
derivate of *āsâvaccheda, m.

ava-cāreti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of prec, (a)), to cause
someone to move or act within a definite sphere; kāma-
bhava-saṁkhāte [Ee kāme bh°] kāme paṭisandhim
~etï ti 'kāmâvacaraṁ (scil. cittaṁ)', As 62,29 ≠
paṭisandhiṁ bhave kāme (split-cpd.) avacārayatī ti
(scil. kāmâvacaraṁ cittaṁ), Abhidh-av 3,13*.

ava-jaya, m. (verb, noun of ava + √ji), defeat;
Dhp-a II 228,8 (v. l. for ajaya); — ifc. v. sampattâ°
(Mhv LXI 14).

2a-vajja, (mf)n. [generally taken = 3a + sa.
varjya, grd. of √vṛj, opp. vajja], "something not to
be avoided", no sin, no fault; n. acc ~añ ca avaj-
jato [scil. ñatvā], Dhp 319; loc. ~e vajjamatino,
Dhp 318 (Dhp-a) ≠ ~e vajjamatinī, Thī 107 ( =
anavajje vajjamatinī, Thī-a); ~e vajjasaññitā, Dhs
1160 = Nidd I 218,20 (= niddose dosa-saññitā,
Nidd-a); — °dassi(n), mfn., finding no fault; f. vajje
~dassinī, Thī 107 (= sâvajje anavajja-diṭṭhī, Thī-a);
— °-saññitā, f. abstr., imagining something not to be a
fault; vajje ~ā, Dhs 1160 (As 383,27); Nidd I 218,21
(= sadose niddosa-saññitā, Nidd-a).

1a-vajja, mfn. (abstracted from an-avajja, q. v.),
blamable; inferior, low, vile; Abh 699 (= paṭikiṭṭha
+ ); pl. (n.) na avajjā 'anavajjā', aninditā agarahitā
ti vuttaṁ hoti, Pj I 140,11 (ad Sn 263); [avajjā, w.
r. for avañjhā, Th 789, see avañjha]; — ifc. v. an-°
(q. v.), nir-° (Mil 252,28), sâ° (mfn. & n.: DN I
163,10; II 215,14; MN I 119,31; AN I 154,14; II 2,81;
135,25; IV 363,11; Pp 41,1; Ja I 130.24'; Mil 37,3;
224,25; Ps I 113,32; °-ânavajja, Sn 534 (cf. 900);
Pp 30,31; AN III 165,15; Ps II 255,15).

a-vajjita-kasāva, mfn. [3a + sa. varjita (√vṛj)
+ kaṣāya], not deprived of (not free from) impurity
(dross); Mp II 362,7 (= 'anikkhitta-kasāva', AN I
254,1 (Ee aninnïta-k°, q. v.)).

a-vajjha, mfn. [sa. avadhya, neg. grd. of √vadh],
not to be killed, inviolable; m. tīhi ṭhānehi ~o bhavati
brāhmaṇo, Ja VI 199,28*; ~o brāhmaṇo dūto, Ja VI
528,2* (brāhmaṇo ca dūto ca imasmim loke ~o, pt);
hantā ~o paramo sa devo, Ja VI 212,16*; acc ghā-
temi kaṁ ~aṁ, Ja V 182,22* (= aghātetabbaṁ,
Ct.); m. pl. ~ā brāhmanā āsuṁ, Sn 288 (Pj); —
°-kavaca, m.n. [cf. sa. kavaca], an impenetrable
coat of mail; Mil 257,21 (°-dhāraṇatāya dakkhiṇaṁ
visodheti; arhaddhvaja nam-æti avadhyasvarūpa-vū
uracchadana-dhāraṇatāyen, Hīnaṭ); — °-rūpa,mfn.,
i. q. avajjha; m. arahaddhajo sabbhi ~o, Ja V 49,22*,
quoted Mil 221,23* = 222,22*, and Sp (II) 296,5.

ava-jjhāyati, pr. 3 sg. (only in Ct.s explaining
(va)jhāyati (Sadd 350,3 foll.), see apajjhāyati, upa-
jjhāyati and sa. ava + √dhyai with different mean-
ing), to muse or mourn; 3 sg. ~ati, Spk I 113,15 ( =
balava-cintanaṁ cinteti, ad SN I 57,24*: akkha-
cchinno va jhāyati, quoted Mil 66,30*, cf. SN I 67,2*:
akkha-cchinno va socati); Nidd I 149,28 foll. (jhāyati
pajjhāyati nijjhāyati ~ati (v. l. apajjhāyati) = tato
apagantvā cinteti, Nidd-a); 3 pl. ~anti, Dhp-a III
132,18-24 (ad Dhp 155: jiṇṇa-koñcā va jhāyanti).

ava-jāta, mfn. (like ati-jāta formed on the pattern
of abhi-jāta (b) and anu-jāta), base-born (said of a
son inferior to his father in caste (a) or in morals (b);
nom. m. atijāto anujāto ~o (scil. putto), It 63,(4),24—
64,3; 64,8* (b; = mātāpitūnaṁ asamo (v. l. avamo)
hutvā jāto, It-a); do. Ja VI 380,24' (kulaṅgāro (so
Cfcs) kulapacchimako [cf. kulantima, antima-purisa]
dhanavināsako ~o nāma); Mp I 429,17 (tvam pi
avajāto, aham pi duggatakule nibbattā; a; see ib.
424,9); voc. purisanta kali ~a, Sn 664 (b; Pj); —
°-dāraka, m., a boy born in mesalliance, Mp I 424,9
(see next a); — °-putta, m. (a ) = avajāta-dāraka;
~o, Dhp-a I 178,2; 180,4; (b) an unworthy son; voc.
Buddhassa ~a, Pj II 479,5 (= 'avajāta'); —
[°-rāja(n), m., pl. ~āno, Ja I 338,17; Tr. reads adham-
mikâvajātarājāno for (Ee) adhammikā va jātirā-
jāno; read: adhammikā vijāti-rājāno (gp: 'vijāti' =
napuru vū jāti æti (a)].

ava-jānana, n. (verb, noun of avajānāti),; Rūp
(Ce) 85,31 = Sadd 882,18 = Pay fol. gū v. 7 (sense
paribhava of prp. ava); ṙ. q. avajānanā (b), Sp (IV)
735,26 (opp. paṭijānana).

ava-jānanā, f. (do.), (a) despising, underrating;
attānaṁ ~ā, Vibh-a 486,19 (= 'atf-avaññā'); acc.
~aṁ (+ paribhavaṁ), Spk I 134,31; — (b) disprov-
ing, disapproving of, Kv-a 9,7 (mṭ: opp. anujānanā);
11,24 (opp. paṭiññā).

ava-jānāti, pr. 3 sg. [ts., √jñā; Sadd 496,16-23],
(a) to despise or underrate, (b) to deny, dis(ap)prove
(of) the assertions of others, to disown one's own state-
ments; 3 sg. (a ) ~āti, MN I 319,15 (nâyam āyasmā
taṁ tena ~āti, a; Ps); datvā ~āti, saṁvāsena ~āti,
AN III 164,16—165,3 (a; = avamaññati, Mp III
288,6 foll.) ≠ Pp 65,1-9; taṁ . . . muniṁ . . . nâva-
jānāti [metr. n'avajanati!] sadevako pi loko, Ud 77,19*
(a; = na ~āti na paribhoti, Ud-a), quoted Nett 37,6*
(reading na vijānāti [metr.l and cf. Sn 644]); yo
nâvajānāti sahāya-matte sippena . . . jaccā, Ja IV
76,8* (a; Ct.); bhūtena vuccamāno ~āti no paṭijānāti,
AN I 202,20 (b); avajānitvā paṭijānāti, paṭijānitvā
~āti, Vin IV 1,9 (b; = tattha (ɔ: attano vāde) dosaṁ
sallakkhetvā 'nâyaṁ mama vādo' ti ~āti, Sp) ≠
1185,16 (scil. āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno); Kv-a 9,8
(b; saying "na hevaṁ vattabbe"; cf. paṭikkhipati, ib.
10,34; opp. "āmantā" ti paṭijānāti, ib. 8,14-24, etc.);
Sadd 5,3 (a; = paribhavati); (β) ~ati, Sn 132 (a;
= ~āti nīcaṁ karoti, Pj; opp. samukkaṁse) ≠ 438;
— 2 sg. kacci abhiṇhasaṁvāsā nâvajānāsi paṇḍitaṁ,
Sn 335 (a; = jātiādīnaṁ aññatarena vatthunā pari-
bhavasi, Pj) ≠ Sn 336 (1 sg. ~āmi); — 1 sg.
attānaṁ ca nâvajānāmi, SN II 54,3 (Spk: iminā
omāna-pahānaṁ [Ee w. r. osāna-] kathitaṁ); —
3 pl. *~anti (a), Th 129; — part. m. ~anto, Kv-a
11,27 (b; opp. paṭijānanto); Sp (IV) 736,2 (do.); —
part. med. f. avajānamānā, Spk II 176,4 (a); — pot.
3 sg. (a ), avajāneyya, Sn 206 (a); khattiyaṁ (etc.)
daharo ti nâvajāneyya, SN I 69,13*,18*,23* (a; + na
naṁ paribhave; Spk I 132,9—133,7); (β) dātāraṁ
nâvajāniya (for °yā? so B-mss), Sn 713, quoted Spk
II 109,8*; — aor. 3 sg. cf. mā naṁ daharo [ — — ?]
ti uññāsi, Ja V 63,1*-25* (a; cf. SN I 69,13*); — abs.
(α) ~itvā, Vin IV 1,8 foll. (b); (β) avaññāya, Ja I
257,18 (a; = avajānitvā, pt); [Mp I 366,13 see avañ-
ñā, f.]; —grd. (a ) ~itabba, mfn., Dhp-a III 20,2 (a);
(β) avaññeyya, mfn., Pv-a 175,27 (= 'avaññā'); (γ)
*avañña, mfn., Pv 391 (veṇï vā ~ā (f. pl.) honti, un-
metrical; ɔ: veṇī vâvaññ(iy)ā honti?; Pv-a (Ee Ce):
'avaññā' ti avaññeyya, avajānitabbā ti vuttaṁ hoti;
vambhanā [ɔ: *vambh[an]iyā?] ti vā pāṭho, parehi
bādhanīyā ti attho), cf. uññātabba, mfn. (SN I 69,1); —
see avaññatti, avaññāta [avaññita], avaññā, and next.

ava-jānāpeti, pr. 3 sg., caus. of prec; 3 sg. ~eti,
Sadd 5,36 (= 'paribhāvāpeti'); aor. 3 sg. ~esi, Ps II
99,15 (= 'ujjhāpesi').

ava-jānīyate, pr. 3 sg., pass, of avajānāti; Sadd
6,32 (= 'paribhavīyate').

ava-jināti, pr. 3 sg., see ojināti [ava + √ji(jyā)],
to conquer; cf. 1 pl. med. ojināmase, Ja VI 222,3* ( =
jināma, Ct.), see next.

ava-jīyati (or ava-jiyyati), pr. 3 sg. pass, (from
ava + √ji), (a) to be lost (in game or war) (nom. rei),
(b) to lose (nom. personæ, acc. rei); Dhp 179 (yassa
jitaṁ nâvajīyati (a); Dhp-a III 197,14) ≠ Ja I
313,23*-24* (Ct.); hereof [or from the active ava-jeti?
cf. parā + √ji] pot. 1 sg., Ja VI 155,3* (b; read with Ct.
in Cks; pati(ṁ) mâham avajiyyaṁ = let me not lose
my husband, [omitting the words maṁ yācām' ahaṁ],
Cks ajiyyaṁ, Ee Bds ajeyyaṁ).ava-jīyati

ava-jīyati (or ava-jiyyati), pr. 3 sg. pass, (from
ava + √ji), (a) to be lost (in game or war) (nom. rei),
(b) to lose (nom. personæ, acc. rei); Dhp 179 (yassa
jitaṁ nâvajīyati (a); Dhp-a III 197,14) ≠ Ja I
313,23*-24* (Ct.); hereof [or from the active ava-jeti?
cf. parā + √ji] pot. 1 sg., Ja VI 155,3* (b; read with Ct.
in Cks; pati(ṁ) mâham avajiyyaṁ = let me not lose
my husband, [omitting the words maṁ yācām' ahaṁ],
Cks ajiyyaṁ, Ee Bds ajeyyaṁ).ava-jīyati

ava-jīyana, n. (verb, noun of prec); Ja I 313,27
(abl. puna ~ato).

[ava-jeti, pr. 3 sg. (ava + √ji); pot. 1 pl. ~eyyāma,
Ja VI 273,4* (v. l. for abhi-jeti, q. v.)].

a-vañcana, mfn. (3a + vañcana, verb, noun (adj.)
of √vañc); m. pl. ~ā (pādā), not able to go (or totter),
Ja I 214,16* (Ct.) = Cp III 9,10, quoted Sadd 335,19
(= vañcituṁ gantuṁ asamatthā) & 529,6 (the Vat-
ṭaka-paritta, cf. Epigr. Zeyl. I 40,4; III 169).

a-vañjha, mfn. [sa. a-vandhya], not barren,
fruitful, productive; m. . . . kato adhikāro ~o bhavati
saphalo, Mil 97,4; 101,13 (aparādho), cf. ib. 95,12
(vañjho aphalo); f. ~ā (Ed. avajjā) mayhaṁ pab-
bajjā, Th 789; DN II 251,7 ≠ MN I 271,20 (pabbajjā
~ā bhavissati saphalā saudrayā; = amoghā, Ps; cf.
Sv (II) 670,19) = SN II 29,11; acc. m. Th-a ad Th
451 (~aṁ divasaṁ kareyya = 'amoghaṁ'); n. pl.
~āni (Ed. avajjhāni) tv evâhaṁ sikkhāpadāni vadā-
mi, AN I 232,31 (= atucchāni saphalāni saudrayāni,
Mp); ~āni tv evâhaṁ pane' indriyāni vadāmi, SN V
201,8; 202,9; ~āni (kammāni), Pv 443 (= amoghāni
anipphalāni, Pv-a); — °-vādi(n), mfn., whose words
(or predictions) are not vain; m. ~ī (sabbaññū so hi
Bhagavā, etc.), Saddh 345.

avaññā (synon, uññā), f. [sa. ava-jñā], disrespect,
disregard (cf. ava-jānāti, a—b above); acc. Bodhisatte
~aṁ katvā, Ja I 358,14; tesu ~aṁ akatvā, Ps II
395,34 ≠ Mp III 339,14; instr, mayi ~āya, Mp I
366,13; — °-kăraṇamattaṁ, Sv(II) 435,20 = Ps IV
180,17; — ifc. v. an-avaññā-patilābha (AN II 143,17);
— — the form uññā see uññā° s. v. avajānāti; instr.
uññāya, Vin IV 241,22**(+ paribhavena, etc.; Sp (IV)
915,13: 'uññāyā' ti avaññāya, nīcaṁ katvā jānanāya);
— ifc. v. att'-uññā.

ava-ññāta (or oñ(ñ)āta), mfn. (pp. of ava-
jānāti), despised; n. oññātaṁ ~am hīḷitaṁ pari-
bhūtaṁ acittīkataṁ, Vin IV 6,16 (scil. nāmaṁ; Sp
(IV) 738,30: oñātan ti ~aṁ, uññātan ti pi paṭhanti,
~an ti vambhetvā ñātaṁ); m. oñāto ~o hīḷito khīḷito
garahito, Mil 191,19-29 (cf. 229,29 & 288,18-16);
Saddh 88 (~o ca hot[ī/i]dha majjapāyī purā naro); —
ifc. v. an-°; — avaññāta-kula-ja, mfn., born in a
contemptible family; m. ~o, Saddh 90.

[avaññita, mfn., dishonoured; Abh 756 (so both
editions, w. r. for avaññāta, or to avaññā like saṁ-
jñita to saṁjñā].

1avaṭa, m. [ts.], a hole; a pit (or basin); — ifc. v.
mahā-telâ° (Mhv XLII 19).
2avaṭa, mfn., prob. w. r. for a-vaṇṭa (q. v.).

Avaṭakāyā, f. Npr., Amāv 132,9 (v.ll. Avāva-
ṭakayā, Avāṭakayā) = 'Sivāvatikā' [sic], Ps II 268,20
(Be Acāravatī).

avaṭamsa, m., see vaṭaṁsa (s. v. avataṁsa) &
vaṭaṁsaka [cf. Geiger § 66,1; Vin. Trsl. II 347, n. 5].

ava-ṭṭhāna, n. (mostly ava-tthāna, cf. avatthā)
[sa. avasthāna], standing, fixed position, stability;
nom. ~aṁ, Ja I 508,23 (kampamānassa ~aṁ nāma
na hosi [sic]); Pj II 50,12 (ussāho ummaggo +;
quoted Ss 3,31); ib. 16* (synon, adhiṭṭhānaṁ); acc.
~aṁ, Ps II 26,33 (catuhi pādehi paṭhaviṁ uppīletvā
~aṁ; = 'ṭhānaṁ'); Pv-a 286,17 (kammānaṁ); [Mp
III 291,2, P. t. for a-vavatthāna-°, cf. AN III 171,12];
— ifc. v. an-°; — — °-kathā, f., explanation of a°;
Sv(II) 670,36 (= vipassanā-magga-nibbānānaṁ taṁ-
taṁ-padehi vavatthapetvā kathā, pt); — °-yācanā,
f., asking for a°; Ud-a 324,12 ad Ud 62,25; — °-va-
cana, n., v. l. for next.

ava-ṭṭhāpana, n. (or ava-tthāpana; cf. sa.
ava-sthāpana), fixing, settling; — °-vacana, n., an
expression for a°; Nidd I 3,1 (Nidd-a I 18,25; = 'addhā',
q. v.; cf. Nidd II 82,33, v. l. avatthāna-vacanaṁ).

ava-ṭṭhita (often written ava-tthita), mfn. [sa.
avasthita], standing (abiding) firmly, steady, settled,
placed; m. ~o, Ps III 79,16* ≠ Ja IV 380,26* (reading
idha ṭṭhito); Ud-a 206,16; acc. ~aṁ, Ud-a 63,12 ( =
'patiṭṭhitaṁ'); Ja V 160,19* (scil. tejaṁ, etc.); instr.
tayā sudantena ~ena hayena, Th 1140; [gen. tassa ma-
ma Antakena adhipannassa ~assa (sic [conjecture] Se;
Cks avatthavassa ɔ: avatthaṭassa) kā nāma rati, Ja
VI 28,19]; n. pl. sammā ~ā, Pj II 347,33 (= 'sam-
avaṭṭhitā', scil. sotā); instr, pl. taṁ-taṁ-mucchanânu-
rūpaṁ ~ehi (sammad-eva yojitehi doṇi-patta-bāhu-
daṇdehi), Vv-a 281,18; — °-tta, n. abstr.; Ja I 470,20*
(°âbhayabhīrutāya ca); — °-vāda, mfn., having
firm (dogmatic) views; Nidd I 301,22 (daḷha-vāda+;
Nidd-a); 302,3; — °-sabhāva, mfn., of a stable na-
ture; m. ~o, Ud-a 299,32 (= 'ṭhitadhammo', scil.
mahāsamuddo); — °-samâdāna, mfn., with steady
'enterprise'; m. ~o, DN III 145,24 (=niccala-gahaṇo,
anivattita-gahaṇo, Sv (III) 919,23); Nidd I 487,'22
(Nidd-a); — — ifc. v. an-° (q. v. and add AN III
443,10); an-avatthita-citta (q. v.).ava-ṭṭhita

ava-ṭṭhiti, f. [sa. ava-sthiti], a firm position,
stability, steadfastness; (indriyānaṁ) gopānasīnaṁ ~i,
SN V 228,12 foll. (saṇṭhiti +); cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti
~i, Dhs 11 = 570 (here ava-thiti; As 293,28) = Nidd
I 365,23 (Nidd-a).

a-vaṭuma, mfn. [3a + sa. vartman], without
paths; loc. ~e (scil. paṭhaviyaṁ), Porāṇaṭṭhakathā
[so mhṭ] apud Vism 123,7 (opp. sa-vaṭume; mhṭ:
paṭhaviyan ti vatvā pi maṇḍalâpekkhāya napum-
sakaniddeso).

a-vaḍḍhana, n. [neg. verbal noun of vaḍḍheti,
caus.],; instr. °-vasena, Vism 112,5; — ifc. v. vaḍ-
ḍhanâ° (Vism 110,17; 111,29—113,13).

a-vaḍḍhanaka, mfn. (from vaḍḍnati), not in-
creasing; — °-pakkha, m. [sa. pakṣa], the fortnight
of the waning moon; Pālim fol. ghai v.i foll.

a-vaḍḍhi, f. [3a + sa. vṛddhi], no increase, no
growth, decay (also a-vaddhi or a-vuḍḍhi): anayo
~i mahāvināso, Ja III 357,24'; ~i vināso, Ja
IV 426,1' (= 'parābhavo'); Sv (III) 1005,6 ( =
'apāyo'); Ps III 165,3 (= 'abhū'); acc. ~iṁ, Ja III
176,11' (= 'anatthaṁ'); ~iṁ vināsaṁ, Ps II 265,29
(= 'anaya-vyasanaṁ') ≠ Ud-a 355,26; ~iṁ āpajjati,
Mp II 318,31 (= 'anayarh'); ~iṁ vināsaṁ, Mp III
16,8 (= 'an-abhāvaṁ'); avaddhim āpajjanaṁ, Sadd
86,8 (= 'parābhavanaṁ'); instr. ~iyā, Sv(III) 950,33
(Ee avuḍḍhiyā; = 'abhavena'); loc. ~°-mukhe, Dhp-a
III 335,25 (= 'uyyogamukhe'); — °-kara, mfn.,
pernicious, unhealthy; n. pl. ~āni ārammaṇāni, Ps
IV 55,4 (= 'asappāyāni'); — °-kāma, mfn., who does
not care for what is profitable; gen. ~assa, Ja III 108,26
(= 'anattha-kāmassa').

avaḍḍhita, mfn. (neg. pp. caus. of √vṛdh), not
developed; loc. ~e (ārammaṇe), Vism 88,1.

avaḍḍhita-kasiṇa, mfn., who has not developed
a kasina (q. v.) practice; gen. ~assa, Ps IV 24,1; cf.
Sv I 115,7.

avaḍḍhi-nissita, mfn. [from sa. ni-√çri], subject
to a°, fortuneless; pl. ~ā, Mp III 261,9 (= 'apāṭubhā'
(v. l. apajahā), ad AN III 76,12).

avaḍḍhi-bhūta, mfn., contemptible, disrespected;
f. ~ā amàṅgala-bhūtā, Ps III 453,3 (ad MN II 210,7;
= 'avabhūtā').

a-vaḍḍhetvā, neg. abs. of vaḍḍheti (√vṛdh),
q. v.; Sv I 115,5-8; Vism 152,23.

a-vaṇa, mfn. [sa. a-vraṇa], without wound: (a)
not wounding, (b) unscarred m. ~o, Th 757 (a-sattho
+; a); loc. ~e veluriya-manimhi vanaṁ uppādento,
Ud-a 113,21 (b).

a-vaṇṭa, mfn. [3a + sa. vṛnta], (a) without stalk,
nom. pl. m. duvidhā jātā urajā ~ā . . . addhalābusa-
mā thanā, Ja V 155,26* (Ct.); hence (b) probably a
designation for the tāla-tree (m) and its fruit (n),
see avaṇṭa-phala): ~aṁ adadaṁ phalaṁ, Ap 294,22;
445,17 (Ee Ce avaṭaṁ); adāsiṁ ~aṁ phalaṁ, Ap 409,5
(Ee Ce avaṭaṁ, metr., but prob, transposed from a
text like 294,22 etc.); m. pl. ~ā (EeCe avaṭā) pakka-
bharitā, Ap 346,19.

a-vaṇṭaka, mfn. = prec.(a); n. pl. akhīlakāni ca
~āni (scil. rukkhaphalāni), Ja V 203,3*; ~āni nīpa-
pupphâdīni, Sp (III) 618,15.

avaṇṭa-phala, n., prob. i. q. tāla-phala; see next
and a-vaṇṭa, mfn.

Avaṇṭaphala-dāyaka, m., designation of a thera
(≠ Sigālapita(r) or Sambula-Kaccāna); his apadāna,
Ap 294,18—295,3 = Th-a (Ce) 71,18*-24* = 314,19*-25*.

Avaṇṭaphaliya, m., designation of a thera; his
apadāna, Ap 409,1-12 (so Ce; E* Avaṭa-°); — do.,
Ap 445,13-24 (EeCe Avaṭa-°).

2a-vaṇṇa, m. [sa. a-varṇa], bad repute, dispraise,
speaking ill of (gen.); nom. ~o c'assa rūhati, It 67,20*
(It-a); Vin IV 216,12 (yo etissā ~o, mayh' eso ~o;
+ akitti, ayaso, alābho; = aguṇo, Sp); Sv(II) 527,17
(atha nesaṁ ~o uggacchati); acc. ~añ ca akittiñ ca
dussīlo labhate naro, Th 611; Vin III 21,11 (kosaj-
jassa ~aṁ bhāsitvā; = nindaṁ garahaṁ bhāsitvā,
Sp); DN I 2,13 foll. (Buddhassa ~aṁ bhāsati; =
dosaṁ nindaṁ, Sv); AN IV 345,4; Vin I 85,22;
(a)vaṇṇârahassa ~aṁ bhāsati, AN I 89,8-9; 113,4;
III 264,15; vaṇṇârahassa ~aṁ bhāsitā, Pp 48,37 foll.;
paresaṁ vaṇṇaṁ vā ~aṁ vā bhāsanti, MN II 114,11;
~aṁ bhaṇamānaṁ nivāreti, DN III 187,24 (Sv); sa-
maṇassa Gotamassa ~aṁ uppādetvā, Ja IV 187,16-24
≠ Dhp-a III 178,14-19; ~aṁ [v]uṭṭhāpetvā, Ud-a
113,23; loc. tassa satthuno ... tassa ādāyassa ~e
bhaññamāne, Vin I 70,21; parassa vaṇṇe vā ~e vā
bhāsiyamāne, AN III 165,6; Sv I 52,13; — ifc. v.
vaṇṇâ° (mfn. Vin I 285,20; II 99,1); — cf. next &
foll. cpd.s.

1a-vaṇṇa, mfn. [sa. a-varṇa or a-varṇya], not
worthy of praise; loc. sg. or acc. m. pl., ~e vaṇṇa-kā-
rakā, Ja V 270,4* (Ct.: '~e vaṇṇakārakā' ti pesuñña-
kārakā).

a-vaṇṇanīya, mfn. (neg. grd. of vaṇṇeti, vaṇ-
ṇayati), indescritable; — °-sobha, mfn. [cf. sa. çobhā].
n., rūpaṁ jivhāya ~aṁ, Ja V 282,27 (the beauty where-
of no tongue can describe).

avaṇṇa-bhaya, n., fear of dispraise; abl. ~ā,
Vibh-a 485,14 - Vism 29,18.

avaṇṇa-bhāsaka, mfn., speaking ill (of); loc. pl.
~esu, Sv I 52,12.

avaṇṇayi, ~um, aor. 3 sg. & pl. of vaṇṇeti
(to praise)', It 98,11* (= kittayi, It-a); Sn 292—294.

avaṇṇa-rahita, mfn., free from dispraise; gen.
~assa (scil. Buddhassa), Sv I 36,23.

avaṇṇa-vādi(n), mfn. speaking ill (of, gen.);
acc. ~im, Ja III 110,13.avaṇṇa-vādin

avaṇṇa-vādi(n), mfn. speaking ill (of, gen.);
acc. ~im, Ja III 110,13.avaṇṇa-vādin

avaṇṇa-saṁsagga-bhaya, n. [sa. °-saṁsar-
ga-°], fear of being involved in blame; abl. ~ā (scil.
eke na karonti pāpaṁ), Ja VI 374,21*.

avaṇṇa-samyutta, mfn. [sa. °-saṁyukta],
beset with bad repute; m. pl. ~ā, Ja III 441,28*.

avaṇṇa-haraṇa, n., bringing (spreading) ill-
fame; Vibh-a 485,15 = Vism 29,19 (cf. pesuñña-
haraṇa, Khuddas XII 1, etc.).

avaṇṇa-hārikā, f., producing (or propagation)
of dispraise; Vibh 353,8 (akkosanā + ; Ee °-hāriyā;
Vibh-a 485,14 — Vism 29,17 (Ee °-hāritā)); instr.
~āya, Nidd I 165,15 (= 'nindāya'; = aguṇa-vaḍḍha-
nena, Nidd-a).

avaṇṇâraha, mfn. (2avaṇṇa + araha), deserving
dispraise (opp. vannâraha); gen. ~assa, AN I 89,8
= II 3,3 - III 264,14 foll. ≠ Pp 6,17 (48,30); AN
II 100,7 foll.

avataṁsa, m. [ts.] and avaṭaṁsa(ka), synon. =
uttaṁsa, m. (cf. √taṁs, sa. Dhātup 17,13 = Sadd II
879 (p. 442,2 w. r. ḷ/vās-i: alaṁkāre)), a chaplet, an
(ear)ornament (made of flowers), (1) m. ~o, Abh 308
('uttamso' sekharâveḷā, muddhamālye 'vaṭamsako');
870 (uttamso tv-avataṁso ca kaṇṇapūre ca sekhare
≠ Am-k III 3,226); pl. ~ā, Ap 579,23 = Thī-a 70,8*
(on a cetiya); — (2) the pali form is vaṭaṁsa (a)
or more frequently vaṭaṁsaka (b), n. or m.; (a ) Mhv
ḷ XI 28 (vataṁsaṁ; = kanna-pilandhanaṁ, Mhv-t);
Dīp XVII 84, quoted Sp I 75,17* (note, however, Sp-ṭ:
vaṭakan ti kaṇṇa-pilandhanaṁ, vaṭaṁsakan ti vut-
taṁ hoti; vaṭaṁsakaṁ kaṇṇacūlikaṭṭhāne olamba-
nakan ti pi vadanti ≠ Vmv); -— (b) nom. m. sovat-
thiko ~ako, Sv (II) 445,30 (pt: ~o ti āveḷaṁ); acc.
~akaṁ karonti pi . . . āveḷaṁ karonti pi, Vin III
180,5 (Sp: vataṁsako (!) ti vaṭaṁsako) = Vin II
9,36 (cf. ib. 10,6); Ap 216,6,18; Vv 439; bandhitvāna
(or gaṇṭhitvāna) ~aṁ, Ap 174,18 = Th-a Ce 201,32*;
pl. m. ~akā, Vv 428 (= ratanamayā kannikā-vataṁ-
sakā, Vv-a) = 476 = 561; tayo ~akā, Ja VI
488,25 (soil, of the state elephant; C%s ~akāni); pl.
m. acc. ~ake, Vv-a 176,15 (ib. is: ~akāni); — ifc.
(vaṭaṁsaka) v. kaṇṇikā-° (Vv-a 174,28); puppha-°
(Sp (IV) 892,33), pūv'a-° (ib. 32; Sp-ṭ), rajata-° (Dhp-a
III 441,18), vicitta-vāneyya-vaṭaṁsaka (Th 523),
Sineruvana-° (Cp I 9,14,21,25,51 (Cp-a), quoted Ja
VI 486,24* resp. 511,26*).

ava-tata, mfn. [ts.; pp. of ava + √tan], covered,
overspread; — ifc. v. 2aneka-cittâ° (q. v.), veḷuriya-
jālâ° (Vv 752; = chādita, Vv-a), suvaṇṇa-jālâ°
(Vv 744; = do., Vv-a); — also otata, Dhp 162;
Mil 307,7.

ava-taraṇa, n. [ts., verbal subst, from ava-tarati],
descending; Abh 981 (explaining avatāra, m.); —
ifc. v. devâ° (Pj I 132,22 v. l.).

ava-tarati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-√tf[, otherwise
otarati (q. v.), to descend, dive in (loc ), Nett 22,7
(ariya-saccesu ~ati); [caus. aor. 1 sg. (a)vatāresiṁ,
conjectured for *a-thāresiṁ, q. v. above]; pp. ava-tinna
(q. v.).

a-vattana, mfn. [3a + sa. vartana], not staying
or abiding in, not moving in (loc.); abl. ~ato (attano
vase ~), Nidd-a (Se) II 303,18; = 'a-vasavattanato',
Nidd II 279,32.

a-vattabbatā, f. [3a + sa. vaktavyatā], the state
of not to be spoken of or expressed: abl. ~āya anak-
khātaṁ nāma [scil. nibbānaṁ], Dhp-a III 289,18.

2avattha, mfn. (from ava + √as2) ≠ 2apattha
[sa. apâsta], q. v.; thrown away; acc. f. ~aṁ (soṇiṁ),
Ja V 302,19* (= chaḍḍitaṁ, Ct).

ava-tthaṭa, mfn. (pp. of ava-ttharati; also
otthaṭa, Ap 87,16 = Th-a Ce 329,30*; Ja V 295,7;
Dhp-a III 175,11; Mil 299,25 (mahikô°); Mhv XXI
30), covered, overwhelmed (with, instr.); m. bhatta-
kācena ~o, Ja V 295,9 (cf. ib. 7: otthaṭaṁ); sokena
~o, Dhp-a I 179,8 (v. l. avaṭṭharito); do. v. l. for
patthaṭo, Dhp-a III 53,12; gen. sg. ~assa, Ja VI 28,19'
(Cks avatthavassa; = 'adhipannassa'); m. pl. ~ā
(gehena), Dhp-a II 267,16—268,2.

ava-tthaddha, mfn. [pp. of ava + √stambh],
trusting or relying on (loc); m. ~o (sake sippe), Ap
221,2 (so Ee; Se apatthaddho, q. v. above).

avatthantara-bheda, m. (avatthā + antara +
bheda), division of the different (mental) states (scil.
bhāvanā, etc.); abl. ~ato, Saddh 457.

avatth[ā/a]peti, pr. 3 sg. caus. of ava-tiṭṭhati; —
[pp. ~āpita, mfn., fixed, defined; w. r. Sp I 22,26
(manasā ~āya (Ce Se vavatthāpitāya) pāḷiyā desanā)
≠ As 22,11 (vavatthāpitāya) = Sv I 20,10]; — abs.
~ăpetvā, Ja IV 452,2'.avatthāpeti

ava-ttharaṇa (or ottharaṇa), n. [sa. ava-
starana; cf. next], (a) covering; (b) overpowering (by
a sudden attack); Ja II 336,4 (loc. °-kāle; b); Ja II
104,11 (°-bhāva, m. abstr.; b); Sv I 274,3 (so Se; Ee
avatthāraṇa-°); — ifc. v. piṭṭhi-pādôttharaṇa° (Ps
II 354,4; a); mahikôttharaṇa (Mil 299,31; a; see
mahikā).ava-ttharaṇa

ava-ttharati (or ottharati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava +
√stṛ], to cover, to spread over, to heap over, to over-
whelm; haritaṁ ottharati, Vin IV 205,31'; tejo mama
sarīraṁ ottharati, Dhp-a I 427,2; ottharati (scil.
mahā-vārikkhandho), Mil 121,16; avattharati, Mp II
311,22 (= 'abhiharati'); Pp-a 250,4 ad Pp 67,26 ( =
'ajjhottharati'); Ja I 487,11; 3 pl. ~anti, Ja IV 84,28';
1 pl. ~āma, Ja IV 432,12* (Cks apa-°); part. in. ~anto,
Ja IV 258,19; Dhp-a II 249,7; ottharanto (vādena),
Ja II 258,9 (Bi oṭṭaranto); acc f. avattharantiṁ, Dāṭh
I 38; m. pl. ~antā, Ja IV 191,9; loc. n. ~ante, Ja VI
177,20 (ifc v. an-otthara(t)); part. med. m. avattha-
ramāno, Ja I 212,13; f. ~amānā (Māra-balaṁ), Ja I
74,27 ; n. ~amānaṁ, Dhp-a II 265,14; pot. 3 sg. ~eyya,
Ja I 62,29; IV 6,3' (nâ°; — 'nâtivatteyya'); ottha-
reyya, Mil 296,25; aor. 3 sg. avatthari, Ja III 364,19
= 365,17; fut. 3 sg. ottharissati, Ja I 212,15; inf.
avattharituṁ, Ja I 212,27-30; abs. (a.) ~itvā, Ja I
61,22; 213,23; 255,28; III 130,15; 365,19; IV 327,4;
V 298,18'; VI 400,8; Ps IV 50,4; Dhp-a III 202,19;
ottharitvā, Dhp-a III 175,9; (β) otthariyāna (?; Se
Ee uttariyāna), Ja V 204,9* (Ct.: 'uttariyānā' ti
uttaritvā avattharitvā); — pass. 3 pl. ottharīyanti,
Vin II 152,6; part. gen. otthariyamānassa, Dhp-a II
241,5.

avatthā, f. [sa. avasthā], stability; position, stage,
period (of life); abl. ~āto, Sadd 363,32*; loc.pl. tīsu
pi ~āsu, Ud-a 88,28; 135,6; — °-bheda, m., division
according to a°, Pay fol. cā v. 5-6 (Devadattassa bāla-
tâdi ~o) ≠ °âdi-vibhāga, m., Ud-a 215,28 (instr.
~ena); — ifc. v. rogâ° (Bhes 2:66); do. mfn. v. an-
avattha tad-° (& a-tad-°) (Ud-a 40,11-13); — cf.
āvatthika (Pj I 107,7).

avatthāpīyati, pr. 3 sg. pass, of next; Paṭis-a
I 13,2.

avatth[ā/a]peti, pr. 3 sg. caus. of ava-tiṭṭhati; —
[pp. ~āpita, mfn., fixed, defined; w. r. Sp I 22,26
(manasā ~āya (Ce Se vavatthāpitāya) pāḷiyā desanā)
≠ As 22,11 (vavatthāpitāya) = Sv I 20,10]; — abs.
~ăpetvā, Ja IV 452,2'.avatthāpeti

avatthāraka, m. [from sa. ava + √str], covering
with; — ifc. v. tin-' (Vin IV 207,5; II 87',6 [Sp]).

ava-ṭṭhita (often written ava-tthita), mfn. [sa.
avasthita], standing (abiding) firmly, steady, settled,
placed; m. ~o, Ps III 79,16* ≠ Ja IV 380,26* (reading
idha ṭṭhito); Ud-a 206,16; acc. ~aṁ, Ud-a 63,12 ( =
'patiṭṭhitaṁ'); Ja V 160,19* (scil. tejaṁ, etc.); instr.
tayā sudantena ~ena hayena, Th 1140; [gen. tassa ma-
ma Antakena adhipannassa ~assa (sic [conjecture] Se;
Cks avatthavassa ɔ: avatthaṭassa) kā nāma rati, Ja
VI 28,19]; n. pl. sammā ~ā, Pj II 347,33 (= 'sam-
avaṭṭhitā', scil. sotā); instr, pl. taṁ-taṁ-mucchanânu-
rūpaṁ ~ehi (sammad-eva yojitehi doṇi-patta-bāhu-
daṇdehi), Vv-a 281,18; — °-tta, n. abstr.; Ja I 470,20*
(°âbhayabhīrutāya ca); — °-vāda, mfn., having
firm (dogmatic) views; Nidd I 301,22 (daḷha-vāda+;
Nidd-a); 302,3; — °-sabhāva, mfn., of a stable na-
ture; m. ~o, Ud-a 299,32 (= 'ṭhitadhammo', scil.
mahāsamuddo); — °-samâdāna, mfn., with steady
'enterprise'; m. ~o, DN III 145,24 (=niccala-gahaṇo,
anivattita-gahaṇo, Sv (III) 919,23); Nidd I 487,'22
(Nidd-a); — — ifc. v. an-° (q. v. and add AN III
443,10); an-avatthita-citta (q. v.).ava-ṭṭhita

a-vatthu, n. [3a + sa. vastu], no reality, Sacc
367; no ground, no reason: loc. (a ) ~usmiṁ akāraṇe,
Vin I 114,28-30; 314,21-37 (cf. vatthusmiṁ kāraṇe,
ib. 36) ≠ II 241,15-18-23; ~usmiṁ ajānitvā, Mil
142,20 ≠ 187,4; ~usmiṁ pasïdati, Ps I 291,28 (cf.
vatthusmiṁ, ib.32); — (β) ahetusmiṁ ~umhi, Mil
119,14—120,2.

a-vatthuka, mfn., rootless, groundless; without
material base; acc. m. kāya-vatthukam pi itara-vat-
thukam pi ~am pi, Dhp-a I 36,21; f. ~ā, Sp (III)
715,29 (cf. next); n. uddesikaṁ (cetiyaṁ) ~aṁ mana-
mattakena hoti, Ja IV 228,19; ~aṁ bhavaṁ kathesi,
alikaṁ tucchakaṁ kathesi, Ja III 464,5; instr. ~ena
vacanena Ja I 440,9; — °-pakka, mfn., cooked with-
out the vatthu(?); f. ~ā, Sp (III) 715,29 (ucchura-
saṁ upādāya a-pakkā vā ~ā vā sabbā pi a-vatthukă
ucchu-vikati 'phāṇitan' ti veditabbaṁ; ad Vin III
251,24; cf. savatthuka-pakka, Sp (III) 716,19).

[a-vatthu-kata, mfn., torn up by the root?? —
ifc. v. tālâ° (Vin III 2,18, etc.; MN I 139,21, etc.; SN
IV 84,1, etc.; cf. Sp I 132,29: tālā vatthukatā). Cf.
an-abhāva-kata above].

ava-tāra, m. [ts.], 1., descent (from above), a
landing place, a fissure, Abh 981 (= avataraṇa-
titthasmiṁ vivare 'py atha); — 2. introduction,
manual, primer; — ifc. v. Abhidhammâ° (q. v.), Bālâ°
(name of a grammar by Dhammakitti (Piṭ-sm § 407:
Saddhammakitti; Gv 62,5-9 (71,26-30?): Vācissara);
see Geiger 46,5 & Franke, Geschichte u. Kritik p. 24;
printed editions: Colombo 1869 & 1892, Pæliyagoda
1902); Bālâvatāraṭīkā (by Uttama), Piṭ-sm § 408;
the old sanne (Gaḍalādeni-sannaya), Colombo 1917.

2avati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. avate], to announce, pro-
claim; only Sadd 322,33 (sense sadde of √u, cf. sa.
Dhātup 22,56: çabde); [hence accord, to Sadd 323,1-2
aor. 3 sg. pāvā, Sn 782 (= vadati, Pj; = pāvadati,
Nidd), scil. from pra + √u, alternatively, from pra +
√vad, cf. Sadd 389,1; see pavadati].

ava-tiṭṭhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √sthā], to abide,
remain, linger, tarry; ~ati, Th 21 (yattha bhayaṁ
nâ°); SN I 25,17* (no ce a-ssaddhiyam ~; metre
faulty); yaṁ pamāṇa-kataṁ kammaṁ na taṁ tatrâ-
vasissati na taṁ tatrâ°~, DN I 251,8-20 (çloka-
rhythm) = MN II 207,22—208,7 = SN IV 322,14-26
= AN V 299,27—301,1; — aor. 3 sg. (a ) avatthāsi,
Vin III 79,27—81,3-14 (matthake ~; fell down upon);
Ja IV 208,3 (daṇḍako patitvā khandhe ~); Mp I
329,15 (khāṇuke pādena ~); (β) avaṭṭhāsi, Ud 40,11
(Ee 'apatāsi' = apati, Ud-a); — ifc. v. an-; — pp.
avaṭṭhita (q. v.); — caus, avatthăpeti (q. v.).

ava-tiṇṇa, mfn. (pp. of avatarati — otarati),
descended, come into, affected with; m, uppathaṁ ~o
bhavaṁ, Sadd 136,13; — ifc. v. icchâ° (Sn 306),
issâ° (Ja V 98,8*), sokâ° (DN II 39,14*; SN I 123,1*,
see anutiṇṇa above); — cf. otiṇṇa, otarita.

a-vada(t), mfn., neg. part, of vadati (SN II
13,12); — a-vadamāna, mfn., neg. part. med. of do.
(SN V 147,2, so C-mss; Ee a-saṁvadamānā; cf. Sv
(III) 847,6: apadamāna, Se apatamāna; see also Spk
III 200,16 with note 8; pt (B-tradition): aparamānā
[= avhāyantī, Sv-pṭ from Ja II 59,20?]).

a-vadaññ[ū/u], mfn. (cf. sa. vadānya, "affable";
-ññū for -ñña on the pattern of -ññū: -ñña (sa. jña)),
not affable, unkind, (niggardly); m. assaddho kadariyo
~ū, Sn 663; — °-tā, f. abstr. ,Vibh 371,26-31 (= thad-
dhamacchariya-vasena "dehi karohī" ti vacanassa ajā-
nanā, Vibh-a); acc. assaddhiyaṁ . . . ~aṁ . . . kosaj-
jaṁ (ap)pahāya√ AN V 146,4 foll.—148,4 foll.; instr.
~āya, Nidd I 37,15 (Nidd-a). — Cf. avadāniya.a-vadaññū

a-vadaññ[ū/u], mfn. (cf. sa. vadānya, "affable";
-ññū for -ñña on the pattern of -ññū: -ñña (sa. jña)),
not affable, unkind, (niggardly); m. assaddho kadariyo
~ū, Sn 663; — °-tā, f. abstr. ,Vibh 371,26-31 (= thad-
dhamacchariya-vasena "dehi karohī" ti vacanassa ajā-
nanā, Vibh-a); acc. assaddhiyaṁ . . . ~aṁ . . . kosaj-
jaṁ (ap)pahāya√ AN V 146,4 foll.—148,4 foll.; instr.
~āya, Nidd I 37,15 (Nidd-a). — Cf. avadāniya.a-vadaññū

a-vada(t), mfn., neg. part, of vadati (SN II
13,12); — a-vadamāna, mfn., neg. part. med. of do.
(SN V 147,2, so C-mss; Ee a-saṁvadamānā; cf. Sv
(III) 847,6: apadamāna, Se apatamāna; see also Spk
III 200,16 with note 8; pt (B-tradition): aparamānā
[= avhāyantī, Sv-pṭ from Ja II 59,20?]).

(ava-dayati), pr. 3 sg. [ava + sa. √day], to feel
pity or compassion for (gen.); aor. 1 sg. nâvadāyis-
saṁ, Ja IV 178,2* (bhūtānaṁ); d. t. Bds nânukam-
piyaṁ [ɔ: °kampissaṁ]; Ct.).

avadāta, mfn. [ts.; pp. of ava + √dai], clean
white, generally odāta (q. v.); — °-ka, mfn. id.;
acc. m. ~aṁ (dhajaṁ), Th 965; — °-tanu-ttaca,
mfn., with white and tender skin; acc. m. ~aṁ, Ap 476,1
(so Ce).

a-vadāniya, mfn. [3a + sa. vadānya], not
affable, unkind, niggardly (= a-vadaññ[ū/u] above);
m. pl. ~ā, Sn 774 (Nidd I 36,29—37,2; Nidd-a).

ava-dāraṇa, n. [ts.], (a) breaking, splitting,
digging; sense of √kan3 (v. l. kaṇ), Dhātup 178; do. of
√khan, Dhātup 179 (v. l. khaṇ); Dhātum 258—59;
Sadd 397,25; — (b) a hoe or spade, Abh 447 (kha-
ṇittī + ≠ Am-k II 9,12). Cf. ava-dīyati.

ava-disati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √diç; cf. apa-
disati above], to point out, characterize; grd. °-disi-
tabba, mfn.; m. pl. ~ā, visuṁ kātabbā, vavatthape-
tabbă, Ps I 92,2-3 (ad MN I 12,19: 'ādissā').

ava-dissati, pr. 3 sg. pass, of prec; Ja I 401,20'
(dissati avadissati, tasmā disā ti vuccati) ≠ Mp III
287,24 (ad AN III 164,1).

ava-dihati, pr. 3 sg.; udaraṁ ~ati upacinoti
paripūretī ti 'udarâvadehakaṁ' (q. v.), pt ad Sv (III)
1031,15.

ava-dīyati, pr. 3 sg. pass. [sa. ava-dīryate, ava
+ √dṛḷ, to be split, to burst; Ja VI 183,2* (mahi
ssa-m- ~ati; = paṭhavī bhijjitvā vivaraṁ deti, Ct.).
Cf. ava-dāraṇa & udrīyati.

ava-dehakaṁ, ind. [from sa. ava + √dih; cf.
avagaṇḍakārakaṁ, etc.], so as to overfill; — ifc. v.
udarâvadehakam (bhutvā or bhuñjitvā) (Th 935;
DN III 238,23 = MN I 102,3 - AN III 222,25).

ava-dehana, n., verb, noun of ava-dihati, abl.
~ato, Sv (III) 1031,15.

ava-dhāna, n. [ts.], attention; = odhāna (q.v.);
— ifc. v. sotâ° (Sn 322; MN II 176,3; AN V 126,11;
Ap 75,23; Mil 21,27; Rūp Ce 130,4).

ava-dhāraṇa, n. [ts.], ascertainment, affirmation,
(emphasis); restriction; loc. ~e, Abh 1117 (sv-appe
'vadhāraṇe mattaṁ); 1159 (dhuvaṁ thirâvadhāraṇe);
1166 (sense of ni ≠ Sadd 885,10*); = yāva-° in cpd.s,
Mogg III 4 (yāva-saddo ~e, . . . ~aṁ ettakatā-paric-
chedo) ≠ Pay fol. ghṛ v. 7; — given as ex. of the
sense nicchaya of prp. ava, Pay fol. gū v. 7 (nicchaye
~aṁ ≠ Sadd 882,17), do. of prp. ni(r), Pay fol. gr 3
(~e nicchayo) ≠ Sadd 885,17; — giving the sense
of several particles: (a ) atho, Pv-a 251,17 (nipāta-
mattaṁ ~(a)tthe vā); (b) iti (Sadd 317,29); (c) eva,
Abh 1152; Pj I 166,25 (ad Sn 222: sabbe va); Pj II
503,12 ('yāvad evā' ti paricchedâvadhāraṇa-vaca-
naṁ); (d) evaṁ, Sv I 26,16—27,32 (ad DN I 1,4);
Pj I 100,2—101,10; II 135,3-14, etc.; Ud-a 8,30; It-a I
22,6; Ps I 4,7, (Sadd 904,29 foll.) etc.; (e ) kho, Pj
II 182,22; 228,2; 394,21 (padapūraṇa-matte ~âdi-
kālatthe vā nipāto); Pv-a 11,21; 18,28; (f) no, Pj I
170,18 (explaining 'na no', Sn 224); Pj II 402,12; (g)
va, Pj II 76,1 (ad Sn 38); — °-(a)ttha, mfn., having
the meaning of a°, Pj II 76,1; 182,22; Ud-a 8,29, etc.; —
°-(a)tthaṁ, ind., for the sake of restriction, Kacc-v 79;
— °-phala, mfn. giving an av° as its result (implying
an av°); °tta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, It-a I 23,23 (cf. pt
ad Sv I 28,31) = Ud-a 12,24 (Ee w. r. °bālattā); —
— ifc. v. atthâ° Mhv-ṭ 10,7); — vyañjanâ° (Ps I
6,3; Ud-a 15,19; Mhv-t 10,7); — sâ° (ind. ~aṁ, Mhv
LXXII 106; cf. Trsl. note). — Cf. next.

ava-dhārita, mfn. [ts.; pp. of next], ascertained
settled; m. ~o, Abh 797 (= 'suto'); loc. ~e, Mhv
XLVII 4 (tasmiṁ atthe ~e); LI 8 (raññā ~e).

ava-dhāreti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √dhṛ], to as-
certain, determine; abs. ~etvā, Pj II 320,28.

ava-dhi, m. [ts.], see odhi; the starting point of
a verbal action (cf. apâdāna, b); Mogg II 28 (Mogg-p);
ifc. v. calâ° (Sadd 701,24-26), niccalâ° (ib.).

ava-dhīyati, pr. 3 sg. (pass, of odahati) to be
applied; Paṭis-a I 13,2.

a-vana, mfn. (a + vana, 2), free from lust; m.
~o, Nidd II 185,10 (Buddho ~o nibbano; = kilesa-
vana-virahito, tanhā-virahito eva vā, Pj II 605,12
ad Sn 1131; cf. Pj II 24,24-25).

ava-nata, mfn. [ts.; pp. of ava + √nam; gener-
ally oṇata, q. v.], bent down; n. ~aṁ siro yassa
(= 'avaṁsiro)', Sadd 102,30; — °-gala, mfn., wry-
necked(?)) = 'bhinna-gala' (q. v.), Vmv ad Sp (V)
1030,1 (the 79th parisadūsaka); — ifc. v. unnatâ°
(Mil 146,15—147,6).

ava-nati, f. [ts., cf. prec], bending down, stooping,
depression; — ifc. v. unnatâ° (Mil 387,12).

[a-vanatha, mfn. = a-vana, mfn. (formed after
nibbanatha, w. r. for (metr.) a-nata (q. v.), Th 1214
(nibbanathā [ɔ: nibbanatho, Th-a Ce] ~o) = SN I
186,26* (Spk I 269,27: araṇo, w. r. for anato].

a-vanta-taṇha, mfn. (neg. pp. of vamati +
taṇhā), who has not given up desire; pl. ~ā, Nidd I 49,3
(= 'avītataṇhā', Sn 776; Nidd-a: vikkhambha-
ppahānâbhāvena na vamitā taṇhā ti).

Avant[ī/i], f. sg. or m. pl. [ts.], (1) f. name of a city
and a country (= Ujjenī, sa. Ujjayinī); Abh 184; Sadd
205,15; 263,3; abl. ~iyā, SN IV 288,2-3 (Spk: Avanti-
dakkhiṇāpathe ~ °-ito); — (2) m. pl. the people of the
A°-country, or of a certain southern district, perhaps a
colony from A°, see below °-dakkhiṇāpatha (cf. Rhys
Davids, Buddhist India p. 28—30); gen. pl. ~īnaṁ,
DN II 235,20* (Māhissatī ~, their capital, cf. Sn 1011
[& Mvu III 208,18* v. l.)]; AN I 213,4 = IV 252,8 =
256,20 = 261,1; loc.pl. ~īsu viharati (scil. Mahā-
Kaccāno), SN III 9,13 (Spk: Avanti-dakkhiṇāpatha-
saṁkhāte Avanti-raṭṭhe) = 12,30 = Vin I 194,18
foll. ≠ Dhp-a II 176,7; do. SN IV 115,3 (Kurara-
ghare) = AN V 46.14 = Ud 59,3 (Ud-a); cf. 58,4
°-dakkhiṇāpatho) ≠ Dhp-a IV 101,7 ≠ SN IV
116,30 (Makarakaṭe; Spk); Ja IV 397,3*; Mhv-ṭ
159,29; — [Avantikā, m. pl., prob. w. r. for Āvanti-
kā, Mhv-ṭ 159,29]; — °-janapada, m. = Avanti (1);
loc. ~e, Dhp-a IV 101,7; — °-dakkhiṇā-patha, m.,
the Southern Avanti (see above); ~o appabhikkhuko
hoti, Vin I 195,5 foll. = Ud 58,4 (v. /.); loc. ~e, Vin
I 196,1 foll.; Ja III 463,16 (Avantī°); Spk III 92,5 (ad
SN IV 288,2-3; cf. Spk II 258,19 ad SN III 9,13); —
°-dakkhiṇā-pathaka, mfn., living in A°-d-°; pl. ~ā
bhikkhū, Vin II 299,7; gen. pl. ~ānaṁ, ib. 298,23;
— °-putta, m., a prince in A°; rājā Madhuro ~o, MN
II 83,18,23(= Avanti-raṭṭherañño dhītāyaputto, Ps);
— °-pura, n., the town Ā°; loc. ~e, Gv 67,29; — —
°-mahārāja(n), m., the king of A°; ~ā, Ja IV
390,14 (in Ujjenī); °-raṭṭha, n., the kingdom of A°;
~aṁ, Ja V 318,6'; Mhv XIII 8 (Mhv-t 324,24); Mhbv
98,21; loc. ~e Ujjeniyaṁ, Ja IV 390,14; 397,27 (Ujje-
