and Sv (II) 637,9 ad DN II 200,6; see also Rhys
Davids Buddhist India p. 27 ad Sn 977 (Assakassa
visaye; Pj)).Avantī

Avant[ī/i], f. sg. or m. pl. [ts.], (1) f. name of a city
and a country (= Ujjenī, sa. Ujjayinī); Abh 184; Sadd
205,15; 263,3; abl. ~iyā, SN IV 288,2-3 (Spk: Avanti-
dakkhiṇāpathe ~ °-ito); — (2) m. pl. the people of the
A°-country, or of a certain southern district, perhaps a
colony from A°, see below °-dakkhiṇāpatha (cf. Rhys
Davids, Buddhist India p. 28—30); gen. pl. ~īnaṁ,
DN II 235,20* (Māhissatī ~, their capital, cf. Sn 1011
[& Mvu III 208,18* v. l.)]; AN I 213,4 = IV 252,8 =
256,20 = 261,1; loc.pl. ~īsu viharati (scil. Mahā-
Kaccāno), SN III 9,13 (Spk: Avanti-dakkhiṇāpatha-
saṁkhāte Avanti-raṭṭhe) = 12,30 = Vin I 194,18
foll. ≠ Dhp-a II 176,7; do. SN IV 115,3 (Kurara-
ghare) = AN V 46.14 = Ud 59,3 (Ud-a); cf. 58,4
°-dakkhiṇāpatho) ≠ Dhp-a IV 101,7 ≠ SN IV
116,30 (Makarakaṭe; Spk); Ja IV 397,3*; Mhv-ṭ
159,29; — [Avantikā, m. pl., prob. w. r. for Āvanti-
kā, Mhv-ṭ 159,29]; — °-janapada, m. = Avanti (1);
loc. ~e, Dhp-a IV 101,7; — °-dakkhiṇā-patha, m.,
the Southern Avanti (see above); ~o appabhikkhuko
hoti, Vin I 195,5 foll. = Ud 58,4 (v. /.); loc. ~e, Vin
I 196,1 foll.; Ja III 463,16 (Avantī°); Spk III 92,5 (ad
SN IV 288,2-3; cf. Spk II 258,19 ad SN III 9,13); —
°-dakkhiṇā-pathaka, mfn., living in A°-d-°; pl. ~ā
bhikkhū, Vin II 299,7; gen. pl. ~ānaṁ, ib. 298,23;
— °-putta, m., a prince in A°; rājā Madhuro ~o, MN
II 83,18,23(= Avanti-raṭṭherañño dhītāyaputto, Ps);
— °-pura, n., the town Ā°; loc. ~e, Gv 67,29; — —
°-mahārāja(n), m., the king of A°; ~ā, Ja IV
390,14 (in Ujjenī); °-raṭṭha, n., the kingdom of A°;
~aṁ, Ja V 318,6'; Mhv XIII 8 (Mhv-t 324,24); Mhbv
98,21; loc. ~e Ujjeniyaṁ, Ja IV 390,14; 397,27 (Ujje-
ni-nagare); Gv 66,14 (do.); Ja V 133,24 (Dakkhinā-
pathe); Ud-a 307,1 (= 'Avantīsu'); Spk II 258,'20
(do.); Ps III 319,13; — — Ifc. v. Assakâ° (~iṁ, Ja
V 317,24* = Assaka-raṭṭhaṁ vā °-raṭṭhaṁ vā, Ct.; cf.
sa. Āvanty-Açmakāh, Ganapātha ad Pan VI 2,37,
and Sv (II) 637,9 ad DN II 200,6; see also Rhys
Davids Buddhist India p. 27 ad Sn 977 (Assakassa
visaye; Pj)).Avantī

a-vandi, aor. 3 sg. of √vand (Th 869 = MN II
100,7*); do. 1 sg. (avandi 'haṁ, Ap 369,28; 419,4).

a-vandiya, mfn. (neg. grd. of √vand), not to be
praised, honoured, or worshipped; m. pl. ~iyā (dasa),
Vin II 162,23 foll; do. Utt-vn 661; Khuddas XX 1
(also title ib.); kathaṁ ~iyā Buddha, Ap 535,12 =
Thī-a 149,8*.

Avandiya, m. Npr. of a Tamil chief; Mhv
LXXVI 146 (°-rāyaro).

avanna-kāma, mfn., wishing to disparage; pl. ~ā
(Buddhassa, etc.), AN IV 188,2.

ava-nindati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √nind], to
blame, reject; pr. 1 pl. ~āma, Ja VI 576,1* (dānam
assa pasaṁsāma nâvanindāma; cf. v.II.; = na nin-
dāma, Ct.).

[ava-nibhāsa-vaṇṇa, mfn., of colour almost
similar to, conjectured by Tr. ad Ja IV 439,1* (Ed.
better migā manussā va nibhāsavaṇṇā (cf. vaṇṇa-
nibhā), = nibhā-samānavaṇṇā, Ct.)].

avanī, f. [ts.], the earth; Abh 182 ≠ Sadd 81,21*;
acc. ~iṁ, Mhv XXXVII 153 (hatthenâhaniyâ° po-
ṭhento); — °ī-abhimukha, mfn. towards the earth;
Mhbv 33,15; — °ĭ-pa, m., a king, ruler; ~o, Ras I
31,11* (v. l.; Ce vasudhâdipo); — ĭ-pāla, m., do.; ~o,
DāthlVδ; — °-pati, m., do.; Mhv LXXXIII 52
( ˇ ˇ - ˇ ˇ ); LXXXVIII 80; — °-'ssara, m. (avanī
+ issara, do.; Mhv LXXXI 40 (°-~o).

[avapakāsati, pr. 3 sg., prob, a clerical blend of
vapakāsati and apakāsati, Vin II 204,25; see apa-
kassati (2) & cf. ava-kassati].

ava-patta, mfn. (ava + sa. pattra; cf. ava
(a, a)), leafless; n. ~aṁ nippattaṁ patita-pattaṁ,
Ja III 496,7' ( = 'opattam').

ava-patita, mfn. (pp. of ava + √pat, see opatati),
fallen down; acc. m. ~aṁ (hatthi-kkhandhā), Th 194
(cf. anukkamati; = ava-mukhaṁ patitaṁ, Th-a).

[avappakāsa-dukkhāni, in the uddāna AN III
147,23* ts w. r. for vapakāsa-samaṇadukhā; cf. ava-
pakāsati above].

ava-pivati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *ava + √Pā], to drink
(a little or furtively); Ja I 163,13' (pānīyassa piva-
nato aḍḍharatte ~atī ti aḍḍnarattâvapāyī).

ava-pīḷanaka, n. [cf. sa. ava-pīdana], a certain
medical treatment (with sarpiṣ); Bhes 4:7 (cf. opïḷeti).

ava-bujjhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-budhyate, √budh],
to know, perceive, be aware of, mind; (neg.) 3 sg.
nâvabujjhati, Th 737 (khuraṁ madhunā littaṁ ~);
taṁ jano nâ°, It 83,24*—84,12*—24* (= na jānāti,
It-a) = AN IV 96,21* ( = do. Mp); vaddhānaṁ yo
vākyaṁ nâ°, Ja III 256,16* (= vacanaṁ na ganhāti,
Ct.) = 485,3*; sadatthaṁ nâ°, Ja III 260,12* ( = na
jānāti, Ct.) ≠ IV 26,10*; hadayaṁ nâvabujjhati,
Th 733 (= sāsanassa hadayaṁ abbhantaraṁ . . . na
jānāti, Th-a); — (neg.) 2 sg. evaṁ ce yācamānānaṁ
añjaliṁ nâvabujjhasi, Ja IV 218,7* = V 234,21* (—
na jānāsi, na paṭigaṇhāsi, Ct.) ≠ 327,13*; — (neg.)
3 pl. nâvabujjhanti, 'AN IV 98,2*; Ud-a 341,12; —
(neg.) aor. 3 sg. med. nâvabujjhatha, Ja III 401,27*
(= na jam, Ct.); — inf. ava-bujjhituṁ (na sakkā
sukhena ~), Ps II 174,24; — grd. ava-bujjhitabba,
mfn.; m. dukkhena ~o, ib. — cf. avabodhati.

ava-bodha, m. [ts.], perception, full knowledge;
+ ānubhāva, Ud-a 48,20 (avijjâdi ... khayassa
~ânubhāva-dīpakaṁ udānaṁ); — ifc. v. [an°, see
above, do. see sabhāvâ° (Ud-a 214,22)], aviparītâ°
(Ud-a 76,11), yathābhūtâ° (Ud-a 213,14, °âbhāva),
yathābhūta- sabhāvâ° (Ud-a 135,20), visayâ° (Ud-a
155,14*), saka-attabhāvâ° (Ud-a 68,3 o), saccâ° (Pj
II 509,5).

ava-bodhati, pr. 3 sg. [ts., ava + √budh; cf.
ava-bujjhati], to perceive, pay attention to; to believe
in (acc.); mostly neg. cf. avabujjhati; 1 sg. sakassa
cittassa nâvabodhāmi kiñcanaṁ, Ja V 215,27* (Ct.:
anissaro jāto 'mhi . . . ummattako); 3 pl. vācaṁ
sandhibhedassa nâvabodhanti, Ja III 151,16* (= na
sārato paccenti, Ct.); — caus. ~eti (q. v.).

ava-bodhana, n. [ts., verbal noun of prec.]; sense
of √ñā1, Dhātup 358; Dhātum 584; Sadd II 247
(p. 350,26); — do. Dhātup 497 = Dhātum 718 =
Sadd II 1240 (p. 496,16); Pay fol. chai v. 5; cf. sa-
Dhātup § 31,36; — ifc. v. saddhâdi . . . (Ud-a 141,6),
sukhâ° (Mp II 281,5).

ava-bodheti, pr. 3 sg. caus. of ava-bodhati (q. v.),
to communicate (with); inf. ~etuṁ (paraṁ), Mp II
281,8.

ava-bhāsa, m. [ts.], splendour, light, see obhāsa
(ava + √bhās); — ifc. v. gambhīrâ° (mfn. DN II
55,10 = SN II 92,9; SN II 36,27, cf. gambhīrôbhāsa,
AN II 105,11; 106,23).

2ava-bhāsati, pr. 3 sg. only in the form obhā-
sati (Ud-a 73,9*).

1(ava-bhāsati) pr. 3 sg. (ava + √bhās2, sa.
√bhāṣ), to address with fascinating (seductive) talk;
pot. 3 sg. ava-bhāseyya, Sp (III) 547,10 ad Vin III
128,35': obhāseyyā ti ajjhācāro vuccati; see 1obhāsati.

ava-bhāsita, mfn. [ts.; pp. of ava + √bhăs],
illumined, resplendent; °pajjotenâ° Saddh 590 — ifc.
v. asītânuvyañjanâ° (Ja I 89,21, see anuvyañjana
above; cf. obhāsita Mil 119,4; Ud 73,11*).

ava-bhuñjati, pr. 3 sg. (ava + γbhuj), to eat
(unlawfully, as a parasite) ~ati, Ja III 273,1'; inf.
~bhottuṁ (rājapiṇḍaṁ), Ja III 272,23* (= dubbhut-
taṁ bhuñjituṁ, Ct.); pp. ~bhutta, mfn., partaken
of before, Pj II 180,20 ('na paṭipūjeti', na vā deti
~aṁ vā deti, ad Sn 129).

ava-bhūta, mfn. (pp. of ava + √bhū), mean,
ignoble; f. ~ā, MN II 210,7 (= avaḍḍhibhūtā amaṅ-
galabhūtā, Ps; pt: adhobhūtā, adhobhāvo sattānaṁ
avaḍḍhi avamaṅgalan ti āha: 'avaḍḍhibhūtā yevā' ti).

ava-maṅgala, mfn. (ava + maṅgala = a-maṅ-
gala (q. v.) & cf. sa. apa-maṅgala); inauspicious, un-
lucky; n. ~aṁ (+ kāḷakaṇṇi-sadisaṁ), Ja I 372,25-30;
ib. 402,4-17 (nāmaṁ); subst, n. Nāmar-p 1302; maṅ-
gale ~aṁ vadanto, Ja I 446,27; Dhp-a III 123,12-13;
Ja VI 424,5-6; Pv-a 261,8; — loc. ~e rathe ~e asse,
Ja VI 10,4-5 (cf. ib. 27); — also occurring as B-reading
for a-maṅgala; — ifc. v. maṅgalâ° (Ja II 197,2); — —
°-vattha, n., (said of a winding sheet), Sp (V) 1117,32
ad Vin I 278,25 ('siveyyakaṁ' nāma Uttarakurusu
sīvathikaṁ ~aṁ; see ib. 1118,7).

ava-mañgalya or ava-mañgalla, mfn. (from
prec), unlucky; Ja I 446,28 (imaṁ ~laṁ anumoda-
naṁ kathesi, quoting Khp VIII); loc. pl. ~llesu
anumodanaṁ karonto (quoting Khp V 1) ib. 446,29,ava-mañgalya

ava-mañgalya or ava-mañgalla, mfn. (from
prec), unlucky; Ja I 446,28 (imaṁ ~laṁ anumoda-
naṁ kathesi, quoting Khp VIII); loc. pl. ~llesu
anumodanaṁ karonto (quoting Khp V 1) ib. 446,29,ava-mañgalya

ava-maññati, pr. 3sg. [sa. ava-manyate, √man],
to despise, to treat contemptuously; Sadd 882,18 ≠ Pay
fol. gū v. 7 (ex. of the sense paribhava of prp. ava);
imper. 3 sg. ~atu, Sadd 401,13 (= 'ocināyatu', Ja
VI 4,19*, cf. ib. 22' v. l. Bd); pot. 3 sg. nâvamaññeyya,
Saddh 271; aor. 3 sg. avamaññi, Pj II 324,28; [1 sg.
avamaññissaṁ, w. r. in Se for a-maññisaṁ, Sv (III)
813,7 ad DN II 352,13]; aor. 3sg. meɔṙ. pati(ṁ) bhariyā
~atha, Sn 314 (= paribhavi, avamaññi, Pj); fut. 3 sg.
~issati, Ja VI 273,27; [abs. avamaññāya, v. l. for
avaññāya, Mp I 366,13]; pp. ava-mata, q. v. — caus.
ava-māneti (q. v.).

ava-maññana, n. [verbal noun of prec.; cf. sa.
ava-mānana], underrating; Sadd 523,3 (attani parehi
kataṁ ~aṁ makkho ti vuccati, quoting Vin I 25,4).

ava-maññanā, f. [do., cf. sa. ava-mānanā], dis-
respect (outrage); pl. ~ā, Ja VI 509,7' (etā ~ā atikka-
manti; so Tr. for Ee etā avamaññā nâtikkamanti).

ava-mata, mfn. (pp. of ava-maññati), despised;
— ifc. v. an-° (DN III 153,18*; cf. an-avaññāta).

ava-maddana, n. [sa. ava-mardana, √mṛd; cf.
omaddana], crushing, striking, breaking off; (a) sense
of √kiñc, Dhātum 50; (b) do of √bhañj1, Dhātum 73.
(Cf. Sadd 528,22 & Dhātup 42; 68; sa. Dhātup 29,16).

ava-mayūra, mfn. [cf. sa. mayūra, m.], aban-
doned by the peacocks; n. ~aṁ (ava-kokilaṁ +),
Mogg III 15 (see ava-kuṭṭha & avakokila above).

a-vambhana, mfn. (3a + vambhanā, √vambh),
v. r. for avañña, Pv-a 175,27 (see avajānāti, grd. (γ)).

ava-māna, m. [ts.] = omāna (q. v.), disrespect,
contempt; Abh 172 (here n. ~aṁ for avamānanaṁ?)
+ tirokkāro paribhavo); ~o, Ja V 384,28 (pt: ava-
māno ti avamaññako!); Ps II 281,3; acc. ~aṁ, Ja
II 386,1; III 16,22; 423,12; instr. °-vasena, Ja III
248,4' (= 'amānanā'); — °ppatta, mfn., subject to a°;
f. ~ā, Dhp-a II 276,19.

(ava-māneti), pr. 3 sg. caus. of ava-maññati (or
denom, of avamāna); to dishonor; abs. ~etvā raṭṭhā
pabbājesi, Ja V 246,4; pp. see prec.

ava-mukha, mfn., with the face downwards;
~aṁ patitaṁ, Th-a ad Th 194 (= 'ava-patitaṁ').

[ava-muñcati, pr. 3sg., always omuñcati, q. v.;
cf. Ja VI 218,20* (khaggaṁ va muñcati, where Tr.
has (a)vamuñcati = lays down)].

ava-mocana, n. [ts.], loosening; sense of √sutt,
Sadd 540,24 (cf. sa-Dhātup 35,54).

a-vaya, mfn. [cf. sa. 2a-vyaya], without want or
deficiency, in the traditional analysis of an-avaya
(q.v.), and samavaya-saṭṭh'-esana (DN III 269,12;
AN II 41,2, where Sv & Mp explain with an-ūna
(q. v).

a-vayama(t), mfn. (neg. part, of vy-ā + √yam),
without exertion; m. (a ) an-uṭṭhahaṁ avāyamaṁ,
SN I 217,3* (v. l. avāyāmaṁ, metr. (see next), also
in Spk Ee; = (β) avāyamanto, Spk); gen. (a ) ~yama-
to, AN IV 295,18 (an-uṭṭhahato +); (β) ~yaman-
tassa, Ja II 233,5' (= 'an-īhamānassa').

a-vayama(t), mfn. (neg. part, of vy-ā + √yam),
without exertion; m. (a ) an-uṭṭhahaṁ avāyamaṁ,
SN I 217,3* (v. l. avāyāmaṁ, metr. (see next), also
in Spk Ee; = (β) avāyamanto, Spk); gen. (a ) ~yama-
to, AN IV 295,18 (an-uṭṭhahato +); (β) ~yaman-
tassa, Ja II 233,5' (= 'an-īhamānassa').

avayava, m. [ts.], (a) limb, member, constituent,
part; Abh 278; 1163 (viyogâvayavesu, giving the
sense of the prefix pa-, not in Rūp Ce 84,12-20 ≠
Pay fol. gūw. l ≠ Sadd 881,25); — sense of √pis1,
Sadd II 981 (p. 453,4 √piç, sa. Dhâtup § 28,143);
do. of √vind, Sadd II 449 (p.379,29 — √khind,
ib. p.379,30 — √bind or √bhind, sa. Dhātup§3,27;
do. of √saṭ2, Sadd II 268 (p.352,28) = √ṣaṭ, sa.
Dhātup 9,20; — loc. ~e samūhavohārena, Sp (III)
522,21 (. . . ettha "sākhacchedako rukkhacchedako
ti vuccatī" ti ādi nidassanaṁ, Vjb); ~e câyaṁ sam-
udāya-vohāro, Vv-a 201,12; [yathā rukkhe sākhā
~amhi (v. l. yava-rāsimhi ≠ pt ad Sv I 32,11) sam-
uṭṭhito, Ud-a 22,16]; gen. pl. samaṁ saha vā ~ānaṁ
ayanaṁ pavatti adhiṭṭhānan ti samūho 'samayo',
Ud-a 20,15; ~ānam ādhāra-bhāvena paññāpīyati,
Ud-a 22,15 = pt ad Sv I 32,11; — (b) a suffix (opp.
anubandha, q. v.), (Mogg I 23) Pay fol. no v. 8; —
(c) a member in a syllogism; instr, pl. ~ehi, Pj II 397,2
(paṭiññâdīhi, cf. Tikap-a 11,19); — — ifc. v. an-°
(q. v.), dehâ° (Abh 791), dvi-avayava-samudāya°
(Sadd 266,26 (misprint in Ee)), nagarâ° (Ps I 242,3),
pañcâ° (Sadd 919,25), padâ° (Sadd 280,22), mūlâ°
(Pv-a 251,7), vacanâ° (Tikap-a 11,19-20), vatthâ°
(Abh 294), vikalâ° (pt ad Sv (III) 871,30), sabbâ°
(Ap 512,14 = Thī-a 273,22*), samudāyâ° (-tta, Sadd
222,10), sarīrâ° (Pv-a 211,9; Vv-a 53,10; Sadd 254,22
foll).

avayava-bhūta, mfn., being a constituent; loc.
pl. ~esu, Vism 485,16; — °-vinimmutta, mfn., apart
from the members; m. samūho ~o paramatthato avijja-
māno, Ud-a 22,13 = pt ad Sv I 33,10; — °-visesa-
va(t), mfn., having different parts; m. pl. ~vanto,
Vv-a 276,3; — °-sabhāva-ṭṭhāna, n., the natural
place of the parts; ~aṁ, Ud-a 20,17; — °-sambandha,
m., connection with the parts (a function of the gen.); loc.
~e, Ud-a 37,11 (cf. ib. 118,7); Mogg-p II 1 (Ce 36,11);
— °-âdi-sampanna, mfn., possessed of the different
logical members, etc. (see avayava, c); f. ~ā (vācā),
Pj II 397,5.

2avara, mfn. = apara; (a) posterior, (b) western;
n. subst, loc. purassa ~e, Ps II 21,7 (b; 'avara-pure');
— ifc. v. parâvara (Pj II 410,4), paro-'vara (Sn
353, 475).

1avara, mfn. [ts.] — ora (q. v.); — °-mattaka,
(mf)n., instr. ~ena, Mp ad AN IV 22,22 (= 'ora-
mattakena'); — ifc. v. an-āvara.

avara-ja, mfn. (2avara, a; sa. apara-ja); m.,
a younger brother, Mhv LXXXVIII 19, 24, 79.

ava-rajjhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √rādh], (a) to
miss, omit, fail of; 3 pl. ~anti, Ja IV 428,14* (na ~ te
vaco; = na te vacanaṁ ~issanti, Ct.); fut. 1 sg. nâ-
varajjhissaṁ, Th 167 (karissaṁ + ; v. l. nâvarujjhissaṁ
& na virajjhissaṁ; Th-a (Ce): 'na virujjhissaṁ' =
na dhamme virādhessaṁ); — (b) = aparajjhati (q. v.),
to offend; pr. 1 pl. ~āma, Ja V 375,11* (Ct.).

avaratta, n. (haplol. for 2avara + ratta, sa.
-rātra, cf. Amg puvva-rattâvaratta), the later half of
the night; loc. aḍḍharatte 'varatte vā, (so Tr.), Ja VI
80,14*-16* (= pacchima-ratte, Ct.) = 550,20*-22*.

avara-pura, mfn. (Npr.l) [from an indecl.
*avara-pure, cf. anto-gāme, etc.], (the park) situated
to the west of the city; loc. ~e vana-sande, MN I 68,6
(Ps II 21,7).

avarādha, v. l. for aparādha, Ja V 26,25' (C*s);
acc. ~aṁ, Ja V 26,20* (Ee na . . . aparādh' ito 'haṁ
ṭuyhaṁ [v. l. (metr.) tuviyaṁ, cf. Sadd 805,2] sarāmi,
i. e. any injury).

avarujjhati, pr. 3 sg. intrans. (cf. avaruddha, c),
v. t. Cks for aparajjhati Th 167, to oppose, to rebel.

avaruddha, mfn. (pp. of avarundhati Se ava-
rujjhati), = oruddha (a) blocked up, intercepted, (b)
relegated, (c) rebellious; m. avaruddho, Sadd 470,18
(= pabbājito, b); vaje oruddho (goṇo), AN III 393,21
(a); gen. m. avaruddhassa, Ja VI 557,29* (b); m. pl.
~ā, DN III 204,1-6 (c; = paccāmittā verino, Sv =
opponents); Ja VI 572,5* (b; = pabbājitā, Ct); Saddh
592(a); Vin IV 181,31 (c; = paṭiviruddhā, Sp); acc.
pl. m. oruddhe bhikkhavo, Ap 599,18 (a); gen.pl.
avaruddhānaṁ, Ja VI 584,21* (b); — oruddha-pati-
ruddha, mfn., Ja IV 4,9* (a; m. ~o; Ct.).

avaruddhaka, mfn. = avaruddha (b, c); m. pl.
~ā, Ja VI 575,15*(21') (b); acc.pl. ~e, Ja VI 582,
20*,28' (b); Dīp I 21 (c).

Avaruddhaka, m. Npr. of a yakkha; Dhp-a II
237,13—238,3.

ava-rundhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √rudh], also
orundh°; (a) to enclose, to keep checked, to lock up,
(b) (to seclude, remove), to relegate, exile; gāvam
~ati vajaṁ, (a), Mogg-v II 2 (from Kāç 14,51; Pay);
Ja VI 516,9* (Ee avaruddhati; = raṭṭhā pabbājeti,
Ct.; b); 2 sg. ~asi, Ja VI 505,13* (Ee avaruddhasi;
= raṭṭhā nīharasi, Ct.; = nikkaḍḍhāpesi, pt; quoted
Sadd 794,8; b); abs. orundhiyā naṁ, Ja IV 480,11* (a;
= orundhitvā, Ct.); — caus. (or denom, from orodha),
orodheti; pot. 1 pl. orodheyyāma, DN III 38,19 ( =
vinandheyyāma [scil. vāda-jālena, pt], Sv) = 53,16;
— pass, orundhīyati, avarundhīyatī ti orodho, Sadd
470,13; pp. avaruddha, q. v.

Avaroja, m. Npr. of a kuṭumbika and his nephew
(time of Vipassī Buddha), Dhp-a III 364,13 foll.

ava-rodha, m. (verb, noun of avarundhati, cf.
orodha), the act of enclosing, inclusion (under, loc);
acc. ettha ~aṁ gacchanti (are subsumed under that),
Vibh-a 31,28 = Vism 478,28; abl. tad-avarodhato,
Vibh-a 31,14-29 = Vism 478,13-28; sabba-paññattī-
naṁ vijjamânâdisu [Pp-a 171,28] chasu paññattisu
~o, Ud-a 14,18 (cf. pt ad Sv I 29,18: sabba-paññat-
tīnam vijjamānâdi-vasena chasu paññatti-bhedesu
antogadhattā).

ava-lakkhaṇa, mfn. (cf. ava-maṅgala), with none
or unauspicious marks (said of a sword); Ja I 455,10.

a-valañja, mfn. (3a + the present stem of vaḷañjati,
Sadd 349,22), impassable, impracticable, out of use; m.
tava vicaraṇa-maggo ~o viya jāto, Dhp-a IV 116,9;
acc. m. maggaṁ (prob. ɔ: vacca-maggaṁ) ~aṁ karoti,
Ps II 377,15 (obstructs); acc. n. setu-saṁkamanāni~aṁ
akaṁsu (as in cpd. with karoti), Vv-a 46,3; loc. n. ~e
chadḍeti, Vin IV 266,1.2 (where nobody passes'!).

a-valañjana, (mf)n. (neg. verb, noun [adj.]), non-
using, or out of use (as a way); °aṭṭhena purāṇa-
maggo, Spk II 118,28; °ṭṭhānesu, ib. 278,6.

a-valañjiyamāna, mfn. (neg. part, pass.), out of
use, Ja I 111,15.

ava-lamba, ind. (abs. of ava + √lamb), leaning
(on, acc): Pv 435 (= olambitvā, apassenaṁ [so Ce]
apassāya, Pv-a).

ava-lambaka, (mf)n., (something) hanging down
(as a per pendicle); ~aṁ yam kiñci cārento viya,
pt ad Ja I 484,24 (= 'olambakaṁ', cf. Ja VI 392,13;
Spk II 330,16).

ava-lambaka(-semha), m., one of the five kinds
of phlegmatic humour, Bhes 1:41.

ava-lambana, n. (verb, noun from avalambati),
(a) hanging down, Sadd 406,29 (= 'avasaṁsana'); (b)
support, Bhes 1:41.

ava-lekhati (or perhaps (in good texts) belter ava-
likhati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √likh], (a) to strip off the
bark; pot. 3 sg. avalekhana-satthakena ~eyya, Mp III
181,16 (Ee °likh°; — 'lekhaniyā likheyya'); — (b) to
clean oneself in the vaccakuṭi; 3 pl. pharusena kaṭṭhena
(see avalekhana-kaṭṭha) avalekhanti, Vin II 221,33;
pot. 3 sg. nâvalekheyya, Khuddas XVI 4 ≠ Mula-s
V 9 [ ˇ ˇ - - ˇ ] ≠ Vin-vn 2936; grd. n. ~itabbaṁ,
Vin II 222,16; — (c) to shave, see olikhati (Th 169;
Thī 88); — (d) to smoothenÇl), do. (AN III 295,24; Mp).ava-lekhati

ava-litta, mfn. [sa. avalipta, pp. of avalimpati],
besmeared, daubed; ullitto vā ~o vā ullittâvalitto vā,
Vin IV 47,28' (= bahi litta, Sp (III) 567,5 ad Vin III
149,23'); — ifc v. ullittâ° (iterative cpd.; AN I 101,12
(Mp); MN I 76,6 (Ps); 118,16; Vin III 149,23'; IV
47,28'); — n(a)hātâ° (Ps III 112,19 C*; better Ee
nhāta-vilitta).

ava-lekhati (or perhaps (in good texts) belter ava-
likhati), pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √likh], (a) to strip off the
bark; pot. 3 sg. avalekhana-satthakena ~eyya, Mp III
181,16 (Ee °likh°; — 'lekhaniyā likheyya'); — (b) to
clean oneself in the vaccakuṭi; 3 pl. pharusena kaṭṭhena
(see avalekhana-kaṭṭha) avalekhanti, Vin II 221,33;
pot. 3 sg. nâvalekheyya, Khuddas XVI 4 ≠ Mula-s
V 9 [ ˇ ˇ - - ˇ ] ≠ Vin-vn 2936; grd. n. ~itabbaṁ,
Vin II 222,16; — (c) to shave, see olikhati (Th 169;
Thī 88); — (d) to smoothenÇl), do. (AN III 295,24; Mp).ava-lekhati

ava-lekhana, n. (see also apalekhana), verb, noun
of prec; — °-kaṭṭha, n. (sa. kāṣṭha), a wooden chip
for cleaning (cf. avalekhati, b); Vin II 141,24-25 (anu-
jānāmi ~aṁ); 221,33; 222,16 (na pharusena kaṭṭhena
avalekhitabbaṁ, na ~aṁ vaccakūpamhi pātetabbaṁ;
Sp) ≠ Vin-vn 2936 ≠ Khuddas XVI 4 (nâvalekheyya
pharusena — koros pusan-daňden no pisnēya, sn);
Vin II 222,23 ≠ Vin-vn 2941;'— °-piṭhara, m., a
receptacle for used avalekhana-kaṭṭhas; Vin II
141,25-26 (= avalekhana-kaṭṭhānaṁ ṭhapana-bhā-
jana-viseso, Vmv); 222,23 ≠ Vin-vn 2941; —
°-sattha, n. = next (Ja IV 402,17 Ee); — °-satthaka,
n. (sa. çastra(ka)), a tool for barking (cf. avalekhati, a);
~an ti ucchu-tacâvalekhana-satthakaṁ, mhṭ ad Vism
255,15; Mp III 181,16 (= 'lekhanī'); Ja IV 402,17
(°satthena, v. l. °satthakena); — °saṇṭhānaṁ, Vism
255,15 (scil. uparimaṁ hanukaṭṭhi) = Pj I 50,28.

ava-lepa, m. [ts.], (a) anointing (= lepa), Abh
1079; (b) presumption, pride, Abh ib. (= gabba);
Sadd 473,7 (= ahaṁkāra); 485,15 (māno +); vigata-
kodha-madâvalepo, Tel 1; — ifc v. sâ° (Mhv LXXII
105).

ava-lepana, n. (cf. ava-litta), daubing, plastering;
— ifc v. addâ°, allâ°, taca-maṁsâ° (mfn.; Sn 194
= Ja I 146,15*), pītâ° (n., MN I 385,7), bahalâ°
(n., DN II 332,27).

ava-lokana, n. [ts.], looking, a look; Sadd (518,26
v. l.); 520,13; — ifc v. veneyya-janâ° (Bv-a Ce 248,27,
quoted Ss 16,35).

ava-lokita, (mf)n. [ts.], v. l. in nāgâ° for nāgâpa-
lokita, see apaloketi (above) and cf. nāgâpalokana
(C*) for nāga-vilokana, Ps III 133,11.

ava-loketi, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √lok], to look
at, regard (more common oloketi, q. v.); [MN II
137,21-22 (Ps) & DN II 96,29 prob. w. rr. for apa-l°];
pot. 3 sg. (med.) avalokeyyātha pāvacanaṁ, Th 587
(= olokeyya, paññācakkhunā passeyya, Th-a); neg.
abs. an-avaloketvā, Mp I 320,15 (better v. l. an-ap°).

a-vavatthāna, n. (neg. verb, noun of vy-ava +
√sthā), the not being settled or determined; abl. ~ato,
Vism 236,13 (= 'animittato'; = kālâdi-vasena vava-
tthānâbhāvato, mhṭ); — °-cārikā, f., Mp III 291,2
(= 'anavattha-cārikā', q. v.).

a-vavatthita, mfn. (also written °ṭṭhita), un-
settled, not firm; — °-cārikā, f., Mp III 330,2 (= 'ana-
vattha-cārikā', q. v.); — °ârammana, mfn., Ps
I 117,22.

Avavādakā, f. Npr., the sister of Saccā, Lola
and Paṭācārā, Ja III 1,14 (B-readings: Avacārikā,
Avadārikā) ≠ Ps II 268,20 (Sivāvatikā; Amāv:
Avaṭakāyā).

a-vasa, mfn. [sa. avaça], (a) not having one's
free will, dependent; ~o, Abh 743 (= vivaso); Saddh
290; Mhv II 33 (see b); acc tvaṁ mam ~aṁ ānesi,
Ja III 36,14 (— balakkārena ānesi, pt); nom.pl. ~ā
abalā aviriyā niyati-saṅgati-bhāva-pariṇatā, DN I
53,32 (Sv I 161,22) = MN I 407,26 (Ps) = 517,2 = SN
III 210,9 (Spk); acc.pl. ye hanāma mayam pure ḷ
avase, 'saṁ bhayaṁ hoti, Th 705 (Th-a: '~e' ti avase

pi paṭhanti . . . = avasesānaṁ, ayam eva vā pāṭho);
— (b) independent, Mhv II 33 (alternatively = na
aññavasiko, Mhv-ṭ; — cf. avasatā (f.), avassa.

ava-saṁsana, n. [sa. avasraṁsana], falling or
hanging down; sense of √√ramb and lamb, Dhātup
198—99, Dhātum 283—84, Sadd II 612 (p. 406,29;
= avalambana), paṁs (ɔ: saṁs?) and bhaṁs, Sadd
II 950—51 (p. 449,6).

avasaka, mfn. i. q. avasa (a); ~aṭṭhena, Ps III
146,8 (so C*; Ee asakaṭṭhena).

ava-sakkati, pr. 3 sg. (cf. apa-sakkati above), to
go back, retire; Ja III 83,6*; otherwise osakkati.

ava-saṭa, mfn. [sa. ava-sṛta, pp. of ava + √sṛ],
i. q. osaṭa; having entered, arrived; acc m. Manasā-
kaṭato tāvad eva ~aṁ (just arrived from M.), DN I
249,1 (taṁ-khaṇam eva nikkhantan ti attho, Sv)
≠ MN II 206,25 (v. l. apasakkaṁ; Ps = Sv); f. cutā
vā nāsitā vā ~ā vā (scil. bhikkhunī). Vin IV 216,34**
(= titthâyatanaṁ saṁkantā, ib. 217,15').

avasatā, f., abstr. of a-vasa; the being unsub-
missive to one's will ("unruly"); instr. ~āya, Vism
612,2 (+ avidheyyatāya; = avasavattanato, mhṭ).
a-vasana, n. (neg. verb, noun of vasati: to dwell);
Ja I 237,20 (imasmiṁ vihāre tassa ~°âkāro).

ava-sanna, mfn. (pp. of ava-sīdati), i. q. osanna;
sunk down, dejected; — °-saṁkappa, mfn., Dhp-a
III 409,10; — °-sammā-saṁkappa-citta, mfn., ib.
410,3' (= 'saṁsanna-saṁkappa-mana(s)').

[avasamgata, Editor's mistake in Thī-a 181,16*
= Ap 566,2; read with Ap Ce; sapāṇa-m-iva kanto
me (scil. putto) tadā Yama-vasaṁ gato].

a-vasamāna, mfn. (neg. part, of vasati); Ja I
436,22'.

avasara, m. [ts.], occasion, opportunity; Abh 770
(~ patthāva (sa. prastāva); ≠ Am-k III 2,24);
mahā-khaggappahārâvasaraṁ (acc), Mhv LXXVI 165.

(ava-sarati), pr. 3 sg. = osarati; to enter, to
arrive; aor. (a) 1 sg. māsa-khettaṁ tarito (see Sadd)
avâsariṁ, Vv 892 (= upagacchiṁ pâvisiṁ vā, Vv-a),
quoted Sadd 426,4; (β) 3 sg. anupubbena cārikañ
caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari, Vin III 11,30
(= tena avasari, Sp; 'tan' ti karaṇatthe upayoga-
vacanaṁ, Sp-t) ≠ DN I 87,5 (Sv I 244,1-2) ≠ MN I
285,4 (Ps) ≠ Sn p. 103,2 (Pj) ≠ Ud 78,6 (Ud-a);
85,26 (Ud-a).

a-vasa-vattaka, mfn. (from vase vattati, sa.
vaçe vartate), not dependent on one's will; abl. rūpaṁ
rittato passati . . . ~ato, Nidd II 279,32 (Ee avasa-
vattanato; Nidd-a), quoted Vism 655,8 (mhṭ: aññassa
vase na vattati, nâpi aññaṁ attano vase vattetī ti);
loc. evaṁ ~e saṁsāra-ppavatte (so CeEe for °-vaṭṭe?),
Pv-a 64,14.

a-vasa-vattana, n., non subjection; abl. ~ato,
Nidd II 279,32 (see prec); Ud-a 236,10; Ps I 73,15;
Sadd 591,24; — °aṭṭhena, Mp ad AN IV 423,1 (≠
Ps III 146,9: na attaṭṭhena); Ud-a 215,17; Dhp-a III
407,7; mhṭ ad Vism 612,2 (= 'avasatāya'); — °âkāra,
m., Nidd-a Ee (II) 385,24 (= 'anattâkāra').

2a-vasa-vatti(n), mfn., unsubmissive (cf. avasa,
b); loc. sg. n. (see Sadd 667,23-25): citte ~ini, Thī 37
≠ 77 (according to Thī-a, see prec); -°tta, n. abstr.
Khuddas L 2.

2a-vasa-vatti(n), mfn. (3a + sa. vaça-vartin; cf.
attano vase vatteti, Ja V 316,12 foll.), not exercising
supreme power, without power of self-masteru; m. ~ī,
DN I 247,14 (opp. vasavattī, see Sv (II) 404,12-14);
anissaro assāmī ~ī, Mil 253,4-14; abl. m. ~ito, Vism
618,38 (assāmikato +); f.. or loc. sg. n. of 2a-vasa-
vatti(n): aladdhā cetaso santiṁ citte ~in[ī/i], Thī 37
(Thī-a: viriya-samatāya [so Ce] abhāvena mama
bhāvanā-citte na vasavattini) = 40 (Thī-a: citta-
vasaṁ vattetuṁ a-samattha-bhāvato, thus f. ~inī)
= 42 = 169 ≠ 77 (= mama citte mayham vase
a-vattamāne, Thī-a).2a-vasa-vattin

2a-vasa-vatti(n), mfn. (3a + sa. vaça-vartin; cf.
attano vase vatteti, Ja V 316,12 foll.), not exercising
supreme power, without power of self-masteru; m. ~ī,
DN I 247,14 (opp. vasavattī, see Sv (II) 404,12-14);

vasaṁ vattetuṁ a-samattha-bhāvato, thus f. ~inī)
= 42 = 169 ≠ 77 (= mama citte mayham vase
a-vattamāne, Thī-a).2a-vasa-vattin

2a-vasa-vatti(n), mfn., unsubmissive (cf. avasa,
b); loc. sg. n. (see Sadd 667,23-25): citte ~ini, Thī 37
≠ 77 (according to Thī-a, see prec); -°tta, n. abstr.
Khuddas L 2.

a-vassaṁ, ind. [sa. a-vaçyam], inevitably,
necessarily; Abh 1150 ('~' 'nūna' ca nicchaye) ≠
Am-k III 4,16; Kacc-v 638 (Sadd 862,15 foll.) cf. Mogg
V 54; — with grd.: ~ kātabbaṁ 'kiccaṁ', itaraṁ
'karaṇīyaṁ', Ud-a 116,1; paraṁ ayanaṁ assa . . . ~
pattabban ti 'sambodhi-parāyano', Ud-a 290,10 ≠
Spk II 73,15; aññā patiṭṭhā n'atthi, ... evaṁ ~
pahātabbaṁ, Ja V 109,14; dhuvaṁ maraṇaṁ, ~ mayā
maritabbaṁ, Dhp-a III 170,23, cf. Vism 231,2 (jātassa
~ maraṇato); ~ vissajjetabbo, Sv I 263,34; dve vāre
asakkontena pana, ~ ('at least') ekavāraṁ paccavekkhi-
tabbaṁ, Ps II 67,30 (cf. asakkonto pana, ~ manussa-
lokaṁ āgantvā sacchi-karoti, Sv (II) 544,3-6); — with
fut.: sace jīvati, ~ ... āgamissati, Ja III 271,26; Ja VI
567,18' (jīvamānā ~ putte passissāma); Ja IV 253,11
(ayaṁ maṁ akathentaṁ ~ māressati); maraṇaṁ
... ~ āgamissati, Saddh 293; Ps III 330,2; Ja VI 105,1;
~ bahunnaṁ sannipāta-ṭṭhāne koci mama kammaṁ
jānissati, Ud-a 417,(12(-)17); na kho . . . nikkammako
acchissati, ~ iminā mayhaṁ sotthibhāvo kato bhavis-
sati, Ja VI 439,6; cf. pubbabhāge an-uppajjamānam
pi kilesajātaṁ ārammaṇassa adhiggahītattā eva apa-
rabhāge ~ uppattito 'ārammaṇâdhiggahītuppannan'
ti vuccati, Pj II 6,28 (cf. 4,27); Ps I 145,17-31; Dhp-a
I 305,13; II 273,4; — with present: sabbam pi saṁ-
khāra-gataṁ ~ yeva bhijjati, Mhv XXXII 19;
Vibh-a 33,19; Abhidh-av 109,28*; [PsII 259,16 read
with v. l. ath'assa?]; Saddl 34,10; ~ icchanti, Sadd
11,2 (scil. keci akkharacintakā); — with verbal adj.s
(Kacc 638; Mogg V 54) see avassa(ṁ)kāri(n), °gāmi(n),
°bhāvi(n); ~ sampāpako, Ps I 162,34; ~ bheda-
gāmikaṁ, Nāmar-p 1079; vissatthâvassa-ghātino,
Nāmar-p 996.

avassa(ṁ)-bhāvi(n), mfn., that must be or
become; m. avassambhāvī, It-a II 72,31; f. icchitabbā
. . . avassabhāvinī, Mp II 318,28 (= 'pāṭikaṁkhā') ≠
III 411,26 (v. l. avassaṁ-bh°) ≠ Ps I 167,32; n.
avassa-bhāvi, Ud-a 234,32; Ja I 19,16 (= 'dhuvaṁ',
ib. 19,30* = Bv II 115); niyata-vasena avassaṁ-
bhāvi-vasena vattamāna-vacanaṁ kataṁ, Bv-a ad
Bv II 110 (scil. 'dhuvaṁ . . , bhavām' ahaṁ' for bha-
vissāmi).

avassa(ṁ)-bhāvi(n), mfn., that must be or
become; m. avassambhāvī, It-a II 72,31; f. icchitabbā
. . . avassabhāvinī, Mp II 318,28 (= 'pāṭikaṁkhā') ≠
III 411,26 (v. l. avassaṁ-bh°) ≠ Ps I 167,32; n.
avassa-bhāvi, Ud-a 234,32; Ja I 19,16 (= 'dhuvaṁ',
ib. 19,30* = Bv II 115); niyata-vasena avassaṁ-
bhāvi-vasena vattamāna-vacanaṁ kataṁ, Bv-a ad
Bv II 110 (scil. 'dhuvaṁ . . , bhavām' ahaṁ' for bha-
vissāmi).

a-vassaka, mfn. (from prec; cf. sa. āvaçyaka),
necessary, inevitable; Kacc 638 (-âdhamiṇesu ṇī; Sadd
862,14-25) from Pāṇ III 3,170; — °tta, n. abstr., Sadd
862,18.

avassa-kari(n), mfn., who will do something
inevitably; Mogg-v V 54 (Pay).avassa-karin

avassa-kari(n), mfn., who will do something
inevitably; Mogg-v V 54 (Pay).avassa-karin

avassa-gami(n), mfn., who will necessarily go
(arrive); — °-tā, f. abstr. '[ā/a]gamā' ti antarā-magge
vattamāno pi ~āya evaṁ vutto, Ja V 319,24'.

avassa-gami(n), mfn., who will necessarily go
(arrive); — °-tā, f. abstr. '[ā/a]gamā' ti antarā-magge
vattamāno pi ~āya evaṁ vutto, Ja V 319,24'.

(ava-ssajati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. avasṛjati], to let loose,

Vaitālīya), Ud 64,29* (cf. ib. 25: āyusaṁkhāraṁ

(= do., Mp), quoted Nett 60,31* (= do., Nett-a);
micchâjīvam [Ee °jīvañ ca] ~, DN III 177,27* (metre

VI 79,20*); — 1 sg., pata, te taṁ ~iṁ, Ja IV 425,9*
(Ct.).

ava-ssattha, mfn. (pp. of avassajati); n. ~aṁ,
Sv (II) 558,7 = Ud-a 330,5; — °-bhava-saṁkhāra,
mfn., Ud-a 330,6.

a-vassana, n. (neg. verb, noun of vassati, √vāç);
tassā (d: ajāya) ~°atthāya mukhaṁ bandhitvā, Ja IV
251,10 (to prevent her from bleating).

ava-ssandana, n., said to mean gatta-vikkhepa,
sense of √naṭ, Sadd II 1375 (p. 531,26; cf. p. 352,21).

avassa(ṁ)-bhāvi(n), mfn., that must be or
become; m. avassambhāvī, It-a II 72,31; f. icchitabbā
. . . avassabhāvinī, Mp II 318,28 (= 'pāṭikaṁkhā') ≠
III 411,26 (v. l. avassaṁ-bh°) ≠ Ps I 167,32; n.
avassa-bhāvi, Ud-a 234,32; Ja I 19,16 (= 'dhuvaṁ',
ib. 19,30* = Bv II 115); niyata-vasena avassaṁ-
bhāvi-vasena vattamāna-vacanaṁ kataṁ, Bv-a ad
Bv II 110 (scil. 'dhuvaṁ . . , bhavām' ahaṁ' for bha-
vissāmi).

avassa(ṁ)-bhāvi(n), mfn., that must be or
become; m. avassambhāvī, It-a II 72,31; f. icchitabbā
. . . avassabhāvinī, Mp II 318,28 (= 'pāṭikaṁkhā') ≠
III 411,26 (v. l. avassaṁ-bh°) ≠ Ps I 167,32; n.
avassa-bhāvi, Ud-a 234,32; Ja I 19,16 (= 'dhuvaṁ',
ib. 19,30* = Bv II 115); niyata-vasena avassaṁ-
bhāvi-vasena vattamāna-vacanaṁ kataṁ, Bv-a ad
Bv II 110 (scil. 'dhuvaṁ . . , bhavām' ahaṁ' for bha-
vissāmi).

ava-ssaya, m. [cf. sa. apâçraya], resort, refuge,
support; (a) said of things: Ps IV 35,21 (patiṭṭhā +);
Ps II 7,25 (~o patiṭṭhā upatthambho; = 'assāso'),
cf. Ill 410,3 (thāmo ~o; = 'balaṁ . . . assāso'); Ud-a
281,24 (~o patiṭṭhā ālambanaṁ, tāṇaṁ leṇaṁ, gati
parāyanaṁ); Ps IV 72,15 (paṭisaraṇaṁ +); imasmiṁ
loke sacca-samo ~o nāma n'atthi, Ja VI 285,1; — (b)
said of persons: aham assa ~o bhavissāmi, Ja I 211,21
(= patiṭṭhā, pt); III 304,18; IV 377,7; VI 394,11;
Pv-a 5,7; Ja I 153,15; Dhp-a II 267,3; ib. 13 (= Thī-a
111,13); ib. 18 (tāṇaṁ saraṇaṁ ~o); ayaṁ mahāja-
nassa ~o bhavissati, As 181,8; Ja II 197,3; tvaṁ
amhākaṁ ~o, Ja V 379,19' (explaining 'bhūtānaṁ
dharanī-r-iva'); ~o dviyuddhe pi tuvaṁ me si, Mhv
XXXII 24 (cf. Mhv-ṭ 591,26); ~o vata me Satthā jāto,
Ja I 277,2; Dhp-a IV 198,22; Sāriputtatthero catun-
naṁ paribbājikānaṁ ~o hutvā sabbā arahattaṁ
pāpesi, Ja III 2,27; attano pi esa satthā ~o bhavituṁ
na sakkoti, PsIII 234,13; upādāya pana ~o hoti
(scil. Tathāgato), Mil 160,4; — instr, mayā imissā
~ena bhavituṁ vaṭṭati, Dhp-a II 273,7 ≠ Pv-a 113,2.

avassaya-kamma, n., a (good) act useful as a
support (for, gen.); yāvâhaṁ Buddhapūjâdiṁ attano
~aṁ karomi, Ps V 2,22.

ava-ssayati, pr. 3 sg. (ava + sa. √çri, or =
apassayati, q. v.; cf. avassaya), to lie down in, or to
resort to (loc); aor. 1 sg., paṁke ~ayiṁ, Ja II 80,15* ( =
nipajjiṁ, vāsaṁ kappesiṁ, Ct.), quoted Sadd 85,27;
pp. avassita, q. v.

ava-ssava, m. (verb, noun of ava + sa. √sru),
= next, esp.: erotic affect (see avassuta, e); Sp (IV)
901,23; 902,14; — ifc. v. an-°.

a-vassika, mfn. (3a + sa. vārṣika), (1) not
belonging to the rainy season, see avassika-saṁketa
— (2) not reckoning a full year [from the ordination]
(inclusive of a vassa-residence); upasampanna-kāle ~o
va samāno tipiṭaka-dharo ahosi, Sp I 41,13 (= upa-
sampadato paṭṭhāya aparipuṇṇa-ekavasso, Sp-ṭ); ara-
hattaṁ patto ~o [Ee aṭṭha-v°] hoti, Dhp-a IV 69,16
(not a year after his arahatta-patti); nom. pl. ~ā va
uppabbajitā, Dhp-a I 72,17 ("before keeping a single
residence"; = ni-væsi va gihi-vūvō, gp); ~-kaālto
(v. l. aṭṭha-v°) paṭṭhāya, MpI 42,13; ~-kāle (v. l.
aṭṭha-v°), ib. 44,22 (cf. 38,14: tivassa-bhikkhu-kāle;
Mp-ṭ: tivasso ca so bhikkhu cā ti tivassa-bhikkhu,
tassa tena vā upalakkhito kālo 'tivassa-bhikkhu-
kālo'); ~-bhikkhu-kāle, Ps III 126,15-17 (opp. aṭṭhā-
rasa-vassika-sāmaṇera-kāle, etc.); — °-dahara, m.,
a novice before his first full year (or vassa-resfcṝence);
gen. pl. ~ānaṁ santikaṁ gantvā, Ps III 135,24.

avassika-saṁketa, mfn. (prec. (1) + saṁketa
'a conventional term)'), not styled ,,vassika(-māsa)";
acc. pl. aṭṭha māse ~e, Vin IV 39,35 (o: the 8 months
exclusive of those of the rains; Sp (IV) 772,13-15).

ava-ssita, mfn. (pp. of avassayati), resorting to
(acc); m. anariya(ṁ) dhamm' ~o, Ja V 375,27* (Ct.);
m. pl. mada-mānā (for °-mānaṁ?) ~ā, Dīp II 5.

ava-ssuta, mfn. (pp. of ava + sa. √sru),
(a) leaking, letting in water, see an-avassuta (Ja IV
20,22*); — (b) drenched, moist; kūṭâgāre ducchanne
kūṭam pi arakkhitaṁ hoti . . . kūṭam pi ~aṁ hoti,
kūṭam pi pūtikaṁ hoti . . ., AN I 261,32; — (c) (as a
complement to °-pūti): yāni tāni rukkhāni anto-pūtīni
~āni kasambujātāni [anto- to all three members], tāni
kuṭhāri-pāsena ākoṭitāni daddaraṁ paṭinadanti,
AN IV 171,9 (see samana-dusi(n)); do. metaph, see
anto-pūti (Ctt. generally = rāgâdīhi tinto; mhṭ ad
Vism 55,7: chahi dvārehi rāgâdikilesânuvassanena
tintatāya '~assa' ≠ Ud-a 297,22 (CXEβ kilesa-vassa-
nena)); acc. m. kaṭuviyakataṁ āmagandhe ~aṁ, AN I
280,7-30 (Mp II 378,13); nom. ~o, ib. 281,3*; mano-
kammaṁ (etc.) ~aṁ hoti, AN I 261,24; kathaṁ ~o
hoti . . ., SN IV 184,25—186,11 (viz, ~o cakkhu-
viññeyyesu rūpesu . . . mano-viññeyyesu dhammesu),
quoted Nidd II 85,9 foll.; — (d) letting out (humidity),
oozing; loc. sg. pure duggandhe Māra-pakkhe ~e . . .
kāye, Th 279 (— sabbakālaṁ kilesâvassavanena
tahiṁ tahiṁ asuci-nissandanena ca '~e', Th-a); —
(e) [cf. perhaps sa. mada-srāvin, etc., said of ruttish
elephants] under the influence of sexual excitement:
nom. f. & gen. m., yā bhikkhunī ~ā ~assa purisa-
puggalassa . . . āmasanaṁ . . . sādiyeyya . . ., Vin IV
213,34** (~ā nāma sārattā apekkhavā paṭibaddha-
cittā, ib. 214,14'; kāyasaṁsagga-rāgena '~ā' tintā,
kilinnā ti attho, Kkh = Sp (IV) 901,5), quoted Sv I
28,18 (= kilinnā kilinnassa) = Ps I 4,29 etc. ≠ Ud-a
12,7 ≠Pj I 101,28; cf. Vin-vn 1970, Utt-vn 166, 171;
~ā ~assa purisapuggalassa hatthagahanam sādiyeyya,
Vin IV 220,33** (221,6'; Sp (IV) 904,18 foll); ~â
~assa hatthato khādaniyaṁ ... sahatthā paṭiggahetvă
. . ., Vin IV 233,8** (233,14') quoted Sadd~492,2; cf.
Vin-vn 2078, Utt-vn 186, 891, 925; nom. m. gen. f.
~o ~āya . . . kāya-saṁsaggaṁ samāpajji, Vin IV
212,30-31; see besides Vin IV 212,38 foll; 220,18 foll.;
abl. sg. m. ~amhā, Utt-vn 770 (cf. ib. 763 avassuta-
hatthato); loc. absol. n. ubhato avassute (if there is
mutual lust) . . . ekato avassute, Vin IV 214,34—
215,11 foll. (Sp (IV) 902,14: avassave sati) ≠ 233,27
foll.; cf. Vin-vn 2080—82; gen. pl. ubhinnaṁ rattānaṁ
sārattānaṁ ~ānaṁ pariyuṭṭhitānaṁ pariyādinna-
cittānaṁ ubhinnaṁ sadisānaṁ dhammo, Nidd I
139,11 (= 'methuna-dhammo'; Nidd-a); — ifc. v.
an-° (add: Vin IV 234,1 ≠ ubhayâvassutâbhāve,
Vin-vn 2083).

avassuta-kāyakammanta, mfn. (+ °-vacī-
kammanta, °-manokammanta), whose bodily (etc.) acts
are "moist" (o: in decay); AN I 261,25.

avassuta-citta, mfn., of lustful mind; Ud-a
172,14 (Bhagavā ~aṁ . . . Nandaṁ accharāyo olo-
kāpesi).

Avassuta-pariyāya, m., title of SN IV 184,19—
186,11 (187,29), quoted Nidd II 85,3—86,9 (Spk III
53,6; Nidd-a), cf. Anavassuta-p°.

ava-ssuti, f. (cf. avassuta, e), an erotic encounter;
~iṁ cari, Ja VI 264,21* (= kilesâvassutiṁ bhattu
pariyesanaṁ car[at]i, Ct).

ava-sādana, n. (verb, noun of avasādeti),
(causing to sink) bringing to an end; — ifc. v. gaty-
āvasādana (Dhātup 150, Dhātum 217, Sadd
384,10-12).

ava-sādeti, pr. 3 sg. (caus. of avasīdati) =
osādeti (q. v.), to press down, to dishearten; pot. 3 sg.
subhāsiṭaṁ (a)numodeyya dubbhaṭṭhe nâvasādaye. |
AN I 199,10* (= dukkathitasmiṁ na avasādeyya,
Mp; cf., however, apasādeti (b)).

2avasāna, mfn. (abstracted from cpd.sl), final,
last; Nidd-a (Ee) I 91,14-20 (= 'antima'); loc ~e
(jhāne), Vism 86,21 (opp. tatiye, catutthe; = (dvīsu
pi nayesu) pariyosāna-jjhāne, mhṭ).

1avasāna, n. [ts.] i. q. osāna; stopping, cessation,
(coming to an) end; Abh 791 (= anta); 912 (= nitthā);
Thī-a 19,23 (— 'avasāyo'); Sadd 384,11 (cf. avasā-
dana); Sadd 885,10*-16 (Pay fol. gr 3) from Rūp (Ce)
84,32 (sense of 'ni-') ≠ Abh 1166 (osāna); Dhātup
458 (sense of √sā2) ≠ Dhātum 698 (cf. Sadd 489,13);
— loc. (a ) ~e, Vism 86,21 (see 3avasāna); 661,3;
Abhidh-av 95,13*; 97,31*, 127,10*,28*; 128,9*; Ja IV
54,29; 87,11; Ps I 262,32; (β) ~asmiṁ, Abhidh-av
52,22*; — ifc v. [anavasāna-pubba-rogo, Ud-a
126,1 w. r. for athavā yāpetabba-rogo], anumo-
danâ°, anulomâ°, kathâ° (Mp ad AN IV 358,28),
gāthâ° (Dhp-a II 278,6; III 5,1), chārikâ° (mfn. Sv I
166,12 = Ps III 227,18), jarâ° (mfn. Ap 574,3),
desanâ° (Dhp-a I 446,14; III 175,14; Pv-a 54,5),
pacchima-yāmâ° (Ud-a 207,26), bhatta-kiccâ°
(Dhp-a III 170,21; 335,5), bhuttâ° (Ja III 163,23),
raṭṭhâ° (Mp ad AN IV 106,8).

avasāna-gāthā, f., i. q. osāna-g°, the last
stanza; Spk I 208,2.

avasāna-piṇḍapāta, m., the last (gift of) alms-
food; Ud-a 406,9.

avasân[ī/i]ya, mfn. (accord, to Tr. = a-vasa-ānīya),
not to be brought into subjection; n. akattabbaṁ ~aṁ,
Mp ad AN IV 106,12 (= 'akaranīyaṁ'; so Ck; Ce
agamanīyaṁ, Se ajiniyaṁ [conjecture!]).avasânīya

avasân[ī/i]ya, mfn. (accord, to Tr. = a-vasa-ānīya),
not to be brought into subjection; n. akattabbaṁ ~aṁ,
Mp ad AN IV 106,12 (= 'akaranīyaṁ'; so Ck; Ce
agamanīyaṁ, Se ajiniyaṁ [conjecture!]).avasânīya

avasāya, m. [ts.] = 1avasāna; ~o vuccati ava-
sānaṁ niṭṭhānaṁ, Thī-a 19,22 (see next).

avasāyi(n), mfn. (from prec, or rather verb. adj.
from ava + √sā), (taking up one's abode), determinate,
unswerving; nom. sg. f. (I) chandajātā avasāyī, Thī 12
(Ee conjectures avasāye).avasāyin

avasāyi(n), mfn. (from prec, or rather verb. adj.
from ava + √sā), (taking up one's abode), determinate,
unswerving; nom. sg. f. (I) chandajātā avasāyī, Thī 12
(Ee conjectures avasāye).avasāyin

a-vas[ī/i], aor. 3 sg. of vasati, Ja V 66,10* (mâkatvā
~ rājā); 2 sg. Ja VI 301,25*; 1 sg. ~iṁ, Thī 421.a-vasī

ava-siṭṭha, mfn. (pp. of ava-sissati; sa. avaçiṣṭa),
left (over), remaining (the rest, the other); m. gen. pl.
ñātīnaṁ ~ānaṁ, Ja V 339,23*; f. ~ā, MN II 138,26
(odana-miñjā); n. yaṁ te sūkara-maddavaṁ ~aṁ,
DN II 127,21; yaṁ tattha ~aṁ hoti, MN III 105,1;
appamattakaṁ~aṁ, SN II 133,25; antamaso bhaṅga-
mattam pi assa ~aṁ n'atthi, As 206,8; n. pl. ~āni
bhavissanti, Spk II 80,27 (= 'avasiss(iss?)anti'); (ifc.)
tivassasahassâvasiṭṭhe āyukamhi, Ja VI 52,17; in
cpd.s ~-dhanaṁ, Ud-a 332,9; ~-sabb'-akusala-ppahā-
naṁ, Ud-a 362,1; pahīna-kilesâvasiṭṭha-kilese, Mil
339,2; Vism 676,11-24; mhṭ ad Vism 73,30* (= 'ava-
sesa').

ava-siṭṭhaka, (mf)n., something left over (by
beasts of prey); sīhānaṁ . . . ~aṁ, Ja III 311,25*,27'
(cf. ucchiṭṭha, vigh[ā/a]sa, ib.-15*-26*).

ava-siṭṭhita, mfn. (denom, pp. of avasiṭṭha, if
not w. r. for avasiṭṭhaka); m. pl. ~ā, Abhidh-av 127,1*.

ava-sita, mfn. (pp. of ava + √sā; cf. ava-sīna)
= osita; situated, settled, ascertained; Sadd 715,23
(nadim anv-āvasitā) ≠ 883,20 (Pay fol. gu v. 4) from
Rūp (Ce) 85,39 (Kāç I 4,85); Abh 963; — °-tta, n.,
abstr. v. l. for āvaṭṭitatta, or āvesitatta, Dhp-a I
196,12.

ava-sitta, mfn. (pp. of ava + √sic, sa. avasikta)
= ositta; poured down; besprinkled; ~-udaka-dhāra-
vaṇṇa, Ja V 400,20' (= 'ositta-vaṇṇa'); — ifc. v. an-°,
muddhâ° (DN I 69,34 (Sv); II 169,20; III 60,12; MN
I 343,30 (Ps); SN I 100,28 (Spk); AN I 106,21 (Mp);
II 87,1 (Mp); 207,15 (Mp); Vin IV 160,14**,21' (Sp);
Mil 234,2; 360,12, cf. Mhv-ṭ 305,20—306,8).

a-vasiya, mfn. (cf. sa. a-vaçin) = avasa (a);
~-pavatta-sallakkhaṇa-vasena, Nidd II 278,13 (ib. 18
perhaps avasiya-rūpe vaso na labbhati; Nidd-a:
avase hutvā pavatta-saṁkhāre passana-vasena, olo-
kana-vasena).

ava-sissati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-çiṣyate], to be left
over, to remain; nāmam evâvasissati, Sn 808; viññā-
ṇaṁyeva ~, MN III 242,10 (Ps); yaṁ pamāṇakataṁ
kammaṁ, na taṁ tatrâvasissati na taṁ tatrâvatit-
ṭhati, DN I 251,8 foll. (çloka-rhythm) = SN iV
322,13-25 ≠ AN V 299,27—301,1 ≠ yaṁ pamā-
ṇakataṁ kammaṁ na taṁ tatrâvasissati, Ja II
61,28* (62,14'-21'); 3 pl. (for fut.) sarīrāni ~anti,
SN II 83,6-15 (sītī-bhavissanti +; = avasiṭṭhāni
bhavissanti, Spk); pot. 3 pl. ~eyyuṁ, SN II 83,9 ( =
tiṭṭheyyuṁ, Spk); imper. 3 sg. kāmaṁ taco ca n(a)hārū
ca atthī ca ~atu, sarīre upasussatu maṁsalohitaṁ,
MN I 481,2 (çloka-rhythm) — SN II 28,25 = AN I
50,10, quoted Nidd I 66,26, Ja I 71,24, 110,3 (w. r.
avasussatu), Pj II 391,18 (cf. Th 312 ≠ Vv 162);
Saddh 46 (& Ce avasussatu).

ava-sissana, n. (verb, noun of prec), ~am
aṭṭhissa, Abh 157 (from MN I 481,2, see prec).

a-vas[ī/i], aor. 3 sg. of vasati, Ja V 66,10* (mâkatvā
~ rājā); 2 sg. Ja VI 301,25*; 1 sg. ~iṁ, Thī 421.a-vasī

a-vasīkata, mfn., not mastered; pañcahi vasitāhi
~aṁ (paron.; scil. jhānaṁ), mṭ ad As 184,23 ( =
'a-ppaguṇarh').

ava-sīdati, pr. 3 sg. (ava + √sad) = osīdati,
to sink down; nāvā . . . aṇṇave ~ati, Ja VI 234,27*;
abs. avasīditvā, Sadd 384,19.

ava-sīna, mfn. (pp. of ava + √sā; *sīna (pr. sa.
sināti) to ava-sita as lūna (pr. lunāti) to (vi)luta,
Mvu II 181,13* resp. SN I 5,9*), settled, established;
acc. pl. Gandhabbakāy[ū/u]pagate 'vasïne, DN II 272,25*
(= G°-kāyaṁ āvāsike hutvā upagate, Sv); tiṇṇaṁ
tesaṁ avasīn' ettha eko G°-kāy[ū/u]pagato 'vasīno, ib.
275,1*-2* (= tattha hīne kāye eko eva āvāsiko
jāto, Sv).

ava-sīyati, pr. 3 sg. (pass.; ava + √sā), to be
ascertained, proved; Mogg-p I 1 (Ce 5,27).

(ava-sumbhati, pr. 3 sg., to fling down); neg.
abs. an-avasumbhitvā (prob, the better reading), Ja VI
76,27: yathā vā tathā vā ~, not flinging it down
carelessly; cf. anu-sumbhati above (to be modified).

ava-sussati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava-çuṣyati], to become
dry, to languish; [imper. 3 sg. ~atu, w. r. for avasissatu,
Nidd I 66,26, etc.]; fut. 3 sg. ava-succhati [cf. sa.
çokṣyati], Ja VI 550,20*-22* (so Ee; Cks Lk °-sujjhati,
Ba °-sussati; — ava-sussissati (so Bd), Ct.).

ava-sūra, mfn., whereupon the sun has set, Ja V
56,21' (Ee avasuraṁ), see an-āvasūra.

ava-seka, m. [ts.], overflowing; Sv I 141,1 (ex-
plaining 'udāna') = Ps II 198,20 = Mp III 315,11
= Ud-a 2,14 = Sp-ṭ ad Sp I 28,19; — ifc v. an-°.

1ava-sesa, m. [sa. ava-çeṣa], remnant, rest; instr.
~ena vacchako yāpeti, AN II 207,26 — Pp 56,21; —
ifc. (m. 'the rest of . . .'; mfn. 'whereof it remains only
. . .') v. aṭṭhi-mattâ° (mfn.), aṭṭhi-samgbāta-mat-
tâ° (mfn.), an-° (mfn.), appâ° (mfn.), ācamana-
udakâ° (m. Dhp-a I 53,19), āmâ° (m. Vin I 221,25
= AN III 250,14), katacchu-mattâ° (eka-dvi-, mfn.
Pj II 272,10), kantārâ° (m. SN II 98,14), kappâ° (777.
DN II 103,4-7 foll. = SN V 259,20-24 foll. (discussed Mil
140,20—142,12) = AN IV 309,7-11 foll. = Ud 62,20-22
foll.), kammâ° (m. Ap 299,13-19; 487,11, cf. kamma-
visesa, ib. 17, kamma-vipāka, ib. 299,11 foll.), [ghaṭâ°
Ss 80,21 (C*) from Spk I 55,10, read ghaṭā-vasena; —
samūha-vasena, pt], tad-° (see 2avasesa, ifc), divasâ°
(m. MN II 119,6; Mil 4,11), na-ciram-idhâ° (mfn. Sn
694), nir-° (mfn., opp. sâvasesa, Dhp-a III 49,4; Spk
III 216,17; Ud-a 16,18; 29,34; Nett 14,30; ~ato, Mil
91,2; °-vacana, Mil 182,17), pakkâ° (m. Dhp-a I 327,10),
bhuttâ° (m. Vin II 216,23; cf. bhutta-sesaka, Abh
467), rattâ° (ratti + a°, m. DN II 158,28; Mil 89,4),
vipākâ° (m. SN II 255,81; Ps III 67,7; Dhp-a III
69,13; Ud-a 263,22), vuttâ° (see 2avasesa, ifc), saṁ-
khārâ° (m. As 207,1, cf. 208,19—209,7), sâ° (mfn.
AN I 20,30—21,23; 88,9; Mil 134,10; 147,9—148,2 foll.;
159,30; Dhp-a III 49,4; -°dohi(n), MN I 222,24-33;
224,11-15; -°maṁsa-lohita-yutta, Sv (III) 772,10 ≠
Ps I 273,23 (sesâvasesa°); -°âyuka, Mil 151,15).

2ava-sesa, mfn. (abstracted from cpd.sl), remain-
ing, other (cf. avasiṭṭha); — with expressions for
'excepting, than': methuna-dhammato ~e . . . pañca
kāmaguṇe hitvā, Pj II 493,4; tato paraṁ ~-lokaṁ,
Pj I 169,23; ito muttā ~ā, Ps III 4,24; ṭhapetvā
micchādiṭṭhiṁ ~ā, Vism 469,24 foll.; ṭhapetvā ma-
nusse ca sagge ca ~ānaṁ nāga-supaṇṇâdīnaṁ, Pj I

tated; m. ~o, Sp (III) 630,3 (= 'abbhetabbo').

tion, (b) invocation, (e) naming (cf. avhayana); giving
the sense of √kand1 (Dhātup 138; Dhātum 213; Sadd
381,4, cf. 384,7), ykaland (Sadd 381,4), √kus3 (Dhātup

119,14 (a) ≠ Mp I 250,23; ~aṁ niratthakaṁ, Spk I

nāmena yutto, Pj II 605,17 (c; = 'saccavhayo'); —
°ân-abhinandana, f., Vism 68,21 ("non-acceptance of
invitation"; mhṭ).

273,30* (Anūnanāmo iti m'~(c); = pakkosanti, Ct.;
quoted Sadd 456,15); Pj II 487,15 (c); Mhv-ṭ 353,6 (a,

bheyya, Vin III 186,19 (e); 2 sg. cajāmi naṁ ... mayā
pamuttaṁ tato [naṁ] avhayesi, Ja V 220,22* (e; =
tato naṁ a-pariggahattā ān(āp)eyyāsi, Ct.); te (acc.

avikkhepa-paṭilābha, m., gain of a°; ~o uddhac-
cena suñño, Paṭis II 182,25; — °-paṭivedha, m.,
mastering of a°; ib. 34; — °-pariggaha, m., acquisition
of a°; ib. iβ; — °-pariyogāhana, n., intimate know-
ledge of a°; ib. 183,33; — °-parisuddha, mfn., puri-
fied by, perfect as to a°; in °-tta, n. abstr., Paṭis 1(2,6)
94,11—96,21; — °-maṇḍa, m., the fine essence a°
(opp. kasaṭa), Paṭis II 87,6—90,16; — °-lakkhaṇa, n.,
the characteristic of a°; samathassa ~aṁ, Sv I 64,28;
~ena ekavidho (scil. samādhi), Vism 85,8; do. mfn.,
having a° for its characteristic; m. ~o samādhi, Vism
85,5; 464,14; f. ~ā cittekaggatā, Ps II 348,18; —
°-vimutti, mfn., having a° for its releasing factor(?);
~i samādhisambojjhaṅgo, Paṭis II 145,25; — °-virā-
ga, mfn., having a° for its purifying factor; ib. 142,31
(see 140,24); — °-sīsa, n., the main purport of a°;
Paṭis I 102,20 (see Paṭis-a (Ee) I 324,26—-325,13); —
°âdhiṭṭhāna, n., resolve to a°; ~aṁ uddhaccena
suññaṁ, Paṭis II 183,24; — °âbhisamaya, m., the
attainment (result) of a°; ~o sammāsamādhi, ib.
216,10; — °esanā, f., the pursuit of a°; ~ā uddhac-
cena suññā, ib. 182,8.

a-vikāra, mfn., without change (for the worse),
unaltered, unaffected; acc m. disvā mukhaṁ ~aṁ
purāṇaṁ, AN III 56,22* (Mp: 'purāṇan' ti nibbikāra-
tāya porāṇakam eva) = Ja III 205,4*.

a-vikiṇṇa, mfn. (neg. pp. of vi + √kṛ), not
scattered, esp. not loose, not uncontrolled (of speech);
acc f. ~aṁ mitaṁ vācaṁ patte kale udīraye, Ja VI
295,21*; Ps II 214,10; — °-vacana-vyappatha, mfn.
(tautol, cpd.), of controlled speech; ~o [va] ahosi, DN
III 175,25* ( ˇ ˇ - ˇ ˇ ˇ ˇ - ˇ - ˇ - ≃ , Upasthita-
pracupita, pāda b; Sv: avikiṇṇa-vacanānaṁ viya
purima-bodhisattānaṁ vacana-vyappatho assā ti);
— °-vāca, mfn. = prec; m. ~o, Ja I 387,9' ( =
'akutūhalo'); anuddhato . . . acapalo amukharo ~o,
Pp 35,9 = AN I 266,21; III 391,21; the same formula
(m.pl.): MN I 32,18; III 6,21; AN I 70,12; III 199,11;
instr, amukharena bhavitabbaṁ ~ena, MN I 470,18;
m.pl. guyhamantā ~ā, Ja V 82,3*; — °-sukha, n.;
Ps II 214,8 (= 'avyāseka-sukhaṁ'), cf. Sv I 183,24-25.

a-vikopana, n. (neg. verb, noun of vikopeti
[= vināseti], or vikuppati [ɔ: vinassati, Vism 705,37—
706,29]), non-decay, or non-destruction (infraction);
Ps I 94,24 (bhūtagāma-sikkhāpadassa avikopanat-
thaṁ); — ifc. v. nānā-baddha-° (Vism 706,1-6;
= attanā asambaddhassa parikkhārassa avināsanaṁ,
mhṭ).

a-vikopi(n), mfn., not destructive (or indestruct-
ible!); m. pl. satt' ime sassatā kāyā a-cchejjā ~ino, Ja
VI 226,10*(= vikopetuṁ na sakkā, Ct., but cf. na vipa-
riṇamanti, na aññamaññaṁ vyābādhenti, DN I 56,23).a-vikopin

a-vikopi(n), mfn., not destructive (or indestruct-
ible!); m. pl. satt' ime sassatā kāyā a-cchejjā ~ino, Ja
VI 226,10*(= vikopetuṁ na sakkā, Ct., but cf. na vipa-
riṇamanti, na aññamaññaṁ vyābādhenti, DN I 56,23).a-vikopin

a-vikopiya, mfn. (neg. grd.), indestructible; par[ū/u]-
pakkamena ~o hoti, Ja IV 76,1'-2' (Ee °ena avidhiko
piyo hoti, see v.ll.).

a-vigacchamāna, mfn. (neg. part. med. of vi +
√gam), not departing, not disappearing; m. ~o, Nidd
II 86,25 (†aviccamāno +; = viyogaṁ an-āpajjamāno,
Nidd-a).

a-vigata, mfn. [ts.], (a) not gone away, not
absent, (b) with no part lacking; m. anañño ~o san-
dhāvati (scil. puggalo), Kv 32,18-20 (b; Kv-a: 'anañño'
ti sabbâkārena ekasadiso, '~o' ti ekena pi ākārena
avigato); instr. ~ena, v. r. Mp I 455,13 (Mp-ṭ: 'adhi-
gatenā' ti maggâdhigamen' eva adhigatena, 'aviga-
tenā' ti vā pāṭho; b); loc. andhakāre ~e, Dhp-a II
49,17 (a); — °-chanda, mfn., not free from inclinations
[etc.]: kāme avïtarāgo (or avigata-°) ~o avigata-pemo
avigata-pipāso avigata-parilāho avigata-tanho, DN
III 238,14; MN I 101,29; SN III 7,22; 11,15; 107,6;
IV 387,25 = Vibh 377,30-32 ≠ AN IV 461,4 = V
18,14 foll.; — °-taṇha, mfn. [cf. sa. tṛṣṇā], see prec;
Nidd I 49,3 (+ acatta-taṇha, etc.); — °-paccaya, m.,
"the non-absence-cause" (said to be = atthi-paccaya),
Tikap 1,17; 7,10-20 (Tikap-a 21,27-30 (= Vism
541,12-15); 59,12-16); Abhidh-s 37,17 (Abhidh-s-ṭ
245,2); — °-paccaya-tā, f.abstr., Abhidh-s-ṭ 245,3
= mhṭ ad Vism 541,12; — °-pariḷāha, mfn. [cf. sa.
paridāha, burning], see avigata-chanda; — °-pipāsa,
mfn., see do.; — °-pema, mfn. [cf. sa. preman], see do.;
AN IV 15,10-26; DN III 252,18—253,2; — °-bhāva,
m. abstr.; instr. ~ena, Vism 541,12 — Tikap 21,27; —
°-rāga, mfn., see avigata-chanda; — °-vimati, mfn.,
still doubting; Sadd 13,20*; — °-soka, mfn., not free
from sorrow; gen. pl. ~ānaṁ, Ja VI 584,27' (= 'jīva-
sokinaṁ').

a-viggaha, m. (3a + sa. vigraha, discord), non-
quarrel; abhandanaṁ ~o akalaho, SN I 224,11 (cf.
ib. 8).

A-viggaha, m. (3a + sa. vigraha, body), 'the
Bodiless One', i. q. Anaṅga (Kama), Abh 42.

a-viggahaka, mfn., without strife; acc. n. ~aṁ
padaṁ, Abhidh-av 133,12* (o: nibbānaṁ, cf. 'avivāda-
bhūmaṁ' = nibbānaṁ, Pj II 558,1).

a-viggahïta, mfn., without discord; Ps II 240,12
(°aṭṭhena samaggaṭṭhena 'ekaṁ', scil. cittaṁ).

a-vighaṭṭita, mfn., not shaken (as a bell); Ja V
203,5* (= a-ghaṭṭita, Ct.).

a-vighatava(t), mfn., undisturbed, untroubled;
m. ~vā, Th 899 (= cittassa vighāta-karaṁ vikkhepaṁ
pahāya ~ avikkhitto samāhito, Th-a).a-vighatavat

a-vighatava(t), mfn., undisturbed, untroubled;
m. ~vā, Th 899 (= cittassa vighāta-karaṁ vikkhepaṁ
pahāya ~ avikkhitto samāhito, Th-a).a-vighatavat

a-vighati(n), mfn., unhurt, unhindered; m. ~ī,
Vism 58,10* (scil. sīlagandho; = appaṭighātī, mhṭ).

a-vighati(n), mfn., unhurt, unhindered; m. ~ī,
Vism 58,10* (scil. sīlagandho; = appaṭighātī, mhṭ).

a-vighāta, mfn., without hurt or harm; m. ~o,
SN III 8,23 (sukho +, scil. vihāro; opp. savighāto);
acc. n. (ind.) ~aṁ viharati, AN I 204,18; II 13,23;
429,19; — °-pakkhika, or °iya, mfn., joining the
party of a°; m. ~o, MN I 116,6 (scil. nekkhamma-
vitakko; Ps: na dukkha-kotṭhāsāya saṁvattatī ti)
≠ It 82,23—83,3; m. pl. ~ā,' SN V 97,28—98,2 (scil.
bojjhaṅgā).

a-vicakkhaṇa, mfn. (3a + sa. vicakṣaṇa), unwise;
m. dummedho ~o, AN I 131,20* (= saṁvidahana-
paññāya rahito, Mp) ≠ Ja III 534,16* (= vicāraṇa-
paññā-rahito, Ct.).

a-vicala, mfn. [ts.], immovable, firm; instr, f.
~āya mettāya, Vism 325,29 (= paṭipakkhena akam-
panīyāya, mhṭ); — °âdhiṭṭhāna, mfn., with "un-
swerving resolve"; Vism 325,29 (mhṭ).

aviccaṁ, ind. (abs.), (prob.) openly; ~aṁ bhāsati,
Ja V 434,2** (opp. viviccaṁ; = bahujana-majjhe,
apaṭicchanne, ib. 436,32'; unexplained, PED suggests
a-viviccaṁ), quoted Dhp-a IV 197,5 (see v.II.; Ee avi-
haccaṁ).

†a-viccamāna, mfn., v. l. (Nidd-a Ce) for ave-
dhamāna (likewise corrupt), Nidd II 86,25 (+ a-vigac-
chamāno; = 'anānuyāyī'; = a-viyujjamāno, Nidd-a).

a-vicchijja, ind. (neg. abs. of vicchindati), without
interruption, Vin-vn 1659, from Sp (IV) 865,8 (a-
vicchinditvā).

a-vicchinna, mfn. (neg. pp. of vi + √chid), un-
interrupted; loc. ~e . . . vihāre, Pj I 113,25; Mp (Se)
III 343,14 ad AN IV 394,11 (aparâparaṁ ~aṁ pave-
ṇiṁ); — °-'ttha, m., the sense of uninterrupted
sequence, Sadd 891,(23),26 ('atha', cf. aviccheda(na)-
ttha); — °-dhāra, mfn., in an uninterrupted stream;
~aṁ katvā Ākāsagaṅgaṁ otārento viya desanaṁ
desesi, Ps V 58,6 (Ee w. r. avicchinnavāraṁ; Be a-
chinna-dhāraṁ); — °-pavatti, f., an uninterrupted
series (of actions), Sp-ṭ ad Sp (III) 464,21 (anuppa-
bandho + ; explaining 'yathânusandhin[ā/a]'); [— °-va-
ra, w. r. for °dhāra above].

a-viccheda, m. (neg. verb, noun of vi + √chid),
continuity; instr, dhamma-santati dhammassa ~ena
pavatti, Sp-ṭ ad Sp I 25,9 (explaining 'paveṇi');
~vasena, Vv-a 16,34; dat. ~āya, Ps I 207,30; —
°-karaṇa, n., maintaining a continuity, Sadd 540,17
(pabandhakiriyā + ; explaining 'santānakiriyā'); —
°-'ttha, m. = avicchinnattha; loc. ~e nipāto, Pj I
113,24 ('atha'; Ee avicchedanatthe).

2a-vicāra, mfn. [ts.], without reflection; m. pl. ~ā
dhammā, Dhs (p. 6,26) 1271; see avitakka, mfn.; —
ifc. v. avitakka-°.

a-vicāretvā, ind. (neg. abs. of vicāreti); without
reflecting on (acc); Vv-a 336,6.

a-vicāliya, mfn. (neg. grd. of *vi-cāleti), from
which one can not be removed; f. patiṭṭhā~ā, Saddh 444.

a-vicikiccha, mfn. (3a + vicikicchā, sa. vici-
kitsā), undoubting; AN V 149,12 (from this abstracted:
vicikiccha, mfn., ib. 147,4).

[a-viciṇṇa, prob, always w. r. for adhi-ciṇṇa,
q. v.].

a-vijana(t), mnf. (neg. part, of vi + √jñā), not

104,16* (It-a II 151,12); gen., saddhammam ~ato,

275); gen. pl., saddhammam ~ataṁ, Dhp 60.a-vijanat

a-vijana(t), mnf. (neg. part, of vi + √jñā), not

a-vijaha(t), mfn. (neg. part, of vi + √hā); not
intermitting; m. satiṁ ~anto, Sv (II) 363,23 (= 'appa-
matto') = Ud-a 174,8; m. pl. citti-kāram ~antā,
Pv-a 26,28 (so Ce; Ee vijjamānā, prob, for avijaha-
mānā, part. med.).a-vijahat

a-vijaha(t), mfn. (neg. part, of vi + √hā); not
intermitting; m. satiṁ ~anto, Sv (II) 363,23 (= 'appa-
matto') = Ud-a 174,8; m. pl. citti-kāram ~antā,
Pv-a 26,28 (so Ce; Ee vijjamānā, prob, for avijaha-
mānā, part. med.).a-vijahat

a-vijahita, mfn. (neg. pp. of vi + √hā), not
abandoned or intermitted, obligatory (at all occasions);
sabba-buddhānaṁ ~aṁ udānaṁ (viz. "anekajāti-
saṁsāraṁ . . .", necessarily uttered by all Buddhas),
Ja I 76,22 (cf. Dhp-a III 127,19; Ud-a 3,25); do. ~-aca-
laṭṭhānaṁ, Ja I 71,18; do. ~-ṭṭhānaṁ, ib. 94,25;
(sabba-buddhānaṁ) cattāri ~-ṭṭhānāni, Sv (II)
424,8-19 (bodhi-pallaṅko avijahito, etc.; pt: '~o' ti
buddhānaṁ tathā nisajjāya an-aññattha-bhāvi-bhā-
vato apariccatto); ~ā niccânubandhā (prob, for
°baddhā), Spk I 181,8 ( — 'anuṭṭhitā', scil. iddhi-
pādā); — °-gandha-tela-ppadīpa, mfn., Ja I 178,25.

avijja-kkhaṇa, n., a (psychic) moment filled with
avijjā; Mp II 120,11.

avijj'-aṇḍa-kosa, m., the egg(shell ) 'avijjā' (q. v.);
Vin III 4,1 ='AN IV 176,16; Nett 61,9.

avijj'-andhakara, m(n)., the darkness 'avijjā';
acc. ~aṁ vidhameti, vijj'-obhāsaṁ janeti, Mil 39,9-16;
instr, mahatā ~ena pihitaṁ (scil. cittaṁ), Mil 312,15;
~ena onaddha-pariyonaddho (scil. yogâvacaro), Vism
666,10; ~ena . . . 'andhakāre' loke, Vv-a 106,28; gen.

covered with a°; 777. ~o lokasannivāso kilesapañjara-
pakkhitto, Paṭis I 127,12 (quoted Ud-a 142,23).

a-vijjamāna, mfn. (neg. part. med. of vijjati),
(a) inexistent, (b) untrue, false; m., puriso ~o, Ps V

Bhagavā hi katthaci vijjamānena ~aṁ dasseti,
katthaci ~ena vijjamānaṁ, PsV 50,23-27 (a); f., pa-
ramatthato ~ā, Abhidh-s 39,23 (a); — °(a)jjatana,

°-tā, f. abstr. (a); Ps I 68,30; natthitā ~ā, Sadd 71,28

— °-paññatti, f. (cf. sa. prajñapti), designation of

V 50,23 foll); Abhidn-s 39,29-36 (Abhidh-s-t); Sacc
372—384.

a-vijjā, f. [sa. avidyā (opp. jñāna rather than
vidyā, a limited art or science); Abhidh-k-vy Trsl.
III 88,13—94,9], 'ignorance', but (unlike aññāṇa, see

mahāmoho, Sn 730; ~ā mūlaṁ (kodhassa, etc.), Nidd

naṁ samāpattiyā, SN VI,13 ≠ AN V 214,10 = It
34,7; imesu . . . dhammesu ~ā anupatitā, SN II 40,29
(Spk II 58,18-22) = AN II 158,30; ~ā pahīyati, vijjā
uppajjati, DN II 215,26; SN III 47,2; IV 31,3; AN I

MN I 67,32; SN II 82,14 (Spk II 78,13-17); ~ā vihatā,
vijjā uppannā (in the Bodhi night), Vin III 4,32—

IV 177,25—178,20—179,10; It 99,13—100,6-12; ~ā
pahīnā hoti . . . āyatiṁ anuppāda-dhammā, MN I
139,20; AN III 84,19—85,30; ~ā virājitā, SN I 13,22*
= 165,23*; Ja III 404,17*; IV 387,13*; Th 282 (cf.
Thī 18); It 57,2*-10*; javana-kkhaṇe~ā, Spk II 269,29
(= 'avijjā-dhātu'); ~ā upayantī saṁkhāre upayāpeti,
SN II 118,27 (cf. 119,7); — katamā ~ā: yaṁ dukkhe
aññāṇaṁ . . . dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya
aññāṇaṁ, SN II 4,11; Vibhl 35,10; Nett 75,20; cf.
Ja III 404,29'—405,1'; ~ā ~ā ti vuccati, katamā nu
kho ~ā, kittāvatā ca avijjāgato hoti: idha assutavā
puthujjano rūpaṁ na pajānāti . . ., SN III 162,24 . . .
(163,6) ≠ 171,4 ... (31) ... 176,17 ... (29); IV
256,20; V 429,14; adukkha-m-asukhāya vedanāya ~ā
paṭibhāgo, MN I 304,14; rūpa-rāgo . . . ~ā (pañca
uddhambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni), Vibh 377,10 (see
avijjā-saṁyojana, °ânusaya, °âsava); ~ā (saṁkhārā-
naṁ upanisā), SN II 31,24; ~ā saṁkhārānaṁ uppāda-
ṭṭhiti ca pavattaṭṭhiti ca, Paṭis I 50,4 (Paṭis-a I
239,3-11); ~ā paccayo, saṁkhārā paccaya-samup-
pannā, ib. 50,7 (do. hetu, 51,1, do. paṭicca, 51,17);
moho ~ā, āyūhanā saṁkhārā, ib. 52,19 (Paṭis-a I
241,11-20); ito pubbe sabbena sabbaṁ . . . ~ā nâ-
hosī ti esā purimā koṭi na paññāyati, yaṁ ahu-
tvā sambhoti hutvā paṭivigacchati, esā p. k. pañ-
ñāyati, Mil 51,33 (cf. AN V 113,2); ~ā ~āya hetu,
ayoniso-manasikāro paccayo, Nett 79,9-11(—80,8);
avijjā-paccayā saṁkhāro, saṁkhāra-paccayā pi ~ā,

ṇā ~ā, Nett 28,19; — acc: sabbaṁ ~aṁ pariyādiyati
(scil. anicca-saññā), SN III 155,17; ~aṁ bhinda (Ee

jaṁ uppādessati, AN I 8,8 ≠ SN V 11,3,7,14; bhetvā

avinibbhoga-paccupaṭṭhāna, mfn.; n. ~aṁ

avinibbhoga-rūpa, n.; pl. ~āni, Abhidh-s 29,4

a-vinibbhoga-sadda, m., (a) confused talk, Ps

1,13 (Ps); 7,18; 135,29; III 227,27; SN III 3,13; IV
287,18; Dhs 1003; 1217; Nidd II 81,30; sayaṁ ~o
aññehi vinetabbo, Mp ad AN V 190,24 ('venayiko').

vipākaṁ . . . adinna-vipākaṁ, Nidd-a).

a-vipakkanta, mfn. (neg. pp. of vi + pra +

pakkaṁ', cf. Nett-a ad Nett 98,32); pl. atītā ~ā
dhammâ, Kv 151,18—153,16 (Kv-a 51,3,13).

avippaṭisāra-vipanna, mfn., whose a° has been

a-vippavāsa, m. (cf. prec), non-absence: satiyā

a-vibhatta, mfn. [sa. avibhakta, neg. pp. of
vibhajati], undivided, not analysed; m. ~o lokakkhā-
yikehi mahāsamuddo, Mil 316,20; n. ~aṁ (atthato),
Pv-a 77,28; gen. n. vitthārena [atthaṁ] ~assa, MN
III 46,11 = 53,20 ≠ AN V 257,13; m. pl. ~ā, MN II
161,17; — ifc. v. °-loma-bhamuka, mfn. (nalāta-
lomehi), Vmv ad Sp (V) 1028,21 (= 'makkaṭa-bha-
muka').

a-vibhattika, mfn. [sa. a + vibhakti + ka], (a)
not admitting of subdivisions; m. pl. ~ā (aṭṭhārasa,
scil. dhammā), Nāmar-s 10,25-31(—11,25 . . . 12,27;
opp. savibhattikā); — (b) without case-suffix; m. ~o
niddeso, Sadd 300,2; 384,28; avibhattika-niddeso,
Vv-a 164,9, see Sadd 15,1—16,4; n. ~aṁ nāmika-
padam, Sadd 450,13.

a-vibhatti-yutta, mfn. [3a + sa. vibhakti +
yukta], not (apt to be) constructed with (or to replace)
case-forms; m. pl. ~ā, Sadd 299,20 (—300,1); (893,10)
895,16.

a-vibhavi(n), mfn. [neg. adj. of do.], incapable of
clear understanding; m. avijjā-gato aññāṇī ~ī dup-
pañño (= 'avidvā'), Nidd II 98,29.a-vibhavin

a-vibhavi(n), mfn. [neg. adj. of do.], incapable of
clear understanding; m. avijjā-gato aññāṇī ~ī dup-
pañño (= 'avidvā'), Nidd II 98,29.a-vibhavin

a-vibhāga, m. [ts.], no separation (of words);
Sadd 38,5 foll. (= eka-padattha-gahaṇaṁ, ib. n).

a-vibhāvayitvā, [neg. abs. of vibhāveti]; not
having understood distinctly; Sn 318; 320 (dhammaṁ~).

a-vibhāvita, mfn. [neg. pp. of do.], not under-
stood (in detail); n. lakkhaṇaṁ aññātaṁ . . . avi-
bhūtam ~am [Ee misprints avibhāritaṁ], Nidd I
339,10 (opp. vibhāvitaṁ, ib. 16; = paññāya na vaḍ-
ḍhitaṁ, Nidd-a) = Paṭis-a I 60,12; — °(a)ttha, mfn.,
indistinct; °-saddo, Sadd 326,10 (= 'avyatta-saddo');
instr. ~enanigghosena rahitāni, Ps III 350,7 (= 'appa-
nigghosāni') ≠ Sv (III) 833,20.

a-vibhūta, mfn. [neg. pp. of vibhavati; cf. prec],
indistinct, not clear; undeveloped; m. ativāte saddo
~o hoti, Mil 92,4; ayaṁ kālo mayhaṁ paṭicchanno
(— 'channo') ~o na paññāyati, Spk I 41,16; f. ~ā
(scil. vedanānaṁ uppatti), Sv (III) 723,29 (duddīpanā
andhakārā + ; Ee āvibhūtā) = Ps I 277,23; upekkhā
andhakārā ~ā duddīpanā, Ps II 370,7; Vism 112,5
(aṭṭhika-saññă); n. ~aṁ (opp. vibhūtaṁ), Abhidh-s
16,20; Nidd I 339,10 (+ avibhāvitam; = napākaṭaṁ,
Nidd-a); Mil 311,8 (cittaṁ abalaṁ+); Vism 125,4
(maṇḍalaṁ; = gaja-nimīlanena pekkhantassa rāpa-
gataṁ viya, mhṭ.); 244,13 (kammaṭṭhānaṁ); m. pl.
~ā (saṁkhārā aññamañña-missā āluḷitā ~ā duddī-
panā), Ps II 364,25; [Thī419, v. ll. adhibhūtā, avisūtā;
read: te maṁ pitū gharaṁ paṭi ḷ nayiṁsu vimanā
dukhena adhibhūtā ||]; — [compar. n. avibhūtataraṁ,
Spk II 134,15, v. l. better avibhūta-vāram?].

a-vibhūsanā, f. [sa. a + vibhūṣaṇā], "lack of
adomment"; AN V 136,7.

a-vibhediya, mfn. [neg. grd. of vi + √bhid], i. q.
abhejja (b), cf. abhejja-parisa; f. avibhediyā 'ssa
parisā bhavati, DN III 173,8* (metre Pramitākṣarā;
Ee aviheṭhiyā . . . bhavantil).

a-vimana(s), mfn. [ts.], not perplexed (terrified
or confused); m. sumānaso ~o, Vin I 25,25*; f. ~ā
devi hohi, Vin I 343,14; imasmiṁ gehe ~ā abhira-
massu, Pv-a 274,13; cf. adhi-mana(s).a-vimanas

avimana-mānasa, mfn., with trustful mind;
m. sādhukaṁ suṇohi manasikarohi ~o, Mil 132,12
(cf. prec).

a-vimana(s), mfn. [ts.], not perplexed (terrified
or confused); m. sumānaso ~o, Vin I 25,25*; f. ~ā
devi hohi, Vin I 343,14; imasmiṁ gehe ~ā abhira-
massu, Pv-a 274,13; cf. adhi-mana(s).a-vimanas

a-vimhāpaka, mfn. [3a + sa. vismāpaka, from
vi + √smi], not imposing, not humbugging; ni. ~o tīhi
kuhana-vatthūhi, Pj II 549,20 (= 'akuhako').

a-vimānanā, f. [cf. sa. a-vimāna], non-disrespect,
veneration; instr. ~āya, DN III 190,6 (Sv (111)955,19;
cf. amānanā . . . vimānanā, Ja III 247,22*).

a-vimukha, mfn. [3a + vimukha], not averse
(or not turning away [from work]); m. pl. dāsa-kam-
makara-porisā ~ā kammaṁ karonti, AN III 260,16
(Tr. abhimukhā!; cf. vimukhā, ib. 8; Mp III 331,10).

a-vimutta, mfn. [sa. a-vimukta], unreleased, not
liberated; m. ~o (upāyo (or upayo), see 1an-upāya and
an-ūpaya), SN III 53,9; gen. ~assa, AN I 109,13 =
Pp 27,30; n. ~aṁ (cittaṁ), MN I 350,2; DN I 80,14
(Vism 410,20-22); 81,5; II 299,27 (Sv (III) 776,32:
ubhaya-vimutti-virahitaṁ; see DN I 156,25); Paṭis
I 113,24-25 (cf. II 234,11); AN V 346,7 foll.

a-viyaggatā, /. [neg. abstr. from sa. vyagra], non-
discord, equilibrium (of the humours of the body); Ja
VI 224,9* (vātānaṁ ~ā; Ee avisaggatā; Ct.); cf. viy-
aggatā (Ee vissaggo) & vaggavaggā, ib. 224,31').

a-viyatta, mfn. [sa. avyakta] = a-vyatta, indi-
stinct; loc. f. ~āyaṁ vācāyaṁ, sense of √milech, Sadd
342,3.

a-viyutta, mfn. [sa. aviyukta], not separated,
not deprived (of: instr.); utūhi ~ā, Ct. ad Anāg 17
(JPTS 1886, p. 43,34; = ɔsabbôtuka-m-anāvaṭā' scil.
pokkharaṇī); — [v. l. for abhi-yutta, q. v.].

a-viyojita, mfn. [neg. pp. of vi-yojeti], not separ-
ated from (abl.); n. ~aṁ rukkhato, Sv I 81,24.

a-viragi(n), mfn. [cf. sa. virāga], not changing
colour, (constant, unalterable), f. ~inī, Ja III 88,23*
(yassa cittaṁ a-hāliddaṁ saddhā ca ~inī; Ct.).a-viragin

a-viragi(n), mfn. [cf. sa. virāga], not changing
colour, (constant, unalterable), f. ~inī, Ja III 88,23*
(yassa cittaṁ a-hāliddaṁ saddhā ca ~inī; Ct.).a-viragin

a-virajaya(t), mfn. [neg. part, of 1virājeti; cf. sa.
virāgayati], not detaching himself (from: acc); m. ~aṁ
(+ appajahaṁ), SN IV 17,9 foll. (scil. sabbaṁ . . .
cakkhuṁ, etc.; = avirājento, Spk).

a-virajaya(t), mfn. [neg. part, of 1virājeti; cf. sa.
virāgayati], not detaching himself (from: acc); m. ~aṁ
(+ appajahaṁ), SN IV 17,9 foll. (scil. sabbaṁ . . .
cakkhuṁ, etc.; = avirājento, Spk).

a-virajjhana-vedhitā, f. abstr. [of *avirajjhana-
vedhi(n) (cf. a-viradhita-vedhi(n)) = 'hitting (his
mark) infallibly', see akkhana-vedhi(n) above]; — instr.
~āya sampanna-hatthe (acc. m. pl.)., Ja VI 448,23' (Ee
avirujjhana-°; = 'kata-hatthe').

a-virajjhitvā, neg. abs. of virajjhati (cf. prec),
without missing (his mark), hence: infallibly; Ps II
33,1; 422,11; Ud-a 148,19; As 394,32 (v. l. a-rujjhitvā).

a-virata, mfn. [ts.; neg. pp. of vi + √ram], not
having renounced, not abstaining from (abl.; see abstr.);
n. indecl. continually ~aṁ vyasanaṁ pareti, Tel 53;
Abh 41 (niccaṁ +); — °-tta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, Pj II
468,18 — Dhp-a IV 180,7.

a-viraddha, mfn. [3a + viraddha, pp. of vi +
ḷ rādh], not missing, not failing (acc); m. ~o, Ja I
490,17 (maṁ virajjhanto pi . . . soḷasa ussada—niraye
~o yevâsi; cf. naviraddho, Ja III 85,7); — °-vedhi(n)
— akkhana-vedhi(n), q. v.; Ja IV 497,30' (pl. ~ino).

a-viraḷa, mfn. [3a + sa. virala], not sparse; —
°-danta, mfn., v. l. for avivara-danta, q. v. (cf. sa.
aviraladanta, not gap-toothed, Vyu 17 :s).

a-viraḷita, mfn. [see prec], not interrupted,
n. (adv.) ~am udentaṁ (scil. vividha-kirana-jālaṁ),
Dāṭh IV 24 (Ee aviralitam).

a-virādhita, mfn. [neg. pp. of vi-rādheti], not
failed, not missed; n. ~aṁ (tāla-cchiggaḷena asanaṁ
atipātente, without missing), SN V 453,12 foll.; —
do. metaph. — clear, undoubted; PsIV 200,10 (=
'apaṇṇakaṁ'); — °-vedhi(n), mfn., = avirajjhana-
vedhi(n), q. v.; m. ~ī, Ja II 91,11' (= 'akkhaṇa-vedhī%
q. v.); — °- -hattha, m., the unfailing hand (of an
archer); Spk I 181,9.

a-viriya, mfn. [sa. a-vīrya], without energy,
powerless; m. pl. ~ā (avasā abalā +), DN I 53,32 =
MN I 407,26 - SN III 210,9.

a-virujjhamāna, mfn. [neg. part. med. & pass,
of vi-rujjhati, sa. vi + √rudh], (a, pass.) unob-
structed, unimpeded, m. sg. ~o (sabbena lokena), Sn 73
(so Pj II 128,20; Nidd II 99,3, but prob. = b); (b, med.)
not opposing, not contradicting, m. pl. ~ā (ditthīhi-
diṭṭhiṁ), Sn 833 (Nidd I 175,8).

a-viruddha, mfn. [ts.; pp., cf. prec, b], (a) not
opposing, not hostile; m. ~o, Sn 365 (Pj); 704 (+
asāratto; Pj); 854 (taṇhāya; Nidd I 239,22); dhīro
~o anussito, AN I 199,7*; anānuruddho ~a kenaci,
SN IV 71,16* (Spk II 382,1, cf. Sadd 15,29); acc ~aṁ
viruddhesu, Sn 630 (Pj) — Dhp 406 (Dhp-a) ≠ SN I
236,21*; — (b) not incompatible (with logic or grammar),
synon, apaṇṇaka (q. v.), Abh 698; m. ~o, Ud-a 215,1.

a-viruddhaka, m. (cf. prec), designation of a
certain class of heretics (sense and reading doubtful; no
Ct.); AN III 276,33 (nigaṇṭho . . . tedaṇḍiko, ~o,
gotamako, devadhammiko; v. l. āruddhako); [acc pl.
~e, Ps IV 179,10 (Tr.) read with Ee avaruddh(ak)e ≠
Sv (II) 434,21].

aviruddha-kāraṇa, n., the correct reasoning),
cf. aviruddha (b); Ja I 104,12' (ekaṁsika-kāraṇaṁ + ;
= 'apaṇṇakaṁ ṭhānaṁ').

aviruddha-gāha, m. — 'apaṇṇakagāha', q. v.;
acc ~aṁ gahita-manussā (paron.), Ja I 97,26 (cf.
ib. I 104,8').

aviruddha-paṭipadā, f. = apaṇṇaka-paṭipadā
(q. v.); instr. ~āya, Nidd-a I 65,15 (= 'anuloma-
paṭipadāya').

a-virūhana, mfn. (cf. virūhati), where nothing
can take root; n. giri-sikharaṁ sabba-bījānaṁ ~aṁ,
Mil 322,27; nibbānaṁ sabba-kilesānaṁ ~aṁ, ib. 29.

a-virūḷha, mfn. [neg. pp. of vi-rūhati, √ruh],
not grown out, undeveloped; loc. ~e (viññāṇe), SN II
66,2—67,22 (Spk II 71,5-33); — °-pakkha, mfn.
[sa. °-pakṣa], whose wings are not grown out, unfledged;
m. ~o (scil. kokila-potako), Ja III 103,7.

a-virūḷhi-chanda, mfn. [sa. °-chandas], with no
desire fore growth; m. pl. khīṇa-bījā ~ā, Khp VI 14 =
Sn 235 (Pj I 194,21); a-virūṭhi-dhamma, mfn. [sa.
°-dharma], not liable to growth (i. e., unable to make
progress); m. dandho ~o, Ja I 116,33 (= avuddhi-
sabhāvo, pt) = Dhp-a I 245,5; niyyānika-sāsanaṁ
labhitvā ~o kir' amhi, Ps II 104,34; chinna-paccayo
. . . sāsane ~o, ib. 306,12; m. pl. tumhe khv attha
nāgā ~ā imasmiṁ dhamma-vinaye, Vin I 87,28; —
°-dhammatta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, Sp I 133,5 (ad Vin
III 2,18: 'avatthukatā'); — °-bhāva, m. abstr.; Ps II
104,18 (assa . . . ~aṁ dassento).

a-virodha, m. [ts., cf. vi + √rudh], non-oppo-
sition, harmony, compatibility (with: instr.); Ps III
341,1 (~o vuccati mettā; ad MN II 105,1*); Ja V
379,3' (= 'avirodhanaṁ'); Ud-a 37,9 (Khandhaka-
pāṭhena iminā Udāna-pāḷiyā avirodha-dassana-mu-
khena); — °-kara, mfn., not hostile, peaceful; loc. pl.
~esu pāṇisu, Pv 470 (= avirodhaṁ karontesu (or
virodhaṁ akarontesu) miga-sakuṇâdisu, Pv-a); —
°-ppasaṁsi(n), mfn. [sa. °-praçaṁsin], praising pea-
ceableness; gen. pl. khantivādānaṁ ~inaṁ sunantu
dhammaṁ, Th 875 - MN II 105,1*; — °-lakkhaṇa,
mfn., having the characteristic of a°, As 127,22 (adoso
acaṇḍikka-lakkhaṇo ~o vā anukūla-mitto viya) =
Vism 465,10 (mhṭ: 'avirodho' = aviggaho) — A-
bhidh-av 19,26.

a-virodhana, n. = a-virodha (q. v.); Ja III
274,2* (akkodhaṁ avihiṁsā ca khantī ca ~aṁ; quoted
ib. 320,7* & 412,21*) ≠ Ja V 378,14* (Ct.).

a-virodhitā, f. abstr. [cf. sa. virodhin, vi + ḷ/rudh],
absence of opposition; — °-paccupaṭṭhāna, mfn.,
having a° as its manifestation; f. ~ā (sabbakiriyāsu,
scil. rūpassa mudutā), Abhidh-av 71,5 — Vism 448,27
(mhṭ).

a-virodhiya, mfn. [3a + sa. virodhya], not to
be opposed, Ap 47,22-24 (or v. l. a-virādhiya, neg. grd.
of vi-√rādh = not to be injured) = Th-a C* 369,23-25*.

a-vilaṅghanīya, mfn. [ts.; neg. grd. of vi-
√laṅgh], not to be overpassed; f. vohāra-visayasmiṁ
loka-sammuti . . . ~ā, Sadd 72,15.

a-vilambita, mfn. [ts.; neg. pp. of vi-ḷ/lamb],
not delaying, speedy; Abh 40.

[a-vilāpanatā, f. abstr., w. r. Pp 25,16 for apilā-
panatā, q. v.].

a-vilutta, mfn. [neg. pp. of vi-√lup], not robbed,
not plundered; loc. ~e vilutta-saññī, Vin III 197,23
(Sp (III) 642,10: gabbhaṁ bhinditvā pasayhâvahāra-
vasena ɔ~e' ti veditabbaṁ) = Vin III 252,2.

a-vilopiya, mfn. [neg. grd. of do.}, not to be
plundered; n. ~aṁ aññehi, Saddh 311 (cf. Khp VIII 9).

a-vilomenta, mfn. [neg. part, of vilometi, denom,
of vi-loma, q. v.], not disagreeing with (acc); m. ~o,
Ps I 139,20 (Bhagavato desanaṁ).

a-vivaṭa, mfn. [3a + sa. vivṛta], closed, not open;
n. ~aṁ . . . na vivaranti, MN I 221,24 ≠ AN I 117,31
(~aṁ . . . vivaranti) = IV 152,6.

a-vivadamāna, mfn. [neg. part. med. of viva-
dati], not disputing, not quarrelling; m. ~o, Vin III
172,37 (samaggo hi saṁgho sammodamāno ~o ekud-
deso phāsu viharati; Sp (III) 608,27) ≠ m. pl., MN
III 156,10; do. acc. pl. m., MN II 120,29.

a-vivara, mfn. [3a + sa. vivara], without gaps or
interstices; m. pl. ~ā (+ sahitā, scil. dantā), DN III
173,5* (v. l. aviraḷā); Dhp-a I 387,21 (dantā sukkā
samā~ā; gp; v. l. do.); — °-danta, mfn., i. q. avirala-
danta; m. ~o, DN II 18,22 (cf. Sv (II) 450,15)'=
III 144,18 (v. l. aviraḷa-°; cf. Sv (III) 938,19: dantā
aparipuṇṇā c'eva honti viralā ca, Ee virata) ≠
172,7 (v. ï. avirala-°) ≠ MN II 137,3 (cf. notes & Ps
III 381,22).

a-vivāda, m. [3a + vivāda], (1) absence of dis-
puting, harmony; acc. ~aṁ, Ap 6,9 (vivādaṁ bhayato
disvā ~añ ca khemato); dat. ~āya (saṅgahăya +)
saṁvattati, scil. ayaṁ dhammo, DN III 245,13 =
246,2 foll. - MN II 251,1 ≠ AN V 89,18-91,25 ≠
MN I 322,7 foll. = AN III 289,18; — °-bhūmi, f.,
and °-bhumma(n), n. (cf. sa bhūman), a place for
a°; acc. ~iṁ, Sn 896 = avivāda-bhummaṁ, Nidd I
308,1 (— amata-nibbānaṁ), quoted Sīmā-v 30,23*; —
°-vaddhana-kara, mf(ī)n., causing growth of a°; acc.
f. ~iṁ sugiram . . . abhani (so metre and good Mss),
DN III 172,23*.

a-vivitta, mfn. [sa. avivikta, neg. pp. of vi-√vic],
(a) not devoid of, full of (instr.); n. ~aṁ (dasahi sad-
dehi, scil. Amaraṁ nāma nagaraṁ), Bv II 2 = Ja
I 3,3* ≠ Ap 61,9 — Th-a Ce 393,25* (always w. r. dasa
saddă-avivittaṁ scil. Sudassanaṁ nagaraṁ); Pj I
110,25* (scil. Kosaiānaṁpuraṁ); Ps III 210,8(dāraka-
dārikāhi (Ee ~ehi!) ~aṁ); f. ~ā, DN II 147,7 (Kusā-
vatī . . . dasahi saddehi ~ā ahosi); ~ā Sāvatthï
arahantehi, MN II 196,20; ~ā Sāvatthiyā (a:Savatthi)
manussehi kālaṁ karontehi, Ud 91,30 (= asuññā,
Ud-a); dasahi saddehi ~ā, Ja VI 397,14' (— 'sadda-
vatī', scil. senā); — (b) unseparated, not exempt from;
m. ~o (tedhātukehi dhammehi), Kv 605,8 foll.; (c) not
detached; Dhp-a II 77,2 (bālo assaddho dussīlo appa-
ssuto ~o, etc. (v. l. appavivitto; opp. pavivitto ib. 5,
see appiccha above).

a-vivittatā, f. abstr. of a-vivitta; Sadd 71,27
(atthitā vijjamānatā ~ā = 'atthibhāvo').

a-viveka-bhūta, mfn. [3a + viveka + bhūta],
who has not been separated or isolated; gen. ~assa
(kilesa-saṅgaṇikâdivasena), mhṭ ad Vism 691,16.

a-visa, mfn. [sa. a-visa], (a) not poisonous (said of
snakes); m. ~o atimaññasi, Ja VI 194,10* (= nibbiso ti
avajānāsi, Ct.); pl. ~ā, Ja VI 507,2* (= nibbisā, Ct.);
Ja III 16,27* (āsīvisaṁ maṁ ~ā sapanti); — (b) free
from (the effects of) poison; Mil 305,22 (avisaṁ kareyya).

a-visaṁka, mfn. [3a + sa. viçaṅkā], without
doubt or hesitation; pl. ~ā, Saddh 176 (adhimattāni
pāpāni ~ā caranti [so sn; prob, avisamkâcaranti] ye);
cf. nibbisaṁka, Pj II 239,7.

a-visaṁketa, mfn. [3a + vi-saṁketa; cf. sa.
saṁketa, m.], not against agreement; n. ~aṁ, Sp (II)
478,11 (opp. visaṁketaṁ).

a-visaṁvādana, n. [neg. verbal noun of vi-saṁ-
√vad, caus.], fidelity to one's purpose or promise;
dvīhi dvārehi ~aṁ (= ;saccaṁ'), Pj II 148,13; abl.
~ato, Ud-a 145,11; 151,26; — °-tā, f. abstr.; instr.
~āya, DN III 190,18 (Sv (III) 956,7).

a-visaṁvāda-sīla, mfn. (cf. sa. çīla, n.) = avi-
saṁvādaka, q.v.; gen. ~assa, Ja IV 77,19' (= 'avi-
saṁvādakassa').

a-visaṁvādenta, mfn. [neg. part.], being true to
ones word or purpose (caus. of sa. vi-saṁ-√vad), m.
~ento, Ja V 124,5'; Ud-a 134,1; — a-visaṁvādetvā,
abs., Sv (III) 956,8-9.

2a-visajjamāna, mfn. [neg. part. med. of vi-
√sṛj], not giving up, not abandoning; m. ~o, Nidd-a
ad Nidd II 95,29 (= 'a-riñcam[ā/a]no', Sn 69).

1a-visajjamāna, mfn. [neg. part. med. of vi-
√sañj], not clinging to, not adhering; m. ~o, Nidd-a
(Se) ad Nidd II 86,25 (= 'a-vedhamāno'; cf. Sn 213).

a-visaṭa, mfn. [3a + visaṭa, sa. vi-sṛta, pp. of
vi-√sṛ], not spread, not diffused; n. ~aṁ (bahiddhā
avikkhittaṁ+, scil. viññāṇaṁ), It 94,2 = MN III
223,11 (It-a; Ps); m. ~o, Ps III 394,14 (= 'avisārī',
scil. ghoso) ≠ Sv (II) 640,32 (v. l.); ~o (nadiyā soto;
avikkhitto +), AN III 64,24; instr, m. bindunā ~ena
piṇḍitena sarena samannāgato, Ja II 439,8' (= 'bin-
dussaro').

a-visada, mfn. [3a + sa. viçada], (a) not distinct
(or clear, said of the (fleshy) female body and its move-
ments, hence, generally, of feminine substantives (and
their paradigm, see below °âkāra, etc.)); m. itthīnaṁ
. . . uparima-kāyo ~o, As 321,7 ['not broad', Trsl.],
quoted Sadd 224,5; n. ~aṁ (ind.), As 321,14, quoted
Sadd 224,6 (itthiyo hi gacchamānā ~aṁ gacchanti,
'without assertiveness'); n. pl. ~āni (paripakkāni āluḷi-
tāni+, scil. indriyāni, As 328,26 (ad Dhs 644) =
Ps I 216,13; — (b) not clever, unintelligent; m. ~o
accheko, Sv (III) 811,30 (= 'avyatto'); — °-tā,
f. abstr., lack of intelligence, Pp-a 249,3, quoted Sadd
491,1 (instr. ~āya); — °-tta, n. abstr., indistinctness
(see next); Sadd 210,11*-10*; — °âkāra, mfn., of
indistinct (plump) appearance; f. pl. ~ā (itthiyo),
Sadd 224,10-12; — °-âkāra-vohāra, m., expression
(for a thing) of such appearance; ~o itthiliṅgaṁ,
Sadd 216,6 ... 222,2,6 ... 224,35; °-vohāratā, f.
abstr.; Sadd 112,11-13; 115,7; 209,29.

a-visama, mfn. [3a + sa. vi-ṣama], 'not unequal',
even, moderate; instr, m. ~ena . . . majjhimena ñāyena
pavatteyya, Pv-a 131,9 (= 'saraena vatteyya').

a-visamvādaka, mf(-ikā)n. [ts., neg. vb. adj. of vi-
saṁvadati; cf. sa. visaṁvāda, untrustworthiness], not
deceiving (gen.), not breaking one's word; not false; m. ~o
lokassa (saccavādī+), DN I 4,14 (Sv) — III 170,16
= MN III 33,26 = AN I 212,5 (Mp) - Pp 57,30
(Pp-a) = Nidd I 220,11 (Nidd-a) = 472,12 (Nidd-a)
≠ m. pl. AN IV 249,27; gen. m. ~assa, Ja IV 76,13*
(= a-visaṁvāda-sīlassa, Ct.); acc. f. ~ikaṁ, Ps III
438,24 (= 'saccaṁ', scil. giraṁ, Sn 632); n. pl. ~āni
(saccāni), Pj I 81,13 ≠ Vism 495,30; — °-ṭhāyi(n),
mfn. [cf. sa. sthāyin], persevering in being trustful;
m. pl. ~ino (pacceka-ṭhāyino+), Vin V 164,25 ( =
avisaṁvādaka-ṭṭnāne ṭhitā, Sp).

a-visamvādanā, f. = prec.; ~ā mittānaṁ
āhāro, AN V 136,23 (cf. Ja IV 76,12*-13*).

a-visamhāra, m. [3a + *visaṁhāra from vi-
saṁ-√hṛ], 1. q. a-visāhāra (synon, a-vikkhepa); —
°-lakkhaṇa, mfn. = avikkhepa-lakkhaṇa (q. v.),
Abhidh-av 18,28; Nāmar-p 78; see avisāhāra (Dhs 11;
As 144,18, etc.); cf. avisāra (Vism 464,14, mhṭ).

a-visaya, m. [sa. aviṣaya], anything out of one's
sphere (dominion or competence), anything improper
or impossible; nom. ~o esa mayhaṁ, Pv-a 122,18;
aññesaṁ ~o, buddhānam eva visayo, As 11,23; ~o
ekaccassa arahato sabbaṁ jānituṁ, Mil 267,1; ~o
eso pañho, Mil 316,27; Sadd 135,13; loc. (a ) yathā taṁ
~asmiṁ, SN IV 15,21 (Spk) = 67,21 = V 109,27
(Spk) = AN V 50,17; (β) ~e, Vism 300,21* (tassâ-
visaye; = agocare, mhṭ); Pj II 143,20 (attano ~e
appaṭipajjamāno); Sadd 506,29 (dhātūnaṁ ~e); [~e,
conjectured by Kern at Ja V 117,5* for avisare or,
better, adhisare, q. v.]; used as an adj. instr, f., sabba-
sattesu ~āya sammā-paṭipattiyā, Ud-a 89,7.

avisaya-bhūta, mfn. (cf. prec), not within one's
power, ungetable ; n. aññesaṁ ~aṁ (scil. ñāṇaṁ),
Pv-a 197,23; titthiyānaṁ ~aṁ buddha-gocaraṁ,
Ud-a 215,6; sabba-titthiyānaṁ ~aṁ, Vism 239,25
(mhṭ Se reads: avisayī-bhūtaṁ).

a-visayha, mfn. [sa. aviṣahya, neg. grd. of vi-
√sah], (a) unbearable (as something too heavy), (b) in-
tolerable, (c) difficult to treat, untractable; n. sac'assa
hoti ~aṁ, MN I 207,21 (a) — III 157,14 = Vin I
157,23; sace ca jaññā ~am attano, Ja IV 226,11* (c;
Ct.); m. pl. bahū ete, ekakassa mayhaṁ ~ā, Dhp-a
III 242,24 (c); — °-sāhi(n), mfn., who can endure
what is a° (b); voc. m. ~i, Ja V 8,10* (Ct.).

a-visari(n), mfn. [3a + sa. visārin], not diffuse;
m. ~ï, DN II 211,24 (bindu +, scil. Brahmuno
Sanaṁkumārassa saro; = avisaṭo [Ee suvisado] avip-
pakiṇṇo, Sv) = 227,23; do. MN II 140,7 (Gotamassa
... ghoso; = avisaṭo, Ps) — Nidd I 446,5 (= na
patthaṭo, Nidd-a).a-visarin

a-visari(n), mfn. [3a + sa. visārin], not diffuse;

Sanaṁkumārassa saro; = avisaṭo [Ee suvisado] avip-
pakiṇṇo, Sv) = 227,23; do. MN II 140,7 (Gotamassa
... ghoso; = avisaṭo, Ps) — Nidd I 446,5 (= na
patthaṭo, Nidd-a).a-visarin

[avisare, Ja V 117,5*; 119,1'; read adhisare (see

a-visaha(t), mfn. [neg. part, of vi-√sah], not
being able; m. ~anto, DN III 5,29 (= asakkonto,
Sv); f. ~antī, Vv-a 69,5; [instr, m. ~antena, Ja VI
492,30', v. l.].a-visahat

a-visahana, n. [neg. verbal noun of do.], non-
enduring; Sadd 21,23 (°-vasena).

a-visahamāna, mfn. [neg. part. med. of do.],
= a-visaha(t); m. ~o, Ja I 91,15.

a-vissaja(t), mfn. [neg. part.; cf. sa. vi-sṛjati,
\ sv]], not giving away, not spending; m. a-dadaṁ ~aṁ
bhogaṁ, Ja III 253,14* (= a-vissajjento, Ct.); —
[a-vissaji, aor., w. r. for avassaji, see ava-ssajati
above; cf. next & foll.].a-vissajat

a-vissaja(t), mfn. [neg. part.; cf. sa. vi-sṛjati,

bhogaṁ, Ja III 253,14* (= a-vissajjento, Ct.); —
[a-vissaji, aor., w. r. for avassaji, see ava-ssajati
above; cf. next & foll.].a-vissajat

a-vissajjaniya, [neg. grd. of prec] = a-vissajjiya
(q. v.); Nett 161,28; 176,1—178,23; 191,25 (~aṁ, opp.
vissajjaniyaṁ).

a-vissajjita, mfn. [neg. pp. of visajjeti, vi-√sṛj],
not given away or transferred; n. loc. ~e vissajjita-
saññī, Vin III 197,19 (Sp) = 251,35; n. pl. ~āni, Vin
II 170.25.

a-vissajjitvā, ind. [neg. abs. of vi-sṛj], not omit-
ting; Dhp-a IV 100,9 (nāmarūpaṁ ~).

a-vissajjiya, mfn. [neg. grd. cf. prec], not to be
given away or transferred; n. ~aṁ avebhaṅgiyaṁ,
Vin V 216,5 ≠ Vin I 305,13 (spelt avissajjikaṁ); n. pl.
pañca ~āni, Vin II 170,23; V 129,19 (cf. 133,17*).

a-vissaji, (mfn.), i. q. avissajjiya, in the uddāna
Vin V 133,17* (cf. a-vebhangi(ya) below).

a-vissattha, mfn. [sa. aviçvasta, neg. pp. of vi-
√çvas], not trusted, suspected; m. loc. ~e (na vissase),
Ja I 389,1* (Ct.), cf. Nāmaṙ-p 1221; without confidence
(hesitating); m. pl. bhikkhū ~ā paribhuñjanti, Vin I
211,35.

a-vissasi(n), mfn., without confidence or trust (in:
loc); nom. pl. m. sabbasattesv avissāsī, Nāmar-p 948.'a-vissasin

a-vissasi(n), mfn., without confidence or trust (in:

a-vissāsika, mfn. [3a + sa. viçvāsika], untrust-

a-vissāsiya, mfn. = a-vissāsanīya (q. v.); Vism

a-visāra, m. [3a + visāra], not diffusiveness;
mhṭ ad Vism 464,14 (~o attano eva avisaraṇa-sabhā-

a-visārada, mfn. [3a + sa. viçārada], not con-
fident, diffident, uneasy; m. ~o upasaṁkamati maṁ-
kubhūto, DN II 85,24 (Sv (II) 539,7-17); upāsako
~o agāraṁ ajjhāvasati, AN III 203,25 foll.; suten'
