°-tta, n. abstr. = prec; abl. ~ā parisaṁ otarituṁ
na sakkoti, Sv (III) 834,16 (= 'aparisâvacaro')-

a-visāhaṭa, mfn. [3a + vi + sa. saṁ-hṛta; cf.
next], not distracted, unperturbed; — °-citta, mfn., id.,

— °-tā, f.abstr.; Dhs 11, etc. (see avisāhāra) = Nidd I
365,24 (Nidd-a & As 144,23 = avisāhaṭa[ssa]-māna-
sassa bhāvo).

a-visāhāra, m. (the canonical spelling for a-
visaṁhāra, Sadd 632,19), absence of distraction; cit-
tassa ṭhiti saṇthiti avaṭṭhiti ~o avikkhepo, avisāhata-
mānasatā, Dhs 11 (As 144,17), 15, 88, 287, 570'=
Nidd I 365,23 (Nidd-a - As).

a-visuddha, mfn. [3a + sa. vi-çuddha, pp. of
vi-√çudh], not purified (from : instr.), unclean; m. ~o
tāhi āpattīhi, Vin II 68,34; f. anto ~ā, not cleaned
out inside, AN II 201,1 (scil. sāla-laṭṭhī); n. gen.
~assa cittassa visuddhiyā, AN III 212,13 = 213,1;
gen. pl. ~ānaṁ saddhâdīnaṁ visuddha-karaṇa-vasena,
Ud-a 222,28.

a-visesa, m. [sa. a-viçeṣa], non-distinction, uni-
formity; instr. ~ena (adv.), not differently, without spe-
cification; Dhp-a I 35,13 (~ena sabbam pi); As 338,20;
Ps II 235,21; Pv-a 116,11 (but see v. l.); Sp I 108,22
- Sv I 132,11 = Spk I 13,1, etc.; Ill 291,18; Ja
I 177,13'; Abhidh-av 61,9*; Vism 475,27; 556,25;
573,15; 581,19; 589,1; 709,25; — abl. ~ato (adv.),
do.; Ps I 223,33; Spk III 13,13; Vism 502,30; Sadd
339,4; — °-kara, mfn., making no distinction; nom.
~o Neru, Ja III 248,2*; loc. ~e nage, Ja III 247,25*;
f.pl. Neru viya ~ā, Ja V 425,17** (Ee °kārā; = nibbi-
sesa-karā, ib. 432,16'); — °-kāra, m., the not making
distinction; abl.~ato, Spk III 13,15 (Ee~ito); 15,13-25;
— °-ññ[ū/u], mfn. [sa. °-jña], not knowing the distinction;
m. pl. ~uno hi evamādi-vibhāgaṁ ajānantā, Sadd
104,27; — °-tā, f. abstr., want of distinction; instr.
~āya, Mil 180,29; — °-tta, n. abstr., do.; loc. ~e
sati, Sadd 208,19.

Aviha, m. pl. [Buddh, sa. Avṛha], a class of divine
beings; ~ā, Atappā, Sudassā, Sudassī, Akaniṭṭhā
(pañca suddhâvāsā), DN III 237,19 ≠ Abhidh-s
21,18; ~ā devā, MN III 103,1 (Vehapphalā devā +,
do.); instr.pl. ~ehi devehi, DN II 52,16-20-22 (Sv
(11)480,2; attano sampattiyā na hāyanti na vihā-
yantī ti A-vi-hā = Vibh-a 521,10); gen. pl. ~ānaṁ
devānaṁ, Kv 207,21; loc. pl. ~esu, Pp-a 199,5; 200,4;
Pj I 182,26; ~esu devesu, DN II 50,13; ~esu nib-
battitvā, Dhp-a III 290,1; Spk III 143,24; ~esu nib-
batta-mattā . . . arahattaṁ pattā, Thī-a 222,17 ≠

20,2; ~°âdisu, Ud-a 93,4; Sv (III) 740,3; — n. sg.,

acc ~aṁ gato, AN I 279,29*; ~aṁ upapannāse, SN I
35,6* = 60,4*, quoted Ps II 191,5*, V 63,1*, Thī-a
222,20*; abl. ~ā cuto, Pp 17,21; ~ato, Pp-a 199,30;
loc ~e, Pp-a 199,21; — °-brahmaloka, m.; loc. ~e,
Ps V 62,26-28 (cf. Avihâdi-brahmalokasmiṁ, Spk I
91,19).

a-vihaññamāna, mfn. [neg. part. pass, of vi-
√han], without being distressed; tā (scil. vedanā) sudaṁ
Bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi ~o, DN II 99,5
(Sv) = SN V 152,24 (Spk = Sv) - Ud 82,26 (Ud-a
= Sv) ≠ SN I 28,3 (= apīḷiyamāno, Spk).

a-vihata, mfn. [neg. pp. of vi-√han], not struck
away, not removed; — °-khāṇuka, mfn. [cf. prākr.
khāṇu, thāṇu, sa. sthāṇu], ''not (yet) stubbed"; acc
n. dukkhettaṁ . . . ~aṁ, SN V 379,22 ≠ loc. n. duk-
khette . . . ~e, DN II 353,7; — °-yobbana, mfn. [cf.
sa. yauvana], with still fresh youth; f. ~ā, Dhp-a I 388,4
(Ee avigata-y°; Dharmapr 232,32 : no naṭa yovun æti);
— °-sakkāya-diṭṭhika, mfn., who has not got rid of
the theory of permanence [cf. Buddh.sa. sat-kāya-dṛṣṭi],
m. pl. ~ā (puthujjanā), As 349,3.

a-vihiṁsa(t), mfn. [neg. part, of vihiṁsati], not

a-vihiṁsa(t), mfn. [neg. part, of vihiṁsati], not

97,18; AN III 447,18 (~u bhāvetabbā); Vibh 86,5-40—
87,4; acc. ~uṁ, SN II 152,34 (Spk); — °-paccupaṭ-
ṭhāna, mfn., having a° as its manifestation; f. ~ā
(karuṇā), Abhidh-av 21,24 ≠ Vism 318,13; —

paccati, Ja V 144,5* (Ct.); instr. ~inā, Ja I 366,8; abl.
~ito, Spk I 18,18; 204,8; II 245,18; 274,8 (khajjopa-
naka-mattaṁ aggiṁ nīharitvā), quoted Ss 54,7; Ja III
459,30, etc.; Dhp-a III 181,5; 225,10; Pj I 249,13;
Ud-a 108,1; 246,14; loc. m. ~imhi, Sv (II) 440,15 ; Spk
I 111,20; 218,31; Ja I 44,31*; IV 103,3, etc.; Dhp-a
I 142,16, etc. etc.; anto- ~imhi (yojanasatike), Dhp-a
I 148,5; loc. f. ~iyaṁ, Spk III 103,11; in cpd.s: Bha-
vagga-gahaṇatthaṁ hattha-ppasāraṇaṁ viya Avīci-
phusanatthaṁ pāda-ppasāraṇaṁ viya, Sv (III) 802,23
= Vibh-a 117,25; Avīci-ādi-anekappakāraṁ nirayaṁ,
Ud-a 418,21; Avïci-ādi-bhedaṁ nirayaṁ, Pj II 290,21;
— °-niraya, m., the hell A°; nom. ~o, Nidd I 405,20*
= II 170,20*; acc. ~aṁ patto, Vin II 203,11* = It
86,7*; hetthato ~aṁ pariyantaṁ karitvā, Dhs 1280
= Paṭis I 83,30 = Vibh 86,10, quoted Sv (III) 987,29,
Vism 486,25, Ps IV 106,4, Spk II 136,5 ≠ As 61,34;
~aṁ gacchantā sattā, Mil 4,31; loc. ~e, Pj II 50,9;
— °-niraya-santāpa, m., the heat of the Avīci-hell;
~o yojana-sataṁ pharati, Ja VI 8,20; — °-paṭi-
panna, mfn., who has entered A°; ~o, Ja III 460,15;
— °-parāyana, mfn., destined to A°; m. ~o jāto, Ja
III 454,9 (= 460,9') = IV 100,21 = 159,2 = V 262,5
= Mhv-ṭ 44,21; ~o bhavissati, Dhp-a III 189,19; acc.
~aṁkaroti, Ja V 113,24'; — °-pariyanta,mfn., having
A° as limit; acc. ~aṁ katvā, Spk III 67,25 (ɔ: down to
A°); Mhv-ṭ 589,24 (o: Avīciṁ pariyantaṁ k.?); —
°-mahāniraya, m., the great hell A°; ~o, Pj II 443,20 =
Vism 207,3; Sv (III) 855,33; Ja I 232,17'; gen. ~ass'
ev' etaṁ nāmaṁ (scil. Jāla-roruvo), Spk I 81,24; abl.
~ato, Ja I 322,4; loc. ~e, Spk II 290,24 = Vibh-a
4,32; Dhp-a II 10,9; 21,25; Pj II 307,6; Ja III 42,20;
243,30'; Mil 357,15 (sata-yojanike); — do. °-uppatti-
saṁvattanika, mfn., conducive to rebirth in A°; n.
~aṁ kappaṭṭhikaṁ atekicchaṁ . . . saṁghabheda-
kammaṁ, Ūd-a 317,23; — do. °-santāpa, m., its
heat; Dhp-a I 127,1—128,16; -- °-saṁpatta, mfn.
[sa. samprāpta], reaching to A°; n. dakkhiṇa-cakka-
vāḷaṁ (etc.) ~aṁ viya ahosi, Ja I 71,2,6,13; — —
ifc. v. anto-° (q. v.), Mahâvīci (Ja V 266,14*; =
mahanto Avīci, Ct.).

1a-vīci, mfn. (see Abhidh-k-vy Trsl III 148,7 foll.;
Vism-mhṭ, As-mṭ take vīci = antara (A 1), from *vy-
añc, cf. Old. ad RV X 10,6?), uninterrupted (opp. sa-
vīci); ~i savīcī ti evam pi duvidhā hoti (scil. jarā),
As 328,33 = Ps I 216,19 = Spk II 12,23 = Vibh-a
99,14; — °-jarā, f., continuous decay; Vism 449,35 (yā
ca pathavī-udaka-pabbata-candima-suriyâdisu ~ā nā-
ma, "where change is uninterrupted", Trsl.) ≠ Ps I
216,23 = As 329,2 (+ nirantarā jarā ti attho); —
°-m-anusambandha, mfn., in unbroken succession;
~o nadī-soto va vattati, Ps I 261,9* = Spk III 190,21*;
Nāmar-p 1544; — °-santati-sahitaṁ, ind., with
uninterrupted continuity; Nidd I 18,27 (Nidd-a I 80,2:
avīcï ti aviralaṁ) = 347,3 = II 264,30.

a-vīcika, mfn. [from 1a-vīci, mfn.]; acc. f. ~aṁ
citta-santatiṁ, Vism 669,30 ("the gapless continuity of
consciousness'", Trsl.).

a-vīta, mfn. [neg. pp. of vi + √i], not gone away,
not disappeared, only in cpds: °-gandha, mfn., having
preserved its fragrance; n. ~aṁ (scil. padumaṁ), SN
I 81,14* (= avigata-gandhaṁ, Spk) = AN III 239,24*
(Mp = Spk), quoted Ja I 116,13*, Dhp-a I 244,4*; —
°-cchanda, mfn. [sa. °-chandas], not free from desire;
m. ~o, AN IV 461,4, etc., see °-rāga below; — °-taṇha,
mfn. [cf. sa. tṛsnā], not free from craving; m. ~o (avīta-
rāgo+), AN IV 461,5 foll. (463,5), etc.; ~o hi pā-
piccho, Ud-a 63,9; m. pl. (a ), Th 778 (bahū manussā
~ā maraṇaṁ upenti); (β) ~āse bhavâbhavesu (scil.
hīnā narā), Sn 776 (= avigata-taṇhā, etc., Nidd I
49,3) ≠ 901; — °-dosa, mfn. [sa. °-dveṣa], not free
from hatred; m. ~o (avīta-rāgo +), MN I 23,30; AN
I 144,7; m. pl. ~ā, MN III 291,30; — °-pariḷāha,
mfn. [sa. °-paridāha], not free from pain or fever; m.
~o, AN IV 461,5, etc.; — °-pipāsa, mfn. [cf. sa.
pipāsā], not free from thirst; m. ~o, ib.; — °-pema,
mfn. [cf. sa. preman], not free from affection; m. ~o, ib.;
— °-moha, mfn., not free from delusion; m. ~o,
MN I 23,30; AN I 144,7; m. pl. ~ā, MN III 291,30;
— °-rāga, mfn., not (yet) free from passion; (a) m.
~o kāmesu, AN III 373,19* (= avigata-rāgo, Mp);
Ja IV 111,28* (= taṇhā-vasiko puggalo, Ct.); Pp
32,13 foll. (Pp-a); Mil 76,30 (opp. vīta-rāgo); acc.
~aṁ, SN I 125,36; m. pl. ~ā (opp. vīta-rāgā), DN II
157,20 (Sv (II) 595,28); m. acc. pl. ~e (satte), MN I
506,31; — (b) m. ~o (+ °-doso °-moho), MN I 23,30
(samaṇo Gotamo); AN I 144,6 (Sakko devānam indo);
acc. ~aṁ (+ do.), MN I 236,36; m. pl. ~ā (+ do.),
MN III 291,30; — (c) m. ~o (+ °-cchando °-pemo
°-pipāso °-pariḷáho °-taṇho, scil. pañca cetaso vini-
bandhā), AN IV 461,4 foll. ≠ II 173,35 (here and in
foll. passages avīta-° alternating with avigata-°) =
III 249,17 = V 18,15 - MN I 101,29 = Vibh 377,30;
— do. gen. rūpe ~assa (+ °-cchandassa, etc.), SN III
7,21 ≠ 107,5 foll.

a-vītikkanta, mfn. [neg. pp. of vītikkamati, cf.
next]; — °-pubba mfn.; Pj II 305,16 (not crossed be-
fore = 'atiṇṇa-pubba').

a-vītikkama, m. [3a + sa. vyatikrama, √kram],
non-transgression, the not being guilty; ~o (kāyiko etc.),
Dhs 1342 (quoted Spk I 254,16-17) = Pp 25,32, quoted
Pj II 148,32; ~o sīlaṁ, Paṭis I 44,35—46,7 (quoted
Vism 7,1 (see ib. 7,29) & 49,29) ≠ Uttarakurukānaṁ
manussānaṁ ~o pakati-sīlaṁ, Vism 15,21.

a-vītivatta, mfn. [neg. pp. of vy-ati-√vṛt], not
having passed or overcome; m. vivādāni ~o, Sn 796
(Pj: so diṭṭhi-kalahe ~o va hoti; = an-atikkanto
a-samatikkanto, Nidd); m. pl. ~ā sakkāyaṁ, Thī 199
(= nissaranâbhimukhā ahutvā sakkāya-tīram eva
anu-paridhāvantā, Thī-a) ≠ SN III 86,7* = AN
II 34,8*.

a-vīmaṁsita, mfn. [neg. pp. of vīmaṁsati], not
examined; n. ~aṁ, Ja IV 5,30' (a-saṁkhātaṁ +)

a-vīra-purisa, m. [sa. a-vīra-puruṣa], a weak
man, ~o, Mp III 396,27 (ad AN III 389,7).

a-vīvadāta, mfn. [neg. pp. of vy-ava-√dā3], not
purified; m. pl. ~ā (dhammā = diṭṭhiyo), Sn 784
(= avodātā, Pj; ~ă avodātā aparisuddhā saṁkiliṭṭhā
saṁkilesikā, Nidd).

a-vuṭṭhāpanīya, mfn. [neg. grd. of vuṭṭhāpeti,
caus. of vy-ut-√sthā], not to be expelled or discharged;
777.pl. ~ā, Sp (V) 1122,32 ad Vin I 285,4 (= na
vuṭṭhāpetabbā); cf. 1123,6.

a-vuṭṭhi, f. [sa. a-vṛṣṭi], want of rain, drought;
— °-ativuṭṭhi-ādīhi (kasikammaṁ appa-phalaṁ
hoti), owing to want of rain or to excessive rain etc.,
Ps III 444,15.

a-vuṭṭhika, mfn., rainless; f. ~ā disā n'atthi,
santatta-kaṭhitā (or -kuthitā) na ca, Ap 521,20; —
°-megha, m., a rainless cloud; It-a II 58,2 (°-samo =
'avuṭṭhika-samo').

a-vuṭṭhika-sama, m(fn)., (a person) like a
rainless cloud; m. ~o (scil. puggalo), It 64,19-21;
66,2* (It-a, see above).

a-vuṭṭhikā, f. = a-vuṭṭhi; instr. ~āya, Ja V
401,10*; manussā ~āya (Ce avuṭṭhitāya) upaddutā,
Th-a Ce 24,14 ad Th 1; — °-bhaya, n., fear of drought;
ib. (lokassa ~aṁ vidhamitukāmo).

a-vuṭṭhita, mfn. [3a + sa. vy-utthita, from
vy-ut-ḷsthā], not yet risen; instr, āsanā ~ena, Vin
IV 82,36 (Sp (IV) 829,30); loc. ~āya parisāya, Vin I
129,34.

a-vutta, mfn. [sa. an-ukta, neg. pp. of √vac;
cf. an-utta above], (a) unsaid, not named; [Vin-vn
2639 read avuttho]; n. ~am, Vin IV 82,32 (alam etaṁ
sabban ti ~aṁ hoti); tena vuttañ ca ~añ ca, Ja VI
165,2; — ifc. v. vuttâ° (v. l. to Ja VI 186,1); —(b)
uninvited (of one's own accord); f. ~ā, Vin III 207,27
(Sp (III) 662,9-12); — (c) in an active sense: hassa-
kena pi musā a-vutto, Ja VI 91,31' (cf. v. l.; = 'sac-
cavādī'); — — °-kāla,m(f/7.), Sadd 51,1*-10*(= 'anutta-
kāle' q. v., Kacc 417, quoted Sadd 50,34*; 51,15*, cf. ib.
813,26-30); — °-naya, mfn., the purport of which has
not been explained (before); acc. ~aṁ vaṇṇayissāma,
Pj II 344,26 ≠ 363,18 (cf. ib. 15: sesaṁ vutta-nayam
eva); — °-pubba, mfn., not mentioned before; n.
~aṁ, Pj II 174,21; — °-vikappana, n., an unnamed
alternative; Vv-a 37,12 (°-attho, mfn., scil. vā-saddo);
— °-samuccaya, m., adding (implying) something
not expressedly named, pt ad Sv (II) 651,1 (°-attho,
mfn., scil. ca-saddo); — °-siddha, mfn., self-evident;
pt ad Sv (II) 637,4-5; — °-âlamba, mfn., Sacc 369.

a-vutti-paribhoga, m. [sa. a-vṛtti + pari-
bhoga], partaking of unnatural food; instr. ~ena, Ja V
469,22* (= attano an-ājīva-bhūtena paribhogena, Ct.).

a-vuttha, mfn. [neg. pp. of √vas], who has not
kept his Lent (in full); Khuddas XLV 13 ≠ Vin-vn
2639 (so MSS and ṭ; Ee avutto).

a-vuttha-pubba, mfn. [neg. pp. of vasati, √vas,
+ sa. pūrva], who has not lived (together) before; acc.
(ekato) ~aṁ, Ja VI 311,1' (= 'a-santhutaṁ').

a-vuddhi, f. = a-vaḍḍṁ (q- v.); Sadd 248,11
(= 'abhavo', opp. vuddhi); acc. vyasanaṁ āpajjati
~iṁ pāpuṇāti, Sadd 4,24 (= 'parābhavati').

a-vuddhika, mfn., with no vṛddhi; pl. ~ā, Sadd
550,8 (tanoti tanute ti ~ā; opp. sa-vuddhikā : tāneti
tānayati); tudādayo ~ā, Dhātum, ch. lb (after v. 99).

a-vusita, mfn. [neg. pp. of vasati, √vas, cf.
vasita & vuttha], not properly led (as a brahmacariya);
instr, akatena me ettha kataṁ ~ena me ettha vusitaṁ,
MN I 515,23 foll. (Ps: ~en' eva brahmacariyena
vusitaṁ nāma hoti); — °-tta, n. abstr., DN I 90,22
(abl. ~ā); — °-va(t), mfn., not having led (his brahma-
cariya) properly; nom. m. ~vā, DN I 90,20 (= ācariya-
kule ~vā asikkhito appassuto (ca) samāno, Sv)
— °vāda, m.; ~ena vuccamāno ('paron.'), DN I 90,23.

a-vûpaccheda, m. [3a + *vy-upa-ccheda, cf.
sa. vyuccheda], non-interruption; yattha ~o tattha
santati, Nett 79,31; avûpacched'-attha, m. — santati-
attho, ib. 79,27.

a-vûpasanta, mfn. [3a + pp. of sa. vy-upa-
√çam], uneasy, not quiet, troubled; m. ~o (loko), Paṭis
I 127,8 (quoted Ud-a 142,22); n. ~aṁ (kāya-duccari-
tena cittaṁ āvilaṁ hoti, luḷitaṁ, . . . ~aṁ), Nidd I
488,28 (= anibbutaṁ, Nidd-a); m. pl. ~ā ajjhattam,
Th 936; — °-citta, mfn., id. said of persons; gen. m.
~assa, AN I 3,29; pl. ajjhattaṁ ~ā, MN III 291,19—
292,28 (avītarāgā+); — °-âkāra, m., i. q. avûpa-
sama, Ps I 284,29.

a-vûpasama, m. [3a + sa. vy-upa-çama], non-
tranquillity, absence of calmness; cetaso ~o, AN I 3,27;
SN V 65,6; cittassa uddhaccaṁ ~o, Dhs 429 ≠ 1159;
loc. cetaso ~e, Vism 469,8; Ps I 284,28 (do. ayoniso
manasi-kārena uddhacca-kukkuccassa uppādo hoti,
~o nāma avûpasantâkāro); — °-kara, mfn., pro-
moting unrest (scil. kāya-cittānaṁ), Abhidh-av 20,3 ;
— °-lakkhaṇa, mfn., having the characteristic of a°
(scil. uddhaccaṁ), Vism 469,5; Abhidh-av 23,32.

a-vekalla, n. [3a + sa. vaikalya (cf. a-vi-kala)],
(a) mfn., without deficiency (see abstr.); (b) n., non-
deficiency; acc. n. jānuṁ (Ee jaṇṇū) ~aṁ karoti,
Mil 418,6 (Se reads: jānuṁ avicalaṁ karoti, see a-
vicala, mfn. above); — °-tā, f. abstr.; indriyānaṁ ~ā
dullabhā lokasmiṁ, AN III 441,7; — °-tta, n. abstr.;
instr. ~ena, Vism 521,17 for avekallaṭṭhena?; —
°-nāma, mfn., who is named thus after his perfectness;
acc. m. ~aṁ, Spk I 85,6 ad SN I 33,2* (= 'anoma-
nāmaṁ' (q. v.); cf. Anūna-nāma); — °-buddhi,
/., complete knowledge; Ja VI 297,5 (°-sampanno =
'buddhi-sampanno').

avekkhati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ava + √īkṣ; cf. apek-
khate, with abs. apekkhitvā (/?)], to look down upon;
to consider; ~ati, Dhp 28 (dhīro bale; = passati,
Dhp-a I 259,26(—260,5); It 33,7* (v. l. ap°; = upa-
dhārayati upaparikkhati, It-a); imaṁ lokaṁ ~ati,
AN IV 97,11*; ~ati vipariṇāma-dhamme, AN IV 157,8*
= 159,25*; pajaṁ jātijar[ū/u]petaṁ phandamānaṁ ~ati,
AN IV 290,16*; gijjho . . . kuṇapāni ~ati, Ja II 51,25*
(perceives from above) = III 331,6* (= passati, Ct.);
ubho loke ~ati, Ja III 35,15* — 399,19* (= oloketi,
Ct.); kāmaguṇe ~ati aniccato, etc., Ja V 148,22* ( =
do.), cf. avecca passati below; — part. m. acc. ~antaṁ
(lokaṁ), Sn 1118—19 = Ap 488,2-5 ≠ Dhp 170; part,
f. ~antī, Thī 84; — imper. 2 sg. med. ~assu, Sn 1119
= Ap 488,3 (suññato lokaṁ); janatam apetasoko
~assu [prob. ˇ - ˇ - ] jāti-jarâbhibhūtaṁ, Vin I 6,1*
= DN II 39,14* (= upadhāraya upaparikkha, Sv) =
MN I 168,34* (= do. Ps) = SN I 137,30* (= do. Spk),
cf. It 33,7* (above); — pot. 3 sg. attano va ~eyya katāni
akatāni ca, Dhp 50 (Dhp-a I 379,20); khandhe ~eyya,
SN III 143,8*; Ja IV 6,1'(= 'samekkhe'); — aor. 3 sg.
~i, Ja VI 313,28* v.r. (Ct.: 'sāmaggi-pekkhī' — sāmag-
giṁ pekkhamāno, 'sāmaṁ avekkhī' ti pipāṭho); —
abs. (a ) ~iyāna, Ja III 441,14* (= avekkhitvā, Ct.);
(β) ~iya, Ja III 441,20*; V 116,25*; Mhv V 195; (γ)
~itvā, Ja IV 5,31' (an-°); Ja V 118,10' (attano dha-
naṁ); — pp. ~ita, mfn., in the cpd. avekkhitâcāra,
mfn., Vin I 359,1* (~o susaṁvutindriyo, "who watches
over his behaviour"", Trsl.; Sp: apekkhitâcāro, ālokite
vilokite sampajānakārī [DN I 70,27] ti ādinā nayena
upaparikkhitâcāro).

[avekkhipantī, part, f., perh. for *avakkhirantī,
scraping with the feet, Ja IV 251,24*, cf. Pāṇ VI 1,142:
apaskirate, sa. apa + ḷ/(s)kṙ; Ct.: pacchimapāde
khipantī].

a-vegāyitvā, abs. [neg. denom, from vega], with
no haste; aturitvā+, Ja I 136,22' (Ee avegā hitvā).

avecca, ind. [abs. of ava-√i, see aveti; Buddh.sa.
avetya, Jāt-m 210,25 and Av-ç II 99 note 5; Wogi-
hara, Asanga's Bodhisattvabhūmi (1908) p. 19; cf.
also Geiger SN Trsl. II 99 note 4, with reference to
avecca-ppasāda, q. v.], having understood or penetrated;
Khp VI 8 β Sn 229 (yo ariya-saccāni ~ passati; =
paññāya ajjhogahetvā passati, Pj); Sn 378 (sabbaṁ
tuvaṁ ñāṇam ~ dhammaṁ pakāsesi; = paṭivijjhitvā,
Pj); DN III 158,21* (sukhumāni atthāni ~ dakkhiti;
= ñatvā passissati, Sv); Vin-vn 1963; Mhv XXX 100
(= pariyogahetvā sallakkhetvā, Mhv-ṭ); — °-ppa-
sanna, mfn. [sa. °-prasanna], possessed of the avecca-
ppasāda, q. v. (in : loc); m. Sāriputte ~o ahosi, MN
III 263,7; n. gen. buddha-sāsane ~assa kulassa dhītā,
Dhp-a I 405,3; m. pl. ~ā (mayi), AN V 120,13 (= acala-
ppasādena sampannā, Mp), quoted Paṭis I 161,26; gen.
pl. m. & f. ~ānaṁ, AN I 26,13, 24 (= acalena pasādena
samannāgatānaṁ, Mp I 396,20, 455,13); — °-ppasāda,
m. (cf. prec), 'serenity' founded in knowledge, intelli-
gent faith (in: loc); m. tassā (scil. saddhāya) ~o pa-
daṭṭhānaṁ, Nett 28,10; Buddhâdisu ~o yeva araṇïyato
'attho', Ps I 173,22; instr. Buddhe ~ena samannā-
gato, DN II 93,27 (Sv (II) 544,22: Buddha-guṇānaṁ
yathā-bhūtato ñātattā acalena accutena ~ena; pt:
'avecca' yāthāvato jānitvā, tannimitta(ṁ) uppanna-
pasādo '~o', maggâdhigamena uppanna-pasādo); DN
II 217,19-20 (do. Buddhe, Dhamme, Saṁghe); III
227,7; MN I 37,16 (Ps); 46,23 (= acala-ppasādena, Ps);
II 51,16; III 253,31; SN II 69,21(SpkII 74,4: avigatena
[quasi 3a + vi-√i] acalappasādena); IV 271,34 foll.;
V 343,1; 345,10; 405,1 (cf. ib. 381,29 opp. appasā-
dena); AN II 56,9; III 212,15; 332,29 foll; 451,2 foll;
IV 406,22 foll; As 336,15; Ud-a 109,9-10; °-vasena
pasannā, Ps III 451,5 (= 'abhippasannā'); tīsu vat-
thusu °-saṁkhātāya lokuttara-saddhāya, Dhp-a I
76,17 ; — loc. ~e, AN I 222,13; gen. pl. tinnaṁ ~ānaṁ,
Nett 50,24.

a-vecikicchi(n), mfn. [neg. vb. adj. from vicikic-
chati, cf. vecikicchi(n) [ ˇ ˇ - ˇ ], Sn 510; i. q. a-vici-
kiccha], free from mistrust, uncertainty or doubt; m.
a-kaṁkhī ~ī niṭṭhaṁgato saddhamme, AN II 175,32
(cf. ib. 174,28: kaṁkhī vicikicchī), cf. also AN V 149,12 :
a-vicikiccho samāno bhabbo rāgaṁ, etc., pahātuṁ.a-vecikicchin

a-vecikicchi(n), mfn. [neg. vb. adj. from vicikic-
chati, cf. vecikicchi(n) [ ˇ ˇ - ˇ ], Sn 510; i. q. a-vici-
kiccha], free from mistrust, uncertainty or doubt; m.
a-kaṁkhī ~ī niṭṭhaṁgato saddhamme, AN II 175,32
(cf. ib. 174,28: kaṁkhī vicikicchī), cf. also AN V 149,12 :
a-vicikiccho samāno bhabbo rāgaṁ, etc., pahātuṁ.a-vecikicchin

aveti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. avaiti, ava-√i]; i. q. ava-
gacchati, to go down (into), to know, to understand; yo
'veti, AN I 165,29* (Mp: yo ~eti avagacchati, 'yo vedī'

and, accordingly, 'uncaused' as well as 'unproductive',
said of nirvana [magga, paṭicca-samuppāda, ākāsa],
in contradistinction from other dharmas or dhātus);
n. sg. (subst. — nibbāna); Abh 7; Sadd 70,15*; Abhidh-
av 79,9; Nett 55,6*; ~añ ca desissāmi ~a-gāmiñ ca
maggaṁ, SN IV 359,8—368,8 (= a-kataṁ, Spk);
tīṇi ~assa ~a-lakkhaṇāni . . .: na uppādo paññā-
yati, na vayo p., na ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ p., AN I
152,11-14 (Mp II 252,2-23); atthi a-jātaṁ a-bhūtaṁ
a-kataṁ ~aṁ, It 37,6-10 (It-a I 161,18—163,25) = Ud
80,23 (Ud-a 395,6—397,7); katame dhammā sacchi-
kātabbā: yaṁ ~aṁ, Nett 20,17 (Nett-a Ce reads: yā
~ā dhātu); discussion about saṁkhata and "~a (nib-
bāna : niyāma... ākāsa), Kv 317,2—330,7 (Kv-a 89,1—
92,25); Tikap-a 356,9 (ad Dukap 190,9); PsIII 143,10;
Ud-a 144,26—145,4; ~aṁ nibbānaṁ: āma ~aṁ n.
na kehici kataṁ, n. na vattabbaṁ 'uppannan' ti vā
..., Mil 270,6 (—271,6); — padaṁ ~aṁ, It 39,3*;
Pv 477, cf. Ja V 454,10*; a-jarâmaraṁ santi-puraṁ
(so, metr., Ce) gamissāmi ~aṁ, Ap 584,24; ~aṁ ṭhā-
naṁ, Spk I 256,11; — m., tīṇi saccāni saṁkhatāni
nirodha-dhammāni . . ., nirodho ~o, Nett 14,24, cf.
nirodhassa asaṁkhaf-aṭṭho, Paṭis I 118,22, quoted
Vism 494,19, Ud-a 135,17; ~ā dhammā, Dhs p. 2,34
(As 47,29: paccayehi samāgantvā katā ti 'saṁkhatā',
na saṁkhatā ti '~ā'; It-a I 163,24; Ud-a 395,8 foll.);
Dhs 1086 (= yo so dhammo a-ppaccayo, cf. ib. 1084;
as to the plural see As 368,11-15, It-a II 106,24, Sadd
18,17); 1439 (= nibbānaṁ); yāvatā dhammā saṁ-
khatā vā ~ā vā, AN II 34,23 = It 88,4 (Mp III 74,11),
quoted Vism 293,7(12'), Ud-a 287,24; Pp-a 175,6; saṁ-
khatâsaṁkhatehi, Nett 191,18; Dhammam ~am appa-
ṭikūlaṁ, Vv 616 (Vv-a 232,10), quoted Sv I 230,4*,
etc.; — f. ~ā dhātu = nibbāna, Abh 9; ~ā dhātu
disā ca, Sadd 70,20*; saṁkhatā ca dhātu ~ā ca
dhātu, MN III 63,13 (Ps); ~ā dhātu, Dhs 583 (As
297,7-10); 992; 1084; 1165; As 368,11; ~ā dhātu
amatato santato khemato ca daṭṭhabbā, Vism 489,33;
vipassanā-cittaṁ . . . ~āya amatāya dhātuyā upa-
saṁharati, Ps III 146,20; na sakkoti garukaṁ ...
mahatiṁ ~aṁ nibbāna-dhātuṁ paṭivijjhituṁ . . . ~ā
nibbāna-dhātu dīghā āyatā . . . vipulā mahantā, Mil
311,12—312,(2(-)6); — °-gāmi(n), mfn., leading to a°
(nibbāna), SN IV 359,8 foll; — °-tta, n. abstr., Mil
270,5; — °-pa'ññatti, f., expression for a°; Pp-a
(174,28) 175,6-7; — °-samyutta, n., title of SN IV
359—373; lokuttar'-attha-dīpakā ~âdayo, Spk III
291,9 (ad SN V 407,18 'lokuttarā'); — °-ârammaṇa,
mfn., having a° for its object; Nett 127,17.

a-saṁkharāna, mfn. [neg. part, med., see Geiger
§ 192, bhikkhayāna, Ap 115,7, prob, ghasāna, Vin II
201,25* (metr.)], contracting no abhisaṁkhāra (2);
suvimuttacitto ~o [Ee a-saṁkhār°I] satimā an-oko,
SN I 126,2 G* (= tayo kammâbhisaṁkhāre anabḥi-
saṁkharonto, Spk) ≠ Mvu III 284,9* (cod. B: smṛti-
mān akopyo tapureptkamāno, cf. apurekkharāno,
Sn 844).

a-saṁkhya, mfn., (1) innumerable; a-parimita-
m-asaṁkhya-m-appameyy'-aṭṭhena, Mil 355,12 (v. ll.
asaṁkhyāta-m, asaṁkheyyaṁ); (2) with no distinc-
tion of number, n. = an indeclinable (avyaya); Mogg
III 2,52 (cf. next), m., id. Sadd 299,17.

a-saṁkhāta, mfn. [neg. pp. of saṁkh(y)āti],
not considered, not taken into account; yesaṁ etaṁ
~aṁ, Ja IV 4,28* (= a-vīmaṁsitaṁ, Ct.).

a-saṁkhāra, mfn. [sa. a + saṁskāra], (1) devoid
of the (skandha) saṁskāra; ayaṁ so a-rūpī a-vedano
a-saññī ~o a-viññāṇo tathāgato ti samanupassasi,
SN III 112,2; (2) said of a certain citta ("automatic or
unprompted consciousness"), Vism 452,33 foll.; As 71,4;
Abhidhis 24,28*-29* (Sadd 340,3; 595,13); ~ena, Pp
17,9 (Pp-a 199,11); — °-parinibbāyi(n), mfn. [Bu.
sa. anabhisaṁskāra-parinirvāyin, "qui obtient le Nir-
vana sans effort", Abhidh-k-vv-Trsl. VI (210,14) 211,16
foll.], the third in rank among the anāgāmi(n)s; AN IV
72,12-23 ≠ Pp 17,6-11 (Pp-a: 'a-saṁkhārena' appa-
dukkhena adhimatta-ppayogaṁ akatvā va . . . '~ī');
AN IV 380,11 (Nett 190,1); AN I 233,32; V 120,21;
SN V 201,17; DN III 237,22; — °-bhāva, m. abstr.
(a-saṁkhāra (2j), As 71,4.

a-saṁkhārika, a-saṁkhāriya, mfn., i. q. a-saṁ-
khāra (2); Pj I 37,22; Nāmar-s 3,15-20; 4,17-21; 16,4;
Abhidh-s 1,11-18; 9,22; As 71,1.

a-saṁkhubbha, mfn. [neg. grd. of sam +
√ksubh], imperturbable; anil'-anjaso v' asaṁkhubbho
(v.'I. a-saṁkhobho), Ap 113,26 = Th-a Ce 494,17*
(doubtful readings; a-kkhobbha otherwise epith. of
sāgara!).

a-saṁkheyya, mfn. [sa. a-saṁkhyeya, neg. grd.;
cf. asaṁkh(iy)a], innumerable; ~o a-ppameyyo mahā
puñña-kkhandho (resp. udaka-kkhandho), SN V
400,6-17; ~ā a-ppameyyā dakkhiṇā, MN III 255,20;
Bhagavā a-samo . . . a-tulo ~o a-ppameyyo a-pari-
meyyo, Mil 331,24; ~ā a-parimeyyā manussā, Pv-a
212,7; channam pi cittānaṁ gaṇanaṁ atikkamitvā
~ena guṇena parisuddhaṁ . . ., Mil 106,8; — saṁ-
vacchare ~e (acc. pl.), Ja V 266,26* (= gaṇetuṁ
a-sakkuṇeyye, Ct.); aparimita-m-asaṁkheyya-kap-
paṁ upādāya, Mil 264,22 ≠ (loc. sg. or acc. pl.) Mil
362,11; — n. (with acc. pl. ~e or ~āni), a high number;
Kacc-v 397(Sadd 801,29; 802,16*; ib. 304,1), Abh 476;
cattāri kappassa ~āni, AN II 142,15-28 (Vism 414,8
—422,9); —- sata-sahassaṁ kappānaṁ caturo ca ~e
kappe Bodhisatto catunnaṁ yeva ariyasaccānaṁ
abhisamayaṁ anvesi, Mil 289,21; catuhi ca ~ehi
kappānaṁ kappa-sata-sahassena ca etth' antare, Mil
232,8—233,16 (cf. Cp I 1,1 s. v. a-saṁkhiya); ... ca-
tunnaṁ ~ānaṁ matthake, Ja I 2,32 = Dhp-a I 83,10
≠ (gen. sg.) 104,25; Ps II 346,13; Dhp-a I 5,12;
Ud-a 134,2; 211,14; Ps II 24,30, etc.

a-saṁkhobha, mfn., v. l. for a-saṁkhubbha, Ap
113,26.

a-saṁganta(r), m. [neg. nom. ag. of sam +
√gam], who does not pay (frequent) visits; gen. sg.
mettï ~u a-saṁvāsena jīrati, Ja V 208,8* (= a-sam-
āgacchantassa, Ct.).a-saṁgantar

a-saṁganta(r), m. [neg. nom. ag. of sam +
√gam], who does not pay (frequent) visits; gen. sg.
mettï ~u a-saṁvāsena jīrati, Ja V 208,8* (= a-sam-
āgacchantassa, Ct.).a-saṁgantar

a-saṁgāhanā, f. [neg. vb. noun of sam +
√gāh], non-entering (into), incomprehension; aññāṇaṁ
. . . ~ā a-pariyogāhanā, Dhs 390; 1061; 1162;'Pp
21,20; Nidd I 413,24 (Ee °gāhatāl; Nidd-a: rūpâdisu
ekadhammam pi aniccâdi-sāmaññato na gaṇhātī(I)
ti ~ā).

a-saṁghaṭṭa, mfn., not hurting, not offending;
a-kkodhano ~o, Ja VI 295,22* (= paraṁ a-saṁ-
ghaṭṭento, Ct.).

a-saṁyama, m., want of self-control, merciless-
ness (opp. pāṇesu saṁyamo, f. inst. SN I 21,25*); SN
I 43,19*; virama pāṇa-vadhaṁ ~aṁ, Pv 472 (= a-saṁ-
varaṁ dussīlyaṁ, Pv-a).

a-saṁyutta, mfn. [neg. pp. of sam-√yuj], un-
connected, incompatible; migī pakkhī (a quadruped
and a bird) ~ā, Ja III 265,26* (= jayampatikā
bhavituṁ ayuttā, a-sambaddhā [CkBdEe a-samban-
dhā vā], Ct.); taṁ vivāhaṁ ~aṁ kathaṁ amhe karo-
mase, Ja VI 163,26* (= tiracchānehi saddhiṁ saṁ-
saggaṁ an-anucchavikaṁ, Ct.).

a-saṁyoga, m., non-attachment; a-sārāgāya san-
tike ~āya s. . . . an-upādānāya s., MN I 411,24 (see
2an-upādāna; cf. Ps III 123,18: 'saṁyogāyā' ti . . .
saṁyojanatthāya) = 498,28.

a-saṁyog'-anta, mfn., not followed by a con-
sonant-group (said of a vowel); Kacc 402 (Sadd 806,9);
485 (Sadd 829,29).

a-saṁyojaniya, mfn., "unfavourable to the Fet-
ters", As-Trsl; ~ā dhammā, Dhs p. 3,17-25 (see As
48,36—49,1); 1126; 1463.

a-saṁlitta, mfn., [neg. pp. of sam-√lip], not stick-
ing or adhering; a-litto ~o an-upalitto, Nidd I 55,24
(Nidd-a: visesena na kilissati, maṇi-ratane palive-
ṭhita-kāsikavatthaṁ viya); 90,21.

a-saṁvaṭṭana, n., non-dissolution, non-destruc-
tion (of the elements: earth, ether, etc.; cf. saṁvaṭṭa :
vivaṭṭa, see Abh-k-vy-Trsl. Ill 181 foll.); paṭhaviyā
saṁvaṭṭanaṁ vā ~aṁ vā tatvato ñatvā, Ja III 77,3.

a-saṁvattanika, mfn., not leading (to: dat.);
As 396,28 (ad Dhs 1343); nom. pl. m. nibban'-atthaya
~ā, Spk III 152,5 (Ee asaṁvattikā; — 'a-nibbāna-
saṁvattanikā').

a-saṁvara, m. [see a-saṁvuta], non-shutting
(a door, one of the 'sense doors'), non-restraint; uddhac-
caṁ ~o pamādo, AN III 449,8-12 (= an-adhivāsaka-
bhāva, Mp); uddhaccaṁ pahātuṁ, ~aṁ p., dussīlyam
p., AN V 146,2-6; saṁvaro ca ~o ca veditabbo, SN
IV 189,17-29—(190,7); vācasikena ~ena samannāgato,
Pv-a 11,1 (= 'vācā . . . a-saññato'); ~assa a-vaṇṇaṁ
nindaṁ garahaṁ bhāsitvā, Sp I 221,30 (= 'kosajjassa
a-vaṇṇaṁ')—222,9-25; ~aṁ dussīlyam, Pv-a 206,16
(= 'a-saṁyamaṁ'); — channaṁ indriyānaṁ a-gutti
a-gopanā an-ārakkho ~o, Dhs 1345 (= a-thakanaṁ
a-pidahanaṁ, As 401,20); five or eight a-saṁvaras, As
95,34—96,13 (below "ifc"), cf. Dhp-a IV 86,8 foll.; saṁ-
varo: ~o, As 400,23—401,7; Sp I 21,20, etc. (see, ifc,
saṁvarâs°); — ~e sati dvāram pi a-guttaṁ hoti, As
401,14—402,10; — ifc. v. cakkhu-a°, sota-ghāna-
jivhā-pasādakāya-copanakāya-a°, vācā-a°, ma-
no-a° (As 95,34 foll.), samvarâsamvara-kathā, f.
(ɔ: the essence of Vinaya, Sp I 21,20—22,7 (Sp-t) =
Sv I 19,15-28(30)).

a-saṁvara-dvāra, n., see As 95,34 (above);
aṭṭha ~āni, Dhp-a IV 86,10.

a-saṁvarâbhirata, mfn., with no inclination
towards 'restraint'; ye paṭikkhipanâdhippāyā ~ā, Sp
I 223,5 (opp. ye sikkhā-kāmā saṁvare ṭhitā).

1a-saṁvāsa, m. [cf. 1a-sambhoga], no (or too
little) being together; mettī . . . ~ena jīrati, Ja V 208,8*
(= a-samāgamana-saṁkhātena ~ena, Ct.); exclusion
from (monastic) society: ~o bhikkhūhi [ca] bhikkhu-
nīhi ca ḷ sambhogo ekacco tahiṁ na labbhati, Vin
V 216,2* (Sp: '~o' ti uposatha-pavāraṇâdinā saṁ-
vāsena ~o, 'sambhogo . . . °bbhatī' ti akappiya-sam-
bhogo na labbhati, nahāpana-bhojanâdi-paṭijagga-
naṁ pana mātarā yeva kātuṁ labbhati).

a-saṁvāsiya, mfn. [from 1a-saṁvāsa], who can-
not live together (with: instr.), not liking the company
(of); — °-tta, n. abstr.; abl. pāpehi ~ā jina-sāsa-
nassa, Mil 250,27; — °-bhāva, m., abstr., ib. 249,27;
250,18-28 (cf. Vin II 237,2-3: 27-30).

a-saṁvidita, mfn., i. q. a-ppatisaṁvidita (b),
Vin-vn 1863—1867 (see Vin IV 182,15**, 183,14'-22',
Sp (IV) 887,32 foll.).

a-saṁvinda(t), mfn., [neg. part, of saṁvindati],
not finding, not feeling; nom. sg. m., mamattam . . .
~aṁ, Th 717 (= a-labhanto a-karonto, Th-a) ≠ Sn
951 (Nidd).a-saṁvindat

a-saṁvinda(t), mfn., [neg. part, of saṁvindati],
not finding, not feeling; nom. sg. m., mamattam . . .
~aṁ, Th 717 (= a-labhanto a-karonto, Th-a) ≠ Sn
951 (Nidd).a-saṁvindat

a-saṁvibhāgi(n), mfn. [neg. vb. adj. from saṁ-
vibhajati; cf. saṁvibhāgi(n), Ja IV 110,19*, Mil
207,15], not generous, miserly; na câpi ekâsanam
ariya-pūjitaṁ, ~ī ca sukhaṁ navindati, Ja V 397,23*
≠ Mvu II 56,6*.a-saṁvibhāgin

a-saṁvibhāgi(n), mfn. [neg. vb. adj. from saṁ-
vibhajati; cf. saṁvibhāgi(n), Ja IV 110,19*, Mil
207,15], not generous, miserly; na câpi ekâsanam
ariya-pūjitaṁ, ~ī ca sukhaṁ navindati, Ja V 397,23*
≠ Mvu II 56,6*.a-saṁvibhāgin

a-saṁvihita, mfn. [neg. pp. of sam-vi-√dhā],
(a) not prepared (in cpd.s), (b; active sense) who has
not taken due measures (as reporting himself, and the
like); te ce bhikkhū . . . ~ā taṁ āvāsaṁ āgacchanti,
Vin I 175,27 (b; ā-gamana-jānanatthāya a-kata-saṁ-
vidahanā, a-viññātā va hutvā, Sp); — °-kammanta,
mfn., whose acts and affairs are not in order; (opp. su-
saṁvihita-k°), Ja V 100,11* = VI 361,28*; — °-sākhā-
parivāra, mfn., where no hedge has been provided
for; ~aṁ sassaṁ, Vism 37,3 (cf. ib. 15).

a-saṁvuta, mfn. [sa. a + samvṛta], (1) not
closed; Mp I 54,21; with no material limits, said of
the intermundia; lokantarikā aghā (q. v.) ~ā andha-
kārā . . ., DN II 12,11 (= heṭṭhā pi a-ppatiṭṭhā, Sv;
pt: '~ā' ti heṭṭhā upari ca kenaci na pihitā, tena
vuttaṁ "heṭṭh°" ti; cf. Sv ib.: 'aghā' ti nicca-vivatā)
= MN III 120,9 (Ps) = SN V 454,17 = AN II 130,27
(Mp); (2) not controlled, not guarded (said of persons
or their sense organs, 'sense-doors'); SN IV 70, 26*;
m. pl. pākatā ~ā a-hirikā . . ., Mil 251,13; nom. sg.
n. cittaṁ: a-dantaṁ, a-guttaṁ, a-rakkhitaṁ, ~aṁ,
AN I 7,18-29 (Mp I 54,21) ≠ cakkhuṁ phassāyata-
naṁ (etc.): SN IV 70,4-12; cakkhundriyaṁ ~aṁ vi-
harantaṁ, Dhs 1345 (= a-pihita-cakkhu-dvāraṁ, As
400,16); 1347; Pp 20,27, etc. (see anvāssavati); — ifc.
v. cakkhundriya-saṁvara-a° (AN III 387,31).

a-saṁsagga, m. [sa. a+ saṁsarga; cf. next],
not mingling together, keeping aloof, isolation; saṁ-
saggā vanatho jāto ~ena chijjati, SN II 158,26* (Spk
II 142,2) = It 70,22*; a-saṁsattho ~assa vanna-vādī,
MN I 214,9 = SN II 202,22; 209,1-32; 'a-lobho' an-
abhissaṅgo a-pariggaha-lakkhaṇo mutta-ppavattana-
raso ~o ti gayhati, Nāmar-p 91; — °-kathā, f., conver-
sation about (or favourable to) a°; appiccha-kathā+,
Nidd I 220,29 (Nidd-a I 332,5-31) ≠ Mil 344,30; AN
IV 352,10. — °ârāma-tā, f. abstr., liking for a°; AN
IV 331,25.

a-saṁsaṭṭha, mfn. [sa. a + saṁsṛṣṭa], not
mingling with (instr, or loc), keeping aloof (neg. com-
plement to pavivitta); ~aṁ gahaṭṭhehi, Sn 628 (Pj) =
Dhp 404 (Dhp-a); a-saṅga-citto nikleso ~o kule gaṇe,
Ap 390,13 = Th-a Ce 506,34*; pavivitto ~o, Vism
73,25*; — appiccho c'eva santuṭṭho pavivitto vase
muni ~o gahaṭṭhehi, Th 581 (Th-a = Dhp-a IV
173,19'); appiccho santuttho, pavivitto ~o, SN I
63,29 (Spk I 123,4-10); Mil 244,11 ; Ps III 20,25; Ud-a
225,28; ~o a-saṁsaggassa (q. v.) vaṇṇa-vādī, MN I
214,9, etc.

a-saṁsappa, m. [neg. verb, noun from saṁ-
sappati, cf. Sv (III) 826,28], non-hesitation; 'adhi-
mokkho' ~o susanniṭṭhāna-lakkhaṇo, Nāmar-p 83.

a-saṁsaya, mfn. [sa. a + saṁçaya], (1) having
no doubt; gen. ~assa, MN I 386,9* (scil. Bhagavato;
"by doubts untroubled"), quoted Sp-ṭ ad Sp I 251,6;
f. ~ā bahujana-pūjitā ahaṁ, Vv 146 (= soḷasa-
vatthukāya aṭṭha-vatthukāya ca vicikicchāya pahi-
nattā apagata-saṁsayā; 'asaṁsiyā' [o: āsaṁsiyā?] ti
keci paṭhanti, Vv-a); (2) undoubted, certain; n. subst,
loc. ~e, Sadd 559,7 (scil. √car); acc. ~aṁ, adv. (synon.
dhuvaṁ, avassaṁ); ~ jāti-khay'-anta-dassī na gab-
bha-seyyaṁ punar āvajissaṁ, Ja III 434,1*; ~ so
nirayaṁ pareti, Ja IV 47,26*(—48,2*); pallatthito (so
Bds) bālo ~ so, Ja V 78,4*; 120,29*; 345,13*; VI
195,20*; Mil 209,11; Ja I 56,17.

a-saṁhārima, mfn. (see saṁhārimaṁ, Vism
124,4 = saṁharitabbaṁ, gahetvā caraṇa-yoggaṁ,
mhṭ; cf. a-sañcārima), not movable; loc. anāpatti. . .
~e (scil. āsane?), Vin IV 272,35'; ~e phalake vā
pāsāṇe vā, Sp (IV) 845,10 (= thāma-majjhimena pu-
risena a-saṁhāriye, Vmv) ≠ Vin-vn 1427.

a-saṁhāriya, mfn. [neg. grd. of sam-√hṛ],
immovable (complement to daḷha); imperturbable;
(Tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā) mūla-jātā patiṭṭhitā,
daḷhā ~ā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā . . ., DN III
84,19 (= sunikhāta-indakhïlo viya kenaci cāletuṁ
a-sakkuṇeyyā, Sv); SN V 219,2; It 77,11 (≠ 78,1*);
MN I 320,19 ( = harituṁ na sakkā, Ps); ~o nāma
sa [Ee ca] hotipaṇḍito, Th 372c (≃ - ˇ - ɔ: ahāriyo?
see 370—71, 373—74; — kilesehi deva-mārâdisu
kenaci a-saṁhāriyatāya ~o nāma hoti, Th-a); aññehi
~aṁ katvā, Dhp-a I 278,2 (= no-hæriya-hæki koṭæ,
gp); Vmv ad Sp (IV) 845,10 (explaining 'a-saṁhāri-
ma'); Sp (V) 1085,19 (— 'a-samkamanīya'); Pj II
607,13 ( — 'a-saṁhīra') ≠ Spk I 279,19.

a-saṁhīra, mfn. [neg. grd. of sam-√hṛ; cf. pr.
pass, (pari)hīrati (Pischel § 537) against sa. hr-iyate,
and kiriyā against sa. kr-iyā, kr-iyate] = prec, (com-
plement to [daḷha and] ṭhita); yāva-jīvaṁ ~ā (scil. sad-
dhā), It 78,1* (≠ 76,11) ≠ Ap 194,22 = 262,7; vinaye
ṭhito hoti ~o, AN IV 141,11 (= vinaya-lakkhaṇe
patiṭṭhito . . . na sakkā gahita-gahaṇam vissajjāpe-
tuṁ, Mp) ≠V 71,23 ≠ vinaye cheko [so Ee, no Ct.] hoti
~o, Vin II 96,1; tasmiṁ te amate akkhāte | dhamma-
(d)dasā ṭhitā ~ā, SN I 193,19* (= a-saṁhāriyā hutvā
patiṭṭhitā, Spk) = Th 1243; — mettaṁ cittañ ca
bhāvemi . . . ~aṁ a-saṁkuppaṁ cittaṁ āmodayām'
ahaṁ, Th 649 (Th-a: '~aṁ' . . . āsanna-paccatthikena
rāgena an-ākadḍhanīyaṁ, 'a-saṁkuppam' . . . dūra-
paccatthikena vyāpādena a-kopanīyaṁ); ~aṁ a-saṁ-
kuppaṁ, Sn 1149 (Nidd II 100,14; Pj: dvīhi pi padehi
nibbānam bhaṇati); ~am a-saṁkuppaṁ, MN III
187,26* (scil. vipassanaṁ or nibbānam, Ps (V) 2,1-6)
— Ap 506,4; — °-citta, mfn., id. (said of persons);
Ja IV 283,8-10.

a-saka, mfn. [sa. a + svaka; see *a-sa, etc.],
not belonging to one's self; a-sak'-aṭṭhena 'parato'
(te dhamme samanupassati), Ps III 146,8 = Mp ad
AN IV 422,26.

a-sakka, mfn. [sa. a-çakya, cf. a-sakya, a-sakku-
ṇeyya], impossible; manussehi pi kātuṁ ~a-rūpaṁ
karoti, Ja V 362,17 (Bds a-sakkuṇeyyaṁ evarūpaṁ).

a-sakkaccaṁ, ind. [opp. sakkaccaṁ, sa. satkṛtya
abs. of sat-√kṛ], carelessly, unconsiderately; (sīho miga-
rājā) hatthissa ce pi pahāraṁ deti, sakkaccaṁ yeva p.
d. no ~, . . . bhikkhūnaṁ ce pi Tathāgato dhammam
deseti, sakkaccaṁ yeva T. dh. d. no ~, AN III 121,26
—122,18 (Mp: an-avaññāya a-virajjhitvā va deti, no
avaññāya virajjhitvā, scil. sīho); sakkaccaṁ yeva
(scil. bhikkhuṁ) payirupāsāmi no ~ ... s. y. (scil.
dhammaṁ) suṇāmi no ~, AN IV 215,2-4; yo anāda-
riyaṁ paṭicca ~ piṇḍapātam paṭigaṇhāti, Vin IV
190,6'; — ~ deti, acitti-katvā d., a-sahatthā d.,
apaviddhaṁ d., anāgamana-diṭṭhiko d., AN III 171,30
(= na sakkaritvā a-suciṁ katvā, Mp; Mp-ṭ); DN II
356,1 (= saddhā-virahitaṁ a-saddhā-dānaṁ, Sv);
MN III 22,19 ( = deyya-dhammam pi puggalam pi
na sakkaroti . . ., Ps IV 80,25—81,5); dentu yeva me
mā a-daṁsu . . . sakkaccaṁ yeva me dentu mā ~,
SN II 200,20.

asakkacca-kari(n), mfn., acting inconsiderately;
nom. sg. m. na samādhissa samāpatti-kusalo hoti . . .
~ī ca hoti a-sātacca-kārī ca a-sappāya-kārī ca, AN
III 427,27 (ib. 427,5).asakkacca-karin

asakkacca-kari(n), mfn., acting inconsiderately;
nom. sg. m. na samādhissa samāpatti-kusalo hoti . . .
~ī ca hoti a-sātacca-kārī ca a-sappāya-kārī ca, AN
III 427,27 (ib. 427,5).asakkacca-karin

asakkaccakiriyatā, f. abstr., want of careful
behaviour; kusalānaṁ dhammānaṁ bhāvanāya ~ā
a-sātaccakiriyatā . . . an-anuyogo pamādo, Vibh
350,24 (Vibh-a 468,19), quoted Pj I 143,20.

asakkacca-dāna, n., "careless giving", As 412,4
(mṭ; see Ps IV 80,25 foll.).

a-sakkata, mfn. [sa. a + sat-kṛta], not con-
sidered, not honoured (by: instr, or gen. [cf. rājñāṁ pū-
jitaḥ, Kāç II 3,67], and this replaced by dat.); nom.pl.
m. ~ā c'amha (c'asma) Dhanañjayāya, Ja III 98,10*
(Ct.: karaṇatthe sampadānaṁ, Dhanañjayena ~ā;
Sadd 133,10-18, 699,25—700,22, 737,32); Ja IV 103,30'
(= 'a-sammānitā'); —aññatitthiyā paribbājakā ~ā
honti a-garu-katā a-mānitā a-pūjitā, na apacitā
(q. v.) ..., SN II 119,26 = Ud 12,13 = 72,30.

a-sakkariyamāna, mfn. [neg. part. pass, of sak-
karoti 'to honour']; Vin I 353,34 (see a-sakkāra-pakata).

a-sakkāra, m., the not being honoured; yassa
sakkariyamānassa ~ena c[ū/u]bhayaṁ ḷ samādhi na
vikampati, SN II 232,18* — It 74,23* = Th 1011; —
°-pakata, mfn., under the influence of a°; evaṁ ime
amhehi a-sakkariyamānā a-garukariyamānā a-mā-
niyamānā a-pūjiyamānā ~ā pakkamissanti . . ., Vin
I 353,35 ≠ II 23,12.

a-sakkuṇeyya, mfn. [neg. ger. from the present
stem of sakk(uṇ)oti, sakkuṇāti, cf. apacineyya], im-
possible; bodhetum ~o, Ja I 55,3; II 326,17; daṭṭhuṁ
~e haday'-abbhantare, Ja III 41,11; netuṁ ~o, Ja
IV 242,9' (= 'dunnayo'); V 272,25'; 362,17 (v. l.);
367,9'; 437,22'; VI 171,23'; Pj I 185,27; Mhv XXIII
57; Anāg-a ad Anāg 67; Sadd 91,12; abl. (abstr.), ma-
tassa jīvāpetuṁ ~ato, Ja III 167,20; see asakka,
asakya; — °-tā, f. abstr., Pj II 35,7; Ud-a 210,3; Ja
I 204,5'; 'an-oṇami(ta)daṇḍa-jāto'ti yāvadatthaṁ
bhojanena oṇamituṁ ~āya an-oṇamana-daṇḍo viya,
Mp-ṭ ad Mp II 12,17; — °-tta, n. abstr., Sv (II) 537,7
= Ps II 400,32; Sadd 300,4; — °-bhāva, m. abstr.,
Ja IV 228,14.

a-sakkhara, mfn. [3a + sakkharā, sa. çarkarā],
free from gravel (and stone); f. ~ā c'eva mudū subhā
ca . . . bhūmi, Ja V 168,21* (= pāsāṇa-sakkhara-
rahitā, Ct.); ~ā a-pabbhārā . . . nadikā, Ap 15,9 =
Th-a Ce II 95,12* (cf. pokkharaṇī ... a-kakkasā a-pab-
bhārā, Ja V 405,30*); ~o (scil. maggo), Dhp-a III
401,8 (= hakuru næti, gp).

a-sakkhika, mfn. [cf. sakkhi(n); sa. a-sākṣika],
without witnesses; ~aṁ aṭṭ[h]aṁ karonto viya, As
31,10 (mṭ).

a-sakya, mfn., i. q. a-sakka; a-phalo ca ~o ca
vāyāmo, Pj II 7,29-31.

a-sakya-dhītarā, f. [formed on the acc. dhīta-
raṁ; cf. next], no right Buddhist nun; a-ssamaṇī hoti
~ā, Vin IV 214,29' (Ee °dhītā, but see Sadd 141,25-30;
199,23-26; 668,20)—222,1'.

a-sakya-puttiya, m. [from Sakya-putta 'the
Sakyan'], not a true Buddhist monk; (yo methunaṁ
dhammaṁ paṭisevati, etc.) a-ssamaṇo hoti ~o, Vin I
96,26—97,16 (quoted Sās 156,33—157,8); yaṁ nūnâ-
haṁ a-ssamaṇo assaṁ, y. n. ~o assaṁ, Vin III 25,11
foll.; ~o ti mam dhārehi, ib. 27,8 (Sp I 254,14-19);
— °-dhamma, mfn., un-Buddhistic as to doctrine; a-
(s)samana-dhammo, ~o, SN IV 326,31; — °-bhāva, m.
abstr.; ~aṁ patthayamāno, Vin III 25,14; — °-veva-
cana, n., a term equivalent of a°; Vin III 27,24 (viz.
'na sammāsambuddha-putto' etc., Sp).

a-saṅga, mfn. [ts.], not slicking, free from attach-
ment; dharaṇī-r-iva sīlena . . . ~o anilo yathā, Ap
460,2 (cf. a-sajjamāna); bhikkhū . . . ~ā a-tuliya-
guṇā, Mil 343,10; —m., aloofness; pāpâpāpa-bhavâ-
saṅgā (abl.), Jināl 103 (104); — °-cāri(n), mfn.,
moving about without loitering; magakā (so metre and
v. ll.) viy' asaṅgacārino | a-niketā viharanti bhik-
khavo, SN I 199,21*(Spk I 291,27-35)≠Mvu III 421,6*
(mṛgakā va as°); — °-citta, mfn., with an unattached
mind; ~o nikleso, Ap 390,13 = Th-a Ce 506,34*; ~o
sabbattha anilo viya, Ap 508,22 — Th-a Ce 406,5*;
cf. a-saṅga-mānasa.

asaṅga-mānasa, mfn., i. q. asaṅga-citta; Thī
396; Vv 770 (Vv-a 285,3'); kulesu kāmesu ~o, Th
1119 (cf. Ap 390,13).

a-saṅgaha, m. [sa. a + saṅgraha], non-inclu-
sion, non-comprehension (under a head: instr., loc);
saṅgaho ~o saṁgahītena a-saṁgahītaṁ . . ., Dhātuk
1,3 foll. (Dhātuk-a 114,7; 115,3, foll.); tekālikâ-
khyātapade kālâtipattiyā (gen.) ~o va hoti, Sadd
55,3*.

a-saṅgahaka, mfn., incapable of obtaining favour
or sympathy; ~o ājīvika-bhayassa bhāyeyya, AN IV
365,(8(-)17), cf. ib. 364,10-23.

a-saṅgahīta, mfn., (1) not included, Dhātuk 1,3,
see a-saṅgaha; (2) not kindly received, not favoured;
Ja V 118,7'.

a-sacca, mfn. [sa. a + satya], false, mendacious;
~assa. . . musā-vādissa luddassa, Ja V 374,7* (= vacī-
sacca-rahitassa, Ct.); acc. f., tan taṁ ~aṁ a-vibhajja-
seviniṁ, Ja V 399,25* (Ct.) ≠ Mvu II 59,10* (†same-
vasanti avijānāmi ɔ: avicārya-sevinīm ?); (Abh
1176?).

a-sacchi-kata, mfn. [neg. pp. of sacchï-karoti,
sa. sākṣāt-k°], not beheld directly, not realized; n'
atthi kiñci Brahmuno a-diṭṭhaṁ, a-viditaṁ, ~aṁ,
DN I 222,3; a-ññātam . . . ~aṁ an-abhisametaṁ,
AN IV 384,19; ~e sacchikata-saññino, Vin III 91,7';
abs., paññāya a-sacchi-katvā, Ps II 171,18.

a-sajja(t), mfn. [neg. pait. o/sajjati], not clinging,
unimpeded; a-rajjanto + ~anto, Dhp-a IV 100,10;
a-sajjamāno, mfn. [do. med.], without obstacle;
tiro-kuḍḍaṁ ... ~o gacchati, DN I 78,4 (= a-
laggamāno, Vism 394,18); 212,23 ≠ MN I 494,27;
II 18,12,31; III 98,4; SN II 121,17; 212,21; AN III
280,8; Paṭis II 208,9; vāto va jālamhi ~o, Sn 71 ≠
213; vaṁsa-kaḷīro va ~o, Sn 38 (= a-laggamāno, Pj);
without attachment: ~ā vicaranti loke, Sn 466 (hence
Asajjamānā pl., self-designation of a group of pac-
cekabuddhas, Pj II 75,12); nāma-rūpasmiṁ ~aṁ, Dhp
221 (Dhp-a); without hesitation: thero pucchita-puc-
chitaṁ pañhaṁ ~o va kathesi, Vibh-a 489,25, quoted
Ss 52,4; ~o deti, Ja III 352,19 ("ungrudgingly").a-sajjat

a-sajja(t), mfn. [neg. pait. o/sajjati], not clinging,
unimpeded; a-rajjanto + ~anto, Dhp-a IV 100,10;
a-sajjamāno, mfn. [do. med.], without obstacle;
tiro-kuḍḍaṁ ... ~o gacchati, DN I 78,4 (= a-
laggamāno, Vism 394,18); 212,23 ≠ MN I 494,27;
II 18,12,31; III 98,4; SN II 121,17; 212,21; AN III
280,8; Paṭis II 208,9; vāto va jālamhi ~o, Sn 71 ≠
213; vaṁsa-kaḷīro va ~o, Sn 38 (= a-laggamāno, Pj);
without attachment: ~ā vicaranti loke, Sn 466 (hence
Asajjamānā pl., self-designation of a group of pac-
cekabuddhas, Pj II 75,12); nāma-rūpasmiṁ ~aṁ, Dhp
221 (Dhp-a); without hesitation: thero pucchita-puc-
chitaṁ pañhaṁ ~o va kathesi, Vibh-a 489,25, quoted
Ss 52,4; ~o deti, Ja III 352,19 ("ungrudgingly").a-sajjat

a-sajjita, mfn. [ts.], not prepared, not arranged;
— °iriyāpatha, mfn., = 'a-kappita-iriyāpatha',
Nidd-a I 440,3.

a-sajjhāya-kata, mfn. [neg. pp. of sajjhāyaṁ
karoti (see s. v. a-dinna)], not repeated, not rehearsed;
sajjhāya-katā pi mantā na patibhanti, pag eva ~ā,
SN V 121,15(—126,2).

a-sajjhāya-mala, mfn., being corrupted by
(the purity of which suffers from) non-repetition; nom.
pl. m. ~ā mantā, AN IV 195,15,23* = Dhp 241
(Dhp-a III 347,12')-

1a-sañcaraṇa, n., neg. vb. noun of sañcarati;
mora-rājassa pāde (loc.) pāsassa ~a-kāraṇaṁ, Ja IV
335,26 (the reason why the noose does not find the way
to (fit on) the foot of the peacock; Bid a-bajjhana-k°;
pt (B?) asajjana-kāraṇaṁ; Ja-pot here no-bæïïdenṭa
kāraṇa, but see next).

2a-sañcaraṇa, mfn., vb. adj. (1) = an active part.:
not having access to: satta vassasatāni ~a-pāso, Ja IV
336,10 (that, during 700 years, had been unable to fit
(on his feet); Ja-pot: no hæsuruṇu); pāsassa ~a-bhā-
vaṁ, Ja II 36,26 (cf. 36,14); — (2) like a passive part.:
(of a way) unpracticable: maggaṁ luggaṁ . . . paṭi-
cchannaṁ ~aṁ, Mil 217,30—219,8 (= saṁcaraṇayak
nættā-vū, Hīnaṭ).

a-sañcalita, mfn., unshaken; a-kampitaṁ ~aṁ
. . . pītiṁ paṭilabhi, Mil 224,6.

a-sañcārima, mfn. (cf. a-saṁhārima), not mov-
able; ~ena upakaraṇena (ɔ: traps or pit-falls, opp.
arrows or javelins) māretu-kāmassa, Sp (II) 439,24 ≠
asañcārim'-upāyena māraṇatthaṁ, Vin-vn 247.

1a-sañcicca, ind. [neg. abs. of sam + √ci(n)t, cf.
cecca], unintentionally (see sañcicca, Vin IV 124,20*,29'
≠ JAs 1914, 518,1: saṁcintya); an-āpatti ~ (scil.
pāṇâtipāte), Vin III 79,29-33; do. ~ ajānantassa, Vin
III 126,4' (Vin-vn 351); do. ~ asatiyā a-jānantassa,
IV 185,22' (Sp (IV) 889,27; Vin-vn 1873: a-sañciccâ-
satissā pi ajānantassa kevalaṁ); IV 222,5' (Vin-vn
2007); Kv 593,2-28.

2a-sañcicca, mfn. (occasional abstraction from
prec), without any intention; kiṁ-citto tvaṁ [scil.
did you kill the man]? — asañcicco ahaṁ, Vin III
79,28 (= a-vadhaka-cetano, Sp).

a-sañcetanika, mfn. (1) said of an act: un-
conscious or unintentional; MN I 377,5 (a kind of
kamma-vipāka accord, to the Nigaṇṭha); (2) said of
persons: = 2asañcicca; Dhp-a I 225,11.

a-sañjāta, mfn., not yet born or produced; an-
uppannassa (q. v.) maggassa uppādetā ~assa mag-
gassa sañjanetā, SN I 191,1 (Spk: '~assā' ti idaṁ
'anuppanna'-vevacanam) = MN III 8,12, etc. ≠ ~añ
ca sañjani, Ap 499,11 = 570,6 = Thī-a 91,34*; —
future: ye dhammā a-jātā a-bhūtā ~ā a-nibbattā
(q. v.), Dhs 1036, etc.; rūpaṁ a-jātaṁ . . . ~aṁ, Vibh
1,20; loc. kappe (a)saṁjāte, Anāg 5 (= an-uppanne
a-sampatte, anāgate, Anāg-a); Leumann ajāte = v. l.

a-sañña, mfn.[3a+ saññā, cf. a-saññi(n), vi-sañña,
nis-sañña], (1) senseless; Mātaṅga-paṇḍitaṁ . . . po-
thetvā ~aṁ katvā pakkāmi, Ja IV 376,13 (v. l. visañ-
ñaṁ); Sv (II) 569,23; (2) unconscious: n. (a) the un-
conscious state: saññā rogo . . . sallaṁ, etaṁ santaṁ
(etaṁ) paṇītaṁ yad idaṁ ~aṁ, MN II 230,19; (cf.
1a-saññā); (β) i. q. asañña-bhava; Ja I 45,7*; Ps II
333,16; m. pl., i. q. Asañña-sattā: ~e arūpibrahmāno ca
ṭhapetvā, Dhp-a IV 132,2 (cf. Pj II 359,26); — °-ka,
mfn. = prec. (2), Vibh 419,29; — °-kathā, f., title of
Kv (III 11) 260—263; — °-ka-bhava, m., v. l. for
asañña-bhava; — °-kāya, m., an unconscious 'body'
(ɔ: element; as to kāya, see Sv I 165,27; 167,18-25);
nirindriyaṁ ... ~aṁ ... aggiṁ, Ja VI 207,13* ( =
anindriya-baddhaṁ a-citta-kāyaṁ, Ct.).

asañña- in cpd.s: °-bhava, m., the sphere of the
Asañña-sattas; ~e (v. l. asaññaka-bhave) acittaka-
paṭisandhiṁ, Mp I 310,13; ~e nibbatte a-cittaka-satte
dasseti, Ja I 473,17 (explaining a-saññino), cf. Nidd-a
I 357,9; Ps I 35,30; II 333,31; — °-satta, m. (sg.,
Nidd I 280,5; otherwise) pl. (see a-saññi(n) and cf.
asaṁjñisattva, Abhidh-k-vy-Trsl. II 199 n. 1, III 22,4,
etc.), 'the Unconscious Beings', a class of (brahma-)gods
representing the 5th sattâvāsa; sattā a-saññino a-
ppaṭisaṁvedino seyyathā pi devā~ā, AN IV 401,17 =
DN III 263,19 (quoted Pj I 86,28); ~ā devā a-hetukā
an-āhārā . . . a-saññakā a-cetanakā a-cittakā pātu-
bhavanti, Vibh 419,28, quoted Pj I 77,16 (Vibh-a
520,32—521,8); ~ā nāma devā, saññu〈p〉pādā ca
. . . tamhā kāyā cavanti, DN I 28,25 (Sv I 118,8-24);
~ā devā Vehapphalehi saddhiṁ eka-talā, Ps I 35,31;
a-saññino vuccanti nirodha-samāpannā ye ca ~ā, na
pi so [scil. 'no pi asaññī', etc., Sn 874] nirodha-samā-
panno no pi ~o, Nidd I 280,4-5; ~esu saññā atthi?,
Kv 260,21—263,1 (Kv-a 71,23 foll); Yam I 154,12;
198,29; II 10,1; Pj II 359,26; Th-a Ce 291,9 (cf. Mp
I 310,13); Sadd 77,5 (from Ps I 35,29 foll); — n. (cf.
a-sañña (2), n.), the sphere of the Asañña-sattas; ~aṁ
up(a)pajjantānaṁ tesaṁ rūpakkhandho [Sv I 118,16]
uppajjati... ~e, tattha rūp° upp°, Yam I 19,17 ... 26
foll.; apāye ~e, tattha dukkhasaccaṁ uppajjati, ib.
179,1.

a-saññata, mfn. [cf. sa. saṁyata, sam + √yam],
not held in check, unrestrained (instr.: kāyâdīhi, loc:
kāmesu, dat. (once): para-pāṇa-rodhāya, Sn 220 ( =
pāṇānaṁ jīvif-indriy[ū/u]pacchedāya kāya-vācā-cittehi
~o, Pj)); kāmesu ~ā janā, Sn 243 ≠ 247 ≠ AN
II 6,7* ≠ 19,22*; pāṇesu ~o, MN II 99,31* = Th 867;
kāyena saññato āsiṁ, vācāyâsiṁ ~o, Pv 5 ( =
vācasikena a-saṁvarena samannāgato, Pv-a); sahasā
karontānam ~ānaṁ, Ja II 123,17* = V 91,11* ( =
dussīlānaṁ, Ct.); bhoga-Iuddho ~o, Ja VI 525,32*;
para-hiṁsāya rato ~o, Pv 470; māyāvi ~o palāpo,
Sn 89; bālassa mūḷhassa . . . ~assa, Ja IV 207,6*;
~o, Ja VI 360,7* (= kāyâdīhi ~o dussīlo, Ct.);
~o pabbajito na sādhu, Ja III 105,24*; ~o saññata-
sannikāso, Ja V 87,2* = VI 306,25*; pāpadhammā
~ā . . . bhuñjeyya dussīlo raṭṭha-piṇḍaṁ ~o, Vin III
90,25*... 28* = It 43,4*. . .10* (=90,15*) = Dhp
307—08; f. a-satiṁ ~aṁ, Ja III 530,16*; ac-
cantasīlāsu ~āsu, Ja V 448,18*; majja-maṁsa-niratā
~ā, Ja V 452,13*; uddhatā a-niyatā~ā, ib.n*; in cpd.:
na~a-samaṇassa vuttha-ṭṭhānam etaṁ, Ps III 210,23;
— °-parikkhāra, mfn., not taking heed of (heedless
about) the requisites; ~aṁ bhikkhuṁ, Dhp-a III 15,6
(= no saňgavana pirikara æti, gp; cf. 15,11: parik-
khāro paṭisāmetabbo = hæňgæviyæ yutu, gp); —
°-parikkhāra-bhikkhu-vatthu, n., title of Dhp-a III
15—16; — °-vacana, mfn., heedless in speech; pl. ~ā,
Ps I 152,14 (= 'vikiṇṇa-vācā').

a-saññatti, f., non-information (abstracted from
next); Mp II 149,28; — °-bala, mfn. (3a + saññatti-
bala [AN I 76,9], this = having their force in mutual

asani-sata-sannipātena, Ja I 71,26.asanī

asanīya, mfn., grd. of as(a)nāti; n., -khādanīyaṁ

catthikā, Sv); not exposed to intrusion or encroach-
ments: mettaṁ . . . mānasaṁ bhāvaye . . . uddhaṁ

150 = Khp IX 8 (= vigata-paccatthikaṁ, Pj); said

a-sapatt[ī/i]bhinivesa, (m)f(n)., attached to the

... ~ā, AN III 363,17 (v. l. °ttï-vinivesā; Mp: asa-

a-sapatt[ī/i]bhinivesa, (m)f(n)., attached to the

a-sappatha, m. [sa. a + sat-patha], the wrong
way, ~am an-otaritvā, Sadd 91,13 ≠ 109,2 (so Ce,
see notes ib.).

viṣama (≠visabhāga) 'unequal, irregular' and 'unsui-
table, unwholesome'; Buddh, sa. see below], unwholesome
(as food, etc.); ~āni bhojanāni, MN II 257,5-14; lobha-
niyam pi ~aṁ na sevati, tena a-rogo hoti, As 128,38;
~aṁ, Ja III 86,8' (= 'a-hitaṁ', scil. pipphaliṁ); in a
psychic or moral sense: gārayhaṁ dhammaṁ āpajjiṁ
~aṁ, Vin IV 176,12**; 177,26**; 179,19**; 180,26** (JAs
1913, 525,6 foll.: a-sāmpreyam; note ib. not con-
vincing); yāni sammā nibbānâdhimuttassa ~āni
(= a-vaḍḍml(arāhi ārammaṇāni, Ps) . . . ~aṁ cak-
khunā rūpadassanaṁ [cf. Vism 34,19] ... ~aṁ manasā
dhammaṁ, MN II 256,16 foll.; seven things (āvāsa,
etc.) to be avoided, when a-sappāya: Vism 127,3*—
128,13; 613,22; sappāyâsappāyaṁ, AN III 144,17;
Ps IV 54,18; — °-kāri(n), mfn., not acting in ac-
cordance with (the rules of) hygiene; Vin I 302,30 =
AN III 143,23; 145,5; 427,6-28; — °-kiriyā, f., an
unhygienic life or treatment; AN V 136,7; MN II
257,22; — °-tā, f.abstr.; Vism (118,28) 121,20-27.

a-sappurisa, m. [sa. a + sat-puruṣa], a mean
fellow, an unworthy person; jāneyya . . . ~o ~aṁ, MN
III 21,4—22,28; idha ~o uccā kulā pabbajito hoti, etc.,
MN III 37,16—44,36; khama, deva, ~assa, Ja IV
43,2* [metre doubtful]; evaṁ kataṁ ~e nassati na viṁ-
hati, ib. 42,12*; ahetu-vādo puriso . . . yo ca khatta-
vidho naro, ete ~ā loke, Ja V 241,12* . . . 242,9*; AN
II 217,2-11; = 'an-ariya', Pj II 479,3, Ja II 223,23'; =
'a-sabbhi', Ja I 495,3', V 483,25'; —. 'a-sa(t)', Ja IV
65,16'; — °-kammanta, mfn., doing the work of an
as°; asappuriso a-saddhamma-samannāgato hoti
asappurisa-bhatti, ~-cintī, ~-mantī, ~-vāco, ~-kam-
manto, ~-diṭṭhi hoti, ~-dānaṁ deti, MN III 21,16
(cf. ib. 23,12); 22,6-9; — °-cinti(n), mfn., with the
intentions of an as°; ib. 21,15,28-31; — °-tara, mfn.,
compar.; a-sappurisena ~aṁ, AN II 217,3-20; tato
~o nāma n'atthi, Ja VI 414,12; — °-dāna, n., a gift
like that of an as°; MN III 21,17 (paron.); 22,18-22;
pañca ~āni, AN III 171,28-32; — °-diṭṭhi, mfn.,
with the views of an as°; MN III 21,17; 22,9-18; —
°-dhamma, m., the moral state of an as°; MN III
37,11—44,36; mfn., of the as° quality; Ja V 233,17*;
— °-bhatti, mfn. [sa. bhakti, f.], having devotion to
asappurisas; MN III 21,15,23-27; v. l. for ~-sam-
bhatti, q. v.; — °-manti(n), mfn., laying the schemes
of an as°; MN III 21,16,32—22,2; — °-vāca, mfn.,
speaking like an as°; ib. 21,16; 22,3-6; — °-sam-
sagga, m., the mixing up with mean fellows; Ja V
241,14*; — °-saṁseva, mfn., attending to do.; AN V
113,24—114,15; — °-sambhatti, mfn., keeping com-
pany with do.; nom. pl. ~ino, AN V 150,6 (v. l. ~-bhat-
tino).

a-sappurisā, f. (!); pt ad Ja III 527,6 ( = 'a-
sabbhā', Ja Ee asabbho).

a-sabala, mfn. [sa. a + cabala], not spotted,
unmixed, pure; said of the sīlas, see a-khanda and
a-cchidda, and DN II 94,6; III 227,21; SN IV 272,17;
V 343,17; -— °-kāri(n), mfn., doing something in a
homogeneous way(?); a-khaṇḍakāri(n) a-cchidda-
kāri(n) +, qq. v.

a-sabba-kālika, mfn. [sa. a + sārvakālika],
not belonging to all times, not to be found always;
— °-tta, n. abstr., Mp ad AN IV 401,5 = Sv (III)
1046,9-12.

a-sabbaññ[ū/u], mfn. [sa. a + sarvajña], not om-
niscient; Mil 102,8—108,21; m. pl. ~uno, Mil 272,17;
— °-tā, f.abstr.; Mil 232,27.a-sabbaññū

a-sabbaññ[ū/u], mfn. [sa. a + sarvajña], not om-
niscient; Mil 102,8—108,21; m. pl. ~uno, Mil 272,17;
— °-tā, f.abstr.; Mil 232,27.a-sabbaññū

a-sabbattha-gami(n), mfn., not always applic-
able; ~gāmiṁ [metre doubtful ɔ: *a-sabba-gāminiṁ?]
vācaṁ bālo sabbattha bhāsati. Ja I 449,3* (Ct.: yā
vācā opamma-vasena sabbattha na gacchati).

a-sabbattha-gami(n), mfn., not always applic-
able; ~gāmiṁ [metre doubtful ɔ: *a-sabba-gāminiṁ?]
vācaṁ bālo sabbattha bhāsati. Ja I 449,3* (Ct.: yā
vācā opamma-vasena sabbattha na gacchati).

[a-sabbathattā, w. r. Ee in Kacc-v 400 for sab-
bathattā (Ce), said to mean sabbena pakārena; about
this Sadd 805,13-22].

a-sabbadhātuka, (mf)n., (the verbal endings)
not belonging to the sārvadhātuka class; Kacc 509
(Sadd 834,16).

a-sabbanāma, n., not a pronoun; Sadd 271,6;
— °-tta, m. abstr., Sadd 271,8.

a-sabba-ppayoga, m., using something only
partially; sense of √sis, Sadd 567,31 (for sa-Dhātup:
a-sarvôpayoga).

a-sabba-saṅgāhaka, mfn., not comprising the
totality, of limited purport; ~-vacanaṁ, Sadd 211,3.

a-sabba-sādhāraṇa, mfn., not common to all,
special; Sadd 318,18.

a-sabbha, mfn. [sa. sabhya > sabbha, Sa-
bhiya [Sn p. 91,15 ≠ Mvu III 394,7], and prob.
*sabbhiya, see 2a-sabbhi], indecent, unbecoming, im-
proper; abl. n. ovadeyyânusāseyya ~ā ca nivāraye,
Dhp 77 (= akusala-dhammā, Dhp-a) = Th 994,
quoted Nidd I 503,23*, Ja III 367,28*, Sadd 176,12;
~āhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosanti paribhāsanti, Ud
12,17 (= a-sa[b]bhā-yoggāhi, sabhāyaṁ sādhu-jana-
samūhe vattuṁ ayuttāhi, dutthullāhi,Ud-a 113,11-12);
Mil 221,26; Ja VI 582,27' (quoted Sadd 176,17); ~aṁ
(v. l. a-sabbha-vācaṁ) bhaṇanto (or °ntā) vicaranti,
Dhp-a I 256,8; mātugāmo nam' esa ~o akataññū,
Ja III 527,6 (pt Br; 'asabbḥā' [see Sadd 96,14—31]
ti asappurisāI); [ïhī-a 246,11 read with Ce; handa
tassa sambhāvitaṁ akkhiṁ]; — °-vācā, f., indecent
speech; ~aṁ, Dhp-a I 256,8 (v. l. for a-sabbhaṁ).

1a-sabbhi, instr, pl. of asa(t) [sa. a-sadbhih],
AN I 61,21; Ja V 483,11*; cf. Sadd 174,29—176,20,
with tentative derivation of (a)sabbhi, mfn., see next.

2a-sabbhi, mfn. [possibly, like pāni for pāniya,

p'etam ~i, Jātaveda, yan taṁ vāladhinâbhipūjayāma,

n., an unseeming act(l ), Mil 280,1; — °-jātika, mfn.
= 'asabbhi-rūpa', Ja VI 387,28'; — °-rūpa, mfn.,
of an indecent kind; pāpakammam akāsi ~aṁ, Ja VI
386,30* (= a-sādhujātikaṁ lāmakaṁ akusala-kam-
maṁ, Ct.; see Sadd 175,16); ābādho 'yaṁ ~o, Ja VI
387,23* (Ct.; Sadd ib.); an-ariyarūpo . . . a-sam(m)o-
dako thaddho, ~o, Ja VI 414,14* (uncivil; = a-paṇ-
ḍita-jātiko, Ct.; Sadd ib.); — °-vācā, f., an improper

[asabha never occurs = sa. ṛṣabha (see usabha),

a-sabhāga, mfn., not being in community with
others, unsociable; ~āya visadisāya jīvita-vuttiyā
samannāgato, Mp III 228,2 (= ' a-sabhāga-vuttiko');
— °-vutti, mfn. [sa. ~-vṛtti] = next; m. pl. agāravā
appatissā ~ino viharanti, Vin I 84,6; Ja I 218,14; —
°-vuttika, mfn., not living in mutual courtesy; te
aññam-aññaṁ a-gāravā a-ppatissā ~ā viharanti, Vin
II 161,21; AN III 14,23.

a-sabhā-yogga, mfn., not fit for an assembly,
Ud-a 113,11 (= 'a-sabbha'; Ee a-sabbhā-y°!).

dha; Bv IX 23; cf. Asamā, f.

4Asama, m., an agga-sāvaka of Sobhita Buddha;
Bv VII 21 (Bv-a Cɔ 137,38); Ja I 35,21.

2Asama, (m. pl.), designation of a class of devas;
Veṇhū ca devā Sahaḷī ca ~ā ca duve Yamā, DN II
259,22* (= Asama-devatā ca dve Yamaka-devatā ca,

puttā: ~o ca Sahaḷī ca Niṁko ca . . ., SN I 65,31.

1a-sama, mfn. [ts.], 1 a. not even (ɔ: unjust, etc.),
ifc: andho va visamaṁ maggaṁ na jānāti samâsa-
maṁ, Ja IV 192,11*; 1 b. not like, not comparable,
different (from: instr.): Tathāgato bodhisatto samāno
~o lokena, Mil 119,1; ~ā ubho dūra-vihāra-vuttino
gihi dāra-posī a-mamo ca subbato, Sn 220; jāti hi
tesaṁ ~ā samānaṁ (gen. pl.; Ee °nā), Ja VI 213,30*
(Ct. not clear); 2. without an equal, unequalled (as to:
instr.); mettāya ~o hohi, Bv II 158; paññāya ~o,
Ap 4,26; sabba-dhammehi ~o, Bv VI; ~aṁ sīlaṁ,
Bv IX 2 (= añña-sīlena a-sadisaṁ, Bv-a); ~o a-ppa-
ṭipuggalo, BvIXl; XVIII 1 (quoted Ja I 40,27*);
Ap 519,15; ghose ~e appatipuggale, Ap 451,23 (blun-
der in Ee) = Th-a Ce 91,18* = 398,22*; Dhp-a III
114,7 (guṇehi); ~assa an-upamassa, Mil 156,14; a-tulaṁ
vipulam ~aṁ (pāṭihāriyaṁ), Mil 208,1; — a-dutiyo...
~o a-sama-samo . . ., AN I 22,24(Mp); aggo . . . ~o
a-sama-samo, Mil 239,10 ≠ 331,23 ≠ Nidd II 51,5;
Vism 207,15.

a-sama-karuṇa, mfn., of incomparable com-
passion; ~assa loka-nāthassa, Sp I 258,7 (v. l. ~-kā-
ruṇikassa).

Asama-ghosa, m., a thera (in Anurādhapura),
author of Chagati-dīpanï and Candasuriyagati-dīpanī,
Piṭ-sm § 367—68 (see LSV p. 35).

a-sama-cari(n), mfn., living wickedly (cf. iasama
la); m. pl. adhammâbhiratā ~ino, Ja IV 184,3.a-sama-carin

a-sama-cari(n), mfn., living wickedly (cf. iasama
la); m. pl. adhammâbhiratā ~ino, Ja IV 184,3.a-sama-carin

a-samatta, mfn. [sa. a + samāpta], not com-
pleted, not perfect; nom. pl. 'a-kevalī' ~ā apa-
ripuṇṇā, Nidd I 300,4; (loc. sg. or) acc. pl. te
Bhagavā ~e ovadati, yathā Puṇṇañ ca govatikam
[MN I 387,11, foll.] Acelañ ca kukkuravatikaṁ, Nett
99,8 (Nett-a: '~e' ti kamme a-sampuṇṇe, te a-sam-
puṇṇe vā); — °-teja(s), mfn., not with his full burning
force, or [if a-samatta = a-sam-ā-tta, √dā] not
using (ail) his b. f.; ādīpitaṁ dāru . . . dahan [scil.
Aggi] na tappe [o: tṛpyeta, see Ct.] ~o, Ja VI 206,11*
(= a-sadisa-tejo (cf. sinh, sudusu), Ct.; Ee coni. a-sam-
attha-).

a-samattha, mfn. [sa. a-samartha], unable (to:
loc. or inf.); upāyâpariccāge anupāyâpariggahe ca
~o, Ps I 243,23; yuga-naṅgalâdīni vahituṁ ~o, Dhp-a
III 126,19; Sadd 335,20; Bu-up 39,32; — Ja III
170,5' (= 'nâlaṁ'); — °-ka, mfn., id.; Sacc 312; —
°-tā, f. abstr.; As 209,7; Ud-a 424,13; — °-pañña,
mfn., whose intellect is 'unable' (not fully developed);

śamatta°?

a-sama-dhura, mfn. [cf. sa. sama-dhura,
'bearing an equal burden'; cf. vi-dhura], peerless;
Tathāgato nāma ~o, Tathāgatena vūḷhaṁ dhuraṁ
añño vahituṁ samattho nāma n'atthi, Ja I 193,27;
cf. Dhp-a III 212,19; evaṁ ~aṁ paṇḍitaṁ, Ja VI
477,18'; sadevake loke ~o a-sadiso, Ja VI 330,23; —
~assa (ɔ: Buddhassa) dhammaṁ, Sn 694 (Pj); 695;
— ~o Vidhura-paṇḍito, Ja VI 259,17; 263,15.

a-samannāgata, mfn. [sa. a + sam-anv-āgata],
not (fully) possessed of (instr.); AN III 442,19.

a-samannāhāra, mfn. [neg. verb, noun of sam-
annāharati, 'to consider (with interest)']; abl. ~ato,
Vism (364,22) 369,5-9.

a-samanupassanā, f. (or ~a, n.), absence of

mānaṁ ~ă-lakkhaṇā niccasaññā, Nett 27,17,19.

a-samapekkhaṇa, n. [for a-samav°, see avek-
khati, or with Ct.s. vb. noun from *asamaṁ pekkhati,
!a-sama 1 a], "lack of impartial regard" (As-Trsl.); abl.
aññāṇā . . . ~ṇā, SN III 261,27 (title of the sutta, ib.);
instr. ~ṇena (or ~ṇe) moho uppajjati, Sv I 185,2 = Ps I
254,1; ~ṇena mohaṁ an-uppādentassa, Dhp-a IV 85,9;

a-samaya m. [ts.], not the right time (for: dat.); akā-
lo Bhagavantaṁ dassanāya . . ., mano-bhāvaniyānam
pi bhikkhūnaṁ ~o dassanāya, MN II 23,6 ≠ DN III
36,11; pañca ~ā padhānāya, AN III 65,30—-67,15;
attha a-kkhaṇā ~ā brahmacariya-vāsāya, AN IV
225,20—227,6 ≠ (nava) DN III 263,31—265,18 ≠
(attha) 287,12; — ~ena bhuttaṁ anojavantaṁ hoti,
AN III 260,8 (= a-kāle, Mp); — °-nibbuta, mfn.,

mfn. (ɔ: samayaṁ a-ppatto, see a-viññutā, etc.), not

a-samaya-vimutta, mfn. [Buddh, sa. 3a + sama-
yavimukta, Abhidh-k-vy- Trsl. VI 251,10 foll., cf. sāma-
yika, Sn 54; AN III 349,14], released without condi-
tion, "definitely released"; bhikkhu ~o karaṇīyaṁ
attano na samanupassati katassa vā paticayaṁ, AN
V 336,26 (= a-samaya-vimuttiyā vimutto, khīṇâ-
savo, Mp); Pp 11,7 (Pp-a); — °-vimutti, f., definitive
deliverance; a-samaya-vimokhaṁ ārādheti, aṭṭhānam
etaṁ . . . yaṁ so bhikkhu tāya ~iyā parihāyetha,
MN I 197,27-29; — °-vimokha, m. = prec., q.v.
(Ps II 232,3-14); Paṭis II 40,18-20.

a-samavekkhitvā, neg. abs. of samavekkhati;
not having considered, MN I 225,8-13.

a-sama-sama, mfn. [cf. sama-sama reciprocally,
or really equal], with no equal; a-samo (q. v.) ~o, AN
I 22,25 (Mp: a-samā vuccanti atītânāgatā sabba-
buddhā, tehi a-samehi samo ti '~o'), etc.; ayaṁ

a-sambandha, mfn., unrelated, Dhp-a III 267,9

a-veraṁ a-sapattaṁ (q.v.), Sn 150 — Khp IX 8
(= sambādha-virahitaṁ, bhinna-sīmaṁ, Pj); a-sa-

a-sambuddha, mfn., who has not understood or
