Sp); V 205,7.

a-samādhi, f., no concentration (cf. a-samāhita);
iti kho samādhi maggo, ~i kummaggo, AN III 420,29
(= an-ekagga-bhāvo, Mp).

a-samādhi-saṁvattanika, mfn., not leading to
concord or (accord, to Ct.s) to concentration; yā sa
vācā aṇdakā (q. v.) . . . ~ikā, MN I 286,37 (= appanā-
samādhissa vā upacāra-samādhissa vā a-saṁvatta-
nikā, Ps), etc., etc., Dhs 1343 (As = Ps).

a-samādhi-sukha, n., (all) happy feelings ex-
clusive of those felt in samādhi, AN I 81,32 (dve
. . . sukhāni: samādhi-sukhañ ca ~añ ca; Mp II
153,20-21).

a-samāna, mfn. [ts.], not the same, different;
~e kattari, the agent (of the finite verb) being different
(from that of the abs.), Sadd 312,25; — °-kattuka,
mfn. [sa. °-kartṛ-ka], where the agents are different,
ib. 313,9; — °-kālika, mfn., belonging to diverse
tenses, ib. 31,13; — °-gatika, mfn., not homologous;
°-tta, n., ib. 182,3; — °-jātika, mfn., of a different
(inferior) class (caste ), Ps III 281,19 (= 'it(t)ara-jacca');
— °-'tta, mfn. [quasi a-samānâtman], not equitable
or impartial; ~tā, f. abstr., Mil 161,21; — °-'ttha,
mfn., not synonymous; Sadd 31,9,14-21; — °-'nta,
mfn., with different endings; ib. 31,13; 32,10-14; ~tta,
n. abstr., ib. 495,1; — °-'ntika, mfn. — prec., ib.
461,13; — °-pada-jātika, mfn., belonging to different
parts of speech; ib. 31,13; 32,19-24; — °-ppavatti-
nimitta, mfn., with different motive; ib. 31,11,21-25
(said of homonymous words of different structure); —
°-liṅga, mfn., of different gender; ib. 31,12,25-29; —
°-vacanaka, mfn., of different grammatical number;
ib. 31,12,32—32,10; — °-vibhattika, mfn., of different
case form; 31,10,12,29-32; — °-sutika, mfn. [sa.
-çrutika; cf. Sadd 31,9-11], not homonymous; Sadd
461,12; — °âsanika, mfn., having a different sort
of seat (pīṭha, mañca, etc.); Vin II 169,17.

a-samāpanna, mfn., not reached or attained;
°-pubba, SN II 279,22; — °-ka-vara, m., designation of
MN I 3,32-36 foll., Ps I 37,32(—38,8).

a-samāsa, m., a non-compound (a syntagma,
vyāsa), Sadd 249,10*; 368,34*; — °-ka, m., id.; ib.
249,5*(brachyl.-, samāsaka-padañ c'eva ~amevaca); —
-visaya, m., where compounds are not used; Sadd 141,1.

a-samāhita, mfn., not composed or firm, without
self control, incapable of samādhi-concentration; samā-
hito ārādhako hoti no ~o, AN V 329,7; ~ā vib-
bhantacittā, MN I 20,10; ~assa, AN IV 229,5; —
uddhatā unnaḷā . . . muṭtha-ssatï a-sampajānā ~ā
vibbhanta-cittā, MN I 32,13; AN I 266,21; It 91,4;
Pp 35,5; kuhā . . . unnaḷā ~ā, AN II 26,17-25*
= It 112,14—113,8* ≠ sīlesu ~ā ḷ unnaḷā . . . |
(kuhā . . .), Th 958 (959); — ~o samāno 'samāhito
ti maṁ jano jānātū' ti icchati, Vibh 351,15 (Vibh-a
475,11-19); attā . . . ~o, Th 159*.d (opp. su-samāhito,
ib. 160M); ~aṁ cittaṁ *am cittan' ti pajānāti, DN
I 80,12—81,2 (Vism 410,18) = II 299,24; — °-saṁ-
kappa, mfn., of no firm determination; AN II 23,13*
(= a-ṭṭhapita-[or an-avaṭṭhita-]saṁkappa, Mp).

a-samijjhanaka, mf(-ikā)n., that cannot be
fulfilled; āsā nāma ~ikā n'atthi, Ja III 252,3.

2a-samiddhi, mfn., poor, wretched; acc. m. 'an-
iddhinan' ti . . . an-iddhiṁ ~iṁ dalidda(ka)-purisaṁ,
Ja VI 584,24'.

1a-samiddhi, f., (1) no success, failure, sense of
du-; Būp Ce p. 85,11 foll. ≠ Sadd 885,28*—886,2;
Abh 1169; (2) indigence, poverty; ~i dameti no, Ja VI
584,19*.

a-samugghāta, m., non-abolishing; Nett (79,29)
80,5 (yattha ~o, tattha anusayo); — °-gata, mfn. (ɔ:
samugghātaṁ a-gata, see a-viññutā, etc.), not (yet)
abolished; ~ā kilesă, (Porāṇā apud) Ps III 251,20 =
Mp II 46,9 = Vibh-a 299,9 (here Ee a-samugghāṭitā).

a-samugghātita, mfn. = prec; Ps III 252,10
— Mp II 46,26 — Vibh-a 299,25; a-samugghātit'-
uppanna, mfn., cf. a-vikkhambhit'-uppanna; Ps III
251,23, Mp II 46,13, Vibli-a 299,12, and a-samūhat'-
uppanna; Ps III (251,23) 252,12, etc.

a-samucchinna, mfn., not abolished; AN V
17,20; Dhp-a IV 48,11' (= 'an-ūhata').

a-samuṭṭhita, mfn., not come into existence;
a-jāta+, Dlis 1036 (see As 360,4) ≠ Vibh 1,22.

a-samudācāra, m. [see Abh-k-vy-Trsl. Ill 8
n. 2; VI 189,7], not coming into activity (function);
kilesānaṁ ~ena pabbajita-kiccaṁ no nipphannaṁ,
Dhp-a III 111,16; Mp I 30,3,17—31,24.

a-samudānita, mfn. [neg. pp. of sam-ud-ā √nī
for °udānīta, on the pattern of verbs in °eti: °ita, like
udāneti (√an): udānita], not brought about, not gained;
aladdhā vittaṁ [so Tr.] tapati pubbe ~aṁ, Ja IV
177,21* (= a-sambhataṁ dhanaṁ, Ct.).

a-samuppanna, mfn., unborn, not come into
existence; a-jātam ~aṁ a-sokaṁ vi-rajaṁ padaṁ,
It 37,21*; ajāta+, Dhs 1036 (see As 360,2) ≠
Vibh 1,21.

a-samūhata, mfn. [neg. pp. of sam-ud-√han],
not extirpated; 'asmī' ti anusayo ~o, SN III 130,31—
131,30; Pj II 7,12; a-samuhat'-uppanna, mfn., cf. a-
samugghatit'-uppanna; Pj II (6,24) 7 (10-)13.

a-samekkhita, mfn. [neg. pp. of sam-ā-√īkṣ],
not considered (or active sense); — °-tta, n. abstr.;
marīci-dhammaṁ ~ā, Ja VI 206,3* (Ct.).

a-samenta, mfn. [neg. part, of sam-(ā)-√i]; loc.
abs. (subj, in nom.): ekaṁ phalaṁ ~nte, Ja II 399,4
(tf only one (among the marked mango-fruits) does not
appear; if one fruit lacks of the sum; sama no-vana
kalhi, gp).

a-samosaraṇa, n. [neg. vb. noun of sam-o-
sarati, to come together, to call upon each other]; acc-
ābhikkhana-saṁsaggā ~ena ca . . . mittā jīranti, Ja
V 233,20*!

a-sayaṁ-kāra, mfn., not (to be) made by one's
self; ~o, DN III 138,1 etc. — Ud 69,29 (+ a-paraṁ-
kāro, q. v.; = a-sayaṁ-kato, Sv (pt); cf. a-paraṁ-kata
and ahaṁ-kāra-pasuta).

a-sayaṁ-vasi(n), mfn. [3a + sayaṁ-vasi(n), cf.
sa. svayaṁ-vaça], not his own master, dependent;
nom. sg. m. saṁkuddho ~ī, DN II 262,7* (Sv); nom.
pl. anāthā ~ī, Ja I 337,18 (a çloka-pāda).a-sayaṁ-vasin

a-sayaṁ-vasi(n), mfn. [3a + sayaṁ-vasi(n), cf.
sa. svayaṁ-vaça], not his own master, dependent;
nom. sg. m. saṁkuddho ~ī, DN II 262,7* (Sv); nom.
pl. anāthā ~ī, Ja I 337,18 (a çloka-pāda).a-sayaṁ-vasin

1a-sayha, mfn. [neg. ger. of sahati, cf. a-sāhiya;
sa. a-sahya], intolerable, irresistible; nom. sg. f.
mayhaṁ . . . ~ā bhavissati, Ja VI 337,33 ; ~-tibba-
dukkhâbhibhūtā (scil. nerayikā sattâ), Mil 148,18;
ghorâsayha-kaṭuka-pphalesu kāmesu, Ud-a 365,22;
It-a I 149,16-17; asayha-bhāra, Spk III 291,16; cf.
a-ppasayha.

2Asayha, m., (1) Npr. of a paccekabuddha,
MN III 70,18*; — (2) designation of a certain çreṣṭhin;
Asayha-(mahā-)setthi(n), Pv-a 112,11,14 ... 124,8'
(= 'Angīrasa', Pv 275).

asayha-sahi(n), mfn. (paron.), enduring what
is beyond endurance; acc. sg. m. tathāgataṁ buddham
~inaṁ, It 32,11* (It-a I 149,16: asayhassa sakalassa
bodhi-sambhārassa mahākaruṇâdhikārassa [so with
v. l. ?] ca sahanato vahanato, tathā . . . asayhānaṁ
pañcannaṁ Mārānaṁ sahanato abhibhavanato . . .);
gen. sg. m. buddhassa putto 'mhi ~ino, Th 536; voc.
~i, Ja III 14,21*; gen. pl. jayo Kaliṅgānam ~inaṁ,
Ja III 6,25* (= dussahaṁ sahituṁ samatthānaṁ,
Ct.); — °-tā, f. abstr., Ja III 15,3.asayha-sahin

asayha-sahi(n), mfn. (paron.), enduring what
is beyond endurance; acc. sg. m. tathāgataṁ buddham
~inaṁ, It 32,11* (It-a I 149,16: asayhassa sakalassa
bodhi-sambhārassa mahākaruṇâdhikārassa [so with
v. l. ?] ca sahanato vahanato, tathā . . . asayhānaṁ
pañcannaṁ Mārānaṁ sahanato abhibhavanato . . .);
gen. sg. m. buddhassa putto 'mhi ~ino, Th 536; voc.
~i, Ja III 14,21*; gen. pl. jayo Kaliṅgānam ~inaṁ,
Ja III 6,25* (= dussahaṁ sahituṁ samatthānaṁ,
Ct.); — °-tā, f. abstr., Ja III 15,3.asayha-sahin

asayha-sīta, mfn., where the cold is intolerable;
loc. sg. m. tibbandhakāre . . . ~e lokantare, Vism
501,21* = Vibh-a 97,30*.

a-sara, mfn. (unexplained, a synon, of 2a-saraṇa
would suit the context; Nidd I 409,11—410,17 and Pj
explain by a-sāra); samantam ~o loko . . . icchaṁ
bhavanam (— tāṇaṁ . . . saraṇaṁ, Nidd) attano,
nâddasāsim an-ositaṁ, Sn 937 (v. l. a-sāro, against
metre, from Nidd, Pj).

1a-saraṇa, (mf)n. [cf. sa. smaraṇa, n.], non-
remembering; —-°-tā, /. abstr.; Pp 21,14 (a-sati +); —
°-bhāva, m. abstr.; (assa) sattâhaṁ ~aṁ katvā,
Dhp-a III 121,13 (as if not remembering him; = sihi
no karana bavu, gp).

2a-saraṇa, mfn. [cf. sa. çaraṇa, n.], with no
shelter, having no (place of) refuge; ~o loka-sannivāso,
Paṭis I 127,6 (āditto ... a-tāṇo a-leṇo+), quoted
Ud-a 142,21; nom. pl. m. a-tāṇā a-leṇā ~ā asaraṇī-
bh[ū/u]tā, (scil. saṁkhārā), Nidd I 410,21-29 ≠ Mil 148,19
≠ (nom. sg. m.) 325,19 ≠ Ps V 55,22; 56,10; Ja I
213,29; VI 409,13; Pv-a 80,21 (= 'a-leṇa'); [Dhs
p. 7,3, etc. w. r. for a-raṇa, q. v.]; abl. ~ato (scil. phas-
saṁ tīreti), Nidd I 53,10 (a-niccato ... a-tāṇato
a-leṇato; Nidd-a I 169,28).

a-sara-dassi(n), mfn., regarding something (loc.)
as a-sāra (q. v.); nom. pl. m. asāre . . . ~ino, Dhp 11.a-sara-dassin

a-sara-dassi(n), mfn., regarding something (loc.)
as a-sāra (q. v.); nom. pl. m. asāre . . . ~ino, Dhp 11.a-sara-dassin

a-sarambhi(n), mfn. [neg. deriv. of sārambha,
cf. prec], not disposed to 'excitement'; — °-tā, f. abstr;.
a-cchambhitā ~ā an-issukitā, Pj I 34,20.a-sarambhin

a-sarambhi(n), mfn. [neg. deriv. of sārambha,
cf. prec], not disposed to 'excitement'; — °-tā, f. abstr;.
a-cchambhitā ~ā an-issukitā, Pj I 34,20.a-sarambhin

a-sarūpa, mfn. [ts.; cf. a-savaṇṇa], not hom-
organic (said of vowels); Kacc 13 (Sadd 613,7);
referred to: Sadd 43,25.

a-sallakkhaṇa, n. [neg. verb, noun of sallakkheti,
sa. saṁlakṣayati], not taking notice of (loc); abl. rūpe,
etc, ~ā, SN III 261,18-19 (aññāṇā +; Spk II
352,16-18); title of the sutta ibid.

a-sallakkhetvā, ind. [neg. abs. of do.], heedlessly
(in a hurry); Vin II 215,7-8; inadvertently: ahaṁ
~ akkamiṁ, mā kujjhi, Ja I 209,23.

a-sallīna, mfn. [neg. pp. of sam + √lī], not
shrinking, not disheartened; āraddhaṁ . . . viriyaṁ
ahosi ~aṁ, Vin III 4,4 (Sp I 141,11) ≠ It 119,2 ≠
AN I 149,1 ≠ MN I 21,32 ≠ SN IV 125,18; ~ena
cittena vedanaṁ ajjhavāsayi, SN I 159,5* (Spk I
224,33) = DN II 157,14* = Th 906.

2a-sallīn'-atta, mfn. [-atta = sa. ātman], un-
disheartened (said of persons); ~-pahitatta-paggahaṭ-
ṭhe paññā, Paṭis I (2,16) 103,26—104,23 (Paṭis-a
43,25—44,13; v. r. ~ā pahitattā (abl. sg. of ia-sallī-
natta, see Paṭis-a 45,6-11).

1a-sallīnatta, n. abstr.; abl. ~ā, v. r. Paṭis I
2,16 (Paṭis-a 45,6-11), see next.

a-sallekha, m. [3a + sallekha, Bu-sa. saṁ-
lekha], an unrestrained life; a-santuṭṭhiyā ~assa ca
. . . nivāraṇe, Ps I 96,26.

a-savaṇṇa, mfn. [about sa-vaṇṇa = sarūpa see
Sadd 606,28—607,18], of differring quality (said of
vowels); Kacc 14 (Sadd 613,19); cf. a-sarūpa.

a-sassata, mfn. [3a + sassata, sa. çāçvata], not
constant, impermanent; aho rūpaṁ ~aṁ, Ap 575,20
= Thī-a 85,16*; (kāmā) ~ā viparināmadhammā
[ ˇ ˇ - - ˇ - - ?], Ja V 176,6* (cf. DN ï 18,35); ~aṁ
sassataṁ nu [Ee metr. no] tava-y-idaṁ [ ˇ - - , Ee
tavêdaṁ], Ja VI 315,20*; ~o loko ti vā antavā loko
ti vā, DN I 189,27; Dhs 1099 (As 371,1); 1117; ~o
attā ca loko ca, DN III 137,21; preceded by anicca,
addhuva (qq. v.), DN III 31,26; MN I 326,26; SN III
85,25; — °-bhāva, m. abstr.; ~ena assāsa-rahitā, (scil.
saṁkhārā), Mp ad AN IV 100,19 (= 'an-assāsikā').

a-sassati(n), mfn., i. q. asassata; nom. sg. m.,
asassatī-r-iva, (unmetrical) v. r. Ud 79,26* accord, to
Ud-a 386,23.a-sassatin

a-sassati(n), mfn., i. q. asassata; nom. sg. m.,
asassatī-r-iva, (unmetrical) v. r. Ud 79,26* accord, to
Ud-a 386,23.a-sassatin

a-saha(t), mfn. [neg. part, of sahati, to endure,
forbear]; nom. sg. m. ~anto, Ja III 367,7 (garahaṁ);
VI 575,27 (do.); cf. a-sahamāna.a-sahat

a-saha(t), mfn. [neg. part, of sahati, to endure,
forbear]; nom. sg. m. ~anto, Ja III 367,7 (garahaṁ);
VI 575,27 (do.); cf. a-sahamāna.a-sahat

a-sahatthā, ind. [3a + sahatthā, cf. svahas-
tam (eva), Mvu III 142,2; 257,9], not with his own
hand (without due consideration); asakkaccaṁ (q. v.) +,
MN III 22,20 (= na attano hatthena deti, dāsa-
kammakarâdīhi dāpeti, Ps) ≠ AN IV 392,21 (= sa-
hatthe(na) adatvā para-hatthena deti, āṇatti-mattam
eva karoti, Mp) ≠ DN II 356,2.

a-sahana, n. [neg. verb, noun of sahati], katassa
aparādhassa ~aṁ, Ja III 20,28; 22,21; parehi sādḥā-
raṇa-bhāvâsahana-lakkhaṇassa maccherassa, Pv-a
17,24 (Ee sādhāraṇâbh°, see Vibh-a 513,3); a-sahan'-
atthe, Mp-ṭ ad Mp III 298,18 (= 'amarisan'-atthe',
cf. Sadd 458,24); sense of √khid, Dhātup 409; do. of
the interj. ham, Pv-a 117,20; — °-tā, f. abstr.; parehi
sādhāraṇa-bhāvassa ~ā, Vibh-a 513,3 (= 'maccha-
riyanY); ~āya, Sp (IV) 915,16 (= 'a-kkhantiyā').

a-sahamāna, mfn. [neg. part. med. of sahati];
makkhañ (ca) ~o, Vin I 25,4,26*.

1a-sahasa, mfn. [ts.], not acting violently or in-
considerately; a-paḷāso ~o, AN I 199,8* (= rāga-dosa-
moha-sāhasānaṁ vasena ~o, Mp); acc vohāra-suciṁ
~aṁ, Ja III 320,20* (= dhammika-vinicchaye ṭhi-
tattā yeva sāhasa-kiriyāya rahitaṁ, Ct.).

†a-sahāna-dhammatā, f.; acc. pappoti bo-
dhiṁ~aṁ, DN III 165,25* (= apariḥāna-dhammataṁ,
Sv; pt: sa(ha) hāna-dhammenā ti sa-hānadhammo,
na sahānadhammo ti a-sahānadhammo, tassa
bhāvo ~ā, taṁ ~aṁ, aparihānīya-sabhāvan ti attho;
thus, tradition does not support the conjecture (Sv-Se)
reported s. v. aparihānadhammatā).

a-sahāya, mfn. [ts.], without companion (unique,
peerless); adutiyo ~o a-ppaṭimo, AN I 22,24 (said of
a Buddha); Ap 461,9 (do.); Mil 225,25-26 (do.); =
'eka', Ud-a 18,26; 174,6; Sadd 267,12; 283,17; Mogg
IV 56; — °-kicca, mfn. (3a + sahāyakicca), needing
no companion, Ps II 152,20.

a-sahita, mfn. [ts.; 3a + sahita], inconsistent,
unreasonable; appaṁ bhāsati ~añ ca, AN II 138,17
(= atthena asaṁyuttaṁ, Mp) = Pp 42,18, cf. Dhp 19-
20; sahitaṁ me ~aṁ te, DN I 8,13 ("meine Behauptung
ist logisch, deine widerspricht sich"; Sv: 'sahitaṁ' =
silitthaṁ attha-yuttaṁ kāraṇa-yuttaṁ) = MN II
3,27 (Ps) = 243,25 = SN III 12,10 (Spk II 261,4),
quoted Nidd I 173,9 (Nidd-a) = 200,10 (see note, and
Nidd-a); — ifc. v. kusalā sahitâsahitassa, AN II
138,17 (attha-nissitassa vā a-nissitassa vā, Mp) =
Pp 42,19.

asnāti (often (mis)read asanāti), pr. 3 sg. [sa.
açnāti], to eat, to enjoy; vuttānaṁ [sa. uptānām]
phalam ~āti, Ja VI 14,21* (= paribhuñjati, Ct.),
quoted Ud-a 45,30*, Sadd 501,17; ghataṁ ~āti, Ja I
472,19' (explaining 'ghatâsano') ≠ V 64,11'; imper.
3 sg. etādiso kho 'arahan' ti (so Cks) piṇḍam ~ātu
bhattuno, Ja V 376,27*; 2 pl. ~ātha pivatha khā-
datha, DN II 170,15 (quoted Sadd 501,19); pot. 1 sg.
tasmā adatvā udakam pi nâsmiye, Ja V 397,29*
(cf. Mvu II 56,10*; = na paribhuñjissāmī ti imaṁ
vataṁ samādiyiṁ, Ct.; as to mixed pot.s [got. sijais]
cf.: 3sg. maddiye, Cp III 3,8; pakampiye, Ja VI 295,9*
Ck; haññe, AN IV 254,17*; 2 sg. dajjesi, vajjesi
(Sadd 370,3, 388,23); 1 pl.paṭikiriyemu, Ja IV 384,13*
(Cks); dajjeyyāma (and pot.-imper. dajjehi), Geiger
§143; hindi dījiye, prākr. (Pravacana-sāra III 49—
50) se (ɔ: syāt); -sm- for -sn- (also in the part. med.
below) is merely graphical like sv:sm in asmase, see
assasati); fut. 1 sg. (a ) nâsissaṁ na pivissāmi . . . na
nikkhame ḷ na . . . nipātessaṁ, Th 223; (β) asissāmi
. . . asissaṁ, Sn 970; part. med. see añhamāna with
v. l. as[a]mamāna (o: asnamāna); — pp. 2asita; pass.
asïyati; grd. see asitabba (and āsiya in mukhâsiya,
Dhs 646).

asma(n) = amha(n), m. [sa. açman]; a stone
(Abh 605); nom. sg. asmā ha nūna (so C*s, metr.) te
hadayaṁ, Ja VI 549,4* (= pāsāṇo, Ct.); mā tvaṁ
adhammo ācarito asmā kumbham ivâbhidă, Ja III
29,17* (= pāsāṇo, Ct.); instr, (a ) taṁ (ɔ: senaṁ) te
paññāya gacchāmi [brachyl. < paccug-gacchāmi, Sn
442] āmaṁ pattaṁ va asmanā (or amhanā), Sn 443;
(β) asmena (or amhanā), Ap 18,24, see amha(n); loc.
mā pādaṁ khaṇi-y-asmani, Ja III 433,11* (= pāsā-
nasmiṁ, Ct.); also = asmarī; jar'-asma-sotha-, Bhes
4:16.

asma(d) = amha, stem of pers. pron. 1 pl., see
aham; asmad-atthe, Vv-a 10,4; Sadd 290,24.asma

asma(d) = amha, stem of pers. pron. 1 pl., see
aham; asmad-atthe, Vv-a 10,4; Sadd 290,24.asma

asma(n) = amha(n), m. [sa. açman]; a stone
(Abh 605); nom. sg. asmā ha nūna (so C*s, metr.) te
hadayaṁ, Ja VI 549,4* (= pāsāṇo, Ct.); mā tvaṁ
adhammo ācarito asmā kumbham ivâbhidă, Ja III
29,17* (= pāsāṇo, Ct.); instr, (a ) taṁ (ɔ: senaṁ) te
paññāya gacchāmi [brachyl. < paccug-gacchāmi, Sn
442] āmaṁ pattaṁ va asmanā (or amhanā), Sn 443;
(β) asmena (or amhanā), Ap 18,24, see amha(n); loc.
mā pādaṁ khaṇi-y-asmani, Ja III 433,11* (= pāsā-
nasmiṁ, Ct.); also = asmarī; jar'-asma-sotha-, Bhes
4:16.

asmarī, f. [sa. açmarī: açman- = pīvarī: pīvan-],
gravel; Bhes 4:5 (= mūtra-pathayehi vū gal, sn);
ifc. v. sukk'-asmarī (çukrâçmarī, Bhes 1:94).

asmiṁ, loc. sg. of ayaṁ; asmin 'dha loke, Ja
V 79,18* ('idhā' ti nipāta-mattaṁ, Ct.).

asmi-māna, m., the attitude "asmī" ti (SN III
46,22, Nidd-a I 209,15), 'egotism' (distinct from ahaṁ-
kāra; see Vibh (346,2-13:346,16 [Nidd I 80,17])
353,16—355,10:356,1-6; cf. Abhidh-k-vy Trsl. Ill
84,5, V 27,1, etc.); ~assa yo vinayo, Ud 10,22* (Ud-a:
arahattaṁ hi ~assa patipassaddhi-vinayo ti vuccati)
= Vin I 3,30* (Sp = Ud-a), quoted Kv 212,20*, cf.
Tuneld, Recherches p. 65 foll., 70 n. 1; ~o samucchin-
no, SN III 83,19* (= nava-vidho [Vibh 356,2-4] ~o,
Spk); anicca-saññā bhāvitā... sabbaṁ ~aṁ pariyā-
diyati samūhanti, SN III 155,18—157,10; anicca-
saññaṁ . . . bhăvanaṁ bhāvayato, yo ~o, so pa-
hīyissati, MN I 425,1 (Ps) ≠ III 115,5 (yo pañcas'
upādānakkhandhesu ~o, cf. SN III 128,34); eka-
dhamme bhāvite (scil. kāyagatāya satiyā) . . . ~o
pahïyati, AN I 44,16; eko dhammo pahātabbo: ~o,
Paṭis I 26,18 (Paṭis-a 116,2); kathaṁ . .. napajjhāya-
ti: idha ~o pahīno hoti . . ., AN II 216,27 ≠ MN I
139,36 (describing 'ariyo pannaddhajo'; Ps) = AN
III 85,10 ≠ AN II 41,30 ('patilīno'); katamo eka-
dhammo pahātabbo . . .: ~o, DN III 273,1 (Sv (III)
1056,24); 'thale ussādo' ti ~ass' etaṁ adhivacanaṁ,
SN IV 180,15 (see ib. 179,15; Spk III 41,22-32); —
°-samugghāta, m., extirpation of a°; AN III 325,3
(Mp III 360,3); IV 358,17-19; Ud 37,18-20.

1assa, gen. sg. m. of ayaṁ (q. v.), in sandhi:
'(s)sa: yaṁ hi 'ssa, MN I 10,20; yaṁ 'sa, 137,34;
evaṁ 'sa, 9,28 (cf. rāṣṭra(ṁ) sya, Mvu I 278,3*-5*);
about Sacc 305, etc., see Sadd 42,2-15; nâssa, DN I
74,7-28, Ja VI 294,1*-5*.

4assa, n. [sa. āsya], the mouth; Sadd 386,17*
(= 'mukhaṁ', not in Abh 260).

5assa, m. [sa. -asra, -açra], a corner, edge, Abh
394 (koṇa), 1102 (do.); ifc. v. catur-° (Pv 112; caturas-
sara-, Dhp-a I 126,6, w.r.; gp: caturassa-°; = sirī-
muguren); cf. 3aṁsa (ifc).

6assa, m. [sa. açva], a horse, Sadd 417,23*(-27*);
Abh 368, 1102, cf. ājānïya, sindhava, kambojaka,
khaluṁka, assa-sadassa, kisora; (sandhi: hatthi-'ss'-
uraga-soṇānaṁ, Mūla-s V 5); ~o bhadro, SN I
7,23*; ~o va jiṇṇo nibbhogo, SN I 176,16*; ~o
(opp. gadrabho), MN II 153,31; ~am pi dhāvan-
taṁ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, MN II 99,12; cittaṁ
samādhesiṁ ~aṁ bhadraṁ va jāniyaṁ, Thī 114
(Thī-a O: yathā ~aṁ bhadraṁ ājāniyaṁ kusalo
sārathi sukhena sāreti); (hatthī +) ~ā, Mil (35,5)
37,20; 39,28 (cavalry), cf. ~asmiṁ katāvī, MN II 69,8
(Sadd 727,17); pl. ~ā, SN V 4,22 (the team); ~ā hasiṁ-
su, Ud-a 149,24; ~ā yathā sārathinā sudantā, Dhp 94
(a team); — f. ~ā, Abh 371 (cf. assadhenu, vaḷavā,
and, prob., vaḷabhī [> sinh. veḷamba], see under assa-
tarī-ratha [Ja VI 266,19*-20*]); — ifc. v. an-assa(ka),
abal'-a°, araññ'-a°, ājāniy'-a° (Ja VI 274,23'),
khaluṁk'-a° (Ja I 181,27'), gav[ā/a]ssa (Sn 769, Thī
327), catur-° (Thī 229), duṭṭh'-a° (Saddh 367), maṅ-
gal'-a° (Ja II 98,10), valav'-a° (Ja I 184,24), sad-°
(see AN IV 397,3), sīgh'-a° (Dhp 29), hatthi-'ssa-
ratha-pattikā, pl. (Ap 311,7).

5a-ssaka, mfn. [sa. a-svaka], (1), having nothing
of his own, poor; daḷiddo ~o anāḷhiyo, MN I 450,34
(= nis-sako, Ps) = II 178,18 = AN III 384,11 (Mp);
III 352,1; (2) (in spite of Ct.s) = 2a-sa; ~o loko,
sabbaṁ pahāya-gamanīyaṁ, MN II 68,25—71,16 ( =
nis-sako saka-bhaṇḍa-rahito, Ps), commented upon:
Paṭis I 126,32, quoted Ud-a 142,17.

2assaka, m. [sa. açvaka; Mogg-v IV 41], a
small horse, a toy-horse; ~-rathakâdïhi bāla-kīḷana-
kehi kīḷamāno, Ps III 291,22; cf. ime te hatthikā
assā . . . yehi ssu pubbe kīḷiṁsu, Ja VI 564,15*.

1Assaka, m(pl.) [sa. Açmaka], an Andhra-tribe
(and their country); gen. pl. Aṅgānaṁ Magadhānaṁ
. . . ~ānaṁ Avantīnaṁ, AN I 213,3 = IV 252,7 . . .
260,29; ~ānañ ca Potanaṁ (cf. Potali) ḷ Māhissatī
Avantīnaṁ (q. v.), DN II 235,19*, cf. Assakâvantiṁ,
Ja V 317,24*; jayo Kaliṅgānaṁ . . . parājayo anayo
~ānaṁ, Ja III 6,26*; Sv (II) 637,9; — sg. m., the king
of A°: ~assa visaye Muḷakassa samāsane, Sn 977 (Pj
II 581,1: ~assa ca Muḷakassa cā ti dvinnaṁ Andhaka-
rājānaṁ samāsanne [sic!] visaye); Assakaraṭṭhe Po-
talinagare ~o rajjaṁ kāresi, Ja III 3,4 foll. (. . . 8,6)
≠ II 155,18; Ja VI 99,10* (Dudīpo+); see Assaka-
rāja(n), Assakâdhipati.

1assa-kaṇṇa, m. [sa. açva-karṇa], a tree (Shorea
robusta); Abh 562 (+ sāla, sajja) ≠ Am-kII 4,44;
assakaṇṇa-vibhīṭakā, Ja II 161,20* (gp: 'assakaṇṇa'
asu-gas, muruta-da kiyat, 'vibhīṭaka' buḷu); n'eva
sālo na khadiro n' ~o, kuto dhavo, rukkho ca phan-
dano nāma, Ja IV 209,9*; dhav'-assakaṇṇā khadirā
sālā phandana-māluvā, Ja VI 528,28* (Ct.) = 534,1*.

2Assakaṇṇa, m., one of the seven mountains that
surround Sineru; Abh 27; Yugandharo . . . ~o, Vism
206,9* = As 298,18* = Sp I 119,16* (Sp-t) = Pj II
443,5* ≠ Ja VI 125,14*.

Assaka-raja(n), m. = *Assaka (sg.): ~ā, Vv-a
259,24; instr, (α) °rājena, Ja II 157,21*, (β) °raññā,
ib. 24*; gen. (a ) °rājassa, Vv-a 261,23, (β) °rañño,
ib. 260,3; Mp 1333,8.Assaka-rajan

Assaka-raja(n), m. = *Assaka (sg.): ~ā, Vv-a
259,24; instr, (α) °rājena, Ja II 157,21*, (β) °raññā,
ib. 24*; gen. (a ) °rājassa, Vv-a 261,23, (β) °rañño,
ib. 260,3; Mp 1333,8.Assaka-rajan

Assaka-rattha, n., the kingdom of 1assaka; Ja
III 3,4 foll; V 318,6'; Vv-a 259,23; 260,3; 261,23.

assa-kāya, m., a corps of cavalry; pl. ~ā, MN II
69,31 (hatthi-kāyā +).

assa-kuṇapa, m., (part of) a dead horse; Vism
343,2 (see ahi-kuṇapa).

assa-khaluṁka, m. [= Amg., see Charpentier
ad Uttarajjh XXVII 3], an unmanageable horse (of
inferior breed; opp. assâjāniya); tayo ~ā, AN I
287,(28)33—288,7 (Mp: ~o ti assa-poto, cf. Sadd
417,27*); attha ~ā, AN IV 190,17—192,15 (cf. Th
976); IV 397,2 foll.; V 166,24; 323,8; Ja VI 452,9';
Vism 490,2 = Vibli-a 81,2; — °-suttanta, m., = AN
I 287,28—289,14 (uddāna ib 304,8*); Ps III 358,14.

[assa-gaṇa, Ja VI 23,29*, read: 'yoggan' ti yuge
yuñjitabbakaṁ assa-goṇâdiṁ, Tr.].

assa-gandhā, f., the plant Withania somnifera;
Bhes 10:18 (= amukkarā, sn); assagandhâdi-piṭ-
ṭhāni, Sp (IV) 837,22 ≠ Vin-vn 1364.

Assagutta, m. [sa. Açvagupta], Npr. (1) of a
thera: in the series Mahā-Kassapa, Candagutta,
Suriyagutta, ~, Yonaka-Dhammarakkhita, Tissa
(ɔ: Dhammâsokassa kaniṭṭha-bhātā), Spk III 143,3;
mettā-vihārīnam aggo (time of Dhammâsoka), Ps III
276,13, cf. Sv (III) 779,28 = Ps I 283,17 = Spk III
166,22 = Vibh-a 272,4; residing at Vattaniya: Mhv-ṭ
192,18—193,13 (ordination of †Janasāna [Jara-soṇa?]);
Vism 430,18-22 = As 419,15-19 (miracle of the curds);
preaches sitting in the air on a camma-khaṇḍa: Vism
98,33; — (2) of the tutor of Nāgasena, Mil 6,7,22 . . .
16,30.

assa-gumba, m. [cf. sa. gulma], a troop of
cavalry; acc. pl. ~e, Ja VI 47,26* (see ib. 51,30':
'hatthi-gumbā' = hatthi-ghaṭāyo).

assa-gocara, mfn., having horses for his object
(victims); Ja II 32,8'.

assa-gopaka, m., a groom; Ja II 99,9'; pt ad
Ja II 98,10 (= 'assa-bandho' ɔ: the limping groom
Giridatta, ib. 98,20* (v. l.) ≠ dusito giridatina,
Barhut Inscr., against Lūders, Bhārhut etc. 1941, p.
90); Ja IV 476,5; ~-vesena, Ja V 286,20; maṅgal'-~,
Ja V 444,13.

assa-jātiya, mfn., of the nature (kin) of horses;
Kacc-v 355 (Sadd 789,3).

Assaji, m. [sa. Açvajit], Npr. (1) of the last among
the Pañcavaggiyā (Koṇḍañña +), DīpI 32; became
an arhat at Isipatana, Vin I 13,7 (—14,37; Sp (V)
965,20-31); Ja I 82,16; Ps II 192,24; proselytes Sāri-
putta by the gāthā "ye dhammā hetuppabhavā . . .",
Vin I 39,28—41,34*; Ap 24,14; Ja I 85,1e; Ps II
346,16; Mp I 157,29; Tn-a Ce II 93,34; Dhp-a I 91,10
foll.; IV 75,13; Sāriputta venerates him: Ap 31,1-6
= Th-a Ce II 109,7*-12*; Pj II 328,2-18; Dhp-a IV
150,13—151,8; falls ill at Kassapârāma, SN III
124,17; meets with Saccaka, MN I 227,28—228,16;
(2) of a bhikkhu (gaṇâcariya), one of the Chabbaggiyā
(Paṇḍuka and Lohitaka, Mettiya and Bhummajaka,
Assaji and Punabbasuka), Ps III 186,21 foll.; Assaji-
Punabbasukā, dvandva, m. pl.: at Kīṭāgiri, MN I
473,20 (Ps); Ja II 387,12; besides the offences of the
Chabbaggiyā, Assaji and Punabbasuka are guilty of
the foll. faults: mālā-vacchaṁ ropenti ..., Vin III
179,31—184,5 (Sp (III) 613,26—614,30) ≠ Vin II 9,29
(—15,3); Dhp-a II 108,21 foll. (ad Dhp 77 = Th 994,
cf. Th-a Ce II 115,15-18); Mp II 165,3; saṁghikaṁ
senâsanaṁ bhājesuṁ, Vin II 171,3-38; khuddânu-
khuddakā āpattiyo sañcicca vītikkamantā yathā-
paññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya na vattanti,
Sv (II) 525,95-27; — Assaji-Punabbasukānaṁ vat-
thu, title of Dhp-a II 108—110.

Assatara, m., name of a naga(-senapati):
Kambal'-Assatara āgu Pāyāgā saha ñātibhi, DN
II 258,18* (= Kambalo ca ~o ca, Sv; see Kl. Turf.
IV 177,3* and note 5); KambaF-Assatar(a) uṭṭhentu,
Ja VI 165,4* (= tassa [o: Dhataraṭṭhassa] māti-
pakkhikā Sinerupāde vasanakā [cf. Sv (II) 688,19]
nāgā, Ct.; here designation of a whole nāga-class,
senāpatis accord, to Spk II 350,1-13, quoted Ss
175,6-21); Kambal'-Assataradayo nāgā, Pj I 163,20;
Abh 652.

assatara, m. [sa. açvatara], a mule; Sadd 417,24*
≠ Abh 369; Sadd 792,9, Mogg-v IV 57 (Pay); idha
vaḷavaṁ gadrabhena sampayojeyyuṁ . . . so . . . ~o
hoti, MN II 153,28-33; varam ~ā dantā ājānīyā va
sindhavā, Dhp 322 (= vaḷavāya gadrabhena jātā,
Dhp-a), quoted Dhp-a I 213,3*; yojentu ve rājarathe
sucitte kambojake ~e sudante, Ja IV 464,4* (Ct.);
[Ja VI 135,28* read: assa-ratanam pi Kesiṁ, Bd, Se,
metre]; Ja VI 342,21—343,29; hand' assatarassa te
ayaṁ [= ~ato gadrabho uttamo, ib. 29] [ assatarassa
hi gadrabho pita, Ja VI 343,35*-36*.

assatarī, f. [sa. açvatarī], a (she-)mule; phalaṁ
ve kadaliṁ hanti . . . gabbho ~iṁ yathā, SN I 154,4*
(Spk) = II 241,33* = AN II 73,33* = Vin II 188,22*,
quoted Dhp-a III 156,23*; ~ī atta-vadhāya gabbhaṁ
gaṇhāti, parābhavāya g. g., SN II 241,21 = AN II
73,27 (see Mp III 104,12-18) — Vin II 188,19; ~ī
atta-jena haññati, Mil 166,26.

assatarī-ratha, m., 'a chariot drawn by mules';
purato va setena paleti hatthinā | majjhe pana
~ena, Pv 72 (= assatarī-yuttena rathena, Pv-a); yo
so majjhe ~ena, ib. 75; Pv-a 55,18; sataṁ hatthī
sataṁ assā sataṁ ~ā, SN I 211,14*(28*) = Vin II
156,3* ≠ Ja VI 266,19* (+ sataṁ vaḷabhiyo, brachyl,
for vaḷabhī-rathā [vaḷavā X (gadra)bhī > vaḷabhī >
sinh., veḷemba, veḷamba]); sataṁ nekkhā (so v. l.)
sataṁ assā sataṁ ~ā, Vv 469; dāsaṁ dāsiñ ca so
dajjā assañ c' ~aṁ, Ja VI 575,18*; yassa n'atthi
(cod. Lk nâssa) ghare dāso asso c' ~o (Lk vâssata-
rīratho), Ja VI 575,29*; ~añ ca [metr. assatarï-rathañ
ca] ekamekaṁ | phītaṁ gāmavarañ ca ekamekaṁ,
Ja VI 355,17*.

2assattha, mfn., pp. of assasati (2) [*āçvasta: sa.
viçvas(i)ta], recovered, comforted; ~am āsīnaṁ samek-
khiyāna(ṁ), Ja VI 309,10* (= laddha-assāsaṁ hutvā
nisinnaṁ, Ct.); taṁ . . . udakena abhisiñcatha, ~aṁ
naṁ viditvâna, Ja VI 566,31*; ~-kālam aññāya, Cp II
6,8 (= parissamam apanetvā ... kilamathassa vigata-
kālaṁ jānitvā, Cp-a); ~-kāle, Mhv XXXIII 73 (= te-
saṁ assāsajāta-kāle, Mhv-ṭ); — ahaṁ . . . ~o para-
mena assāsena (paron.), assāsāya ca dhammaṁ de-
semi, Vin I 236,11(234,36) = AN IV 185,1(182,29);
danto dametā, santo ca sametā, nibbuto isi ḷ nibbā-
petā ca, ~o assāsetā mahājanaṁ, Ap 460,22; ~o
assāsessāmi, Ud-a 133,18; Pj I 22,5; ahañ c' amhi ~o,
loko ca an-assattho, Paṭis I 131,1, quoted Ud-a
144,18; kena puñña-kammena ~ā acchasi, Vv-a 80,22
(cf. assāsa 2 c-d).

1assattha, m. [sa. açvattha], the holy fig-tree,
Ficus religiosa; Abh 551, 1038; assatthassêva taru-
ṇaṁ pavāḷaṁ mālutêritaṁ . . . hadayaṁ me pave-
dhati, Ja V 328,25* (Ct.; cf. assattha-patta); ~e hari-
tôbhāse, Th 217; mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā
rukkhānaṁ ajjhārūhā (°rohā?) . . . seyyath[ī/i]daṁ ~o
nigrodho .. ., SN V 96,7-12; 'khandhabījaṁ' ~o nigro-
dho ti evam-ādi, Spk II 272,9 ≠ Sv I 81,18 ; assattha-
nigrodha-madhūka-vetasā, Ja V 405,22* (see Cks);
ambā ... harītakā āmalakā ~ā, Ja VI 529,21*; ~ā
panasā . . . nigrodhā, Ja VI 550,25*; — ~aṁ va pathe
jātaṁ . . . santānaṁ vissametāraṁ (scil. Vessanta-
raṁ), Ja VI 526,19* (+ nigrodhaṁ ... ambaṁ ... sā-
lam . . . dumaṁ, ib. 22*-31*); ~a-mūle, Ja III 107,11;
— ahaṁ (Gotamo) . . . ~assa mule abhisambuddho,
DN II 4,17 (Sv (II) 415,24—416,31) ≠ Bv XXVI 20;
bodhi tassa bhagavato ~o ti pavuccati, Bv II 69
(quoted Ja I 16,16*) ≠ III 12; assattha-rukkha-mū-
lamhi, Bv II 65; —n., a fig; nigrodha-bījāni pila-
kkh[ū/u]dumbarāni (metr., cf. Bd) ca | ~āni ca bhakkhe-
tvā, Ja III 398,27*.

assatthaka, mfn., made of 1assattha-wood; ~ke
phalamaye ... labhāmi thālake ahaṁ, Ap 311,15
(Ce v. l. asatthake).

assattha-patta, n., an 1assattha leaf; vedhaṁ
~aṁ va, Ja VI 548,19* (= vātena kampita-~am
iva kampiṁsu, pt).

ass'-atthara, (m.) n., = assa-piṭṭh'-attharaṇa;
acc. (āsandiṁ pallaṁkaṁ, goṇakaṁ . . . kuttakam)
hatthattharaṁ ~aṁ rathattharaṁ, DN I 7,10 (Sv:
hatthi-assa-piṭṭhisu attharaṇa-attharakā va) = 65,36
≠ (nam. ~aṁj AN I 181,23 ≠ Vin I 192,9 (acc.) ≠
192,17 (nom. ~aṁ) ≠ II 163,24 (acc.) ≠ 169,34 (nom.).

ass'-attharaka, m. n., carpet with horse-pattern?;
hatth' - attharaka - ~-sīhattharaka - vyaggḥattharaka-
candattharaka-, Ps III 18,11 (explaining sabba-san-
thariṁ) = Spk III 45,4.

assati, (1) pr. 3 sg. (√as3), to throw, Sadd 490,1
(cf. nirassati); 3 sg. aor. te tape assi nirassi pahāsi
viddhamsesī (so v. l.) ti 'tap'-assi', Sp I 136,2; (2) pr.
pass. 3 sg. (do.), Mp-ṭ ad Mp III 216,20, see 'assa-
puṭa.
a-ssati, f., t. q. a-sati, f.; AN IV 192,20, v. l.

assate, 3 sg. pr. pass.: ~te 'asanaṁ', Sadd 865,12
(from √aç 'to eat' or √as 'to throw') ≠ Kacc-v 643
(Senart).

assa-damaka, m. [sa. açva-damaka], a horse-
breaker; dakkho ~o bhadraṁ assâjānīyaṁ labhitvā
paṭhamen' eva mukhâdhāne kāraṇaṁ kāreti, etc.,
MN I 446,3-25 ≠ III 2,3 foll.; ~ena . . . assa-dammo
sārito ekaṁ yeva disaṁ dhāvati . . ., MN III 222,8;
~o, Spk II 220,2 (= 'sūto').

assa-damma, m(fn). [cf. sa. damya, m(fn).; see
Vism 207,23], a (young) untamed horse (colt); MN III
222,9; ahaṁ ~aṁ saṇhena pi vinemi pharusena pi v.
saṇha-pharusena pi v., AN II 112,(7)8 foll.; dve
hatthi-dammā vā ~ā vā go-dammā vā sudantā suvi-
nītā, MN II 129,4 ≠ III 130,(s-)io (Ps); Mp III 120,9;
-— °-sārathi, m., a coachman, expert in breaking
horses; kathaṁ maṁ ajja ~i kāraṇaṁ kāressati, AN II
114,8 ≠ V 323,11; dakkho yoggâcariyo ~i, MN I
124,20 ≠ III 97,8 = SN IV 176,18 - AN III 28,17;
Dhp-a IV 4,8; Kesï ~i, AN II 112,2 (Mp III 120,9:
assa-damme sāretī ti ~i).

a-ssaddha, mfn. [3a + saddhā, sa. çraddhā; or
3a + saddha, Kacc-v 372, Sadd 794,1, mfn., sa. çrād-
dha], unbelieving; ~ā a-ppasannā (q. v.), Vin I 74,15,
etc.; ~o akataññū (q. v.) ca, Dhp 97 (Dhp-a II 187,19;
a 'virodhâbhāsa' JPTS 1908 p. 137,11), quoted Ja III
78,17*, Nidd I 237,3*; ~o ca . . . a-cchandiko ca dup-
pañño ca, AN III 436,3 (opp. saddho chandiko pañ-
ñavā, ib. 12); do. (pl ), Pp 13,9 (quoted Sv (II) 469,30,
quoted and commented upon, Vism 177,11-19) ≠ Vibh
341,39 (Vibh-a 461,25); ~ā dus-sïlā appa-ssutā mac-
charino dn-ppaññā, Dhs 1326 = Pp 20,18 (As 394,1:
n'atthi etāsaṁ(!) saddhă ti ~ā), see AN V 152,22
foll.; bālo ~o dussīlo appa-ssuto, a-vivitto ... a-khīṇâ-
savo samāno, Dhp-a II 77,2; ~o . . . dussīlo, kotū-
hala-maṅgaliko, AN III 206,8; ~o maccharī kadariyo
paribhāsako, AN IV 79,13 ≠vacasā paribhāsati aññe ḷ
~o kadariyo avadaññū ḷ macchari, Sn 663; ~o ahi-
rīko anottāpī (q. v.) appa-ssuto, kusīto muṭṭha-ssati
du-ppañño, MN III 21,19 (see SN II 159,5-11 and AN
V 329,5-8) ≠ AN III 3,10,29; V 125,2; Vin I 63,21;
66,34; — ye te puggalā ~ā jīvikatthă na saddhā
agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajitā, saṭhā . . . kusītā
hīna-viriyā mutthassatino . . . du-ppaññā ela-mūgā,
MN I 32,7-14 (Ps) = AN III 198,26—199,7; V 158,26
—161,4; — °-bhāva, m. abstr.: a-ssaddhâdibhāvaṁ
. . . āgamma, Ud-a 183,19; — °-bhoji(n), mfn. (from
Mahābhāṣya I 101,16: a-çrāddha-bhojin), abstaining
from food during the çrāddha ceremony; Sadd 744,17.

a-ssaddhā,f.,non-faith, disbelief; vināsayati~aṁ
saddhaṁ vaḍdheti sāsane "evam me sutam" ice evaṁ
vadaṁ, Sv I 31,20* = Ps I 7,28* = Ud-a 18,19*, etc.

assaddhiya, n. abstr. of assaddha, mfn. (cf. prec);
yato . . . saddhā antarahitā hoti, ~aṁ (v. l. assaddha)
pariyuṭṭhāya tiṭṭhati, AN III 5,6; (āhāro a-yoniso-
manasikārassa), AN V 113,(19(-)21) ≠ 117,(4(-)6); ~aṁ
pahāya, avadaññutaṁ, kosajjaṁ, AN V 148,18; ~aṁ
. . . dhamma-vinaye parihānam etaṁ, AN V 158,26—
161,5; ~aṁ ahirīkam anottappaṁ (q.v.), AN III
421,9; Nett 40,5; SvI 31,18 (opp. saddhā-sampadā)
= Ps I 7,26 etc.; ~e na kampatī ti 'saddhā-balaṁ',
As 145,16; assaddhiyâdīnaṁ citta-dosānaṁ vigatattā
... desanāya bhājana-bhāv[ū/u]pagamanena kammanīya-
cittaṁ, Ud-a 282,35; ~e akampiya-maṇḍo saddhāba-
laṁ, ~aṁ kasaṭaṁ chaḍḍetvā ..., Paṭis II 86,(12(-)25);
~assa an-upaṭṭhānaṁ saddhindriyassa assādo hoti,
Paṭis II 8,21; saddhāya pariggahitaṁ cittaṁ ~e na
iñjati (Ee ijjhati), Paṭis II 206,24 (quoted Vism 386,21,
Ud-a 186,12); no ce assaddhiyam avatiṭṭhati (C-mss.
otiṭṭhantil), SN I 25,17* (unmetrical, like 19* ib.;
yadi ~aṁ na tiṭṭhati, Spk).

assa-dūta, m., a mounted messenger (or scout);
catuddisā ~e uyyojetvā, Vin I 16,13 (= ārūḷha-asse
dūte, Sp-ṭ); Aṅkuro ~ehi catusu disāsu pānīyaṁ
maggāpesi, Pv-a 112,30.

assa-dosa, m., the vice(s) of an assa(khaluṁka);
pl. aṭṭha ~ā, AN IV 190,18—192,15.

a-(s)sandamāna, neg. part. med. of sandati sa.
syandati, to flow; pl. f. nadiyo ~ā atthaṁsu, Ja I
51,18 (cf. Sv (II) 440,16, Ps IV 186,23; Ap 158,19).a-ssandamāna

assa-nāvika, m., a horse-freighter; — °-puttā,
pl., designation of two Tamil chiefs, Mhv XXI 10 (see
Trsl. p. 143 note 1).

assa-paṇ[ī/i]ya, n. [cf. sa. paṇya], horses for sale;
puriso udayatthiko ~aṁ (readings: paṇiyaṁ, paṇī-
yaṁ, pāṇivaṁ) poseyya, AN II 199,20 (Mp III
180,8-13).

assa-paṇ[ī/i]ya, n. [cf. sa. paṇya], horses for sale;
puriso udayatthiko ~aṁ (readings: paṇiyaṁ, paṇī-
yaṁ, pāṇivaṁ) poseyya, AN II 199,20 (Mp III
180,8-13).

assa-panti, f. [cf. sa. paṅkti], a row (file) of
horses; sabbaṁ rājaṅgaṇaṁ nirantaraṁ ~īhi pari-
kkhittam iva ahosi, Ja II 290,19, cf. Ja VI 275,5.

Assapāla, m., Npr. of the second son of king
Esukari's purohita, brother of Hatthipāla, Gopāla and
Ajapāla; Ja IV 476,5 (assa-gopakānaṁ santike vaḍ-
ḍhati) . . . 491,4 (= Sāriputta).

assa-piṭṭha, n. [cf. sa. pṛṣṭha, which is orig, a
samāsânta-form of *pṛṣṭhi, cf. avest. parśti, Pali
piṭṭhi; Pali -piṭṭha mainly in loc. — 'on', 'above'[,
horse-back; hatthi-gīvāya vā nisinno ~e vā nisinno
rath[ū/u]patthare vā ṭhito, DN I 103,30; ~e nisinno,
Dhp-a III 82,2; ~e ṭhapita-kumbhaṇdam iva (an
instance of unstable equilibrium), Sv I 73,18 = Ps II
206,30.

assa-piṭṭh'-attharaṇa, n., the saddle (or sadd-
ling) of a horse; cammaṁ vihananti eḷakassa | ~assa
hetu, Ja VI 353,27*.

assa-piṭṭhi, f. [see assa-piṭṭha], horse-back; abl.
~ito oruyha, Ja VI 273,7*; ~ito otaritvā, Dhp-a II
121,9.

2assapuṭa, mfn., deserving the 1assapuṭa- pe-
nance; AN II 242,11,14,20, see above.

1assa-puṭa, (m.) n., a bag (purse) containing
ashes [8assa < *āsya, deriv. of ved. āsa m., 'ashes', cf.
Kern Toev. I p. 91,2; B-mss. and -editions have lectio
facilior: bhassa- or bhasma-; the gloss khipīyati
(Sv-pṭ, Mp-ṭ, below) points to an etym, from √as (Sadd
490,1), not from √bha(ṁ)s]; kāḷakaṁ vatthaṁ pari-
dhāya kese pakiritvā ~aṁ khandhe āropetvā . . .
evaṁ vadeyya: ahaṁ bhante pāpaṁ kammaṁ akā-
siṁ (cf. ib. 241,27, 242,28) gārayhaṁ (2)assapuṭaṁ,
AN II 242,9-11 (confessing a delict involving symbolic
scattering of ashes on the head, and exile); Mp III 216,20:
'~an' ti chārikā-bhaṇḍikaṁ (v. l.) ... 'gārayhaṁ
assapuṭan' ti garahitabbaṁ (v. l.) chārikā-puṭena mat-
thake abhighātârahaṁ; Mp-ṭ (Be) and pt ad Sv I
267,21 (Be): [bh]assati niratthaka-bhāvena khipīyatī
ti '[bh]assaṁ' (Mp-ṭ: bhasmaṁ) chārikā (Mp-ṭ adds
tassa puṭaṁ bhaṇḍikā 'bhasma-puṭaṁ'); khura-muṇ-
ḍaṁ karitvā ~ena vadhitvā raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pab-
bājeyyuṁ, DN I 98,24 (Sv I 267,21: '~enā' ti bhasma-
puṭena, sīse chārikaṁ okiritvā ti attho).

Assapura, n. [accord, to Ja from 6assa], name of
an Aṅga-city; ~aṁ nāma Aṅgānaṁ nigamo, MN I
271,8 (Ps); 281,3; its foundation, Ja III 460,23; —
°-sutta, n., (1) Mahā-Assapurasutta = MN (ch. 39)
I 271—80; reference in Ps III 265,7 (o: Ps II 323,22
foll.): Mahā-Assapure vuttaṁ; Ps IV 230,17: Assa-
purasutte (ɔ: Ps II 323,30); (2) Cūḷa-Assapurasutta
= MN I (etc. 40) I 281—84.

assa-pota, m., a colt; ~o, Sadd 417,27* (= ki-
soro, khaluṁko); Mp II 381,8 (v. l. (Se) °gotto;
= 'assa-khaluṁko'); ~a-ppamāṇo (said of a kapi), Ja
I 278,18 (= as-pæṭavaku-pamaṇa, Ja-pot); °-ka,
m., id.; Ja II 288,1,3, foll. (≠ sindhava-potaka);
sarīraṁ pan' assa (ɔ: a miga) mahantaṁ ~a-ppamā-
ṇaṁ (v. l. assapota-pp°) ahosi, Ja I 149,22.

assa-bandha, m. [cf. sa. açva-bandha], a groom
(or 'master of the horse' ?; alternating with assa-
bhaṇḍa, see Kern, Toev. I p. 35, referring to (pehl.)
bandak); hatthi-bandhaṁ ~aṁ go-purisañ ca . . .
anupatanti nāriyo, Ja V 449,3* (no v. l.); Giridatto
(so v. l.) nāma ~o, Ja II 98,10 (= assa-gopako [q. v.],
pt); sundaraṁ ~aṁ, ib. 26; assabandhâdayo, Dhp-a I
392,19 (= as-govu-æyihu, gp); assâcariya-assavejja-
assabandhâdayo, Mp ad AN IV 107,12 (= 'assâ-
rohā') = Sv I 156,17 (Ee °bhaṇḍa°; Bm °meṇḍa°;
cf. Sv-pṭ (Be): hatthi-meṇḍā nāma hatthīnaṁ pāda-
rakkhakā); +hatthi-bhaṇḍe †assa-bhaṇḍe upasamka-
mitvā, Vin I 85,35 (no v. l.; Sp: 'hatthi-bhaṇḍe assa-
bhaṇḍe' (v. ll. °gaṇḍe) ti hatthi-gopake ca assa-gopake
ca); 86,1-5 [the textform hatthi-bhaṇḍā assa-bhaṇḍā
<; (a more idiomatic formula) *hatthi-meṇḍā assa-
bandhā?].

assa-bhaṇḍaka, (n.), horse-trappings, PED;
~ena alaṁkaritvā assaṁ adāsi, Ja II 113,23 (= san-
nāha-sannaddhayen sarahana lada açvayeku ... dī,
Ja-pot).

a-ssabhāva, m. [cf. sa. svabhāva], impropriety
(of view or conduct); ~o, Ja III 367,20' (= 'a-dham-
mo').

assama, m. [sa. āçrama], (1) a hermitage (ɔ: forest
dwelling of an ascetic [jaṭila, brāhmaṇa], with paṇṇa-
sālā, caṅkama, and not far from a gocara-gāma [Pj II
581,14-15]); Abh 928, 409 (the sense (2) 'stage of life'
only here); —detailed descriptions: ~o sukato may-
haṁ (scil. Sumedha), Bv II 29(—33; Bv-a Ce 62,17—
65,7) ≠ Ja I 6,11—10,29*; do. (o: Sāriputta), Ap 15,6
—17,24 = Th-a Ce II 95,9*—97,8*; do. with similar de-
scriptions of flora and fauna: Ap 328,22—329,2, 345,24
—348,17,362,3—363,14,367,23—369,8, and, especially
(Vessantara): Ja VI 520,2—521,7, 528,22*—531,24',
533,27*—540,15'; — ~o sukato mama, Ap 397,16 ≠
421,25 — 431,17; ~aṁ sukataṁ katvā, Ap 452,4; Cp
I 9,42; ~o mayhaṁ Vissakammena māpito, Ap 342,3;
~aṁ tattha māpetvā, Ap 370,25; ~o, Ja VI 530,13*;
557,11*; 559,31*; ~aṁ, ib. 532,1*; Ja V 321,2*( =
assama-padaṁ, Ct.); ~e, Ja VI 550,15*; assamâbḥi-
mukho agamāsi, Ja VI 541,16; — Uruvela-Kassapassa
jaṭilassa ~o, Vin I 24,19; 26,1 (of other jatilas: Vin
I 246,26, IV 109,2, DN II 339,28); Rammakassa brāh-
maṇassa ~o, MN I 160,26; puna pāvisi ~aṁ (scil.
Bāvari), Sn 979; — bhuttañ ca pītañ ca tav' assa-
mamhi, Ja IV 281,11* (= tava nivesane, Ct.; politely
of the home of a brahmin farmer, cf. sense (2); [~aṁ
taṁ, Ja V 200,21*, 201,3* see assam'-anta]; — ifc. v
Kaviṭṭhak(a)-° (Ja III 463,7-11), van'-° (Ja V 203,14*X

assa-maṁsa, n., horse-flesh; na ~aṁ pari-
bhuñjitabbaṁ, Vin I 219,(10-)16; Vin-vn 431 ≠ Khud-
das X 1.

a-ssamaṇa, m. [cf. sa. çramaṇa], a non-ascetic
(often: an unworthy monk); yam nūnâhaṁ ~o assaṁ,
Vin III 25,1].'; 27,8 (Sp I 254,8-14); ~o hoti a-sakya-
puttiyo, Vin I 96,26—97,16; ~o samaṇa-paṭiñño, AN
II 239,30; mayaṁ hi pubbe ~ā va samānā 'samaṇ'
amhā' ti paṭijānimha, MN I 177,21 (Ps); Ps II 4,2-4;
~e samaṇa-mānine, Sn 282; so maṁ daṇḍena pahāsi
(metr. *pâhāsi) yathā ~o tathā, Ja III 85,12* (Ct).

1Assa-maṇḍala, n., a manege-ground; assaṁ
ānane gahetvā ~e parivatteyya, Ja II 99,8' (= 'maṇ-
ḍale'); sabba-disāsu ~e assam iva mettā-sahagataṁ
cittaṁ sāreti pi paccāsāreti pi, Vism 308,24; ~ato
yāva Gampāya, Ps III 7,13.

2Assamaṇḍala, n., 'a locality at Anurādhapura';
— °vāmena, Mliv I App. B 15 = Mhbv 136,17*; —
°-tittha, n., Mhv LXXII 27 (Trsl. (I) p. 321 note 5).

assa-maṇḍalikā, f. pl., (the circular horse pens)
'the camp of the Uttarāhakā assa-vāṇijā' (q. v.); ~āsu
bhikkhūnaṁ pattha-pattha-puḷakaṁ (see Sp) paññat-
taṁ hoti, Vin III 6,22 (Sp I 176,4-10; Sp-ṭ).

a-ssamaṇī, f. [cf. prec], an unworthy nun; ~ī
hoti a-sakyadhīt(ar)ā (q. v.), Vin IV 214,29' (220,1',
222,1').

assam'-anta, m. [see anta 7], i. q. assama-pada;
ubho va gacchāmase ~aṁ, Ja V 200,21* (Ee assamaṁ
taṁ); te yeva pucchesi mam' ~aṁ, ib. 201,3* (do.).

assama-pada, n., an assama(-ground); atha naṁ
~aṁ netvā . . . paṭijaggi, Dhp-a I 166,10; pannarasa-
yojanaṁ ~aṁ māpehi, Ja I 315,3 (cf. Ja IV 489,5 foll.)
≠VI 520,(2(-)30); Ja V 75,19; 321,3'(= 'assamaṁ');
phalâphalaṁ āharitvā ~e ṭhapetvā, Ja VI 76,5;
~-dvāre, Ja VI 520,10; — ~aṁ vaṇṇento āha, Ja
VI 529,19 (scil. 529,20*—530,28*); isīnaṁ ~ena gac-
chanto, Spk I 346,18.

assama-magga, m., the way leading to an a°;
~-passe, Ja V 201,6'.

-assamiya, mfn., living in an assama; in (acc.
pl.) Keniy'-assamiye jaṭile, Sn p. 105,9 (= Keṇiyassa
assama-nivāsine, Pj).

2Assamukha, n., one of the four outlets of Ano-
tatta (Sīha-, Hatthi-, Assa-, Usabha-m°); Ps III
36,10; Pj II 438,14; Ud-a 301,9, quoted Ss 249,5.

1assa-mukha, mfn., horse-faced; f. ~ī yakkhinī,
Ja III 502,19-20 [Ee assu-mukhī].

assa-muṭṭhika, mfn. [9assa, sa. açman + muṣṭi
+ ka], 'with a stone in his fist', a class of tāpasas
(≠ Ap 18,24 amhanā koṭṭikā, sa. açma-kuṭṭaka);
'divase divase bhikkhā-pariyeṭṭhi . . . dukkhā . . .' ti
muṭṭhi-pāsāṇena ambāṭakâdīnaṁ rukkhānaṁ tacaṁ
koṭṭetvā khādanti, te ~ā nāma, Sv I 271,1-4 (pt
(Ee) reads: ayamuṭṭhikā, q. v.) ≠ Pj II 295,20-24.

[assa-meṇḍa, v. l. (B) for assa-bhaṇḍa (-bandha,
q. v.), Sv I 156,17', cf. hatthi-meṇḍa].

assa-medha, m. [sa. açva-medha], the horse
sacrifice; Abh 413; ~aṁ purisa-medhaṁ sammā-
pāsaṁ . . ., SN I 76,20* (Spk: assam ettha medhanti
vadhantī ti ~o) = AN II 42,29* (Mp) = IV 151,7*
(Mp) = Sn 303 (Pj) = It 21,14* (It-a); accord, to
Spk I 144,28—145,2 (= Mp ad AN IV 151,7* = It-a
I 93,17-21) assamedha replaces [after the vipallāsa
of the brahmins, Sn 299] a sassa-medha, crop-tithe,
of old; — °-vikappa, m., a variety of (or substitute
fori) a°; Spk I 146,9 . . . It-a I 94,29.

assaya, m. [sa. āçraya], support (cf. also āsaya
[√çī] in the sense vasana-ṭṭhāna, Spk I 101,10); ifc. v.
an-, pad'-assaya (Mhv XX 52), [puññassaya, Sv I
67,18 read puññussaya, Ps I 51,20].

assa-yāna, n., a horse as a vehicle; bhaddakaṁ
vata bho ~aṁ, sace damathaṁ upeyya, DN II 174,29
(scil. the assa-ratana); hatthi-yānaṁ ~aṁ sivikaṁ
sandamānikaṁ ḷ labhāmi, Ap 387,3; hatthi-yānaṁ
. . . ~aṁ . . . ratha-yānaṁ, etc., Mil 276,25; hatthi-
yānaṁ ~aṁ go-yānaṁ . . . khara-yānaṁ, Nidd I
145,19; na hatthi-yānaṁ samaṇassa kappati ḷ na
~aṁ na rathena yātuṁ, Spk I 83,4*.

assayin, mfn. [cf. assaya], having for support,
dependent on; ifc. v. man'-assayi(n), mfn. (= 'mā-
nassi(n'), Sp ad Vin II 183,14 (see PED s. v. mānassi(n)).

1Assayuja, m. [sa. Açvayuj], the first nakṣatra;
Sadd 251,2; 359,15-16; Abh 58; ~a-nakkhattena (Bha-
gavato) devôrohanaṁ, Sv (II) 425,15.

2Assayuja, m. [sa. Açvayuja], the month under
1A° (Āçvina); Sadd 583,18, Abh 75; Assayuja-Kat-
tikā-māsā hi loke sarada-utā ti vuccanti, It-a I 90,7;
Bhes 6:2 (= vap-masa, sn); ~-sukka-pakkhe, Mhv
XVIII 7.

assa-yuddha, n., horse-fight (amusement); hatthi-
yuddhaṁ ~aṁ . . . vaṭṭaka-yuddhaṁ, DN I 6,14.

a-ssara(t), mfn., neg. part, of sarati (√smṛ) to
remember; nom. pl. m. brāhmaṇā porāṇaṁ °rantā
evam āhaṁsu, DN III 81,23 (Sv (III) 862,13-19 : —
a-saramānā . . . (an)anussarantā).a-ssarat

a-ssara, mfn., without a vowel: ~aṁ (scil.
vyañjanaṁ), Kacc 10 (Sadd 611,(5-)13), see adhoṭhita.

assa-raja(n), m., an excellent horse; DN II
174,27 (scil. Valāha(ka), see assa-ratana); Ja V
408,32* (~a-harayo); Ja I 62,5 (Kanthaka); Vv-a 314,7
(do.); Ja VI 302,25*; Ud-a 281,34 = Sv (II) 472,10
(refers to Ja II 129,8—130,20: Valah'-assa-raja(n));
ifc. v. manomaya-° (Ja V 409,24').

assa-raja(n), m., an excellent horse; DN II
174,27 (scil. Valāha(ka), see assa-ratana); Ja V
408,32* (~a-harayo); Ja I 62,5 (Kanthaka); Vv-a 314,7
(do.); Ja VI 302,25*; Ud-a 281,34 = Sv (II) 472,10
(refers to Ja II 129,8—130,20: Valah'-assa-raja(n));
ifc. v. manomaya-° (Ja V 409,24').

assa-ratana, n. [sa. açva-ratna], a precious
horse; ~am pi Kesiṁ . . . ānetha, Ja VI 135,28* (Ee
assataraṁ); SN I 97,8 (Spk I 163,30 foll.); esp. the
horse of a Cakravartin: rañño Mahā-Sudassanassa ~aṁ
pātur-ahosi, sabba-seto kāka-sīso . . . Valāhako nāma
assa-rājā, DN II 174,26—175,8 (Sv (II) 625,15-30;
Pj I 172,25-27); SN V 99,5 (Spk III 154,8); DN I 89,2
(Sv I 250,11) ≠ Sn p. 106,13, etc.

a-ssara(t), mfn., neg. part, of sarati (√smṛ) to
remember; nom. pl. m. brāhmaṇā porāṇaṁ °rantā
evam āhaṁsu, DN III 81,23 (Sv (III) 862,13-19 : —
a-saramānā . . . (an)anussarantā).a-ssarat

[assarati, pr. 3 sg., v. l. for āsarati (q. v.) or
sarati, Nidd-a I 207,12 (cf. 410,4)].

assa-ratha, m., a chariot drawn by horses;
assena yutto ratho ~o, Rūp Ce 129,22 (Sadd
755,17); acc. sg. ~aṁ, Vin I 272,17; pl. ~ā sannaddhā
ussita-ddhajā, Ja VI 50,5* ≠ acc.pl. ib. 48,13*;
[assāsayi ~aṁ brāhmaṇassa dhanesino, Ja VI 512,28*
(Ct.: 'assāsayī' ti paritosento niyyādesi; pt: 'assa'
brāhmaṇassa, 'rathaṁ' 'assāsayi' adāsi, the horses
being devaputtas, ib. 512,21-23, Cp-a 86,1-12)].

assa-rūpaka, n., the likeness of a horse; Dhp-a
II 69,22.

assa-lakkhaṇa, n. [cf. sa. lakṣaṇa], (the science
of) the (auspicious) marks of a horse (cf. Bṛhat-Saṁhitā
ch. 66); (maṇi-lakkhaṇaṁ +) ~aṁ, DN I 9,20; (among
the aṭṭhārasa mahā-sippāni), Sadd 504,18.

assa-laṇda, n., horse-dung; Ja III 85,21' ≠
Dhp-a IV 156,14'.

Assalāyana, m. [sa. Açvalāyana], Npr. (1) of
a young brāhmaṇa; MN II 147,9—157,17; Pj II
372,25; (2) of the father of Mahā-Koṭthita, Ap 480,17
= Tti-a Ce 31,11*; — °-sutta, n., title of MN (ch. 93)
II 147—57; reference Pj II 406,26.

2assava, m. [sa. āsrava; cf. assāva], purulent
matter; Abh 1036 (= pubba ɔ: sa. pūya); cf. kaṇḍu
vā piḷakā vā assavo ("discharge", SBE) vā thullakac-
chā vā, Vin I 202,24 (scil. anujānāmi cuṇṇāni bhe-
sajjāni) ≠ 296,5, further cf. āsavaṁ deti, AN I 124,8.

1assava, mfn. [sa. āçrava, Sadd 636,19-24], do-
cile, compliant, obedient; ~o, A.bh 730 (= subbaco);
sussūsā seṭṭhā bhariyānaṁ yo ca puttānam assavo,
SN I 6,26* (= āsuṇamāno (v. l.), Spk); bhavati
parijan' assavo vidheyyo, DN III 154,1* (= vaca-
nakaro, Sv); yakkhā va te ~ā santi keci, Ja IV 98,3*
(= vacana-kārakā, icchif-icchita-dāyakā, Ct.) ≠
98,6*; sajīvavā ~o pārisajjo, Ja VI 214,2* (= attano
ovādakara-parisâvacaro, Ct.); kacci te sādisī bhariyā
~ā piya-bhāṇinī, Ja IV 428,7* = V 348,21* (= va-
cana(ṁ)-sampaṭicchikā, Ct.; Sadd 636,19) ≠ VI
49,11*, 51,3*, 53,20*; gopī ca ahañ ca ~ā, Sn 32;
gopī mama ~ā alolā, Sn 22; cittaṁ mama ~aṁ
vimuttaṁ, Sn 23; arahato cittaṁ . . . dantaṁ sudan-
taṁ ~aṁ vacana-karaṁ, Mil 254,7; catur-aṅginiyā
senāya ... ~āya ovāda-paṭikarāya, AN III 151,20
(Mp III 285,14); — ifc. v. an-° (Mp III 285,15).

assa-vata, n. [cf. sa. vrata], 'the horse-practice'
(followed by some ascetics, cf. go- and kukkura-vata,
Ps III 100,18 foll); hatthi-vataṁ ~aṁ, etc., Nidd
I 92,25; — assa-vatika, m(fn)., observing that;
Nidd I 89,18 (see Nidd-a I 217,34—218,8).

assavati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. *ā + sravati, cf. āsa-
vati], to flow (on); pot. 3 sg. āvedhañ ca na passāmi
yato ruhiram assave, Ja II 276,1* (= pagghareyya,
Ct.; Sadd 621,27).

a-ssavana, n. [neg. verb, noun of suṇoti, √çru],
non-hearing; Pj II 398,18; ~-bhāva, Sv I 28,31 = Ps I
5,7; Ud-a 12,25—43,2; — °-ka, mfn., not hearing, not
docile, Nidd-a ad Nidd II 195,10 (= 'an-assava'); —
°-tā, f. abstr.; abl. ~ā dhammassa parihāyanti ('because
they do not hear the Doctrine'), Vin I 5,25, 21,7 = DN II
38,15, 46,29 = MN I 168,22, III 261,27 = SN I
105,32, 137,16 (= assavanatāya, Spk I 172,27).

a-ssa-vasa, mfn. [cf. sa. sva-vaça], who cannot
help one's self; 'jarâturan' ti jarāya āturaṁ jarāya
kilantaṁ ~aṁ, pt ad Sv (II) 455,15.

assa-vāṇija, m., horse-dealer; Uttarāhakā (so,
for lectio facilior Uttarāpathaka, with Sp-t, MSL
1935 p. 271,34) ~ā, Vin III 6,20 (Sp I 175,28—176,4;
Sp-ṭ); — °-ka, m., id.; Dhp-a II 154,2.

assa-vāla, (m.), horse-hair; ~ehi kata-kamba-
laṁ, Sv (II) 357,5 (= 'văla-kambalaṁ') ≠ pt ad
Sv (III) 1010,6; as material for ropes: Ja IV 278,20',
V 358,28.

assasati, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ā-çvasiti], 1 a. to inhale
(see Vism 272,1-7 > Sadd 399,21—400,6; opp. pas-
sasati): sato va assasati sato passasati, dīghaṁ vā
~anto dīgham assasāmī ti pajānāti, DN II 291,6(-10;
ct. in Paṭis I 176,32—86,9, Vism 271,22—277,19; Sv
(III) 764,10—766,17 ≠ Ps I 248,30—250,25 ≠ Sp (II)
408,12—415,13) = MN I 56,15-22 ("Anâpāna-pab-
baṁ") = 425,9-16 = III 82,27-35 = 89,12-20 = Vin III
70,34—71,15; part, mukhena ~anto pi passasanto pi
tiṭṭhati, Sp (II) 412,12 (panting after a run); ~anto
passasanto (as if snoring) niddaṁ upagañchi, Ja II
53,11; mātā ... ~antī passasantī rodati, Spk I 307,26;
[~anto, better C* sn: passasanto, Dhp-a I 215,25]; 1 b.
to breathe on someone (acc. or gen.), so as to harm (by
magic); pr. and inf. yakkhā pisācā athavā pi petā
kupitā pi te ~anti manusse, na maccuno assasit'
ussahanti, Ja IV 495,8*-9* (= assāsa-vātena upa-
hananti, āvisantī ti vā attho, Ct.); — 2. ('to get one's
wind'), to compose one's self; abs. mutto dāmāto kuñ-
jaro muhuttaṁ ~itvāna agamā yena pabbato, Ja
IV 93,28* (= thokaṁ vissamitvā, Ct.); to take
courage; imp. 2 sg. amma ~a (Ee assāsa) mā soci,
Ja VI 190,9*; ~a (so metre; Ee assāsa), hessāmi te
pati, Ja VI 265,22*; ~a (do., do.) hessasi bhariyā
[ - ˇ - , see Ee, note] mamaṁ, ib. 25*; imp. 3 sg. ~at'
āyasmā, SN V 408,27 (so Spk III 291,28; see assā-
seti); [abs. ~itvā, Ja IV 111,15, read assāsetvā, see
v. ll.]; — 3. (i. q. vissasati) to put confidence (in: loc.
[and acc.1] personæ): pot. 3 sg. †nâsmase kata-
pāpamhi, nâsmase (a)likavādine, †nâsmas' attaṭṭha-
paññamhi, atisante pi †nâsmase, Ja IV 56,23*-24*
(Ct.: †'nâsmase' ti nâssase, ayam eva vā pāṭho, na
vissase ti vuttaṁ hoti; as to -sm-, where we expect
-sv-, cf. -pasmani, Ja V 396,5* [= passe, Ct. — «)pṭ],
possibly also vis[a]maṁ, Dhp-a III 393,3', if for
*vi-svaṁ i. e. akiñcanaṁ [cf. 5assaka, 2assa]; simila-
rity sm: sn in †asmiye, s. v. asnāti); tādisam pi †nâs-
mase, Ja IV 57,2* = 4* — 6* (unmetrical ɔ: tādi-
samhi pi nâ°, see ib. 29'); pp. assattha, cf. assasita.

assa-sadassa, m. [sa. sat + açva], a good
(noble) horse; tayo ~e, AN I 289,16-28 (= assesu
sad-asse, Mp; but sadassa is the opp. of khalumka and
the whole cpd. is the opp. of assa-khaluṁka, ib. 287,28);
IV 397,3—399,10.

assa-sammadda, mfn. [cf. sa. saṁmarda],
crowded with horses; rañño antepuraṁ hatthi-sam-
maddaṁ ~aṁ ratha-sammaddaṁ, Vin IV 160,6 (Sp
reports inferior v. rr. -sammataṁ for -sammaddaṁ,
and antepure ... -sammaddaṁ) = AN V 83,5 (Mp
gives no v. r.).

[assasāpeti, caus. pr. 3 sg.; aor. 2 sg. ~esi, Ja
V 26,16', v. l. for ussayāpesi].

assa-sālā, f. [sa. açva-çālā], a stable, equerry;
asse ~āyaṁ saṇṭhāpesi, Ja I 124,29; — °-nissita,
mfn., situated near an a°; Vin III 151,16.

assasita, (mf)n. [pp. of assasati used as a nomen
actionis], the (mere) breathing; ~-passasita-mattena
jīvanti, na paññā-jīvitena, Pj I 124,24.

assa-sippa, n. [cf. sa. çilpa], horse-lore; Ud
31,27 (cf. Ud-a 205,1: 'hatthi-sippan' ti yaṁ hatthī-
naṁ parigaṇhana-damana-sāraṇa-rogatikicchâdibhe-
daṁ kattabbaṁ, tam uddissa pavattaṁ . . .).

assâcariya, m. [cf. sa. ācārya], (the king's)
horse expert (or equerry); Spk I 34,7; ~-assavejja-
assabandhâdayo, Sv I 156,17 (= 'assârohā'); an
officer of the cavalry: ~ehi, Ja VI 504,25' (= 'gāma-
nīyehi').

assâjān[ī/i]ya, m. [cf. sa. ājāneya], a noble (tho-
rough-bred) horse (opp. assa-khaluṁka); dakkho assa-
damako (q. v.) bhadraṁ ~aṁ labhitvā, etc., MN I
446,4-27 ("Ājānīyasus[ū/u]pamā", MN I 445,27 foll., Ps
III 158,1—162,21) ≠ III 2,4 foll. (Ps IV 69,21-22); tīhi
aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo ~o rājâraho hoti
..., AN I 244,10-15; catuhi do., AN II 113,22-27;
250,3-8; pañcahi do., AN III 248,9 foll.; chahi do, AN
III 282,21 foll. ; atthahi do., AN IV 188,16 foll.; tayo
bhaddā ~ā, AN I 290,33—291,4; IV (397,4) 399,27—
400,1; cattāro do., AN II 114,4—115,5 (cf. Sadd
177,20); — bhikkhu ca khīṇâsavo ~o ca (asaniyā
phalantiyā na santasanti), AN I 77,24 (cf. Ja III
292,1'); bhaddassa ~assa kiñcâpi na evaṁ icchā
uppajjeyya 'aho vata maṁ manussā ājānīya-ṭṭhāne
ṭhapeyyuṁ' ..., AN V 168,29; bhadro ... ~o
doṇiyā baddho na 'yavasaṁ, yavasan' ti jhāyati, AN
V 324,11; Ud-a 185,6 (cf. ib. 266,19); dibbaṁ manoja-
vaṁ ~aṁ paṭilabhi, Pv-a 216,1; ~a-vinay[ū/u]pāyo viya
saddhammo, suvinīta-~a-samūho viya saṁgho, Pj I
21,11-12; — note the spelling: assâjāneyya, Dhp-a
III 49,7.assâjānīya

assâjān[ī/i]ya, m. [cf. sa. ājāneya], a noble (tho-
rough-bred) horse (opp. assa-khaluṁka); dakkho assa-
damako (q. v.) bhadraṁ ~aṁ labhitvā, etc., MN I
446,4-27 ("Ājānīyasus[ū/u]pamā", MN I 445,27 foll., Ps
III 158,1—162,21) ≠ III 2,4 foll. (Ps IV 69,21-22); tīhi
aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo ~o rājâraho hoti
..., AN I 244,10-15; catuhi do., AN II 113,22-27;
250,3-8; pañcahi do., AN III 248,9 foll.; chahi do, AN
III 282,21 foll. ; atthahi do., AN IV 188,16 foll.; tayo
bhaddā ~ā, AN I 290,33—291,4; IV (397,4) 399,27—
400,1; cattāro do., AN II 114,4—115,5 (cf. Sadd
177,20); — bhikkhu ca khīṇâsavo ~o ca (asaniyā
phalantiyā na santasanti), AN I 77,24 (cf. Ja III
292,1'); bhaddassa ~assa kiñcâpi na evaṁ icchā
uppajjeyya 'aho vata maṁ manussā ājānīya-ṭṭhāne
ṭhapeyyuṁ' ..., AN V 168,29; bhadro ... ~o
doṇiyā baddho na 'yavasaṁ, yavasan' ti jhāyati, AN
V 324,11; Ud-a 185,6 (cf. ib. 266,19); dibbaṁ manoja-
vaṁ ~aṁ paṭilabhi, Pv-a 216,1; ~a-vinay[ū/u]pāyo viya
saddhammo, suvinīta-~a-samūho viya saṁgho, Pj I
21,11-12; — note the spelling: assâjāneyya, Dhp-a
III 49,7.assâjānīya

assāda, m. [sa. āsvāda]; (1) the act of tasting;
giving the sense of the roots amb (Dhātum 287),
cakkh (Sadd 332,24), ras (Dhātum 451, 871, Sadd
443,18), lih (Dhātum 489), see assādana, n.; —
(2) the act of enjoying (an agreeable sense-impression);
mānasaṁ ubbejayitabbaṁ, ~o na kātabbo, Mil 388,2;
piya-rūpesu ~ena giddhā, Ud-a 120,(21-)30 (= 'piya-
rūpa-sāta-gadhitāse'); evarūpe parakkame kañci assā-
daṁ a-labhitvā, Mil 244,23 (ɔ: no result); aladdhā
tattha ~aṁ vāyas' etto apakkame, SN I 124,7* (cf.
assādanā, ib. &*; 'finding nothing nice') = Sn 448;
Pj II 393,17; — ~o (sukha-saññāya) padaṭṭhānaṁ,
Nett 27,16; — (3) 'tastefulness'; parittam ettha so-
khyaṁ, app' ~o, dukkham ettha bhiyyo, Sn 61 (Pj);
no ce taṁ loke ~o abhavissa, na-y-idaṁ sattā loke
sārajjeyyuṁ, AN I 260,(2(-)33); most frequently together
with ādīnavo and nissaraṇaṁ, for inst.: ko loke ~o,
AN I 258,25(—259,12); ko kāmānaṁ ~o, MN I 85,12
(—88,5; cf. AN II 10,19); indriyānam ~aṁ ... pajānā-
ti, SN V 193,14 ≠ 203,25; Palis II 8,19 foll.; ko cak-
khussa ~o, SN IV 7,2(-2o); ko rūpassa ~o, SN III
27,32 (cf. 62,3); 102,27(—103,6); ko vāyo-dhātuyā
~o, SN II 170,(6(-)20); — ifc. v. a-nir-° (Vism 135,16),
app'-° (mfn., Saddh 51), evam-° (DN III 85,17),
kām'-° (Spk III 103,4), kāy'-° (Ja I 303,6), citt'-° (Ja I
303,6), dassan'-° (Pay II 96,6), dhamma-nimitt'-°
(MN III 225,25), nimitt'-° (SN IV 168,17), nir-°
(Vism 134,27), param'-° (Ap 390,17, 564,26), pavi-
vekaras'-° (Vism 76,11*), putt'-° (AN III 227,23),
phass'-° (Ps I 211,6), bāhir'-° (AN I 280,2), mah'-°
(AN IV 237,6), rah'-assādâpekkha (Sp (IV) 926,18),
ritt'-° (AN I 280,2, read rittâsa, Sadd 177,8, 237,19),
rūpa-nimitt'-° (MN III 225,33), laddh'-° (Ud-a
361,17); lok'-° (Ja I 289,1').

assāda-cetanā, f., intention of (sexual) enjoy-
ment; supinante ~ā, Sp (III) 518,23-24 (cf. 519,8:
mocan'-assada-cetana-vasena); — °-diṭṭhi, f., the
view permitting to enjoy the objects; ~i attânudiṭṭhi
micchādiṭṭhi, AN III 447,23 (ib. 27: ~iyā pahā-
nāya anicca-saññā bhāvetabbā; = sassata-diṭṭhi, Mp
III 415,16); Vibh 368,26-29 (Vibh-a 499,3); among the
soḷasa diṭṭhiyo, Paṭis I 139,2 (—158,36).

assādana, n., i. q. assāda (1), sense of the roots
rak (written dak, Sadd 522,11), ras (Dhātup 325, 629,
Sadd 443,17), lak (Sadd 522,11), lih (Dhātup 335,
Sadd 459,2), sad (Sadd 543,16), sa (Sadd 489,15), sād
(Dhātup 147, Dhātum 221); ifc. v. nir-° (v. l. Ps I
298,23 (Tr.); Vism 135,5 Se).

assādanā, f., the act of tasting; api ~ā siyā (ɔ:
shall we have something palatable), SN I 124,6* (= api
assādo siyā, Spk) = Sn 447 (Pj).

assādanīya, mfn. [ger. of assādeti], palatable,
attractive; abl.(abstr.) ~ato, Ps I 220,13; [~añ ca palo-
bhanīyañ ca, Spk II (277,10)281,19, v. l. for ussada-
tantiyañ (so Ee, pṭ) ca, see note ib.].

assāda-pariyesanā, f., searching for enjoyment;
~aṁ acariṁ (+ādīnava-pariyesanaṁ, nissaraṇa-pa-
riyesanaṁ), SN II 171,(6(-)27) ≠ III 29,3 foll. ≠ IV
8,28 foll.

assāda-baddha-citta, mfn., given to enjoyment
(said of persons); °-tā, f. abstr., Spk II 121,11.

assāda-mattā, f. [cf. sa. mātrā], some (limited)
enjoyment; hoti c'eva kāci s[ā/a]ta-mattā ~ā, yad idaṁ
vaṇa-mukhānaṁ kaṇḍūvana-hetu, MN I 508,2-9
(Ps III 218,13); also v. l. for assāsa-mattā, q.v.

assāda-saññā, f., consciousness of enjoying;
ādīnava-dassanena ~āya (pahānaṁ), Ps I 23,17 =
Spk II 253,31 = Pj II 9,6.

assādânupassi(n), mfn., finding something (loc.)
attractive; saññojaniyesu dhammesu ~ī viharanto,
AN I 50,34; upādāniyesu dhammesu ~ino viharato
taṇhā pavaḍḍhati, SN II 84,25—86,3 (Spk II 81,29);
tassa sārattassa saṁyuttassa sammūḷhassa ~ino viha-
rato, MN III 287,28; — °-tā, f. abstr., AN I 50,32
(opp. nibbidânupassitā); Ud-a 366,7.assādânupassin

assādânupassi(n), mfn., finding something (loc.)
attractive; saññojaniyesu dhammesu ~ī viharanto,
AN I 50,34; upādāniyesu dhammesu ~ino viharato
taṇhā pavaḍḍhati, SN II 84,25—86,3 (Spk II 81,29);
tassa sārattassa saṁyuttassa sammūḷhassa ~ino viha-
rato, MN III 287,28; — °-tā, f. abstr., AN I 50,32
(opp. nibbidânupassitā); Ud-a 366,7.assādânupassin

assādeti, pr. 3 sg. [sa. ā-svādayati], to taste,
enjoy, take pleasure in; yo ... uppannaṁ lābha-
sakkāra-silokaṁ ~eti nikāmeti, SN II 227,29; so tad
~eti taṁ nikāmeti tena ca vittim āpajjati, AN II
126,20(—127,35), quoted Kv 484,28; samāpanno ~eti,
jhāna-nikanti jhānârammaṇā, Kv 483,20—484,34;
taṁ garuṁ katvā ~eti abhinandati, Tikap-a 40,9 (cf.
Tikap 323,9); samāpattim eva ~eti, Dhp-a I 318,10; jī-
vitanikantiṁ jahāti, paviveka-sukha-rasaṁ ~eti, Vism
73,23 (cf. 76,11*); 3 pl. ~enti, Vibli-a 45,15 (= 'ra-
santi'; Sadd 585,24); part, vipassanaṁ ~entassa ni-
kanti-pariyādānaṁ nāma na hoti, Vism 628,7; obhā-
saṁ . . . ~ento nisīdati, Abhidh-av 121,18* (cf. Vism
287,13); ~ento accheyya, Dhp-a I 318,5; ~entaṁ
viya hoti, Sadd 332,25 (= 'cakkhati'); gen. sg.
~ayato, Ud-a 219,8.

assânīka, n.. cavalry forces; (hatthânīkaṁ +)
~am, Vin IV 107,'34'(—108,4'); Spk II 194,6; Ja II
217,18'.

a-ssāmaṇaka, mfn. [cf. sa. çrāmaṇaka], what
does not beseem an ascetic; (an-anucchaviyaṁ +)
~aṁ akappiyaṁ akaraṇīyaṁ, Vin I 45,7; 59,24; III
20,19 (Sp); tena me ummattakena bahuṁ ~aṁ ajjhā-
ciṇṇaṁ, MN II 248,15; bhikkhūnaṁ bahuṁ do. do.,
ib. 250,3-9; samaṇā eva-rūpam ~aṁ an-anucchavi-
kaṁ karonti, Ps II 419,1.

a-(s)sāmanta-pañña, mfn. [cf. sāmanta, a neigh-
bour [and presumably rival] king], of unrivalled
intelligence; Paṭis II 193,21—196,17 (taking sāmantā
= dure), quoted Mp II 82,27—83,22 ; — °-tā, f. abstr.;
dat. gambhïra-paññatāya ~āya saṁvattati, AN I
45,13 (cf. Vyu 48,34-35: gambhīraprajñah, a-sama-
prajñah) ≠ SN V 412,11 (w.r. appamattapaññat-
tāya) ≠ Paṭis II 189,19.a-ssāmanta-pañña

2a-ssāmika, mfn., ownerless, unclaimed (as pro-
perty); Ps I 299,27 (cf. II 88,29); ~aṁ (ratanaṁ),
Pj I 170,15 (opp. sa-ssāmikam, ib. 14); 170,17 (Ee
a-ssāmika-ratanaṁ, v. l. nis-sāmikaṁ ratanaṁ); acc.
sg. f. kuṭiṁ . . . ~aṁ, Vin III 149,10**,25'; pl. kuṭiyo
. . . ~āyo, ib. 144,26 (= an-issarāyo, Sp); assāmi-
kaṭṭhena 'suññato', Mp ad AN IV 423,1 (≠ Ps III
146,8 : nissatta°); — °-bhaṇḍa n., unclaimed property;
~aṁ nāma rañño pāpuṇāti, Ja VI 348,7.

1a-ssāmika, m. [cf. prec], not (the right) owner;
acc. pl. sāmike ~e kātuṁ, Ps II 211,3 (an unfair,
biassed judgment); ~e sāmike karonto, Ja IV 179,6;
Ja V 229,1; ib. 6.

a-ssāmin, m(fn). [cf. sa. svāmin], not a master,
powerless: tattha . . . an-issaro ~ī a-vasavattī, Mil
253,4; attano santakassa ~ino hutvā, Ja III 196,6;
sāmino idha hutvāna honti ~ino [Ee a-sām° against
metre] tahiṁ, Pv 743.
[a-ssāra, mfn., w. r. for a-sāra, Nidd II 278,37].

assârūha, assâroha, m. [6assa + stem of ā-
rohati and ā-rūhati; sa. açvâroha], a horseman; hat-
thârohā ~ā (-o-) rathikā, DN I 51,8 (= sabbe pi
assâcariya-assavejja-assabandhâdayo, Sv); AN IV
107.12 (-o-); nāgo . . . hatthârūham pi hanti . . . ~am
(-ū-) pi hanti, AN II 116,37 ≠ III 162,6; ~o gāmani
(Ee -o-, C-mss. -ū-), SN IV 310,5,8(10)—311,19 (do.);
As 305,19 (-o-); Ja I 179,16 (-o-). — Rem. In Ja VI
50,20* metre seemingly supports the reading of Ee (no
v.l.): kadâssu maṁ assa-rūhā (≠ hattha-rūhā for
hatthi-r°?, ib. 17*); perh. also Ja VI 48,29* ts to be
scanned: kadā ahaṁ *assa-rūhe (and *hatthi-rūhe, ib.
26*); *assa-ruhā would fit the verses as well).

assāvin, mfn. (seeprec.), discharging (asa wound);
vaṇo ~ī, MN II 257,5; 259,12; cf. an-assavi(n).

assāsa, m. [sa. āçvāsa see assasati (1—2)],
(la) inhalation; Abh 39; uddhaṁ-gamā vātā ...
aṅgamaṅgânusārino vātā, ~o passāso, MN I 188,30
(= anto-pavisana-nāsikă-vāto. Ps = Vibh-a 71,1;
but the Vinayaṭthakathā took it = exhalation, see Vism
272,1; Sadd 399,21—400,6 with references) = MN I

assāsa-vāta, m., the (noxious) breath of a preta;

assāsa-virahita, mfn., Sv (II) 635,22 (= 'an-

a-sādu, mfn. [a3 + sādu, sa. svādu], tasteless;

ñesaṁ (scil. nidhiṁ), Khp VIII 9 (= ~o aññesaṁ,
Pj; quoted Saddh 589) - Kv 351,18* ≠ Divy
561,16; ~ā aññesaṁ (scil. dhamma-desanā), Sv I
277,31 (= 'sāmukkaṁsikā') — Ps III 92,10; — ayam
up(a)patti ~ā puthujjanehi, AN II 128,20-27; imāni
satta dhanāni (ɔ: saddhā-dhanaṁ, etc.) ~āni agginā
udakena rāj[ū/u]hi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi, AN IV
7,10; rāja-cora-. . . -ādīhi asādhāraṇa-bhogatā ~-dha-
na-paṭilābho, Pj I 34,1; parehi ~aṁ āveṇiyaṁ dha-
naṁ, Ja VI 128,9'; aggi-ādīhi ~e ṭhāne buddha-
sāsane, Dhp-a III 62,12; aññehi dhanuggahehi ~am

ñāṇa ... sabbaññuta-ñāṇa, Ja I 78,21-26); Saddh
592; sabbaññu-pavāraṇaṁ . . . ~aṁ paccekabuddha-
aggasāvaka-mahāsāvakehi, Spk I 327,20; upari ~-sa-
bhāvaṁ nissāya, Sv I 71,9; — cha-cattārīsa (scil.
sikkhāpadāni) bhikkhūnaṁ bhikkhunïhi ~ā, etc., Vin
V 146,32*-34*; 147,15-32; Utt-vn 810—822 (830—
832), cf. 778—79, 828 (~-paññatta); yā āpat-

cured; sappi-kumbha-satenā pi . . . ~o (scil. vyādhi),
Mhv V 218.

quoted Sadd 285,26; sukarāni ~ūni, Dhp 163 (= apāya-

uncomely, indecent; voc. a-sappurisa ~a, Ja I 495,4'
(= 'asabbhi'); n. ~aṁ lāmakaṁ akusala-kammaṁ,
Ja VI 387,3' (= 'pāpakammaṁ . . . asabbhi-rūpaṁ');
— °-sannivāsa, m., bad company; ~o nāma pāpo
anatthakaro, Ja II 101,15.

a-sāmaêgiya, n. [neg. abstr. of samagga], want

a-sāmañña, mfn. [3a + samañña, çrāmaṇya,

70,26 (+ a-brahmaññatā, q. v.).

bour [and presumably rival] king], of unrivalled

= dure), quoted Mp II 82,27—83,22 ; — °-tā, f. abstr.;

45,13 (cf. Vyu 48,34-35: gambhīraprajñah, a-sama-
prajñah) ≠ SN V 412,11 (w.r. appamattapaññat-
tāya) ≠ Paṭis II 189,19.a-ssāmanta-pañña

asāmanta-paññā, f. (abstracted from prec), un-
rivalled intelligence, Paṭis II 193,21—196,17 (written
assām°), quoted Mp II 82,27—83,22.

a-sāma-pāka, m(fn)., [cf. sāmaṁ by oneself,

cooking (for) himself; pl. ~ā, a class of ascetics, Sv I
270,21; 271,1 ( = asavaṁpācakā, pt; cf. kālapakvabhuj,
Manu VI 17 ≠ Yājñavalkya III 3: 49).

a-sāmayika or a-sāmāyika, mfn. ['double
vṛddhi'? Amg. sāmāia; neg. deriv. of samaya], not

302,28.

Mil 22,9* (like Uttarajjh XXVIII 32) to sāmāyika.a-sāmayika

a-sāmayika or a-sāmāyika, mfn. ['double

302,28.
Rem.; In Sn 54 metre points to sāmayika, in
Mil 22,9* (like Uttarajjh XXVIII 32) to sāmāyika.a-sāmayika

a-sāra, mfn. [ts.], without substance, unsubstan-

654,36 foll.; asāra-rukkha-paricito, Ps II 279,30;
kiṁ . . . kāya-kalinā ~ena, Thī 458; ~e kaḷevare, Thī

(oil.; [~o loko, Sn 937, ' Nidd I 409,14—410,17; but
see asara, mfn.]; satthā ca me lokam imam adhiṭṭhahi
aniccato addhuvato ~ato, Th 1131; ~assa dhanassa
dānaṁ sāro, Ja IV 7,24; ~e sāra-matino sāre câsāra-
dassino, Dhp 11 (Dhp-a: cattāro paccayā, dasa-
vatthukā micchādiṭṭhi, tassā upanissaya-bhūtā dham-
ma-desanā ti ayaṁ ~o nāma); sārañ ca sărato ñatvā
~añca ~ato, Dhp 12; ~esu diṭṭhigatesu, Ud-a 343,15;
~e sāra-yoga-ññu, Ja IV 429,3* (Ct.: '~e' ti nissāra-

a-sāraka, mfn. = prec.; (1) kaṭṭhaṅga-rukkhesu

tucchato suññato ca sabbe dhammā an-attā, Ud-a

a-sāhasiya, mfn. (= prec); — °-kamma, n., i.q.
2a-sāhasa; dhammena samena ~ena āhaṭaṁ, Ja VI
263,7' (= 'dhammâhataṁ', see ib. 267,13*,22*,
280,12*).

tikhiṇa-dhāraṁ ~iṁ sampanna-pāyimaṁ, Ja III

cchedaṁ, Mil 290,19 = 358,6; tikhiṇena ~inā sīse
chijjante pi, SpkI 184,17; ~inā sīsaṁ pātetabbaṁ,

a-sikkhitaka, mfn. = prec; nom. pl. m.
akata-buddhino ~ā, Ja III 58,10' (= 'akatā').

asikkhita-vinaya, mfn., who has not practised
the vinaya (training); — °-tā, f. abstr.; instr, (abl.)
~āya 'a-vinīto', Ps I 194,12.

†asi-koṭṭha, m., said to mean a 'chamār'
(worker in leather; shoemaker); kissa tvaṁ . . . nisīda-
naṁ samantato samañcasi (or °ñchasi) seyyathâpi
purāṇâsikoṭṭho [prob, for °koṭṭo, Oldenbebg], Vin
IV 171,5 (= purāṇa-cammakāro (so Ce), Sp (IV)
884,12-15).

asi-kosa, m. [cf. kosa [sa. koça] and kosī], a
scabbard; Spk III 58,24; ~ato asiṁ nīḥara, Ja III
185,22'; asikos'-attha (for the sake of), Ja V 106,21*;
asikos'-atthaya, ib. 106,3.

asi-(g)gāha, m. [cf. sa. khaḍga-grāhin], 'a
swordbearer'; (1) a swordsman of the guard, (2) a high
officer (orig, one intrusted with the kings sword), see
Cūḷavaṁsa-Trsl. p. XXVIII; (1) asi-ggāhā (v. l. -ggā-
hakā) . . . kosito (v. l. kosato) asiṁ abbāhiṁsu, Sp I
58,10; ~o asiṁ abbāhesi, Ja II 319,23 (= kal va-
ḍannē asi-gānā hō, gp); (parivārenti) rājānaṁ viya
eka-rathe ṭhitā asi-(g)gāha-chatta-(g)gāhā, Ps IV
132,13; — (2) seṭṭhiṁ chatta-(g)gāhaṁ asi-ggāhaṁ, Ja
VI 38,25 (in rank after senāpati and bḥaṇḍâgārika);
Silākāḷaṁ asiggāhaṁ katvā rakkhāya yojayi, asi-
ggāha-Silākāḷo iti tenâsi vissuto, Mhv XXXIX 54—55;
XLIV 1 (later king Samghatissa); 43—54—64 (later
king Silāmeghavaṇṇa); — °-ka, m., id. (1); Sp I 58,10
(v. l.); — °-ka-thāna, n., the office of a° (2), Mhv
XLIV 43.asi-ggāha

asi-(g)gāha, m. [cf. sa. khaḍga-grāhin], 'a
swordbearer'; (1) a swordsman of the guard, (2) a high
officer (orig, one intrusted with the kings sword), see
Cūḷavaṁsa-Trsl. p. XXVIII; (1) asi-ggāhā (v. l. -ggā-
hakā) . . . kosito (v. l. kosato) asiṁ abbāhiṁsu, Sp I
58,10; ~o asiṁ abbāhesi, Ja II 319,23 (= kal va-
ḍannē asi-gānā hō, gp); (parivārenti) rājānaṁ viya
eka-rathe ṭhitā asi-(g)gāha-chatta-(g)gāhā, Ps IV
132,13; — (2) seṭṭhiṁ chatta-(g)gāhaṁ asi-ggāhaṁ, Ja
VI 38,25 (in rank after senāpati and bḥaṇḍâgārika);
Silākāḷaṁ asiggāhaṁ katvā rakkhāya yojayi, asi-
ggāha-Silākāḷo iti tenâsi vissuto, Mhv XXXIX 54—55;
XLIV 1 (later king Samghatissa); 43—54—64 (later
king Silāmeghavaṇṇa); — °-ka, m., id. (1); Sp I 58,10
(v. l.); — °-ka-thāna, n., the office of a° (2), Mhv
XLIV 43.asi-ggāha

asi-camma, n. dvandva [sa. asi + carman, cf.
ManuVII 192; Kacc-v 324 (Sadd 750,23), Mogg-v
III 23], sword-and-shield ɔ: weapon of offence and
defence; ~aṁ gahetvā dhanu-kalāpam sannayhitvā,
Vin II 192,4 = MN I 86,28 (= asiñ c'eva khetaka-
phalakâdīni ca, Ps) = II 99,5 = AN III 93,32 (Mp)
—100,20; ~aṁ gahetvāna khaggaṁ paggayha, Ja IV
184,20* ≠ 364,12* (= asi-laṭṭhiñ c'eva kaṇda-vāra-
ṇañ ca, Ct.); asi-cammâdīni gahetvā, Spk II 183,31;
~assa kovidā, Ja VI 449,16* (= etesaṁ gahaṇe
kusalā, Ct.).

a-sijjha(t), mfn. [neg. part, of sijjhati]; evañ câpi
~ante, Sacc 321 (tf tt will not succeed in that way).a-sijjhat

a-sijjha(t), mfn. [neg. part, of sijjhati]; evañ câpi
~ante, Sacc 321 (tf tt will not succeed in that way).a-sijjhat

asiñcati, preterite (impf.) 3 sg. [augment and prim-
ary ending, see apucchasi], was watering; paresaṁ
bhaṭako poso ambârāmam ~, Vv 877 (= siñcati,
a-kāro nipāta-mattaṁ . . . 'asiñcathā' ti ca pāṭho,
asiňcitthā [so Ce] ti attho; 'asiñc' ahan' ti ca pathan-
ti, Vv-a 307,12-15').

2asita, mfn. [sa. açita; see as(a)nāti], (1) passive
sense: eaten, consumed (as solid aliments); Kacc-v 627
(Sadd 860,4); Abh 757 (khâdita + ; cf. Am-k III
1,110-111); nom. sg. n. ~aṁ paribhuttaṁ, Spk III
8,11; ~a-pīta-khāyita-sāyitaṁ, MN I 422,19 = AN
III 30,2 (do. gen. ib. 32,1); MN I 423,8-9; used as an
infinitive (Kacc 558, Sadd 850,3, 875,24-26, 877,20-23):
abl. aññatr' eva asita-pīta-khāyita-sāyitā . . . aññatra
niddā-kilamatha-pativinodanā, MN I 83,5 — SN I
62,10 = AN II 48,20 = 49,35 = IV 430,4; loc.
abhikkante (see 2abhikkanta) . . . ~e pīte . . . sam-
pajāna-kārī, DN I 70,29 (Sv I 200,7) = II 292,28 =
MN I 57,8 (Ps I 267,6) — AN V 206,28; Pv-a 25,4;
(2) active sense: having eaten, sated, satisfied, (cf.
Kacc-v 628, Sadd 860,8-11): ~o dhāto, Ja VI 555,16*
(= asitâsano, paribhutta-phalo, Ct.); ~o ca gharaṁ
vaje, Ja II 247,10* (= dhāto suhito, Ct.; v. l. āsito,
cf. Pāṇ VI 1,207, and duma-pakkāni-m-āsito, Ja II
446,9* (= rukkha-phalāni khāditvā ~o dhāto suhito,
Ct.), visam āsito, Mil 302,13); — ifc. (2) v. an-° (Vin IV
178,29).

4asita, mfn. [ts], black (= kāḷa, see next, cf. asi-
tâtiga); Abh 96 (≠ Am-kI 5,14); dīgh' assa kesā
~ā atho sūn'-agga-vellitā, Ja VI 86,16*; ~e vellit'-
agge kese (acc. pl.), Ja V 302,5* ( = kāḷake, Ct.);
asita-nicita-muduke kese, Thī 480 (indanīla-bhamara-
samāna-vaṇṇatāya ~e (so Ce), ghana-bhāvena nicite,
Thī-a); asita-ghana-buddha-rasmiyo, Ud-a 412,23;
see asitâpaṅga below.

5Asita, m. [= prec], by-name of several Rṣis:
(1) Asito (Devalo) or Kāḷa-devalo, Kanha-siri-'vhayo
isi; Sirikaṇho (Pj II 487,14), the ascetic (formerly puro-
hita of Suddhodana, Pj II 483,28 foll.) who wor-
shipped the new-born Buddha; Sn 679, 686, 689, 698,
699 (Pj II 483,9 etc.), cf. Ja I 54,16 (. . . 55,29), 67,23,
88,22, VI 479,23 (always Kāḷa-devala, sinh. Kaḷul-
dev-rsi, Amāv 12,12), similarly Sv (II) 435,18 [teacher
of Māyā-devī]; see Mvu II 30,7—33,6; 33,7*—43,5*
[like Sn 679—98 a nidāna to Mvu III 386,18* = Sn 699
('Asitassa')]; Lal 101,1—108,4; Buddha-carita 149
foll.; —- (2) Asito Devalo isi (bodhisatta accord, to Ps
III 411,14), who confounded seven brahmins with the
Gandhabba-pañha; MN II 155,1—157,12; — (3) Asito
Devalo, so Ja III 466,27*, in prose Kāḷa-devala: Ja
III 463,16 . . . 469,21 (= Mahā-Kaccāna at the time
of Sarabhaṅga Bodhisatta), cf. Ja V 151,29*.

6Asita, m. [= 3a-sita], name of a Paccekabuddha,
MN III 70,13* (+ Anāsava, cf. taṁ chinna-ganthaṁ
asitaṁ anāsavaṁ, Sn 219).

3a-sita, mfn. [3a + sita, sa. çrita 'clinging to' +
sa. sita 'bound, fettered'], unattached (synon , anissita)
or unfettered (synon , abaddha); said of Buddhas and
arhats; ~o tādï, Sn 519; ~aṁtādiṁ, Sn 957; ~assatā-
dino, AN III 40,25*; tādiṁ, taṁ chinna-ganthaṁ ~aṁ,
Sn 219; taṁ... bandha-pamuñca(na)-karaṁ ~aṁ, SN I
193,15* = Th 1242; abbūḷha-sallo ~o, Sn 593; nir-āma-
gandho ~o, Sn 251 ≠ 717; ~assa appaṇihitassa (so
Sp-ṭ [CeBe] ad Sp I 251,6 for appahīnassa Ee), MN I
386,25* (= abaddhassa, Ps; Turk. Rem. p. 30,25*);
~o careyyaṁ, Sn 1065; caranti loke ~ā, Th 671: ~aṁ
sabba-lokassa . . . sabba-ppahāyinaṁ, It 97,21* (=
katthaci anissitaṁ . . . sabbasmiṁ satta-loke, It-a);
~o anejo, Th 38; ... te ~ā, . . . te tusită, . . . te
anejā, . . . te sukhitā, AN II 15,28*-30* (tags attached
to the pādas of a mixed stanza 27*-30*, cf. Ud
71,29-30: ... sikkha-sārā ... upaṭṭhāna-sārā); —
sucetaso ~o (v. l. anissito) tadānisaṁso, SN I 46,25*
(Spk; [ ˇ - ˇ - , ˇ ˇ ˇ , ˇ - ˇ - - ]) = 52,28*.

7'Asita, m., Npr. of a māla-kāra [= Sukatâveḷiya
thera] at the time of Sikhi Buddha, Ap 217,2.

1asita, (m.) n. [sa. asida, m., Apastamba-Çrauta-
sūtra 13,1 (= dātra, Ct.); Amg. asiya; cf. hindl ha(rṇ)-
siyā?], a sickle; Abh 448 (dāttaṁ lavittaṁ ~aṁ ≠
dātraṁ lavitram, Am-k II 9,13); 1005 (lavitte asito);
~aṁ gahetvā . . . sāliyo lāyati, Mp ad AN IV 353,9
(the Sālilāyakôpamā) = Ud-a 235,19-29; hatthen'eva
chinditvā vā ~ena lāyitvā vā, Sp (II) 340,7-14 ≠
Vin-vn 155, cf. Pj II 148,18 (niddānaṁ karosi); ~ena
lāyitvā . . . -satthena chinditvā . . . pharasunā koṭ-
ṭetvā ... nikhādanena vijjhitvā, Ja V 46,23 (cf.
45,25); tiṇa-hārako ~añ c'eva kājañ ca [see under
asita-vyābhaṅgī] tiṇabandhana-rajjuñ ca . . . chaḍ-
ḍetvā palāyi, Ja III 129,26; abl. sg. su-muttiko 'mhi
tīhi khujjakehi, ~ā su mayā, naṅgalā su mayā,
khudda[y. r. prob, kuṇṭha-]-kuddālā su mayā, Th
43 (accord, to Th-a asitāsu, etc. are loc. pl. instead of
abl. pl.: lavittehi mayā muttan ti, partly right, for
su stands brachyl, for sumutta). — ifc v. tiṇa-
lāyana-asita (Ps III 429,1).

Asitañjana-nagara, n., the capital of Mahā-
Kaṁsa, Ja IV 79,9; 82,20; Pv-a 111,20 (ib. 111,16
°-nigame, v. l. °nagare); birthplace of Tapassu and
Bhalluka, Mp I 382,12; 383,26.

asit'-anjana, n., black collyrium; °saṁkāsam
ākāsaṁ, Bv-a Ce 137,13 (introd. to Bv VI).

asitabba, mfn. [grd. of as(a)nāti], to be eaten;
Kacc-v 627 (Sadd 860,3); mukhena ~aṁ, As 330,12
(= 'mukhâsiyaṁ').

asita-vyābhaṅg[ī/i], dvandva, prob. f. sg. [see asi-
sūnā], once (Vibh-a-mṭ) f. pl. pasita + vyābhaṅgī, f.,
SN IV 201,4-17 = kāja(-daṇḍaka), Spk, pt, used as
a flail], sickle and carrying pole (flaill), symbolizing
the çūdra life (cf. Turner-N kahār); suddassa san
dhanaṁ paññāpenti ~iṁ, ~iñ ca pana suddo san
dhanaṁ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti, MN II 180,26
(= tiṇa-lāyana-asitañ c'eva kājañ ca, Ps); ~iṁ . . .
kula-putto ohāya ... pabbajito hoti, AN III 5,24
(= tiṇa-lāyana-asitañ c'eva tiṇa-vahanakājañ ca,
Mp; vividhā ābhañjanti bhāraṁ olambanti tenā(I) ti
vy-ā-bhaṅgī, vidham [cf. Sv I 269,2], Mp-ṭ); — °-tā,
f. abstr.; kasi-gorakkhâdinā vesso ahaṁ, ~āya suddo
ahaṁ, Vibh-a 515,15 (= dāttena kājena cā ti etena
parikkhārena, asita-vyābhaṅgīhi lavana-vahana-ki-
riyā vā asita-vyābhaṅgī ti vuttā, mṭ).asita-vyābhaṅgī

asita-vyābhaṅg[ī/i], dvandva, prob. f. sg. [see asi-
sūnā], once (Vibh-a-mṭ) f. pl. pasita + vyābhaṅgī, f.,
SN IV 201,4-17 = kāja(-daṇḍaka), Spk, pt, used as
a flail], sickle and carrying pole (flaill), symbolizing
the çūdra life (cf. Turner-N kahār); suddassa san
dhanaṁ paññāpenti ~iṁ, ~iñ ca pana suddo san
dhanaṁ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti, MN II 180,26
(= tiṇa-lāyana-asitañ c'eva kājañ ca, Ps); ~iṁ . . .
kula-putto ohāya ... pabbajito hoti, AN III 5,24
(= tiṇa-lāyana-asitañ c'eva tiṇa-vahanakājañ ca,
Mp; vividhā ābhañjanti bhāraṁ olambanti tenā(I) ti
vy-ā-bhaṅgī, vidham [cf. Sv I 269,2], Mp-ṭ); — °-tā,
f. abstr.; kasi-gorakkhâdinā vesso ahaṁ, ~āya suddo
ahaṁ, Vibh-a 515,15 (= dāttena kājena cā ti etena
parikkhārena, asita-vyābhaṅgīhi lavana-vahana-ki-
riyā vā asita-vyābhaṅgī ti vuttā, mṭ).asita-vyābhaṅgī

Asit'-avhaya, m(fn.), having the name 5Asita
(1); gen. ~assa, Sn 680 [ ˇ ˇ ˇ ˇ - ˇ , quasi Asita-
vh°]; 698 [do.].

asita-visa, mfn. [2asita], whose food turns into
poison (when digested), said of snakes; Spk III 8,8-12
(explaining āsīvisa).

asitâtiga, mfn. [4asita + ati-ga], an epith. to
the full-moon, having overcome the dark fortnight
(asita = kāḷapakkha?); dakkhem' ogha-taraṁ nāgaṁ
candaṁ va ~aṁ, DN II 261,11* (= kāḷaka-bhāvâ-
tītaṁ, 'spotless', Sv, pt).

asitâpaṅga, mfn. [4asita + apaṅga (1)], with
black (painted) eye-corners; f. voc. ~i, Ja III 419,19*
(v. r. asitâvaṅgi, see 419,25'; = añjana-salākāya
nīharitvā abhisaṁkhita-~i, Ct.; — añjanena akkhi(!)-
añjitattā kāḷavaṇṇa-akkhikoṭivantā, pt).

Asitābhū, f. [cf. sa. asita-bhrū], Npr. of a prin-
cess; Ja II 230,1 ... 231,2* (T; instr. ~uyā); cf.
Vibh-a 470,28—471,3 (quoting Ja II 231,1*-2*).

asitâsana, mfn. [2asita + 1asana, paron.], who
has had his meal, Ja VI 555,29' (= 'asito').

asi-tuṇda, n.(?), the point of a sword; instr.
~ena paṭicchitvā, Ja III 180,25.

asi-tharu, m. [cf. sa. tsaru, prākr. charu, tharu,
Pischel §327], the hilt of a sword; corassa hatthe
~uṁ ṭhapetvā, Dhp-a IV 66,25 ( = kaḍu-miṭu, gp).

a-sithila, mfn., not unsteady, firm; Pj II
146,27-28 (acala+); — °-parakkama, mfn., of un-
failing energy; — °-tā, f. abstr.; nikkamo +, Dhs 13
(= 'viriyindriyaṁ') = 289 = 571 ≠ 22 (= 'sammā-
vāyāmo'); — °-pūraka, mfn., keeping strictly to his
duty; Ps II 403,7.

a-siddha, mfn. (1) = apakka (1) [cf. siddha, v. r.
for pakka, Ja II 435,17*(21')]; asiddha-dussiddhānaṁ
. . . gandho, As 319,32; see asiddha-bhojana; (2) not
proved, not evidenced, in °-tta, n. abstr.; abl. aṇu-
ādīnaṁ ~ā, Vism 509,4.

asiddha-bhojana, mfn., who has not prepared
his food; abhinna-kattho 'si ... ~o, Ja V 201,27*
(Ct.).

asi-dhārā, f., a sword-blade; tikhiṇa ~ā, Spk
III 235,18; — °ûpama, mfn., like that; ~ehi tikhiṇehi
loha-tuṇḍ(ak)ehi, Spk II 217,16 — Sp (II) 507,17;
sara-pattehi ~ehi, Spk III 68,26.

a-siniddha, mfn. [cf. sa. snigdha], not unctuous,
not containing oily ingredients; Abh 977 (= rukkha
ɔ: sa. rūkṣa, otherwise lūkha); Sp (V) 1092,22 (ex-
plaining akaṭayūsa).

2asi-patta, mfn., where the leaves are swords,
found in: °-niraya, m. = next (brachyl.); nikkhanta-
mattam . . . ~ā dukhā, Ja VI 250,10* (cf. Mvu I
12,2*); — °-vana, n., the grove in hell where the leaves
are swords; MN III 185,21, foll.; Sn 673 (Pj II
481,18-24); Saddh 194; °-ppavesanaṁ, Pv-a 221,13.

1asi-patta, n. [sa. asi-pattra], the blade of a
sword, perh. in the cpd.s below.

a-sippa, mfn. [cf. sa. çilpa], who has not learnt
any art or craft; kicchā vutti ~assa, Ja IV 177,24*
(cf. ahaṁ sippavā, ime ni(s)sippā [Cks na-sippā], Ja
IV 77,9'); unskilled, kalim eva nūna gaṇhāmi ~o
dhuttako yathā, Ja VI 228,18* (= asikkhito akkha-
dhutto, Ct.).

a-sippajivi(n), mfn., not living by a craft; ~ī
lahu(-)attha-kāmo, Ud 32,15* (see ib. 31,24 foll.;
Ud-a 206,4-7).a-sippajivin

a-sippajivi(n), mfn., not living by a craft; ~ī
lahu(-)attha-kāmo, Ud 32,15* (see ib. 31,24 foll.;
Ud-a 206,4-7).a-sippajivin

asi-ppahāra, m. [cf. sa. prahāra], a sword-cut;
gen. pl. khamo satti-ppahārānaṁ ~ānaṁ usu-pp° pha-
rasu-pp° (so AN), MN III 133,26 ≠ AN II 117,5.

a-sippi(n), mfn., i. q. a-sippa; nom. pl. dhīrā
ca bālā ca . . . sipp[ū/u]papannā ca asippino ca, Ja VI
356,17*; a-cchekā+, Mil 250,30.a-sippin

a-sippi(n), mfn., i. q. a-sippa; nom. pl. dhīrā
ca bālā ca . . . sipp[ū/u]papannā ca asippino ca, Ja VI
356,17*; a-cchekā+, Mil 250,30.a-sippin

Asi-pāsā, m. pl., a class of genies: Sivā Vasu"
devā Ghanikā ~ā Bhaddiputtā, Mil 191,7.

asi-puttī, f. [sa. asi-putrī], a knife, Abh 392
(churikā sattī [read satthī] +) ≠ Am-k II 8,92.

Asibandhaka-putta, m., designation of a gā-
maṇī, SN IV 312,1 ... 325,11 (no Ct.; C-mss here
always Asibaddha°; possibly for orig. Assa-b°, see
assa-bandha, cf. SN IV 308,17: yodhâjïvo g°, 310,2-5:
hatthâroho g°, assâroho g°); Nett 45,11 (quoting SN
IV 312,5—-314,18; Nett-a (Ce): ~o ti Asibandhakassa
nāma putto).

asi-māla, n. (or °ā, f. ?), only in acc. °aṁ karoti,
to make a (red) sword-garland of somebody, to cut him
into pieces (and arrange them in some artistic way']),
a trick described in Ja III 180,24-26: kaḷevaraṁ
ākāse khipitvā asi-tuṇdena paṭicchitvā ~aṁ nāma
katvā mahātale vippakiri (= çarīraya ākāçayaṭa
damā, kaduven kapā, çarīramāṁsa vadamal-peti-së
kapā dæmīya, Ja-pot); ~aṁ nāma kāresi, ib. 178,2,17
(B-mss prefer °mālakaṁ; pt (Br): °mālakan ti asinā
vicchinditvā cuṇṇaṁ [for cuṇṇī-?] katvā chedanaṁ
°-laṁ nāma).

asi-mālaka, mfn., hewn piece-meal, see prec;
~o 'si kato, Ja III 181,17'.

asimāla-kamma, n., i. q. asi-māla; kārā-
p ay ante ~aṁ, Dāṭh III 35.

asi-lakkhaṇa, n., sword-lore, a text on the signs
of swords; DN I 9,16 (maṇi-lakkhaṇaṁ+) ≠ Ja I
374,13' (subhaga-lakkhaṇaṁ+); asiṁ upasiṁghitvā
(cf. Bṛhat-Saṁhitā 50,21-22, Çārṅgadhara-Paddhati
4683) ~aṁ udāharati, Ja I 455,8; — °-jātaka, n.,
title of Ja (126) 1455—458; — °-pāṭhaka, m., a
doctor of sword-lore; Ja I 455,6 . . . 458,11 (= çastra-
lakṣaṇa-dannā-vū, gp).

asi-laṭṭhi, f. [cf. sa. asi-yaṣṭi, asi-latā], a (long,
narrow) sword-blade; Ja IV 366,25 (see asi-camma);
'naṅguṭṭhena kammaṁ (karoti)' nāma naṅguṭṭhe
baddhāya (Ee bandhāya!) dīghâsilaṭṭhiyā (Ee dīgha-
sīlaṭṭhiyā!) vā aya-musalena vā chedana-bhedanaṁ,
Ps III 128,1; 328,10. — ifc. v. maṅgala-° (Ps III
328,23).

siliṭṭhâsiliṭṭhaṁ, Pp-a 224,7.

a-siloka, m. [cf. sa. çloka], bad fame; Ja VI
491,9*; Sadd 380,5* (cf. a-silāghā); — °-bhaya, n., fear
for a°; ājīvikabhayaṁ +, AN IV 364,28 (— garaha-

I 371,12 (= garahăto bhayaṁ, Nidd-a); ~ena, Sp I

asi-loma, mfn., with hairs (of the body) as

III 106,12-16; Spk, Sp ad locc

(= pharasuñ ca gaṇdikañ ca, Ct.); — °-ûpama, mfn.,

126,26; ~i koṭiyo, BvVIIIβ; XII 11; ~i sata-
